// src/contexts/CurrencyContext.js
import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useMemo } from "react";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import { CURRENCIES, getCurrency } from "../constants/currencies";

const STORAGE_KEY = "@skilledproz:currency";

const CurrencyContext = createContext({
  currency: CURRENCIES[0],
  setCurrencyCode: () => {},
  format: () => "",
});

export function CurrencyProvider({ children, initialCode = "USD" }) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState(initialCode);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) setCode(saved);
      } catch {}
    })();
  }, []);

  const setCurrencyCode = async (next) => {
    setCode(next);
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
    } catch {}
  };

  const currency = getCurrency(code);

  /**
   * format(amount, opts?) → string
   *  - If `currencyCode` is passed in opts, use that currency (per-component override).
   *  - Otherwise use the global currency.
   *  - Uses Intl.NumberFormat for locale-aware grouping when available.
   */
  const format = useMemo(
    () =>
      (amount, opts = {}) => {
        const targetCode = opts.currencyCode || code;
        const target = getCurrency(targetCode);
        const num = Number(amount ?? 0);

        try {
          // Intl is available in modern RN (Hermes 0.74+)
          return new Intl.NumberFormat(opts.locale || undefined, {
            style: "currency",
            currency: targetCode,
            minimumFractionDigits: opts.minimumFractionDigits ?? 0,
            maximumFractionDigits: opts.maximumFractionDigits ?? 2,
          }).format(num);
        } catch {
          // Fallback if Intl unavailable for that currency
          const formatted = num.toLocaleString(undefined, {
            minimumFractionDigits: opts.minimumFractionDigits ?? 0,
            maximumFractionDigits: opts.maximumFractionDigits ?? 2,
          });
          return `${target.symbol}${formatted}`;
        }
      },
    [code],
  );

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      currency,
      currencyCode: code,
      setCurrencyCode,
      format,
      currencies: CURRENCIES,
    }),
    [currency, code, format],
  );

  return (
    <CurrencyContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </CurrencyContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useCurrency = () => useContext(CurrencyContext);

// src/contexts/ToastContext.js
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useEffect,
} from "react";
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  Animated,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Platform,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { useTheme } from "./ThemeContext";

/**
 * Toast types: "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning"
 *
 * Usage anywhere in the tree:
 *   const { toast } = useToast();
 *   toast.success("Logged in");
 *   toast.error("Invalid credentials");
 *
 * The `toast` object and `show` function are stable across renders, so it's
 * safe to put `toast` in useEffect / useCallback dependency arrays without
 * causing re-render loops.
 */
const ToastContext = createContext(null);
const DURATION = 3500;

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id) => {
    setQueue((q) => q.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  // `show` itself is stable (no deps) — safe to put in useCallback deps.
  const show = useCallback((message, type = "info", opts = {}) => {
    const id = ++idRef.current;
    const toastItem = {
      id,
      message: String(message ?? ""),
      type,
      duration: opts.duration ?? DURATION,
    };
    setQueue((q) => [...q, toastItem]);
    return id;
  }, []);

  // `toast` object is memoized so identity is stable across renders.
  // This is the critical fix — without useMemo, every consumer that depends
  // on `toast` re-fires its effects on every render.
  const toast = useMemo(
    () => ({
      success: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "success", opts),
      error: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "error", opts),
      info: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "info", opts),
      warning: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "warning", opts),
    }),
    [show],
  );

  // Provider value also memoized so context consumers only re-render when
  // something they actually use changes.
  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ show, toast, dismiss }),
    [show, toast, dismiss],
  );

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      <ToastViewport queue={queue} onDismiss={dismiss} />
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

function ToastViewport({ queue, onDismiss }) {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  return (
    <View
      pointerEvents="box-none"
      style={[styles.viewport, { top: insets.top + 8 }]}
    >
      {queue.map((t) => (
        <ToastItem key={t.id} toast={t} onDismiss={onDismiss} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function ToastItem({ toast, onDismiss }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const opacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const translateY = useRef(new Animated.Value(-12)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(opacity, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 220,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 240,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start();

    const timer = setTimeout(handleDismiss, toast.duration);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleDismiss = () => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(opacity, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: -8,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start(() => onDismiss(toast.id));
  };

  const palette = getPalette(toast.type, theme);

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        styles.toast,
        {
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
          borderColor: palette.border,
          shadowColor: theme.colors.shadow,
          opacity,
          transform: [{ translateY }],
        },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={[styles.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: palette.bgIcon }]}>
        <Ionicons name={palette.icon} size={18} color={palette.iconColor} />
      </View>
      <Text
        style={[styles.message, { color: theme.colors.text }]}
        numberOfLines={3}
      >
        {toast.message}
      </Text>
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={handleDismiss}
        hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
      >
        <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={theme.colors.textDim} />
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

function getPalette(type, theme) {
  switch (type) {
    case "success":
      return {
        icon: "checkmark-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.green,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.greenDim,
        border: theme.colors.greenDim,
      };
    case "error":
      return {
        icon: "alert-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.red,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.redDim,
        border: theme.colors.redDim,
      };
    case "warning":
      return {
        icon: "warning",
        iconColor: theme.colors.orange,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.orangeDim,
      };
    case "info":
    default:
      return {
        icon: "information-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.orange,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.border,
      };
  }
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  viewport: {
    position: "absolute",
    left: 12,
    right: 12,
    zIndex: 9999,
    elevation: 9999,
    gap: 8,
  },
  toast: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingVertical: 12,
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
    gap: 12,
    ...Platform.select({
      ios: {
        shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
        shadowOpacity: 0.18,
        shadowRadius: 12,
      },
      android: { elevation: 6 },
    }),
  },
  iconWrap: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    borderRadius: 16,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  message: { flex: 1, fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 19 },
});

export const useToast = () => {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error("useToast must be used inside <ToastProvider>");
  }
  return ctx;
};

// src/contexts/ToastContext.js
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  useRef,
  useEffect,
} from "react";
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  Animated,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Platform,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { useTheme } from "./ThemeContext";

/**
 * Toast types: "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning"
 *
 * Usage anywhere in the tree:
 *   const { toast } = useToast();
 *   toast.success("Logged in");
 *   toast.error("Invalid credentials");
 *   toast.info("Heads up");
 *   toast.warning("Are you sure?");
 *
 * Always prefer this over Alert.alert.
 */

const ToastContext = createContext({
  show: () => {},
  toast: { success: () => {}, error: () => {}, info: () => {}, warning: () => {} },
});

const DURATION = 3500;

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id) => {
    setQueue((q) => q.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const show = useCallback(
    (message, type = "info", opts = {}) => {
      const id = ++idRef.current;
      const toast = {
        id,
        message: String(message ?? ""),
        type,
        duration: opts.duration ?? DURATION,
      };
      setQueue((q) => [...q, toast]);
      return id;
    },
    [],
  );

  const toast = {
    success: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "success", opts),
    error: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "error", opts),
    info: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "info", opts),
    warning: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "warning", opts),
  };

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ show, toast, dismiss }}>
      {children}
      <ToastViewport queue={queue} onDismiss={dismiss} />
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

function ToastViewport({ queue, onDismiss }) {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  return (
    <View
      pointerEvents="box-none"
      style={[
        styles.viewport,
        { top: insets.top + 8 },
      ]}
    >
      {queue.map((t) => (
        <ToastItem key={t.id} toast={t} onDismiss={onDismiss} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function ToastItem({ toast, onDismiss }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const opacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const translateY = useRef(new Animated.Value(-12)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(opacity, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 220,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 240,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start();

    const timer = setTimeout(handleDismiss, toast.duration);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleDismiss = () => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(opacity, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: -8,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start(() => onDismiss(toast.id));
  };

  const palette = getPalette(toast.type, theme);

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        styles.toast,
        {
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
          borderColor: palette.border,
          shadowColor: theme.colors.shadow,
          opacity,
          transform: [{ translateY }],
        },
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={[styles.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: palette.bgIcon }]}
      >
        <Ionicons name={palette.icon} size={18} color={palette.iconColor} />
      </View>
      <Text
        style={[styles.message, { color: theme.colors.text }]}
        numberOfLines={3}
      >
        {toast.message}
      </Text>
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={handleDismiss}
        hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
      >
        <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={theme.colors.textDim} />
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

function getPalette(type, theme) {
  switch (type) {
    case "success":
      return {
        icon: "checkmark-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.green,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.greenDim,
        border: theme.colors.greenDim,
      };
    case "error":
      return {
        icon: "alert-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.red,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.redDim,
        border: theme.colors.redDim,
      };
    case "warning":
      return {
        icon: "warning",
        iconColor: theme.colors.orange,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.orangeDim,
      };
    case "info":
    default:
      return {
        icon: "information-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.orange,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.border,
      };
  }
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  viewport: {
    position: "absolute",
    left: 12,
    right: 12,
    zIndex: 9999,
    elevation: 9999,
    gap: 8,
  },
  toast: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingVertical: 12,
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
    gap: 12,
    ...Platform.select({
      ios: {
        shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
        shadowOpacity: 0.18,
        shadowRadius: 12,
      },
      android: { elevation: 6 },
    }),
  },
  iconWrap: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    borderRadius: 16,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  message: {
    flex: 1,
    fontSize: 14,
    lineHeight: 19,
  },
});

export const useToast = () => useContext(ToastContext);

// App.js
import "react-native-gesture-handler";
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from "react-native-gesture-handler";
import { SafeAreaProvider } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import * as SplashScreen from "expo-splash-screen";
import {
  useFonts,
  Syne_700Bold,
  Syne_800ExtraBold,
} from "@expo-google-fonts/syne";
import {
  DMSans_400Regular,
  DMSans_500Medium,
  DMSans_600SemiBold,
  DMSans_700Bold,
} from "@expo-google-fonts/dm-sans";

import { ThemeProvider } from "./src/contexts/ThemeContext";
import { CurrencyProvider } from "./src/contexts/CurrencyContext";
import { ToastProvider } from "./src/contexts/ToastContext";
import { SubscriptionProvider } from "./src/contexts/SubscriptionContext";
import { VoiceCallProvider } from "./src/contexts/VoiceCallContext";
import VoiceCallProviderUI from "./src/components/video/VoiceCallProvider";
import LoadingScreen from "./src/components/LoadingScreen";

import RootNavigator from "./src/navigation/RootNavigator";
import { initI18n } from "./src/i18n";
import i18n from "./src/i18n";
import useOTAUpdates from "./src/hooks/useOTAUpdates";

SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync().catch(() => {});

export default function App() {
  const [i18nReady, setI18nReady] = useState(false);
  const [langKey, setLangKey] = useState("en");

  useOTAUpdates();

  const [fontsLoaded, fontError] = useFonts({
    Syne_700Bold,
    Syne_800ExtraBold,
    DMSans_400Regular,
    DMSans_500Medium,
    DMSans_600SemiBold,
    DMSans_700Bold,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log("🚀 initI18n starting...");
    initI18n()
      .then(() => {
        console.log("✅ initI18n resolved");
        setI18nReady(true);
        setLangKey(i18n.language || "en");
        i18n.on("languageChanged", (lng) => setLangKey(lng));
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.log("❌ initI18n REJECTED:", err?.message || err);
        setI18nReady(true); // Force boot so we can see other errors
      });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log("⏸️ Loading status:", { fontsLoaded, i18nReady, fontError });
    if (fontsLoaded && i18nReady) {
      console.log("🎉 Hiding splash screen");
      SplashScreen.hideAsync().catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [fontsLoaded, i18nReady, fontError]);

  if (!fontsLoaded || !i18nReady) {
    return <LoadingScreen />;
  }

  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={styles.flex}>
      <SafeAreaProvider>
        <ThemeProvider>
          <CurrencyProvider>
            <ToastProvider>
              <SubscriptionProvider>
                <VoiceCallProvider>
                  <RootNavigator key={langKey} />
                  <VoiceCallProviderUI />
                </VoiceCallProvider>
              </SubscriptionProvider>
            </ToastProvider>
          </CurrencyProvider>
        </ThemeProvider>
      </SafeAreaProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  flex: { flex: 1 },
});

=== END: App.js ===

=== FILE: README.md ===
# SkilledProz Hirer — React Native (Expo) App

The Hirer-side mobile app for SkilledProz. Mirrors the website's design system, supports dark/light themes, multi-language (i18n), and multi-currency.

Talks to the same backend as the website: `https://skilledpro-backend-production.up.railway.app/api`.

---

## Setup

```bash
cd SkilledProzHirer
npm install
npx expo start
```

Press `i` for iOS simulator, `a` for Android emulator, or scan the QR with **Expo Go**.

The API URL is read from `app.json → expo.extra.API_URL`. Override it for local dev by editing that file or using `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` env vars.

---

## Project structure

```
src/
  api/client.js              # axios + token refresh + tokenStore (SecureStore)
  components/                # AppText, AppButton, AppInput, AppScreen, AppCurrency, etc.
  constants/                 # theme tokens, currency list, language list
  contexts/                  # ThemeContext, CurrencyContext, ToastContext
  i18n/                      # i18next config + locale JSON files
  navigation/                # Root, Auth, Hirer stacks
  screens/auth/              # Login, Welcome, Register, ForgotPassword, VerifyEmail
  screens/main/              # HomeScreen (placeholder for the Hirer dashboard)
  store/authStore.js         # Zustand store mirroring the website's auth shape
  utils/validators.js
App.js                       # providers + font loading + i18n init
```

---

## The four pillars (use these everywhere)

### 1. Theming — `useTheme()`

Mirrors the website's CSS variables one-to-one.

```jsx
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

const { theme, mode, setMode, effectiveMode } = useTheme();
// theme.colors.bg, theme.colors.text, theme.colors.orange, etc.
// mode = "light" | "dark" | "system" (persisted in AsyncStorage)
```

The status bar style and react-navigation theme update automatically.

### 2. i18n — `useTranslation()`

```jsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { changeLanguage } from "../i18n";

const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
t("auth.signIn");                    // → "Sign In" / "Se connecter" / etc.
t("auth.verifyEmailBody", { email }); // interpolation
await changeLanguage("es");           // persisted, takes effect immediately
```

Locales shipped: **en, es, fr, ar (RTL), pt**. Add a new locale by dropping a JSON file in `src/i18n/locales/` and importing it from `src/i18n/index.js`.

### 3. Currency — `useCurrency()`

```jsx
import { useCurrency } from "../contexts/CurrencyContext";
import AppCurrency from "../components/AppCurrency";

const { currency, format, setCurrencyCode } = useCurrency();

// Component-friendly:
<AppCurrency amount={1500} />                     // global currency
<AppCurrency amount={1500} currencyCode="NGN" />  // per-instance override

// Imperative:
format(1500);                                     // global
format(1500, { currencyCode: "EUR" });            // override
```

26 currencies pre-loaded with symbols and flags. The selected currency is persisted across sessions.

### 4. Toast — `useToast()` (NEVER use `Alert.alert`)

```jsx
import { useToast } from "../contexts/ToastContext";

const { toast } = useToast();
toast.success("Logged in");
toast.error("Invalid credentials");
toast.warning("Are you sure?");
toast.info("Heads up");
```

The toast is animated, themed, dismissable, and auto-stacks if multiple fire.

---

## Global components

Always reach for these instead of raw RN primitives:

| Use this        | Instead of           | Why                                                 |
| --------------- | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `AppText`       | `Text`               | applies theme color + correct font + a11y font cap  |
| `AppButton`     | `TouchableOpacity`   | matches website CTA, supports loading state         |
| `AppInput`      | `TextInput`          | matches website input, password eye toggle, errors  |
| `AppScreen`     | `SafeAreaView` etc.  | safe areas + theme bg + keyboard avoidance + status |
| `AppCurrency`   | manual `${sym}{amt}` | locale-aware formatting, currency override          |
| `useToast`      | `Alert.alert`        | non-blocking, themed, doesn't break the flow        |

---

## Auth flow

```
                      ┌──────────────┐
                      │ App launches │
                      └──────┬───────┘
                             ▼
                  authStore.hydrate()
                             │
              ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
              ▼                             ▼
         user found                    no user
              │                             │
              ▼                             ▼
       HirerNavigator               AuthNavigator
        (Home, etc.)            (Login → Welcome → Register
                                 → ForgotPassword → VerifyEmail)
```

Tokens live in **SecureStore** (`expo-secure-store`); user object is cached in **AsyncStorage** for instant rehydration. The axios client auto-refreshes on 401.

---

## Adding a new screen

1. Create `src/screens/main/YourScreen.js`. Wrap with `<AppScreen>`. Use `AppText`, `AppButton`, `AppInput`, `AppCurrency`.
2. All strings must come from `t(...)`. Add keys to **every** locale JSON.
3. All money must go through `<AppCurrency>` or `format()`.
4. All user feedback via `useToast()`.
5. Add it to `HirerNavigator.js`.

---

## Backend contract (auth)

Endpoints used by this app today (full controller code lives server-side):

| Method | Path                          | Purpose                  |
| ------ | ----------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| POST   | `/auth/register`              | Create Hirer account     |
| POST   | `/auth/login`                 | Login                    |
| POST   | `/auth/logout`                | Logout (auth required)   |
| GET    | `/auth/me`                    | Current user             |
| POST   | `/auth/refresh`               | Refresh access token     |
| POST   | `/auth/forgot-password`       | Send reset email         |
| POST   | `/auth/reset-password`        | Reset with token         |
| POST   | `/auth/resend-verification`   | Resend verify email      |
| GET    | `/auth/verify-email?token=x`  | Verify email (web link)  |

Email verification is link-based — tap the link in the email and the website handles the GET. After verification the user can sign in normally.

---

## Next up

Auth is wired. The natural next batches:

1. **Search & worker discovery** (`search.controller.js`)
2. **Job posts + applications** (`job.controller.js`)
3. **Bookings + escrow + check-in** (`booking.controller.js`, `payment.controller.js`)
4. **Messaging + video call** (`message.controller.js`, `videocall.controller.js`)
5. **Settings, profile, subscription, featured listings**

=== FILE: extract-keys-from-code.js ===
// extract-keys-from-code.js
// Scans all source files for translation keys and generates a complete report.

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const { promisify } = require("util");
const readdir = promisify(fs.readdir);
const stat = promisify(fs.stat);
const readFile = promisify(fs.readFile);

const SRC_DIR = "./src";
const LOCALE_DIR = "./src/i18n/locales";
const REPORT_FILE = "./translation-keys-report.json";

// All languages you want to keep in sync
const LANGUAGES = [
  "en",
  "es",
  "fr",
  "ar",
  "pt",
  "zh",
  "ha",
  "yo",
  "ig",
  "de",
  "it",
  "hi",
];

// Regex to find t("...") or t('...') or i18n.t("...")
// Matches: t("key"), t('key'), i18n.t("key"), useTranslation().t("key")
const KEY_REGEX = /(?:i18n\.)?t\s*\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*\)/g;

async function walk(dir, fileList = []) {
  const files = await readdir(dir);
  for (const file of files) {
    const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
    const stats = await stat(filePath);
    if (stats.isDirectory()) {
      await walk(filePath, fileList);
    } else if (/\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$/.test(file)) {
      fileList.push(filePath);
    }
  }
  return fileList;
}

async function extractKeys() {
  console.log("🔍 Scanning source files for translation keys...");
  const files = await walk(SRC_DIR);
  const allKeys = new Set();

  for (const file of files) {
    const content = await readFile(file, "utf-8");
    let match;
    while ((match = KEY_REGEX.exec(content)) !== null) {
      allKeys.add(match[1]);
    }
  }

  const keysArray = Array.from(allKeys).sort();
  console.log(`✅ Found ${keysArray.length} unique translation keys.`);

  // Save report
  fs.writeFileSync(REPORT_FILE, JSON.stringify(keysArray, null, 2), "utf8");
  console.log(`📄 Report saved to ${REPORT_FILE}`);

  // Optionally, merge these keys into all locale files
  console.log("\n🔄 Merging keys into locale files...");
  LANGUAGES.forEach((lang) => {
    const filePath = path.join(LOCALE_DIR, `${lang}.json`);
    let existing = {};
    if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      try {
        existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));
      } catch (e) {
        existing = {};
      }
    }

    let added = 0;
    keysArray.forEach((key) => {
      if (!existing.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
        existing[key] = `[TODO: Translate to ${lang}] ${key}`;
        added++;
      }
    });

    const sorted = {};
    Object.keys(existing)
      .sort()
      .forEach((k) => {
        sorted[k] = existing[k];
      });
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(sorted, null, 2), "utf8");
    console.log(
      `✅ ${lang}.json → ${Object.keys(sorted).length} keys (${added} added)`,
    );
  });

  console.log("\n🎉 All locale files are now fully synced with the codebase.");
}

extractKeys().catch(console.error);

=== END: extract-keys-from-code.js ===

=== FILE: fill-en-from-ar.js ===
// fill-en-from-ar.js
// Translates Arabic values to English for all placeholder keys in en.json.
// Uses Google Translate (no API key, but rate-limited).

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const translate = require("translate");

const LOCALE_DIR = "./src/i18n/locales";
const EN_PATH = path.join(LOCALE_DIR, "en.json");
const AR_PATH = path.join(LOCALE_DIR, "ar.json");

const DELAY_MS = 500; // avoid rate limits

async function main() {
  console.log("📖 Loading Arabic and English files...");
  const enData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EN_PATH, "utf8"));
  const arData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(AR_PATH, "utf8"));

  // Get all keys that are placeholders (value === key)
  const placeholderKeys = Object.keys(enData).filter(
    (key) => enData[key] === key,
  );

  console.log(
    `🔍 Found ${placeholderKeys.length} placeholder keys in en.json.`,
  );

  let translatedCount = 0;
  for (const key of placeholderKeys) {
    const arValue = arData[key];
    if (!arValue || typeof arValue !== "string") {
      console.log(`⚠️  No Arabic value for key: ${key}, skipping.`);
      continue;
    }
    try {
      // Translate Arabic to English
      const enTranslation = await translate(arValue, { from: "ar", to: "en" });
      enData[key] = enTranslation;
      translatedCount++;
      process.stdout.write(`.`);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, DELAY_MS));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`\n❌ Failed to translate key "${key}":`, err.message);
    }
  }

  // Sort and write back
  const sorted = {};
  Object.keys(enData)
    .sort()
    .forEach((k) => {
      sorted[k] = enData[k];
    });
  fs.writeFileSync(EN_PATH, JSON.stringify(sorted, null, 2), "utf8");

  console.log(
    `\n✅ Updated en.json – ${translatedCount} placeholders translated from Arabic.`,

=== FILE: fix-en-placeholders-readable.js ===
// fix-en-placeholders-readable.js
// Replaces placeholder values in en.json (where value === key) with a human‑readable version.
// e.g. "workerPortfolio.add.title" → "Worker Portfolio Add Title"

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const EN_PATH = "./src/i18n/locales/en.json";

// Helper: convert camelCase to words
function camelToWords(str) {
  return str.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").replace(/^./, (s) => s.toUpperCase());
}

// Helper: split key by dots or slashes, clean up
function keyToReadable(key) {
  // Split by '.' or '/'
  const parts = key.split(/[.\/]/).filter(Boolean);
  // For each part, convert camelCase and capitalise first letter
  const words = parts.map((part) => {
    // Handle "auth" -> "Auth"
    let word = camelToWords(part);
    // Capitalise first letter of each word
    return word.replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
  });
  // Join with spaces
  return words.join(" ");
}

function main() {
  console.log("📖 Reading en.json...");
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(EN_PATH, "utf8");
  const data = JSON.parse(raw);

  let count = 0;
  // Recursively traverse and replace placeholders
  function traverse(obj, parentKey = "") {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
      const fullKey = parentKey ? `${parentKey}.${key}` : key;
      if (typeof value === "string" && value === fullKey) {
        // It's a placeholder – replace with readable version
        obj[key] = keyToReadable(fullKey);
        count++;
      } else if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) {
        traverse(value, fullKey);
      }
    }
  }

  traverse(data);

  // Sort keys and write back
  const sorted = {};
  Object.keys(data)
    .sort()
    .forEach((k) => {
      sorted[k] = data[k];
    });

  fs.writeFileSync(EN_PATH, JSON.stringify(sorted, null, 2), "utf8");
  console.log(
    `✅ Updated ${count} placeholders in en.json with readable English text.`,
  );
  console.log("💡 Please review and polish the generated text manually.");
}

main();

=== END: fix-en-placeholders-readable.js ===

=== FILE: scripts/audit-project.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/audit-project.js
// Run from the project root:  node scripts/audit-project.js
// Outputs a full map of every file in src/ with its exports,
// imports, and whether it's a screen, component, navigator, api, store, etc.
// Paste the output into Claude for a complete project scope analysis.

import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";
import { extname, join, relative } from "path";

const ROOT = process.cwd();
const SRC = join(ROOT, "src");
const OUT = join(ROOT, "project-audit.txt");

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  "node_modules",
  ".git",
  ".expo",
  "dist",
  "build",
  "__tests__",
]);
const CODE_EXTS = new Set([".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx"]);

// ─── Walk directory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function walk(dir, files = []) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry)) continue;
    const full = join(dir, entry);
    const stat = statSync(full);
    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      walk(full, files);
    } else if (CODE_EXTS.has(extname(entry))) {
      files.push(full);
    }
  }
  return files;
}

// ─── Extract metadata from a file ────────────────────────────────────────────
function analyze(filePath) {
  const rel = relative(ROOT, filePath);
  let code;
  try {
    code = readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
  } catch {
    return { rel, error: "unreadable" };
  }

  const lines = code.split("\n");

  // Imports
  const imports = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    const m = line.match(/^import\s+.+\s+from\s+['"](.+)['"]/);
    if (m) imports.push(m[1]);
  }

  // Named exports
  const namedExports = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    const m = line.match(
      /^export\s+(?:const|function|class|async function)\s+(\w+)/,
    );
    if (m) namedExports.push(m[1]);
  }

  // Default export
  let defaultExport = null;
  const defMatch = code.match(/export\s+default\s+(?:function\s+)?(\w+)/);
  if (defMatch) defaultExport = defMatch[1];

  // API calls — GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE
  const apiCalls = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    const m = line.match(/\.(get|post|put|patch|delete)\(['"`]([^'"`]+)/i);
    if (m) apiCalls.push(`${m[1].toUpperCase()} ${m[2]}`);
  }

  // Navigation calls
  const navCalls = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    const m = line.match(/navigate\(['"`](\w+)['"`]/);
    if (m) navCalls.push(m[1]);
  }

  // Classify
  let type = "unknown";
  if (rel.includes("/screens/auth/")) type = "screen:auth";
  else if (rel.includes("/screens/main/worker/")) type = "screen:worker";
  else if (rel.includes("/screens/main/")) type = "screen:hirer";
  else if (rel.includes("/navigation/")) type = "navigator";
  else if (rel.includes("/components/")) type = "component";
  else if (rel.includes("/api/")) type = "api";
  else if (rel.includes("/store/")) type = "store";
  else if (rel.includes("/contexts/")) type = "context";
  else if (rel.includes("/i18n/")) type = "locale";
  else if (rel.includes("/utils/")) type = "util";
  else if (rel.includes("/constants/")) type = "constant";
  else if (rel.includes("/hooks/")) type = "hook";

  const lineCount = lines.length;

  return {
    rel,
    type,
    lineCount,
    defaultExport,
    namedExports: namedExports.length ? namedExports : undefined,
    imports: imports.filter(
      (i) =>
        !i.startsWith("react") &&
        !i.startsWith("@expo") &&
        !i.startsWith("react-native"),
    ),
    apiCalls: apiCalls.length ? apiCalls : undefined,
    navCalls: navCalls.length ? [...new Set(navCalls)] : undefined,
  };
}

// ─── Group and format ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function format(files) {
  const groups = {};
  for (const f of files) {
    const g = f.type;
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g].push(f);
  }

  const ORDER = [
    "navigator",
    "screen:auth",
    "screen:hirer",
    "screen:worker",
    "component",
    "api",
    "store",
    "context",
    "hook",
    "util",
    "constant",
    "locale",
    "unknown",
  ];

  const lines = [
    "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
    "  SKILLEDPROZHIRER — PROJECT AUDIT",
    `  Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
    `  Root: ${ROOT}`,
    "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
    "",
  ];

  for (const group of ORDER) {
    if (!groups[group]) continue;
    lines.push(`${"─".repeat(60)}`);
    lines.push(`  ${group.toUpperCase()}`);
    lines.push(`${"─".repeat(60)}`);
    for (const f of groups[group].sort((a, b) => a.rel.localeCompare(b.rel))) {
      lines.push(`\n  📄 ${f.rel}  (${f.lineCount} lines)`);
      if (f.defaultExport)
        lines.push(`     default export : ${f.defaultExport}`);
      if (f.namedExports?.length)
        lines.push(`     named exports  : ${f.namedExports.join(", ")}`);
      if (f.apiCalls?.length)
        lines.push(`     API calls      : ${f.apiCalls.join(" | ")}`);
      if (f.navCalls?.length)
        lines.push(`     navigates to   : ${f.navCalls.join(", ")}`);
      const localImports = f.imports?.filter(
        (i) =>
          i.startsWith(".") || i.startsWith("../") || i.startsWith("../../"),
      );
      if (localImports?.length)
        lines.push(`     local imports  : ${localImports.join(", ")}`);
    }
    lines.push("");
  }

  // Summary counts
  lines.push("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
  lines.push("  SUMMARY");
  lines.push("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
  for (const group of ORDER) {
    if (groups[group]) {
      lines.push(`  ${group.padEnd(22)} ${groups[group].length} files`);
    }
  }
  lines.push(`\n  TOTAL: ${files.length} files`);
  lines.push("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");

  return lines.join("\n");
}

// ─── Also check package.json for installed packages ──────────────────────────
function auditPackageJson() {
  try {
    const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(ROOT, "package.json"), "utf8"));
    const deps = Object.keys(pkg.dependencies ?? {});
    const devDeps = Object.keys(pkg.devDependencies ?? {});
    return [
      "",
      "─".repeat(60),
      "  INSTALLED PACKAGES",
      "─".repeat(60),
      `  dependencies (${deps.length}):`,
      ...deps.map((d) => `    • ${d}`),
      `\n  devDependencies (${devDeps.length}):`,
      ...devDeps.map((d) => `    • ${d}`),
    ].join("\n");
  } catch {
    return "\n  (package.json not found or unreadable)";
  }
}

// ─── Check which navigator screens are registered vs missing ─────────────────
function auditNavigators(files) {
  const navigatorFiles = files.filter((f) => f.type === "navigator");
  const allScreenNames = new Set();
  const registeredRoutes = new Set();

  for (const nav of navigatorFiles) {
    const code = readFileSync(join(ROOT, nav.rel), "utf8");
    // Extract Screen name= values
    const matches = [...code.matchAll(/name=["'](\w+)["']/g)];
    for (const m of matches) registeredRoutes.add(m[1]);
  }

  // All navigation.navigate() calls
  const navTargets = new Set();
  for (const f of files) {
    for (const target of f.navCalls ?? []) {
      navTargets.add(target);
    }
  }

  // Targets that aren't registered
  const missing = [...navTargets].filter((t) => !registeredRoutes.has(t));

  const lines = [
    "",
    "─".repeat(60),
    "  NAVIGATOR AUDIT",
    "─".repeat(60),
    `  Registered routes (${registeredRoutes.size}):`,
    ...[...registeredRoutes].sort().map((r) => `    ✓ ${r}`),
    `\n  Navigate() calls that have NO registered screen (${missing.length}):`,
    ...(missing.length
      ? missing.sort().map((r) => `    ✗ ${r}  ← MISSING`)
      : ["    (none — all navigation targets are registered)"]),
  ];

  return lines.join("\n");
}

// ─── Run ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log("🔍  Scanning project...");

const allFiles = walk(SRC);
const analyzed = allFiles.map(analyze).filter((f) => !f.error);

const report = [
  format(analyzed),
  auditPackageJson(),
  auditNavigators(analyzed),
].join("\n");

writeFileSync(OUT, report, "utf8");
console.log(`✅  Audit complete — ${analyzed.length} files analyzed`);
console.log(`📋  Report saved to: ${OUT}`);
console.log("\nPaste the contents of project-audit.txt into Claude.\n");

=== END: scripts/audit-project.js ===

#!/usr/bin/env node
// build-locales.js — Batch translate: one request per namespace, not per key
// This cuts 1,182 requests → ~30, preventing Google rate-limit blocks.
//
// RUN:  node scripts/build-locales.js
//       node scripts/build-locales.js --locale fr      (single locale)
//       node scripts/build-locales.js --locale yo,ha,ig
//       node scripts/build-locales.js --force          (re-translate complete locales)
//       node scripts/build-locales.js --delay 4000     (ms between namespaces, default 2000)

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const delayArg = args.indexOf("--delay");
const ONLY = localeArg >= 0 ? args[localeArg + 1].split(",") : null;
const FORCE = args.includes("--force");
const DELAY = delayArg >= 0 ? parseInt(args[delayArg + 1]) : 4000; // ms between namespaces

const LOCALES_DIR = path.resolve("locales");

// ── Write en.json ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const enPath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, "en.json");
fs.writeFileSync(enPath, JSON.stringify(EN, null, 2), "utf8");
const totalKeys = countAll(EN);
console.log(`\n✅  en.json written — ${totalKeys} keys\n`);

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function countAll(o) {
  let n = 0;
  for (const v of Object.values(o)) {
    if (v && typeof v === "object") n += countAll(v);
    else if (typeof v === "string") n++;
  }
  return n;
}
function countFilled(o) {
  let n = 0;
  for (const v of Object.values(o)) {
    if (v && typeof v === "object") n += countFilled(v);
    else if (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() !== "") n++;
  }
  return n;
}
function mergeDeep(ex, tr) {
  const out = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(tr)) {
    if (tr[k] && typeof tr[k] === "object") {
      out[k] = mergeDeep((ex || {})[k] || {}, tr[k]);
    } else {
      const e = (ex || {})[k];
      out[k] = e && e !== "" ? e : tr[k];
    }
  }
  return out;
}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
let _gt;
async function gt() {
  if (!_gt) {
    try {
      const m = await import("@vitalets/google-translate-api");
      _gt = m.translate;
    } catch {
      console.error("❌  Run: npm install @vitalets/google-translate-api");
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }
  return _gt;
}

// ── KEY FIX: translate whole namespace as JSON, not key-by-key ───────────────
// Sends ONE request per namespace (~30 total) instead of one per string (1182)
// This is what prevents the "Too Many Requests" block.
async function translateNamespace(nsObj, to, nsName, retries = 3) {
  const fn = await gt();

  // Flatten nested objects to single-level for safe JSON translation
  function flatten(obj, prefix = "") {
    const out = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
      const key = prefix ? `${prefix}__${k}` : k;
      if (v && typeof v === "object") Object.assign(out, flatten(v, key));
      else if (typeof v === "string") out[key] = v;
    }
    return out;
  }
  function unflatten(flat) {
    const out = {};
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(flat)) {
      const parts = key.split("__");
      let cur = out;
      for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
        cur[parts[i]] = cur[parts[i]] || {};
        cur = cur[parts[i]];
      }
      cur[parts[parts.length - 1]] = val;
    }
    return out;
  }

  const flat = flatten(nsObj);
  const keys = Object.keys(flat);

  // Skip template-only values, translate the rest
  const toTranslate = {};
  const passThrough = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(flat)) {
    if (
      /^{{.*}}$/.test(v.trim()) ||
      /^[A-Z_]{2,}$/.test(v.trim()) ||
      v.trim() === ""
    ) {
      passThrough[k] = v;
    } else {
      toTranslate[k] = v;
    }
  }

  if (Object.keys(toTranslate).length === 0) return nsObj;

  // Build a compact string to translate: KEY1|value1||KEY2|value2
  // Use a separator that Google won't mangle
  const SEP = "|||";
  const KEYSEP = "::";
  const payload = Object.entries(toTranslate)
    .map(([k, v]) => `${k}${KEYSEP}${v}`)
    .join(SEP);

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
    try {
      const result = await fn(payload, { to });
      const translated = result.text;

      // Parse back
      const pairs = translated.split(SEP);
      const out = { ...passThrough };

      for (const pair of pairs) {
        const colonIdx = pair.indexOf(KEYSEP);
        if (colonIdx === -1) continue;
        const rawKey = pair.slice(0, colonIdx).trim();
        const val = pair.slice(colonIdx + KEYSEP.length).trim();
        // Try to find the original key (Google may translate the key name)
        const origKey = keys.find(
          (k) => k === rawKey || k.toLowerCase() === rawKey.toLowerCase(),
        );
        if (origKey) out[origKey] = val;
      }

      // Fill any keys that didn't parse back (fallback to English)
      for (const k of keys) {
        if (!out[k]) out[k] = flat[k];
      }

      return unflatten(out);
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt === retries) {
        console.warn(
          `    ⚠️  Namespace '${nsName}' → ${to} failed after ${retries} attempts. Using English fallback.`,
        );
        return nsObj;
      }
      const backoff = [20000, 45000, 90000][attempt - 1] || 90000;
      console.log(
        `    ↺  ${nsName} → ${to}: rate limited, waiting ${backoff / 1000}s…`,
      );
      await sleep(backoff);
    }
  }
  return nsObj;
}

// ── Translate all locales ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const targets = ALL_LOCALES.filter((l) => l.code !== "en").filter(
  (l) => !ONLY || ONLY.includes(l.code),
);

for (const loc of targets) {
  const fp = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${loc.code}.json`);
  const existing = fs.existsSync(fp)
    ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fp, "utf8"))
    : {};
  const filled = countFilled(existing);
  const pct = Math.round((filled / totalKeys) * 100);

  if (!FORCE && pct >= 95) {
    console.log(`⏭️   ${loc.code} (${loc.name}) — ${pct}% complete, skipping`);
    continue;
  }

  console.log(
    `\n🌐  Translating → ${loc.code} (${loc.name})  [${filled}/${totalKeys} already done]`,
  );
  const result = {};

  const namespaces = Object.keys(EN);
  for (let i = 0; i < namespaces.length; i++) {
    const ns = namespaces[i];
    process.stdout.write(`   [${i + 1}/${namespaces.length}] ${ns.padEnd(20)}`);

    // If this namespace is already fully translated, skip it
    const exNs = existing[ns] || {};
    const nsTotal = countAll(EN[ns]);
    const nsFilled = countFilled(exNs);
    if (!FORCE && nsFilled >= nsTotal) {
      process.stdout.write("✓ already complete\n");
      result[ns] = exNs;
      continue;
    }

    const translated = await translateNamespace(EN[ns], loc.gtCode, ns);
    result[ns] = mergeDeep(exNs, translated);
    const newFilled = countFilled(result[ns]);
    process.stdout.write(`→ ${newFilled}/${nsTotal} keys ✅\n`);

    // Save after EVERY namespace — so if rate-limited mid-run you don't lose progress
    fs.writeFileSync(fp, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), "utf8");

    // Pause between namespaces to avoid rate limits
    if (i < namespaces.length - 1) await sleep(DELAY);
  }

  // Save incrementally — after every locale AND after each namespace (see inner loop)
  fs.writeFileSync(fp, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), "utf8");
  const total = countFilled(result);
  console.log(
    `\n💾  ${loc.code}.json saved — ${total}/${totalKeys} (${Math.round((total / totalKeys) * 100)}%)\n`,
  );
}

console.log("  LOCALE STATUS — all 9 languages");
console.log("═".repeat(56));
console.log(
  `  ${"Locale".padEnd(13)} ${"Code".padEnd(5)} ${"Keys".padEnd(12)} Progress`,
);
console.log("  " + "─".repeat(52));
for (const loc of ALL_LOCALES) {
  const fp = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${loc.code}.json`);
  const data = fs.existsSync(fp) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fp, "utf8")) : {};
  const f = countFilled(data);
  const pct = Math.round((f / totalKeys) * 100);
  const bar =
    "█".repeat(Math.round(pct / 10)) + "░".repeat(10 - Math.round(pct / 10));
  const icon = pct === 100 ? "✅" : pct > 50 ? "🟡" : "❌";
  console.log(
    `  ${icon} ${loc.name.padEnd(12)} ${loc.code.padEnd(5)} ${`${f}/${totalKeys}`.padEnd(12)} ${bar} ${pct}%`,
  );
}
console.log("═".repeat(56) + "\n");

#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/check-hardcoded.js
// Run from project root: node scripts/check-hardcoded.js
//
// Finds all hardcoded English strings in .js/.jsx files that should
// be using t() translations instead. Groups by file and severity.

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const SRC_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "..", "src");

// ── Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Patterns that indicate a hardcoded UI string
// Each has: pattern (regex), description, severity (high/medium/low)
const PATTERNS = [
  // JSX text content — most common case
  // Catches: <AppText>Some text</AppText>  <Text>Hello</Text>
  {
    re: />\s*([A-Z][a-zA-Z\s]{3,}[a-zA-Z])\s*</g,
    desc: "JSX text content",
    severity: "high",
    filter: (m) => !isLikelyCode(m[1]),
  },

  // String props that are human-visible
  // Catches: title="Post a Job"  label="Submit"  placeholder="Search..."
  {
    re: /(?:title|label|placeholder|hint|subtitle|message|text|description|header|heading|emptyText|errorText)\s*=\s*["']([A-Za-z][a-zA-Z\s'.,!?-]{3,})["']/g,
    desc: "String prop (title/label/placeholder etc.)",
    severity: "high",
    filter: (m) => !isLikelyCode(m[1]),
  },

  // toast.* calls with hardcoded strings
  // Catches: toast.error("Something went wrong")
  {
    re: /toast\.\w+\(\s*["']([A-Za-z][a-zA-Z\s'.,!?-]{4,})["']/g,
    desc: "Hardcoded toast message",
    severity: "high",
    filter: (m) => !isLikelyCode(m[1]),
  },

  // Alert.alert with hardcoded strings
  {
    re: /Alert\.alert\(\s*["']([A-Za-z][a-zA-Z\s'.,!?-]{3,})["']/g,
    desc: "Hardcoded Alert title",
    severity: "high",
    filter: (m) => !isLikelyCode(m[1]),
  },

  // console-visible but not UI — lower severity
  // Catches standalone string args that look like messages
  {
    re: /(?:onPress|onConfirm|message)\s*=\s*["']([A-Za-z][a-zA-Z\s'.,!?-]{6,})["']/g,
    desc: "Hardcoded message prop",
    severity: "medium",
    filter: (m) => !isLikelyCode(m[1]),
  },
];

// Strings that look like code/values, not UI text — skip these
const CODE_PATTERNS = [
  /^[a-z]/, // starts lowercase — likely a key or variable name
  /^\d/, // starts with number
  /^https?:\/\//, // URL
  /^#/, // color
  /\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|json|png|jpg|svg)$/, // file extension
  /^[A-Z_]{3,}$/, // ALL_CAPS constant
  /^rgba?\(/, // CSS color
  /navigation|screen|route|params|props|state|store|context|hook|util|helper|config|api|client|axios|fetch|promise|async|await|import|export|from|const|let|var|function|return|class|extends|null|undefined|true|false/i,
];

const ALWAYS_SKIP = new Set([
  "SkilledPro",
  "SkilledProz",
  "SP",
  "USD",
  "GBP",
  "EUR",
  "NGN",
  "PRO",
  "FREE",
  "ENTERPRISE",
  "VERIFIED",
  "PENDING",
  "REJECTED",
  "FIXED",
  "HOURLY",
  "DAILY",
  "WEEKLY",
  "MONTHLY",
  "CUSTOM",
  "GET",
  "POST",
  "PATCH",
  "DELETE",
  "PUT",
  "Mon",
  "Tue",
  "Wed",
  "Thu",
  "Fri",
  "Sat",
  "Sun",
  "Jan",
  "Feb",
  "Mar",
  "Apr",
  "May",
  "Jun",
  "Jul",
  "Aug",
  "Sep",
  "Oct",
  "Nov",
  "Dec",
  "iOS",
  "Android",
  "React",
  "Expo",
  "Node",
]);

function isLikelyCode(str) {
  if (!str || str.length < 3) return true;
  if (ALWAYS_SKIP.has(str.trim())) return true;
  for (const p of CODE_PATTERNS) {
    if (p.test(str.trim())) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

// Files/dirs to skip entirely
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", ".expo", "assets", "scripts"]);
const SKIP_FILES = new Set([
  "theme.js",
  "currencies.js",
  "languages.js",
  "client.js",
  "authStore.js",
]);

// ── File collection ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function collectFiles(dir, results = []) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      collectFiles(full, results);
    } else if (/\.(js|jsx)$/.test(entry.name) && !SKIP_FILES.has(entry.name)) {
      results.push(full);
    }
  }
  return results;
}

// ── Already translated check ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Check if a file already uses useTranslation
function usesI18n(src) {
  return src.includes("useTranslation") || src.includes("i18next");
}

// ── Main scan ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const files = collectFiles(SRC_DIR);
const results = []; // { file, usesI18n, hits: [{line, col, text, desc, severity}] }
let totalHits = 0;

for (const file of files) {
  const src = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  const lines = src.split("\n");
  const hasI18n = usesI18n(src);
  const hits = [];

  for (const { re, desc, severity, filter } of PATTERNS) {
    re.lastIndex = 0;
    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) {
      const text = m[1]?.trim();
      if (!text || text.length < 3) continue;
      if (filter && !filter(m)) continue;

      // Find line number
      const upTo = src.slice(0, m.index);
      const lineNum = upTo.split("\n").length;
      const lineText = lines[lineNum - 1]?.trim() ?? "";

      // Skip if this match is already inside a t() call
      if (/\bt\(/.test(lineText)) continue;
      // Skip comments
      if (lineText.startsWith("//") || lineText.startsWith("*")) continue;
      // Skip import/export lines
      if (/^(import|export)\s/.test(lineText)) continue;
      // Skip console.log
      if (lineText.includes("console.")) continue;

      hits.push({ line: lineNum, text, desc, severity, lineText });
      totalHits++;
    }
  }

  // Dedupe by line number (multiple patterns can match same line)
  const seen = new Set();
  const deduped = hits.filter((h) => {
    const key = `${h.line}:${h.text}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });

  if (deduped.length > 0) {
    results.push({ file, hasI18n, hits: deduped });
  }
}

// ── Sort by severity and hit count ───────────────────────────────────────────
results.sort((a, b) => {
  const aHigh = a.hits.filter((h) => h.severity === "high").length;
  const bHigh = b.hits.filter((h) => h.severity === "high").length;
  return bHigh - aHigh || b.hits.length - a.hits.length;
});

// ── Output ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log("\n🔍  SkilledProzHirer — Hardcoded String Audit\n");
console.log("=".repeat(65));
console.log(`\n📁  Scanned ${files.length} source files`);
console.log(
  `⚠️   Found ${totalHits} potential hardcoded strings in ${results.length} files\n`,
);
console.log("=".repeat(65));

// Summary table first
console.log("\n📊  Files ranked by hardcoded string count:\n");
console.log("  File".padEnd(52) + "i18n?  High  Med  Total");
console.log("  " + "─".repeat(62));

for (const { file, hasI18n, hits } of results) {
  const rel = path.relative(path.join(__dirname, ".."), file);
  const high = hits.filter((h) => h.severity === "high").length;
  const med = hits.filter((h) => h.severity === "medium").length;
  const i18nIcon = hasI18n ? "✅" : "❌";
  const name = rel.length > 48 ? "..." + rel.slice(-45) : rel;
  console.log(
    `  ${name.padEnd(50)} ${i18nIcon}    ${String(high).padStart(3)}  ${String(med).padStart(3)}  ${String(hits.length).padStart(5)}`,
  );
}

// Detailed breakdown
console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(65));
console.log("\n📋  Detailed findings:\n");

for (const { file, hasI18n, hits } of results) {
  const rel = path.relative(path.join(__dirname, ".."), file);
  const highCount = hits.filter((h) => h.severity === "high").length;

  console.log(`\n── ${rel}`);
  console.log(
    `   i18n: ${hasI18n ? "✅ uses useTranslation" : "❌ NO useTranslation imported"}`,
  );
  console.log(
    `   Hardcoded strings: ${hits.length} (${highCount} high priority)\n`,
  );

  for (const { line, text, desc, severity, lineText } of hits) {
    const icon = severity === "high" ? "🔴" : "🟡";
    console.log(`   ${icon} Line ${String(line).padStart(4)}  [${desc}]`);
    console.log(`          Text: "${text}"`);
    console.log(`          Code: ${lineText.slice(0, 80)}`);
    console.log();
  }
}

// ── Action plan ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log("=".repeat(65));
console.log("\n✍️   Priority rewrite list (files with NO i18n + high hits):\n");

const noI18nFiles = results.filter(
  (r) => !r.hasI18n && r.hits.some((h) => h.severity === "high"),
);
if (noI18nFiles.length === 0) {
  console.log("  🎉 All files already import useTranslation!");
} else {
  for (const { file, hits } of noI18nFiles) {
    const rel = path.relative(path.join(__dirname, ".."), file);
    const high = hits.filter((h) => h.severity === "high").length;
    console.log(`  🔴 ${rel}  (${high} high-priority strings)`);
    for (const h of hits.filter((hh) => hh.severity === "high").slice(0, 5)) {
      console.log(`       • "${h.text}"`);
    }
  }
}

console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(65));
console.log("\n✍️   Already using i18n but still has hardcoded strings:\n");

const hasI18nButHardcoded = results.filter(
  (r) => r.hasI18n && r.hits.some((h) => h.severity === "high"),
);
if (hasI18nButHardcoded.length === 0) {
  console.log("  🎉 No partially-translated files found!");
} else {
  for (const { file, hits } of hasI18nButHardcoded) {
    const rel = path.relative(path.join(__dirname, ".."), file);
    const high = hits.filter((h) => h.severity === "high").length;
    console.log(`  🟡 ${rel}  (${high} strings still hardcoded)`);
    for (const h of hits.filter((hh) => hh.severity === "high").slice(0, 5)) {
      console.log(`       Line ${h.line}: "${h.text}"`);
    }
  }
}

console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(65));
console.log("\n✅  Audit complete.\n");

=== FILE: scripts/check-locales.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/check-locales.js
// Run from project root: node scripts/check-locales.js
//
// What it does:
//   1. Scans every .js / .jsx file in src/ for t("key") / t('key') calls
//   2. Loads all 9 locale JSON files
//   3. Reports which keys are missing from which locales
//   4. Shows a per-locale summary so you know exactly what to write

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

// ── Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const SRC_DIR = path.join(ROOT, "src");
const LOCALES_DIR = path.join(ROOT, "src", "i18n", "locales");

const LOCALES = ["en", "es", "fr", "pt", "zh", "ha", "yo", "ig", "ar"];

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Recursively collect all .js / .jsx files */
function collectFiles(dir, results = []) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) collectFiles(full, results);
    else if (/\.(js|jsx)$/.test(entry.name)) results.push(full);
  }
  return results;
}

/** Flatten a nested JSON object into dot-notation keys */
function flattenKeys(obj, prefix = "", out = new Set()) {
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    const key = prefix ? `${prefix}.${k}` : k;
    if (v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v)) {
      flattenKeys(v, key, out);
    } else {
      out.add(key);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Extract all t("...") / t('...') / t(`...`) keys from source */
function extractKeys(src) {
  const keys = new Set();
  // Matches: t("some.key") t('some.key') — static strings only
  const re = /\bt\(\s*["'`]([^"'`\s{}()]+)["'`]/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) {
    keys.add(m[1]);
  }
  return keys;
}

/** Load a locale file, return flat key set (empty set if file missing) */
function loadLocale(locale) {
  const file = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return { keys: new Set(), missing: true };
  try {
    const json = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
    return { keys: flattenKeys(json), missing: false };
  } catch {
    return { keys: new Set(), missing: true };
  }
}

// ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log("\n🔍  SkilledProzHirer — Locale Completeness Check\n");
console.log("=".repeat(60));

// 1. Collect all translation keys used in source
const files = collectFiles(SRC_DIR);
const allUsedKeys = new Set();
const keyToFiles = {};

for (const file of files) {
  const src = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  const keys = extractKeys(src);
  for (const k of keys) {
    allUsedKeys.add(k);
    if (!keyToFiles[k]) keyToFiles[k] = [];
    keyToFiles[k].push(path.relative(ROOT, file));
  }
}

console.log(`\n📁  Scanned ${files.length} source files`);
console.log(
  `🔑  Found ${allUsedKeys.size} unique translation keys used in code\n`,
);
console.log("=".repeat(60));

// 2. Load all locales
const localeData = {};
for (const locale of LOCALES) {
  localeData[locale] = loadLocale(locale);
}

// 3. Compute missing keys per locale
const missingByLocale = {};
const allMissingKeys = new Set();

for (const locale of LOCALES) {
  const { keys, missing: fileMissing } = localeData[locale];
  const missing = [];
  for (const key of allUsedKeys) {
    // Skip interpolation placeholders like "toast.{{type}}"
    if (
      key.includes("{{") ||
      (key.includes("postJob.durationType.") && key.endsWith("."))
    )
      continue;
    if (!keys.has(key)) {
      missing.push(key);
      allMissingKeys.add(key);
    }
  }
  missingByLocale[locale] = { missing, fileMissing };
}

// 4. Print per-locale summary
console.log("\n📊  Per-locale status:\n");

for (const locale of LOCALES) {
  const { missing, fileMissing } = missingByLocale[locale];
  const { keys } = localeData[locale];
  const total = allUsedKeys.size;
  const present = total - missing.length;
  const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((present / total) * 100) : 100;
  const bar =
    "█".repeat(Math.round(pct / 5)) + "░".repeat(20 - Math.round(pct / 5));
  const status = fileMissing
    ? "❌ FILE MISSING"
    : missing.length === 0
      ? "✅ Complete"
      : `⚠️  ${missing.length} missing`;

  console.log(
    `  ${locale.toUpperCase().padEnd(4)} [${bar}] ${pct}%  ${status}`,
  );
}

// 5. Print detailed missing keys grouped by namespace
console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(60));
console.log("\n📋  Missing keys by locale:\n");

for (const locale of LOCALES) {
  const { missing, fileMissing } = missingByLocale[locale];
  if (missing.length === 0 && !fileMissing) continue;

  console.log(
    `\n── ${locale.toUpperCase()} ──────────────────────────────────`,
  );

  if (fileMissing) {
    console.log(`  ⚠️  Locale file not found: src/i18n/locales/${locale}.json`);
    console.log(`  All ${allUsedKeys.size} keys need to be added.\n`);
  }

  if (missing.length === 0) {
    console.log("  ✅ No missing keys");
    continue;
  }

  // Group by namespace (first segment of dot-notation key)
  const grouped = {};
  for (const key of missing) {
    const ns = key.split(".")[0];
    if (!grouped[ns]) grouped[ns] = [];
    grouped[ns].push(key);
  }

  for (const [ns, keys] of Object.entries(grouped).sort()) {
    console.log(`\n  [${ns}]  (${keys.length} missing)`);
    for (const key of keys.sort()) {
      console.log(`    • ${key}`);
    }
  }
}

// 6. Print keys that ARE in locales but NOT used in code (orphaned)
console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(60));
console.log("\n🗑️   Orphaned keys in EN (defined but never used in code):\n");

const { keys: enKeys } = localeData["en"];
const orphaned = [...enKeys].filter((k) => !allUsedKeys.has(k));
if (orphaned.length === 0) {
  console.log("  ✅ No orphaned keys found");
} else {
  console.log(`  Found ${orphaned.length} orphaned keys:`);
  for (const k of orphaned.sort()) {
    console.log(`    • ${k}`);
  }
}

// 7. Generate a TODO list of namespaces to write
console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(60));
console.log("\n✍️   Namespaces that need translation work:\n");

const namespacesNeeded = new Set();
for (const locale of LOCALES) {
  const { missing } = missingByLocale[locale];
  for (const key of missing) {
    namespacesNeeded.add(key.split(".")[0]);
  }
}

if (namespacesNeeded.size === 0) {
  console.log("  🎉 All namespaces complete across all locales!");
} else {
  console.log("  Namespaces with missing translations:\n");
  for (const ns of [...namespacesNeeded].sort()) {
    const localesNeeding = LOCALES.filter((l) =>
      missingByLocale[l].missing.some((k) => k.startsWith(`${ns}.`)),
    );
    console.log(`  📦 "${ns}"  →  needs work in: ${localesNeeding.join(", ")}`);
  }
}

console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(60));
console.log("\n✅  Check complete.\n");

=== END: scripts/check-locales.js ===

#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/check-styling.js
// Run: node scripts/check-styling.js
//
// Audits every source file for:
//   1. Font usage — raw fontFamily/fontSize/fontWeight vs AppText variants
//   2. Color usage — hardcoded hex/rgba colors vs theme tokens
//   3. Spacing usage — raw pixel values vs SPACING constants
//   4. StyleSheet.create() vs inline styles
//   5. Component inventory — full project tree
//   6. UX consistency score per file

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const SRC = path.join(ROOT, "src");

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  "node_modules",
  ".expo",
  "assets",
  "scripts",
  ".git",
]);

// ── Theme tokens from theme.js ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const THEME_COLORS = new Set([
  "c.orange",
  "c.orangeHover",
  "c.orangeDim",
  "c.orangeGlow",
  "c.red",
  "c.green",
  "c.bg",
  "c.bgPanel",
  "c.bgCard",
  "c.bgInput",
  "c.card",
  "c.inputBg",
  "c.text",
  "c.textDim",
  "c.textMuted",
  "c.border",
  "c.borderHover",
  "c.borderFocus",
  "c.redDim",
  "c.greenDim",
  "c.shadow",
  "th.colors",
  "theme.colors",
  // Also allow these brand constants
  "#f97316",
  "#ef4444",
  "#22c55e", // orange, red, green brand colors
  "#fff",
  "#ffffff",
  "#000",
  "#000000",
  "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
  "transparent",
]);

const FONT_FAMILIES = new Set([
  "Syne_700Bold",
  "Syne_800ExtraBold",
  "DMSans_400Regular",
  "DMSans_500Medium",
  "DMSans_600SemiBold",
  "DMSans_700Bold",
]);

const APPTEXT_VARIANTS = new Set([
  "display",
  "displaySm",
  "title",
  "body",
  "small",
  "label",
]);

const APPTEXT_WEIGHTS = new Set([
  "displayBlack",
  "semibold",
  "medium",
  "regular",
  "bold",
]);

// ── File walker ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function walkDir(dir, depth = 0, lines = []) {
  const entries = fs
    .readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((e) => !SKIP_DIRS.has(e.name))
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.isDirectory() && !b.isDirectory()) return -1;
      if (!a.isDirectory() && b.isDirectory()) return 1;
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const indent = "  ".repeat(depth);
    const icon = entry.isDirectory() ? "📁" : getFileIcon(entry.name);
    lines.push(`${indent}${icon} ${entry.name}`);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      walkDir(path.join(dir, entry.name), depth + 1, lines);
    }
  }
  return lines;
}

function getFileIcon(name) {
  if (name.endsWith(".js") || name.endsWith(".jsx")) return "📜";
  if (name.endsWith(".json")) return "{}";
  if (name.endsWith(".ts") || name.endsWith(".tsx")) return "📘";
  if (name.endsWith(".md")) return "📝";
  if (name.endsWith(".sh")) return "⚙️";
  if (name.endsWith(".png") || name.endsWith(".jpg") || name.endsWith(".svg"))
    return "🖼️";
  return "📄";
}

function collectJsFiles(dir, results = []) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) collectJsFiles(full, results);
    else if (/\.(js|jsx)$/.test(entry.name)) results.push(full);
  }
  return results;
}

// ── Analyzers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function analyzeFile(filepath, src) {
  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, filepath);
  const lines = src.split("\n");
  const issues = [];

  // ── 1. Raw fontFamily ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fontFamilyRe = /fontFamily\s*:\s*["']([^"']+)["']/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = fontFamilyRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const val = m[1];
    if (!FONT_FAMILIES.has(val)) {
      const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
      issues.push({
        type: "font",
        severity: "high",
        line,
        msg: `fontFamily: "${val}" — use AppText variant instead`,
      });
    } else {
      const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
      issues.push({
        type: "font",
        severity: "medium",
        line,
        msg: `fontFamily: "${val}" — OK but prefer AppText variant`,
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 2. Raw fontSize outside StyleSheet (inline) ────────────────────────────
  const inlineFontSizeRe = /style=\{[^}]*fontSize\s*:\s*(\d+)/g;
  while ((m = inlineFontSizeRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const size = parseInt(m[1]);
    const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
    if (size < 10 || size > 40) {
      issues.push({
        type: "font",
        severity: "medium",
        line,
        msg: `Unusual fontSize: ${size} in inline style — check against design system`,
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 3. Raw fontWeight outside AppText ─────────────────────────────────────
  const fontWeightRe = /fontWeight\s*:\s*["'](\d{3}|bold|normal)["']/g;
  while ((m = fontWeightRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
    issues.push({
      type: "font",
      severity: "low",
      line,
      msg: `fontWeight: "${m[1]}" — prefer AppText weight prop`,
    });
  }

  // ── 4. Hardcoded colors (hex that aren't brand colors) ───────────────────
  const hexRe = /#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})\b/g;
  const knownHex = new Set([
    "#fff",
    "#ffffff",
    "#000",
    "#000000",
    "#f97316",
    "#ef4444",
    "#22c55e",
    "#6b7280",
    "#818cf8",
    "#a78bfa",
    "#22d3ee",
    "#f472b6",
    "#6366f1",
    "#374151",
    "#4b5563",
    "#1e1b4b",
    "#111",
    "#111118",
  ]);
  while ((m = hexRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const hex = `#${m[1]}`.toLowerCase();
    if (!knownHex.has(hex)) {
      const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
      // Skip if it's inside a comment
      const lineText = lines[line - 1]?.trim() ?? "";
      if (!lineText.startsWith("//") && !lineText.startsWith("*")) {
        issues.push({
          type: "color",
          severity: "medium",
          line,
          msg: `Unknown color ${hex} — use theme token (c.orange, c.text etc.)`,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // ── 5. Hardcoded rgba not in theme ────────────────────────────────────────
  const rgbaRe = /rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)/g;
  const knownRgba = [
    [249, 115, 22],
    [239, 68, 68],
    [34, 197, 94], // orange, red, green
    [0, 0, 0],
    [255, 255, 255], // black, white
    [107, 114, 128],
    [99, 102, 241],
    [139, 92, 246], // gray, indigo, violet
  ];
  while ((m = rgbaRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const r = parseInt(m[1]),
      g = parseInt(m[2]),
      b = parseInt(m[3]);
    const isKnown = knownRgba.some(
      ([kr, kg, kb]) => kr === r && kg === g && kb === b,
    );
    if (!isKnown) {
      const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
      const lineText = lines[line - 1]?.trim() ?? "";
      if (!lineText.startsWith("//") && !lineText.startsWith("*")) {
        issues.push({
          type: "color",
          severity: "low",
          line,
          msg: `Custom rgba(${r},${g},${b}...) — verify this matches theme`,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // ── 6. Missing AppText (raw <Text> components) ────────────────────────────
  const rawTextRe = /\bimport\b[^;]*\bText\b[^;]*from\s+['"]react-native['"]/;
  if (rawTextRe.test(src)) {
    const textUsageRe = /<Text[\s>]/g;
    while ((m = textUsageRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
      const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
      issues.push({
        type: "component",
        severity: "high",
        line,
        msg: `<Text> from react-native — replace with <AppText> for consistent styling`,
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 7. StyleSheet vs inline ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const hasStyleSheet = src.includes("StyleSheet.create(");
  const inlineStyleCount = (src.match(/style=\{\{/g) || []).length;
  const styleSheetCount = (src.match(/styles\.\w+/g) || []).length;

  if (!hasStyleSheet && inlineStyleCount > 5) {
    issues.push({
      type: "style",
      severity: "medium",
      line: 0,
      msg: `No StyleSheet.create() — ${inlineStyleCount} inline styles. Move to StyleSheet for performance`,
    });
  }
  if (inlineStyleCount > 20) {
    issues.push({
      type: "style",
      severity: "low",
      line: 0,
      msg: `${inlineStyleCount} inline styles. High count — move repeated styles to StyleSheet`,
    });
  }

  // ── 8. Uses AppText correctly ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const usesAppText = src.includes("AppText");
  const appTextVariantRe = /variant=["']([^"']+)["']/g;
  const variantsUsed = new Set();
  while ((m = appTextVariantRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
    variantsUsed.add(m[1]);
    if (!APPTEXT_VARIANTS.has(m[1])) {
      const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
      issues.push({
        type: "font",
        severity: "high",
        line,
        msg: `Unknown AppText variant: "${m[1]}" — valid: ${[...APPTEXT_VARIANTS].join(", ")}`,
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 9. Theme usage ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const usesTheme = src.includes("useTheme()");
  const usesToast = src.includes("useToast()");
  const usesI18n = src.includes("useTranslation");

  // ── 10. Magic numbers (suspicious pixel values) ──────────────────────────
  const magicNumRe = /:\s*((?:1[5-9][0-9]|[2-9][0-9]{2,}))\b(?!\s*%)/g;
  const magicNums = [];
  while ((m = magicNumRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const val = parseInt(m[1]);
    if (val > 150 && val < 2000) {
      const line = src.slice(0, m.index).split("\n").length;
      const lineText = lines[line - 1]?.trim() ?? "";
      if (
        !lineText.startsWith("//") &&
        !lineText.startsWith("*") &&
        !lineText.includes("fontSize") &&
        !lineText.includes("lineHeight")
      ) {
        magicNums.push({ line, val });
      }
    }
  }
  if (magicNums.length > 3) {
    issues.push({
      type: "spacing",
      severity: "low",
      line: 0,
      msg: `${magicNums.length} magic pixel values (>150px) — verify these are intentional layout values`,
    });
  }

  // ── Score ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const highCount = issues.filter((i) => i.severity === "high").length;
  const medCount = issues.filter((i) => i.severity === "medium").length;
  const lowCount = issues.filter((i) => i.severity === "low").length;
  const score = Math.max(0, 100 - highCount * 15 - medCount * 5 - lowCount * 1);

  return {
    file: rel,
    usesTheme,
    usesAppText,
    usesI18n,
    usesToast,
    hasStyleSheet,
    inlineStyleCount,
    styleSheetCount,
    variantsUsed: [...variantsUsed],
    issues,
    score,
    highCount,
    medCount,
    lowCount,
  };
}

// ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log("\n🎨  SkilledProzHirer — Styling & Font Consistency Audit\n");
console.log("=".repeat(70));

=== FILE: scripts/extract-keys.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Extract All Translation Keys
 *
 * This script extracts all translation keys from the codebase
 * and saves them to a file for review.
 *
 * Run: node scripts/extract-keys.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const CONFIG = {
  srcDir: path.join(rootDir, "src"),
  outputFile: path.join(rootDir, "translation-keys.json"),
  excludedDirs: ["node_modules", ".expo", ".git", "__pycache__"],
};

function getAllFiles(dir, fileList = []) {
  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);

  files.forEach((file) => {
    const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
    const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);

    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      if (!CONFIG.excludedDirs.includes(file)) {
        getAllFiles(filePath, fileList);
      }
    } else {
      const ext = path.extname(file);
      if ([".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx"].includes(ext)) {
        fileList.push(filePath);
      }
    }
  });

  return fileList;
}

function extractTranslationKeys(content, filePath) {
  const keys = new Set();
  const patterns = [
    /t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`]\)/g,
    /t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`],\s*\{/g,
    /t\(`([^`]+)`\)/g,
    /useTranslation\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`]\)/g,
    /i18n\.t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`]\)/g,
  ];

  patterns.forEach((pattern) => {
    let match;
    while ((match = pattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      const key = match[1];
      if (
        key &&
        !key.includes(" ") &&
        !key.includes("{") &&
        !key.includes("}")
      ) {
        keys.add(key);
      }
    }
  });

  return keys;
}

function main() {
  console.log("\n🔑  Extracting translation keys...\n");

  const files = getAllFiles(CONFIG.srcDir);
  console.log(`📁  Scanning ${files.length} files...`);

  const allKeys = new Set();
  const keySources = {};

  files.forEach((file) => {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
      const keys = extractTranslationKeys(content, file);
      const relativePath = path.relative(rootDir, file);

      keys.forEach((key) => {
        allKeys.add(key);
        if (!keySources[key]) {
          keySources[key] = [];
        }
        keySources[key].push(relativePath);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      // Skip files that can't be read
    }
  });

  // Sort keys alphabetically
  const sortedKeys = Array.from(allKeys).sort();

  // Create output data
  const output = {
    generated: new Date().toISOString(),
    totalKeys: sortedKeys.length,
    keys: sortedKeys,
    sources: keySources,
  };

  // Save to file
  fs.writeFileSync(CONFIG.outputFile, JSON.stringify(output, null, 2));

  console.log(`\n✅  Found ${sortedKeys.length} unique translation keys`);
  console.log(`📄  Saved to: ${CONFIG.outputFile}`);

  // Show sample
  console.log("\n📝  Sample keys:");
  sortedKeys.slice(0, 20).forEach((key, i) => {
    console.log(`  ${String(i + 1).padStart(3)}. ${key}`);
  });

  if (sortedKeys.length > 20) {
    console.log(`  ... and ${sortedKeys.length - 20} more`);
  }

  console.log("\n");
}

try {
  main();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Failed to extract keys:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}
