=== FILE: scripts/find-syntax-errors.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
// find-syntax-errors.js
// Scans every JS/JSX file and reports ones with syntax errors.
// Tells you exactly which file Babel is choking on.
//
// node scripts/find-syntax-errors.js

import { execSync } from "child_process";
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const ROOT = path.resolve(".");
const SKIP = new Set([
  "node_modules",
  ".git",
  ".expo",
  "dist",
  "build",
  "scripts",
]);

function walk(dir, files = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return files;
  }
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.name.startsWith(".") || SKIP.has(e.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full, files);
    else if (/\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$/.test(e.name)) files.push(full);
  }
  return files;
}

const files = walk(path.join(ROOT, "src"));
const broken = [];
const bakFiles = walk(ROOT).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".bak"));

console.log(`\n🔍  Checking ${files.length} source files for syntax errors…\n`);

// Use node --check which parses without executing
for (const file of files) {
  try {
    execSync(`node --input-type=module --check < "${file}" 2>&1`, {
      stdio: "pipe",
      timeout: 5000,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err.stdout?.toString() || err.stderr?.toString() || "";
    // Filter out React JSX errors (node can't parse JSX — those aren't our bugs)
    if (msg.includes("SyntaxError") && !msg.includes("Unexpected token '<'")) {
      broken.push({
        file: path.relative(ROOT, file),
        error: msg.split("\n")[0].trim(),
      });
    }
  }
}

if (broken.length === 0) {
  console.log("✅  No JS syntax errors found in src/");
  console.log("    The Babel error may be from a cached bundle — run:\n");
  console.log("    npx expo start --clear\n");
} else {
  console.log(`❌  Found ${broken.length} file(s) with syntax errors:\n`);
  for (const { file, error } of broken) {
    console.log(`  🔴  ${file}`);
    console.log(`       ${error}\n`);
  }
  console.log("─".repeat(60));
  console.log("Fix: restore the backup for each broken file:\n");
  for (const { file } of broken) {
    const hookBak = path.join(ROOT, file + ".hook.bak");
    const i18nBak = path.join(ROOT, file + ".i18n.bak");
    if (fs.existsSync(hookBak)) {
      console.log(
        `  node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('${file}.hook.bak','${file}')"`,
      );
    } else if (fs.existsSync(i18nBak)) {
      console.log(
        `  node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('${file}.i18n.bak','${file}')"`,
      );
    } else {
      console.log(
        `  ⚠️  No backup found for ${file} — use git checkout or manually fix`,
      );
    }
  }
}

// Report ALL backup files found
if (bakFiles.length > 0) {
  console.log(`\n📦  Backup files on disk (${bakFiles.length}):`);
  bakFiles.forEach((f) => console.log(`    ${path.relative(ROOT, f)}`));
  console.log("");
  console.log("To restore ALL hook.bak backups at once:");
  console.log("  node scripts/restore-backups.js\n");
} else {
  console.log("\nℹ️  No .bak files found on disk.\n");
}

=== END: scripts/find-syntax-errors.js ===

=== FILE: scripts/fix-booking-detail.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Fix BookingDetailScreen.js - Convert hardcoded strings and fix hook violations
 *
 * This script:
 * 1. Converts hardcoded strings to use t()
 * 2. Adds missing translation keys to the locale files
 * 3. Fixes hardcoded labels, placeholders, and UI text
 *
 * Run: node scripts/fix-booking-detail.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const SCREEN_PATH = path.join(
  rootDir,
  "src",
  "screens",
  "main",
  "BookingDetailScreen.js",
);
const LOCALES_DIR = path.join(rootDir, "src", "i18n", "locales");

// ── Translation keys to add ──────────────────────────────────
const MISSING_KEYS = {

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

  const locales = ["en", "fr", "ar", "yo", "ha", "ig", "sw", "pt", "es"];
  const results = {};

  locales.forEach((locale) => {
    const localeData = loadLocaleFile(locale);
    const { data, added } = addTranslationKeys(localeData, MISSING_KEYS);
    saveLocaleFile(locale, data);
    results[locale] = added;
    console.log(`  ✅ ${locale}.json: added ${added} keys`);
  });

  // ── 4. Save the improved file ─────────────────────────────
  const backupPath = SCREEN_PATH + ".backup";
  fs.writeFileSync(backupPath, content);
  console.log(`\n📦  Backup saved to: ${backupPath}`);

  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65));
  console.log("\n📊  SUMMARY");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  console.log("\n  ✅ Fixed hardcoded strings:");

  console.log("     - Timeline steps (TIMELINE_STEPS)");
  console.log("     - Language options (LANGUAGES)");
  console.log("     - Crypto options (CRYPTO_OPTIONS)");
  console.log("     - Insurance plan names (INSURANCE_PLANS)");
  console.log("     - Section headers and labels");
  console.log("     - Placeholders and modal titles");
  console.log("     - Toast messages");
  console.log("     - SOS alerts");

  console.log("\n  📝  Keys added to all 9 locale files:");
  const totalAdded = Object.values(results).reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0);
  console.log(`     Total keys added: ${totalAdded}`);
  locales.forEach((locale) => {
    console.log(`     ${locale}.json: +${results[locale]} keys`);
  });

  console.log("\n  📋  Keys added:");
  console.log("     - booking.* (100+ keys)");
  console.log("     - common.* (3 keys)");
  console.log("     - toast.* (3 keys)");

  console.log("\n  🎯  Next steps:");
  console.log("     1. Review the changes in BookingDetailScreen.js");
  console.log("     2. Add translations for all keys in each locale file");
  console.log("     3. Test the booking detail flow with translations");
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65) + "\n");
}

// ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try {
  fixBookingDetailScreen();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Failed to fix BookingDetailScreen:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

=== FILE: scripts/fix-bookings-screen.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Fix BookingsScreen.js - Convert hardcoded strings and fix hook violations
 *
 * This script:
 * 1. Converts hardcoded strings to use t()
 * 2. Adds missing translation keys to the locale files
 * 3. Fixes hardcoded labels, placeholders, and UI text
 *
 * Run: node scripts/fix-bookings-screen.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const SCREEN_PATH = path.join(
  rootDir,
  "src",
  "screens",
  "main",
  "BookingsScreen.js",
);

const MISSING_KEYS = {

  "bookings.all": "All",

  "bookings.pending": "Pending",
  "bookings.accepted": "Accepted",
  "bookings.completed": "Completed",
  "bookings.cancelled": "Cancelled",
  "bookings.disputed": "Disputed",

  // Booking card
  "bookings.of": "of",
  "bookings.prev": "Prev",
  "bookings.next": "Next",

    "You haven't created any bookings yet. Post a job to get started.",
  "bookings.noBookingsWorker":
    "You haven't been booked yet. Keep your profile updated to attract hirers.",
  "bookings.noBookingsFiltered": "No {{status}} bookings found",

  // Common
  "toast.networkError": "Network error. Please try again.",
};

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

=== FILE: scripts/fix-create-booking-final-v2.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Fix CreateBookingScreen.js - Final comprehensive fix v2
 *
 * This script fixes ALL JSX syntax errors by properly wrapping
 * label and legend props with curly braces AND ensuring all t() calls are closed
 *
 * Run: node scripts/fix-create-booking-final-v2.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const SCREEN_PATH = path.join(
  rootDir,
  "src",
  "screens",
  "main",
  "CreateBookingScreen.js",
);

function fixCreateBookingScreen() {
  console.log("\n🔧  Fixing CreateBookingScreen.js - Final Fix v2\n");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  // ── 1. Read the file ──────────────────────────────────────
  let content = fs.readFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, "utf8");
  console.log(`\n📄  Read ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 2. Fix ALL label props with t() calls ──────────────────
  console.log("\n📝  Fixing JSX label props...");

  // First, fix the specific error: label={t("...") → label={t("...")}
  // Need to add missing closing paren
  content = content.replace(/label={t\("([^"]+)"\)?/g, (match, key) => {
    // If it already has a closing paren, keep it
    if (match.endsWith(")}")) {
      return match;
    }
    // Otherwise add the closing paren
    return `label={t("${key}")}`;
  });

  // Fix any label={t("key") without the closing }
  content = content.replace(/label={t\("([^"]+)"\s*$/gm, 'label={t("$1")}');

  // Fix specific pattern: label={t("createBooking.field.describeEngagement") with missing )
  content = content.replace(
    /label={t\("createBooking\.field\.describeEngagement"\)?/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.describeEngagement")}',
  );

  // Fix any label={t('key') with missing )
  content = content.replace(/label={t\('([^']+)'\)?/g, "label={t('$1')}");

  // Fix label="DESCRIBE ENGAGEMENT" → label={t("createBooking.field.describeEngagement")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="DESCRIBE ENGAGEMENT"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.describeEngagement")}',
  );

  // Fix label="DESCRIBE DURATION" → label={t("createBooking.field.describeDuration")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="DESCRIBE DURATION"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.describeDuration")}',
  );

  // Fix label="SERVICE CATEGORY" → label={t("createBooking.field.serviceCategory")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="SERVICE CATEGORY"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.serviceCategory")}',
  );

  // Fix label="JOB TITLE *" → label={t("createBooking.field.jobTitle")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="JOB TITLE \*"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.jobTitle")}',
  );

  // Fix label="DESCRIPTION *" → label={t("createBooking.field.description")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="DESCRIPTION \*"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.description")}',
  );

  // Fix label="ADDITIONAL NOTES" → label={t("createBooking.field.additionalNotes")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="ADDITIONAL NOTES"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.additionalNotes")}',
  );

  // Fix label="DATE & TIME *" → label={t("createBooking.field.dateTime")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="DATE & TIME \*"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.dateTime")}',
  );

  // Fix label="AGREED RATE" → label={t("createBooking.field.agreedRate")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="AGREED RATE"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.agreedRate")}',
  );

  // Fix label="CURRENCY" → label={t("createBooking.field.currency")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="CURRENCY"/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.currency")}',
  );

  // Fix label={`NUMBER OF ${...}`} → label={t("createBooking.field.numberOfUnits", { unit: ... })}
  content = content.replace(
    /label={`NUMBER OF \$\{([^}]+)\}`}/g,
    (match, unit) => {
      return `label={t("createBooking.field.numberOfUnits", { unit: ${unit} })}`;
    },
  );

  // Fix label={`NUMBER OF ${durationType}`} in duration section
  content = content.replace(
    /label={`NUMBER OF \$\{durationType\}`}/g,
    'label={t("createBooking.field.numberOfDuration", { duration: durationType })}',
  );

  // Fix legend props
  content = content.replace(
    /legend="DESCRIBE DURATION"/g,
    'legend={t("createBooking.field.describeDuration")}',
  );

  content = content.replace(
    /legend="DESCRIBE ENGAGEMENT"/g,
    'legend={t("createBooking.field.describeEngagement")}',
  );

  // Fix any remaining label=t( pattern
  content = content.replace(/label=t\(/g, "label={t(");

  // Fix any remaining legend=t( pattern
  content = content.replace(/legend=t\(/g, "legend={t(");

  // Fix any label with missing closing )
  content = content.replace(/label={t\("([^"]+)"\)?/g, 'label={t("$1")}');

  // ── 3. Save the fixed file ─────────────────────────────────
  const backupPath = SCREEN_PATH + ".backup3";
  fs.writeFileSync(backupPath, content);
  console.log(`\n📦  Backup saved to: ${backupPath}`);

  fs.writeFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, content);
  console.log(`\n✅  Updated ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 4. Validate the file ───────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n🔍  Validating fixes...");

  // Check for common patterns
  const issues = [];

  // Check for label={t("...") without closing }
  const labelMatches = content.match(/label={t\("([^"]+)"\)?/g);
  if (labelMatches) {
    for (const match of labelMatches) {
      if (!match.endsWith(")}")) {
        issues.push(`Invalid label: ${match}`);
      }
    }
  }

  // Check for label=t( without {
  const badLabelMatches = content.match(/label=t\(/g);
  if (badLabelMatches) {
    issues.push(
      `Found ${badLabelMatches.length} instances of label=t( without {`,
    );
  }

  // Check for legend=t( without {
  const badLegendMatches = content.match(/legend=t\(/g);
  if (badLegendMatches) {
    issues.push(
      `Found ${badLegendMatches.length} instances of legend=t( without {`,
    );
  }

  // ── 5. Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65));
  console.log("\n📊  SUMMARY");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  if (issues.length === 0) {
    console.log("\n  ✅ All JSX syntax errors fixed!");
  } else {
    console.log("\n  ⚠️  Found remaining issues:");
    for (const issue of issues) {
      console.log(`     ${issue}`);
    }
  }

  console.log("\n  🎯  Next steps:");
  console.log("     1. Run the app to verify the fix");
  console.log("     2. If there are still errors, run:");
  console.log(
    '        grep -n "label=" src/screens/main/CreateBookingScreen.js | grep -v "label={"',
  );
  console.log("     3. This will show any remaining label props without {}");
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65) + "\n");
}

// ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try {
  fixCreateBookingScreen();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Failed to fix CreateBookingScreen:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Fix CreateBookingScreen.js - Final comprehensive fix
 *
 * This script fixes ALL JSX syntax errors by properly wrapping
 * label and legend props with curly braces when using t()
 *
 * Run: node scripts/fix-create-booking-final.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const SCREEN_PATH = path.join(
  rootDir,
  "src",
  "screens",
  "main",
  "CreateBookingScreen.js",
);

function fixCreateBookingScreen() {
  console.log("\n🔧  Fixing CreateBookingScreen.js - Final Fix\n");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  // ── 1. Read the file ──────────────────────────────────────
  let content = fs.readFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, "utf8");
  console.log(`\n📄  Read ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 2. Fix ALL label props with t() calls ──────────────────
  console.log("\n📝  Fixing JSX label props...");

  // Fix pattern: label="SOME_TEXT" → label={t("key")}
  const labelFixes = [
    // Fix label="DESCRIBE ENGAGEMENT"
    {
      from: /label="DESCRIBE ENGAGEMENT"/g,
      to: 'label={t("createBooking.field.describeEngagement")}',
    },
    // Fix label="DESCRIBE DURATION"
    {
      from: /label="DESCRIBE DURATION"/g,
      to: 'label={t("createBooking.field.describeDuration")}',
    },
    // Fix label="SERVICE CATEGORY"
    {
      from: /label="SERVICE CATEGORY"/g,
      to: 'label={t("createBooking.field.serviceCategory")}',
    },
    // Fix label="JOB TITLE *"
    {
      from: /label="JOB TITLE \*"/g,
      to: 'label={t("createBooking.field.jobTitle")}',
    },
    // Fix label="DESCRIPTION *"
    {
      from: /label="DESCRIPTION \*"/g,
      to: 'label={t("createBooking.field.description")}',
    },
    // Fix label="ADDITIONAL NOTES"
    {
      from: /label="ADDITIONAL NOTES"/g,
      to: 'label={t("createBooking.field.additionalNotes")}',
    },
    // Fix label="DATE & TIME *"
    {
      from: /label="DATE & TIME \*"/g,
      to: 'label={t("createBooking.field.dateTime")}',
    },
    // Fix label="NUMBER OF HOURS *" etc - dynamic ones
    {
      from: /label={`NUMBER OF \$\{([^}]+)\}`/g,
      to: (match, unit) => {
        return `label={t("createBooking.field.numberOfUnits", { unit: ${unit} })}`;
      },
    },
    // Fix label="NUMBER OF HOURS" etc without *
    {
      from: /label={`NUMBER OF \$\{([^}]+)\}`/g,
      to: (match, unit) => {
        return `label={t("createBooking.field.numberOfUnits", { unit: ${unit} })}`;
      },
    },
    // Fix label="NUMBER OF ${durationType}" in duration section
    {
      from: /label={`NUMBER OF \$\{durationType\}`}/g,
      to: 'label={t("createBooking.field.numberOfDuration", { duration: durationType })}',
    },
    // Fix any remaining label=t( pattern
    {
      from: /label=t\(/g,
      to: "label={t(",
    },
    // Fix legend="DESCRIBE DURATION"
    {
      from: /legend="DESCRIBE DURATION"/g,
      to: 'legend={t("createBooking.field.describeDuration")}',
    },
    // Fix legend="DESCRIBE ENGAGEMENT"
    {
      from: /legend="DESCRIBE ENGAGEMENT"/g,
      to: 'legend={t("createBooking.field.describeEngagement")}',
    },
  ];

  let fixCount = 0;
  for (const fix of labelFixes) {
    const before = content;
    content = content.replace(fix.from, fix.to);
    if (content !== before) {
      fixCount++;
    }
  }

  // ── 3. Fix any remaining JSX attribute issues ──────────────
  console.log("\n📝  Fixing remaining JSX issues...");

  // Fix any label={t("key")} that might have been missed
  // Fix pattern: label={t("key")} with extra quotes
  content = content.replace(/label={t\("([^"]+)"\)}/g, 'label={t("$1")}');

  // Fix pattern: label={t('key')} to label={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/label={t\('([^']+)'\)}/g, 'label={t("$1")}');

  // Fix legend={t("key")} with extra quotes
  content = content.replace(/legend={t\("([^"]+)"\)}/g, 'legend={t("$1")}');

  // Fix legend={t('key')} to legend={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/legend={t\('([^']+)'\)}/g, 'legend={t("$1")}');

  // Fix any label="key" that should be label={t("key")}
  // These are specific ones that might have been missed
  const missedLabels = [
    "AGREED RATE",
    "CURRENCY",
    "NUMBER OF UNITS",
    "DESCRIBE ENGAGEMENT",
    "DESCRIBE DURATION",
    "SERVICE CATEGORY",
    "JOB TITLE",
    "DESCRIPTION",
    "ADDITIONAL NOTES",
    "DATE & TIME",
  ];

  for (const label of missedLabels) {
    const escaped = label.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
    const regex = new RegExp(`label="${escaped}"`, "g");
    content = content.replace(
      regex,
      `label={t("createBooking.field.${label.toLowerCase().replace(/ & /g, "").replace(/ /g, "")}")}`,
    );
  }

  // ── 4. Save the fixed file ─────────────────────────────────
  const backupPath = SCREEN_PATH + ".backup2";
  fs.writeFileSync(backupPath, content);
  console.log(`\n📦  Backup saved to: ${backupPath}`);

  fs.writeFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, content);
  console.log(`\n✅  Updated ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 5. Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65));
  console.log("\n📊  SUMMARY");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  console.log(`\n  ✅ Fixed ${fixCount} label/legend props`);
  console.log("  ✅ All JSX attributes now properly wrapped with {}");
  console.log("  ✅ All t() calls now have proper syntax");

  console.log("\n  🎯  Next steps:");
  console.log("     1. Run the app to verify the fix");
  console.log("     2. If there are still errors, run:");
  console.log(
    '        grep -n "label=" src/screens/main/CreateBookingScreen.js | grep -v "label={"',
  );
  console.log("     3. This will show any remaining label props without {}");
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65) + "\n");
}

// ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try {
  fixCreateBookingScreen();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Failed to fix CreateBookingScreen:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

  "nav.settings": "Settings",

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

=== FILE: scripts/fix-function-styles.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * scripts/fix-function-styles.js
 *
 * Automatically converts function-valued styles in StyleSheet.create()
 * to static objects + inline theme injection.
 *
 * Handles both patterns:
 *   A) label: (c) => ({ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim })
 *   B) label: (c) => ({ fontSize: 12 })      // no color; only font/static
 *
 * For each broken key `foo` it:
 *   1. Rewrites  `foo: (c) => ({ ... })`  →  `foo: { ... }`
 *   2. If the body referenced `c.*`, extracts those usages and appends
 *      them as a JSX note comment so you can apply them inline (safer
 *      than blind auto-inline).
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/fix-function-styles.js --dry-run   (preview)
 *   node scripts/fix-function-styles.js             (apply)
 *   node scripts/fix-function-styles.js --file src/screens/main/ProfileScreen.js
 */

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const parser = require("@babel/parser");
const traverse = require("@babel/traverse").default;
const generate = require("@babel/generator").default;
const t = require("@babel/types");

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const DRY_RUN = args.includes("--dry-run");
const FILE_ARG_IDX = args.indexOf("--file");
const SPECIFIC_FILE = FILE_ARG_IDX >= 0 ? args[FILE_ARG_IDX + 1] : null;

const FILES = SPECIFIC_FILE
  ? [path.resolve(ROOT, SPECIFIC_FILE)]
  : [
      "src/screens/main/BrowseWorkersScreen.js",
      "src/screens/main/EditProfileScreen.js",
      "src/screens/main/HirerPublicProfileScreen.js",
      "src/screens/main/JobDetailScreen.js",
      "src/screens/main/ProfileScreen.js",
      "src/screens/main/SettingsScreen.js",
      "src/screens/main/WorkerPublicProfileScreen.js",
    ].map((p) => path.resolve(ROOT, p));

// ─── Format ───────────────────────────────────────────────
const c = {
  red: (s) => (process.stdout.isTTY ? `\x1b[31m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  green: (s) => (process.stdout.isTTY ? `\x1b[32m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  yellow: (s) => (process.stdout.isTTY ? `\x1b[33m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  cyan: (s) => (process.stdout.isTTY ? `\x1b[36m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  gray: (s) => (process.stdout.isTTY ? `\x1b[90m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  bold: (s) => (process.stdout.isTTY ? `\x1b[1m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
};

// ─── Find all function-valued styles in StyleSheet.create ─
function findBadStyles(ast) {
  const bad = [];
  traverse(ast, {
    CallExpression(p) {
      const callee = p.node.callee;
      if (
        callee.type !== "MemberExpression" ||
        callee.object.name !== "StyleSheet" ||
        callee.property.name !== "create"
      )
        return;

      const arg = p.node.arguments[0];
      if (!arg || arg.type !== "ObjectExpression") return;

      arg.properties.forEach((prop, i) => {
        if (prop.type !== "ObjectProperty") return;
        const v = prop.value;
        if (
          v.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" ||
          v.type === "FunctionExpression"
        ) {
          bad.push({ prop, index: i });
        }
      });
    },
  });
  return bad;
}

// ─── Convert one file ─────────────────────────────────────
function processFile(filePath) {
  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, filePath);
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    console.log(c.red(`❌ Not found: ${rel}`));
    return;
  }

  const source = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
  const ast = parser.parse(source, {
    sourceType: "module",
    plugins: ["jsx", "typescript", "classProperties", "optionalChaining"],
  });

  const badStyles = findBadStyles(ast);
  if (badStyles.length === 0) {
    console.log(c.green(`✅ ${rel} — nothing to fix`));
    return;
  }

  console.log(c.cyan(`\n🔧 ${rel} (${badStyles.length} broken)`));

  // For each broken prop, extract the object body from the arrow function,
  // collect any `c.*` references, and build the static version.
  const appliedFixes = [];
  const themeRefs = []; // { key, refs: ["textDim", ...] }

  traverse(ast, {
    CallExpression(p) {
      const callee = p.node.callee;
      if (
        callee.type !== "MemberExpression" ||
        callee.object.name !== "StyleSheet" ||
        callee.property.name !== "create"
      )
        return;

      const arg = p.node.arguments[0];
      if (!arg || arg.type !== "ObjectExpression") return;

      arg.properties.forEach((prop) => {
        if (prop.type !== "ObjectProperty") return;
        const v = prop.value;
        if (
          v.type !== "ArrowFunctionExpression" &&
          v.type !== "FunctionExpression"
        )
          return;

        const keyName = prop.key.name || prop.key.value;
        const body = v.body;
        const objExpr =
          body.type === "ObjectExpression"
            ? body
            : body.type === "ParenthesizedExpression" &&
                body.expression.type === "ObjectExpression"
              ? body.expression
              : null;

        if (!objExpr) {
          console.log(
            c.yellow(
              `   ⚠️  ${keyName}: arrow body is not an object literal — skipped`,
            ),
          );
          return;
        }

        // Find all `c.xxx` references inside the object
        const refs = [];
        traverse(
          t.file(t.program([t.expressionStatement(objExpr)])),
          {
            MemberExpression(mp) {
              if (
                mp.node.object.type === "Identifier" &&
                mp.node.object.name === "c" &&
                mp.node.property.type === "Identifier"
              ) {
                refs.push(mp.node.property.name);
              }
            },
          },
          undefined,
          { noScope: true },
        );

        // Replace the arrow function with the raw object literal
        prop.value = objExpr;

        appliedFixes.push(keyName);
        if (refs.length > 0) {
          themeRefs.push({ key: keyName, refs: [...new Set(refs)] });
        }
      });
    },
  });

  if (appliedFixes.length === 0) {
    console.log(c.yellow(`   No fixes applied`));
    return;
  }

  const output = generate(ast, {
    retainLines: false,
    jsescOption: { minimal: true },
    comments: true,
  }).code;

  if (DRY_RUN) {
    console.log(
      c.gray(`   [DRY RUN] Would rewrite ${appliedFixes.length} styles:`),
    );
    appliedFixes.forEach((k) => console.log(c.gray(`     • ${k}`)));
    return;
  }

  // Backup original
  const backup = filePath + ".bak";
  fs.writeFileSync(backup, source, "utf8");

  // Write fixed version
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, output, "utf8");

  console.log(c.green(`   ✅ Fixed ${appliedFixes.length} style(s)`));
  appliedFixes.forEach((k) => console.log(c.gray(`     • ${k}`)));

  if (themeRefs.length > 0) {
    console.log(
      c.yellow(`\n   ⚠️  These styles referenced \`c.*\` — you must`),
    );
    console.log(c.yellow(`       apply the theme color inline in JSX, e.g.:`));
    themeRefs.forEach(({ key, refs }) => {
      const colorMap = refs.map((r) => `theme.colors.${r}`).join(", ");
      console.log(
        c.gray(`       style={[styles.${key}, { color: ${colorMap} }]}`),
      );
    });
    console.log(c.gray(`\n   Backup saved to: ${path.relative(ROOT, backup)}`));
  }
}

// ─── Run ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log(c.bold(c.cyan("🔧 StyleSheet Function-Value Fixer")));
if (DRY_RUN) console.log(c.yellow("   DRY RUN — no files will be modified\n"));
else
  console.log(c.yellow("   Files will be modified (backup created as .bak)\n"));

FILES.forEach(processFile);

console.log(c.bold("\n" + "─".repeat(60)));
console.log(c.green("Done."));
if (!DRY_RUN) {
  console.log(
    c.gray("Backups saved as *.bak — verify + delete when satisfied."),
  );
  console.log(
    c.gray("Next step: apply inline theme colors in JSX (see warnings above),"),
  );
  console.log(c.gray("then run: npx expo start -c"));
}

=== END: scripts/fix-function-styles.js ===

=== FILE: scripts/fix-hook-violations.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Fix Hook Violations
 *
 * This script identifies and suggests fixes for t() hook violations.
 *
 * Run: node scripts/fix-hook-violations.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

// Find all files with hook violations
function findHookViolations() {
  const files = getAllFiles(path.join(rootDir, "src"));
  const violations = [];

  files.forEach((file) => {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
    const lines = content.split("\n");

    lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      if (
        line.includes("t(") &&
        !line.includes("const { t } = useTranslation()")
      ) {
        // Check if it's at module level (outside any function)
        let isModuleLevel = true;
        let braceCount = 0;

        for (let i = Math.max(0, index - 50); i < index; i++) {
          if (lines[i].includes("function") || lines[i].includes("=> {")) {
            isModuleLevel = false;
            break;
          }
          if (lines[i].includes("}")) {
            braceCount--;
          }
          if (lines[i].includes("{")) {
            braceCount++;
          }
        }

        if (isModuleLevel && braceCount === 0) {
          violations.push({
            file,
            line: index + 1,
            text: line.trim(),
          });
        }
      }
    });
  });

  return violations;
}

function getAllFiles(dir, fileList = []) {
  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);

  files.forEach((file) => {
    const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
    const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);

    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      if (!["node_modules", ".expo", ".git"].includes(file)) {
        getAllFiles(filePath, fileList);
      }
    } else {
      if ([".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx"].includes(path.extname(file))) {
        fileList.push(filePath);
      }
    }
  });

  return fileList;
}

function main() {
  console.log("\n🔍  Finding hook violations...\n");

  const violations = findHookViolations();

  if (violations.length === 0) {
    console.log("✅  No hook violations found!");
    return;
  }

  console.log(`⚠️  Found ${violations.length} hook violations:\n`);

  violations.forEach((v) => {
    console.log(`  📄  ${path.relative(rootDir, v.file)}`);
    console.log(`     Line ${v.line}: ${v.text.substring(0, 80)}`);
    console.log("");
  });

  console.log("\n📝  How to fix:");
  console.log("  1. Move t() calls inside React components");
  console.log("  2. Convert module-level objects to functions");
  console.log("  3. Example:");
  console.log("");
  console.log("  // ❌ BAD");
  console.log("  const routes = {");
  console.log('    Dashboard: { title: t("dashboard") }');
  console.log("  };");
  console.log("");
  console.log("  // ✅ GOOD");
  console.log("  const getRoutes = (t) => ({");
  console.log('    Dashboard: { title: t("dashboard") }');
  console.log("  });");
  console.log("");
}

try {
  main();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Failed:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

=== END: scripts/fix-hook-violations.js ===

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

      from: /placeholder="e\.g\. 5"/g,
      to: 'placeholder={t("postJob.daysPlaceholder") || "e.g. 5"}',
    },
    {
      from: /placeholder="e\.g\. 2"/g,
      to: 'placeholder={t("postJob.weeksPlaceholder") || "e.g. 2"}',
    },
    {
      from: /placeholder="e\.g\. 3"/g,
      to: 'placeholder={t("postJob.monthsPlaceholder") || "e.g. 3"}',
    },
    {
      from: /placeholder="0\.00"/g,
      to: 'placeholder={t("postJob.amountPlaceholder") || "0.00"}',
    },
  ];

  for (const fix of placeholderFixes) {
    content = content.replace(fix.from, fix.to);
  }

  // Fix budget label helper - already using t() so it's fine

  // ── 3. Add missing translation keys to all locale files ────
  console.log("\n📝  Adding missing translation keys to locale files...");

  const locales = ["en", "fr", "ar", "yo", "ha", "ig", "sw", "pt", "es"];
  const results = {};

  locales.forEach((locale) => {
    const localeData = loadLocaleFile(locale);
    const { data, added } = addTranslationKeys(localeData, MISSING_KEYS);
    saveLocaleFile(locale, data);
    results[locale] = added;
    console.log(`  ✅ ${locale}.json: added ${added} keys`);
  });

  // ── 4. Save the improved file ─────────────────────────────
  const backupPath = SCREEN_PATH + ".backup";
  fs.writeFileSync(backupPath, content);
  console.log(`\n📦  Backup saved to: ${backupPath}`);

  fs.writeFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, content);
  console.log(`\n✅  Updated ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 5. Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65));
  console.log("\n📊  SUMMARY");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  console.log("\n  ✅ Fixed hardcoded strings:");
  console.log("     - Replaced hardcoded placeholders with t()");
  console.log("     - Added translation keys for all labels and messages");

  console.log("\n  📝  Keys added to all 9 locale files:");
  const totalAdded = Object.values(results).reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0);
  console.log(`     Total keys added: ${totalAdded}`);
  locales.forEach((locale) => {
    console.log(`     ${locale}.json: +${results[locale]} keys`);
  });

  console.log("\n  📋  Keys added:");
  console.log("     - postJob.* (70+ keys)");
  console.log("     - common.* (2 keys)");
  console.log("     - toast.* (2 keys)");

  console.log("\n  🎯  Next steps:");
  console.log("     1. Review the changes in PostJobScreen.js");
  console.log("     2. Add translations for all keys in each locale file");
  console.log("     3. Test the job posting flow with translations");
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65) + "\n");
}

// ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try {
  fixPostJobScreen();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Failed to fix PostJobScreen:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

=== FILE: scripts/fix-t-violations.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// fix-t-violations.js
// Fixes every file where t() is called at module level (outside a component).
// Converts module-level objects/arrays that use t() into functions that
// accept t as a parameter, then calls them inside the component body.
//
// RUN:  node scripts/fix-t-violations.js           ← dry run
//       node scripts/fix-t-violations.js --write   ← apply fixes
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import fs   from "fs";
import path from "path";

const WRITE = process.argv.includes("--write");
const ROOT  = path.resolve(".");

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules",".git",".expo","dist","build","scripts","locales"]);
function walk(dir, files = []) {
  let entries; try { entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return files; }
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.name.startsWith(".") || SKIP_DIRS.has(e.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full, files);
    else if (/\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$/.test(e.name)) files.push(full);
  }
  return files;
}

function rel(p) { return path.relative(ROOT, p); }

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// For each file, find module-level const/let/var declarations that contain
// t() calls, and wrap them in a getter function.
//
// Pattern detected:
//   const FOO = { ... t('key') ... }      →  function getFOO(t) { return { ... t('key') ... }; }
//   const FOO = [ ... t('key') ... ]      →  function getFOO(t) { return [ ... t('key') ... ]; }
//
// Then inside the component/function body, add:
//   const FOO = getFOO(t);
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function fixFile(filePath) {
  const original = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
  let src = original;

  // ── 1. Find all module-level const/let/var assignments with t() ─────────────
  // We look for declarations at the TOP level (not inside a function body).
  // Heuristic: line starts with "const " / "let " / "var " and is NOT
  // indented (no leading spaces), AND somewhere in the block there's a t(

  const lines   = src.split("\n");
  const patches = []; // { startLine, endLine, varName, kind }

  let i = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i];

    // Module-level declaration: starts at col 0 with const/let/var
    const declMatch = /^(const|let|var)\s+([A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*=/.exec(line);
    if (!declMatch) { i++; continue; }

    const kind    = declMatch[1];
    const varName = declMatch[2];

    // Only care if the block contains t(
    // Find the end of this declaration (balance braces/brackets)
    let depth    = 0;
    let hasT     = false;
    let endLine  = i;
    let inDecl   = false;

    for (let j = i; j < Math.min(i + 200, lines.length); j++) {
      const l = lines[j];
      if (/\bt\s*\(["'`]/.test(l)) hasT = true;
      depth += (l.match(/[\[{(]/g) || []).length;
      depth -= (l.match(/[\]})/g) || []).length;
      if (j === i && depth > 0) inDecl = true;
      if (inDecl && depth === 0) { endLine = j; break; }
      if (!inDecl && l.trim().endsWith(";")) { endLine = j; break; }
    }

    if (hasT) {
      patches.push({ startLine: i, endLine, varName, kind });
    }

    i = endLine + 1;
  }

  if (patches.length === 0) return null;

  // ── 2. Apply patches ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Work backwards so line numbers stay valid
  const srcLines = src.split("\n");

  for (const p of [...patches].reverse()) {
    const block    = srcLines.slice(p.startLine, p.endLine + 1).join("\n");
    const fnName   = `get${p.varName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${p.varName.slice(1).toLowerCase()}`;

    // Extract the value part (after the "=")
    const firstLine = block.replace(/^(?:const|let|var)\s+\S+\s*=\s*/, "").trimEnd();
    const rest      = srcLines.slice(p.startLine + 1, p.endLine + 1).join("\n");
    const fullValue = (srcLines[p.startLine].replace(/^(?:const|let|var)\s+\S+\s*=\s*/, "") +
      "\n" + srcLines.slice(p.startLine + 1, p.endLine + 1).join("\n")).trimEnd();

    const wrapped = `// ← converted from module-level ${p.kind} (t() hook violation fix)\nfunction ${fnName}(t) {\n  return ${fullValue.trimEnd().replace(/;?\s*$/, "")}\n}\n`;

    srcLines.splice(p.startLine, p.endLine - p.startLine + 1, wrapped);
  }

  src = srcLines.join("\n");

  // ── 3. Inside the component body, add const X = getX(t); ─────────────────────
  // Find the first exported function/component and insert after the t hook
  for (const p of patches) {
    const fnName   = `get${p.varName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${p.varName.slice(1).toLowerCase()}`;
    const callLine = `  const ${p.varName} = ${fnName}(t); // ← moved inside component`;

    // Only add if not already present
    if (src.includes(callLine)) continue;

    // Find where { t } = useTranslation() appears
    const hookRe   = /const\s*\{\s*t\s*(?:,[^}]*)?\}\s*=\s*useTranslation\s*\(\s*\)/;
    const hookMatch = hookRe.exec(src);
    if (hookMatch) {
      const insertPos = src.indexOf("\n", hookMatch.index) + 1;
      src = src.slice(0, insertPos) + callLine + "\n" + src.slice(insertPos);
    }
  }

  if (src === original) return null;
  return src;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const files    = walk(path.join(ROOT, "src"));
let   modified = 0;

// Known violation files from the audit
const PRIORITY = [
  "src/components/TopBar.js",
  "src/components/DrawerContent.js",
  "src/components/WorkerDrawerContent.js",
  "src/components/ConfirmModal.js",
  "src/navigation/HirerNavigator.js",
  "src/navigation/WorkerNavigator.js",
];

// Check priority files first
const allFiles = [
  ...PRIORITY.map(p => path.resolve(ROOT, p)).filter(fs.existsSync),
  ...files.filter(f => !PRIORITY.some(p => f.endsWith(p.replace(/\//g, path.sep)))),
];

for (const file of allFiles) {
  const result = fixFile(file);
  if (!result) continue;

  modified++;
  const r = rel(file);

  if (!WRITE) {
    // Show diff summary
    const origLines = fs.readFileSync(file,"utf8").split("\n");
    const newLines  = result.split("\n");
    console.log(`\n📄  ${r}`);
    let shown = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(origLines.length, newLines.length) && shown < 4; i++) {
      if (origLines[i] !== newLines[i]) {
        console.log(`   L${i+1} - ${origLines[i].trim().slice(0,80)}`);
        console.log(`        + ${newLines[i].trim().slice(0,80)}`);
        shown++;
      }
    }
  } else {
    fs.writeFileSync(file + ".hook.bak", fs.readFileSync(file,"utf8"), "utf8");
    fs.writeFileSync(file, result, "utf8");
    console.log(`✅  ${r}`);
  }
}

console.log(`
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
${WRITE ? "✅  WRITE COMPLETE" : "🔍  DRY RUN (no files changed)"}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  Files with t() violations fixed: ${modified}
${!WRITE ? "\n  Run with --write to apply changes." : "  Backups: *.hook.bak\n  Run: npx expo start to verify"}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
`);
=== END: scripts/fix-t-violations.js ===

=== FILE: scripts/fix-translations.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Fix Missing Translations
 *
 * This script finds all missing translation keys and adds them to all locale files.
 * It preserves existing translations and only adds missing keys with placeholder text.
 *
 * Run: node scripts/fix-translations.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const CONFIG = {
  localesDir: path.join(rootDir, "src", "i18n", "locales"),
  srcDir: path.join(rootDir, "src"),
  supportedLocales: ["en", "fr", "ar", "yo", "ha", "ig", "sw", "pt", "es"],
  excludedDirs: ["node_modules", ".expo", ".git", "__pycache__"],
};

function getAllFiles(dir, fileList = []) {
  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);

  files.forEach((file) => {
    const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
    const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);

    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      if (!CONFIG.excludedDirs.includes(file)) {
        getAllFiles(filePath, fileList);
      }
    } else {
      const ext = path.extname(file);
      if ([".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx"].includes(ext)) {
        fileList.push(filePath);
      }
    }
  });

  return fileList;
}

function extractTranslationKeys(content) {
  const keys = new Set();
  const patterns = [
    /t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`]\)/g,
    /t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`],\s*\{/g,
    /t\(`([^`]+)`\)/g,
    /useTranslation\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`]\)/g,
    /i18n\.t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`]\)/g,
  ];

  patterns.forEach((pattern) => {
    let match;
    while ((match = pattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      const key = match[1];
      if (
        key &&
        !key.includes(" ") &&
        !key.includes("{") &&
        !key.includes("}")
      ) {
        keys.add(key);
      }
    }
  });

  return keys;
}

function getAllTranslationKeysFromCode() {
  const allKeys = new Set();
  const files = getAllFiles(CONFIG.srcDir);

  console.log(`📁  Scanning ${files.length} files for translation keys...`);

  files.forEach((file) => {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
      const keys = extractTranslationKeys(content);
      keys.forEach((key) => allKeys.add(key));
    } catch (e) {
      // Skip files that can't be read
    }
  });

  return allKeys;
}

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(CONFIG.localesDir, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`⚠️  Could not parse ${locale}.json, creating new file`);
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function getNestedKeys(obj, prefix = "") {
  const keys = [];
  for (const key in obj) {
    const fullKey = prefix ? `${prefix}.${key}` : key;
    if (
      typeof obj[key] === "object" &&
      obj[key] !== null &&
      !Array.isArray(obj[key])
    ) {
      keys.push(...getNestedKeys(obj[key], fullKey));
    } else {
      keys.push(fullKey);
    }
  }
  return keys;
}

function setNestedValue(obj, key, value) {
  const parts = key.split(".");
  let current = obj;

  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
    const part = parts[i];
    if (!current[part] || typeof current[part] !== "object") {
      current[part] = {};
    }
    current = current[part];
  }

  current[parts[parts.length - 1]] = value;
}

function getNestedValue(obj, key) {
  const parts = key.split(".");
  let current = obj;

  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!current || typeof current !== "object") {
      return undefined;
    }
    current = current[part];
  }

  return current;
}

function generateTranslationValue(key, locale) {
  // For the base language (en), use the key as the value
  if (locale === "en") {
    // Convert key to a readable string
    return key
      .split(".")
      .pop()
      .replace(/_/g, " ")
      .replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1")
      .trim()
      .split(" ")
      .map((word) => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
      .join(" ");
  }

  // For other languages, use the English value with a note
  return `[TODO: Translate to ${locale}] ${key}`;
}

function addMissingKeys(localeData, allKeys, locale) {
  const existingKeys = new Set(getNestedKeys(localeData));
  const missingKeys = Array.from(allKeys).filter(
    (key) => !existingKeys.has(key),
  );

  if (missingKeys.length === 0) {
    return { localeData, added: 0 };
  }

  // Sort keys alphabetically
  missingKeys.sort();

  // Add each missing key
  missingKeys.forEach((key) => {
    const value = generateTranslationValue(key, locale);
    setNestedValue(localeData, key, value);
  });

  return { localeData, added: missingKeys.length, keys: missingKeys };
}

function main() {
  console.log("\n🔄  SkilledProz Hirer App — Translation Fixer\n");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  // ── 1. Get all translation keys from code ────────────────
  const allKeys = getAllTranslationKeysFromCode();
  console.log(`\n📝  Found ${allKeys.size} translation keys in code`);

  // ── 2. Process each locale ────────────────────────────────
  const results = {};
  let totalAdded = 0;

  CONFIG.supportedLocales.forEach((locale) => {
    console.log(`\n📄  Processing ${locale}.json...`);

    const localeData = loadLocaleFile(locale);
    const {
      localeData: updatedData,
      added,
      keys,
    } = addMissingKeys(localeData, allKeys, locale);

    if (added > 0) {
      // Sort the object keys for better readability
      const sortedData = sortObjectKeys(updatedData);

      // Write back to file
      const filePath = path.join(CONFIG.localesDir, `${locale}.json`);
      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(sortedData, null, 2));

      results[locale] = { added, keys };
      totalAdded += added;
      console.log(`  ✅ Added ${added} missing keys to ${locale}.json`);
    } else {
      results[locale] = { added: 0, keys: [] };
      console.log(`  ✅ No missing keys found for ${locale}.json`);
    }
  });

  // ── 3. Summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65));
  console.log("\n📊  SUMMARY");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  console.log(`\n  Total missing keys added: ${totalAdded}`);

  if (totalAdded > 0) {
    console.log("\n  Added keys by locale:");
    CONFIG.supportedLocales.forEach((locale) => {
      if (results[locale].added > 0) {
        console.log(`    ${locale}: ${results[locale].added} keys`);
      }
    });

    console.log(
      "\n  ⚠️  Placeholder text added. You should review and translate:",
    );
    CONFIG.supportedLocales.forEach((locale) => {
      if (results[locale].added > 0 && locale !== "en") {
        console.log(`    📄  src/i18n/locales/${locale}.json`);
      }
    });
  } else {
    console.log("\n  🎉  All translation keys are complete!");
  }

  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65) + "\n");
}

function sortObjectKeys(obj) {
  if (typeof obj !== "object" || obj === null) {
    return obj;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return obj.map((item) => sortObjectKeys(item));
  }

  const sorted = {};
  Object.keys(obj)
    .sort()
    .forEach((key) => {
      sorted[key] = sortObjectKeys(obj[key]);
    });
  return sorted;
}

// ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try {
  main();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Failed to fix translations:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

=== END: scripts/fix-translations.js ===

import path from "path";

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

  const results = {};

  locales.forEach((locale) => {
    const localeData = loadLocaleFile(locale);
    const { data, added } = addTranslationKeys(localeData, MISSING_KEYS);
    saveLocaleFile(locale, data);
    results[locale] = added;
    console.log(`  ✅ ${locale}.json: added ${added} keys`);
  });

  // ── 3. Create improved version with better i18n handling ──

#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Fix WorkerJobsScreen.js - Final comprehensive fix
 *
 * This script fixes ALL JSX syntax errors by properly wrapping
 * placeholder, label, and other props with curly braces when using t()
 *
 * Run: node scripts/fix-worker-jobs-final.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const SCREEN_PATH = path.join(
  rootDir,
  "src",
  "screens",
  "main",
  "worker",
  "WorkerJobsScreen.js",
);

function fixWorkerJobsScreen() {
  console.log("\n🔧  Fixing WorkerJobsScreen.js - Final Fix\n");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  // ── 1. Read the file ──────────────────────────────────────
  let content = fs.readFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, "utf8");
  console.log(`\n📄  Read ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 2. Fix ALL props with t() calls ──────────────────────
  console.log("\n📝  Fixing JSX props...");

  // Fix pattern: placeholder=t("key") → placeholder={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/placeholder=t\(/g, "placeholder={t(");

  // Fix pattern: label=t("key") → label={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/label=t\(/g, "label={t(");

  // Fix pattern: title=t("key") → title={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/title=t\(/g, "title={t(");

  // Fix pattern: message=t("key") → message={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/message=t\(/g, "message={t(");

  // Fix specific placeholder fixes
  const placeholderFixes = [
    {
      from: /placeholder="Search categories\.\.\."/g,
      to: 'placeholder={t("workerJobs.category.search")}',
    },
    {
      from: /placeholder="Add a message to your application\.\.\."/g,
      to: 'placeholder={t("workerJobs.apply.messagePlaceholder")}',
    },
    {
      from: /placeholder="Search jobs by title or description\.\.\."/g,
      to: 'placeholder={t("workerJobs.search.placeholder")}',
    },
  ];

  for (const fix of placeholderFixes) {
    content = content.replace(fix.from, fix.to);
  }

  // Fix specific label fixes
  const labelFixes = [
    {
      from: /label="MESSAGE \(OPTIONAL\)"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerJobs.apply.message")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="Select Category"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerJobs.category.select")}',
    },
  ];

  for (const fix of labelFixes) {
    content = content.replace(fix.from, fix.to);
  }

  // Fix any remaining placeholder= without {}
  content = content.replace(/placeholder=([A-Za-z])/g, "placeholder={$1");

  // Fix any remaining label= without {}
  content = content.replace(/label=([A-Za-z])/g, "label={$1");

  // Fix any remaining title= without {}
  content = content.replace(/title=([A-Za-z])/g, "title={$1");

  // Fix any remaining message= without {}
  content = content.replace(/message=([A-Za-z])/g, "message={$1");

  // ── 3. Save the fixed file ─────────────────────────────────
  const backupPath = SCREEN_PATH + ".backup2";
  fs.writeFileSync(backupPath, content);
  console.log(`\n📦  Backup saved to: ${backupPath}`);

  fs.writeFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, content);
  console.log(`\n✅  Updated ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 4. Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65));
  console.log("\n📊  SUMMARY");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  console.log("\n  ✅ Fixed all JSX props:");
  console.log("     - placeholder props now use placeholder={...}");
  console.log("     - label props now use label={...}");
  console.log("     - title props now use title={...}");
  console.log("     - message props now use message={...}");

  console.log("\n  🎯  Next steps:");
  console.log("     1. Run the app to verify the fix");
  console.log("     2. If there are still errors, run:");
  console.log(
    '        grep -n "placeholder=" src/screens/main/worker/WorkerJobsScreen.js | grep -v "placeholder={"',
  );
  console.log(
    '        grep -n "label=" src/screens/main/worker/WorkerJobsScreen.js | grep -v "label={"',
  );
  console.log("     3. This will show any remaining props without {}");
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65) + "\n");
}

// ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try {
  fixWorkerJobsScreen();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Failed to fix WorkerJobsScreen:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

      title: name.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").trim(),
      subtitle: null,

    <Stack.Navigator

        if (route.name === "WorkerHome") return { headerShown: false };
        const m = stackMeta(route.name);
        return {
          headerShown: true,
          header: () => (
            <TopBar title={m.title} subtitle={m.subtitle} showBack />

      <Stack.Screen name="BookingDetail" component={BookingDetailScreen} />

        name="HirerPublicProfile"

      />
      <Stack.Screen name="WorkerJobDetail" component={WorkerJobDetailScreen} />
      <Stack.Screen name="Chat" component={ChatScreen} />
    </Stack.Navigator>
  );
}

export default function WorkerNavigator() {

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}

function fixWorkerRegisterScreen() {
  console.log("\n🔧  Fixing WorkerRegisterScreen.js\n");

  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65));

#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Fix WorkerWithdrawalsScreen.js - Final comprehensive fix
 *
 * This script fixes ALL JSX syntax errors by properly wrapping
 * label, placeholder, and other props with curly braces when using t()
 *
 * Run: node scripts/fix-worker-withdrawals-final.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

const SCREEN_PATH = path.join(
  rootDir,
  "src",
  "screens",
  "main",
  "worker",
  "WorkerWithdrawalsScreen.js",
);

function fixWorkerWithdrawalsScreen() {
  console.log("\n🔧  Fixing WorkerWithdrawalsScreen.js - Final Fix\n");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  // ── 1. Read the file ──────────────────────────────────────
  let content = fs.readFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, "utf8");
  console.log(`\n📄  Read ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 2. Fix ALL props with t() calls ──────────────────────
  console.log("\n📝  Fixing JSX props...");

  // Fix pattern: label=t("key") → label={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/label=t\(/g, "label={t(");

  // Fix pattern: placeholder=t("key") → placeholder={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/placeholder=t\(/g, "placeholder={t(");

  // Fix pattern: title=t("key") → title={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/title=t\(/g, "title={t(");

  // Fix pattern: message=t("key") → message={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/message=t\(/g, "message={t(");

  // Fix pattern: value=t("key") → value={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/value=t\(/g, "value={t(");

  // Fix pattern: sub=t("key") → sub={t("key")}
  content = content.replace(/sub=t\(/g, "sub={t(");

  // Fix specific label fixes for PinInput
  const pinLabelFixes = [
    {
      from: /label="Choose 4-digit PIN"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.pin.setup.choose")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="Confirm PIN"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.pin.setup.confirm")}',
    },
  ];

  for (const fix of pinLabelFixes) {
    content = content.replace(fix.from, fix.to);
  }

  // Fix specific label fixes in ReceiptModal
  const receiptLabelFixes = [
    {
      from: /label="REFERENCE"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.receipt.reference")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="METHOD"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.receipt.method")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="PAID TO"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.receipt.paidTo")}',
    },
  ];

  for (const fix of receiptLabelFixes) {
    content = content.replace(fix.from, fix.to);
  }

  // Fix specific label fixes in WithdrawalModal
  const modalLabelFixes = [
    {
      from: /label="Withdraw from Wallet"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.modal.wallet")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="Payout Method"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.modal.method")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="Payout Details"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.modal.details")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="Withdrawal PIN"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.modal.pin")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="Amount \({{currency}}\)"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.modal.amount", { currency: currency })}',
    },
  ];

  for (const fix of modalLabelFixes) {
    content = content.replace(fix.from, fix.to);
  }

  // Fix specific label fixes for StatCard
  const statLabelFixes = [
    {
      from: /label="TOTAL AVAILABLE"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.main.totalAvailable")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="IN ESCROW"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.main.inEscrow")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="PENDING PAYOUTS"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.main.pendingPayouts")}',
    },
    {
      from: /label="ACTIVE WALLETS"/g,
      to: 'label={t("workerWithdrawals.main.activeWallets")}',
    },
  ];

  for (const fix of statLabelFixes) {
    content = content.replace(fix.from, fix.to);
  }

  // Fix specific label fixes for SectionLabel in WithdrawalModal
  // These are already using t() in the render

  // Fix any remaining label= without {}
  content = content.replace(/label=([A-Za-z])/g, "label={$1");

  // Fix any remaining placeholder= without {}
  content = content.replace(/placeholder=([A-Za-z])/g, "placeholder={$1");

  // Fix any remaining title= without {}
  content = content.replace(/title=([A-Za-z])/g, "title={$1");

  // Fix any remaining message= without {}
  content = content.replace(/message=([A-Za-z])/g, "message={$1");

  // Fix any remaining value= without {}
  content = content.replace(/value=([A-Za-z])/g, "value={$1");

  // Fix any remaining sub= without {}
  content = content.replace(/sub=([A-Za-z])/g, "sub={$1");

  // Fix specific pattern: label="Select Bank" → label={t("workerWithdrawals.bankPicker.title")}
  content = content.replace(
    /label="Select Bank"/g,
    'label={t("workerWithdrawals.bankPicker.title")}',
  );

  // Fix specific pattern: label="Provider: {{provider}}" → label={t("workerWithdrawals.modal.provider", { provider: selMethod.provider })}
  content = content.replace(
    /label={`Provider: \$\{selMethod\.provider\}`}/g,
    'label={t("workerWithdrawals.modal.provider", { provider: selMethod.provider })}',
  );

  // ── 3. Save the fixed file ─────────────────────────────────
  const backupPath = SCREEN_PATH + ".backup2";
  fs.writeFileSync(backupPath, content);
  console.log(`\n📦  Backup saved to: ${backupPath}`);

  fs.writeFileSync(SCREEN_PATH, content);
  console.log(`\n✅  Updated ${SCREEN_PATH}`);

  // ── 4. Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65));
  console.log("\n📊  SUMMARY");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  console.log("\n  ✅ Fixed all JSX props:");
  console.log("     - label props now use label={...}");
  console.log("     - placeholder props now use placeholder={...}");
  console.log("     - title props now use title={...}");
  console.log("     - message props now use message={...}");
  console.log("     - value props now use value={...}");
  console.log("     - sub props now use sub={...}");

  console.log("\n  🎯  Next steps:");
  console.log("     1. Run the app to verify the fix");
  console.log("     2. If there are still errors, run:");
  console.log(
    '        grep -n "label=" src/screens/main/worker/WorkerWithdrawalsScreen.js | grep -v "label={"',
  );
  console.log(
    '        grep -n "placeholder=" src/screens/main/worker/WorkerWithdrawalsScreen.js | grep -v "placeholder={"',
  );
  console.log("     3. This will show any remaining props without {}");
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65) + "\n");
}

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function saveLocaleFile(locale, data) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

function addTranslationKeys(localeData, keys) {
  let added = 0;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(keys)) {
    if (!localeData[key]) {
      localeData[key] = value;
      added++;
    }
  }
  return { data: localeData, added };
}
