=== FILE: scripts/full-audit.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * SkilledProz Hirer App — Full Codebase Audit
 *
 * This script performs a comprehensive audit of the codebase including:
 * - Translation completeness for 9 languages
 * - t() hook violations
 * - Hardcoded strings
 * - Large files
 * - Console statements
 * - Import analysis
 * - Navigation completeness
 *
 * Run: node scripts/full-audit.js
 */

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const rootDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");

// ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────
const CONFIG = {
  srcDir: path.join(rootDir, "src"),
  localesDir: path.join(rootDir, "src", "i18n", "locales"),
  supportedLocales: ["en", "fr", "ar", "yo", "ha", "ig", "sw", "pt", "es"],
  excludedDirs: ["node_modules", ".expo", ".git", "__pycache__"],
  excludedFiles: [
    ".DS_Store",
    "*.png",
    "*.jpg",
    "*.jpeg",
    "*.gif",
    "*.webp",
    "*.ttf",
    "*.otf",
  ],
  largeFileThreshold: 300,
  criticalLargeFileThreshold: 500,
};

// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getAllFiles(dir, fileList = []) {
  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);

  files.forEach((file) => {
    const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
    const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);

    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      if (!CONFIG.excludedDirs.includes(file)) {
        getAllFiles(filePath, fileList);
      }
    } else {
      const ext = path.extname(file);
      if ([".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx", ".json"].includes(ext)) {
        const shouldExclude = CONFIG.excludedFiles.some((pattern) => {
          if (pattern.includes("*")) {
            const regex = new RegExp(pattern.replace("*", ".*"));
            return regex.test(file);
          }
          return file === pattern;
        });
        if (!shouldExclude) {
          fileList.push(filePath);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  return fileList;
}

function extractTranslationKeys(content) {
  const keys = new Set();
  // Matches t('key'), t("key"), t(`key`), t('key.subkey')
  const patterns = [
    /t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`]\)/g,
    /t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`],\s*\{/g,
    /t\(`([^`]+)`\)/g,
    /t\(['"`]([^'"`]+)['"`]\)/g,
  ];

  patterns.forEach((pattern) => {
    let match;
    while ((match = pattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
      const key = match[1];
      if (key && !key.includes(" ")) {
        keys.add(key);
      }
    }
  });

  return keys;
}

function findModuleLevelTCalls(content) {
  const violations = [];
  const lines = content.split("\n");

  lines.forEach((line, index) => {
    // Check if t() is called outside a React component
    if (
      line.includes("t(") &&
      !line.includes("const { t } = useTranslation()") &&
      !line.includes("const { t } = useTranslation(")
    ) {
      // Check if it's inside a component or function
      let inComponent = false;
      let inFunction = false;

      // Look backward for component/function definitions
      for (let i = Math.max(0, index - 20); i < index; i++) {
        if (
          lines[i].includes("function ") ||
          (lines[i].includes("const ") && lines[i].includes(" = (")) ||
          lines[i].includes("export default function")
        ) {
          inComponent = true;
          break;
        }
      }

      // Check if it's a module-level object/array
      if (!inComponent && !line.includes("//")) {
        violations.push({
          line: index + 1,
          text: line.trim(),
        });
      }
    }
  });

  return violations;
}

function findHardcodedStrings(content, filePath) {
  const hardcoded = [];
  const lines = content.split("\n");

  lines.forEach((line, index) => {
    // Skip lines with translation functions
    if (
      line.includes("t(") ||
      line.includes("i18n.t") ||
      line.includes("useTranslation")
    ) {
      return;
    }

    // Skip comments
    if (
      line.trim().startsWith("//") ||
      line.trim().startsWith("/*") ||
      line.trim().startsWith("*")
    ) {
      return;
    }

    // Check for hardcoded text in JSX (strings in quotes)
    const regex = /["']([^"']{3,})["']/g;
    let match;
    while ((match = regex.exec(line)) !== null) {
      const text = match[1];
      // Filter out common non-text strings
      if (!text.match(/^[a-zA-Z0-9]/) || text.length < 3) {
        continue;
      }
      // Skip common patterns
      if (
        text.match(/^http/) ||
        text.match(/^[0-9]+$/) ||
        text.match(/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/)
      ) {
        continue;
      }
      hardcoded.push({
        line: index + 1,
        text: text,
        context: line.trim(),
      });
    }
  });

  return hardcoded;
}

function analyzeFile(filePath) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
  const lines = content.split("\n").length;
  const hasTranslation =
    content.includes("useTranslation") ||
    content.includes("import { useTranslation }");

  // Extract translation keys
  const keys = extractTranslationKeys(content);

  // Find hook violations
  const violations = findModuleLevelTCalls(content);

  // Find hardcoded strings
  const hardcoded = findHardcodedStrings(content, filePath);

  // Count console statements
  const consoleCount = (
    content.match(/console\.(log|error|warn|info|debug)/g) || []
  ).length;

  return {
    path: filePath,
    lines,
    hasTranslation,
    keys: Array.from(keys),
    hookViolations: violations,
    hardcoded: hardcoded,
    consoleCount,
    isLarge: lines > CONFIG.largeFileThreshold,
    isCriticalLarge: lines > CONFIG.criticalLargeFileThreshold,
  };
}

function loadLocaleFile(locale) {
  const filePath = path.join(CONFIG.localesDir, `${locale}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return {};
}

function getAllTranslationKeys() {
  const allKeys = new Set();
  const files = getAllFiles(CONFIG.srcDir);

  files.forEach((file) => {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
    const keys = extractTranslationKeys(content);
    keys.forEach((key) => allKeys.add(key));
  });

  return allKeys;
}

function getNestedKeys(obj, prefix = "") {
  const keys = [];
  for (const key in obj) {
    const fullKey = prefix ? `${prefix}.${key}` : key;
    if (typeof obj[key] === "object" && obj[key] !== null) {
      keys.push(...getNestedKeys(obj[key], fullKey));
    } else {
      keys.push(fullKey);
    }
  }
  return keys;
}

// ── Main Audit ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function runAudit() {
  console.log("\n🔍  SkilledProz Hirer App — Full Codebase Audit\n");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  // ── 1. Get all source files ─────────────────────────────
  const files = getAllFiles(CONFIG.srcDir);
  console.log(`\n📁  Scanning ${files.length} source files...\n`);

  // ── 2. Analyze each file ─────────────────────────────────
  const analysis = files.map((file) => analyzeFile(file));

  // ── 3. Translation Analysis ──────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n📊  TRANSLATION ANALYSIS");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  const allKeys = getAllTranslationKeys();
  console.log(`\n📝  Total translation keys used in code: ${allKeys.size}`);

  const localeStats = {};
  let totalMissingKeys = 0;

  CONFIG.supportedLocales.forEach((locale) => {
    const localeData = loadLocaleFile(locale);
    const existingKeys = getNestedKeys(localeData);
    const existingSet = new Set(existingKeys);

    const missing = Array.from(allKeys).filter((key) => !existingSet.has(key));
    const missingCount = missing.length;
    totalMissingKeys += missingCount;

    const complete = missingCount === 0;
    const percentage =
      allKeys.size > 0
        ? (((allKeys.size - missingCount) / allKeys.size) * 100).toFixed(1)
        : 0;

    localeStats[locale] = {
      total: allKeys.size,
      existing: existingKeys.length,
      missing: missingCount,
      complete,
      percentage,
      missingKeys: missing,
    };

    const status = complete ? "✅" : missingCount < 10 ? "🟡" : "🔴";
    console.log(
      `  ${status}  ${locale.padEnd(6)}  ${String(percentage).padStart(6)}% complete  (${missingCount} missing)`,
    );
  });

  // ── 4. Translation Summary ───────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n📋  TRANSLATION SUMMARY");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  const completeLocales = CONFIG.supportedLocales.filter(
    (l) => localeStats[l].complete,
  );
  const incompleteLocales = CONFIG.supportedLocales.filter(
    (l) => !localeStats[l].complete,
  );

  console.log(
    `\n  ✅ Complete locales: ${completeLocales.length}/${CONFIG.supportedLocales.length}`,
  );
  if (completeLocales.length > 0) {
    console.log(`     ${completeLocales.join(", ")}`);
  }

  console.log(
    `\n  ⚠️  Incomplete locales: ${incompleteLocales.length}/${CONFIG.supportedLocales.length}`,
  );
  if (incompleteLocales.length > 0) {
    console.log(`     ${incompleteLocales.join(", ")}`);
  }

  console.log(`\n  📝  Total missing translations: ${totalMissingKeys}`);

  // Show top missing keys
  if (incompleteLocales.length > 0) {
    const allMissing = new Set();
    incompleteLocales.forEach((locale) => {
      localeStats[locale].missingKeys.forEach((key) => allMissing.add(key));
    });

    console.log(`\n  🔑  Top 10 missing keys:`);
    const sortedMissing = Array.from(allMissing).slice(0, 10);
    sortedMissing.forEach((key, i) => {
      console.log(`      ${String(i + 1).padStart(2)}. ${key}`);
    });
  }

  // ── 5. Hook Violations ────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n\n⚠️  HOOK VIOLATIONS (t() called outside React component)");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  const violations = analysis.filter((f) => f.hookViolations.length > 0);
  console.log(`\n  Found ${violations.length} files with t() hook violations:`);

  violations.forEach((file) => {
    console.log(`\n  📄  ${path.relative(rootDir, file.path)}`);
    file.hookViolations.forEach((v) => {
      console.log(
        `     Line ${String(v.line).padStart(4)}: ${v.text.substring(0, 80)}`,
      );
    });
  });

  // ── 6. Hardcoded Strings ──────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n\n📝  HARDCODED STRINGS (not using t())");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  const hardcodedFiles = analysis.filter(
    (f) => f.hardcoded.length > 0 && f.hasTranslation,
  );
  console.log(
    `\n  Found ${hardcodedFiles.length} files with hardcoded strings:`,
  );

  hardcodedFiles.slice(0, 10).forEach((file) => {
    console.log(
      `\n  📄  ${path.relative(rootDir, file.path)} (${file.hardcoded.length} strings)`,
    );
    file.hardcoded.slice(0, 3).forEach((h) => {
      console.log(`     Line ${String(h.line).padStart(4)}: "${h.text}"`);
    });
    if (file.hardcoded.length > 3) {
      console.log(`     ... and ${file.hardcoded.length - 3} more`);
    }
  });

  if (hardcodedFiles.length > 10) {
    console.log(`\n  ... and ${hardcodedFiles.length - 10} more files`);
  }

  // ── 7. Files Without Translation ──────────────────────────
  console.log("\n\n📄  FILES WITHOUT i18n SUPPORT");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  const noTranslation = analysis.filter(
    (f) => !f.hasTranslation && f.hardcoded.length > 0,
  );
  console.log(
    `\n  ${noTranslation.length} files have no i18n support but contain text:`,
  );

  noTranslation.slice(0, 10).forEach((file) => {
    console.log(
      `     📄  ${path.relative(rootDir, file.path)} (${file.hardcoded.length} strings)`,
    );
  });

  if (noTranslation.length > 10) {
    console.log(`     ... and ${noTranslation.length - 10} more`);
  }

  // ── 8. Large Files ────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n\n📏  LARGE FILES (>300 lines)");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  const largeFiles = analysis
    .filter((f) => f.isLarge)
    .sort((a, b) => b.lines - a.lines);
  console.log(
    `\n  ${largeFiles.length} files are >300 lines (${largeFiles.filter((f) => f.isCriticalLarge).length} >500 lines):`,
  );

  largeFiles.slice(0, 15).forEach((file) => {
    const indicator = file.isCriticalLarge ? "🔴" : "🟠";
    console.log(
      `  ${indicator} ${String(file.lines).padStart(4)} lines  ${path.relative(rootDir, file.path)}`,
    );
  });

  if (largeFiles.length > 15) {
    console.log(`\n  ... and ${largeFiles.length - 15} more large files`);
  }

  // ── 9. Console Statements ─────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n\n🔊  CONSOLE STATEMENTS");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  const filesWithConsole = analysis
    .filter((f) => f.consoleCount > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.consoleCount - a.consoleCount);
  const totalConsole = filesWithConsole.reduce(
    (sum, f) => sum + f.consoleCount,
    0,
  );

  console.log(
    `\n  ${totalConsole} console statements found in ${filesWithConsole.length} files`,
  );
  console.log(`  Top 10 files with console statements:`);

  filesWithConsole.slice(0, 10).forEach((file) => {
    console.log(
      `     ${String(file.consoleCount).padStart(3)}  ${path.relative(rootDir, file.path)}`,
    );
  });

  // ── 10. Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n\n📊  SUMMARY SCORECARD");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  const totalViolations = violations.reduce(
    (sum, f) => sum + f.hookViolations.length,
    0,
  );
  const totalHardcoded = hardcodedFiles.reduce(
    (sum, f) => sum + f.hardcoded.length,
    0,
  );

  console.log(`
  Metric                              | Value
  ────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────
  Source files scanned                | ${files.length}
  Translation keys used              | ${allKeys.size}
  Missing translations               | ${totalMissingKeys}
  Locales with 100% coverage         | ${completeLocales.length}/${CONFIG.supportedLocales.length}
  Hook violations                    | ${totalViolations}
  Hardcoded strings                  | ${totalHardcoded}
  Files without i18n                 | ${noTranslation.length}
  Large files (>300 lines)           | ${largeFiles.length}
  Critical large files (>500 lines)  | ${largeFiles.filter((f) => f.isCriticalLarge).length}
  Console statements                 | ${totalConsole}
  `);

  // ── 11. Generate Fix Commands ─────────────────────────────
  console.log("\n🛠️  FIX COMMANDS");
  console.log("═".repeat(65));

  console.log(`
  # 1. Fix missing translations (add all missing keys)
  node scripts/fix-translations.js
  
  # 2. Extract all translation keys
  node scripts/extract-keys.js
  
  # 3. Fix hook violations
  #   - Move t() calls inside components
  #   - Convert module-level objects to functions
  
  # 4. Remove console statements
  #   - Manually remove or use: npm run lint:fix
  
  # 5. Split large files
  #   - Break down files > 500 lines into smaller components
  `);

  // ── 12. Save Report ───────────────────────────────────────
  const report = {
    generated: new Date().toISOString(),
    filesScanned: files.length,
    translationKeys: Array.from(allKeys),
    localeStats,
    hookViolations: violations.map((f) => ({
      file: path.relative(rootDir, f.path),
      count: f.hookViolations.length,
      lines: f.hookViolations.map((v) => v.line),
    })),
    hardcodedStrings: hardcodedFiles.map((f) => ({
      file: path.relative(rootDir, f.path),
      count: f.hardcoded.length,
    })),
    largeFiles: largeFiles.map((f) => ({
      file: path.relative(rootDir, f.path),
      lines: f.lines,
    })),
    consoleStatements: filesWithConsole.map((f) => ({
      file: path.relative(rootDir, f.path),
      count: f.consoleCount,
    })),
  };

  const reportPath = path.join(rootDir, "full-audit-report.json");
  fs.writeFileSync(reportPath, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  console.log(`\n📄  Full audit report saved to: full-audit-report.json`);

  // ── 13. Grade ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const grade =
    totalMissingKeys === 0 && totalViolations === 0
      ? "A"
      : totalMissingKeys < 50 && totalViolations < 10
        ? "B"
        : totalMissingKeys < 200 && totalViolations < 50
          ? "C"
          : "D";

  console.log(`\n🏆  Overall Grade: ${grade}`);
  console.log("\n" + "═".repeat(65) + "\n");
}

// ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
try {
  runAudit();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("❌  Audit failed:", error.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// i18n-setup.js — Generates the i18n config files for the Expo app
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Run ONCE to scaffold the i18n infrastructure.
// Creates:
//   src/i18n/index.js         ← i18next config (import this in App.js)
//   src/i18n/useAppLocale.js  ← hook to get/set locale + persist to AsyncStorage
//   locales/en.json           ← (created by scan-i18n.js — don't overwrite)
//
// USAGE:  node scripts/i18n-setup.js
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const ROOT = path.resolve(".");
const I18N_DIR = path.join(ROOT, "src", "i18n");
fs.mkdirSync(I18N_DIR, { recursive: true });

// ── src/i18n/index.js ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const I18N_CONFIG = `// src/i18n/index.js
// i18next configuration for SkilledProz Expo app
// Supports 9 locales: en, fr, ar, yo, ha, ig, sw, pt, es

import i18n             from 'i18next';
import { initReactI18next } from 'react-i18next';
import * as Localization from 'expo-localization';

// Import all locale JSON files
import en from '../../locales/en.json';
import fr from '../../locales/fr.json';
import ar from '../../locales/ar.json';
import yo from '../../locales/yo.json';
import ha from '../../locales/ha.json';
import ig from '../../locales/ig.json';
import sw from '../../locales/sw.json';
import pt from '../../locales/pt.json';
import es from '../../locales/es.json';

export const LOCALES = [
  { code: 'en', name: 'English',     nativeName: 'English',    rtl: false },
  { code: 'fr', name: 'French',      nativeName: 'Français',   rtl: false },
  { code: 'ar', name: 'Arabic',      nativeName: 'العربية',    rtl: true  },
  { code: 'yo', name: 'Yoruba',      nativeName: 'Yorùbá',     rtl: false },
  { code: 'ha', name: 'Hausa',       nativeName: 'Hausa',      rtl: false },
  { code: 'ig', name: 'Igbo',        nativeName: 'Igbo',       rtl: false },
  { code: 'sw', name: 'Swahili',     nativeName: 'Kiswahili',  rtl: false },
  { code: 'pt', name: 'Portuguese',  nativeName: 'Português',  rtl: false },
  { code: 'es', name: 'Spanish',     nativeName: 'Español',    rtl: false },
];

const resources = { en, fr, ar, yo, ha, ig, sw, pt, es };

// Device locale → our supported locale (fallback: 'en')
function resolveLocale() {
  const deviceLocale = Localization.getLocales?.()?.[0]?.languageCode ?? 'en';
  return resources[deviceLocale] ? deviceLocale : 'en';
}

i18n
  .use(initReactI18next)
  .init({
    resources: Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(resources).map(([code, translations]) => [
        code,
        { translation: translations },
      ])
    ),
    lng:           resolveLocale(),
    fallbackLng:   'en',
    interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
    // RTL support — set I18nManager.allowRTL in App.js based on this
    compatibilityJSON: 'v4',
  });

export default i18n;
`;

// ── src/i18n/useAppLocale.js ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const USE_LOCALE = `// src/i18n/useAppLocale.js
// Hook to read and change the app locale, persisted in AsyncStorage

import { useCallback }      from 'react';
import { useTranslation }   from 'react-i18next';
import { I18nManager }      from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage         from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import * as Updates         from 'expo-updates';
import { LOCALES }          from './index';

const STORAGE_KEY = '@skilledproz_locale';

export function useAppLocale() {
  const { i18n } = useTranslation();

  const currentLocale = LOCALES.find((l) => l.code === i18n.language) ?? LOCALES[0];
  const isRTL = currentLocale.rtl;

  const changeLocale = useCallback(async (code) => {
    const locale = LOCALES.find((l) => l.code === code);
    if (!locale) return;

    await i18n.changeLanguage(code);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, code);

    // RTL languages (Arabic) need a full restart to flip layout
    if (locale.rtl !== I18nManager.isRTL) {
      I18nManager.allowRTL(locale.rtl);
      I18nManager.forceRTL(locale.rtl);
      await Updates.reloadAsync().catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [i18n]);

  const loadSavedLocale = useCallback(async () => {
    const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved && saved !== i18n.language) {
      await i18n.changeLanguage(saved);
    }
  }, [i18n]);

  return { currentLocale, isRTL, changeLocale, loadSavedLocale, locales: LOCALES };
}
`;

// ── App.js snippet ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const APP_SNIPPET = `// ── Add to your App.js (or _layout.tsx for Expo Router) ──────────────────────
// 1. Import i18n before anything else:
import './src/i18n/index.js';

// 2. Load saved locale on startup:
import { useAppLocale } from './src/i18n/useAppLocale';

export default function App() {
  const { loadSavedLocale } = useAppLocale();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSavedLocale();
  }, []);

  // ... rest of your App
}
`;

// ── Language picker component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LANG_PICKER = `// src/components/LanguagePicker.jsx
// Drop anywhere in settings screen

import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, FlatList, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { useAppLocale } from '../i18n/useAppLocale';

export default function LanguagePicker() {
  const { currentLocale, changeLocale, locales } = useAppLocale();

  return (
    <FlatList
      data={locales}
      keyExtractor={(item) => item.code}
      renderItem={({ item }) => {
        const active = item.code === currentLocale.code;
        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.item, active && styles.itemActive]}
            onPress={() => changeLocale(item.code)}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.name, active && styles.nameActive]}>
              {item.nativeName}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.sub}>{item.name}</Text>
            {active && <Text style={styles.check}>✓</Text>}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      }}
    />
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  item:       { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', padding: 14, borderBottomWidth: 0.5, borderColor: '#222' },
  itemActive: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(249,115,22,0.1)' },
  name:       { flex: 1, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '600', color: '#fff' },
  nameActive: { color: '#f97316' },
  sub:        { fontSize: 12, color: '#888', marginRight: 8 },
  check:      { color: '#f97316', fontWeight: '800' },
});
`;

// ── Write files ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const filesToWrite = [
  [path.join(I18N_DIR, "index.js"), I18N_CONFIG],
  [path.join(I18N_DIR, "useAppLocale.js"), USE_LOCALE],
  [path.join(ROOT, "src", "i18n", "App.snippet.js"), APP_SNIPPET],
  [path.join(ROOT, "src", "components", "LanguagePicker.jsx"), LANG_PICKER],

for (const [fp, content] of filesToWrite) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(fp), { recursive: true });

    fs.writeFileSync(fp, content, "utf8");
    console.log(`✅  Created: ${path.relative(ROOT, fp)}`);
  } else {
    console.log(`⏭️   Skipped (already exists): ${path.relative(ROOT, fp)}`);
  }
}

console.log(`
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅  i18n SCAFFOLD COMPLETE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Next steps:

#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/patch-locales-v2.js
// Run: node scripts/patch-locales-v2.js
// Adds ALL keys found in the hardcoded-string audit to all 9 locale files.

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const LOCALES_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "..", "src", "i18n", "locales");

function deepMerge(target, source) {
  const out = { ...target };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(source)) {
    if (
      v &&
      typeof v === "object" &&
      !Array.isArray(v) &&
      typeof out[k] === "object"
    ) {
      out[k] = deepMerge(out[k], v);
    } else if (!(k in out)) {
      out[k] = v;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// ── Apply ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let total = 0;
for (const [locale, patch] of Object.entries(PATCHES)) {
  const file = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(file)) {
    console.log(`⚠️  ${locale} — file not found`);
    continue;
  }
  const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
  const merged = deepMerge(existing, patch);
  fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2) + "\n", "utf8");
  console.log(`✅  ${locale.toUpperCase()} — patched`);
  total++;
}
console.log(`\n✅  Done. Patched ${total} locale files.\n`);
console.log(
  "Now run: node scripts/check-hardcoded.js to see remaining code fixes needed.\n",
);

=== END: scripts/patch-locales-v2.js ===

=== FILE: scripts/patch-locales.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/patch-locales.js
// Run from project root: node patch-locales.js
// Deep-merges missing keys into every locale file.

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const LOCALES_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "..", "src", "i18n", "locales");

// ── Deep merge helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function deepMerge(target, source) {
  const out = { ...target };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(source)) {
    if (
      v &&
      typeof v === "object" &&
      !Array.isArray(v) &&
      typeof out[k] === "object"
    ) {
      out[k] = deepMerge(out[k], v);
    } else if (!(k in out)) {
      out[k] = v; // only add — never overwrite existing translations
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// ── Patches per locale ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── Apply patches ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let totalAdded = 0;

for (const [locale, patch] of Object.entries(PATCHES)) {
  const file = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale}.json`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(file)) {
    console.log(`⚠️  Skipping ${locale} — file not found: ${file}`);
    continue;
  }
  const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
  const merged = deepMerge(existing, patch);

  // Count added keys
  const before = JSON.stringify(existing).length;
  const after = JSON.stringify(merged).length;
  const changed = after > before;

  fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2) + "\n", "utf8");

  if (changed) {
    console.log(`✅  ${locale.toUpperCase()} — patched`);
    totalAdded++;
  } else {
    console.log(`⏭️   ${locale.toUpperCase()} — already up to date`);
  }
}

console.log(
  `\n✅  Done. Patched ${totalAdded} locale file(s). Run check-locales.js to verify.\n`,
);

=== END: scripts/patch-locales.js ===

const LANGS = ["en", "ar", "es", "fr", "ha", "ig", "pt", "yo", "zh"];
let ok = 0,
  fail = 0;

for (const lang of LANGS) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${lang}.json`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    console.warn(`⚠️  ${lang}.json not found — skipping`);
    fail++;
    continue;
  }
  try {
    const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));
    existing.workerDash = {
      ...(existing.workerDash ?? {}),
      ...(PATCH[lang]?.workerDash ?? {}),
    };
    fs.writeFileSync(
      filePath,
      JSON.stringify(existing, null, 2) + "\n",
      "utf8",
    );
    console.log(`✅  ${lang}.json — workerDash patched`);
    ok++;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌  ${lang}.json:`, err.message);
    fail++;
  }
}
console.log(`\nDone: ${ok} patched, ${fail} failed.`);
if (fail > 0) process.exit(1);

=== END: scripts/patch-worker-dashboard-i18n.js ===

      loadFail: "加载评价失败",
    },
  },
};

// ─── Merge into locale files ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LOCALES_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "..", "src", "i18n", "locales");

let ok = 0;
let fail = 0;

for (const [lang, patch] of Object.entries(PATCHES)) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${lang}.json`);

  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    console.warn(`⚠️  ${lang}.json not found at ${filePath} — skipping`);
    fail++;
    continue;
  }

  try {
    const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));
    const merged = { ...existing, ...patch };
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2) + "\n", "utf8");
    console.log(
      `✅  Patched ${lang}.json — added workerCat, workerWallet, workerEarnings, workerReviews`,
    );
    ok++;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌  Failed to patch ${lang}.json:`, err.message);
    fail++;
  }
}

console.log(`\nDone: ${ok} patched, ${fail} failed.`);
if (fail > 0) process.exit(1);

// ─── Merge into locale files ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LANGS = ["en", "ar", "es", "fr", "ha", "ig", "pt", "yo", "zh"];
let ok = 0,
  fail = 0;

for (const lang of LANGS) {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${lang}.json`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    console.warn(`⚠️  ${lang}.json not found — skipping`);
    fail++;
    continue;
  }
  try {
    const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));

    // Merge nav keys INTO existing nav object
    existing.nav = { ...existing.nav, ...(NAV_PATCH[lang] ?? {}) };

    // Add screenSub namespace
    existing.screenSub = {
      ...(existing.screenSub ?? {}),
      ...(SCREEN_SUB_PATCH[lang]?.screenSub ?? {}),
    };

    fs.writeFileSync(
      filePath,
      JSON.stringify(existing, null, 2) + "\n",
      "utf8",
    );
    console.log(`✅  ${lang}.json — nav + screenSub patched`);
    ok++;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌  ${lang}.json:`, err.message);
    fail++;
  }
}
console.log(`\nDone: ${ok} patched, ${fail} failed.`);
if (fail > 0) process.exit(1);

    "Set at least one rate (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or custom)",

let skipped = 0;

  const path = `${LOCALES_DIR}/${locale}.json`;
  try {
    const json = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, "utf8"));
    if (json.workerReg) {
      // Merge missing keys only
      const missing = Object.keys(WORKER_REG).filter(
        (k) => !(k in json.workerReg),
      );
      if (missing.length === 0) {
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }
      missing.forEach((k) => {
        json.workerReg[k] = WORKER_REG[k];
      });
    } else {
      json.workerReg = { ...WORKER_REG };
    }
    writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(json, null, 2) + "\n", "utf8");
    console.log(`✅  ${locale}.json — patched`);
    patched++;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌  ${locale}.json — ${err.message}`);
  }
}

console.log(
  `\nDone. Patched: ${patched}  Skipped (already complete): ${skipped}`,
);

#!/usr/bin/env node
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// project-audit.js — Full SkilledProz Expo App Project Audit
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Scans the entire project and produces a single audit-report.md covering:
//
//  §1  Project structure overview
//  §2  Package.json analysis (deps, outdated, missing, unused)
//  §3  i18n completeness (locale files vs actual t() usage)
//  §4  Broken / missing imports
//  §5  t() called outside React component (module-level hook violations)
//  §6  Hardcoded strings still remaining
//  §7  TODO / FIXME / HACK / TEMP comments
//  §8  Console.log left in production code
//  §9  Empty / placeholder screens
//  §10 API endpoint usage (what's called, what might be missing)
//  §11 Navigation screen inventory (registered vs referenced)
//  §12 AsyncStorage key inventory
//  §13 Image / asset references (missing files)
//  §14 Large files (potential performance issues)
//  §15 Duplicate components (same filename in different dirs)
//  §16 Summary scorecard
//
// USAGE:
//   node scripts/project-audit.js
//   node scripts/project-audit.js --dir src   (limit scope)
//   node scripts/project-audit.js --out audit  (custom output folder)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const dirIdx = args.indexOf("--dir");
const outIdx = args.indexOf("--out");
const ROOT = dirIdx >= 0 ? path.resolve(args[dirIdx + 1]) : path.resolve(".");
const OUT = outIdx >= 0 ? path.resolve(args[outIdx + 1]) : ROOT;

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  "node_modules",
  ".git",
  ".expo",
  "dist",
  "build",
  "coverage",
  ".next",
  "__pycache__",
  "android",
  "ios",
  ".gradle",
]);
const CODE_EXTS = new Set([".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx"]);
const ASSET_EXTS = new Set([
  ".png",
  ".jpg",
  ".jpeg",
  ".gif",
  ".webp",
  ".svg",
  ".ttf",
  ".otf",
]);

// ── Walk helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function walk(dir, filter = () => true, files = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return files;
  }
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.name.startsWith(".")) continue;
    if (SKIP_DIRS.has(e.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full, filter, files);
    else if (filter(e.name, full)) files.push(full);
  }
  return files;
}

function rel(p) {
  return path.relative(ROOT, p);
}
function readSrc(p) {
  try {
    return fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

const codeFiles = walk(ROOT, (n) => CODE_EXTS.has(path.extname(n)));
const assetFiles = walk(ROOT, (n) => ASSET_EXTS.has(path.extname(n)));

console.log(`\n🔍  Auditing: ${ROOT}`);
console.log(
  `    ${codeFiles.length} code files · ${assetFiles.length} asset files\n`,
);

const report = []; // markdown lines
const score = { checks: 0, passed: 0, warnings: 0, errors: 0 };

function pass(msg) {
  score.checks++;
  score.passed++;
  return `✅ ${msg}`;
}
function warn(msg) {
  score.checks++;
  score.warnings++;
  return `⚠️  ${msg}`;
}
function fail(msg) {
  score.checks++;
  score.errors++;
  return `❌ ${msg}`;
}
function info(msg) {
  return `ℹ️  ${msg}`;
}

function section(title) {
  report.push("", `## ${title}`, "");
}
function sub(title) {
  report.push("", `### ${title}`, "");
}

report.push(
  "# SkilledProz Expo App — Full Project Audit",
  "",
  `> Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
  `> Root: \`${ROOT}\``,
  "",
);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §1  PROJECT STRUCTURE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§1  Project Structure");

const topLevel = fs
  .readdirSync(ROOT, { withFileTypes: true })
  .filter((e) => !e.name.startsWith(".") && !SKIP_DIRS.has(e.name))
  .map((e) => `${e.isDirectory() ? "📁" : "📄"} ${e.name}`)
  .join("\n");

report.push("```", topLevel, "```", "");

// Count by folder
const folderCounts = {};
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const parts = path.relative(ROOT, f).split(path.sep);
  const top = parts.length > 1 ? parts[0] : "(root)";
  folderCounts[top] = (folderCounts[top] || 0) + 1;
}
report.push("| Folder | Code Files |", "|--------|-----------|");
for (const [folder, count] of Object.entries(folderCounts).sort(
  (a, b) => b[1] - a[1],
)) {
  report.push(`| \`${folder}\` | ${count} |`);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

section("§2  package.json Analysis");

const pkgPath = path.join(ROOT, "package.json");
let pkg = {};
if (fs.existsSync(pkgPath)) {
  pkg = JSON.parse(readSrc(pkgPath));
  report.push(
    pass(
      `package.json found — name: \`${pkg.name || "unnamed"}\`, version: \`${pkg.version || "?"}\``,
    ),
  );
} else {
  report.push(fail("package.json not found"));
}

const deps = { ...(pkg.dependencies || {}), ...(pkg.devDependencies || {}) };
const depList = Object.keys(deps);

// Check critical Expo/i18n deps
const REQUIRED = [
  "expo",
  "react",
  "react-native",
  "react-navigation",
  "@react-navigation/native",
  "i18next",
  "react-i18next",
  "expo-localization",
  "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage",
];
const RECOMMENDED = [
  "expo-image-picker",
  "expo-document-picker",
  "expo-clipboard",
  "@vitalets/google-translate-api",
  "expo-updates",
];

sub("Required Dependencies");
for (const dep of REQUIRED) {
  const has = depList.some((d) => d === dep || d.startsWith(dep + "/"));
  report.push(
    has ? pass(dep) : fail(`\`${dep}\` is MISSING — run: npm install ${dep}`),
  );
}

sub("Recommended Dependencies");
for (const dep of RECOMMENDED) {
  const has = depList.some((d) => d === dep || d.startsWith(dep + "/"));
  report.push(has ? pass(dep) : warn(`\`${dep}\` not found`));
}

// Check for type:module
if (pkg.type === "module") {
  report.push("", pass('`"type": "module"` set — ES module warnings resolved'));
} else {
  report.push(
    "",
    warn(
      '`"type": "module"` missing in package.json — Node shows ESM warning on every script run. Add it.',
    ),
  );
}

// All deps list
sub("All Dependencies");
report.push(`${depList.length} total packages installed.`, "");
report.push("<details><summary>Show all</summary>", "");
report.push("```");
for (const [name, ver] of Object.entries({
  ...(pkg.dependencies || {}),
  ...(pkg.devDependencies || {}),
})) {
  report.push(`${name}: ${ver}`);
}
report.push("```", "", "</details>");

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §3  i18n COMPLETENESS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§3  i18n Completeness");

const localesDir = path.join(ROOT, "locales");
const LOCALE_CODES = ["en", "fr", "ar", "yo", "ha", "ig", "sw", "pt", "es"];

if (!fs.existsSync(localesDir)) {
  report.push(fail("`locales/` directory not found — run scan-i18n.js first"));
} else {
  const localeData = {};
  for (const code of LOCALE_CODES) {
    const fp = path.join(localesDir, `${code}.json`);
    if (fs.existsSync(fp)) {
      try {
        localeData[code] = JSON.parse(readSrc(fp));
      } catch {
        localeData[code] = {};
      }
    }
  }

  // Count filled values recursively
  function countValues(obj, onlyFilled = false) {
    let n = 0;
    for (const v of Object.values(obj || {})) {
      if (typeof v === "object" && v !== null) n += countValues(v, onlyFilled);
      else if (typeof v === "string") {
        if (!onlyFilled || v.trim() !== "") n++;
      }
    }
    return n;
  }

  const enTotal = countValues(localeData["en"] || {});
  report.push(`English base has **${enTotal}** translation keys.\n`);
  report.push("| Locale | Code | Keys Filled | % Complete | Status |");
  report.push("|--------|------|-------------|------------|--------|");

  for (const code of LOCALE_CODES) {
    const d = localeData[code] || {};
    const filled = countValues(d, true);
    const total = enTotal || 1;
    const pct = Math.round((filled / total) * 100);
    const status =
      pct === 100 ? "✅ Complete" : pct > 50 ? "⚠️ Partial" : "❌ Empty";
    const name = {
      en: "English",
      fr: "French",
      ar: "Arabic",
      yo: "Yoruba",
      ha: "Hausa",
      ig: "Igbo",
      sw: "Swahili",
      pt: "Portuguese",
      es: "Spanish",
    }[code];
    report.push(
      `| ${name} | \`${code}\` | ${filled}/${total} | ${pct}% | ${status} |`,
    );
    if (pct < 100) score.warnings++;
    else score.passed++;
    score.checks++;
  }

  // Find t() calls in code
  const tCalls = new Set();
  for (const f of codeFiles) {
    const src = readSrc(f);
    const re = /\bt\s*\(\s*["'`]([\w.]+)["'`]\s*\)/g;
    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) tCalls.add(m[1]);
  }

  // Check if t() keys exist in en.json
  function getNestedKey(obj, keyPath) {
    return keyPath
      .split(".")
      .reduce((o, k) => (o && typeof o === "object" ? o[k] : undefined), obj);
  }

  const missingKeys = [...tCalls].filter(
    (k) => getNestedKey(localeData["en"] || {}, k) === undefined,
  );

  sub("Missing Translation Keys");
  if (missingKeys.length === 0) {
    report.push(pass(`All ${tCalls.size} t() keys found in en.json`));
  } else {
    report.push(
      fail(
        `${missingKeys.length} t() keys used in code but MISSING from en.json:`,
      ),
    );
    report.push("```");
    missingKeys.slice(0, 50).forEach((k) => report.push(k));
    if (missingKeys.length > 50)
      report.push(`… and ${missingKeys.length - 50} more`);
    report.push("```");
    score.errors++;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §4  BROKEN IMPORTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§4  Broken / Suspicious Imports");

const brokenImports = [];
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const src = readSrc(f);
  const dir = path.dirname(f);
  const importRe =
    /(?:import|require)\s*(?:\(?\s*["'`])(\.{1,2}\/[^"'`\n]+)["'`\s)]/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = importRe.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const imp = m[1].split("?")[0]; // strip query strings
    const absBase = path.resolve(dir, imp);
    // Check if file exists with any code extension or as directory index
    const exts = [
      "",
      ".js",
      ".jsx",
      ".ts",
      ".tsx",
      "/index.js",
      "/index.jsx",
      "/index.ts",
      "/index.tsx",
    ];
    const found = exts.some((ext) => fs.existsSync(absBase + ext));
    if (!found) {
      brokenImports.push({ file: rel(f), import: imp });
    }
  }
}

if (brokenImports.length === 0) {
  report.push(pass("No broken relative imports found"));
} else {
  report.push(fail(`${brokenImports.length} potentially broken imports:`));
  report.push("| File | Import |", "|------|--------|");
  brokenImports
    .slice(0, 30)
    .forEach(({ file, import: imp }) =>
      report.push(`| \`${file}\` | \`${imp}\` |`),
    );
  if (brokenImports.length > 30)
    report.push(`| … | and ${brokenImports.length - 30} more |`);
  score.errors += Math.min(brokenImports.length, 1);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §5  t() CALLED AT MODULE LEVEL (hook violation)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§5  t() Called Outside React Component (Hook Violations)");

const hookViolations = [];
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const src = readSrc(f);
  const lines = src.split("\n");
  let depth = 0; // brace depth
  let inComponent = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i];

    // Track function declarations (components start at depth 0)
    if (
      /^(?:export\s+default\s+function|export\s+function|function\s+[A-Z])/.test(
        line.trim(),
      )
    ) {
      inComponent = true;
    }
    // Count braces
    depth += (line.match(/\{/g) || []).length;
    depth -= (line.match(/\}/g) || []).length;
    if (depth <= 0) {
      depth = 0;
      inComponent = false;
    }

    // t() call outside a component (depth 0 or in module-level const)
    if (
      !inComponent &&
      /\bt\s*\(/.test(line) &&
      !/\/\//.test(line.split("t(")[0])
    ) {
      // Check it's not inside a regular function call chain
      if (/(?:^|\s|=|\[|,)\bt\s*\(["'`]/.test(line)) {
        hookViolations.push({
          file: rel(f),
          line: i + 1,
          code: line.trim().slice(0, 80),
        });
      }
    }
  }
}

if (hookViolations.length === 0) {
  report.push(pass("No module-level t() calls detected"));
} else {
  report.push(
    fail(
      `${hookViolations.length} t() calls found OUTSIDE React components — these will crash:`,
    ),
  );
  report.push("| File | Line | Code |", "|------|------|------|");
  hookViolations
    .slice(0, 20)
    .forEach(({ file, line, code }) =>
      report.push(`| \`${file}\` | ${line} | \`${code}\` |`),
    );
  if (hookViolations.length > 20)
    report.push(`| … | | and ${hookViolations.length - 20} more |`);
  report.push("");
  report.push(
    "> **Fix:** Convert module-level arrays/objects that use `t()` into functions that accept `t` as a parameter, called inside the component body.",
  );
  score.errors += Math.min(hookViolations.length, 1);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §6  REMAINING HARDCODED STRINGS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§6  Remaining Hardcoded Strings");

const hardcoded = [];
const IGNORE = [
  /^https?:\/\//,
  /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/,
  /^\d+(\.\d+)?(px|%)?$/,
  /^[A-Z_]{2,}$/,
  /^\s*$/,
  /^[\W\d]+$/,
  /^(true|false|null)$/,
  /^(flex|absolute|relative|center|row|column)$/,
  /^rgba?\(/,
];
function isHard(s) {
  if (s.length < 3) return false;
  return !IGNORE.some((r) => r.test(s.trim()));
}

for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const src = readSrc(f);
  const lines = src.split("\n");
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    if (/\bt\s*\(/.test(line)) return; // already translated
    // JSX text
    const jsxM = line.match(/>\s*([A-Za-z][^<>{}\n]{3,}?)\s*</);
    if (jsxM && isHard(jsxM[1])) {
      hardcoded.push({ file: rel(f), line: i + 1, text: jsxM[1].trim() });
    }
  });
}

if (hardcoded.length === 0) {
  report.push(pass("No remaining hardcoded JSX text found"));
} else {
  report.push(
    warn(
      `${hardcoded.length} hardcoded strings still in JSX (not yet wrapped with t()):`,
    ),
  );
  report.push("| File | Line | Text |", "|------|------|------|");
  hardcoded
    .slice(0, 30)
    .forEach(({ file, line, text }) =>
      report.push(`| \`${file}\` | ${line} | ${text.slice(0, 60)} |`),
    );
  if (hardcoded.length > 30)
    report.push(`| … | | and ${hardcoded.length - 30} more |`);
  score.warnings++;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §7  TODO / FIXME / HACK COMMENTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§7  TODO / FIXME / HACK / COMING SOON Comments");

const todos = [];
const TODO_RE =
  /\/\/\s*(TODO|FIXME|HACK|TEMP|XXX|COMING SOON|coming soon|BROKEN|BUG)[\s:]*(.*)/i;
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const lines = readSrc(f).split("\n");
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    const m = TODO_RE.exec(line);
    if (m)
      todos.push({
        file: rel(f),
        line: i + 1,
        tag: m[1].toUpperCase(),
        text: m[2].trim().slice(0, 80),
      });
  });
}

report.push(`Found **${todos.length}** annotated issues.\n`);
if (todos.length > 0) {
  // Group by tag
  const byTag = {};
  todos.forEach((t) => {
    (byTag[t.tag] = byTag[t.tag] || []).push(t);
  });
  for (const [tag, items] of Object.entries(byTag)) {
    report.push(`**${tag}** (${items.length}):`);
    report.push("| File | Line | Note |", "|------|------|------|");
    items
      .slice(0, 15)
      .forEach(({ file, line, text }) =>
        report.push(`| \`${file}\` | ${line} | ${text || "—"} |`),
      );
    if (items.length > 15)
      report.push(`| … | | and ${items.length - 15} more |`);
    report.push("");
  }
  if (todos.length > 10) score.warnings++;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §8  CONSOLE.LOG IN PRODUCTION CODE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§8  console.log / console.error in Production Code");

const consoleLogs = [];
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const lines = readSrc(f).split("\n");
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    if (
      /console\.(log|warn|error|info|debug)\s*\(/.test(line) &&
      !line.trim().startsWith("//")
    ) {
      consoleLogs.push({
        file: rel(f),
        line: i + 1,
        code: line.trim().slice(0, 80),
      });
    }
  });
}

if (consoleLogs.length === 0) {
  report.push(pass("No console.log statements found"));
} else {
  report.push(
    warn(
      `${consoleLogs.length} console statements found (remove before production):`,
    ),
  );
  report.push("<details><summary>Show all</summary>", "");
  report.push("| File | Line | Code |", "|------|------|------|");
  consoleLogs
    .slice(0, 50)
    .forEach(({ file, line, code }) =>
      report.push(
        `| \`${file}\` | ${line} | \`${code.replace(/\|/g, "∣")}\` |`,
      ),
    );
  if (consoleLogs.length > 50)
    report.push(`| … | | and ${consoleLogs.length - 50} more |`);
  report.push("", "</details>");
  if (consoleLogs.length > 20) score.warnings++;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §9  EMPTY / PLACEHOLDER SCREENS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§9  Empty / Placeholder Screens");

const placeholders = [];
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  if (!f.includes("Screen") && !f.includes("screen")) continue;
  const src = readSrc(f);
  const lines = src.split("\n").filter((l) => l.trim());
  const hasComingSoon =
    /coming soon|placeholder|not yet implemented|TODO.*screen/i.test(src);
  const isTiny = lines.length < 30;
  const noApiCall =
    !src.includes("api.") && !src.includes("fetch(") && !src.includes("axios");
  if (hasComingSoon || (isTiny && noApiCall)) {
    placeholders.push({
      file: rel(f),
      lines: lines.length,
      reason: hasComingSoon
        ? "contains 'coming soon'"
        : `only ${lines.length} lines, no API calls`,
    });
  }
}

if (placeholders.length === 0) {
  report.push(pass("No placeholder screens detected"));
} else {
  report.push(
    warn(`${placeholders.length} screens appear to be placeholders or stubs:`),
  );
  report.push("| File | Lines | Reason |", "|------|-------|--------|");
  placeholders.forEach(({ file, lines, reason }) =>
    report.push(`| \`${file}\` | ${lines} | ${reason} |`),
  );
  score.warnings++;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §10  API ENDPOINT INVENTORY
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§10  API Endpoint Inventory");

const apiCalls = new Map(); // endpoint → Set of files
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const src = readSrc(f);
  const re =
    /api\s*\.\s*(get|post|put|patch|delete)\s*\(\s*[`"'](\/[^`"'\n]+)[`"']/gi;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const key = `${m[1].toUpperCase()} ${m[2]}`;
    if (!apiCalls.has(key)) apiCalls.set(key, new Set());
    apiCalls.get(key).add(rel(f));
  }
}

report.push(
  `**${apiCalls.size}** unique API endpoints called across the app.\n`,
);
report.push("| Method + Endpoint | Called From |", "|---|---|");
for (const [endpoint, files] of [...apiCalls.entries()].sort()) {
  const fileList =
    [...files].slice(0, 3).join(", ") +
    (files.size > 3 ? ` +${files.size - 3}` : "");
  report.push(`| \`${endpoint}\` | ${fileList} |`);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §11  NAVIGATION SCREEN INVENTORY
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§11  Navigation Screen Inventory");

const registeredScreens = new Set();
const navigatedToScreens = new Set();

for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const src = readSrc(f);
  // Registered: <Stack.Screen name="..." or <Drawer.Screen name="..."
  const regRe = /(?:Screen|Tab)\s+name\s*=\s*["'`](\w+)["'`]/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = regRe.exec(src)) !== null) registeredScreens.add(m[1]);

  // Navigated to: navigation.navigate("...") or goTo("...")
  const navRe = /(?:navigate|goTo|push|replace)\s*\(\s*["'`](\w+)["'`]/g;
  while ((m = navRe.exec(src)) !== null) navigatedToScreens.add(m[1]);
}

const unregistered = [...navigatedToScreens].filter(
  (s) => !registeredScreens.has(s),
);
const unreachable = [...registeredScreens].filter(
  (s) => !navigatedToScreens.has(s),
);

report.push(
  `**${registeredScreens.size}** screens registered · **${navigatedToScreens.size}** navigation targets found\n`,
);

sub("Registered Screens");
report.push(
  [...registeredScreens]
    .sort()
    .map((s) => `\`${s}\``)
    .join(" · "),
);

if (unregistered.length > 0) {
  sub("⚠️  Navigated To But Not Registered");
  report.push(
    warn(
      `${unregistered.length} screens navigated to but not found in navigator:`,
    ),
  );
  report.push(unregistered.map((s) => `- \`${s}\``).join("\n"));
  score.warnings++;
} else {
  report.push("", pass("All navigation targets are registered"));
}

if (unreachable.length > 0) {
  sub("ℹ️  Registered But Never Navigated To");
  report.push(
    info(
      `${unreachable.length} screens registered but no navigate() call found (may be initial routes):`,
    ),
  );
  report.push(unreachable.map((s) => `- \`${s}\``).join("\n"));
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §12  ASYNCSTORAGE KEY INVENTORY
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§12  AsyncStorage Key Inventory");

const storageKeys = new Map(); // key → files
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const src = readSrc(f);
  const re =
    /AsyncStorage\s*\.\s*(?:getItem|setItem|removeItem|mergeItem)\s*\(\s*["'`]([^"'`\n]+)["'`]/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) {
    if (!storageKeys.has(m[1])) storageKeys.set(m[1], new Set());
    storageKeys.get(m[1]).add(rel(f));
  }
}

if (storageKeys.size === 0) {
  report.push(info("No AsyncStorage keys found"));
} else {
  report.push(`**${storageKeys.size}** AsyncStorage keys in use:\n`);
  report.push("| Key | Used In |", "|-----|---------|");
  for (const [key, files] of [...storageKeys.entries()].sort()) {
    report.push(`| \`${key}\` | ${[...files].join(", ")} |`);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §13  ASSET REFERENCES (missing files)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§13  Asset Reference Check");

const assetSet = new Set(assetFiles.map((f) => path.basename(f)));
const referencedAssets = new Map();
for (const f of codeFiles) {
  const src = readSrc(f);
  const re =
    /require\s*\(\s*["'`]([^"'`\n]+\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|svg|ttf))["'`]/gi;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) {
    const name = path.basename(m[1]);
    if (!referencedAssets.has(name)) referencedAssets.set(name, []);
    referencedAssets.get(name).push(rel(f));
  }
}

const missingAssets = [...referencedAssets.entries()].filter(
  ([name]) => !assetSet.has(name),

  missingAssets.forEach(([name, files]) =>
    report.push(`| \`${name}\` | ${files.slice(0, 2).join(", ")} |`),
  );
  score.errors++;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// §14  LARGE FILES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
section("§14  Large Files (>300 lines)");

  .map((f) => ({ file: rel(f), lines: readSrc(f).split("\n").length }))
  .filter(({ lines }) => lines > 300)
  .sort((a, b) => b.lines - a.lines);

if (largeFiles.length === 0) {
  report.push(pass("No files over 300 lines"));

#!/usr/bin/env node
// restore-backups.js
// Restores every file the fix-t-violations script corrupted.
// Run this first — it fixes the Babel/Metro compile error.
//
// node scripts/restore-backups.js

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const ROOT = path.resolve(".");

function walk(dir, found = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return found;
  }
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.name.startsWith(".") || e.name === "node_modules") continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full, found);
    else if (e.name.endsWith(".hook.bak")) found.push(full);
  }
  return found;
}

const backups = walk(ROOT);

if (backups.length === 0) {
  console.log("ℹ️  No .hook.bak files found.");
  process.exit(0);
}

for (const bak of backups) {
  const original = bak.replace(/\.hook\.bak$/, "");
  fs.copyFileSync(bak, original);
  fs.unlinkSync(bak);
  console.log(`✅  Restored: ${path.relative(ROOT, original)}`);
}

console.log(`\n✅  ${backups.length} file(s) restored from backup.`);
console.log("    Run: npx expo start   ← should compile cleanly now.\n");

#!/usr/bin/env node
// restore-i18n-backups.js
// Restores every *.i18n.bak file created by wrap-i18n.js --write
// node scripts/restore-i18n-backups.js

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const ROOT = path.resolve(".");

function walk(dir, files = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return files;
  }
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.name.startsWith(".") || e.name === "node_modules") continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full, files);
    else files.push(full); // ← no extension filter — find ALL files
  }
  return files;
}

const all = walk(ROOT);
const i18nBak = all.filter((f) => f.endsWith(".i18n.bak"));
const hookBak = all.filter((f) => f.endsWith(".hook.bak"));

console.log(`\n📦  Found ${i18nBak.length} .i18n.bak files`);
console.log(`📦  Found ${hookBak.length} .hook.bak files\n`);

let restored = 0;

for (const bak of [...i18nBak, ...hookBak]) {
  const original = bak.replace(/\.(i18n|hook)\.bak$/, "");
  fs.copyFileSync(bak, original);
  fs.unlinkSync(bak);
  console.log(`✅  Restored: ${path.relative(ROOT, original)}`);
  restored++;
}

if (restored === 0) {
  console.log("ℹ️  No backup files found.");
} else {
  console.log(`\n✅  ${restored} file(s) restored.`);
  console.log("\nNext: npx expo start --clear\n");
}

=== FILE: scripts/scan-i18n.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// scan-i18n.js — SkilledProz Expo App i18n Scanner
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// WHAT IT DOES:
//   1. Scans every .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx file in the project
//   2. Finds all hardcoded English strings (JSX text, props, alerts, etc.)
//   3. Generates a report: which files + which strings need translation
//   4. Writes a base en.json with all discovered strings as translation keys
//   5. Writes skeleton files for all 9 locales with empty values to fill in
//   6. Writes a TODO list of every line that needs `t()` wrapping
//
// USAGE:
//   node scripts/scan-i18n.js
//   node scripts/scan-i18n.js --dir src/screens   (limit to a folder)
//   node scripts/scan-i18n.js --out locales        (custom output dir)
//
// OUTPUT:
//   locales/en.json                  ← base English keys (auto-filled)
//   locales/fr.json                  ← French skeleton (values = "")
//   locales/ar.json                  ← Arabic skeleton
//   locales/yo.json                  ← Yoruba skeleton
//   locales/ha.json                  ← Hausa skeleton
//   locales/ig.json                  ← Igbo skeleton
//   locales/sw.json                  ← Swahili skeleton
//   locales/pt.json                  ← Portuguese skeleton
//   locales/es.json                  ← Spanish skeleton
//   i18n-report.md                   ← full human-readable report
//   i18n-todo.json                   ← machine-readable list for auto-wrapper
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

// ── CLI args ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const dirIdx = args.indexOf("--dir");
const outIdx = args.indexOf("--out");
const ROOT = dirIdx >= 0 ? path.resolve(args[dirIdx + 1]) : path.resolve(".");
const OUT_DIR =
  outIdx >= 0 ? path.resolve(args[outIdx + 1]) : path.resolve("locales");

// ── The 9 target locales ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LOCALES = [
  { code: "en", name: "English" },
  { code: "fr", name: "French" },
  { code: "ar", name: "Arabic" },
  { code: "yo", name: "Yoruba" },
  { code: "ha", name: "Hausa" },
  { code: "ig", name: "Igbo" },
  { code: "sw", name: "Swahili" },
  { code: "pt", name: "Portuguese" },
  { code: "es", name: "Spanish" },
];

// ── Directories and files to skip ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  "node_modules",
  ".git",
  ".expo",
  "dist",
  "build",
  "coverage",
  "locales",
  "assets",
  ".next",
  "scripts",
]);

const SKIP_FILES = new Set([
  "babel.config.js",
  "metro.config.js",
  "jest.config.js",
  "tailwind.config.js",
  "app.config.js",
  "eas.json",
]);

// ── String patterns that look like real UI text ───────────────────────────────

// Strings to IGNORE (technical, not user-facing)
const IGNORE_PATTERNS = [
  /^https?:\/\//, // URLs
  /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/, // hex colors
  /^\d+(\.\d+)?(px|%|rem|em|vh|vw|dp)?$/, // dimensions/numbers
  /^[A-Z_]{2,}$/, // ALL_CAPS_CONSTANTS
  /^\s*$/, // whitespace only
  /^[\W\d]+$/, // no letters at all
  /^(flex|absolute|relative|center|row|column|bold|normal|auto)$/, // style values
  /^(rgba?|rgb)\(/, // color functions
  /^\.(js|ts|jsx|tsx|json|png|jpg|svg|ttf)$/, // file extensions
  /^[a-z_]+\.[a-z_]+$/, // dot.notation (prop paths, field names)
  /^var\(--/, // CSS variables
  /^(true|false|null|undefined)$/, // JS literals
  /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+:\/\//, // protocol strings
  /^(PENDING|APPROVED|REJECTED|ACTIVE|INACTIVE|HIRER|WORKER|ADMIN)$/, // DB enums
];

function isIgnored(str) {
  const s = str.trim();
  if (s.length < 2) return true;
  // Already wrapped in t() or i18n.t()
  return IGNORE_PATTERNS.some((r) => r.test(s));
}

// ── Extraction patterns ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Pattern 1: JSX text between tags  >Some text<  or  > Some text {var} more <
const JSX_TEXT = />\s*([A-Za-z][^<>{}\n]{2,}?)\s*</g;

// Pattern 2: Common string props with English values
const STRING_PROPS =
  /(?:placeholder|title|label|message|hint|emptyText|description|accessibilityLabel|accessibilityHint|subtitle|heading|buttonText|text|errorMessage|helperText|noDataText|loadingText)\s*=\s*["'`]([A-Za-z][^"'`\n]{2,})["'`]/g;

// Pattern 3: Alert / Toast / console messages
const ALERTS =
  /(?:Alert\.alert|showToast|Toast\.show|Snackbar\.show|console\.(warn|error|info))\s*\(\s*["'`]([A-Za-z][^"'`\n]{2,})["'`]/g;

// Pattern 4: Bare string assignments that look like UI labels
const STRING_ASSIGNS =
  /(?:headerTitle|tabBarLabel|screenTitle|title|name|label)\s*:\s*["'`]([A-Za-z][^"'`\n]{3,})["'`]/g;

// Pattern 5: String inside t-able functions that AREN'T yet wrapped
// Catches: const msg = "Please enter your email"
const PLAIN_STRINGS =
  /(?:const|let|var)\s+\w+\s*=\s*["'`]([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 ,.'!?:()/-]{5,})["'`]/g;

// Already translated — skip lines with t() or i18n.t()
function isAlreadyTranslated(line) {
  return (
    /\bt\s*\(/.test(line) ||
    /i18n\.t\s*\(/.test(line) ||
    /useTranslation/.test(line)
  );
}

// ── Convert a string to a stable translation key ──────────────────────────────
function toKey(str) {
  return str
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "_")
    .slice(0, 60);
}

// ── Walk the directory tree ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
function walk(dir, files = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return files;
  }

  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.name.startsWith(".")) continue;
    if (SKIP_DIRS.has(e.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) {
      walk(full, files);
    } else if (/\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$/.test(e.name) && !SKIP_FILES.has(e.name)) {
      files.push(full);
    }
  }
  return files;
}

// ── Scan a single file ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function scanFile(filePath) {
  let src;
  try {
    src = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
  } catch {
    return [];
  }

  const hits = [];
  const lines = src.split("\n");

  function addHit(lineNum, pattern, raw) {
    const clean = raw.trim();
    if (isIgnored(clean)) return;
    if (isAlreadyTranslated(lines[lineNum - 1] || "")) return;
    hits.push({ line: lineNum, pattern, raw: clean, key: toKey(clean) });
  }

  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    if (isAlreadyTranslated(line)) return;
    const ln = i + 1;

    let m;

    // JSX text
    const jsxRe = />\s*([A-Za-z][^<>{}\n]{2,}?)\s*</g;
    while ((m = jsxRe.exec(line)) !== null) addHit(ln, "jsx_text", m[1]);

    // String props
    const propRe =
      /(?:placeholder|title|label|message|hint|emptyText|description|accessibilityLabel|subtitle|heading|buttonText|text|errorMessage|helperText|noDataText|loadingText)\s*=\s*["'`]([A-Za-z][^"'`\n]{2,})["'`]/g;
    while ((m = propRe.exec(line)) !== null) addHit(ln, "prop", m[1]);

    // Alerts
    const alertRe =
      /(?:Alert\.alert|showToast|Toast\.show)\s*\(\s*["'`]([A-Za-z][^"'`\n]{2,})["'`]/g;
    while ((m = alertRe.exec(line)) !== null) addHit(ln, "alert", m[1]);

    // Navigation titles
    const navRe =
      /(?:headerTitle|tabBarLabel|screenTitle|title|name)\s*:\s*["'`]([A-Za-z][^"'`\n]{3,})["'`]/g;
    while ((m = navRe.exec(line)) !== null) addHit(ln, "nav_title", m[1]);

    // Plain string assignments
    const assignRe =
      /(?:const|let|var)\s+\w+\s*=\s*["'`]([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 ,.'!?:()/-]{5,})["'`]/g;
    while ((m = assignRe.exec(line)) !== null) addHit(ln, "assignment", m[1]);
  });

  // Deduplicate by key within this file
  const seen = new Set();
  return hits.filter((h) => {
    if (seen.has(h.key)) return false;
    seen.add(h.key);
    return true;
  });
}

// ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log(`\n🔍  Scanning: ${ROOT}`);
console.log(`📦  Output:   ${OUT_DIR}\n`);

const files = walk(ROOT);
const allKeys = new Map(); // key → English value
const fileHits = []; // { file, rel, hits[] }
const todoList = []; // machine-readable for auto-wrapper

let totalStrings = 0;
let totalFiles = 0;

for (const file of files) {
  const hits = scanFile(file);
  if (hits.length === 0) continue;

  totalFiles++;
  totalStrings += hits.length;

  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, file);
  fileHits.push({ file, rel, hits });

  for (const h of hits) {
    if (!allKeys.has(h.key)) allKeys.set(h.key, h.raw);
    todoList.push({
      file: rel,
      line: h.line,
      pattern: h.pattern,
      raw: h.raw,
      key: h.key,
    });
  }
}

// ── Sort keys alphabetically ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const sortedKeys = [...allKeys.entries()].sort((a, b) =>
  a[0].localeCompare(b[0]),
);

// ── Write locale files ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fs.mkdirSync(OUT_DIR, { recursive: true });

for (const locale of LOCALES) {
  const outPath = path.join(OUT_DIR, `${locale.code}.json`);
  const existing = fs.existsSync(outPath)
    ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(outPath, "utf8"))
    : {};

  const obj = {};
  for (const [key, enVal] of sortedKeys) {
    if (locale.code === "en") {
      obj[key] = existing[key] || enVal;
    } else {
      // Preserve already-translated values; leave new ones blank for translator
      obj[key] = existing[key] || "";
    }
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(outPath, JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2), "utf8");
  const filled = Object.values(obj).filter(Boolean).length;
  const total = sortedKeys.length;
  const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((filled / total) * 100) : 0;
  console.log(
    `  ${locale.code === "en" ? "✅" : "⬜"} ${locale.code}.json  (${filled}/${total} — ${pct}% complete)  ${locale.name}`,
  );
}

// ── Write TODO JSON ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const todoPath = path.join(ROOT, "i18n-todo.json");
fs.writeFileSync(todoPath, JSON.stringify(todoList, null, 2), "utf8");

// ── Write markdown report ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const reportPath = path.join(ROOT, "i18n-report.md");

const grouped = {};
for (const item of todoList) {
  if (!grouped[item.file]) grouped[item.file] = [];
  grouped[item.file].push(item);
}

const lines = [
  "# i18n Scan Report",
  "",
  `> Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
  `> Root: \`${ROOT}\``,
  "",
  "## Summary",

  `| Metric | Value |`,
  `|--------|-------|`,
  `| Files scanned | ${files.length} |`,
  `| Files with hardcoded strings | ${totalFiles} |`,
  `| Total hardcoded strings found | ${totalStrings} |`,
  `| Unique translation keys | ${sortedKeys.length} |`,
  `| Target locales | ${LOCALES.length} |`,
  "",
  "## Target Locales",
  "",
  LOCALES.map((l) => `- \`${l.code}\` — ${l.name}`).join("\n"),
  "",
  "## Files Requiring i18n Work",
  "",
];

for (const [file, items] of Object.entries(grouped)) {
  lines.push(`### \`${file}\``);
  lines.push("");
  lines.push("| Line | Pattern | String |");
  lines.push("|------|---------|--------|");
  for (const item of items) {
    lines.push(`| ${item.line} | \`${item.pattern}\` | ${item.raw} |`);
  }
  lines.push("");
  lines.push("**Suggested keys:**");
  lines.push("```js");
  for (const item of items) {
    lines.push(`// Line ${item.line}`);
    lines.push(`t('${item.key}')  // "${item.raw}"`);
  }
  lines.push("```");
  lines.push("");
}

lines.push("## All Translation Keys");
lines.push("");
lines.push(
  "These keys were added to `locales/en.json`. Fill in the other locale files.",
);
lines.push("");
lines.push("| Key | English Value |");

for (const [key, val] of sortedKeys) {

📊  SCAN COMPLETE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  Files scanned:          ${files.length}

#!/usr/bin/env node
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// translate-locales.js — Auto-translate en.json to all 8 other locales
// Uses the same Google Translate that the app's TranslateButton uses
// (free, no API key, same engine as the web)
//
// INSTALL:  npm install @vitalets/google-translate-api
// RUN:      node scripts/translate-locales.js
//           node scripts/translate-locales.js --locale fr          (one locale)
//           node scripts/translate-locales.js --locale fr,ar,yo    (a few)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

// ── Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LOCALES_DIR = path.resolve("locales");
const EN_FILE = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, "en.json");

// The 8 target locales — same codes the app uses
const ALL_TARGETS = [
  { code: "fr", name: "French" },
  { code: "ar", name: "Arabic" },
  { code: "yo", name: "Yoruba" },
  { code: "ha", name: "Hausa" },
  { code: "ig", name: "Igbo" },
  { code: "sw", name: "Swahili" },
  { code: "pt", name: "Portuguese" },
  { code: "es", name: "Spanish" },
];

// ── CLI: --locale flag ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const localeIdx = args.indexOf("--locale");
const onlyArg = localeIdx >= 0 ? args[localeIdx + 1] : null;
const TARGETS = onlyArg
  ? ALL_TARGETS.filter((l) => onlyArg.split(",").includes(l.code))
  : ALL_TARGETS;

// ── Strings to NOT translate (placeholders, brand names, etc.) ────────────────
const SKIP_TRANSLATE = (val) =>
  !val ||
  typeof val !== "string" ||
  val.trim() === "" ||
  /^{{.*}}$/.test(val.trim()) || // pure template variable: {{name}}
  /^[A-Z_]+$/.test(val.trim()) || // ALL_CAPS constant
  /^https?:\/\//.test(val) || // URL
  /^[+\d\s()-]+$/.test(val); // phone number pattern

// ── Rate limit helper — Google blocks rapid-fire requests ────────────────────
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

// ── Dynamically import the ESM-only google translate package ─────────────────
let translate;
async function getTranslate() {
  if (translate) return translate;
  try {
    const mod = await import("@vitalets/google-translate-api");
    translate = mod.translate;
    return translate;
  } catch {
    console.error(`
❌  Missing dependency.
    Run: npm install @vitalets/google-translate-api
`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

// ── Translate a single string ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function translateString(text, targetLang, retries = 3) {
  if (SKIP_TRANSLATE(text)) return text;

  const fn = await getTranslate();
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
    try {
      const result = await fn(text, { to: targetLang });
      return result.text;
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt === retries) {
        console.warn(
          `    ⚠️  Failed to translate "${text.slice(0, 40)}" → ${targetLang}: ${err.message}`,
        );
        return text; // fall back to English on failure
      }
      await sleep(1000 * attempt); // back-off: 1s, 2s, 3s
    }
  }
}

// ── Recursively translate all string values in an object ──────────────────────
async function translateObject(
  obj,
  targetLang,
  path = "",
  stats = { done: 0, skipped: 0 },
) {
  const result = {};

  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    const fullPath = path ? `${path}.${key}` : key;

    if (typeof val === "object" && val !== null) {
      result[key] = await translateObject(val, targetLang, fullPath, stats);
    } else if (typeof val === "string") {
      if (SKIP_TRANSLATE(val)) {
        result[key] = val;
        stats.skipped++;
      } else {
        result[key] = await translateString(val, targetLang);
        stats.done++;
        // Brief pause every 5 strings to avoid rate limiting
        if (stats.done % 5 === 0) await sleep(300);
      }
    } else {
      result[key] = val;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

// ── Count all translatable strings in an object ───────────────────────────────
function countStrings(obj) {
  let count = 0;
  for (const val of Object.values(obj)) {
    if (typeof val === "object" && val !== null) count += countStrings(val);
    else if (typeof val === "string" && !SKIP_TRANSLATE(val)) count++;
  }
  return count;
}

// ── Merge: keep existing translations, only fill missing keys ─────────────────
function mergeTranslations(existing, translated) {
  const result = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(translated)) {
    if (
      typeof translated[key] === "object" &&
      translated[key] !== null &&
      !Array.isArray(translated[key])
    ) {
      result[key] = mergeTranslations(
        (existing && existing[key]) || {},
        translated[key],
      );
    } else {
      // Keep existing non-empty value; use translated for blanks
      const existingVal = existing && existing[key];
      result[key] =
        existingVal && existingVal !== "" ? existingVal : translated[key];
    }
  }
  return result;
}

// ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!fs.existsSync(EN_FILE)) {
  console.error(`❌  locales/en.json not found at ${EN_FILE}`);
  console.error(
    "    Run scan-i18n.js first, or place your en.json in the locales/ folder.",
  );
  process.exit(1);
}

const enData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EN_FILE, "utf8"));
const totalKeys = countStrings(enData);

console.log(`\n🌍  Translating en.json → ${TARGETS.length} locale(s)`);
console.log(
  `    ${totalKeys} translatable strings × ${TARGETS.length} locales\n`,
);

for (const locale of TARGETS) {
  const outFile = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${locale.code}.json`);
  const existing = fs.existsSync(outFile)
    ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(outFile, "utf8"))
    : {};

  // Count how many are already filled
  let alreadyFilled = 0;
  function countFilled(obj) {
    for (const val of Object.values(obj)) {
      if (typeof val === "object" && val !== null) countFilled(val);
      else if (typeof val === "string" && val !== "") alreadyFilled++;
    }
  }
  countFilled(existing);

  const remaining = totalKeys - alreadyFilled;

  if (remaining === 0) {
    console.log(
      `✅  ${locale.code} (${locale.name}) — already complete, skipping`,
    );
    continue;
  }

  console.log(
    `\n🔄  ${locale.code} (${locale.name}) — ${alreadyFilled}/${totalKeys} done, translating ${remaining} strings…`,
  );

  const stats = { done: 0, skipped: 0 };
  let translated;
  try {
    translated = await translateObject(enData, locale.code, "", stats);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌  Fatal error translating ${locale.code}:`, err.message);
    continue;
  }

  // Merge: don't overwrite manually-corrected translations
  const merged = mergeTranslations(existing, translated);
  fs.writeFileSync(outFile, JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2), "utf8");

  const filled = totalKeys - stats.skipped;
  const pct = Math.round((filled / totalKeys) * 100);
  console.log(
    `✅  ${locale.code}.json saved  (${filled}/${totalKeys} — ${pct}% translated)`,
  );
}

console.log(`
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅  ALL DONE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Review machine translations — especially:
  • Yoruba (yo) — limited Google support
  • Hausa (ha)  — limited Google support
  • Igbo (ig)   — limited Google support
Native speaker review recommended for these.

To re-run a single locale after manual edits:
  node scripts/translate-locales.js --locale yo
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
`);

=== END: scripts/translate-locales.js ===

const CURRENCY_SYMBOL = {
  USD: "$",
  EUR: "€",
  GBP: "£",
  NGN: "₦",
  GHS: "₵",
  KES: "KSh",
  ZAR: "R",
  INR: "₹",
  CAD: "CA$",
  AUD: "A$",
  JPY: "¥",
  CNY: "¥",
  BRL: "R$",
  AED: "د.إ",
  SAR: "﷼",
  USDC: "◈",
  USDT: "₮",
};

function getCurrencySymbol(currencyCode) {
  return CURRENCY_SYMBOL[currencyCode] || currencyCode;
}

// Helper function to format amount with symbol only
function formatWithSymbol(amount, currencyCode) {
  const symbol = getCurrencySymbol(currencyCode);
  return `${symbol}${Number(amount ?? 0).toLocaleString("en-US", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function fmtDateTime(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}
