                  Total you paid
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  variant="display"
                  weight="displayBlack"
                  style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 26 }}
                >
                  {formatAmount(payment.amount, payment.currency)}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* Worker gets 100% note */}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.workerNote,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.08)",
                  borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.2)",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16, marginRight: 8 }}>✅</AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                Worker receives{" "}
                <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}>
                  100%
                </AppText>{" "}
                of the job amount (
                {formatAmount(workerPayout, payment.currency)})
              </AppText>
            </View>

            {/* Currency badge */}
            <View style={styles.currencyBadgeRow}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.currencyBadge,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: isCrypto
                      ? "rgba(139,92,246,0.12)"
                      : c.orangeDim,
                    borderColor: isCrypto ? "#a78bfa" : c.orange,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: isCrypto ? "#a78bfa" : c.orange }}
                >
                  {payment.currency}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* Footer */}
            <View style={[styles.receiptFooter, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                SkilledPro · Global Skills Marketplace
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </ScrollView>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Summary Card - Shows currency symbol only, changes with viewing currency
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SummaryCard({ label, value, sub, accent, c, viewingCurrency }) {
  const formattedValue = formatWithSymbol(value, viewingCurrency);

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.summaryCard,
        {
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderColor: accent ? c.orange : c.border,
          borderWidth: accent ? 1 : StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        tone="dim"
        style={styles.summaryLabel}
      >
        {label.toUpperCase()}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="display"
        weight={accent ? "displayBlack" : "semibold"}
        style={[styles.summaryValue, { color: accent ? c.orange : c.text }]}
        numberOfLines={1}
        adjustsFontSizeToFit
      >
        {formattedValue}
      </AppText>
      {sub && (
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {sub}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Payment Card (list row) - Shows in original payment currency with symbol
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function PaymentCard({ payment, onReceipt, onRelease, releasing, c }) {
  const payMeta = STATUS_META[payment.status] ?? {
    label: payment.status,
    color: "#888",
  };
  const bookingMeta = BOOKING_STATUS_META[payment.booking?.status] ?? null;
  const worker = payment.booking?.worker ?? {};

  const formatAmount = (amount) => {
    const symbol = getCurrencySymbol(payment.currency);
    return `${symbol}${Number(amount ?? 0).toLocaleString("en-US", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    })}`;
  };

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.payCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Job row */}
      <View style={styles.payCardTop}>
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ flex: 1 }}
          numberOfLines={1}
        >
          {payment.booking?.title ?? "—"}
        </AppText>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.statusPill,
            {
              backgroundColor: `${payMeta.color}22`,
              borderColor: `${payMeta.color}55`,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: payMeta.color }}
          >
            {payMeta.label}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Category + booking status */}
      <View style={styles.chipRow}>
        {payment.booking?.category?.name && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.catChip,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              {payment.booking.category.name}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
        {bookingMeta && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.catChip,
              {
                backgroundColor: `${bookingMeta.color}22`,
                borderColor: `${bookingMeta.color}55`,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: bookingMeta.color }}
            >
              {bookingMeta.label}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Worker + date row */}
      <View style={styles.payCardMeta}>
        <View style={styles.workerRow}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.workerAvatar,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            {worker.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: worker.avatar }}
                style={styles.workerAvatarImg}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {initials(worker.firstName, worker.lastName)}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          <AppText variant="body" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
            {worker.firstName} {worker.lastName}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {fmtDate(payment.createdAt)}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Amount row - Shows in original payment currency with symbol */}
      <View style={[styles.amountRow, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        <View>
          <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold" style={styles.amountText}>
            {formatAmount(payment.amount)}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}>
            Worker gets <AppText weight="semibold">100%</AppText> (
            {formatAmount(payment.workerPayout)})
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#f97316", fontSize: 11 }}>
            Platform fee: 5%
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Action buttons */}
        <View style={styles.actionsRow}>
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.actionBtn,
              { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgInput },
            ]}
            onPress={() => onReceipt(payment)}
          >
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
              Receipt
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          {payment.status === "HELD" && (
            <Pressable
              style={[
                styles.actionBtn,
                {
                  borderColor: "#22c55e",
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.1)",
                },
              ]}
              onPress={() => onRelease(payment.bookingId)}
              disabled={releasing === payment.bookingId}
            >
              {releasing === payment.bookingId ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#22c55e" />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}
                >
                  Release
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Skeleton
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12, padding: 16 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            styles.skCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main Screen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function PaymentHistoryScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();
  const { dashboardCurrency } = useCurrency();

  const [payments, setPayments] = useState([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(null);
  const [currencies, setCurrencies] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [currFilter, setCurrFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState(null);
  const [releasing, setReleasing] = useState(null);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);
  const [viewingCurrency, setViewingCurrency] = useState(dashboardCurrency);

  // ── Fetch ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchPayments = useCallback(
    async (pg = 1, replace = true) => {
      if (replace) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const params = { page: pg, limit: LIMIT };
        if (statusFilter !== "ALL") params.status = statusFilter;
        if (currFilter !== "ALL") params.currency = currFilter;

        const data = await getHirerPayments(params);
        const list = data.payments ?? [];
        setPayments(replace ? list : (prev) => [...prev, ...list]);
        setTotal(data.total ?? 0);
        setTotalPages(data.pages ?? 1);
        setSummary(data.summary ?? null);
        setCurrencies(data.availableCurrencies ?? []);
      } catch {
        toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [statusFilter, currFilter],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1);
    fetchPayments(1, true);
  }, [statusFilter, currFilter]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setPage(1);
    fetchPayments(1, true);
  };

  // ── Release escrow ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleRelease = (bookingId) => {
    setModal({
      title: "Release Payment",
      message: "Release payment to worker? This confirms the job is complete.",
      confirmLabel: "Release",
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setReleasing(bookingId);
        try {
          await releasePayment(bookingId);
          toast.success("Payment released to worker!");
          setPayments((prev) =>
            prev.map((p) =>
              p.bookingId === bookingId ? { ...p, status: "RELEASED" } : p,
            ),
          );
        } catch (err) {
          toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message ?? t("toast.unknownError"));
        } finally {
          setReleasing(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  // ── Filtered (client-side search on top of server filter) ──────────────────
  const visible = payments.filter((p) => {
    if (!search.trim()) return true;
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return (
      p.booking?.title?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      p.booking?.worker?.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      p.booking?.worker?.lastName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      p.id?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  });

  // ── Summary values ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const totalSpent = summary?.totalSpent ?? 0;
  const inEscrow = summary?.inEscrow ?? 0;
  const totalRefunds = summary?.totalRefunds ?? 0;

  // ── Handle currency change ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleCurrencyChange = (currencyCode) => {
    setViewingCurrency(currencyCode);
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={visible}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View style={styles.listHeader}>
            {/* Page Header with Currency Picker */}
            <View style={styles.pageHeader}>
              <View>
                <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={styles.pageTitle}>
                  Payment History
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.pageSubtitle}>
                  All transactions and receipts
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.headerRight}>
                <CurrencyPicker
                  label="Viewing in"
                  onCurrencyChange={handleCurrencyChange}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* Summary cards - formatted with viewing currency */}
            <SummaryCard
              label="Total Spent"
              value={totalSpent}
              sub={`${total} transaction${total !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
              accent
              c={c}
              viewingCurrency={viewingCurrency}
            />
            <SummaryCard
              label="In Escrow"
              value={inEscrow}
              sub="Awaiting release"
              c={c}
              viewingCurrency={viewingCurrency}
            />
            <SummaryCard
              label="Refunded"
              value={totalRefunds}
              sub="Returned to you"
              c={c}
              viewingCurrency={viewingCurrency}
            />

            {/* Search */}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.searchRow,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginRight: 8 }}>
                🔍
              </AppText>
              <TextInput
                style={[styles.searchInput, { color: c.text }]}
                placeholder="Search by job, worker, or ID…"
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                value={search}
                onChangeText={setSearch}
              />
            </View>

            {/* Status filter tabs */}
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={styles.tabsScroll}
              contentContainerStyle={styles.tabsContent}
            >
              {STATUS_TABS.map((s) => {
                const active = statusFilter === s;
                const label =
                  s === "ALL" ? "All" : (STATUS_META[s]?.label ?? s);
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={s}
                    style={[
                      styles.tab,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      },
                    ]}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setStatusFilter(s);
                      setPage(1);
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>

            {/* Currency filter tabs */}
            {currencies.length > 0 && (
              <View style={styles.currencyRow}>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  tone="dim"
                  style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
                >
                  Currency:
                </AppText>
                <ScrollView
                  horizontal
                  showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
                  contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, flexDirection: "row" }}
                >
                  {["ALL", ...currencies].map((cur) => {
                    const active = currFilter === cur;
                    const symbol = getCurrencySymbol(cur);
                    const label = cur === "ALL" ? "All" : `${symbol} ${cur}`;
                    return (
                      <Pressable
                        key={cur}
                        style={[
                          styles.tab,
                          {
                            backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                            borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                          },
                        ]}
                        onPress={() => {
                          setCurrFilter(cur);
                          setPage(1);
                        }}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          variant="small"
                          weight="semibold"
                          style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
                        >
                          {label}
                        </AppText>
                      </Pressable>
                    );
                  })}
                </ScrollView>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <PaymentCard
            payment={item}
            onReceipt={setReceipt}
            onRelease={handleRelease}
            releasing={releasing}
            c={c}
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 10 }} />}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText variant="title" style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                💳
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
              >
                No transactions yet
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 4 }}
              >
                Your payment history will appear here once you book a worker.
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          !loading && totalPages > 1 ? (
            <View style={styles.pagination}>
              <Pressable
                style={[
                  styles.pageBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.border, opacity: page === 1 ? 0.4 : 1 },
                ]}
                disabled={page === 1}
                onPress={() => {
                  const p = page - 1;
                  setPage(p);
                  fetchPayments(p, true);
                }}
              >
                <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
                  ← Prev
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                Page {page} of {totalPages}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                style={[
                  styles.pageBtn,
                  {
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    opacity: page === totalPages ? 0.4 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
                disabled={page === totalPages}
                onPress={() => {
                  const p = page + 1;
                  setPage(p);
                  fetchPayments(p, true);
                }}
              >
                <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
                  Next →
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : null
        }
      />

      {/* Receipt modal */}
      <ReceiptModal
        payment={receipt}
        onClose={() => setReceipt(null)}
        c={c}
        modalBg={th.mode === "dark" ? "#111118" : "#ffffff"}
      />

      {/* Confirm modal (for release) */}
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!modal}
        title={modal?.title}
        message={modal?.message}
        confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel}
        onConfirm={() => {
          modal?.onConfirm?.();
          setModal(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

=== FILE: scripts/validate-js-syntax.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * scripts/validate-js-syntax.js
 *
 * Diagnostic script that finds the EXACT file + line + column of
 * `invalid property name` errors that Hermes/Metro throws at bundle time.
 *
 * Runs @babel/parser on every JS/JSX file in src/, using the same
 * preset as Metro (babel-preset-expo). Reports:
 *   - Any syntax error
 *   - Any `StyleSheet.create({ ... })` call where a value is a function
 *     (a known Hermes crash cause, matching your current error)
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/validate-js-syntax.js
 *   node scripts/validate-js-syntax.js src/components/posts
 *   node scripts/validate-js-syntax.js --quiet   (only failures)
 */

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const parser = require("@babel/parser");
const traverse = require("@babel/traverse").default;

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
const targetDir =
  process.argv[2] && !process.argv[2].startsWith("--")
    ? path.resolve(ROOT, process.argv[2])
    : path.resolve(ROOT, "src");

const QUIET = process.argv.includes("--quiet");

const SUPPORTED_EXT = [".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx"];
const SKIP_DIRS = [
  "node_modules",
  ".git",
  "android",
  "ios",
  "build",
  "dist",
  ".expo",
];

// ─── Colors (graceful fallback if no TTY) ─────────────────
const hasTTY = process.stdout.isTTY;
const c = {
  red: (s) => (hasTTY ? `\x1b[31m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  green: (s) => (hasTTY ? `\x1b[32m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  yellow: (s) => (hasTTY ? `\x1b[33m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  cyan: (s) => (hasTTY ? `\x1b[36m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  gray: (s) => (hasTTY ? `\x1b[90m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
  bold: (s) => (hasTTY ? `\x1b[1m${s}\x1b[0m` : s),
};

// ─── Walk the directory tree ──────────────────────────────
function walk(dir, files = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return files;
  }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (SKIP_DIRS.includes(entry.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      walk(full, files);
    } else if (SUPPORTED_EXT.includes(path.extname(entry.name))) {
      files.push(full);
    }
  }
  return files;
}

// ─── Analyze one file ─────────────────────────────────────
function analyzeFile(filePath) {
  const source = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
  const relPath = path.relative(ROOT, filePath);

  // ─── Phase 1: Parse (this is the exact same parser Metro uses) ───
  let ast;
  try {
    ast = parser.parse(source, {
      sourceType: "module",
      plugins: [
        "jsx",
        "typescript",
        "classProperties",
        "objectRestSpread",
        "optionalChaining",
        "nullishCoalescingOperator",
        "dynamicImport",
        "exportDefaultFrom",
        "exportNamespaceFrom",
      ],
      errorRecovery: false,
      allowReturnOutsideFunction: false,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    // Syntax error — this IS the crash Metro sees
    const { loc, message } = err;
    const line = loc?.line;
    const col = loc?.column;
    const lineText = line ? source.split("\n")[line - 1] : "";

    return {
      ok: false,
      file: relPath,
      kind: "SYNTAX",
      line,
      col,
      message,
      lineText,
    };
  }

  // ─── Phase 2: Detect function-valued styles in StyleSheet.create ───
  // This is the #1 cause of `invalid property name` at runtime
  const badStyles = [];

  traverse(ast, {
    CallExpression(nodePath) {
      const callee = nodePath.node.callee;

      // Match: StyleSheet.create({ ... })
      const isStyleSheetCreate =
        callee.type === "MemberExpression" &&
        callee.object.name === "StyleSheet" &&
        callee.property.name === "create";

      if (!isStyleSheetCreate) return;

      const arg = nodePath.node.arguments[0];
      if (!arg || arg.type !== "ObjectExpression") return;

      for (const prop of arg.properties) {
        if (prop.type !== "ObjectProperty") continue;

        const keyName = prop.key.name || prop.key.value;
        const value = prop.value;

        // Function value → Hermes compilation crash
        if (
          value.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" ||
          value.type === "FunctionExpression"
        ) {
          badStyles.push({
            keyName,
            line: prop.loc.start.line,
            col: prop.loc.start.column,
          });
        }
      }
    },
  });

  if (badStyles.length > 0) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      file: relPath,
      kind: "STYLESHEET",
      badStyles,
    };
  }

  return { ok: true, file: relPath };
}

// ─── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function main() {
  if (!QUIET) {
    console.log(c.bold(c.cyan("🔍 JS Syntax & StyleSheet Validator")));
    console.log(c.gray(`   Root: ${path.relative(process.cwd(), targetDir)}`));
    console.log("");
  }

  const files = walk(targetDir);
  if (!QUIET) {
    console.log(c.gray(`   Scanned ${files.length} file(s)\n`));
  }

  const failures = [];

  for (const file of files) {
    const result = analyzeFile(file);

    if (!result.ok) {
      failures.push(result);
      console.log(c.red(`❌ ${result.file}`));

      if (result.kind === "SYNTAX") {
        console.log(c.red(`   SyntaxError @ ${result.line}:${result.col}`));
        console.log(c.gray(`   ${result.message.split("\n")[0]}`));
        if (result.lineText) {
          console.log(c.gray(`   ${result.lineText.trim()}`));
          console.log(c.gray(`   ${" ".repeat(result.col)}${c.bold("^")}`));
        }
      } else if (result.kind === "STYLESHEET") {
        console.log(
          c.red(
            `   Function-valued styles inside StyleSheet.create() — Hermes will crash:`,
          ),
        );
        for (const s of result.badStyles) {
          console.log(
            c.red(`   • "${s.keyName}": (c) => ({...})  @ line ${s.line}`),
          );
          console.log(
            c.yellow(
              `     Fix: change to  ${s.keyName}: { ... }  and apply theme inline in JSX`,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
      console.log("");
    } else if (!QUIET) {
      console.log(c.green(`✅ ${result.file}`));
    }
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log(c.bold("─".repeat(60)));
  if (failures.length === 0) {
    console.log(c.green(c.bold(`✨ All ${files.length} files passed.`)));
    console.log(c.gray("   Metro/Hermes should bundle without syntax errors."));
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(
      c.red(
        c.bold(
          `🚨 ${failures.length} file(s) contain errors — these WILL crash the bundle:`,
        ),
      ),
    );
    for (const f of failures) {
      console.log(c.red(`   • ${f.file}`));
    }
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main();

=== END: scripts/validate-js-syntax.js ===

=== FILE: scripts/wrap-i18n.js ===
#!/usr/bin/env node
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// wrap-i18n.js — Auto-wrap hardcoded strings with t()
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// RUN AFTER scan-i18n.js.
// Reads i18n-todo.json and rewrites each file, replacing hardcoded strings
// with t('key') calls. Also injects the useTranslation hook if missing.
//
// USAGE:
//   node scripts/wrap-i18n.js              (dry-run — shows diffs only)
//   node scripts/wrap-i18n.js --write      (actually modifies files)
//   node scripts/wrap-i18n.js --file src/screens/Login.jsx --write
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const WRITE = args.includes("--write");
const fileArg = args.indexOf("--file");
const ONLY = fileArg >= 0 ? path.resolve(args[fileArg + 1]) : null;
const ROOT = path.resolve(".");
const TODO_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "i18n-todo.json");

if (!fs.existsSync(TODO_PATH)) {
  console.error("❌  i18n-todo.json not found. Run scan-i18n.js first.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const todo = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(TODO_PATH, "utf8"));

// Group by file
const byFile = {};
for (const item of todo) {
  const abs = path.resolve(ROOT, item.file);
  if (ONLY && abs !== ONLY) continue;
  if (!byFile[abs]) byFile[abs] = [];
  byFile[abs].push(item);
}

let totalReplaced = 0;
let totalFiles = 0;

const T_IMPORT = `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';`;
const T_HOOK = `const { t } = useTranslation();`;

for (const [filePath, items] of Object.entries(byFile)) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) continue;

  let src = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
  const original = src;
  let replaced = 0;

  // Sort by longest string first to avoid partial-replacement bugs
  const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => b.raw.length - a.raw.length);

  for (const item of sorted) {
    const { raw, key, pattern } = item;
    const escaped = raw.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

    if (pattern === "jsx_text") {
      // Replace   >Some text<   with   >{t('key')}<
      const re = new RegExp(`(>\\s*)${escaped}(\\s*<)`, "g");
      const next = src.replace(re, `$1{t('${key}')}$2`);
      if (next !== src) {
        src = next;
        replaced++;
      }
    } else if (pattern === "prop") {
      // Replace   placeholder="Some text"   with   placeholder={t('key')}
      const re = new RegExp(
        `((?:placeholder|title|label|message|hint|description|subtitle|heading|buttonText|text|errorMessage|helperText)\\s*=\\s*)["'\`]${escaped}["'\`]`,
        "g",
      );
      const next = src.replace(re, `$1{t('${key}')}`);
      if (next !== src) {
        src = next;
        replaced++;
      }
    } else if (pattern === "alert") {
      // Replace first string arg in Alert.alert("text", ...)
      const re = new RegExp(
        `(Alert\\.alert|showToast|Toast\\.show)\\s*\\(\\s*["'\`]${escaped}["'\`]`,
        "g",
      );
      const next = src.replace(re, `$1(t('${key}')`);
      if (next !== src) {
        src = next;
        replaced++;
      }
    } else {
      // Generic: replace quoted string
      const re = new RegExp(`["'\`]${escaped}["'\`]`, "g");
      const next = src.replace(re, `t('${key}')`);
      if (next !== src) {
        src = next;
        replaced++;
      }
    }
  }

  if (replaced === 0) continue;

  // Inject useTranslation hook if not already present
  const hasImport = src.includes("useTranslation");
  const hasHook = src.includes("const { t }") || src.includes("const {t}");

  if (!hasImport) {
    // Add import after last existing import line
    src = src.replace(/(import\s[^;]+;?\n)(?!import)/, `$1${T_IMPORT}\n`);
  }
  if (!hasHook) {
    // Add hook after first function/component declaration line
    src = src.replace(
      /(export\s+default\s+function\s+\w+[^{]*\{|const\s+\w+\s*=\s*\([^)]*\)\s*=>\s*\{)/,
      `$1\n  ${T_HOOK}`,
    );
  }

  if (!WRITE) {
    console.log(
      `\n📄  ${path.relative(ROOT, filePath)}  (${replaced} replacements)`,
    );
    // Show a mini diff of the first 3 changes
    const origLines = original.split("\n");
    const newLines = src.split("\n");
    let shown = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < origLines.length && shown < 3; i++) {
      if (origLines[i] !== newLines[i]) {
        console.log(`  L${i + 1}  - ${origLines[i].trim()}`);
        console.log(`       + ${newLines[i].trim()}`);
        shown++;
      }
    }
    if (replaced > 3) console.log(`       … and ${replaced - 3} more`);
  } else {
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath + ".i18n.bak", original, "utf8"); // backup
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, src, "utf8");
    console.log(
      `✅  ${path.relative(ROOT, filePath)}  (${replaced} replacements)`,
    );
  }

  totalReplaced += replaced;
  totalFiles++;
}

console.log(`
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
${WRITE ? "✅  WRITE COMPLETE" : "🔍  DRY RUN (no files changed)"}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  Files modified:   ${totalFiles}
  Strings wrapped:  ${totalReplaced}
${!WRITE ? "\n  Run with --write to apply changes." : "  Backups saved as *.i18n.bak\n  Review changes, then: git diff"}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
`);

=== END: scripts/wrap-i18n.js ===

    .patch(`/bookings/${id}/checkin`, coords)

// src/api/categories.js
import api from "./client";

export const categoriesApi = {
  /**
   * GET /categories
   * Backend returns: { data: { categories: [...] } }
   */
  getAll: async (params = {}) => {
    const { data } = await api.get("/categories", { params });
    // data.data = { categories: [...] }
    const payload = data?.data ?? data;
    if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload;
    if (Array.isArray(payload?.categories)) return payload.categories;
    if (Array.isArray(payload?.data)) return payload.data;
    return [];
  },

  getBySlug: async (slug) => {
    const { data } = await api.get(`/categories/${slug}`);
    return data?.data?.category ?? data?.data ?? null;
  },

  /**
   * POST /categories/suggest
   * Backend returns: { data: { category: { id, name, slug, ... }, alreadyExists } }
   *
   * Always returns a valid { id, name, slug } — name falls back to the
   * string the caller passed so it is NEVER undefined.
   */
  suggest: async (name) => {
    const trimmed = (name ?? "").trim();
    if (!trimmed) throw new Error("Name required");

    const { data } = await api.post("/categories/suggest", { name: trimmed });
    const raw = data?.data?.category ?? data?.data ?? {};

    return {
      id: raw.id ?? `custom_${Date.now()}`,
      name: raw.name ?? trimmed,
      slug: raw.slug ?? "",
      alreadyExists: data?.data?.alreadyExists ?? false,
    };
    // ← No try/catch — let errors propagate so the modal can catch them
  },
};

=== FILE: src/api/client.js ===
// src/api/client.js
import axios from "axios";
import Constants from "expo-constants";
import * as SecureStore from "expo-secure-store";

const API_URL =
  Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.API_URL || "https://api.skilledproz.com/api";

const ACCESS_KEY = "skp_access";
const REFRESH_KEY = "skp_refresh";

// ─── Token storage ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const tokenStore = {
  async getAccess() {
    try {
      return await SecureStore.getItemAsync(ACCESS_KEY);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },
  async getRefresh() {
    try {
      return await SecureStore.getItemAsync(REFRESH_KEY);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },
  async setTokens(access, refresh) {
    try {
      if (access) await SecureStore.setItemAsync(ACCESS_KEY, access);
      if (refresh) await SecureStore.setItemAsync(REFRESH_KEY, refresh);
    } catch {}
  },
  async clear() {
    try {
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(ACCESS_KEY);
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(REFRESH_KEY);
    } catch {}
  },
};

// ─── Axios instance ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_URL,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    Accept: "application/json",
  },
});

// ─── Dev logging ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (__DEV__) {
  api.interceptors.request.use(
    (config) => {
      console.log(
        `🚀 ${config.method?.toUpperCase()} ${config.baseURL}${config.url}`,
      );
      return config;
    },
    (error) => Promise.reject(error),
  );

  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => {
      console.log(`✅ ${response.status} ${response.config.url}`);
      return response;
    },
    (error) => {
      console.error(
        `❌ ${error.response?.status || "Network Error"} ${error.config?.url}`,
      );
      return Promise.reject(error);
    },
  );
}

// ─── Auth token interceptor ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// Skip attaching bearer to auth endpoints themselves — the refresh POST
// must go without a (stale) Authorization header or the backend rejects it.
const AUTH_EXEMPT_PATHS = ["/auth/refresh", "/auth/login", "/auth/register"];

api.interceptors.request.use(async (config) => {
  if (AUTH_EXEMPT_PATHS.some((p) => config.url?.includes(p))) {
    return config;
  }
  const token = await tokenStore.getAccess();
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  return config;
});

// ─── 401 → refresh queue ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// One in-flight refresh at a time. All 401'd requests queue here.
// The critical fix: isRefreshing must be cleared BEFORE the queue is
// flushed, so any 401 arriving during flush starts a NEW refresh cycle
// rather than enqueueing into a dead queue.

let isRefreshing = false;
let queued = [];

const flushQueue = (err, token) => {
  const pending = queued;
  queued = [];
  pending.forEach(({ resolve, reject }) => {
    try {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(token);
    } catch {}
  });
};

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (error) => {
    const original = error.config;

    const is401 = error.response?.status === 401;
    const alreadyRetried = original?._retry;
    const isAuthEndpoint = AUTH_EXEMPT_PATHS.some((p) =>
      original?.url?.includes(p),
    );

    if (!is401 || alreadyRetried || isAuthEndpoint) {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }

    original._retry = true;

    // If a refresh is already in flight, wait for it.
    if (isRefreshing) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        queued.push({
          resolve: (token) => {
            original.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
            resolve(api(original));
          },
          reject,
        });
      });
    }

    // Start a new refresh cycle.
    const refresh = await tokenStore.getRefresh();
    if (!refresh) {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }

    isRefreshing = true;

    try {
      const { data } = await axios.post(
        `${API_URL}/auth/refresh`,
        { refreshToken: refresh },
        {
          timeout: 60000,
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            Accept: "application/json",
          },
        },
      );

      const newAccess = data?.data?.accessToken;
      const newRefresh = data?.data?.refreshToken;

      if (!newAccess) {
        throw new Error("Refresh response missing access token");
      }

      await tokenStore.setTokens(newAccess, newRefresh);

      // CRITICAL: clear the flag BEFORE flushing so any concurrent 401
      // that arrives during retry starts a new cycle instead of queueing
      // to a queue that will never be flushed again.
      isRefreshing = false;
      flushQueue(null, newAccess);

      // Retry the original request with the new token.
      original.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${newAccess}`;
      return api(original);
    } catch (err) {
      isRefreshing = false;
      flushQueue(err, null);
      await tokenStore.clear();
      return Promise.reject(err);
    }
  },
);

// ─── Helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function getErrorMessage(err, fallback = "Something went wrong") {
  return (
    err?.response?.data?.message ||
    err?.response?.data?.error ||
    err?.message ||
    fallback
  );
}

export default api;

=== END: src/api/client.js ===

// src/api/messages.js
import client from "./client";

// GET /messages/conversations
export const getConversations = () =>
  client
    .get("/messages/conversations")
    .then((r) => r.data.data.conversations ?? []);

// GET /messages/:conversationId?page=1&limit=50
export const getMessages = (conversationId, params = {}) =>
  client
    .get(`/messages/${conversationId}`, { params })
    .then((r) => r.data.data.messages ?? []);

// POST /messages  (text or file)
export const sendMessage = (payload) => {
  const isFile = !!payload.file;
  if (isFile) {
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("receiverId", payload.receiverId);
    if (payload.conversationId)
      form.append("conversationId", payload.conversationId);
    if (payload.content) form.append("content", payload.content);
    form.append("file", {
      uri: payload.file.uri,
      name: payload.file.name ?? "attachment",
      type: payload.file.mimeType ?? "application/octet-stream",
    });
    return client
      .post("/messages", form, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      })
      .then((r) => r.data.data);
  }
  return client
    .post("/messages", {
      receiverId: payload.receiverId,
      content: payload.content,
      conversationId: payload.conversationId ?? null,
    })
    .then((r) => r.data.data);
};

// PATCH /messages/:conversationId/read
export const markConversationRead = (conversationId) =>
  client.patch(`/messages/${conversationId}/read`).then((r) => r.data);

import client from "./client";

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// CARD — POST /payments/initiate/:bookingId
// Stripe  → data: { clientSecret }
// Paystack→ data: { authorizationUrl, reference }
// Already paid → data: { alreadyPaid: true, bookingId }
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const initiatePayment = (bookingId) =>
  client.post(`/payments/initiate/${bookingId}`).then((r) => r.data.data);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MOBILE STRIPE CHECKOUT — POST /payments/initiate-checkout/:bookingId
// Returns { url, sessionId } — Checkout Session URL, safe to open in browser.
// Add this single extra endpoint to payment.routes.js (see mobile_stripe_addition.js)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const initiateStripeCheckout = (bookingId) =>
  client
    .post(`/payments/initiate-checkout/${bookingId}`)
    .then((r) => r.data.data);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// VERIFY PAYSTACK — GET /payments/verify/paystack?reference=xxx
// Returns { success, message, data: { bookingId, status:"HELD" } }
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const verifyPaystackPayment = (reference) =>
  client
    .get("/payments/verify/paystack", { params: { reference } })
    .then((r) => r.data);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// BANK TRANSFER — Step 1: GET details (no DB write)
// POST /payments/bank-transfer/:bookingId
// Returns {
//   reference, platformFee, workerPayout, totalToSend,
//   bankDetails: { bankName, accountNumber, accountName, amount, currency, narration }
// }
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const initiateBankTransfer = (bookingId) =>
  client.post(`/payments/bank-transfer/${bookingId}`).then((r) => r.data.data);

// BANK TRANSFER — Step 2: Confirm after manual transfer (creates DB record)
// PATCH /payments/bank-transfer/:bookingId/confirm
// Body: { reference, proofUrl?, senderName?, bankName? }
// Returns { success, message, data: { payment } }
export const confirmBankTransfer = (bookingId, payload) =>
  client
    .patch(`/payments/bank-transfer/${bookingId}/confirm`, payload)
    .then((r) => r.data);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// CRYPTO — Step 1: GET wallet details (no DB write)
// POST /payments/crypto/:bookingId  body: { cryptoCurrency: "USDC" }
// Returns {
//   reference, platformFee, workerPayout, totalToSend,
//   cryptoDetails: { currency, network, wallet, amountFiat, note }
// }
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const initiateCrypto = (bookingId, cryptoCurrency = "USDC") =>
  client
    .post(`/payments/crypto/${bookingId}`, { cryptoCurrency })
    .then((r) => r.data.data);

// CRYPTO — Step 2: Submit tx hash (creates DB record)
// PATCH /payments/crypto/:bookingId/confirm
// Body: { txHash, cryptoCurrency, reference, cryptoAmount? }
// Returns { success, message, data: { payment } }
export const confirmCrypto = (bookingId, payload) =>
  client
    .patch(`/payments/crypto/${bookingId}/confirm`, payload)
    .then((r) => r.data);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// RELEASE ESCROW — POST /payments/release/:bookingId  (HIRER)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const releasePayment = (bookingId) =>

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/api/posts.js
import client from "./client";

// ── Feed ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// GET /posts/feed?page=1&limit=20&type=GENERAL
export const getFeed = (params = {}) =>
  client.get("/posts/feed", { params }).then((r) => r.data.data);

// ── My posts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getMyPosts = (params = {}) =>
  client.get("/posts/my", { params }).then((r) => r.data.data);

// ── User posts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getUserPosts = (userId, params = {}) =>
  client.get(`/posts/user/${userId}`, { params }).then((r) => r.data.data);

// ── Single post ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getPost = (postId) =>
  client.get(`/posts/${postId}`).then((r) => r.data.data.post);

// ── Create post (multipart FormData for image support) ────────────────────────
export const createPost = (payload) => {
  // payload: { content, type?, isPublic?, images?: [{ uri, name, type }] }
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append("content", payload.content);
  form.append("type", payload.type ?? "GENERAL");
  form.append("isPublic", payload.isPublic ?? true);

  (payload.images ?? []).forEach((img, i) => {
    form.append("images", {
      uri: img.uri,
      name: img.name ?? `photo_${i}.jpg`,
      type: img.type ?? "image/jpeg",
    });
  });

  return client
    .post("/posts", form, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
    })
    .then((r) => r.data.data.post);
};

// ── Update post ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const updatePost = (postId, payload) =>
  client.put(`/posts/${postId}`, payload).then((r) => r.data.data.post);

// ── Delete post ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const deletePost = (postId) =>
  client.delete(`/posts/${postId}`).then((r) => r.data);

// ── Repost ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/api/settings.js
import api from "./client";

export const settingsApi = {
  // ── Profile ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getProfile: () => api.get("/settings/profile").then((r) => r.data.data.user),

  updateProfile: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/profile", payload).then((r) => r.data.data.user),

  updateAvatar: async (uri) => {
    const form = new FormData();
    const filename = uri.split("/").pop();
    const match = /\.(\w+)$/.exec(filename);
    const type = match ? `image/${match[1]}` : "image/jpeg";
    form.append("avatar", { uri, name: filename, type });
    const { data } = await api.post("/settings/avatar", form, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
    });
    return data.data.avatar;
  },

  // ── Hirer profile ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  updateHirerProfile: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/hirer-profile", payload).then((r) => r.data),

  // ── Password ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  changePassword: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/password", payload).then((r) => r.data),

  // ── Notifications ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getNotificationPrefs: () =>
    api.get("/settings/notifications").then((r) => r.data.data.prefs),

  updateNotificationPrefs: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/notifications", payload).then((r) => r.data),

// src/api/verification.js
// Hirer AND Worker verification functions.
// Route breakdown from backend:
//   Worker: GET  /verification/status           → getWorkerVerificationStatus
//   Worker: POST /verification/submit-id        → submitIdVerification
//   Worker: POST /verification/submit-certification → submitWorkerCertification
//   Worker: DELETE /verification/certifications/:certId → deleteWorkerCertification
//   Hirer:  GET  /verification/hirer/status     → getHirerVerificationStatus  (existing)
//   Hirer:  POST /verification/hirer/submit     → submitHirerVerification     (existing)

import client from "./client";

// ── HIRER (unchanged) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getHirerVerificationStatus = async () => {
  const res = await client.get("/verification/hirer/status");
  return res.data.data;
};

export const submitHirerVerification = async (formData) => {
  const res = await client.post("/verification/hirer/submit", formData, {
    headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
  });
  return res.data;
};

// ── WORKER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getWorkerVerificationStatus = async () => {
  const res = await client.get("/verification/status");
  return res.data.data;
};

// formData must contain: idType, idNumber, dateOfBirth?, nationality?, + file
export const submitIdVerification = async (formData) => {
  const res = await client.post("/verification/submit-id", formData, {
    headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
  });
  return res.data;
};

// formData: name, issuedBy, issueDate?, expiryDate?, + optional file
export const submitWorkerCertification = async (formData) => {
  const res = await client.post(
    "/verification/submit-certification",
    formData,
    {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
    },
  );
  return res.data.data.certification;
};

export const deleteWorkerCertification = async (certId) => {
  const res = await client.delete(`/verification/certifications/${certId}`);
  return res.data;
};

// ── ROLE-AWARE HELPER (used by VerificationScreen) ───────────────────────────
// Call this from VerificationScreen instead of calling role-specific functions directly.
export const getVerificationStatus = async (role) => {
  if (role === "WORKER") return getWorkerVerificationStatus();
  return getHirerVerificationStatus();
};

Drop your `icon.png` (1024x1024), `splash.png`, and `adaptive-icon.png` here.

Until then, Expo uses its default Expo icon — totally fine for development.

=== FILE: src/components/AppButton.js ===
// src/components/AppButton.js
import React from "react";
import {
  Pressable,
  ActivityIndicator,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * AppButton — primary CTA used everywhere.
 *
 * variant:
 *   - "primary" (default): solid orange, dark text — matches "Sign In", "Continue →"
 *   - "secondary": panel bg with border — matches "← Back"
 *   - "ghost": transparent
 *   - "danger": red
 *
 * size: "md" (default) | "sm" | "lg"
 */
export default function AppButton({
  title,
  onPress,
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  loading = false,
  disabled = false,
  iconLeft,
  iconRight,
  fullWidth = true,
  style,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const palette = getPalette(variant, theme, disabled);
  const dims = SIZE[size];

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.base,
        {
          backgroundColor: palette.bg,
          borderColor: palette.border,
          borderWidth: variant === "secondary" || variant === "ghost" ? 1 : 0,
          paddingVertical: dims.py,
          paddingHorizontal: dims.px,
          borderRadius: dims.radius,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          width: fullWidth ? "100%" : undefined,
          alignSelf: fullWidth ? "stretch" : "flex-start",
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <View style={styles.row}>
        {loading ? (
          <ActivityIndicator color={palette.fg} />
        ) : (
          <>
            {iconLeft ? (
              <Ionicons
                name={iconLeft}
                size={dims.icon}
                color={palette.fg}
                style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
              />
            ) : null}
            <AppText
              variant={dims.textVariant}
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: palette.fg, textAlign: "center" }}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {title}
            </AppText>
            {iconRight ? (
              <Ionicons
                name={iconRight}
                size={dims.icon}
                color={palette.fg}
                style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
              />
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const SIZE = {
  sm: { py: 10, px: 16, radius: 10, icon: 16, textVariant: "small" },
  md: { py: 14, px: 20, radius: 12, icon: 18, textVariant: "subtitle" },
  lg: { py: 16, px: 24, radius: 14, icon: 20, textVariant: "subtitle" },
};

function getPalette(variant, theme, disabled) {
  const base = (() => {
    switch (variant) {
      case "secondary":
        return {
          bg: theme.colors.bgPanel,
          fg: theme.colors.text,
          border: theme.colors.border,
        };
      case "ghost":
        return {
          bg: "transparent",
          fg: theme.colors.text,
          border: theme.colors.border,
        };
      case "danger":
        return {
          bg: theme.colors.red,
          fg: "#ffffff",
          border: "transparent",
        };
      case "primary":
      default:
        return {
          // The website uses pure orange button with near-black text on the
          // "Sign In" CTA; we match that contrast.
          bg: theme.colors.orange,
          fg: "#0f0f1a",
          border: "transparent",
        };
    }
  })();

  if (disabled) {
    return { ...base, bg: theme.colors.orangeDim, fg: theme.colors.textDim };
  }
  return base;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
});

=== END: src/components/AppButton.js ===

=== FILE: src/components/AppCurrency.js ===
// src/components/AppCurrency.js
import React from "react";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useCurrency } from "../contexts/CurrencyContext";

/**
 * AppCurrency — render a monetary amount.
 *
 *   <AppCurrency amount={1500} />                     // uses global currency
 *   <AppCurrency amount={1500} currencyCode="NGN" />  // overrides for this instance
 *   <AppCurrency amount={1500} variant="title" />     // any AppText variant
 *
 * This is intentionally a thin component so screens never have to know how
 * formatting works for a given user's locale.
 */
export default function AppCurrency({
  amount,
  currencyCode,
  variant = "body",
  weight,
  tone,
  style,
  minimumFractionDigits,
  maximumFractionDigits,
}) {
  const { format } = useCurrency();
  const text = format(amount, {
    currencyCode,
    minimumFractionDigits,
    maximumFractionDigits,
  });

  return (
    <AppText variant={variant} weight={weight} tone={tone} style={style}>
      {text}
    </AppText>
  );
}

// src/components/AppInput.js
import React, { useState, forwardRef } from "react";
import {
  View,
  TextInput,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  I18nManager,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * AppInput — themed input that matches the website's pill input
 *  (icon left, optional eye toggle for password, label above, error below).
 */
const AppInput = forwardRef(function AppInput(
  {
    label,
    iconLeft,
    placeholder,
    value,
    onChangeText,
    onBlur,
    onFocus,
    secureTextEntry,
    keyboardType = "default",
    autoCapitalize = "none",
    autoCorrect = false,
    autoComplete,
    textContentType,
    error,
    helperText,
    rightAction,
    rightActionLabel,
    onRightActionPress,
    multiline = false,
    numberOfLines,
    maxLength,
    editable = true,
    style,
  },
  ref,
) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const isPassword = !!secureTextEntry;
  const obscured = isPassword && !showPassword;

  const borderColor = error
    ? theme.colors.red
    : focused
    ? theme.colors.borderFocus
    : theme.colors.border;

  return (
    <View style={[styles.wrap, style]}>
      {(label || onRightActionPress) && (
        <View style={styles.labelRow}>
          {label ? (
            <AppText variant="label" tone="dim">
              {label}
            </AppText>
          ) : (
            <View />
          )}
          {onRightActionPress ? (
            <Pressable onPress={onRightActionPress} hitSlop={6}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="brand" weight="semibold">
                {rightActionLabel}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      )}

      <View
        style={[
          styles.field,
          {
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgInput,
            borderColor,
            paddingVertical: multiline ? 12 : 0,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {iconLeft ? (
          <Ionicons
            name={iconLeft}
            size={18}
            color={theme.colors.textDim}
            style={styles.iconLeft}
          />
        ) : null}

        <TextInput
          ref={ref}
          value={value}
          onChangeText={onChangeText}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          placeholderTextColor={theme.colors.textMuted}
          onFocus={(e) => {
            setFocused(true);
            onFocus?.(e);
          }}
          onBlur={(e) => {
            setFocused(false);
            onBlur?.(e);
          }}
          secureTextEntry={obscured}
          keyboardType={keyboardType}
          autoCapitalize={autoCapitalize}
          autoCorrect={autoCorrect}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          textContentType={textContentType}
          multiline={multiline}
          numberOfLines={numberOfLines}
          maxLength={maxLength}
          editable={editable}
          maxFontSizeMultiplier={1.2}
          style={[
            styles.input,
            {
              color: theme.colors.text,
              textAlign: I18nManager.isRTL ? "right" : "left",
              fontFamily: "DMSans_400Regular",
              minHeight: multiline ? Math.max(48, (numberOfLines || 3) * 22) : 48,
              paddingLeft: iconLeft ? 0 : 14,
              paddingRight: isPassword ? 0 : 14,
            },
          ]}
        />

        {isPassword ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setShowPassword((s) => !s)}
            hitSlop={8}
            style={styles.eye}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name={showPassword ? "eye-off-outline" : "eye-outline"}
              size={18}
              color={theme.colors.textDim}
            />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {error ? (
        <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={styles.helper}>
          {error}
        </AppText>
      ) : helperText ? (
        <AppText variant="small" tone="muted" style={styles.helper}>
          {helperText}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
});

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrap: { gap: 8 },
  labelRow: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
  },
  field: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  iconLeft: {
    paddingLeft: 14,
    paddingRight: 10,
  },
  input: {
    flex: 1,
    fontSize: 15,
    paddingVertical: 0,
  },
  eye: {
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 12,
  },
  helper: {
    marginTop: 2,
  },
});

export default AppInput;

=== END: src/components/AppInput.js ===

=== FILE: src/components/AppScreen.js ===
// src/components/AppScreen.js
import React from "react";
import {
  View,
  StyleSheet,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StatusBar as RNStatusBar,
} from "react-native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { StatusBar } from "expo-status-bar";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * AppScreen — every screen mounts inside this wrapper. It handles:
 *  - safe areas (notches, gesture bars)
 *  - themed background
 *  - keyboard avoidance
 *  - optional scroll
 *  - status bar style synced with the active theme
 *  - pull-to-refresh (pass a <RefreshControl /> via `refreshControl` prop)
 */
export default function AppScreen({
  children,
  scroll = true,
  keyboard = true,
  padded = true,
  edges = ["left", "right", "bottom"],
  contentContainerStyle,
  refreshControl,
  style,
}) {
  const { theme, effectiveMode } = useTheme();

  const body = scroll ? (
    <ScrollView
      keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
      showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      refreshControl={refreshControl}
      contentContainerStyle={[
        styles.scrollContent,
        padded && styles.padded,
        contentContainerStyle,
      ]}
    >
      {children}
    </ScrollView>
  ) : (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.viewContent,
        padded && styles.padded,
        contentContainerStyle,
      ]}
    >
      {children}
    </View>
  );

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      edges={edges}
      style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.bg }, style]}
    >
      <StatusBar style={effectiveMode === "light" ? "dark" : "light"} />
      {keyboard ? (
        <KeyboardAvoidingView
          behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : undefined}
          style={styles.flex}
          keyboardVerticalOffset={
            Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0 : RNStatusBar.currentHeight || 0
          }
        >
          {body}
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
      ) : (
        body
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1 },
  flex: { flex: 1 },
  scrollContent: { flexGrow: 1 },
  viewContent: { flex: 1 },
  padded: { paddingHorizontal: 20, paddingVertical: 16 },
});

=== END: src/components/AppScreen.js ===

=== FILE: src/components/AppText.js ===
// src/components/AppText.js
import React from "react";
import { Text, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * AppText — every piece of text in the app should use this component.
 *
 * Variants map to the website's typographic system:
 *   - "display" / "displaySm" → Syne (the bold "Sign in to SkilledProz" headlines)
 *   - "title"   → DM Sans 600, larger
 *   - "body"    → DM Sans 400 (default)
 *   - "label"   → uppercase tracking, used for form labels and "WELCOME BACK"
 *   - "muted"   → for hints and helper text
 *
 * `tone` overrides color: "default" | "dim" | "muted" | "brand" | "danger" | "success"
 *
 * Because text is sized in `sp` and we don't allow OS-level font scaling beyond a
 * cap, layouts hold up across long languages (German, Russian) without breaking.
 */
export default function AppText({
  children,
  variant = "body",
  tone = "default",
  weight,
  align,
  style,
  numberOfLines,
  selectable,
  ...rest
}) {
  const { theme, fonts } = useTheme();

  const variantStyle = VARIANTS[variant] || VARIANTS.body;
  const fontFamily = weight
    ? FAMILY_BY_WEIGHT[weight] || fonts.body
    : variantStyle.fontFamily(fonts);

  const color = TONE_COLOR(tone, theme);

  return (
    <Text
      maxFontSizeMultiplier={1.3}
      numberOfLines={numberOfLines}
      selectable={selectable}
      style={[
        styles.base,
        { fontFamily, color },
        variantStyle.style,
        align && { textAlign: align },
        style,
      ]}
      {...rest}
    >
      {children}
    </Text>
  );
}

const VARIANTS = {
  display: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.displayBlack,
    style: { fontSize: 36, lineHeight: 42, letterSpacing: -0.5 },
  },
  displaySm: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.display,
    style: { fontSize: 28, lineHeight: 34, letterSpacing: -0.3 },
  },
  title: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.bodySemiBold,
    style: { fontSize: 20, lineHeight: 26 },
  },
  subtitle: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.bodyMedium,
    style: { fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 22 },
  },
  body: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.body,
    style: { fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 21 },
  },
  small: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.body,
    style: { fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 18 },
  },
  label: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.bodySemiBold,
    style: {
      fontSize: 12,
      lineHeight: 16,
      letterSpacing: 1.2,
      textTransform: "uppercase",
    },
  },
  muted: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.body,
    style: { fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 18 },
  },
};

const FAMILY_BY_WEIGHT = {
  regular: "DMSans_400Regular",
  medium: "DMSans_500Medium",
  semibold: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
  bold: "DMSans_700Bold",
  display: "Syne_700Bold",
  displayBlack: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
};

const TONE_COLOR = (tone, theme) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case "dim":
      return theme.colors.textDim;
    case "muted":
      return theme.colors.textMuted;
    case "brand":
      return theme.colors.orange;
    case "danger":
      return theme.colors.red;
    case "success":
      return theme.colors.green;
    default:
      return theme.colors.text;
  }
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    // RN's default includeFontPadding on Android adds extra vertical space —
    // disabling gives us pixel-accurate alignment with the web design.
    includeFontPadding: false,
  },
});

// src/components/Avatar.js
import React from "react";
import { View, Image, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * Avatar — circular user photo with initials fallback.
 *
 *   <Avatar uri={user.avatar} firstName={user.firstName} lastName={user.lastName} size={40} />
 *
 * Falls back to a colored circle with the user's initials when no avatar.
 */
export default function Avatar({
  uri,
  firstName = "",
  lastName = "",
  size = 40,
  style,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const initials =
    `${firstName[0] || ""}${lastName[0] || ""}`.toUpperCase() || "?";

  if (uri) {
    return (
      <Image
        source={{ uri }}
        style={[
          styles.img,
          {
            width: size,
            height: size,
            borderRadius: size / 2,
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgInput,
          },
          style,
        ]}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.fallback,
        {
          width: size,
          height: size,
          borderRadius: size / 2,
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.orangeDim,
          borderColor: theme.colors.border,
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        weight="bold"
        style={{
          color: theme.colors.orange,
          fontSize: Math.max(11, Math.floor(size * 0.4)),
        }}
      >
        {initials}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  img: {},
  fallback: {
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
});

// src/components/Badge.js
import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * Badge — themed status pill.
 *
 *   <Badge tone="success">Accepted</Badge>
 *   <Badge tone="danger">Disputed</Badge>
 *
 * Tones: "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info" | "neutral"
 * Or pass `status` directly (PENDING / ACCEPTED / COMPLETED / etc.) and it
 * auto-picks the right tone.
 */
export default function Badge({ children, tone, status, size = "sm" }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const effectiveTone = tone || toneFromStatus(status);
  const palette = getPalette(effectiveTone, theme);
  const label = String(children ?? status ?? "").toUpperCase();

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.base,
        size === "sm" ? styles.sm : styles.md,
        { backgroundColor: palette.bg, borderColor: palette.border },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        weight="bold"
        style={{
          color: palette.fg,
          fontSize: size === "sm" ? 10 : 11,
          letterSpacing: 0.8,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function toneFromStatus(status) {
  switch ((status || "").toUpperCase()) {
    case "ACCEPTED":
    case "COMPLETED":
    case "RELEASED":
    case "VERIFIED":
    case "ACTIVE":
      return "success";
    case "PENDING":
    case "IN_PROGRESS":
    case "HELD":
    case "PROCESSING":
      return "warning";
    case "REJECTED":
    case "CANCELLED":
    case "DISPUTED":
    case "FAILED":
    case "REFUNDED":
      return "danger";
    case "OPEN":
      return "info";
    default:
      return "neutral";
  }
}

function getPalette(tone, theme) {
  switch (tone) {
    case "success":
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.green,
        bg: theme.colors.greenDim,
        border: theme.colors.greenDim,
      };
    case "warning":
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.orange,
        bg: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.orangeDim,
      };
    case "danger":
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.red,
        bg: theme.colors.redDim,
        border: theme.colors.redDim,
      };
    case "info":
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.orange,
        bg: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.orangeDim,
      };
    case "neutral":
    default:
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.textDim,
        bg: theme.colors.bgCard,
        border: theme.colors.border,
      };
  }
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    alignSelf: "flex-start",
    borderRadius: 6,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  sm: { paddingHorizontal: 8, paddingVertical: 4 },
  md: { paddingHorizontal: 10, paddingVertical: 6 },
});

=== END: src/components/Badge.js ===

import React from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet, Image } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

const STATUS_MAP = {
  PENDING: { bg: "rgba(251,191,36,0.12)", fg: "#fbbf24" },
  ACCEPTED: { bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)", fg: "#f97316" },
  IN_PROGRESS: { bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.12)", fg: "#818cf8" },
  COMPLETED: { bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.10)", fg: "#22c55e" },
  CANCELLED: { bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)", fg: "#ef4444" },
  DISPUTED: { bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.20)", fg: "#f87171" },
};

const CURRENCY_SYMBOL = {
  USD: "$",
  EUR: "€",
  GBP: "£",
  NGN: "₦",
  GHS: "₵",
  KES: "KSh",
  ZAR: "R",
  INR: "₹",
  CAD: "C$",
  AUD: "A$",
  JPY: "¥",
  CNY: "¥",
  BRL: "R$",
  AED: "د.إ",
  SAR: "﷼",
  USDC: "$",
  USDT: "$",
};

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return null;
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

export default function BookingRow({ booking, onPress, showDivider = true }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const worker = booking.worker ?? {};
  const workerName =
    `${worker.firstName ?? ""} ${worker.lastName ?? ""}`.trim();
  const categoryName = booking.category?.name ?? "";
  const meta = [workerName, categoryName].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
  const dateLabel = fmtDate(booking.scheduledAt);

  const statusKey = (booking.status ?? "").toUpperCase();
  const palette = STATUS_MAP[statusKey] ?? { bg: c.bgCard, fg: c.textDim };
  const statusLabel = statusKey.replace("_", " ");

  const hasRate = booking.agreedRate != null && Number(booking.agreedRate) > 0;
  const symbol = CURRENCY_SYMBOL[booking.currency] ?? booking.currency ?? "";

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.row,
        {
          borderBottomColor: c.border,
          borderBottomWidth: showDivider ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth : 0,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Left: avatar + info */}
      <View style={styles.left}>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.avatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
          ]}
        >
          {worker.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: worker.avatar }} style={styles.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={styles.avatarText}>
              {initials(worker.firstName, worker.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={styles.info}>
          <AppText style={[styles.title, { color: c.text }]} numberOfLines={1}>
            {booking.title || "Untitled booking"}
          </AppText>
          {!!meta && (
            <AppText
              style={[styles.meta, { color: c.textDim }]}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {meta}
            </AppText>
          )}
          {!!dateLabel && (
            <AppText style={[styles.date, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
              {dateLabel}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Right: rate + badge */}
      <View style={styles.right}>
        {hasRate && (
          <AppText style={[styles.rate, { color: c.orange }]} numberOfLines={1}>
            {symbol}
            {Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()}
          </AppText>
        )}
        <View style={[styles.badge, { backgroundColor: palette.bg }]}>
          <AppText style={[styles.badgeText, { color: palette.fg }]}>
            {statusLabel}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}
