// src/components/CertMediaViewer.js
//
// Full-screen zoomable viewer for images, PDFs, videos (web: CertMediaViewer).
// Uses react-native-webview for PDFs (in-app), Image for pictures,
// expo-video for video previews.

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Image,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import { WebView } from "react-native-webview";

import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";
import {
  FaTimes,
  FaZoomIn,
  FaZoomOut,
  FaRotateCw,
  FaRefreshCw,
  FaFileText,
  FaExternalLink,
  FaImage as FaImageIcon,
} from "../icons/fa";

function classifyFile(url) {
  if (!url) return "other";
  const u = url.split("?")[0].toLowerCase();
  if (/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif|bmp|svg|avif|heic|heif)$/.test(u))
    return "image";
  if (/\.(mp4|webm|mov|m4v|ogg|ogv|avi|mkv)$/.test(u)) return "video";
  if (/\.pdf$/.test(u)) return "pdf";
  if (u.includes("/image/upload/")) return "image";
  if (u.includes("/video/upload/")) return "video";
  return "other";
}

export default function CertMediaViewer({ src, title, kind, onClose }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const { width, height } = useWindowDimensions();
  const fileKind = kind || classifyFile(src);

  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [rotation, setRotation] = useState(0);

  const reset = () => {
    setZoom(1);
    setRotation(0);
  };

  const zoomIn = () => setZoom((z) => Math.min(4, z + 0.25));
  const zoomOut = () => setZoom((z) => Math.max(0.25, z - 0.25));
  const rotate = () => setRotation((r) => (r + 90) % 360);

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <View style={styles.backdrop}>
        {/* Top bar */}
        <View style={styles.topBar}>
          <View style={styles.title}>
            <FaFileText size={14} color={c.orange} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                color: "#fff",
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "600",
                marginLeft: 8,
              }}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {title || "Document"}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.controls}>
            {fileKind === "image" ? (
              <>
                <Pressable onPress={zoomOut} style={styles.ctrlBtn}>
                  <FaZoomOut size={14} color="#fff" />
                </Pressable>
                <AppText style={styles.zoomLabel}>
                  {Math.round(zoom * 100)}%
                </AppText>
                <Pressable onPress={zoomIn} style={styles.ctrlBtn}>
                  <FaZoomIn size={14} color="#fff" />
                </Pressable>
                <Pressable onPress={rotate} style={styles.ctrlBtn}>
                  <FaRotateCw size={14} color="#fff" />
                </Pressable>
                <Pressable onPress={reset} style={styles.ctrlBtn}>
                  <FaRefreshCw size={14} color="#fff" />
                </Pressable>
              </>
            ) : null}
            <Pressable
              onPress={onClose}
              style={[styles.ctrlBtn, styles.closeBtn]}
            >
              <FaTimes size={16} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Stage */}
        <View style={styles.stage}>
          {fileKind === "image" ? (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: src }}
              style={{
                width,
                height: height - 80,
                transform: [{ scale: zoom }, { rotate: `${rotation}deg` }],
              }}
              resizeMode="contain"
            />
          ) : fileKind === "pdf" ? (
            <View
              style={{
                width: width - 24,
                height: height - 100,
                backgroundColor: "#fff",
                borderRadius: 8,
                overflow: "hidden",
              }}
            >
              <WebView source={{ uri: src }} startInLoadingState />
            </View>
          ) : fileKind === "video" ? (
            <Pressable
              style={{
                width: width - 24,
                height: height - 100,
                backgroundColor: "#000",
                borderRadius: 8,
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
              }}
              onPress={() => {
                // Open video in-app — reuse your existing VideoPlayerModal
                // by passing the URL through the parent. For simplicity,
                // show placeholder here.
              }}
            >
              <AppText style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 14 }}>
                Tap to open video preview
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.otherFile}>
              <FaFileText size={48} color="#666" />
              <AppText style={{ color: "#fff", marginTop: 14 }}>
                Preview not available for this file type.
              </AppText>
              <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>
                {src}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  backdrop: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.96)",
  },
  topBar: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    paddingVertical: 12,
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.8)",
    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    borderBottomColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)",
    paddingTop: 48,
  },
  title: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    flex: 1,
    minWidth: 0,
  },
  controls: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: 6,
  },
  ctrlBtn: {
    width: 34,
    height: 34,
    borderRadius: 8,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
    borderWidth: 1,

// src/components/ConfirmModal.js
// Platform-native confirmation modal — replaces Alert.alert() everywhere.
// Matches the app's dark/light theme and orange accent.

import React from "react";
import { Modal, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * Usage:
 *   const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);
 *
 *   <ConfirmModal
 *     visible={!!modal}
 *     title={modal?.title}
 *     message={modal?.message}
 *     confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel}
 *     destructive={modal?.destructive}
 *     onConfirm={() => { modal?.onConfirm?.(); setModal(null); }}
 *     onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
 *   />
 *
 *   // To show:
 *   setModal({
 *     title: "Mark job as filled?",
 *     confirmLabel: "Yes, mark filled",
 *     destructive: true,
 *     onConfirm: () => doSomething(),
 *   });
 */
export default function ConfirmModal({
  visible = false,
  title = "",
  message = "",
  confirmLabel = "Yes",
  cancelLabel = "No",
  destructive = false,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="fade"
      statusBarTranslucent
      onRequestClose={onCancel}
    >
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <Pressable style={styles.backdrop} onPress={onCancel}>
        {/* Stop event bubbling so tapping the card itself doesn't close */}
        <Pressable
          style={[
            styles.card,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderColor: c.border,
              shadowColor: c.shadow,
            },
          ]}
          onPress={() => {}}
        >
          {/* Title */}
          <AppText
            variant="title"
            weight="semibold"
            style={[styles.title, { color: c.text }]}
          >
            {title}
          </AppText>

          {/* Optional message */}
          {!!message && (
            <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={styles.message}>
              {message}
            </AppText>
          )}

          {/* Divider */}
          <View style={[styles.divider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

          {/* Buttons */}
          <View style={styles.btnRow}>
            {/* Cancel */}
            <Pressable
              onPress={onCancel}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.btn,
                styles.cancelBtn,
                { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                pressed && { opacity: 0.7 },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" tone="dim">
                {cancelLabel}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>

            {/* Confirm */}
            <Pressable
              onPress={onConfirm}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.btn,
                styles.confirmBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: destructive ? c.red : c.orange,
                },
                pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#fff" }}
              >
                {confirmLabel}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  backdrop: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 28,
  },
  card: {
    width: "100%",
    borderRadius: 20,
    borderWidth: 1,
    padding: 24,
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 8 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.35,
    shadowRadius: 24,
    elevation: 12,
  },
  title: { textAlign: "center" },
  message: { textAlign: "center", marginTop: 8 },
  divider: { height: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth, marginVertical: 20 },
  btnRow: { flexDirection: "row", gap: 10 },
  btn: {
    flex: 1,
    paddingVertical: 14,
    borderRadius: 12,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  cancelBtn: { borderWidth: 1 },
  confirmBtn: {},
});

// src/components/CurrencyPicker.js
//
// Website reference: HirerDashboard.jsx uses <DashboardCurrencySwitch /> inside
// .headerActions next to the .ctaBtn. On desktop that pill renders as:
//   [₦] [NGN] [▾]
// with no label, borderRadius 8, min-height 40 (matching .ctaBtn), and
// gap ~6 between symbol/code/chevron. The `compact` prop turns the picker
// into exactly that. Without `compact`, it keeps the wider "label + symbol +
// code + chevron" pill used elsewhere in the app (e.g. PostJob currency step).
//
// Modal, search, and currency list are unchanged from the original.

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  Modal,
  FlatList,
  TextInput,
  StyleSheet,
  I18nManager,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useCurrency } from "../contexts/CurrencyContext";
import { CURRENCIES } from "../constants/currencies";

export default function CurrencyPicker({ label, compact = false }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { currency, setCurrencyCode } = useCurrency();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!query.trim()) return CURRENCIES;
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return CURRENCIES.filter(
      (c) =>
        c.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        c.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }, [query]);

  const handleSelect = async (code) => {
    await setCurrencyCode(code);
    setOpen(false);
    setQuery("");
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setOpen(true)}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          compact ? styles.pillCompact : styles.pill,
          {
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
            borderColor: theme.colors.border,
            opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {!compact && label ? (
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginRight: 6 }}>
            {label}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}

        <AppText
          weight="bold"
          style={{
            color: theme.colors.orange,
            fontSize: compact ? 13 : undefined,
          }}
        >
          {currency.symbol}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          weight="semibold"
          tone="brand"
          style={{
            marginLeft: 6,
            fontSize: compact ? 12.25 : undefined,
          }}
        >
          {currency.code}
        </AppText>
        <Ionicons
          name="chevron-down"
          size={compact ? 12 : 14}
          color={theme.colors.textDim}
          style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
        />
      </Pressable>

      <Modal
        visible={open}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setOpen(false)}
          style={[styles.backdrop, { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)" }]}
        />
        <View
          style={[
            styles.sheet,
            {
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
              borderTopColor: theme.colors.border,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold">
              {t("common.currency")}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable onPress={() => setOpen(false)} hitSlop={10}>
              <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={theme.colors.text} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          <View
            style={[
              styles.search,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgInput,
                borderColor: theme.colors.border,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="search"
              size={16}
              color={theme.colors.textDim}
              style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
            />
            <TextInput
              value={query}
              onChangeText={setQuery}
              placeholder={t("common.search")}
              placeholderTextColor={theme.colors.textMuted}
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                color: theme.colors.text,
                fontFamily: "DMSans_400Regular",
                fontSize: 15,
                textAlign: I18nManager.isRTL ? "right" : "left",
              }}
              autoCorrect={false}
              autoCapitalize="characters"
            />
          </View>

          <FlatList
            data={filtered}
            keyExtractor={(item) => item.code}
            keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            renderItem={({ item }) => {
              const isActive = item.code === currency.code;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => handleSelect(item.code)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.item,
                    {
                      borderBottomColor: theme.colors.border,
                      backgroundColor: pressed
                        ? theme.colors.bgCard
                        : "transparent",
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22, marginRight: 12 }}>
                    {item.flag}
                  </AppText>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <AppText weight="semibold">{item.code}</AppText>
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      {item.name}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <AppText
                    weight="bold"
                    style={{ color: theme.colors.orange, marginRight: 12 }}
                  >
                    {item.symbol}
                  </AppText>
                  {isActive ? (
                    <Ionicons
                      name="checkmark-circle"
                      size={20}
                      color={theme.colors.orange}
                    />
                  ) : null}
                </Pressable>
              );
            }}
            ListEmptyComponent={
              <AppText tone="muted" align="center" style={{ marginTop: 40 }}>
                No currencies match
              </AppText>
            }
          />
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  // Default pill (wide, with optional label) — used on PostJob etc.
  pill: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 10,
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  // Compact pill — matches .ctaBtn (borderRadius 8, minHeight 40) so it sits

  pillCompact: {

  },
  backdrop: { flex: 1 },

    maxHeight: "75%",
    borderTopLeftRadius: 20,

    paddingTop: 16,

  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: "row",

  search: {
    flexDirection: "row",

  item: {

=== FILE: src/components/DashboardSkeleton.js ===
// src/components/DashboardSkeleton.js
//
// Verbatim port of HirerDashboard.module.css `.skeletonHeader` / `.skeletonCard`
// / `.skeletonPanel` + `@keyframes shimmer`.
//
// Sizes (phone root = 14):
//   skeletonHeader : h 32, w 180, radius 8, mb 18
//   skeletonCard   : h clamp(60px, 10vw, 90px)
//   skeletonPanel  : h clamp(180px, 25vw, 280px)
//   statCard radius: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 12px)
//   panel radius   : clamp(10px, 1.2vw, 14px)
//
// Shimmer: 400px band sweeping horizontally at 1.4s. In RN we simulate this
// with an Animated.View that translates across the container.

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet, Animated, useWindowDimensions } from "react-native";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

function Shimmer({ height, width, radius, style, c }) {
  const anim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const { width: screenW } = useWindowDimensions();

  useEffect(() => {
    const loop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.timing(anim, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 1400,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    );
    loop.start();
    return () => loop.stop();
  }, [anim]);

  const translateX = anim.interpolate({
    inputRange: [0, 1],
    outputRange: [-screenW, screenW],
  });

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.skeletonBase,
        {
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          height,
          width,
          borderRadius: radius,
          overflow: "hidden",
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          styles.shimmerBand,
          {
            transform: [{ translateX }],
            backgroundColor: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)",
          },
        ]}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

export default function DashboardSkeleton() {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  // Responsive breakpoints — mirror the real dashboard.
  const statsRowSingle = width >= 768;
  const gridTwoCol = width >= 900;

  // clamp(60px, 10vw, 90px)
  const cardHeight = Math.min(90, Math.max(60, width * 0.1));
  // clamp(180px, 25vw, 280px)
  const panelHeight = Math.min(280, Math.max(180, width * 0.25));
  // clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 12px)
  const cardRadius = Math.min(12, Math.max(8, width * 0.012));
  // clamp(10px, 1.2vw, 14px)
  const panelRadius = Math.min(14, Math.max(10, width * 0.012));

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {/* skeletonHeader — 32 tall, 180 wide, radius 8, mb 18 */}
      <Shimmer
        c={c}
        height={32}
        width={180}
        radius={8}
        style={{ marginBottom: 18 }}
      />

      {/* Stats grid skeleton — mirrors .statsGrid layout */}
      <View style={styles.statsGrid}>
        {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
          <View
            key={i}
            style={[
              styles.statCell,
              statsRowSingle ? styles.statCellSingleRow : styles.statCellTwoCol,
            ]}
          >
            <Shimmer c={c} height={cardHeight} radius={cardRadius} />
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>

      {/* Panels skeleton — mirrors .grid2 layout */}
      <View style={[styles.grid2, gridTwoCol && styles.grid2TwoCol]}>
        <View style={styles.grid2Cell}>
          <Shimmer c={c} height={panelHeight} radius={panelRadius} />
        </View>
        <View style={styles.grid2Cell}>
          <Shimmer c={c} height={panelHeight} radius={panelRadius} />
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1 },

  skeletonBase: {
    position: "relative",
  },
  shimmerBand: {
    position: "absolute",
    top: 0,
    bottom: 0,
    width: "40%",
  },

  // .statsGrid mirrors (mobile 2 cols, ≥768 4 cols)
  statsGrid: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    flexWrap: "wrap",
    marginBottom: 20,
    marginHorizontal: -6,
  },
  statCellTwoCol: {
    width: "50%",
    paddingHorizontal: 6,
    paddingBottom: 12,
  },
  statCellSingleRow: {
    width: "25%",
    paddingHorizontal: 7,
    paddingBottom: 0,
  },
  statCell: {},

  // .grid2 mirrors
  grid2: { gap: 16 },
  grid2TwoCol: { flexDirection: "row", gap: 18 },
  grid2Cell: { flex: 1, minWidth: 0 },
});

// Structure:
//   · Logo           "Skilled" (white) + "Proz" (orange) + "HIRER PORTAL"
//   · User block     avatar + name + green "● Hirer" chip → Profile

//   OVERVIEW            Dashboard / My Bookings / Post a Job / Jobs Management
//   WORKERS             Saved Workers / Browse Workers / Browse By Categories

//   PAYROLL             Retained Staffs

//   ACCOUNT & SUPPORT   Messages / Live Support Chat / Support Hub /

//   nav badge      0.5625rem =  7.88   ·  weight 800

// ─── Badge fetchers (notifications + messages) ─────────────────────────────
// Support count lives in useSupportStore — it does its own fetching
// because it depends on two endpoints (tickets + chat threads).
async function fetchNotificationCount() {
  try {
    const data = await getNotifications({ limit: 1 });
    return data?.unreadCount ?? 0;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

async function fetchMessageCount() {
  try {
    const { data } = await client.get("/messages/conversations");
    const convos = data?.data?.conversations ?? data?.conversations ?? [];
    return convos.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.unreadCount || 0), 0);
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

// ─── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function DrawerContent({ state }) {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user, logout } = useAuthStore();
  const c = theme.colors;

  // Support badge is a global store value — both Live Support Chat and
  // Support Hub read the same number, matching the website.
  const supportCount = useSupportStore((s) => s.unreadCount);
  const refreshSupport = useSupportStore((s) => s.refresh);

  const activeRouteName = state?.routes?.[state.index]?.name ?? "Dashboard";

  const [notificationCount, setNotificationCount] = useState(0);
  const [messageCount, setMessageCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    const refreshBadges = async () => {
      const [n, m] = await Promise.all([
        fetchNotificationCount(),
        fetchMessageCount(),
      ]);
      if (cancelled) return;
      setNotificationCount(n);
      setMessageCount(m);
    };

    refreshBadges();
    refreshSupport();

    const id = setInterval(() => {
      refreshBadges();
      refreshSupport();
    }, 30000);

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(id);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const goTo = (route) => {
    navigation.navigate(route);
    navigation.closeDrawer?.();
  };

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    try {
      await logout();
      toast.success(t("auth.logoutSuccess") ?? "Signed out.");
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError") ?? "Something went wrong.");
    }
  };

  const badgeFor = (key) => {
    if (key === "notifications") return notificationCount;
    if (key === "messages") return messageCount;
    if (key === "support") return supportCount;
    return 0;
  };

  const initials = `${user?.firstName?.[0] ?? ""}${
    user?.lastName?.[0] ?? ""
  }`.toUpperCase();

  return (
    <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel }]}>
      {/* ─── Logo ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <View style={[styles.logoBlock, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
        <View style={styles.logoTextRow}>
          <AppText style={[styles.logoText, { color: c.text }]}>
            Skilled
          </AppText>
          <AppText style={[styles.logoText, { color: c.orange }]}>Proz</AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText style={[styles.logoRole, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          Hirer Portal
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* ─── User block ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => goTo("Profile")}
        style={[styles.userBlock, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
      >
        <View
          style={[
            styles.userAvatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
          ]}
        >
          {user?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: user.avatar }} style={styles.userAvatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={[styles.userAvatarText, { color: c.orange }]}>
              {initials || "H"}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={styles.userInfo}>
          <AppText
            style={[styles.userName, { color: c.text }]}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {user?.firstName} {user?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <View style={[styles.userBadge, { backgroundColor: c.greenDim }]}>
            <View style={[styles.userBadgeDot, { backgroundColor: c.green }]} />
            <AppText style={[styles.userBadgeText, { color: c.green }]}>
              Hirer
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Pressable>

      {/* ─── Nav (scrollable) ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <ScrollView
        style={styles.navScroll}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.navScrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {NAV.map((group) => (
          <View key={group.group} style={styles.navGroup}>
            <AppText style={[styles.groupLabel, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
              {group.group}
            </AppText>

            {group.items.map((item) => {
              const active = activeRouteName === item.route;
              const count = item.badge ? badgeFor(item.badge) : 0;

              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={item.route}
                  onPress={() => goTo(item.route)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.navItem,
                    active && { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim },
                    pressed &&
                      !active && { backgroundColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" },
                  ]}
                >
                  {active && (
                    <View
                      style={[styles.activeBar, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
                    />
                  )}
                  <Ionicons
                    name={item.icon}
                    size={15}
                    color={active ? c.orange : c.textDim}
                    style={styles.navIcon}
                  />
                  <AppText
                    style={[
                      styles.navLabel,
                      {
                        color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                        fontWeight: active ? "600" : "500",
                      },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </AppText>

                  {count > 0 && (
                    <View
                      style={[styles.navBadge, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
                    >
                      <AppText style={[styles.navBadgeText, { color: c.bg }]}>
                        {count > 99 ? "99+" : count}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  )}
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        ))}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* ─── Footer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <View style={[styles.footer, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleLogout}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.logoutBtn,
            pressed && { backgroundColor: c.redDim },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name={ICON.logout}
            size={15}
            color={c.textMuted}
            style={styles.navIcon}
          />
          <AppText style={[styles.logoutText, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
            Log out
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/EmptyState.js
//
// Generic empty-state used by retained-staff dashboard panels + future screens.
// Matches the web's .emptyPanel / .emptyState rules from
// HirerRetainedStaff.module.css (dashed border variant uses `bordered`).

import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

export default function EmptyState({
  icon = "information-circle-outline",
  iconSize = 32,
  title,
  text,
  bordered = false,
  compact = false,
  children,
  style,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.wrap,
        compact && styles.wrapCompact,
        bordered && {
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
          borderColor: theme.colors.border,
          borderWidth: 1.5,
          borderStyle: "dashed",
          borderRadius: 14,
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <Ionicons name={icon} size={iconSize} color={theme.colors.textMuted} />
      {title ? (
        <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={styles.title}>
          {title}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
      {text ? (
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          tone="dim"
          align="center"
          style={[styles.text, { color: theme.colors.textDim }]}
        >
          {text}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrap: {
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    paddingVertical: 32,
    paddingHorizontal: 24,
    gap: 12,
  },
  wrapCompact: {
    paddingVertical: 24,
  },
  title: {
    fontSize: 18,
    lineHeight: 24,
    textAlign: "center",
    marginTop: 4,
  },
  text: {
    maxWidth: 380,
    marginTop: 2,
  },
});

// src/components/LanguagePicker.jsx
// Drop anywhere in settings screen

import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, FlatList, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { useAppLocale } from '../i18n/useAppLocale';

export default function LanguagePicker() {
  const { currentLocale, changeLocale, locales } = useAppLocale();

  return (
    <FlatList
      data={locales}
      keyExtractor={(item) => item.code}
      renderItem={({ item }) => {
        const active = item.code === currentLocale.code;
        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.item, active && styles.itemActive]}
            onPress={() => changeLocale(item.code)}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.name, active && styles.nameActive]}>
              {item.nativeName}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.sub}>{item.name}</Text>
            {active && <Text style={styles.check}>✓</Text>}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      }}
    />
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  item:       { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', padding: 14, borderBottomWidth: 0.5, borderColor: '#222' },
  itemActive: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(249,115,22,0.1)' },
  name:       { flex: 1, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '600', color: '#fff' },
  nameActive: { color: '#f97316' },
  sub:        { fontSize: 12, color: '#888', marginRight: 8 },
  check:      { color: '#f97316', fontWeight: '800' },
});

// src/components/LoadingScreen.js
//
// Full-screen app launcher. Shown while fonts/i18n/auth hydrate.
// Displays the SkilledProz logo with a soft pulse — no spinner.
//
// The pulse uses Animated so it runs on the native thread, doesn't
// block JS, and looks identical on iOS and Android.

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Animated, Easing, Image, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";

const LOGO = require("../assets/logo.png");

export default function LoadingScreen() {
  const pulse = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
  const glow = useRef(new Animated.Value(0.4)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    const pulseLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(pulse, {
          toValue: 1.06,
          duration: 900,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease),
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(pulse, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: 900,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease),
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]),
    );

    const glowLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(glow, {
          toValue: 0.9,
          duration: 1200,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease),
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(glow, {
          toValue: 0.4,
          duration: 1200,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.ease),
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]),
    );

    pulseLoop.start();
    glowLoop.start();

    return () => {
      pulseLoop.stop();
      glowLoop.stop();
    };
  }, [pulse, glow]);

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {/* Soft glow behind the logo */}
      <Animated.View
        style={[
          styles.glow,
          {
            opacity: glow,
          },
        ]}
      />
      {/* Logo */}
      <Animated.View
        style={{
          transform: [{ scale: pulse }],
        }}
      >
        <Image source={LOGO} style={styles.logo} resizeMode="contain" />
      </Animated.View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    backgroundColor: "#080810",
  },
  glow: {
    position: "absolute",
    width: 200,
    height: 200,
    borderRadius: 100,
    backgroundColor: "#f97316",
    opacity: 0.3,
  },
  logo: {
    width: 120,
    height: 120,
  },
});

=== END: src/components/LoadingScreen.js ===

import React from "react";

function wrapCard(c, children, style) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        {
          backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
          borderColor: c.border,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderRadius: 14,
          padding: 16,
          gap: 10,
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function PageSkeleton({ variant = "list", rows, style }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  switch (variant) {
    case "detail":
      return (
        <View style={[{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }, style]}>
          <DetailSkeleton c={c} />
        </View>
      );
    case "form":
      return (
        <View style={[{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }, style]}>
          <FormSkeleton c={c} />
        </View>
      );
    case "booking-detail":
      return (
        <View style={[{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }, style]}>
          <BookingDetailSkeleton c={c} />
        </View>
      );
    case "list":
    default:
      return (
        <View style={[{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }, style]}>
          <ListSkeleton rows={rows ?? 6} c={c} />
        </View>
      );
  }
}

=== END: src/components/PageSkeleton.js ===

// Verbatim port of HirerDashboard.module.css `.panel` + `.panelHeader` +
// `.panelTitle` + `.panelLink`.

// Website structure:

import React from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { I18nManager } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

export default function Panel({
  title,
  actionLabel,
  onActionPress,
  children,
  style,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const arrow = I18nManager.isRTL ? "arrow-back" : "arrow-forward";

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.panel,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <View style={[styles.header, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
        <AppText style={[styles.title, { color: c.text }]} numberOfLines={1}>
          {title}
        </AppText>
        {onActionPress && actionLabel ? (
          <Pressable onPress={onActionPress} hitSlop={8} style={styles.link}>
            <AppText style={[styles.linkText, { color: c.orange }]}>
              {actionLabel}
            </AppText>
            <Ionicons name={arrow} size={11} color={c.orange} />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      <View>{children}</View>
    </View>
  );
}

  title: {
    fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
    fontSize: 13.13, // 0.9375rem @ 14
    lineHeight: 16, // 1.2
    fontWeight: "700",
  },
  link: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: 4,
  },
  linkText: {
    fontFamily: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
    fontSize: 10.5, // 0.75rem @ 14
    lineHeight: 14,
    fontWeight: "600",
  },
});

// src/components/PostCard.js
// Shared between MyPostsScreen and CommunityFeedScreen.
// Mirrors the website's post card exactly.

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Share,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import {
  reactToPost,
  repost,
  addComment,
  getComments,
  deleteComment,
} from "../api/posts";

// ── Post type config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const POST_TYPES = {
  GENERAL: {
    label: "General",
    emoji: "💬",
    color: "#6b7280",
    bg: "rgba(107,114,128,0.15)",
  },
  ACHIEVEMENT: {
    label: "Achievement",
    emoji: "🏆",
    color: "#f59e0b",
    bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.15)",
  },
  PORTFOLIO: {
    label: "Portfolio",
    emoji: "🎨",
    color: "#6366f1",
    bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.15)",
  },
  HIRING: {
    label: "Hiring",
    emoji: "📢",
    color: "#06b6d4",
    bg: "rgba(6,182,212,0.15)",
  },
  JOB_UPDATE: {
    label: "Job Update",
    emoji: "💼",
    color: "#f97316",
    bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
  },
  ANNOUNCEMENT: {
    label: "Announcement",
    emoji: "📣",
    color: "#ec4899",
    bg: "rgba(236,72,153,0.15)",
  },
};

const REACTIONS = [
  { type: "LIKE", emoji: "👍" },
  { type: "LOVE", emoji: "❤️" },
  { type: "INSIGHTFUL", emoji: "💡" },
  { type: "CELEBRATE", emoji: "🎉" },
  { type: "SUPPORT", emoji: "🤝" },
];

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  const now = new Date();
  const date = new Date(d);
  const diff = (now - date) / 1000;
  if (diff < 60) return "just now";
  if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}m`;
  if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)}h`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short" });
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

// ── Nested original post (for reposts) ────────────────────────────────────────
function OriginalPostPreview({ original, c }) {
  const a = original?.author;
  if (!original) return null;
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        s.originalCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={s.originalAuthorRow}>
        <View style={[s.miniAvatar, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
          {a?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: a.avatar }} style={s.miniAvatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700" }}>
              {initials(a?.firstName, a?.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
          <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
            {a?.firstName} {a?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {fmtDate(original.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
      <AppText
        variant="body"
        numberOfLines={4}
        style={{ marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 22 }}
      >
        {original.content}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Comments sheet (inline expandable) ────────────────────────────────────────
function CommentsSection({
  postId,
  initialComments = [],
  commentCount = 0,
  userId,
  c,
}) {
  const [comments, setComments] = useState(initialComments);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [loadedAll, setLoadedAll] = useState(false);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (loadedAll || loading) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getComments(postId, { page: 1, limit: 20 });
      setComments(data.comments ?? []);
      setLoadedAll(true);
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const comment = await addComment(postId, text.trim());
      setComments((prev) => [comment, ...prev]);
      setText("");
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (commentId) => {
    try {
      await deleteComment(commentId);
      setComments((prev) => prev.filter((c) => c.id !== commentId));
    } catch {}
  };

  return (
    <View style={[s.commentsSection, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
      {/* Input row */}
      <View style={[s.commentInputRow, { borderColor: c.border }]}>
        <TextInput
          value={text}
          onChangeText={setText}
          placeholder="Write a comment…"
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[
            s.commentInput,
            { color: c.text, backgroundColor: c.bgInput },
          ]}
          multiline
          maxLength={500}
        />
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          disabled={!text.trim() || submitting}
          style={[
            s.commentSendBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: text.trim() ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
              opacity: text.trim() ? 1 : 0.5,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {submitting ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 16 }}>➤</AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* Load all button */}
      {!loadedAll && commentCount > initialComments.length && (
        <Pressable onPress={loadMore} style={s.loadMoreBtn}>
          {loading ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.orange} />
          ) : (
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
              View all {commentCount} comments
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      )}

      {/* Comment list */}
      {comments.map((comment) => {
        const ca = comment.author;
        const isOwn = ca?.id === userId;
        return (
          <View
            key={comment.id}
            style={[s.commentItem, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
          >
            <View style={[s.commentAvatar, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}>
              {ca?.avatar ? (
                <Image source={{ uri: ca.avatar }} style={s.commentAvatarImg} />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700" }}
                >
                  {initials(ca?.firstName, ca?.lastName)}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
              <View style={s.commentAuthorRow}>
                <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
                  {ca?.firstName} {ca?.lastName}
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {" "}
                  · {fmtDate(comment.createdAt)}
                </AppText>
                {isOwn && (
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => handleDelete(comment.id)}
                    style={{ marginLeft: "auto" }}
                  >
                    <AppText style={{ color: "#ef4444", fontSize: 12 }}>
                      ✕
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                )}
              </View>
              <AppText variant="body" style={{ lineHeight: 20, marginTop: 2 }}>
                {comment.content}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main PostCard component
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function PostCard({
  post,
  userId, // current user id (to show delete/own-post behaviour)
  c, // theme colors
  onDelete, // () => void
  onPostUpdated, // (updatedPost) => void
  showDelete = true,
}) {
  const [myReaction, setMyReaction] = useState(post.myReaction ?? null);
  const [reactionSum, setReactionSum] = useState(post.reactionSummary ?? {});
  const [showReacts, setShowReacts] = useState(false); // emoji picker
  const [showComments, setShowComments] = useState(false);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [reacting, setReacting] = useState(false);

  const isOwn = post.author?.id === userId;
  const typeMeta = POST_TYPES[post.type] ?? POST_TYPES.GENERAL;
  const author = post.author;
  const totalReactions = Object.values(reactionSum).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const commentCount = post._count?.comments ?? 0;
  const contentLong = post.content?.length > 180;

  const doReact = async (type) => {
    if (reacting) return;
    setReacting(true);
    setShowReacts(false);
    try {
      await reactToPost(post.id, type);
      if (myReaction === type) {
        // toggle off
        setMyReaction(null);
        setReactionSum((prev) => {
          const n = { ...prev };
          n[type] = Math.max(0, (n[type] ?? 1) - 1);
          if (n[type] === 0) delete n[type];
          return n;
        });
      } else {
        // change or add
        setReactionSum((prev) => {
          const n = { ...prev };
          if (myReaction) {
            n[myReaction] = Math.max(0, (n[myReaction] ?? 1) - 1);
            if (n[myReaction] === 0) delete n[myReaction];
          }
          n[type] = (n[type] ?? 0) + 1;
          return n;
        });
        setMyReaction(type);
      }
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setReacting(false);
    }
  };

  const doRepost = async () => {
    try {
      await repost(post.id);
    } catch {}
  };

  const doShare = async () => {
    try {
      await Share.share({
        message: `${post.content ?? ""}\n\nShared from SkilledPro`,
      });
    } catch {}
  };

  return (
    <View
      style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* ── Author row ── */}
      <View style={s.authorRow}>
        {/* Avatar */}
        <View
          style={[
            s.avatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {author?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: author.avatar }} style={s.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
              {initials(author?.firstName, author?.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Name + meta */}
        <View style={s.authorInfo}>
          <View style={s.nameRow}>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
              {author?.firstName} {author?.lastName}
            </AppText>
            {post.type !== "GENERAL" && (
              <View style={[s.typeBadge, { backgroundColor: typeMeta.bg }]}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    color: typeMeta.color,
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                  }}
                >
                  {typeMeta.label}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {author?.hirerProfile?.companyName ||
              author?.workerProfile?.title ||
              ""}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {[author?.city, author?.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
            {author?.city || author?.country ? " · " : ""}
            {fmtDate(post.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Delete button (own posts) */}
        {isOwn && showDelete && onDelete && (
          <Pressable
            onPress={onDelete}
            style={[
              s.deleteBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText style={{ color: "#ef4444", fontSize: 13 }}>🗑️</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444", marginLeft: 4 }}
            >
              Delete
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* ── Reposted indicator ── */}
      {post.repostOf && (
        <View style={s.repostedRow}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>🔄</AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
            Reposted
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Original post (nested) ── */}
      {post.repostOf && <OriginalPostPreview original={post.repostOf} c={c} />}

      {/* ── Content ── */}
      {!!post.content && (
        <View style={s.contentWrap}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ lineHeight: 24 }}
            numberOfLines={expanded || !contentLong ? undefined : 4}
          >
            {post.content}
          </AppText>
          {contentLong && (
            <Pressable onPress={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)}>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 4 }}
              >
                {expanded ? "Show less" : "…see more"}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Images ── */}
      {post.images?.length > 0 && (
        <View style={s.imagesWrap}>
          {post.images.length === 1 ? (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: post.images[0] }}
              style={s.singleImage}
              resizeMode="cover"
            />
          ) : (
            <FlatList
              data={post.images}
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              keyExtractor={(_, i) => String(i)}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6 }}
              renderItem={({ item }) => (
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: item }}
                  style={s.multiImage}
                  resizeMode="cover"
                />
              )}
            />
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Reaction + comment count row ── */}
      {(totalReactions > 0 || commentCount > 0) && (
        <View style={[s.countRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
          {totalReactions > 0 && (
            <View style={s.reactionCountGroup}>
              {Object.entries(reactionSum)
                .filter(([, v]) => v > 0)
                .slice(0, 3)
                .map(([type]) => (
                  <AppText key={type} style={s.reactionEmoji}>
                    {REACTIONS.find((r) => r.type === type)?.emoji ?? "👍"}
                  </AppText>
                ))}
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>
                {totalReactions}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
          {commentCount > 0 && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowComments((v) => !v)}
              style={{ marginLeft: "auto" }}
            >
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {commentCount} comment{commentCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Action bar ── */}
      <View style={[s.actionBar, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        {/* Like — long press shows picker, tap toggles */}
        <Pressable
          style={s.actionBtn}
          onPress={() => doReact("LIKE")}
          onLongPress={() => setShowReacts((v) => !v)}
          delayLongPress={400}
        >
          <AppText style={s.actionIcon}>
            {myReaction
              ? (REACTIONS.find((r) => r.type === myReaction)?.emoji ?? "👍")
              : "👍"}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{
              color: myReaction ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
              marginLeft: 4,
            }}
          >
            Like
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {/* Comment */}
        <Pressable
          style={s.actionBtn}
          onPress={() => setShowComments((v) => !v)}
        >
          <AppText style={s.actionIcon}>💬</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 4 }}
          >
            Comment
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {/* Repost */}
        <Pressable style={s.actionBtn} onPress={doRepost}>
          <AppText style={s.actionIcon}>🔄</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 4 }}
          >
            Repost
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {/* Send */}
        <Pressable style={s.actionBtn} onPress={doShare}>
          <AppText style={s.actionIcon}>✈️</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 4 }}
          >
            Send
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ── Reaction picker (long-press) ── */}
      {showReacts && (
        <View
          style={[
            s.reactPicker,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {REACTIONS.map((r) => (
            <Pressable
              key={r.type}
              onPress={() => doReact(r.type)}
              style={s.reactPickerItem}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 26 }}>{r.emoji}</AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Comments section ── */}
      {showComments && (
        <CommentsSection
          postId={post.id}
          initialComments={post.comments ?? []}
          commentCount={post._count?.comments ?? 0}
          userId={userId}
          c={c}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/components/ReportButton.js
import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";

import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../api/client";
import {
  FaFlag,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaTimes,
} from "../icons/fa";

const REASONS = [
  { value: "SPAM", label: "Spam" },
  { value: "FAKE_PROFILE", label: "Fake profile" },
  { value: "INAPPROPRIATE_CONTENT", label: "Inappropriate content" },
  { value: "FRAUD", label: "Fraud / scam activity" },
  { value: "HARASSMENT", label: "Harassment" },
  { value: "SCAM", label: "Scam" },
  { value: "MISLEADING_INFORMATION", label: "Misleading information" },
  { value: "FAKE_REVIEWS", label: "Fake reviews" },
  { value: "UNDERAGE_USER", label: "Underage user" },
  { value: "HATE_SPEECH", label: "Hate speech" },
  { value: "OTHER", label: "Other" },
];

const TYPE_LABEL = {
  USER: "user",
  JOB_POST: "job post",
  POST: "community post",
  REVIEW: "review",
  BOOKING: "booking",
  MESSAGE: "message",
};

const URL_RE = /^https?:\/\/\S+$/i;

export default function ReportButton({
  targetType,
  targetId,
  targetName,
  variant = "button",
  onSuccess,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  if (!targetType || !targetId) return null;

  const label =
    variant === "icon"
      ? null
      : variant === "link"
        ? `Report this ${TYPE_LABEL[targetType] || "content"}`
        : "Report";

  return (
    <>
      {variant === "icon" ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setOpen(true)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.iconTrigger,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderColor: c.border,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaFlag size={14} color={c.textDim} />
        </Pressable>
      ) : variant === "link" ? (
        <Pressable onPress={() => setOpen(true)}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.textMuted,
              textDecorationLine: "underline",
            }}
          >
            {label}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      ) : (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setOpen(true)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.btnTrigger,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderColor: c.border,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaFlag size={12} color={c.textDim} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: c.textDim,
              marginLeft: 5,
            }}
          >
            Report
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      )}

      <Modal
        visible={open}
        animationType="slide"
        transparent
        onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <ReportModal
          targetType={targetType}
          targetId={targetId}
          targetName={targetName}
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          onSuccess={onSuccess}
          c={c}
        />
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

function ReportModal({
  targetType,
  targetId,
  targetName,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  c,
}) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [evidence, setEvidence] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [done, setDone] = useState(null);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!reason) {
      setError("Please select a reason.");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const evidenceArr = evidence
        .split("\n")
        .map((l) => l.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .filter((l) => URL_RE.test(l))
        .slice(0, 5);

      const res = await client.post("/reports", {
        targetType,
        targetId,
        reason,
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        evidence: evidenceArr,
      });
      setDone({ ref: res.data.data.ref });
      onSuccess?.();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.message || "Failed to submit report.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
      <Pressable style={styles.modalBackdrop} onPress={onClose} />
      <View
        style={[
          styles.modalSheet,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={[styles.modalHeader, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              flex: 1,
              gap: 10,
            }}
          >
            <View
              style={[
                styles.modalHeaderIcon,
                { backgroundColor: c.redDim, borderColor: c.red },
              ]}
            >
              <FaFlag size={15} color={c.red} />
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 9,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.red,
                  textTransform: "uppercase",
                  letterSpacing: 0.8,
                }}
              >
                Report
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.text,
                  marginTop: 2,
                }}
                numberOfLines={2}
              >
                {targetName
                  ? `Report "${targetName}"`
                  : `Report this ${TYPE_LABEL[targetType] || "content"}`}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
          <Pressable
            onPress={onClose}
            hitSlop={6}
            style={[
              styles.closeBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <FaTimes size={13} color={c.textMuted} />
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {done ? (
          <View style={styles.doneState}>
            <FaCheckCircle size={44} color={c.green} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.text,
                marginTop: 14,
              }}
            >
              Report submitted
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                color: c.textDim,
                textAlign: "center",
                marginTop: 8,
                lineHeight: 18,
              }}
            >
              Reference:{" "}
              <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
                {done.ref}
              </AppText>
              {"\n"}
              Our team will review it within 24–48 hours.
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              onPress={onClose}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.doneBtn,
                { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1 },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}>
                Done
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, gap: 16 }}>
            {error ? (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.errorBox,
                  { backgroundColor: c.redDim, borderColor: c.red },
                ]}
              >
                <FaExclamationTriangle size={13} color={c.red} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: c.red,
                    flex: 1,
                    marginLeft: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  {error}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* Reason */}
            <View>
              <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
                Reason <AppText style={{ color: c.red }}>*</AppText>
              </AppText>
              <View style={styles.reasonGrid}>
                {REASONS.map((r) => {
                  const active = reason === r.value;
                  return (
                    <Pressable
                      key={r.value}
                      onPress={() => {
                        setReason(r.value);
                        setError("");
                      }}
                      style={({ pressed }) => [
                        styles.reasonChip,
                        {
                          backgroundColor: active ? c.redDim : c.bgCard,
                          borderColor: active ? c.red : c.border,
                          opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {active ? (
                        <FaCheckCircle size={10} color={c.red} />
                      ) : null}
                      <AppText
                        style={{

                          marginLeft: active ? 4 : 0,
                        }}

                      >
                        {r.label}
                      </AppText>
                    </Pressable>
                  );
                })}
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* Description */}
            <View>
              <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>

                  style={{

                    fontWeight: "400",
                    textTransform: "none",

                  (optional)
                </AppText>
              </AppText>
              <TextInput
                value={description}
                onChangeText={setDescription}
                placeholder="Describe what happened. The more detail you provide, the faster we can act."
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                multiline
                numberOfLines={3}
                maxLength={1000}
                style={[
                  styles.textarea,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    color: c.text,
                  },
                ]}
              />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  color: c.textMuted,
                  textAlign: "right",
                  marginTop: 4,
                }}
              >
                {description.length}/1000
              </AppText>
            </View>

            {/* Evidence */}
            <View>
              <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
                Evidence URLs{" "}
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    color: c.textMuted,
                    fontWeight: "400",
                    textTransform: "none",
                  }}
                >
                  (optional, one per line, max 5)
                </AppText>
              </AppText>
              <TextInput
                value={evidence}
                onChangeText={setEvidence}
                placeholder={
                  "https://example.com/screenshot1.png\nhttps://example.com/screenshot2.png"
                }
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                multiline
                numberOfLines={2}
                style={[
                  styles.textarea,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    color: c.text,
                  },
                ]}
              />
            </View>

            <View
              style={[
                styles.disclaimer,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: c.textMuted,
                  lineHeight: 16,
                }}
              >
                False or malicious reports may result in action against your
                account. Reports are reviewed by our moderation team and are
                confidential.
              </AppText>
            </View>

            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 10, marginTop: 4 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={onClose}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.cancelBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
                ]}

      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
