=== FILE: src/components/RetainedStaff/EditStaffModal.js ===
// src/components/RetainedStaff/EditStaffModal.js
//
// Ported verbatim from src/pages/hirer/retained-staff/EditRetainedStaffModal.jsx
// + AddStaffModal.module.css (which it reuses).
//
// Key detail: rate change detection. If payRate !== member.payRate,
// show the "Rate Change Detected" panel with "applyToPending" checkbox.

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  TextInput,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Modal,
  StyleSheet,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ActivityIndicator,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import * as Location from "expo-location";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { retainedStaffApi } from "../../api/retainedStaff";

const PAY_FREQUENCIES = [
  { value: "WEEKLY", key: "weekly" },
  { value: "BIWEEKLY", key: "biweekly" },
  { value: "SEMI_MONTHLY", key: "semiMonthly" },
  { value: "MONTHLY", key: "monthly" },
  { value: "QUARTERLY", key: "quarterly" },
  { value: "ON_DEMAND", key: "onDemand" },
];
const EMPLOYMENT_TYPES = [
  { value: "FULL_TIME", key: "fullTime" },
  { value: "PART_TIME", key: "partTime" },
  { value: "CONTRACT", key: "contract" },
  { value: "CASUAL", key: "casual" },
];
const LOCATION_TYPES = [
  { value: "ON_SITE", key: "onSite" },
  { value: "REMOTE", key: "remote" },
  { value: "HYBRID", key: "hybrid" },
];
const WORK_DAYS = [
  { value: "MON", key: "mon" },
  { value: "TUE", key: "tue" },
  { value: "WED", key: "wed" },
  { value: "THU", key: "thu" },
  { value: "FRI", key: "fri" },
  { value: "SAT", key: "sat" },
  { value: "SUN", key: "sun" },
];
const CURRENCIES = ["NGN", "USD", "GBP", "EUR", "GHS", "KES", "ZAR"];

export default function EditStaffModal({ isOpen, onClose, onSuccess, member }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const isNarrow = width <= 560;

  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(empty());

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && member) {
      setForm({
        jobTitle: member.jobTitle || "",
        department: member.department || "",
        employmentType: member.employmentType || "FULL_TIME",
        locationType: member.locationType || "ON_SITE",
        location: member.location || "",
        latitude: member.latitude ?? null,
        longitude: member.longitude ?? null,
        description: member.description || "",
        payRate: member.payRate ?? "",
        currency: member.currency || "NGN",
        payFrequency: member.payFrequency || "MONTHLY",
        overtimeRate: member.overtimeRate ?? "",
        workDays: member.workDays || [],
        workStart: member.workStart || "09:00",
        workEnd: member.workEnd || "17:00",
        timezone: member.timezone || "Africa/Lagos",
        employeeNumber: member.employeeNumber || "",
        managerName: member.managerName || "",
        emergencyContact: member.emergencyContact || "",
        notes: member.notes || "",
        applyToPending: false,
        rateChangeReason: "",
      });
      setError("");
      setLocating(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, member]);

  function empty() {
    return {
      jobTitle: "",
      department: "",
      employmentType: "FULL_TIME",
      locationType: "ON_SITE",
      location: "",
      latitude: null,
      longitude: null,
      description: "",
      payRate: "",
      currency: "NGN",
      payFrequency: "MONTHLY",
      overtimeRate: "",
      workDays: [],
      workStart: "09:00",
      workEnd: "17:00",
      timezone: "Africa/Lagos",
      employeeNumber: "",
      managerName: "",
      emergencyContact: "",
      notes: "",
      applyToPending: false,
      rateChangeReason: "",
    };
  }

  const toggleWorkDay = (day) => {
    setForm((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      workDays: prev.workDays.includes(day)
        ? prev.workDays.filter((d) => d !== day)
        : [...prev.workDays, day],
    }));
  };

  const handleAutoLocate = async () => {
    setError("");
    setLocating(true);
    try {
      const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
      if (status !== "granted") {
        setError(t("retainedStaff.locationPermissionDenied"));
        return;
      }
      const pos = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
        accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
      });
      const { latitude, longitude } = pos.coords;
      let address = `${latitude.toFixed(5)}, ${longitude.toFixed(5)}`;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(
          `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=json&lat=${latitude}&lon=${longitude}&zoom=18&addressdetails=1`,
          { headers: { "User-Agent": "SkilledProz/1.0" } },
        );
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data?.display_name) address = data.display_name;
      } catch {}
      setForm((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        location: address,
        latitude,
        longitude,
      }));
    } catch {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.couldNotGetLocation"));
    } finally {
      setLocating(false);
    }
  };

  const rateChanged =
    parseFloat(form.payRate) !== parseFloat(member?.payRate || 0);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError("");
    if (!form.jobTitle.trim()) {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.jobTitleRequired"));
      return;
    }
    if (!form.payRate || parseFloat(form.payRate) <= 0) {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.payRateRequired"));
      return;
    }
    if (
      ["ON_SITE", "HYBRID"].includes(form.locationType) &&
      !form.location.trim()
    ) {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.locationRequired"));
      return;
    }
    if (rateChanged && form.applyToPending && !form.rateChangeReason.trim()) {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.rateChangeReasonRequired"));
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        jobTitle: form.jobTitle.trim(),
        department: form.department.trim() || undefined,
        employmentType: form.employmentType,
        locationType: form.locationType,
        location: form.location.trim() || undefined,
        latitude: form.latitude ?? undefined,
        longitude: form.longitude ?? undefined,
        description: form.description.trim() || undefined,
        payRate: parseFloat(form.payRate),
        currency: form.currency,
        payFrequency: form.payFrequency,
        overtimeRate: form.overtimeRate
          ? parseFloat(form.overtimeRate)
          : undefined,
        workDays: form.workDays,
        workStart: form.workStart,
        workEnd: form.workEnd,
        timezone: form.timezone,
        employeeNumber: form.employeeNumber.trim() || undefined,
        managerName: form.managerName.trim() || undefined,
        emergencyContact: form.emergencyContact.trim() || undefined,
        notes: form.notes.trim() || undefined,
        applyToPending: form.applyToPending,
        rateChangeReason: form.rateChangeReason.trim() || undefined,
      };
      const res = await retainedStaffApi.updateStaff(member.id, payload);
      toast.success(t("retainedStaff.staffUpdated"));
      onSuccess?.(res.data?.data?.member);
      onClose?.();
    } catch (err) {
      const msg =
        err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.staffUpdateFailed");
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const showLocationField = ["ON_SITE", "HYBRID"].includes(form.locationType);
  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={isOpen}
      animationType="slide"
      transparent
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <View style={styles.overlayRoot}>
        <View
          style={[
            StyleSheet.absoluteFill,
            { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)" },
          ]}
        />
        <KeyboardAvoidingView
          behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : undefined}
          style={styles.kav}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.modal,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View style={[styles.header, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: rem(1.25),
                    lineHeight: rem(1.25) * 1.15,
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    color: c.text,
                  }}
                >
                  {t("retainedStaff.editStaffTitle")}
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  numberOfLines={1}
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                    fontSize: rem(0.8),
                    lineHeight: rem(0.8) * 1.35,
                    color: c.textDim,
                    marginTop: 4,
                  }}
                >
                  {member?.worker?.firstName} {member?.worker?.lastName}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <Pressable onPress={onClose} hitSlop={10} style={{ padding: 4 }}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={c.textDim} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {error ? (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.errorBanner,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                    borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.3)",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={16} color={c.red} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    flex: 1,
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.85),
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.red,
                    marginLeft: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  {error}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            <ScrollView
              style={{ flex: 1 }}
              contentContainerStyle={styles.body}
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            >
              <SectionTitle
                text={t("retainedStaff.roleAndPosition")}
                theme={theme}
                rem={rem}
              />
              <View
                style={[styles.formGrid, isNarrow && styles.formGridSingle]}
              >
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.jobTitle")}
                  required
                  value={form.jobTitle}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, jobTitle: v })}
                  placeholder="e.g. Senior Developer"
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.department")}
                  value={form.department}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, department: v })}
                  placeholder="e.g. Engineering"
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <SelectField
                  label={t("retainedStaff.employmentType")}
                  value={form.employmentType}
                  options={EMPLOYMENT_TYPES.map((o) => ({
                    value: o.value,
                    label: t(`retainedStaff.${o.key}`),
                  }))}
                  onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, employmentType: v })}
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <SelectField
                  label={t("retainedStaff.locationType")}
                  value={form.locationType}
                  options={LOCATION_TYPES.map((o) => ({
                    value: o.value,
                    label: t(`retainedStaff.${o.key}`),
                  }))}
                  onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, locationType: v })}
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />

                {showLocationField ? (
                  <View style={{ width: "100%", marginBottom: 8 }}>
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontFamily:
                          theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                        fontSize: rem(0.75),
                        fontWeight: "600",
                        color: c.textDim,
                        textTransform: "uppercase",
                        letterSpacing: 0.05 * rem(0.75),
                        marginBottom: 6,
                      }}
                    >
                      {t("retainedStaff.workLocation")}
                    </AppText>
                    <View
                      style={{
                        flexDirection: "row",
                        gap: 8,
                        alignItems: "stretch",
                      }}
                    >
                      <View style={{ flex: 1, position: "relative" }}>
                        <Ionicons
                          name="location-outline"
                          size={16}
                          color={c.textMuted}
                          style={{
                            position: "absolute",
                            left: 12,
                            top: 14,
                            zIndex: 1,
                          }}
                        />
                        <TextInput
                          value={form.location}
                          onChangeText={(v) =>
                            setForm({
                              ...form,
                              location: v,
                              latitude: null,
                              longitude: null,
                            })
                          }
                          placeholder={t(
                            "retainedStaff.workLocationPlaceholder",
                          )}
                          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                          style={{
                            backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                            borderColor: c.border,
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            borderRadius: 8,
                            paddingHorizontal: 14,
                            paddingVertical: 10,
                            paddingLeft: 36,
                            color: c.text,
                            fontFamily:
                              theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                            fontSize: rem(0.9),
                          }}
                        />
                      </View>
                      <Pressable
                        onPress={handleAutoLocate}
                        disabled={locating}
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                          borderColor: c.orange,
                          borderWidth: 1,
                          opacity: locating ? 0.7 : 1,
                          flexDirection: "row",
                          alignItems: "center",
                          paddingHorizontal: 14,
                          paddingVertical: 10,
                          borderRadius: 8,
                        }}
                      >
                        {locating ? (
                          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.orange} />
                        ) : (
                          <Ionicons
                            name="navigate-outline"
                            size={16}
                            color={c.orange}
                          />
                        )}
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontFamily:
                              theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                            fontSize: rem(0.8),
                            fontWeight: "600",
                            color: c.orange,
                            marginLeft: 6,
                          }}
                        >
                          {locating
                            ? t("retainedStaff.locating")
                            : t("retainedStaff.autoDetect")}
                        </AppText>
                      </Pressable>
                    </View>
                    {form.latitude && form.longitude ? (
                      <View
                        style={{
                          flexDirection: "row",
                          alignItems: "center",
                          gap: 4,
                          marginTop: 8,
                        }}
                      >
                        <Ionicons
                          name="checkmark-circle-outline"
                          size={12}
                          color={c.green}
                        />
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontFamily:
                              theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                            fontSize: rem(0.7),
                            color: c.green,
                          }}
                        >
                          {t("retainedStaff.gpsCaptured", {
                            lat: form.latitude.toFixed(5),
                            lng: form.longitude.toFixed(5),
                          })}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    ) : null}
                  </View>
                ) : null}

                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.employeeNumber")}
                  value={form.employeeNumber}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, employeeNumber: v })}
                  placeholder="EMP-001"
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.roleDescription")}
                  value={form.description}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, description: v })}
                  placeholder={t("retainedStaff.roleDescriptionPlaceholder")}
                  multiline
                  full
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
              </View>

              <SectionTitle
                text={t("retainedStaff.compensation")}
                theme={theme}
                rem={rem}
              />
              <View
                style={[styles.formGrid, isNarrow && styles.formGridSingle]}
              >
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.payRate")}
                  required
                  keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                  value={String(form.payRate)}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, payRate: v })}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <SelectField
                  label={t("retainedStaff.currency")}
                  value={form.currency}
                  options={CURRENCIES.map((cur) => ({
                    value: cur,
                    label: cur,
                  }))}
                  onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, currency: v })}
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <SelectField
                  label={t("retainedStaff.payFrequency")}
                  value={form.payFrequency}
                  options={PAY_FREQUENCIES.map((o) => ({
                    value: o.value,
                    label: t(`retainedStaff.${o.key}`),
                  }))}
                  onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, payFrequency: v })}
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.overtimeRate")}
                  keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                  value={String(form.overtimeRate)}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, overtimeRate: v })}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
              </View>

              {/* Rate change detection */}
              {rateChanged ? (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.rateChangeBox,
                    { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                      fontSize: rem(0.9),
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: c.orange,
                      marginBottom: 6,
                    }}
                  >
                    {t("retainedStaff.rateChangeDetected")}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                      fontSize: rem(0.85),
                      lineHeight: rem(0.85) * 1.5,
                      color: c.textDim,
                      marginBottom: 10,
                    }}
                  >
                    {t("retainedStaff.rateChangeDesc", {
                      oldCurrency: member?.currency,
                      oldRate: member?.payRate?.toLocaleString?.() || "0",
                      newCurrency: form.currency,
                      newRate: parseFloat(form.payRate || 0).toLocaleString(),
                    })}
                  </AppText>

                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() =>
                      setForm({
                        ...form,
                        applyToPending: !form.applyToPending,
                      })
                    }
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      alignItems: "center",
                      gap: 8,
                    }}
                  >
                    <View
                      style={{
                        width: 20,
                        height: 20,
                        borderRadius: 4,
                        borderWidth: 1.5,
                        borderColor: c.orange,
                        backgroundColor: form.applyToPending
                          ? c.orange
                          : "transparent",
                        alignItems: "center",
                        justifyContent: "center",
                      }}
                    >
                      {form.applyToPending ? (
                        <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={14} color="#fff" />
                      ) : null}
                    </View>
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        flex: 1,
                        fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                        fontSize: rem(0.85),
                        color: c.text,
                      }}
                    >
                      {t("retainedStaff.applyToPending")}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>

                  {form.applyToPending ? (
                    <View style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
                      <Field
                        label={t("retainedStaff.rateChangeReason")}
                        required
                        value={form.rateChangeReason}
                        onChangeText={(v) =>
                          setForm({ ...form, rateChangeReason: v })
                        }
                        placeholder={t(
                          "retainedStaff.rateChangeReasonPlaceholder",
                        )}
                        theme={theme}
                        rem={rem}
                      />
                    </View>
                  ) : null}
                </View>
              ) : null}

              <SectionTitle
                text={t("retainedStaff.workingSchedule")}
                theme={theme}
                rem={rem}
              />
              <View style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.75),
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.textDim,
                    textTransform: "uppercase",
                    letterSpacing: 0.05 * rem(0.75),
                    marginBottom: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  {t("retainedStaff.workDays")}
                </AppText>
                <View style={styles.daysRow}>
                  {WORK_DAYS.map((d) => {
                    const active = form.workDays.includes(d.value);
                    return (
                      <Pressable
                        key={d.value}
                        onPress={() => toggleWorkDay(d.value)}
                        style={({ pressed }) => [
                          styles.dayBtn,
                          {
                            backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgInput,
                            borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                            opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                          },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontFamily:
                              theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                            fontSize: rem(0.8),
                            fontWeight: "600",
                            color: active ? "#fff" : c.textDim,
                          }}
                        >
                          {t(`retainedStaff.${d.key}`)}
                        </AppText>
                      </Pressable>
                    );
                  })}
                </View>
              </View>
              <View
                style={[styles.formGrid, isNarrow && styles.formGridSingle]}
              >
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.startTime")}
                  value={form.workStart}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, workStart: v })}
                  placeholder="09:00"
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.endTime")}
                  value={form.workEnd}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, workEnd: v })}
                  placeholder="17:00"
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
              </View>

              <SectionTitle
                text={t("retainedStaff.hrInformation")}
                theme={theme}
                rem={rem}
              />
              <View
                style={[styles.formGrid, isNarrow && styles.formGridSingle]}
              >
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.manager")}
                  value={form.managerName}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, managerName: v })}
                  placeholder={t("retainedStaff.managerPlaceholder")}
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.emergencyContact")}
                  value={form.emergencyContact}
                  onChangeText={(v) =>
                    setForm({ ...form, emergencyContact: v })
                  }
                  placeholder={t("retainedStaff.emergencyContactPlaceholder")}
                  keyboardType="phone-pad"
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <Field
                  label={t("retainedStaff.internalNotes")}
                  value={form.notes}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm({ ...form, notes: v })}
                  placeholder={t("retainedStaff.internalNotesPlaceholder")}
                  multiline
                  full
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
              </View>
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={[styles.footer, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={onClose}
                disabled={submitting}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.cancelBtn,
                  {
                    borderColor: pressed ? c.borderHover : c.border,
                    opacity: submitting ? 0.5 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.85),
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  {t("retainedStaff.cancelBtn")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleSubmit}
                disabled={submitting}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.submitBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: pressed ? c.orangeHover : c.orange,
                    opacity: submitting ? 0.6 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <Ionicons
                    name="checkmark-circle-outline"
                    size={18}
                    color="#fff"
                  />
                )}
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.85),
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: "#fff",
                    marginLeft: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  {submitting
                    ? t("retainedStaff.saving")
                    : t("retainedStaff.saveChanges")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

function SectionTitle({ text, theme, rem }) {
  return (
    <AppText
      style={{
        fontFamily: theme.fonts?.display || "Syne_700Bold",
        fontSize: rem(0.95),
        lineHeight: rem(0.95) * 1.2,
        fontWeight: "700",
        color: theme.colors.orange,
        textTransform: "uppercase",
        letterSpacing: 0.06 * rem(0.95),
        marginTop: rem(1.5),
        marginBottom: rem(0.75),
      }}
    >
      {text}
    </AppText>
  );
}

function Field({
  label,
  required,
  value,
  onChangeText,
  placeholder,
  keyboardType,
  multiline,
  full,
  theme,
  rem,
}) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: full ? "100%" : undefined,
        flex: full ? undefined : 1,
        minWidth: full ? undefined : 140,
        marginBottom: 8,
      }}
    >
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
          fontSize: rem(0.75),
          fontWeight: "600",
          color: theme.colors.textDim,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          letterSpacing: 0.05 * rem(0.75),
          marginBottom: 6,
        }}
      >
        {label}
        {required ? (
          <AppText style={{ color: theme.colors.red }}> *</AppText>
        ) : null}
      </AppText>
      <TextInput
        value={value}
        onChangeText={onChangeText}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        placeholderTextColor={theme.colors.textMuted}
        keyboardType={keyboardType}
        multiline={multiline}
        style={{
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgInput,
          borderColor: theme.colors.border,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderRadius: 8,
          paddingHorizontal: 14,
          paddingVertical: 10,
          color: theme.colors.text,
          fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
          fontSize: rem(0.9),
          minHeight: multiline ? 60 : 42,
          textAlignVertical: multiline ? "top" : "center",
        }}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

function SelectField({ label, value, options, onChange, theme, rem }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const current = options.find((o) => o.value === value);
  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 140, marginBottom: 8 }}>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
          fontSize: rem(0.75),
          fontWeight: "600",
          color: theme.colors.textDim,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          letterSpacing: 0.05 * rem(0.75),
          marginBottom: 6,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setOpen(true)}
        style={{
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgInput,
          borderColor: theme.colors.border,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderRadius: 8,
          paddingHorizontal: 14,
          paddingVertical: 10,
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          minHeight: 42,
        }}
      >
        <AppText
          numberOfLines={1}
          style={{
            fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
            fontSize: rem(0.9),
            color: theme.colors.text,
            flex: 1,
          }}
        >
          {current?.label || "—"}
        </AppText>
        <Ionicons
          name="chevron-down"
          size={16}
          color={theme.colors.textMuted}
        />
      </Pressable>
      <Modal
        visible={open}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setOpen(false)}
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",
            justifyContent: "center",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: 24,
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
              borderRadius: 12,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: theme.colors.border,
              width: "100%",
              maxWidth: 400,
              paddingVertical: 8,
            }}
          >
            {options.map((opt) => (
              <Pressable
                key={opt.value}
                onPress={() => {
                  onChange(opt.value);
                  setOpen(false);
                }}
                style={{
                  paddingHorizontal: 16,
                  paddingVertical: 12,
                  backgroundColor:
                    opt.value === value
                      ? theme.colors.orangeDim
                      : "transparent",
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily:
                      opt.value === value
                        ? theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold
                        : theme.fonts?.body,
                    fontSize: rem(0.9),
                    fontWeight: opt.value === value ? "600" : "400",
                    color:
                      opt.value === value
                        ? theme.colors.orange
                        : theme.colors.text,
                  }}
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/RetainedStaff/FilterTabs.js
//
// Ported from .filterTabs / .filterTab / .filterTabActive
// in HirerRetainedStaff.module.css.
// Horizontally scrollable on mobile (mirrors the ≤640px CSS rule).

import React from "react";
import {
  ScrollView,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

export default function FilterTabs({ options, value, onChange }) {
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const isCompact = width <= 640;

  const fs = (isCompact ? 0.7 : 0.78) * 16 * fontScale;
  const padV = isCompact ? 0.3 * 16 : 0.4 * 16;
  const padH = isCompact ? 0.65 * 16 : 0.875 * 16;

  return (
    <ScrollView
      horizontal
      showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.row}
    >
      {options.map((opt) => {
        const active = opt === value;
        return (
          <Pressable
            key={opt}
            onPress={() => onChange(opt)}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.tab,
              {
                backgroundColor: active
                  ? theme.colors.orangeDim
                  : theme.colors.bgCard,
                borderColor: active ? theme.colors.orange : theme.colors.border,
                paddingVertical: padV,
                paddingHorizontal: padH,
                borderRadius: 999,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                fontSize: fs,
                lineHeight: fs * 1.3,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: active ? theme.colors.orange : theme.colors.textDim,
              }}
            >
              {opt}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        );
      })}
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    gap: 6,
    paddingBottom: 4,
  },
  tab: {
    borderWidth: 1,
    flexShrink: 0,
  },
});

=== FILE: src/components/RetainedStaff/PayCycleModal.js ===
// src/components/RetainedStaff/PayCycleModal.js
//
// Ported verbatim from src/pages/hirer/retained-staff/PayCycleModal.jsx
// + HirerCycleDetail.module.css (modal section).
//
// Two providers: card (redirects to booking pay flow) and wallet
// (deducts from balance + shows success modal).

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Modal,
  StyleSheet,
  ActivityIndicator,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { retainedStaffApi } from "../../api/retainedStaff";
import client from "../../api/client";
import PaymentSuccessModal from "./PaymentSuccessModal";

export default function PayCycleModal({ isOpen, onClose, cycle, member }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const isNarrow = width < 420;

  const [provider, setProvider] = useState("card");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [walletBalance, setWalletBalance] = useState(null);
  const [loadingWallet, setLoadingWallet] = useState(false);
  const [showSuccess, setShowSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [paidCycleId, setPaidCycleId] = useState(null);

  const currency = cycle?.currency || member?.currency || "NGN";
  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    setLoadingWallet(true);
    client
      .get("/wallet/balance", { params: { currency } })
      .then((res) => setWalletBalance(res.data?.data?.balance ?? 0))
      .catch(() => setWalletBalance(0))
      .finally(() => setLoadingWallet(false));
  }, [isOpen, currency]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const totalToPay = cycle?.netAmount || 0;
  const hasEnoughBalance =
    walletBalance !== null && walletBalance >= totalToPay;

  const PROVIDERS = [
    {
      key: "card",
      label: t("retainedStaff.payCardLabel"),
      desc: t("retainedStaff.payCardDesc"),
      icon: "card-outline",
      disabled: false,
    },
    {
      key: "wallet",
      label: t("retainedStaff.payWalletLabel"),
      desc: loadingWallet
        ? t("retainedStaff.loadingBalance")
        : walletBalance === null
          ? t("retainedStaff.walletUnavailable")
          : hasEnoughBalance
            ? t("retainedStaff.walletAvailable", {
                currency,
                amount: walletBalance.toLocaleString(),
              })
            : t("retainedStaff.walletInsufficient", {
                currency,
                amount: walletBalance?.toLocaleString() || 0,
              }),
      icon: "cash-outline",
      disabled: !hasEnoughBalance && !loadingWallet,
    },
  ];

  const handlePay = async () => {
    setError("");
    if (provider === "wallet" && !hasEnoughBalance) {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.walletInsufficientError", { currency }));
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const payRes = await retainedStaffApi.payCycle(member.id, cycle.id, {
        paymentMethod: "ESCROW",
        provider,
      });
      const bookingId = payRes.data?.data?.booking?.id;
      const returnedCycleId = payRes.data?.data?.cycleId;

      if (provider === "wallet") {
        await client.post(`/payments/wallet/${bookingId}`);
        setPaidCycleId(returnedCycleId);
        setShowSuccess(true);
      } else {
        onClose?.();
        navigation.navigate("PaymentScreen", {
          bookingId,
          method: provider,
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const msg =
        err?.response?.data?.message ||
        err?.message ||
        t("retainedStaff.payFailed");
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (showSuccess) {
    return (
      <PaymentSuccessModal
        isOpen={showSuccess}
        onClose={() => {
          setShowSuccess(false);
          onClose?.();
        }}
        onViewCycle={() => {
          setShowSuccess(false);
          onClose?.();
          navigation.navigate("RetainedStaffCycleDetail", {
            id: member.id,
            cycleId: paidCycleId,
            payment: "success",
          });
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={isOpen}
      animationType="slide"
      transparent
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <View style={styles.overlayRoot}>
        <View
          style={[
            StyleSheet.absoluteFill,
            { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)" },
          ]}
        />
        <View style={styles.kav}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.modal,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View style={[styles.header, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: rem(1.25),
                    lineHeight: rem(1.25) * 1.15,
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    color: c.text,
                  }}
                >
                  {t("retainedStaff.payCycleTitle")}
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  numberOfLines={2}
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                    fontSize: rem(0.8),
                    lineHeight: rem(0.8) * 1.35,
                    color: c.textDim,
                    marginTop: 4,
                  }}
                >
                  {cycle?.label || "—"} · {member?.worker?.firstName}{" "}
                  {member?.worker?.lastName}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <Pressable onPress={onClose} hitSlop={10} style={{ padding: 4 }}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={c.textDim} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {error ? (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.errorBanner,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                    borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.3)",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={16} color={c.red} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    flex: 1,
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.85),
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.red,
                    marginLeft: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  {error}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            <ScrollView style={{ flex: 1 }} contentContainerStyle={styles.body}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.paySummary,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <SummaryRow
                  label={t("retainedStaff.baseAmountShort")}
                  value={`${currency} ${(cycle?.baseAmount || 0).toLocaleString()}`}
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                {cycle?.bonusAmount > 0 ? (
                  <SummaryRow
                    label={t("retainedStaff.bonusShort")}
                    value={`+ ${currency} ${cycle.bonusAmount.toLocaleString()}`}
                    theme={theme}
                    rem={rem}
                  />
                ) : null}
                {cycle?.deductionAmount > 0 ? (
                  <SummaryRow
                    label={t("retainedStaff.deductionsShort")}
                    value={`− ${currency} ${cycle.deductionAmount.toLocaleString()}`}
                    theme={theme}
                    rem={rem}
                  />
                ) : null}
                <SummaryRow
                  label={t("retainedStaff.platformFee")}
                  value={`− ${currency} ${(cycle?.platformFee || 0).toLocaleString()}`}
                  theme={theme}
                  rem={rem}
                />
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.paySummaryTotalRow,
                    { borderTopColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontFamily: theme.fonts?.display || "Syne_700Bold",
                      fontSize: rem(1.1),
                      fontWeight: "800",
                      color: c.text,
                    }}
                  >
                    {t("retainedStaff.totalToPay")}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontFamily:
                        theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                      fontSize: rem(1.1),
                      fontWeight: "800",
                      color: c.orange,
                    }}
                  >
                    {currency} {(cycle?.netAmount || 0).toLocaleString()}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>

              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: theme.fonts?.display || "Syne_700Bold",
                  fontSize: rem(0.85),
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.textDim,
                  textTransform: "uppercase",
                  letterSpacing: 0.06 * rem(0.85),
                  marginTop: 8,
                  marginBottom: 12,
                }}
              >
                {t("retainedStaff.choosePaymentMethod")}
              </AppText>

              <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                {PROVIDERS.map((p) => {
                  const isSelected = provider === p.key;
                  return (
                    <Pressable
                      key={p.key}
                      disabled={p.disabled || loadingWallet}
                      onPress={() => setProvider(p.key)}
                      style={({ pressed }) => [
                        styles.providerCard,
                        {
                          borderColor: isSelected ? c.orange : c.border,
                          backgroundColor: isSelected ? c.orangeDim : c.bgInput,
                          opacity: p.disabled ? 0.6 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.providerIcon,
                          {
                            backgroundColor: isSelected ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                          },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <Ionicons
                          name={p.icon}
                          size={20}
                          color={isSelected ? "#fff" : c.textDim}
                        />
                      </View>
                      <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontFamily:
                              theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                            fontSize: rem(0.9),
                            fontWeight: "700",
                            color: c.text,
                          }}
                        >
                          {p.label}
                        </AppText>
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontFamily:
                              theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                            fontSize: rem(0.75),
                            lineHeight: rem(0.75) * 1.4,
                            color:
                              p.key === "wallet" &&
                              !hasEnoughBalance &&
                              !loadingWallet
                                ? c.red
                                : c.textDim,
                            marginTop: 2,
                          }}
                        >
                          {p.desc}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.radio,
                          {
                            borderColor: isSelected ? c.orange : c.border,
                            backgroundColor: isSelected
                              ? c.orange
                              : "transparent",
                          },

                        {isSelected ? (
                          <Ionicons
                            name="checkmark-circle"
                            size={16}
                            color="#fff"
                          />
                        ) : null}
                      </View>
                    </Pressable>
                  );
                })}
              </View>
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={[styles.footer, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={onClose}
                disabled={loading}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.cancelBtn,
                  {
                    borderColor: pressed ? c.borderHover : c.border,
                    opacity: loading ? 0.5 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.85),
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  {t("retainedStaff.cancelBtn")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handlePay}
                disabled={
                  loading ||
                  (provider === "wallet" && !hasEnoughBalance) ||
                  loadingWallet
                }
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.payBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: pressed ? c.orangeHover : c.orange,
                    opacity:
                      loading ||
                      (provider === "wallet" && !hasEnoughBalance) ||
                      loadingWallet
                        ? 0.6
                        : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {loading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <Ionicons name="card-outline" size={18} color="#fff" />

                  style={{

                    fontSize: rem(0.85),
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: "#fff",
                    marginLeft: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  {loading
                    ? t("retainedStaff.processing")
                    : t("retainedStaff.continueToPayment")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// src/components/RetainedStaff/StatCard.js

// Ported from .statCard / .statIcon / .statLabel / .statValue
// in HirerRetainedStaff.module.css.
//
// Icons (web FiUsers / FiDollarSign / FiClock / FiCheckCircle) are
// passed in as Ionicons names by the parent screen.
//
// Renders the top gradient bar (::before pseudo) as a real <View>.

import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet, useWindowDimensions } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

const ACCENT = {
  default: (t) => ({ bg: t.colors.bgCard, fg: t.colors.textDim }),
  orange: (t) => ({ bg: t.colors.orangeDim, fg: t.colors.orange }),
  green: (t) => ({ bg: t.colors.greenDim, fg: t.colors.green }),
  yellow: () => ({ bg: "rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15)", fg: "#fbbf24" }),
};

export default function StatCard({ icon, label, value, accent = "default" }) {
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const palette = (ACCENT[accent] || ACCENT.default)(theme);

  // rem → px (Option B): px = rem × 16 × fontScale
  const isCompact = width <= 640;
  const statIconSize = isCompact ? 36 : 42;
  const statIconInner = isCompact ? 16 : 20;

  const labelFs = isCompact ? 0.6 * 16 * fontScale : 0.65 * 16 * fontScale;
  const labelLs = (isCompact ? 0.08 : 0.1) * labelFs;

  const valueRaw = Math.min(1.5 * 16, Math.max(1.125 * 16, width * 0.035));
  const valueFs = (isCompact ? 1.05 * 16 : valueRaw) * fontScale;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.card,
        {
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
          borderColor: theme.colors.border,
          paddingVertical: isCompact ? 14 : 18,
          paddingHorizontal: isCompact ? 10 : 16,
          borderRadius: isCompact ? 12 : 14,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Top gradient bar (::before) */}
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          styles.topBar,
          {
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.orange,
            opacity: 0.5,
          },
        ]}
      />

      <View style={styles.row}>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.iconWrap,
            {
              backgroundColor: palette.bg,
              width: statIconSize,
              height: statIconSize,
              borderRadius: 10,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons name={icon} size={statIconInner} color={palette.fg} />
        </View>
        <View style={styles.info}>
          <AppText
            numberOfLines={1}
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
              fontSize: labelFs,
              lineHeight: labelFs * 1.3,
              letterSpacing: labelLs,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              color: theme.colors.textMuted,
              fontWeight: "700",
            }}
          >
            {label}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            numberOfLines={1}
            adjustsFontSizeToFit
            minimumFontScale={0.7}
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: valueFs,
              lineHeight: valueFs * 1.1,
              letterSpacing: -0.03 * valueFs,
              color: theme.colors.text,
              fontWeight: "800",
              marginTop: 2,
            }}
          >
            {value}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    borderWidth: 1,
    overflow: "hidden",
    minHeight: 82,
  },
  topBar: {
    position: "absolute",
    top: 0,
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    height: 2,
  },
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: 14,
  },
  iconWrap: {
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    flexShrink: 0,
  },

    minWidth: 0,
  },

// src/components/RetainedStaff/UpcomingItem.js
//
// Ported from .upcomingItem / .upcomingAvatar / .upcomingInfo /
// .upcomingMeta / .upcomingName / .upcomingRole / .upcomingAmount /
// .upcomingDate in HirerRetainedStaff.module.css.
//
// Avatar resolution: tries every common field name from the backend.
// Debug logging kept in place — remove console.log lines once avatar
// field is confirmed.

import React from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  Image,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";

// ─── Avatar URL resolver ──────────────────────────────────────
// Handles absolute URLs, relative paths, and missing values.
const API_BASE = client?.defaults?.baseURL || "https://api.skilledproz.com";

function resolveAvatar(raw) {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "string") return null;
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  // Already absolute
  if (trimmed.startsWith("http://") || trimmed.startsWith("https://")) {
    return trimmed;
  }
  // Relative — prefix with API base
  return `${API_BASE}${trimmed.startsWith("/") ? "" : "/"}${trimmed}`;
}

// Try every likely field name for the worker's avatar.
function pickAvatar(cycle) {
  if (!cycle) return null;
  return (
    cycle.workerAvatar ||
    cycle.avatar ||
    cycle.avatarUrl ||
    cycle.profileImage ||
    cycle.profilePicture ||
    cycle.photoURL ||
    cycle.worker?.avatar ||
    cycle.worker?.avatarUrl ||
    cycle.worker?.profileImage ||
    cycle.workerProfile?.avatar ||
    cycle.workerProfile?.avatarUrl ||
    cycle.workerProfile?.profileImage ||
    cycle.member?.avatar ||
    cycle.member?.avatarUrl ||
    null
  );
}

// ─── Money / Date formatting ──────────────────────────────────
function formatMoney(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  if (amount == null) return "—";
  try {
    return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    })}`;
  } catch {
    return `${currency} ${amount}`;
  }
}

function formatDate(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return "—";
  try {
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
      day: "numeric",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
    });
  } catch {
    return "—";
  }
}

// ─── Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function UpcomingItem({ cycle, onPress }) {
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const isCompact = width <= 480;

  // rem → px (Option B): px = rem × 16 × fontScale
  const nameFs = 0.875 * 16 * fontScale;
  const roleFs = 0.72 * 16 * fontScale;
  const amountFs = 0.9 * 16 * fontScale;
  const dateFs = 0.7 * 16 * fontScale;

  const initial = (cycle?.workerName || "?")[0]?.toUpperCase?.() || "?";
  const rawAvatar = pickAvatar(cycle);
  const avatarUri = resolveAvatar(rawAvatar);

  // ─── DEBUG (remove these 2 lines once avatar field is confirmed) ───
  console.log("[UpcomingItem] cycle keys:", Object.keys(cycle || {}));
  console.log("[UpcomingItem] full cycle:", JSON.stringify(cycle));
  console.log("[UpcomingItem] picked avatar:", rawAvatar, "→", avatarUri);
  // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.item,
        {
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgCard,
          borderColor: pressed ? theme.colors.orange : theme.colors.border,
          borderWidth: 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Avatar — image if available, initial fallback */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.avatar,
          {
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.orangeDim,
            borderRadius: 999,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {avatarUri ? (
          <Image
            source={{ uri: avatarUri }}
            style={styles.avatarImg}
            resizeMode="cover"
            onError={(e) =>
              console.log(
                "[UpcomingItem] image load error:",
                avatarUri,
                e?.nativeEvent?.error,
              )
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
              fontSize: 0.85 * 16 * fontScale,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: theme.colors.orange,
            }}
          >
            {initial}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Info */}
      <View style={styles.info}>
        <AppText
          numberOfLines={1}
          style={{
            fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
            fontSize: nameFs,
            lineHeight: nameFs * 1.3,
            fontWeight: "700",
            color: theme.colors.text,
          }}
        >
          {cycle?.workerName || "—"}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          numberOfLines={1}
          style={{
            fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
            fontSize: roleFs,
            lineHeight: roleFs * 1.3,
            color: theme.colors.textDim,
            marginTop: 1,
          }}
        >
          {cycle?.jobTitle || "—"}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Meta */}
      <View style={[styles.meta, isCompact && styles.metaStacked]}>
        <AppText
          numberOfLines={1}
          style={{
            fontFamily: theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
            fontSize: amountFs,
            lineHeight: amountFs * 1.2,
            fontWeight: "800",
            color: theme.colors.orange,
            textAlign: isCompact ? "left" : "right",
          }}
        >
          {formatMoney(cycle?.amount, cycle?.currency)}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          numberOfLines={1}
          style={{
            fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
            fontSize: dateFs,

=== FILE: src/components/Skeleton.js ===
// src/components/Skeleton.js
//
// Shared skeleton primitive for the whole app.
// Mirrors the web's Refund.module.css shimmer treatment:
//   - 1.4s shimmer sweep, 400px gradient across
//   - pulsing opacity fallback for very small screens
//
// Usage:
//   <Skeleton width={120} height={14} radius={6} />
//   <Skeleton width={40} height={40} radius={20} />  // circle
//   <Skeleton.Block style={{ height: 80 }} />
//
// Or use the higher-order helpers to lay out a whole skeleton screen.

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Animated, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

// ── Base skeleton block ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function Skeleton({
  width = "100%",
  height = 14,
  radius = 6,
  style,
  animated = true,
}) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const shimmer = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const opacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!animated) return;

    // Two parallel animations: a shimmer sweep across the bar, and a
    // gentle opacity pulse so small blocks (like 40x40 circles) still
    // read as "loading" even when the shimmer isn't visible.
    const shimmerLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.timing(shimmer, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 1400,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    );
    const pulseLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(opacity, {
          toValue: 0.5,
          duration: 700,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(opacity, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: 700,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]),
    );

    shimmerLoop.start();
    pulseLoop.start();

    return () => {
      shimmerLoop.stop();
      pulseLoop.stop();
    };
  }, [animated]);

  // Interpolate shimmer from -1 → 1 so it can translate across
  const shimmerTranslate = shimmer.interpolate({
    inputRange: [0, 1],
    outputRange: [-200, 200],
  });

  const isCircle = radius >= height / 2 && width === height;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        {
          width,
          height,
          borderRadius: isCircle ? height / 2 : radius,
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          overflow: "hidden",
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      {animated && (
        <>
          <Animated.View
            pointerEvents="none"
            style={[
              StyleSheet.absoluteFill,
              {
                opacity,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              },
            ]}
          />
          <Animated.View
            pointerEvents="none"
            style={[
              StyleSheet.absoluteFill,
              {
                transform: [{ translateX: shimmerTranslate }],
              },
            ]}
          >
            <View
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                width: 200,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                opacity: 0.8,
              }}
            />
          </Animated.View>
          {/* Lighter sweep overlay */}
          <Animated.View
            pointerEvents="none"
            style={[
              StyleSheet.absoluteFill,
              {
                transform: [{ translateX: shimmerTranslate }],
                backgroundColor:
                  th.mode === "dark"
                    ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)"
                    : "rgba(0,0,0,0.04)",
                width: 120,
              },
            ]}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Common pre-shaped skeletons ───────────────────────────────────────────
Skeleton.Line = function Line({ width = "100%", height = 12, style }) {
  return <Skeleton width={width} height={height} radius={4} style={style} />;
};

Skeleton.Circle = function Circle({ size = 40, style }) {
  return (
    <Skeleton width={size} height={size} radius={size / 2} style={style} />
  );
};

Skeleton.Card = function Card({ height = 80, style }) {
  return <Skeleton width="100%" height={height} radius={14} style={style} />;
};

// ── Row helper: avatar + two lines ────────────────────────────────────────
Skeleton.ListRow = function ListRow({ style }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        {
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          padding: 14,
          borderRadius: 12,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
          backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
          gap: 12,
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <Skeleton.Circle size={40} />
      <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 8 }}>
        <Skeleton.Line width="70%" height={14} />
        <Skeleton.Line width="40%" height={11} />
      </View>
      <Skeleton.Line width={60} height={20} />
    </View>
  );
};

// src/components/Skeleton/RetainedStaffSkeleton.js
//
// Mirrors the loading block in HirerRetainedStaffDashboard.jsx:
//   header (3 lines) + right button + 4 KPI cards + 1 card (200h) + table (4 rows, 3 cols)
// Uses the app's existing <Skeleton /> primitive (from src/components/Skeleton.js)
// for shimmer — DO NOT rebuild the shimmer here.

import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet, useWindowDimensions } from "react-native";
import Skeleton from "../Skeleton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

export default function RetainedStaffSkeleton() {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const isWide = width >= 768;
  const isXWide = width >= 900;

  // KPI grid: 2 cols on mobile, 4 cols on >=768 (mirrors CSS)
  const kpiCols = isWide ? 4 : 2;
  const kpiGap = 12;
  const kpiWidthPct = kpiCols === 4 ? "23%" : "48%";

  // Two-column panels on >=900 (mirrors .twoCol media query)
  const panelWidthPct = isXWide ? "48%" : "100%";

  return (
    <View style={styles.page}>
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={[styles.header, isWide && styles.headerRow]}>
        <View style={styles.headerLeft}>
          <Skeleton width={140} height={12} style={{ marginBottom: 8 }} />
          <Skeleton width={200} height={26} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }} />
          <Skeleton width={160} height={14} />
        </View>
        <Skeleton
          width={160}
          height={40}
          radius={8}
          style={{ marginTop: isWide ? 0 : 12 }}
        />
      </View>

      {/* KPI grid */}
      <View style={styles.kpiGrid}>
        {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
          <View
            key={i}
            style={[
              styles.kpiCell,
              { width: kpiWidthPct, marginBottom: kpiGap },
            ]}
          >
            <Skeleton width="100%" height={82} radius={14} />
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>

      {/* Two-column panels */}
      <View style={[styles.twoCol, isXWide && styles.twoColRow]}>
        <View style={{ width: panelWidthPct, marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <Skeleton width="100%" height={200} radius={12} />
        </View>
        <View style={{ width: panelWidthPct }}>
          <Skeleton width="100%" height={200} radius={12} />
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Table skeleton */}
      <View style={styles.tableBlock}>
        {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
          <View key={i} style={styles.tableRow}>
            <Skeleton width="40%" height={14} />
            <Skeleton width="25%" height={14} />
            <Skeleton width="20%" height={14} />
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

//   .statCard {
//     background: var(--bg-card);
//     border: 1px solid var(--border);
//     border-radius: clamp(8px,1.2vw,12px);  → 12
//     padding: clamp(8px,1.5vw,16px);        → 16
//     position: relative; overflow: hidden;
//     min-width: 0;
//   }
//   .statCard::before { radial-gradient overlay — decorative, skip on RN }
//   .statCard_orange { border-color: rgba(249,115,22,0.2);
//                      background: var(--orange-dim); }
//   .statCard_orange .statValue { color: var(--orange); }
//   .statCard_green  { border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.15);
//                      background: var(--green-dim); }
//   .statCard_green  .statValue { color: var(--green); }
//   .statIcon {
//     font-size: clamp(16px,2.2vw,24px);     → 24
//     display: block;

import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

export default function StatCard({ icon, label, value, accent, footer }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const isOrange = accent === "orange";
  const isGreen = accent === "green";

  const backgroundColor = isOrange
    ? c.orangeDim // rgba(249,115,22,0.12) dark / 0.08 light — matches var(--orange-dim) per theme
    : isGreen
      ? c.greenDim // rgba(34,197,94,0.10) dark / 0.08 light — matches var(--green-dim)
      : c.bgCard; // rgba(255,255,255,0.03) dark / rgba(0,0,0,0.02) light

  const borderColor = isOrange
    ? "rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.20)"
    : isGreen
      ? "rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)"
      : c.border;

  const valueColor = isOrange ? "#f97316" : isGreen ? "#22c55e" : c.text;

  return (
    <View style={[styles.card, { backgroundColor, borderColor }]}>
      <AppText style={styles.icon}>{icon}</AppText>

      {typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number" ? (
        <AppText
          numberOfLines={1}
          adjustsFontSizeToFit
          minimumFontScale={0.5}
          style={[styles.value, { color: valueColor }]}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
      ) : (
        value
      )}

      <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]} numberOfLines={1}>
        {label}
      </AppText>

      {footer ? (
        <AppText
          style={[styles.footer, { color: c.textMuted }]}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {footer}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: 12,
    padding: 16,
    minWidth: 0,
    overflow: "hidden",
  },
  icon: {
    fontSize: 24,
    lineHeight: 24, // line-height: 1 (website)
    marginBottom: 6,
  },
  value: {
    fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
    fontSize: 28,
    lineHeight: 34, // 1.2 × 28
    fontWeight: "700",
    letterSpacing: -0.5,
    marginBottom: 2,
  },
  label: {
    fontFamily: "DMSans_500Medium",
    fontSize: 12,
    lineHeight: 16,
    fontWeight: "500",
  },
  footer: {
    fontFamily: "DMSans_500Medium",
    fontSize: 9.1, // 0.65rem @ 14px
    lineHeight: 12.3, // 1.35
    marginTop: 4,
    fontWeight: "500",
  },
});
