export default function TopBar({
  title: titleProp,
  subtitle: subtitleProp,
  showBack,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const [unread, setUnread] = useState(0);

  const routeName = useNavigationState(
    (state) => state?.routes?.[state.index]?.name,
  );
  const fallback = SCREEN_FALLBACK[routeName] ?? {};
  const title = titleProp ?? fallback.title ?? prettyTitle(routeName);
  const resolvedSub = subtitleProp ?? fallback.subtitle ?? null;

  // ── Role-aware notification polling — 30s ────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    let timer;
    const fetchUnread = async () => {
      try {
        let count = 0;
        if (user?.role === "WORKER") {
          const res = await client.get("/workers/dashboard/notifications", {
            params: { limit: 1, page: 1 },
          });
          count = res.data.data?.unreadCount ?? 0;
        } else {
          const data = await hirerApi.getNotifications();
          count = data?.unread ?? 0;
        }
        if (!cancelled) setUnread(count);
      } catch {}
    };
    fetchUnread();
    timer = setInterval(fetchUnread, 30_000);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [user?.role]);

  // ── Left button ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleLeft = () => {
    if (showBack) {
      if (navigation.canGoBack()) navigation.goBack();
      else openDrawer();
    } else {
      openDrawer();
    }
  };

  const openNotifications = () => {
    try {
      navigation.navigate("Notifications");
    } catch {
      globalNavigate("Notifications");
    }
  };

  const openMessages = () => {
    try {
      navigation.navigate("Messages");
    } catch {
      globalNavigate("Messages");
    }
  };

  const openProfile = () => {
    const target = user?.role === "WORKER" ? "WorkerProfile" : "Profile";
    try {
      navigation.navigate(target);
    } catch {
      globalNavigate(target);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.wrap,
        {
          paddingTop: insets.top,
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bg,
          borderBottomColor: theme.colors.border,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={styles.row}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleLeft}
          hitSlop={10}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.iconBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
              borderColor: theme.colors.border,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name={showBack ? "arrow-back" : "menu"}
            size={18}
            color={theme.colors.text}
          />
        </Pressable>

        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 2 }}>
          <AppText
            weight="bold"
            numberOfLines={1}
            style={{ fontSize: 15, color: theme.colors.text }}
          >
            {title}
          </AppText>
          {resolvedSub ? (
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{ fontSize: 11, color: theme.colors.textDim }}
            >
              {resolvedSub}
            </AppText>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        <View style={styles.rightCluster}>
          {/* Messages icon */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={openMessages}
            hitSlop={6}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.iconBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
                borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaCommentDots size={18} color={theme.colors.text} />
          </Pressable>

          {/* Notifications bell */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={openNotifications}
            hitSlop={6}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.iconBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
                borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="notifications-outline"
              size={18}
              color={theme.colors.text}
            />
            {unread > 0 && (
              <View
                style={[styles.badge, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.orange }]}
              >
                <AppText
                  weight="bold"
                  style={{ color: "#0f0f1a", fontSize: 9, lineHeight: 10 }}
                >
                  {unread > 9 ? "9+" : String(unread)}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </Pressable>

          {/* Avatar */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={openProfile}
            hitSlop={6}
            style={({ pressed }) => [{ opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1 }]}
          >
            <Avatar
              uri={user?.avatar}
              firstName={user?.firstName}
              lastName={user?.lastName}
              size={34}
            />
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function prettyTitle(route) {
  if (!route) return "";
  return route.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").trim();
}

// src/components/VideoPlayerModal.js
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import { useVideoPlayer, VideoView } from "expo-video";

import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { FaTimes, FaPlay } from "../icons/fa";

export default function VideoPlayerModal({
  visible,
  videoUrl,
  title,
  onClose,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const { width, height } = useWindowDimensions();

  // Initialize paused
  const player = useVideoPlayer(videoUrl, (p) => {
    p.loop = false;
    p.pause();
  });
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);

  // Reset to paused every time the modal is opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) {
      try {
        player.currentTime = 0;
        player.pause();
      } catch {}
      setPlaying(false);
    } else {
      try {
        player.pause();
      } catch {}
      setPlaying(false);
    }
  }, [visible, player]);

  const togglePlay = () => {
    if (playing) {
      player.pause();
      setPlaying(false);
    } else {
      player.play();
      setPlaying(true);
    }
  };

  if (!videoUrl) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      animationType="fade"
      transparent
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <View style={styles.overlay}>
        <Pressable onPress={onClose} hitSlop={10} style={styles.closeBtn}>
          <FaTimes size={22} color="#fff" />
        </Pressable>

        {/* Full screen video tap area */}
        <Pressable style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} onPress={togglePlay}>
          <VideoView
            player={player}
            style={{ width, height }}
            nativeControls={false}
            contentFit="contain" // fits the whole video without cropping
          />

          {/* Big play button overlay when paused */}
          {!playing ? (
            <View style={styles.playOverlay}>
              <View style={[styles.playCircle, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
                <FaPlay size={32} color={c.bg} style={{ marginLeft: 4 }} />
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </Pressable>

        {/* Title at bottom */}
        {title ? (
          <View style={styles.titleBar} pointerEvents="none">
            <AppText style={styles.titleText}>{title}</AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  overlay: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "#000", // Solid black background
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  closeBtn: {
    position: "absolute",
    top: 50,
    right: 20,
    width: 44,
    height: 44,
    borderRadius: 22,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    zIndex: 10,
  },
  playOverlay: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)",
  },
  playCircle: {
    width: 80,
    height: 80,
    borderRadius: 40,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  titleBar: {
    position: "absolute",
    bottom: 60,
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    paddingHorizontal: 24,
  },
  titleText: {
    fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: "700",
    color: "#fff",
    textAlign: "center",
    textShadowColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)",
    textShadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 1 },
    textShadowRadius: 4,
  },
});

import React from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet, Image } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

export default function WorkerRow({ worker, onPress, showDivider = true }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const wp = worker.workerProfile ?? {};
  const name = `${worker.firstName ?? ""} ${worker.lastName ?? ""}`.trim();
  const title = wp.title ?? "";
  const rating = Number(wp.avgRating ?? 0);
  const ratingLabel = rating > 0 ? rating.toFixed(1) : "—";

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.row,
        {
          borderBottomColor: c.border,
          borderBottomWidth: showDivider ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth : 0,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={styles.avatar}>
        {worker.avatar ? (
          <Image source={{ uri: worker.avatar }} style={styles.avatarImg} />
        ) : (
          <AppText style={styles.avatarText}>
            {initials(worker.firstName, worker.lastName)}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.info}>
        <AppText style={[styles.name, { color: c.text }]} numberOfLines={1}>
          {name || "Worker"}
        </AppText>
        {!!title && (
          <AppText
            style={[styles.title, { color: c.textDim }]}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {title}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.rating}>
        <AppText style={styles.star}>★</AppText>
        <AppText style={[styles.ratingText, { color: c.textDim }]}>
          {ratingLabel}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

// src/components/auth/AuthShell.js
//
// Shared auth screen primitives — mirrors the website's AuthLayout
// + form.module.css. Every auth screen composes these so all look
// identical and match the website 1:1.
//
// Safe-area aware — the back button always clears the notch/status bar
// by a generous margin on every device, including the S22.

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  TextInput,
  ScrollView,
  Animated,
  ActivityIndicator,
  StyleSheet,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

// ─── Icon safety helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const safeIcon = (name) => name || null;

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AuthShell — outer wrapper for every auth screen.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function AuthShell({ children, showBack = true, backTo = "Login" }) {
  const ctx = useTheme() || {};
  const th = ctx.theme;
  const c = (th && th.colors) || {
    bg: "#080810",
    text: "#fff",
    textDim: "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)",
    textMuted: "rgba(255,255,255,0.28)",
    orange: "#f97316",
  };

  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const navigation = useNavigation();

  const fade = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const slide = useRef(new Animated.Value(16)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    const anim = Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(fade, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 450,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(slide, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 450,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]);
    anim.start();
    return () => anim.stop();
  }, [fade, slide]);

  return (
    <KeyboardAvoidingView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : undefined}
    >
      <ScrollView
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
        contentContainerStyle={{
          flexGrow: 1,
          paddingHorizontal: 16,
          // Increased top padding to push the back button lower from the screen edge
          paddingTop: Math.max(insets.top, 24) + 56,
          paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, 24) + 24,
        }}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {showBack && (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.canGoBack()
                ? navigation.goBack()
                : navigation.navigate(backTo)
            }
            style={styles.backRow}
            hitSlop={8}
          >
            <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={15} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="medium"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
            >
              Back
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        <Animated.View
          style={{
            width: "100%",
            maxWidth: 400,
            alignSelf: "center",
            opacity: fade,
            transform: [{ translateY: slide }],
          }}
        >
          {children}
        </Animated.View>
      </ScrollView>
    </KeyboardAvoidingView>
  );
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AuthField — label + input + icon + error
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function AuthField({
  label,
  value,
  onChangeText,
  placeholder,
  iconLeft,
  iconRight,
  secureTextEntry,
  keyboardType,
  autoCapitalize,
  autoComplete,
  textContentType,
  error,
  editable = true,
  inputRef,
}) {
  const ctx = useTheme() || {};
  const c = (ctx.theme && ctx.theme.colors) || {
    red: "#ef4444",
    border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
    bgInput: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)",
    textMuted: "rgba(255,255,255,0.28)",
    text: "#fff",
    textDim: "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)",
  };

  const borderColor = error ? c.red : c.border;
  const leftIcon = safeIcon(iconLeft);
  const rightIconName = safeIcon(iconRight?.name);

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 7 }}>
      {label ? (
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.textDim, letterSpacing: 0.2, fontSize: 12 }}
        >
          {label}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
      <View
        style={[styles.inputWrap, { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor }]}
      >
        {leftIcon && (
          <View style={styles.iconLeft}>
            <Ionicons name={leftIcon} size={15} color={c.textMuted} />
          </View>
        )}
        <TextInput
          ref={inputRef}
          value={value}
          onChangeText={onChangeText}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          secureTextEntry={secureTextEntry}
          keyboardType={keyboardType}
          autoCapitalize={autoCapitalize ?? "none"}
          autoCorrect={false}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          textContentType={textContentType}
          editable={editable}
          style={[
            styles.input,
            {
              color: c.text,
              paddingLeft: leftIcon ? 42 : 15,
              paddingRight: rightIconName ? 42 : 15,
              opacity: editable ? 1 : 0.4,
            },
          ]}
        />
        {rightIconName && (
          <Pressable
            style={styles.iconRight}
            onPress={iconRight?.onPress}
            hitSlop={8}
          >
            <Ionicons name={rightIconName} size={16} color={c.textMuted} />
          </Pressable>
        )}
      </View>
      {error ? (
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
          <Ionicons name="alert-circle" size={12} color="#fca5a5" />
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#fca5a5", fontSize: 11.5 }}>
            {error}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AuthButton — primary orange pill + outline variant
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function AuthButton({
  title,
  onPress,
  loading,
  disabled,
  variant = "primary",
  iconLeft,
}) {
  const ctx = useTheme() || {};
  const c = (ctx.theme && ctx.theme.colors) || {
    orange: "#f97316",
    bg: "#080810",
    text: "#fff",
    border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
  };

  const isPrimary = variant === "primary";
  const isOutline = variant === "outline";

  const bgColor = isPrimary ? c.orange : "transparent";
  const textColor = isPrimary ? c.bg : c.text;
  const borderColor = isOutline ? c.border : "transparent";
  const borderWidth = isOutline ? 1.5 : 0;

  const isDisabled = disabled || loading;
  const leftIcon = safeIcon(iconLeft);

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={isDisabled}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.btn,
        {
          backgroundColor: bgColor,
          borderColor,
          borderWidth,
          opacity: isDisabled ? 0.45 : pressed ? 0.88 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={isPrimary ? c.bg : c.text} />
      ) : (
        <>
          {leftIcon ? (
            <Ionicons
              name={leftIcon}
              size={16}
              color={textColor}
              style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
            />
          ) : null}
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="bold"
            style={{
              color: textColor,
              fontSize: 14.5,
              letterSpacing: 0.2,
            }}
          >
            {title}
          </AppText>
        </>
      )}
    </Pressable>
  );
}

export function AuthAlert({ type = "error", message }) {
  const ctx = useTheme() || {};
  const c = (ctx.theme && ctx.theme.colors) || {
    redDim: "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)",
    greenDim: "rgba(34,197,94,0.1)",
  };

  const isErr = type === "error";
  const bg = isErr ? c.redDim : c.greenDim;
  const border = isErr ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)" : "rgba(34,197,94,0.2)";
  const text = isErr ? "#fca5a5" : "#86efac";
  const icon = isErr ? "alert-circle" : "checkmark-circle";

  return (
    <View style={[styles.alert, { backgroundColor: bg, borderColor: border }]}>
      <Ionicons name={icon} size={15} color={text} style={{ marginTop: 1 }} />
      <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: text, flex: 1, lineHeight: 19 }}>
        {message}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function badgePalette(key, c) {
  switch (key) {
    case "yellow":
      return { bg: "rgba(251,191,36,0.12)", fg: "#fbbf24" };
    case "orange":
      return { bg: c.orangeDim, fg: c.orange };
    case "indigo":
      return { bg: "rgba(129,140,248,0.12)", fg: "#818cf8" };
    case "green":
      return { bg: c.greenDim, fg: c.green };
    case "red":
      return { bg: c.redDim, fg: c.red };
    case "rose":
      return { bg: "rgba(251,113,133,0.12)", fg: "#fb7185" };
    default:
      return { bg: c.bgCard, fg: c.textDim };
  }
}

function GpsCard({
  title,
  dotColor,
  timestamp,
  lat,
  lng,
  distKm,
  cardClass,
  c,
}) {
  const getDistanceIcon = () => {
    if (distKm < 0.1) return <FaCheckCircle size={12} color={c.green} />;
    if (distKm > 1) return <FaExclamationTriangle size={12} color={c.orange} />;
    return <FaMap size={12} color="#3b82f6" />;
  };

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.gpsCard,
        cardClass === "in"
          ? { backgroundColor: "#f0fdf4", borderColor: "#bbf7d0" }
          : { backgroundColor: "#fff1f2", borderColor: "#fecdd3" },
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 8,
          marginBottom: 10,
        }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            width: 10,
            height: 10,
            borderRadius: 5,
            backgroundColor: dotColor,
          }}
        />
        <AppText
          style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#1a1a1a", flex: 1 }}
        >
          {title}
        </AppText>
        {timestamp ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#888" }}>
            {new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], {
              hour: "2-digit",
              minute: "2-digit",
            })}{" "}
            ·{" "}
            {new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
              day: "numeric",
              month: "short",
            })}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          marginBottom: 8,
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#888" }}>Coordinates</AppText>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#333", fontFamily: "Courier" }}>
          {lat.toFixed(5)}, {lng.toFixed(5)}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      {distKm !== null ? (
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 6,
            paddingHorizontal: 10,
            paddingVertical: 6,
            borderRadius: 8,
            backgroundColor: distKm > 1 ? "#fef3c7" : "#dcfce7",
            marginBottom: 10,
          }}
        >
          {getDistanceIcon()}
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: distKm > 1 ? "#92400e" : "#166534",
            }}
          >
            {distKm < 0.1
              ? "Worker was at the job site"
              : `${distKm.toFixed(2)} km from job site`}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() =>
          Linking.openURL(`https://www.google.com/maps?q=${lat},${lng}`)
        }
        style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}
      >
        <FaMap size={11} color="#2563eb" />
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "600", color: "#2563eb" }}>
          View on Google Maps
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Timeline ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Timeline({ step, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: c.border,
        borderRadius: 14,
        paddingHorizontal: 16,
        paddingVertical: 18,
      }}
    >
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          alignItems: "flex-start",
        }}
      >
        {TIMELINE_STEPS.map((label, i) => {
          const active = i <= step;
          const current = i === step;
          return (
            <View key={label} style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: "center" }}>
              <View
                style={{
                  width: 26,
                  height: 26,
                  borderRadius: 13,
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  backgroundColor: current
                    ? c.orange
                    : active
                      ? c.orangeDim
                      : c.bgCard,
                  borderWidth: 2,
                  borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                  shadowColor: current ? c.orange : "transparent",
                  shadowOpacity: current ? 0.4 : 0,
                  shadowRadius: 6,
                  shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 0 },
                }}
              >
                {i < step ? (
                  <FaCheck size={10} color={current ? c.bg : c.orange} />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: current ? c.bg : c.textMuted,
                    }}
                  >
                    {i + 1}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  marginTop: 8,
                  fontSize: 9,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: active ? c.textDim : c.textMuted,
                  textAlign: "center",
                }}
              >
                {label}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Section wrapper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Section({ title, children, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: c.border,
        borderRadius: 14,
        padding: 16,
        gap: 12,
      }}
    >
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
          fontSize: 12,
          fontWeight: "700",
          color: c.textDim,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          letterSpacing: 1,
        }}
      >
        {title}
      </AppText>
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Reviews list ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReviewsSection({
  reviews,
  reviewCheckDone,
  hasReviewed,
  onLeaveReview,
  c,
}) {
  if (!reviews?.length && !reviewCheckDone) return null;
  return (
    <Section title="Reviews" c={c}>
      {reviews?.length > 0
        ? reviews.map((review) => (
            <View key={review.id} style={{ gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "flex-start",
                  gap: 10,
                }}
              >
                <View
                  style={{
                    width: 38,
                    height: 38,
                    borderRadius: 19,
                    backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    overflow: "hidden",
                  }}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
                  >
                    {review.giver?.firstName?.[0]}
                    {review.giver?.lastName?.[0]}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {review.giver?.firstName} {review.giver?.lastName}
                    <AppText style={{ color: c.textDim, fontWeight: "400" }}>
                      {" · "}
                      {review.giver?.role === "HIRER" ? "Hirer" : "Worker"}
                    </AppText>
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
                    {new Date(review.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                      day: "numeric",
                      month: "short",
                      year: "numeric",
                    })}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
                    <FaStar
                      key={i}
                      size={12}
                      color={i <= review.rating ? "#fbbf24" : c.border}
                    />
                  ))}
                </View>
              </View>
              {review.comment ? (
                <View
                  style={{
                    borderLeftWidth: 2,
                    borderLeftColor: c.orange,
                    paddingLeft: 10,
                  }}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 13,
                      color: c.textDim,
                      fontStyle: "italic",
                      lineHeight: 20,
                    }}
                  >
                    "{review.comment}"
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ) : null}
            </View>
          ))
        : null}
      {reviewCheckDone && !hasReviewed ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={onLeaveReview}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            {
              paddingHorizontal: 14,
              paddingVertical: 10,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 9,
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 6,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaStar size={12} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
          >
            Leave a Review
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
      {reviewCheckDone && hasReviewed ? (
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 6,
            paddingHorizontal: 12,
            paddingVertical: 10,
            backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: c.green,
            borderRadius: 8,
          }}
        >
          <FaCheckCircle size={13} color={c.green} />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, flex: 1 }}>
            Your review has been submitted.{" "}
            {(reviews?.length ?? 0) < 2 ? " Waiting for the other party." : ""}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </Section>
  );
}

// ── GPS Section ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function GpsSection({
  booking,
  hasCheckInGps,
  hasCheckOutGps,
  checkInDistKm,
  checkOutDistKm,
  c,
}) {
  return (
    <Section title="Worker Location" c={c}>
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 6 }}>
        GPS recorded at check-in and check-out. Visible to both parties.
      </AppText>
      <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
        {hasCheckInGps ? (
          <GpsCard
            title="Check-in Location"
            dotColor="#16a34a"
            timestamp={booking.checkInAt}
            lat={booking.checkInLat}
            lng={booking.checkInLng}
            distKm={checkInDistKm}
            cardClass="in"
            c={c}
          />
        ) : null}
        {hasCheckOutGps ? (
          <GpsCard
            title="Check-out Location"
            dotColor="#dc2626"
            timestamp={booking.checkOutAt}
            lat={booking.checkOutLat}
            lng={booking.checkOutLng}
            distKm={checkOutDistKm}
            cardClass="out"
            c={c}
          />
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </Section>
  );
}

// ── Cancel reason ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CancelReason({ reason, c }) {
  return (
    <Section title="Cancellation Reason" c={c}>
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "flex-start",
          gap: 10,
          padding: 14,
          backgroundColor: c.redDim,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)",
          borderRadius: 12,
        }}
      >
        <FaExclamationTriangle size={14} color={c.red} />
        <AppText
          style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, lineHeight: 20 }}
        >
          {reason}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </Section>
  );
}

// ── Bottom actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function BottomActions({
  isCompletedOrPaid,
  showRefundButton,
  onDownloadInvoice,
  onRefundClick,
  refundLoading,
  invoiceLoading,
  c,
}) {
  if (!isCompletedOrPaid) return null;
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        flexWrap: "wrap",
        gap: 10,
        paddingTop: 16,
        borderTopWidth: 1,
        borderTopColor: c.border,
      }}
    >
      <Pressable
        onPress={onDownloadInvoice}
        disabled={invoiceLoading}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          {
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 6,
            paddingHorizontal: 14,
            paddingVertical: 10,
            backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: c.border,
            borderRadius: 9,
            opacity: invoiceLoading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <FaFileAlt size={12} color={c.textDim} />
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}>
          Download Invoice
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
      {showRefundButton ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={onRefundClick}
          disabled={refundLoading}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            {
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 6,
              paddingHorizontal: 14,
              paddingVertical: 10,
              backgroundColor: c.redDim,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.red,
              borderRadius: 9,
              opacity: refundLoading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaUndo size={12} color={c.red} />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.red }}>
            Request Refund
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MAIN EXPORT
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export default function BookingDetailMain({
  booking,
  step,
  dur,
  hasCheckInGps,
  hasCheckOutGps,
  checkInDistKm,
  checkOutDistKm,
  reviewCheckDone,
  hasReviewed,
  bookingId,
  invoiceLoading,
  onDownloadInvoice,
  onLeaveReview,
  isHirer,
  payment,
  paymentStatus,
  isWorker,
  workerName,
  refundLoading,
  hasActiveRefund,
  onShowRefundModal,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const meta = STATUS_META[booking.status] || {};
  const badgeColor = badgePalette(meta.color, c);
  const isCompletedOrPaid = ["COMPLETED", "PAID"].includes(booking.status);
  const isJobPostBooking = booking.source === "JOB_POST";
  const isRetainedStaff = booking.source === "RETAINED_STAFF";

  const showMapLink =
    booking.latitude && booking.longitude && booking.locationType !== "REMOTE";

  const showRefundButton =
    isHirer &&
    paymentStatus === "RELEASED" &&
    !refundLoading &&
    !hasActiveRefund &&
    !isRetainedStaff;

  const renderDuration = () => {
    if (!dur) {
      if (booking.estimatedHours || booking.estimatedValue) {
        return <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>Loading…</AppText>;
      }
      return <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>Not specified</AppText>;
    }
    const unitMap = {
      hours: "hours",
      days: "days",
      weeks: "weeks",
      months: "months",
      custom: "Custom",
    };
    const unitLabel = booking.estimatedUnit
      ? unitMap[booking.estimatedUnit] || booking.estimatedUnit
      : null;

    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          flexWrap: "wrap",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 4,
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}>
          {dur.main}
        </AppText>
        {dur.sub ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textMuted }}>
            {dur.sub}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
        {unitLabel ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
            ({unitLabel}
            {booking.isNegotiated && booking.negotiatedRate
              ? " · negotiated"
              : ""}
            )
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  };

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // BRANCH 1 — RETAINED STAFF PAYROLL
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (isRetainedStaff) {
    const p = calcPricing(booking);
    const currency = p.currency || booking.currency || "NGN";
    const feePercent = Math.round(getHirerFeeRate(currency) * 100);

    return (
      <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
        <BookingReleaseDetails payment={payment} currency={booking.currency} />

        <View
          style={{
            backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: c.border,
            borderRadius: 16,
            padding: 20,
            gap: 8,
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 12 }}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
                fontSize: 20,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.text,
                flex: 1,
                lineHeight: 26,
              }}
            >
              {booking.title}
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 12,
                paddingVertical: 4,
                backgroundColor: badgeColor.bg,
                borderRadius: 20,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: badgeColor.fg,
                  textTransform: "uppercase",
                  letterSpacing: 0.5,
                }}
              >
                {meta.label}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
          {booking.category ? (
            <View
              style={{
                alignSelf: "flex-start",
                paddingHorizontal: 10,
                paddingVertical: 3,
                backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                borderRadius: 12,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
              >
                {booking.category.name}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 4,
              alignSelf: "flex-start",
              paddingHorizontal: 10,
              paddingVertical: 3,
              backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.1)",
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.25)",
              borderRadius: 12,
            }}
          >
            <FaBriefcase size={10} color="#818cf8" />
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: "#818cf8" }}
            >
              Retained Staff Payroll
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        <Section title="Retained Staff Details" c={c}>
          <DetailItem
            icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label="Pay Period"
            value={new Date(booking.scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
            c={c}
          />
          <DetailItem
            icon={<FaMoneyBillWave size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label="Base Rate"
            value={`${booking.currency} ${Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()}`}
            accent
            c={c}
          />
          <DetailItem
            icon={<FaFileAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label="Role"
            value={booking.description || "Standard Retained Role"}
            c={c}
          />
          {booking.jobType
            ? (() => {
                const Icon = JOB_TYPES[booking.jobType]?.Icon || FaBriefcase;
                return (
                  <DetailItem
                    icon={<Icon size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                    label="Job Type"
                    value={JOB_TYPES[booking.jobType]?.label || booking.jobType}
                    c={c}
                  />
                );
              })()
            : null}
          {booking.employmentType ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaBriefcase size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Employment Type"
              value={String(booking.employmentType).replace(/_/g, " ")}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.department ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaBuilding size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Department"
              value={booking.department}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.locationType ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaMapPin size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Location Type"
              value={
                LOC_TYPES[booking.locationType]?.label || booking.locationType
              }
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.location && booking.locationType !== "REMOTE" ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaMapMarkerAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Work Location"
              value={booking.location}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.workDays?.length > 0 ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Work Days"
              value={booking.workDays.join(", ")}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.workStart && booking.workEnd ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaClock size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Working Hours"
              value={`${booking.workStart} — ${booking.workEnd}${booking.timezone ? ` (${booking.timezone})` : ""}`}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.employeeNumber ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaBriefcase size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Employee #"
              value={booking.employeeNumber}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.managerName ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaUser size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Manager"
              value={booking.managerName}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.emergencyContact ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaExclamationTriangle size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Emergency Contact"
              value={
                typeof booking.emergencyContact === "string"
                  ? booking.emergencyContact
                  : booking.emergencyContact.name || ""
              }
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          <DetailItem
            icon={<FaClock size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label="Status"
            value={
              booking.status === "PAID"
                ? "Paid & Completed"
                : booking.status === "ACCEPTED"
                  ? "Active Payroll"
                  : booking.status
            }
            accent={booking.status === "PAID"}
            c={c}
          />
          <DetailItem
            icon={<FaMoneyBillWave size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label="Base Amount"
            value={`${currency} ${Number(p.subtotal).toLocaleString()}`}
            c={c}
          />
          {booking.bonusAmount > 0 ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaPlusCircle size={14} color={c.green} />}
              label="Bonus"
              value={`+ ${currency} ${Number(booking.bonusAmount).toLocaleString()}`}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.deductionAmount > 0 ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaMinusCircle size={14} color="#f87171" />}
              label="Deduction"
              value={`- ${currency} ${Number(booking.deductionAmount).toLocaleString()}`}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          <DetailItem
            icon={<FaMoneyBillWave size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label={`Platform Fee (${feePercent}%)`}
            value={`${currency} ${Number(p.hirerFee).toLocaleString()}`}
            accent
            c={c}
          />
          {isHirer ? (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaMoneyBillWave size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Total Payment"
              value={`${currency} ${Number(p.grossTotal).toLocaleString()}`}
              accent
              c={c}
            />
          ) : (
            <DetailItem
              icon={<FaMoneyBillWave size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label="Your Payout"
              value={`${currency} ${Number(p.workerPayout).toLocaleString()}`}
              accent
              c={c}
            />
          )}
        </Section>

        <Section title="Description" c={c}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, lineHeight: 20 }}>
            {booking.description || "No additional description provided."}
          </AppText>
          {booking.notes ? (
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "flex-start",
                gap: 8,
                padding: 12,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 8,
              }}
            >
              <FaFileAlt
                size={12}
                color={c.textMuted}
                style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
              />
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, flex: 1 }}>
                {booking.notes}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </Section>

        {isCompletedOrPaid ? (
          <ReviewsSection
            reviews={booking.reviews}
            reviewCheckDone={reviewCheckDone}
            hasReviewed={hasReviewed}
            onLeaveReview={onLeaveReview}
            c={c}
          />
        ) : null}

        <BottomActions
          isCompletedOrPaid={isCompletedOrPaid}
          showRefundButton={false}
          onDownloadInvoice={onDownloadInvoice}
          invoiceLoading={invoiceLoading}
          c={c}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // BRANCH 2 — JOB POST
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (isJobPostBooking) {
    const p = calcPricing(booking);
    const currency = p.currency || booking.currency || "NGN";
    const feePercent = Math.round(getHirerFeeRate(currency) * 100);

    return (
      <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
        <BookingReleaseDetails payment={payment} currency={booking.currency} />

        <View
          style={{
            backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: c.border,
            borderRadius: 16,
            padding: 20,
            gap: 8,
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 12 }}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
                fontSize: 20,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.text,
                flex: 1,
                lineHeight: 26,
              }}
            >
              {booking.title}
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 12,
                paddingVertical: 4,
                backgroundColor: badgeColor.bg,
                borderRadius: 20,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: badgeColor.fg,
                  textTransform: "uppercase",
                  letterSpacing: 0.5,
                }}
              >
                {meta.label}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
          {booking.category ? (
            <View
              style={{
                alignSelf: "flex-start",
                paddingHorizontal: 10,
                paddingVertical: 3,
                backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                borderRadius: 12,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
              >
                {booking.category.name}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          {booking.isNegotiated ? (
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 4,
                alignSelf: "flex-start",

function calcDuration(start, end) {
  if (!start || !end) return null;
  const ms = new Date(end) - new Date(start);
  const hrs = Math.floor(ms / 3600000);
  const min = Math.floor((ms % 3600000) / 60000);
  return hrs > 0 ? `${hrs}h ${min}m` : `${min}m`;
}

    padding: 14,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },

// Verbatim port of components/booking/BookingDetail/BookingDetailPayment.jsx
//
// Two render paths:
//   · payment PENDING or missing → renderFeeBreakdown()
//       - Worker branch  OR  Hirer branch
//       - Fixed-total view (job-post / negotiated) OR rate × qty view
//       - Referral slider (hirer only, NGN only, wallet > 0)
//       - Pay Now banner (hirer only, paymentRequired)
//   · payment HELD / RELEASED / REFUNDED / FAILED → renderPaymentCard() receipt
//
// Currency-aware fees: getHirerFeeRate(currency) × 100 (never hardcoded).

import React from "react";
import { Linking, Pressable, View } from "react-native";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { getHirerFeeRate } from "../../utils/pricing";
import {
  FaCreditCard,
  FaGift,
  FaBolt,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaInfoCircle,
  FaChevronUp,
  FaClock,
} from "../../icons/fa";

function getFeePercent(currency = "NGN") {
  return Math.round(getHirerFeeRate(currency) * 100);
}

function formatPrice(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const n = Number(amount) || 0;
  return `${currency} ${n.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

// ── Sub-components ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function PayRow({ label, value, muted, green, capitalize, mono, extra, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        justifyContent: "space-between",
        alignItems: "center",
        paddingVertical: 8,
        gap: 8,
      }}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, flexShrink: 1 }}>
        {label}
      </AppText>
      {extra ? (
        extra
      ) : (
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: "700",
            color: green ? c.green : muted ? c.textDim : c.text,
            textTransform: capitalize ? "capitalize" : "none",
            fontFamily: mono ? "Courier" : undefined,
            textAlign: "right",
            flexShrink: 1,
          }}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 20,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color: c.orange,
        }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Referral slider — replaces HTML <input type="range"> with +/− steps ─
function ReferralSlider({ value, onChange, disabled, c }) {
  const step = 5;
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => !disabled && onChange(Math.max(0, Number(value) - step))}
        disabled={disabled || Number(value) <= 0}
        hitSlop={6}
        style={{
          width: 32,
          height: 32,
          borderRadius: 16,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          opacity: disabled || Number(value) <= 0 ? 0.4 : 1,
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 18, color: c.text, lineHeight: 20 }}>
          −
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          height: 6,
          borderRadius: 3,
          backgroundColor: c.border,
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            height: "100%",
            width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(value)))}%`,
            backgroundColor: c.orange,
          }}
        />
      </View>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() =>
          !disabled && onChange(Math.min(100, Number(value) + step))
        }
        disabled={disabled || Number(value) >= 100}
        hitSlop={6}
        style={{
          width: 32,
          height: 32,
          borderRadius: 16,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          opacity: disabled || Number(value) >= 100 ? 0.4 : 1,
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 18, color: c.text, lineHeight: 20 }}>
          +
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export default function BookingDetailPayment({
  booking,
  payment,
  feeBreakdown,
  walletBalance,
  referralAmount,
  referralApplied,
  referralPercent,
  onPercentChange,
  onReferralToggle,
  showPayOptions,
  onTogglePayOptions,
  paymentRequired,
  refetch,
  onSuccess,
  isHirer,
  isWorker,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const isJobPostBooking = booking?.source === "JOB_POST";

  const feeCurrency =
    (feeBreakdown && feeBreakdown.currency) || booking?.currency || "NGN";
  const feePercent = getFeePercent(feeCurrency);

  const realDurationText =
    booking?.estimatedValue && booking?.estimatedUnit
      ? `${booking.estimatedValue} ${
          {
            hours: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "hour" : "hours",
            days: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "day" : "days",
            weeks: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "week" : "weeks",
            months: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "month" : "months",
            years: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "year" : "years",
            custom: "",
          }[booking.estimatedUnit] || booking.estimatedUnit
        }`
      : null;

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // renderFeeBreakdown
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  const renderFeeBreakdown = () => {
    if (!feeBreakdown) return null;

    const isNegotiated = booking.isNegotiated && booking.negotiatedRate;
    const isFixedTotalView = isNegotiated || isJobPostBooking;

    // ── Worker view ────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (isWorker) {
      const cur = feeBreakdown.currency || "NGN";
      const workerPayout = feeBreakdown.workerPayout || 0;
      const agreedRate = feeBreakdown.agreedRate || 0;

      return (
        <View
          style={{
            backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
            borderColor: c.orange,
            borderWidth: 1.5,
            borderRadius: 12,
            padding: 14,
            gap: 8,
          }}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: "700",
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              letterSpacing: 0.8,
              color: c.textMuted,
              marginBottom: 2,
            }}
          >
            {isNegotiated
              ? "Agreed Total (Negotiated)"
              : isJobPostBooking
                ? "Your Earnings (From Job Post)"
                : "Your Earnings"}
          </AppText>

          {isFixedTotalView ? (
            <>
              <FeeRow
                label={isNegotiated ? "Agreed Total" : "Selected Amount"}
                value={formatPrice(agreedRate, cur)}
                c={c}
              />
              {isJobPostBooking && realDurationText ? (
                <FeeRow
                  label="Duration"
                  value={
                    <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.text }}>
                      {realDurationText}
                      {booking.estimatedHours ? (
                        <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted, fontSize: 11 }}>
                          {" "}
                          (≈ {booking.estimatedHours}h)
                        </AppText>
                      ) : null}
                    </AppText>
                  }
                  c={c}
                />
              ) : null}
              <FeeRow
                label={`Platform Fee (${feePercent}%)`}
                value={`+ ${formatPrice(feeBreakdown.platformFee || 0, cur)}`}
                c={c}
              />
              <FeeTotal
                label="You Earn"
                value={formatPrice(workerPayout, cur)}
                c={c}
              />
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <FeeRow
                label="Agreed Rate"
                value={`${formatPrice(agreedRate, cur)}${
                  { hours: "/hr", days: "/day", weeks: "/wk", months: "/mo" }[
                    feeBreakdown.estimatedUnit
                  ] || ""
                }`}
                c={c}
              />
              {feeBreakdown.hasQty ? (
                <FeeRow
                  label="Duration"
                  value={`${feeBreakdown.qty} ${feeBreakdown.unitLabel}${
                    feeBreakdown.qty !== 1 ? "s" : ""
                  }`}
                  c={c}
                />
              ) : null}
              {feeBreakdown.hasQty ? (
                <FeeRow
                  label={`Subtotal (${feeBreakdown.qty} × ${formatPrice(
                    agreedRate,
                    cur,
                  )})`}
                  value={formatPrice(feeBreakdown.subtotal || 0, cur)}
                  c={c}
                />
              ) : null}
              <FeeRow
                label={`Platform Fee (${feePercent}%)`}
                value={`+ ${formatPrice(feeBreakdown.platformFee || 0, cur)}`}
                c={c}
              />
              <FeeTotal
                label="You Earn"
                value={formatPrice(workerPayout, cur)}
                c={c}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </View>
      );
    }

    // ── Hirer view ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const cur = feeBreakdown.currency || "NGN";
    const agreedRate = feeBreakdown.agreedRate || 0;
    const subtotal = feeBreakdown.subtotal || 0;
    const platformFee = feeBreakdown.platformFee || 0;
    const workerPayout = feeBreakdown.workerPayout || subtotal;
    const grossTotal = feeBreakdown.total || 0;

    const discount =
      referralApplied && booking.currency === "NGN" ? referralAmount : 0;
    const finalTotal = Math.max(0, grossTotal - discount);

    const isCustom = feeBreakdown.estimatedUnit === "custom";

    const isPaymentPending = payment?.status === "PENDING";
    const isBookingAccepted = booking?.status === "ACCEPTED";

    return (
      <View
        style={{
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderColor: c.orange,
          borderWidth: 1.5,
          borderRadius: 12,
          padding: 14,
          gap: 8,
        }}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: "700",
            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 0.8,
            color: c.textMuted,
            marginBottom: 2,
          }}
        >
          {isNegotiated
            ? "Agreed Total (Negotiated)"
            : isJobPostBooking
              ? "Payment Breakdown (From Job Post)"
              : "Payment Breakdown"}
        </AppText>

        {isFixedTotalView ? (
          <>
            <FeeRow
              label={isNegotiated ? "Agreed Total" : "Selected Amount"}
              value={formatPrice(agreedRate, cur)}
              c={c}
            />
            {isJobPostBooking && realDurationText ? (
              <FeeRow
                label="Duration"
                value={
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.text }}>
                    {realDurationText}
                    {booking.estimatedHours ? (
                      <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted, fontSize: 11 }}>
                        {" "}
                        (≈ {booking.estimatedHours}h)
                      </AppText>
                    ) : null}
                  </AppText>
                }
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {isNegotiated && (feeBreakdown.hasQty || isCustom) ? (
              <FeeRow
                label="Duration"
                value={`${feeBreakdown.qty} ${feeBreakdown.unitLabel}${
                  feeBreakdown.qty !== 1 ? "s" : ""
                }`}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            <FeeRow
              label={`Platform Fee (${feePercent}%)`}
              value={`+ ${formatPrice(platformFee, cur)}`}
              c={c}
            />
            {referralApplied && discount > 0 && booking.currency === "NGN" ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  paddingVertical: 4,
                }}
              >
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}
                >
                  <FaGift size={11} color={c.green} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, fontWeight: "600" }}
                  >
                    Referral bonus
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, fontWeight: "600" }}
                >
                  − {formatPrice(discount, booking.currency)}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}
            <FeeTotal
              label="You Pay"
              value={formatPrice(finalTotal, cur)}
              c={c}
            />
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <FeeRow
              label="Agreed Rate"
              value={`${formatPrice(agreedRate, cur)}${
                { hours: "/hr", days: "/day", weeks: "/wk", months: "/mo" }[
                  feeBreakdown.estimatedUnit
                ] || ""
              }`}
              c={c}
            />
            {feeBreakdown.hasQty || isCustom ? (
              <FeeRow
                label="Duration"
                value={`${feeBreakdown.qty} ${feeBreakdown.unitLabel}${
                  feeBreakdown.qty !== 1 ? "s" : ""
                }`}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {feeBreakdown.hasQty || isCustom ? (
              <FeeRow
                label={`Subtotal (${feeBreakdown.qty} × ${formatPrice(
                  agreedRate,
                  cur,
                )})`}
                value={formatPrice(subtotal, cur)}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            <FeeRow
              label={`Platform Fee (${feePercent}%)`}
              value={`+ ${formatPrice(platformFee, cur)}`}
              c={c}
            />
            {referralApplied && discount > 0 && booking.currency === "NGN" ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  paddingVertical: 4,
                }}
              >
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}
                >
                  <FaGift size={11} color={c.green} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, fontWeight: "600" }}
                  >
                    Referral bonus
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, fontWeight: "600" }}
                >
                  − {formatPrice(discount, booking.currency)}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}
            <FeeTotal
              label="You Pay"
              value={formatPrice(finalTotal, cur)}
              c={c}
            />
          </>
        )}

        {/* Referral slider — hirer, NGN only, wallet > 0 */}
        {!feeBreakdown.isActual &&
        isHirer &&
        walletBalance > 0 &&
        booking.currency === "NGN" ? (
          <View
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderRadius: 10,
              padding: 12,
              marginTop: 8,
              gap: 8,
            }}
          >
            <View
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}
            >
              <FaGift size={14} color={c.green} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: c.text,
                  flex: 1,
                }}
              >
                Referral Wallet Balance: {formatPrice(walletBalance, "NGN")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <ReferralSlider
              value={referralPercent}
              onChange={onPercentChange}
              disabled={walletBalance <= 0}
              c={c}
            />
            <View
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.orange,
                  minWidth: 44,
                }}
              >
                {referralPercent}%
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.text,
                  flex: 1,
                  textAlign: "right",
                }}
              >
                {formatPrice(referralAmount, "NGN")}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                onPress={onReferralToggle}
                disabled={referralAmount === 0}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    paddingHorizontal: 14,
                    paddingVertical: 4,
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: referralApplied ? c.orange : c.border,
                    backgroundColor: referralApplied ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                    opacity: referralAmount === 0 ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: referralApplied ? "#fff" : c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  {referralApplied ? "Remove" : "Apply"}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* No-referral info */}
        {!feeBreakdown.isActual && isHirer && walletBalance === 0 ? (
          <View
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
              borderColor: c.green,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderStyle: "dashed",
              borderRadius: 8,
              padding: 10,
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "flex-start",
              gap: 6,
              marginTop: 4,
            }}
          >
            <FaInfoCircle size={12} color={c.green} style={{ marginTop: 1 }} />
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, flex: 1, lineHeight: 18 }}
            >
              You don't have any referral bonus yet. Invite friends to earn!
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Pay Now banner */}
        {isHirer && paymentRequired ? (
          <View
            style={{
              marginTop: 12,
              borderTopColor: c.border,
              borderTopWidth: 1,
              paddingTop: 12,
              gap: 10,
            }}
          >
            {isPaymentPending && isBookingAccepted ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "flex-start",
                  gap: 6,
                  backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                  borderColor: c.orange,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  paddingHorizontal: 10,
                  paddingVertical: 8,
                }}
              >
                <FaClock size={12} color={c.orange} style={{ marginTop: 2 }} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: c.text,
                    flex: 1,
                    lineHeight: 18,
                  }}
                >
                  <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700" }}>
                    Worker is waiting for you to complete payment.
                  </AppText>
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {walletBalance > 0 && booking.currency === "NGN" ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "flex-start",
                  gap: 6,
                  backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
                  borderColor: c.green,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderStyle: "dashed",
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  paddingHorizontal: 10,
                  paddingVertical: 8,
                }}
              >
                {referralApplied ? (
                  <>
                    <FaCheckCircle
                      size={12}
                      color={c.green}
                      style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
                    />
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: c.green,
                        flex: 1,
                        lineHeight: 18,
                      }}
                    >
                      Referral bonus of{" "}
                      {formatPrice(referralAmount, booking.currency)} will be
                      deducted at checkout
                    </AppText>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <FaGift
                      size={12}
                      color={c.green}
                      style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
                    />
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: c.green,
                        flex: 1,
                        lineHeight: 18,
                      }}
                    >
                      Apply your {formatPrice(referralAmount, booking.currency)}{" "}
                      referral bonus using the slider above
                    </AppText>
                  </>
                )}
              </View>
            ) : null}

            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textMuted, lineHeight: 17 }}
            >
              By proceeding, you agree to our{" "}
              <AppText
                onPress={() =>
                  Linking.openURL("https://skilledproz.com/refund-policy")
                }
                style={{
                  color: c.orange,
                  textDecorationLine: "underline",
                  fontWeight: "600",
                }}
              >
                Refund Policy
              </AppText>
              . Platform fees are non-refundable.
            </AppText>

            <Pressable
              onPress={onTogglePayOptions}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                {
                  width: "100%",
                  paddingVertical: 12,
                  borderRadius: 9,
                  alignItems: "center",
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  gap: 6,
                  backgroundColor: showPayOptions ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                  borderWidth: showPayOptions ? 1 : 0,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              {showPayOptions ? (
                <>
                  <FaChevronUp size={12} color={c.textDim} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: c.textDim,
                    }}
                  >
                    Hide Payment Options
                  </AppText>
                </>
              ) : isPaymentPending ? (
                <>
                  <FaBolt size={12} color="#fff" />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    Choose a Different Method
                  </AppText>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FaCreditCard size={12} color="#fff" />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    Pay Now
                  </AppText>
                </>
              )}
            </Pressable>

            {showPayOptions ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  gap: 8,
                  paddingTop: 4,
                  borderTopColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.2)",
                  borderTopWidth: 1,
                }}
              >
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => onSuccess?.("Opening card checkout…")}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    {
                      height: 42,
                      borderRadius: 10,
                      alignItems: "center",
                      justifyContent: "center",
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      gap: 6,
                      backgroundColor: c.orange,
                      opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <FaCreditCard size={12} color="#fff" />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    Pay by Card
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  };

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // renderPaymentCard — receipt view
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  const renderPaymentCard = () => {
    if (!payment) return null;

    const useBreakdown = feeBreakdown && !feeBreakdown.isActual;
    const cur =
      (useBreakdown ? feeBreakdown.currency : payment.currency) || "NGN";
    const cardFeePercent = getFeePercent(cur);

    let total = useBreakdown ? feeBreakdown.total : payment.amount;
    let platformFee = useBreakdown
      ? feeBreakdown.platformFee
      : payment.platformFee;
    let workerPayout = useBreakdown
      ? feeBreakdown.workerPayout
      : payment.workerPayout;

    if (useBreakdown && referralApplied && booking.currency === "NGN") {
      total = Math.max(0, total - referralAmount);
    }

    const statusColor =
      {
        PENDING: "#fbbf24",
        HELD: "#818cf8",
        RELEASED: "#22c55e",
        REFUNDED: "#ef4444",
        FAILED: "#ef4444",
      }[payment.status] || c.textDim;

    return (
      <View
        style={{
          backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
          borderColor: c.border,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderRadius: 14,
          padding: 16,
          gap: 4,
        }}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: "700",
            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 1,
            color: c.textDim,
            marginBottom: 10,
          }}
        >
          Payment
        </AppText>
        <PayRow label="Total" value={formatPrice(total, cur)} c={c} />
        <PayRow
          label={`Platform Fee (${cardFeePercent}%)`}
          value={formatPrice(platformFee, cur)}
          muted
          c={c}
        />
        <PayRow
          label="Worker Payout"
          value={formatPrice(workerPayout, cur)}
          green
          c={c}
        />
        <View
          style={{ height: 1, backgroundColor: c.border, marginVertical: 4 }}
        />
        <PayRow label="Provider" value={payment.provider} capitalize c={c} />
        <PayRow
          label="Status"
          extra={
            <View
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 10,
                paddingVertical: 2,
                borderRadius: 10,
                backgroundColor: `${statusColor}22`,
                borderColor: `${statusColor}55`,
                borderWidth: 1,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: statusColor,
                  letterSpacing: 0.4,
                  textTransform: "uppercase",
                }}
              >
                {payment.status}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          }
          c={c}
        />
        {payment.providerRef ? (
          <PayRow label="Ref" value={payment.providerRef} mono c={c} />
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  };

  const isPending = !payment || payment.status === "PENDING";

  return <View>{isPending ? renderFeeBreakdown() : renderPaymentCard()}</View>;
}
