// src/components/booking/BookingDetailSidebar.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/booking/BookingDetail/BookingDetailSidebar.jsx.
//
// Structure:
//   · Party card     — avatar + name + phone + Send Message
//   · Actions card   — role-conditional action list
//
// Role branches preserved verbatim:
//   · isWorker:
//       EmergencyContact / SOSButton / AcceptBooking (PENDING) /
//       GpsCheckIn (ACCEPTED + HELD) / waiting banner (ACCEPTED + no payment) /
//       GpsCheckIn (IN_PROGRESS) / Cancel box
//   · isHirer:
//       EmergencyContact display / InsuranceAddon (ACCEPTED + not retained) /
//       Release Payment (HELD) / Cancel box
//   · Both: Video call + Raise Dispute
//
// Retained staff guard hides: Accept Booking, GPS check-in, Insurance.
//
// Note: EmergencyContact / SOSButton / GpsCheckIn / InsuranceAddon /
// VideoCallButton are separate components. This file imports them; if
// they don't exist yet, the sub-action row is silently omitted (guarded
// with local light wrappers that render nothing when the child returns
// null).

import React from "react";
import { Image, Linking, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import {
  FaPhone,
  FaCommentDots,
  FaExclamationTriangle,

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ActionBtn({ label, color, loading, onPress, style }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const palette = actionPalette(color, c, loading);

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={loading}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.actionBtn,
        {
          backgroundColor: palette.bg,
          borderColor: palette.border,
          borderWidth: palette.border === "transparent" ? 0 : 1,
          opacity: loading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 13,
          fontWeight: "700",
          color: palette.fg,
          textAlign: "center",
        }}
      >
        {loading ? "…" : label}
      </AppText>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

function actionPalette(color, c, loading) {
  switch (color) {
    case "green":
      return { bg: c.green, fg: c.bg, border: "transparent" };
    case "orange":
      return { bg: c.orange, fg: c.bg, border: "transparent" };
    case "indigo":
      return {
        bg: "rgba(129,140,248,0.15)",
        fg: "#818cf8",
        border: "rgba(129,140,248,0.3)",
      };
    case "red":
      return {
        bg: c.redDim,
        fg: c.red,
        border: "rgba(239,68,68,0.3)",
      };
    case "redOutline":
      return {
        bg: "transparent",
        fg: c.red,
        border: c.red,
      };
    case "outline":
    default:
      return {
        bg: "transparent",
        fg: c.textDim,
        border: c.border,
      };
  }
}

// ── Cancel box ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CancelBox({
  show,
  reason,
  reasonError,
  acting,
  onOpen,
  onClose,
  onChangeReason,
  onConfirm,
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  if (!show) {
    return (
      <ActionBtn
        label={t("booking.cancelBooking") || "Cancel Booking"}
        color="redOutline"
        onPress={onOpen}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.cancelBox}>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 13,
          fontWeight: "600",
          color: c.textDim,
          marginBottom: 4,
        }}
      >
        Reason <AppText style={{ color: c.red }}>*</AppText>
      </AppText>
      <View
        style={[
          styles.cancelInputWrap,
          {
            borderColor: reasonError ? c.red : c.border,
            backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 13,
            color: c.textMuted,
            position: "absolute",
            top: 10,
            left: 12,
          }}
        >
          {/* RN TextInput is added below; placeholder retained for compactness */}
        </AppText>
        <CancelInput
          value={reason}
          onChange={onChangeReason}
          placeholder="Please explain why you are cancelling…"
        />
      </View>
      {reasonError ? (
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.red, marginTop: 4 }}>
          {reasonError}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={onConfirm}
          disabled={acting}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.cancelConfirm,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.red,
              opacity: acting ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}>
            {acting ? "…" : "Confirm Cancellation"}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
        <Pressable
          onPress={onClose}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.cancelAbort,
            {
              borderColor: c.border,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
          >
            Keep Booking
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Cancel input — isolated so we can import TextInput cleanly ─────────
function CancelInput({ value, onChange, placeholder }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const React_TextInput = require("react-native").TextInput;
  return (
    <React_TextInput
      value={value}
      onChangeText={onChange}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
      multiline
      numberOfLines={3}
      textAlignVertical="top"
      style={{
        minHeight: 76,
        padding: 10,
        color: c.text,
        fontSize: 13,
        lineHeight: 18,
      }}
    />
  );
}

// ── Main component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function BookingDetailSidebar({
  booking,
  payment,
  isHirer,
  isWorker,
  other,
  userId,
  acting,
  emergencyContact,
  showCancel,
  cancelReason,
  cancelError,
  onCancelOpen,
  onCancelClose,
  onCancelReasonChange,
  onCancelSubmit,
  onShowDispute,
  onSuccess,
  refetch,
  updateStatus,
  onRelease,
  onMessage,
  onVideoCall,
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const isRetainedStaff = booking?.source === "RETAINED_STAFF";

  const openProfile = () => {
    if (!other?.id) return;
    // Navigation is managed by the parent screen; safe no-op here.
  };

  const callPhone = () => {
    if (other?.phone) Linking.openURL(`tel:${other.phone}`);
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
      {/* ══════════ PARTY CARD ══════════ */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.partyCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 10,
            fontWeight: "700",
            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 1,
            color: c.orange,
          }}
        >
          {isHirer ? "Worker" : "Hirer"}
        </AppText>

        <Pressable onPress={openProfile}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.partyAvatar,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            {other?.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: other.avatar }}
                style={styles.partyAvatarImg}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
              >
                {other?.firstName?.[0]}
                {other?.lastName?.[0]}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        </Pressable>

        <Pressable onPress={openProfile}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
            {other?.firstName || "Unknown"} {other?.lastName || "User"}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {other?.phone ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={callPhone}
            style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}
          >
            <FaPhone size={12} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim }}>
              {other.phone}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}

        <Pressable
          onPress={onMessage}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.messageBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
              borderColor: c.orange,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaCommentDots size={12} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.orange,
              marginLeft: 6,
            }}
          >
            Send Message
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ══════════ ACTIONS CARD ══════════ */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.actionsCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: "700",
            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 1,
            color: c.textDim,
            marginBottom: 4,
          }}
        >
          Actions
        </AppText>

        {/* ── WORKER BRANCH ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {isWorker && (
          <>
            <EmergencyContact
              bookingId={booking.id}
              bookingStatus={booking.status}
              isWorker={isWorker}
              existing={emergencyContact}
              onSaved={() => refetch && refetch()}
            />

            <SOSButton
              bookingId={booking.id}
              bookingStatus={booking.status}
              isWorker={isWorker}
              sosActivatedAt={booking.sosActivatedAt}
              sosResolvedAt={booking.sosResolvedAt}
              onUpdate={() => refetch && refetch()}
            />

            {!isRetainedStaff && booking.status === "PENDING" && (
              <ActionBtn
                label="Accept Booking"
                color="green"
                loading={acting}
                onPress={() => updateStatus("ACCEPTED")}
              />
            )}

            {!isRetainedStaff &&
              booking.status === "ACCEPTED" &&
              payment?.status === "HELD" && (
                <GpsCheckIn
                  bookingId={booking.id}
                  status={booking.status}
                  isWorker={isWorker}
                  jobLatitude={booking.latitude}
                  jobLongitude={booking.longitude}
                  onSuccess={(updated) => {
                    refetch && refetch();
                    onSuccess?.(
                      updated.status === "IN_PROGRESS"
                        ? "Checked in — job is now in progress."
                        : "Checked out — job marked as completed.",
                    );
                  }}
                />
              )}

            {!isRetainedStaff &&
              booking.status === "ACCEPTED" &&
              (!payment || payment.status === "PENDING") && (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.waitingPayment,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: "rgba(251,191,36,0.1)",
                      borderColor: "rgba(251,191,36,0.25)",
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <FaExclamationCircle size={12} color="#fbbf24" />
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 13,
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: "#fbbf24",
                      marginLeft: 6,
                      flex: 1,
                    }}
                  >
                    Waiting for hirer to complete payment before you can check
                    in.
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}

            {!isRetainedStaff && booking.status === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
              <GpsCheckIn
                bookingId={booking.id}
                status={booking.status}
                isWorker={isWorker}
                jobLatitude={booking.latitude}
                jobLongitude={booking.longitude}
                onSuccess={() => {
                  refetch && refetch();
                  onSuccess?.("Checked out — job marked as completed.");
                }}
              />
            )}

            {["PENDING", "ACCEPTED"].includes(booking.status) && (
              <CancelBox
                show={showCancel}
                reason={cancelReason}
                reasonError={cancelError}
                acting={acting}
                onOpen={onCancelOpen}
                onClose={onCancelClose}
                onChangeReason={onCancelReasonChange}
                onConfirm={onCancelSubmit}
              />
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {/* ── HIRER BRANCH ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {isHirer && (
          <>
            {emergencyContact?.name ? (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.emergencyCard,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.06)",
                    borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: c.red,
                    textTransform: "uppercase",
                    letterSpacing: 0.8,
                    marginBottom: 8,
                  }}
                >
                  <FaExclamationTriangle size={11} color={c.red} /> Worker's
                  Emergency Contact
                </AppText>
                <InfoRow label="Name" value={emergencyContact.name} />
                <InfoRow
                  label="Phone"
                  value={emergencyContact.phone}
                  valueStyle={{ color: c.red }}
                />
                {emergencyContact.relationship ? (
                  <InfoRow
                    label="Relation"
                    value={emergencyContact.relationship}
                  />
                ) : null}
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {!isRetainedStaff && booking.status === "ACCEPTED" && (
              <InsuranceAddon
                bookingId={booking.id}
                booking={booking}
                onPurchased={() => onSuccess?.("Insurance activated.")}
              />
            )}

            {payment?.status === "HELD" && (
              <ActionBtn
                label="Release Payment"
                color="green"
                onPress={onRelease}
              />
            )}

            {["PENDING", "ACCEPTED"].includes(booking.status) && (
              <CancelBox
                show={showCancel}
                reason={cancelReason}
                reasonError={cancelError}
                acting={acting}
                onOpen={onCancelOpen}
                onClose={onCancelClose}
                onChangeReason={onCancelReasonChange}
                onConfirm={onCancelSubmit}
              />
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {/* Video call */}
        {(isHirer || isWorker) && (
          <VideoCallButton
            bookingId={booking.id}
            bookingStatus={booking.status}
            userId={userId}
            hirerId={booking.hirerId}
            workerId={booking.workerId}
          />
        )}

        {/* Raise dispute — ACCEPTED / IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED / PAID */}
        {(isHirer || isWorker) &&
          ["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS", "COMPLETED", "PAID"].includes(
            booking.status,
          ) && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={onShowDispute}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.actionBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                  borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.3)",
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <FaExclamationTriangle size={11} color={c.red} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.red,
                  marginLeft: 6,
                }}
              >
                Raise a Dispute
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}

        {!isHirer && !isWorker && (
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              color: c.textMuted,
              textAlign: "center",
              paddingVertical: 8,
            }}
          >
            No actions available.
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function InfoRow({ label, value, valueStyle }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        justifyContent: "space-between",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 8,
        paddingVertical: 5,
      }}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>{label}</AppText>
      <AppText
        style={[
          {
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.text,
            textAlign: "right",
          },
          valueStyle,
        ]}
        numberOfLines={2}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/booking/BookingInvoice.js
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import * as Print from "expo-print";
import * as Sharing from "expo-sharing";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { FaFileAlt, FaSpinner } from "../../icons/fa";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";

function buildInvoiceHtml(booking) {
  const cur = booking.currency || "NGN";
  const amount = booking.payment?.amount || booking.agreedRate || 0;
  const platformFee = booking.payment?.platformFee || 0;
  const workerPayout = booking.payment?.workerPayout || 0;
  const scheduled = booking.scheduledAt
    ? new Date(booking.scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
        day: "numeric",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
      })
    : "—";
  return `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><style>
    *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    body{font-family:sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#111;padding:40px}
    .header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:40px}
    .logo{font-size:24px;font-weight:900}
    .logo span{color:#f97316}
    .meta{text-align:right}
    .meta h1{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:#f97316}
    .meta p{font-size:13px;color:#666;margin-top:4px}
    hr{border:none;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;margin:24px 0}
    .parties{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;margin-bottom:32px}
    .party h3{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#999;margin-bottom:8px}
    .party p{font-size:14px;color:#111;font-weight:600}
    table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:24px}
    th{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#999;font-weight:600;padding:8px 12px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb}
    td{padding:12px;font-size:13px;color:#111;border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6}
    td:last-child{text-align:right;font-weight:600}
    .totals{margin-left:auto;width:240px}
    .total-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 0;font-size:13px;color:#666}
    .total-row.final{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:#111;border-top:2px solid #111;padding-top:12px;margin-top:6px}
    .footer{margin-top:48px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#999}
  </style></head><body>
    <div class="header">
      <div class="logo">Skilled<span>Proz</span></div>
      <div class="meta"><h1>INVOICE</h1>
        <p>#SKP-${(booking.id || "").slice(-8).toUpperCase()}</p>
        <p>Date: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" })}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="parties">
      <div class="party"><h3>Billed To (Hirer)</h3>
        <p>${booking.hirer?.firstName || ""} ${booking.hirer?.lastName || ""}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="party"><h3>Service Provider (Worker)</h3>
        <p>${booking.worker?.firstName || ""} ${booking.worker?.lastName || ""}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <hr/>
    <table><thead><tr>
      <th>Service</th><th>Category</th><th>Date</th><th>Duration</th><th>Amount</th>
    </tr></thead><tbody><tr>
      <td>${booking.title || "—"}</td>
      <td>${booking.category?.name || "—"}</td>
      <td>${scheduled}</td>
      <td>${booking.estimatedHours ? `${booking.estimatedHours}h` : "—"}</td>
      <td>${cur} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString()}</td>
    </tr></tbody></table>
    <div class="totals">
      <div class="total-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>${cur} ${Number(booking.agreedRate || 0).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
      ${
        booking.payment
          ? `
        <div class="total-row"><span>Platform Fee</span><span>− ${cur} ${Number(platformFee).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
        <div class="total-row"><span>Worker Payout</span><span>${cur} ${Number(workerPayout).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
      `
          : ""
      }
      <div class="total-row final"><span>Total Paid</span><span>${cur} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="footer">
      <p>SkilledProz Global Skills Marketplace · support@skilledproz.com</p>
      <p style="margin-top:6px;">Booking ID: ${booking.id} · Status: ${booking.status}</p>
    </div>
  </body></html>`;
}

export default function BookingInvoice({ booking, trigger = true }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handlePrint = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const html = buildInvoiceHtml(booking);
      const { uri } = await Print.printToFileAsync({ html, base64: false });
      if (await Sharing.isAvailableAsync()) {
        await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, {
          mimeType: "application/pdf",
          dialogTitle: "Invoice",
        });
      } else {
        toast.info("Sharing not available on this device.");
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to generate invoice.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={handlePrint}
      disabled={loading}
      style={[styles.btn, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <FaSpinner size={11} color={c.textDim} />
      ) : (
        <FaFileAlt size={11} color={c.textDim} />
      )}
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        tone="dim"
        style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
      >
        {t("booking.button.downloadInvoice")}
      </AppText>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  btn: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 10,
    borderRadius: 8,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
});

// src/components/booking/BookingReleaseDetails.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/booking/BookingReleaseDetails.jsx.
//
// Renders nothing when `payment.releases` is empty (web returns null).
// Otherwise shows a collapsible card:
//   · Header — icon + title ("Release Details (N)" or "Payment Fully Released")
//              + subtitle ("X released · Y still in escrow")
//              + progress bar + % + chevron
//   · Body   — summary block (workerPayoutTotal / released / remaining)
//              + release timeline (each release: amount + latest badge +
//                date + releasedBy + note + before/after snapshot)
//
// Sizes match the web CSS at phone root 14.

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import {
  FaChevronDown,
  FaChevronUp,
  FaMoneyBillWave,
  FaUser,
  FaClock,
  FaLock,
  FaCheckCircle,
} from "../../icons/fa";

function formatMoney(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const n = Number(amount);
  if (amount == null || isNaN(n)) return "—";
  return `${currency} ${n.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

function formatDateTime(date) {
  if (!date) return "—";
  const d = new Date(date);
  return `${d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  })} · ${d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}`;
}

export default function BookingReleaseDetails({
  payment,
  currency: currencyProp,
  defaultOpen = false,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const releases = Array.isArray(payment?.releases) ? payment.releases : [];
  const hasReleases = releases.length > 0;

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen);

  const currency = currencyProp || payment?.currency || "NGN";
  const workerPayout = Number(payment?.workerPayout) || 0;
  const releasedAmount = Number(payment?.releasedAmount) || 0;
  const remaining = useMemo(
    () => parseFloat(Math.max(0, workerPayout - releasedAmount).toFixed(2)),
    [workerPayout, releasedAmount],
  );
  const releaseCount = Number(payment?.releaseCount) || releases.length;
  const releasedPct =
    workerPayout > 0 ? Math.round((releasedAmount / workerPayout) * 100) : 0;
  const isFullyReleased =
    workerPayout > 0 && remaining === 0 && releasedAmount > 0;

  const sortedReleases = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...releases].sort(
        (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt),
      ),
    [releases],
  );

  // Hide the card entirely when there's nothing to show.
  if (!hasReleases) return null;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.section,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* ─── HEADER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.header,
          pressed && { backgroundColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.02)" },
        ]}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={
          open ? "Hide release details" : "Show release details"
        }
      >
        <View style={styles.headerLeft}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.headerIcon,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
            ]}
          >
            {isFullyReleased ? (
              <FaCheckCircle size={14} color={c.orange} />
            ) : (
              <FaMoneyBillWave size={14} color={c.orange} />
            )}
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <AppText
              style={[styles.headerTitle, { color: c.text }]}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {isFullyReleased
                ? "Payment Fully Released"
                : `Release Details (${releaseCount})`}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={[styles.headerSub, { color: c.textDim }]}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {formatMoney(releasedAmount, currency)} released
              {!isFullyReleased ? (
                <> · {formatMoney(remaining, currency)} still in escrow</>
              ) : null}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.headerRight}>
          {/* Progress bar */}
          <View
            style={[
              styles.progressWrap,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View
              style={[
                styles.progressBar,
                {
                  width: `${Math.min(100, releasedPct)}%`,
                  backgroundColor: isFullyReleased ? c.green : c.orange,
                },
              ]}
            />
          </View>
          <AppText style={[styles.progressLabel, { color: c.textDim }]}>
            {releasedPct}%
          </AppText>
          {open ? (
            <FaChevronUp size={10} color={c.textMuted} />
          ) : (
            <FaChevronDown size={10} color={c.textMuted} />
          )}
        </View>
      </Pressable>

      {/* ─── BODY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {open && (
        <View style={[styles.body, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
          {/* Summary */}
          <View style={styles.summary}>
            <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, flex: 1 }}>
                Worker payout total
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}
                numberOfLines={1}
              >
                {formatMoney(workerPayout, currency)}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, flex: 1 }}>
                Released so far
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.orange }}
                numberOfLines={1}
              >
                {formatMoney(releasedAmount, currency)} ({releasedPct}%)
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <View
              style={[styles.summaryDivider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]}
            />
            <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.text,
                  flex: 1,
                }}
              >
                Remaining in escrow
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: "800",
                  color: isFullyReleased ? c.green : c.orange,
                }}
                numberOfLines={1}
              >
                {formatMoney(remaining, currency)}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            {isFullyReleased ? (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.fullyReleasedNote,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
                    borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.3)",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaLock size={11} color={c.green} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: c.green,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    marginLeft: 6,
                    flex: 1,
                    lineHeight: 16,
                  }}
                >
                  All funds have been released. This payment is closed.
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          {/* Timeline */}
          <View style={[styles.timelineWrap, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.textMuted,
                textTransform: "uppercase",
                letterSpacing: 1,
                marginBottom: 8,
                marginTop: 8,
              }}
            >
              Release history
            </AppText>
            {sortedReleases.map((r, i) => {
              const isLatest = i === 0;
              const by = r.releasedBy;
              const releasedByLabel = by
                ? by.role === "HIRER"
                  ? `Hirer · ${by.firstName ?? ""} ${by.lastName ?? ""}`.trim()
                  : by.role === "ADMIN"
                    ? `Admin · ${by.firstName ?? ""} ${by.lastName ?? ""}`.trim()
                    : `${by.firstName ?? ""} ${by.lastName ?? ""}`.trim() ||
                      "System"
                : "System";

              return (
                <View key={r.id} style={styles.timelineItem}>
                  {/* Marker column */}
                  <View style={styles.markerCol}>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.dot,
                        isLatest
                          ? { backgroundColor: c.orange }
                          : {
                              backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                              borderColor: c.orange,
                              borderWidth: 2,
                            },
                      ]}
                    />
                    {i < sortedReleases.length - 1 ? (
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.connector,
                          { backgroundColor: c.border },
                        ]}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                  </View>

                  {/* Body column */}
                  <View style={styles.timelineBody}>
                    <View style={styles.timelineTopRow}>
                      <AppText
                        style={[styles.timelineAmount, { color: c.text }]}
                        numberOfLines={1}
                      >
                        {formatMoney(r.amount, r.currency || currency)}
                      </AppText>
                      {isLatest ? (
                        <View
                          style={[
                            styles.latestBadge,
                            {
                              backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                              borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                            },
                          ]}
                        >
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 9,
                              fontWeight: "800",
                              color: c.orange,
                              letterSpacing: 0.5,
                              textTransform: "uppercase",
                            }}
                          >
                            Latest
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                      ) : null}
                    </View>

                    <View style={styles.timelineMeta}>
                      <View style={styles.metaItem}>
                        <FaClock size={9} color={c.textMuted} />
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 10,
                            color: c.textDim,
                            marginLeft: 4,
                          }}
                        >
                          {formatDateTime(r.createdAt)}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                      <View style={styles.metaItem}>
                        <FaUser size={9} color={c.textMuted} />
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 10,
                            color: c.textDim,
                            marginLeft: 4,
                            flexShrink: 1,
                          }}
                          numberOfLines={1}
                        >
                          {releasedByLabel}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    </View>

                    {r.note ? (
                      <AppText
                        style={{
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: c.textDim,
                          fontStyle: "italic",
                          marginTop: 4,
                          lineHeight: 16,
                        }}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontStyle: "normal",
                            fontWeight: "700",
                            color: c.textMuted,
                          }}
                        >
                          Note:{" "}
                        </AppText>
                        {r.note}
                      </AppText>
                    ) : null}

                    {(r.remainingBefore != null ||
                      r.remainingAfter != null) && (
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.snapshot,
                          {
                            backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                            borderColor: c.border,
                          },
                        ]}
                      >
                        {r.remainingBefore != null ? (
                          <SnapshotItem
                            label="Before"
                            value={formatMoney(
                              r.remainingBefore,
                              r.currency || currency,
                            )}
                          />
                        ) : null}
                        {r.remainingAfter != null ? (
                          <SnapshotItem
                            label="After"
                            value={formatMoney(
                              r.remainingAfter,
                              r.currency || currency,
                            )}
                          />
                        ) : null}
                      </View>
                    )}
                  </View>
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function SnapshotItem({ label, value }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 9,
          color: c.textMuted,
          fontWeight: "700",
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          letterSpacing: 0.6,
          marginBottom: 1,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}
        numberOfLines={1}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Image, Pressable, TextInput, View } from "react-native";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import Skeleton from "../Skeleton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { getHirerFeeRate } from "../../utils/pricing";
import {
  FaShieldCheck,
  FaCheck,
  FaHandshake,
  FaLock,
  FaStar,
  FaMapPin,
  FaCommentDots,
  FaCalendarAlt,
  FaClock,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
} from "../../icons/fa";

const CURRENCY_SYMBOLS = {
  NGN: "₦",
  USD: "$",
  EUR: "€",
  GBP: "£",
  USDC: "USDC",
  USDT: "USDT",
};

function formatPrice(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const symbol = CURRENCY_SYMBOLS[currency] || currency;
  const num = Number(amount) || 0;
  return `${symbol}${num.toFixed(2).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",")}`;
}

const DURATION_OPTIONS = [
  {
    unit: "hours",
    label: "Hourly",
    rateKey: "hourlyRate",
    suffix: "/hr",
    inputLabel: "Hours",
  },
  {
    unit: "days",
    label: "Daily",
    rateKey: "dailyRate",
    suffix: "/day",
    inputLabel: "Days",
  },
  {
    unit: "weeks",
    label: "Weekly",
    rateKey: "weeklyRate",
    suffix: "/wk",
    inputLabel: "Weeks",
  },
  {
    unit: "months",
    label: "Monthly",
    rateKey: "monthlyRate",
    suffix: "/mo",
    inputLabel: "Months",
  },
  {
    unit: "years",
    label: "Yearly",
    rateKey: "yearlyRate",
    suffix: "/yr",
    inputLabel: "Years",
  },
  {
    unit: "custom",
    label: "Custom",
    rateKey: "customRate",
    suffix: "",
    inputLabel: "Description",
  },
];

export default function BookingWorkerInfo({

}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const format = (amount) => formatPrice(amount, lockedCurrency);
  const currencySymbol = CURRENCY_SYMBOLS[lockedCurrency] || lockedCurrency;
  const feeRate = getHirerFeeRate(lockedCurrency);
  const feePercent = Math.round(feeRate * 100);

  const [quantityInput, setQuantityInput] = useState(
    String(form.quantity || 1),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setQuantityInput(String(form.quantity || 1));
  }, [form.quantity]);

  const effectiveTotal = (() => {
    if (isNegotiated && negotiatedRate) return parseFloat(negotiatedRate);
    if (selectedUnit === "custom") {
      const customRate = form.rate || worker?.customRate || 0;
      const customQty = form.quantity || 1;
      return customRate * customQty;
    }
    if (estFees) return estFees.subtotal;
    return 0;
  })();

  return (

            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>

                onPress={onBrowseWorkers}

                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, lineHeight: 15 }}
                >
                  Select how you want to engage this worker. The rate is set by
                  the worker and cannot be modified.
                </AppText>
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}
                >
                  {(availableUnits.length > 0
                    ? availableUnits
                    : [DURATION_OPTIONS[0]]
                  ).map((opt) => {
                    const rate = worker[opt.rateKey];
                    const hasRate = rate > 0;
                    const active = selectedUnit === opt.unit;
                    return (
                      <Pressable
                        key={opt.unit}
                        onPress={() => hasRate && setSelectedUnit(opt.unit)}
                        disabled={!hasRate}
                        style={({ pressed }) => [
                          {
                            flexBasis: "48%",
                            flexGrow: 1,
                            paddingHorizontal: 10,
                            paddingVertical: 12,
                            backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                            borderWidth: 1.5,
                            borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                            borderRadius: 12,
                            alignItems: "center",
                            gap: 3,
                            opacity: !hasRate ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                          },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 11,
                            fontWeight: "700",
                            color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                          }}
                        >
                          {opt.label}
                        </AppText>
                        {hasRate ? (
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: "800",
                              color: active ? c.orange : c.text,
                            }}
                          >
                            {`${format(rate)}${opt.suffix}`}
                          </AppText>
                        ) : (
                          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>
                            Not offered
                          </AppText>
                        )}
                      </Pressable>
                    );
                  })}
                </View>
              </View>

              <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <RateBox label="Agreed Rate" c={c}>
                    {isNegotiated && negotiatedRate
                      ? `${format(parseFloat(negotiatedRate))} · Negotiated`
                      : `${format(lockedRate)}${currentOption?.suffix || ""}`}
                  </RateBox>
                </View>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <RateBox label="Currency" c={c}>
                    {lockedCurrency}
                  </RateBox>
                </View>
              </View>

              {selectedUnit === "custom" ? (
                <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
                  <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                    <AppText style={label(c)}>
                      Rate per {currentOption?.label?.toLowerCase()}{" "}
                      <AppText style={{ color: c.orange }}>*</AppText>
                    </AppText>
                    <View style={inputWrap(c)}>
                      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, color: c.textMuted }}>
                        {currencySymbol}
                      </AppText>
                      <TextInput
                        value={String(form.rate || worker.customRate || 0)}
                        editable={false}
                        style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 14, color: c.text }}
                      />
                      <FaLock size={12} color={c.textMuted} />
                    </View>
                    <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
                      Rate set by worker — cannot be modified
                    </AppText>
                  </View>

                  <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                    <AppText style={label(c)}>Custom Label</AppText>
                    <View
                      style={{
                        backgroundColor: c.bgInput || c.bgCard,
                        borderWidth: 1,
                        borderColor: c.border,
                        borderRadius: 12,
                        paddingHorizontal: 14,
                        paddingVertical: 10,
                        minHeight: 48,
                      }}
                    >
                      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.text }}>
                        {form.customLabel ||
                          worker.customRateLabel ||
                          "No custom label provided"}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                    <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
                      Label provided by the worker
                    </AppText>
                  </View>

                  <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                    <AppText style={label(c)}>
                      Number of {currentOption?.label?.toLowerCase()}{" "}
                      <AppText style={{ color: c.orange }}>*</AppText>
                    </AppText>
                    <TextInput
                      value={quantityInput}
                      onChangeText={(val) => {
                        setQuantityInput(val);
                        if (val === "") return;
                        const num = parseFloat(val);
                        if (!isNaN(num) && num >= 1) set("quantity", num);
                      }}
                      onBlur={() => {
                        if (
                          quantityInput === "" ||
                          parseFloat(quantityInput) < 1
                        ) {
                          setQuantityInput("1");
                          set("quantity", 1);
                        }
                      }}
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      placeholder="1"
                      placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                      style={input(c)}
                    />
                  </View>
                </View>
              ) : currentOption ? (
                <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                  <AppText style={label(c)}>
                    Number of {currentOption.inputLabel}{" "}
                    <AppText style={{ color: c.orange }}>*</AppText>
                  </AppText>
                  <View style={inputWrap(c)}>
                    <FaClock size={14} color={c.textMuted} />
                    <TextInput
                      value={form.estimatedValue}
                      onChangeText={(t) => set("estimatedValue", t)}
                      keyboardType="numeric"
                      placeholder="e.g. 4"
                      placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                      style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 14, color: c.text }}
                    />
                  </View>
                  {form.estimatedValue ? (
                    <View
                      style={{
                        flexDirection: "row",
                        alignItems: "center",
                        gap: 4,
                        marginTop: 2,
                      }}
                    >
                      <FaCalendarAlt size={11} color={c.textDim} />
                      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim }}>
                        {form.estimatedValue}{" "}
                        {currentOption.inputLabel.toLowerCase()}
                        {currentOption.unit !== "hours" ? (
                          <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
                            {currentOption.unit === "days"
                              ? ` ≈ ${parseFloat(form.estimatedValue) * 8}h`
                              : currentOption.unit === "weeks"
                                ? ` ≈ ${parseFloat(form.estimatedValue) * 40}h`
                                : currentOption.unit === "months"
                                  ? ` ≈ ${parseFloat(form.estimatedValue) * 160}h`
                                  : currentOption.unit === "years"
                                    ? ` ≈ ${parseFloat(form.estimatedValue) * 1920}h`
                                    : ""}
                          </AppText>

                      </AppText>
                    </View>

                </View>
              ) : null}
            </>
          )}

          <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => {
                setIsNegotiated((v) => !v);
                if (isNegotiated) {

                  setNegotiationNote("");
                }
              }}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                {
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: 12,
                  padding: 14,
                  backgroundColor: isNegotiated
                    ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.06)"
                    : c.bgCard,
                  borderWidth: 1.5,
                  borderColor: isNegotiated ? c.orange : c.border,
                  borderRadius: 14,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },

              <View
                style={{
                  width: 32,
                  height: 32,
                  borderRadius: 16,
                  backgroundColor: isNegotiated ? c.orangeDim : c.bgPanel,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: isNegotiated ? c.orange : c.border,
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  flexShrink: 0,

                {isNegotiated ? (
                  <FaCheck size={14} color={c.orange} />

                    ? "Using negotiated rate"

                  style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
                >

              <View

                  height: 18,
                  borderRadius: 9,
                  backgroundColor: isNegotiated ? c.orange : "transparent",
                  borderWidth: 2,
                  borderColor: isNegotiated ? c.orange : c.border,
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              />
            </Pressable>

            {isNegotiated ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  padding: 14,
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.04)",
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                  borderRadius: 12,

                    <AppText style={{ color: c.orange }}>*</AppText>

                    <FaCommentDots size={14} color={c.textMuted} />
                    <TextInput

                  </AppText>
                  {lockedRate > 0 && negotiatedRate ? (

                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: "600",

                      {parseFloat(negotiatedRate) < lockedRate

                          ? `🟡 ${format(
                              parseFloat(negotiatedRate) - lockedRate,
                            )} above listed rate`
                          : "✅ Same as listed rate"}
                    </AppText>
                  ) : null}
                </View>

                <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                  <AppText style={label(c)}>
                    Negotiation Note (optional)
                  </AppText>
                  <TextInput
                    value={negotiationNote}
                    onChangeText={setNegotiationNote}
                    multiline
                    numberOfLines={2}
                    placeholder="e.g. Agreed 10% discount for repeat booking"
                    placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: c.bgInput || c.bgCard,
                      borderWidth: 1,
                      borderColor: c.border,
                      borderRadius: 12,
                      paddingHorizontal: 14,
                      paddingVertical: 10,
                      fontSize: 13,
                      color: c.text,
                      minHeight: 60,
                      textAlignVertical: "top",
                    }}
                  />
                </View>

                <View
                  style={{
                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "flex-start",
                    gap: 6,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: c.border,

                  }}

                  <FaLock size={12} color={c.orange} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      flex: 1,

                      lineHeight: 16,
                    }}
                  >
                    Make sure the worker agreed to this price in the platform
                    Chat before booking. This replaces all duration calculations
                    with a fixed total of{" "}
                    <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
                      {negotiatedRate
                        ? format(parseFloat(negotiatedRate))
                        : format(lockedRate)}
                    </AppText>{" "}
                    for this booking.
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          <View
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 12,
              padding: 14,
              gap: 4,
            }}
          >
            <View
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}
            >

                  fontSize: 11,

                  ? "Agreed Total"
                  : "Estimated Total"}

                <View

                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 3,

                    style={{
                      fontSize: 9,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: c.green,

                      letterSpacing: 0.5,

                  >
                    Negotiated

            </View>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",

              {format(effectiveTotal)}

              style={{
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 12,
                paddingHorizontal: 14,
                paddingVertical: 10,
                gap: 6,
              }}

              <FeeRow label="Subtotal" value={format(estFees.subtotal)} c={c} />

                value={format(parseFloat(negotiatedRate) * feeRate)}
                c={c}
              />
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  borderTopWidth: 1,
                  borderTopColor: c.border,
                  paddingTop: 8,
                  marginTop: 4,

              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}

                  Total to Pay

                  style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.green }}
                >
                  {format(parseFloat(negotiatedRate) * (1 + feeRate))}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {worker.pricingNote ? (
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                gap: 6,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 10,
                padding: 12,

                  {worker.pricingNote}
                </AppText>
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </>

=== FILE: src/components/booking/CryptoRateConverter.js ===
// src/components/booking/CryptoRateConverter.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/payment/CryptoRateConverter.jsx.
//
// · Fetches live fiat↔crypto rates from CoinGecko's public API
// · Refreshes every 30s (configurable via refreshInterval prop)
// · Renders 4 token cards (USDC / USDT / BTC / ETH) with:
//     - live rate in fiat
//     - converted amount in crypto for the current fiatAmount
//     - selection indicator
// · Emits onAmountChange({ token, amount, rate, fiatAmount, fiatCurrency })
//   whenever the crypto amount changes (debounced naturally by state)
//
// Port notes:
//   · navigator.clipboard.writeText → expo-clipboard (guarded require)
//   · <button> → <Pressable>
//   · CSS grid 2-col → flexDirection row + flexWrap (2 columns via width: 48%)
//   · Sizes match CSS at phone root 14

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import {
  FaBitcoin,
  FaDollarSign,
  FaMoneyBillWave,
  FaSync,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaCopy,
} from "../../icons/fa";

// Optional expo-clipboard — guarded
let Clipboard = null;
try {
  Clipboard = require("expo-clipboard");
} catch {}

const CRYPTO_TOKENS = [
  { id: "USDC", label: "USDC", icon: "dollar", coingeckoId: "usd-coin" },
  { id: "USDT", label: "USDT", icon: "bill", coingeckoId: "tether" },
  { id: "BTC", label: "Bitcoin", icon: "bitcoin", coingeckoId: "bitcoin" },
  { id: "ETH", label: "Ethereum", icon: "eth", coingeckoId: "ethereum" },
];

const COINGECKO_IDS = CRYPTO_TOKENS.map((t) => t.coingeckoId).join(",");

function TokenIcon({ iconName, size = 20, color }) {
  if (iconName === "dollar") return <FaDollarSign size={size} color={color} />;
  if (iconName === "bill") return <FaMoneyBillWave size={size} color={color} />;
  if (iconName === "bitcoin") return <FaBitcoin size={size} color={color} />;
  // eth — no direct Ionicon, use diamond outline
  return <FaMoneyBillWave size={size} color={color} />;
}

export default function CryptoRateConverter({
  fiatAmount,
  fiatCurrency = "NGN",
  onAmountChange,
  selectedToken: initialToken = "USDC",
  refreshInterval = 30000,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [rates, setRates] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [selectedToken, setSelectedToken] = useState(initialToken);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const lastEmittedRef = useRef(null);

  const fetchRates = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const url = `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=${COINGECKO_IDS}&vs_currencies=${fiatCurrency.toLowerCase()}`;
      const res = await fetch(url);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      const newRates = {};
      CRYPTO_TOKENS.forEach((token) => {
        const price = data[token.coingeckoId]?.[fiatCurrency.toLowerCase()];
        newRates[token.id] = price || null;
      });
      setRates(newRates);
      setLastUpdated(new Date());
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Network error");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fiatCurrency]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRates();
    const id = setInterval(fetchRates, refreshInterval);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [fetchRates, refreshInterval]);

  const selectedRate = rates?.[selectedToken];
  const cryptoAmount =
    selectedRate && fiatAmount > 0 ? fiatAmount / selectedRate : 0;

  // Emit on change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!onAmountChange || cryptoAmount <= 0) return;
    const payload = {
      token: selectedToken,
      amount: cryptoAmount,
      rate: selectedRate,
      fiatAmount,
      fiatCurrency,
    };
    // Avoid emitting identical payloads multiple times (causes parent re-renders)
    const key = `${payload.token}|${payload.amount.toFixed(8)}|${payload.rate}`;
    if (lastEmittedRef.current === key) return;
    lastEmittedRef.current = key;
    onAmountChange(payload);
  }, [
    cryptoAmount,
    selectedToken,
    selectedRate,
    fiatAmount,
    fiatCurrency,
    onAmountChange,
  ]);

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    if (!cryptoAmount || !selectedToken) return;
    const text = `${cryptoAmount.toFixed(6)} ${selectedToken}`;
    if (Clipboard) {
      try {
        await Clipboard.setStringAsync(text);
        setCopied(true);
        setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
        return;
      } catch {}
    }
    // Fallback if clipboard not available
    setCopied(false);
  };

  // ── Initial loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading && !rates) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.converter,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={{ alignItems: "center", paddingVertical: 24, gap: 8 }}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>
            Loading live exchange rates…
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ── Error ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (error) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.converter,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={{ alignItems: "center", paddingVertical: 20, gap: 10 }}>
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={20} color={c.red} />
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            Could not load rates: {error}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={fetchRates}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.retryBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}>
              Retry
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // MAIN
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.converter,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
          Live Crypto Rates
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>
            {lastUpdated ? `Updated: ${lastUpdated.toLocaleTimeString()}` : "—"}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={fetchRates}
            disabled={loading}
            hitSlop={6}
            style={{ opacity: loading ? 0.4 : 1 }}
          >
            <FaSync size={12} color={c.textDim} />
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Fiat amount */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.fiatBox,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim }}>You pay:</AppText>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: "800",
            color: c.orange,
          }}
        >
          {fiatCurrency} {(Number(fiatAmount) || 0).toFixed(2)}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Token grid */}
      <View style={styles.tokenGrid}>
        {CRYPTO_TOKENS.map((token) => {
          const rate = rates?.[token.id];
          const isSelected = selectedToken === token.id;
          const isZero = rate === null || rate === 0;
          const tokenAmount = rate ? fiatAmount / rate : 0;

          return (
            <Pressable
              key={token.id}
              onPress={() => {
                if (!isZero && rate) setSelectedToken(token.id);
              }}
              disabled={isZero || !rate}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.tokenCard,
                {
                  backgroundColor: isSelected ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: isSelected ? c.orange : c.border,
                  opacity: isZero ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <TokenIcon
                iconName={token.icon}
                size={22}
                color={isSelected ? c.orange : c.textDim}
              />
              <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, marginLeft: 8 }}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: isSelected ? c.orange : c.text,
                  }}
                >
                  {token.label}
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 9, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {rate
                    ? `1 ${token.label} = ${fiatCurrency} ${Number(rate).toFixed(4)}`
                    : "No rate"}
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: isSelected ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                    marginTop: 3,
                  }}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {isSelected && rate
                    ? `${tokenAmount.toFixed(6)} ${token.label}`
                    : rate
                      ? `${tokenAmount.toFixed(6)} ${token.label}`
                      : "—"}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              {isSelected ? (
                <View style={[styles.checkmark, { backgroundColor: c.green }]}>
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 8,
                      fontWeight: "800",
                      color: "#fff",
                    }}
                  >
                    ✓
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ) : null}
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      {/* Result + copy */}
      {selectedRate && cryptoAmount > 0 ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.resultBox,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
              borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.2)",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.resultRow}>
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.text, flex: 1, lineHeight: 18 }}
            >
              You need to send{" "}
              <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.green }}>
                {cryptoAmount.toFixed(6)} {selectedToken}
              </AppText>
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleCopy}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.copyBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: copied ? c.greenDim : c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: copied ? c.green : c.border,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <FaCopy size={10} color={copied ? c.green : c.textDim} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: copied ? c.green : c.textDim,
                  marginLeft: 4,
                }}
              >
                {copied ? "Copied!" : "Copy"}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              color: c.textMuted,
              marginTop: 4,
              lineHeight: 14,
            }}
          >
            Rates are live and may change. The exact amount may vary slightly
            when you complete the transfer.
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/booking/EmergencyContact.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/booking/EmergencyContact.jsx.
//
// Renders only when:
//   · isWorker === true
//   · bookingStatus ∈ ["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"]
//
// Two modes:
//   · Display — name / phone (tappable) / relationship, with Edit button
//   · Edit   — three TextInputs + Save button
//
// Endpoint: PATCH /bookings/:bookingId/emergency-contact
// Payload: { name, phone, relationship }
//
// Guards:
//   · Both name and phone are required (relationship optional)
//   · If `existing` prop updates, fields resync

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Linking,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaUser,
  FaPhone,
  FaEdit,
  FaTimes,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
} from "../../icons/fa";

export default function EmergencyContact({
  bookingId,
  bookingStatus,
  isWorker,
  existing,
  onSaved,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(!existing);
  const [name, setName] = useState(existing?.name || "");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(existing?.phone || "");
  const [rel, setRel] = useState(existing?.relationship || "");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // Sync form fields when `existing` prop updates
  useEffect(() => {
    if (existing) {
      setName(existing.name || "");
      setPhone(existing.phone || "");
      setRel(existing.relationship || "");
      setEditing(false);
    }
  }, [existing?.name, existing?.phone, existing?.relationship]);

  // ── Guards ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!isWorker) return null;
  if (!["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(bookingStatus)) return null;

  // ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!name.trim() || !phone.trim()) {
      setError("Name and phone are required");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await client.patch(`/bookings/${bookingId}/emergency-contact`, {
        name: name.trim(),
        phone: phone.trim(),
        relationship: rel.trim(),
      });
      const saved = {
        name: name.trim(),
        phone: phone.trim(),
        relationship: rel.trim(),
      };
      onSaved?.(saved);
      setEditing(false);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.message || "Save failed. Try again.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // DISPLAY MODE — when we have an existing contact and user isn't editing
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (!editing && existing) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.card,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
          <FaUser size={14} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText style={[styles.cardTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
            Emergency Contact
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setEditing(true)}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.editBtn,
              {
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaEdit size={10} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textDim,
                marginLeft: 4,
              }}
            >
              Edit
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {/* Rows */}
        <ContactRow label="Name" value={existing.name} c={c} />
        <Pressable
          onPress={() =>
            existing.phone && Linking.openURL(`tel:${existing.phone}`)
          }
          style={styles.contactRow}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textMuted }}>Phone</AppText>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
            <FaPhone size={10} color={c.orange} />
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.orange }}
            >
              {existing.phone}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
        {existing.relationship ? (
          <ContactRow
            label="Relationship"
            value={existing.relationship}
            c={c}
          />
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // EDIT MODE
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.card,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
        <FaUser size={14} color={c.orange} />
        <AppText style={[styles.cardTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
          Emergency Contact
        </AppText>
        {existing ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setEditing(false)}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.editBtn,
              {
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaTimes size={10} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textDim,
                marginLeft: 4,
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {/* Hint */}
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, lineHeight: 16 }}>
        Someone we can contact in case of an emergency during this job.
      </AppText>

      {/* Full Name */}
      <FieldInput
        label="Full Name *"
        value={name}
        onChangeText={(v) => {
          setName(v);
          setError("");
        }}
        placeholder="e.g. Amaka Johnson"
        c={c}
      />

      {/* Phone */}
      <FieldInput
        label="Phone Number *"
        value={phone}
        onChangeText={(v) => {
          setPhone(v);
          setError("");
        }}
        placeholder="e.g. +234 801 234 5678"
        keyboardType="phone-pad"
        c={c}
      />

      {/* Relationship */}
      <FieldInput
        label="Relationship"
        value={rel}
        onChangeText={setRel}
        placeholder="e.g. Sister, Friend, Spouse"
        c={c}
      />

      {/* Error */}
      {error ? (
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 4,
            marginTop: 4,
          }}
        >
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={10} color={c.red} />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.red, flex: 1 }}>
            {error}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* Save button */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={handleSave}
        disabled={saving}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.saveBtn,
          {
            backgroundColor: saving ? c.bgInput : c.orange,
            opacity: saving ? 0.6 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {saving ? (
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}>
            <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}>
              Saving…
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}>
            {existing ? "Update Contact" : "Save Emergency Contact"}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Sub-components ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import React from "react";

  FaCheckCircle,
