function fmtTimeDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  const dt = new Date(d);
  return (
    dt.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }) +
    " · " +
    dt.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short" })
  );
}

export default function GpsCard({ label, lat, lng, timestamp, isCheckOut }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const dotColor = isCheckOut ? "#ef4444" : "#22c55e";
  const bgColor = isCheckOut ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.08)" : "rgba(34,197,94,0.08)";

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.card,
        { backgroundColor: bgColor, borderColor: dotColor + "44" },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
          <View style={[styles.dot, { backgroundColor: dotColor }]} />
          <AppText weight="bold" style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>
            {label}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {fmtTimeDate(timestamp)}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <View style={[styles.row, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {t("booking.location.coordinates")}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" weight="bold">
          {Number(lat).toFixed(5)}, {Number(lng).toFixed(5)}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() =>
          Linking.openURL(`https://www.google.com/maps?q=${lat},${lng}`)

        style={{
          marginTop: 8,
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 6,
        }}
      >
        <FaMap size={12} color="#3b82f6" />
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          style={{ color: "#3b82f6", fontWeight: "bold" }}
        >
          {t("booking.location.viewOnMaps")}
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

=== FILE: src/components/booking/GpsCheckIn.js ===
// src/components/booking/GpsCheckIn.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/booking/GpsCheckIn.jsx.
//
// Renders only when:
//   · isWorker === true
//   · status ∈ ["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"]
//
// Two modes:
//   · status === "ACCEPTED"     → check-in  (PATCH /bookings/:id/checkin)
//   · status === "IN_PROGRESS"  → check-out (PATCH /bookings/:id/checkout)
//
// Five phases:
//   idle → locating → confirming → submitting → done
//
// Port notes:
//   · navigator.geolocation → expo-location (guarded require)
//   · Reverse-geocoding uses the same public Nominatim endpoint as web
//   · Distance calc uses haversineKm, verbatim from web
//   · Timeout at 10s to match web's `timeout: 10000`
//   · If permission is denied or the fix fails, the check-in proceeds
//     without coordinates — matches web's behavior

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaMapMarkerAlt,
  FaLocationArrow,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaCheck,
  FaTimes,
  FaCircle,
} from "../../icons/fa";

// Optional expo-location — guarded
let Location = null;
try {
  Location = require("expo-location");
} catch {}

// ── Haversine distance (verbatim from web) ─────────────────────────────
function haversineKm(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) {
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLng = ((lng2 - lng1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
  return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
}

// ── Reverse geocode via Nominatim (verbatim from web) ──────────────────
async function reverseGeocode(lat, lng) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(
      `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?lat=${lat}&lon=${lng}&format=json`,
      { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } },
    );
    const data = await res.json();
    const addr = data.address || {};
    return (
      addr.suburb ||
      addr.neighbourhood ||
      addr.village ||
      addr.town ||
      addr.city ||
      addr.county ||
      `${lat.toFixed(4)}, ${lng.toFixed(4)}`
    );
  } catch {
    return `${lat.toFixed(4)}, ${lng.toFixed(4)}`;
  }
}

// ── GPS fetch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function getGPS() {
  if (!Location) return { latitude: null, longitude: null };
  try {
    const perm = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) return { latitude: null, longitude: null };
    const pos = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
      accuracy: Location.Accuracy?.BestForNavigation ?? 6,
    });
    return {
      latitude: pos.coords.latitude,
      longitude: pos.coords.longitude,
      accuracy: Math.round(pos.coords.accuracy || 0),
    };
  } catch {
    return { latitude: null, longitude: null };
  }
}

export default function GpsCheckIn({
  bookingId,
  status,
  isWorker,
  jobLatitude,
  jobLongitude,
  onSuccess,
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("idle");
  const [gpsData, setGpsData] = useState(null);
  const [locationLabel, setLocationLabel] = useState("");
  const [distanceKm, setDistanceKm] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // ── Guards ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!isWorker) return null;
  if (!["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(status)) return null;

  const isCheckIn = status === "ACCEPTED";

  // ── Handle locate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleLocate = async () => {
    setPhase("locating");
    setError("");

    const gps = await getGPS();

    if (!gps.latitude) {
      setGpsData({ latitude: null, longitude: null });
      setLocationLabel("Location unavailable");
      setDistanceKm(null);
      setPhase("confirming");
      return;
    }

    const label = await reverseGeocode(gps.latitude, gps.longitude);
    setLocationLabel(label);
    setGpsData(gps);

    if (jobLatitude && jobLongitude) {
      const dist = haversineKm(
        gps.latitude,
        gps.longitude,
        jobLatitude,
        jobLongitude,
      );
      setDistanceKm(dist);
    }

    setPhase("confirming");
  };

  // ── Handle confirm ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    setPhase("submitting");
    try {
      const endpoint = isCheckIn
        ? `/bookings/${bookingId}/checkin`
        : `/bookings/${bookingId}/checkout`;

      const res = await client.patch(endpoint, {
        latitude: gpsData?.latitude || null,
        longitude: gpsData?.longitude || null,
      });

      setPhase("done");
      onSuccess?.(res?.data?.data?.booking, gpsData);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        e?.response?.data?.message || "Action failed. Please try again.",
      );
      setPhase("idle");
    }
  };

  // ── Handle reset ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleReset = () => {
    setPhase("idle");
    setGpsData(null);
    setLocationLabel("");
    setDistanceKm(null);
    setError("");
  };

  const distanceWarning =
    distanceKm !== null && distanceKm > 1
      ? `You appear to be ${distanceKm.toFixed(1)} km from the job site.`
      : null;

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      {/* ─── IDLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {phase === "idle" ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleLocate}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.mainBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: isCheckIn ? c.orange : c.green,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.pulseDot,
              {
                backgroundColor: isCheckIn
                  ? "rgba(8,8,16,0.5)"
                  : "rgba(8,8,16,0.5)",
              },
            ]}
          />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.bg,
              marginLeft: 8,
            }}
          >
            {isCheckIn ? "Check In — Start Job" : "Check Out — Mark Complete"}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}

      {/* ─── LOCATING ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {phase === "locating" ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.locatingBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <FaMapMarkerAlt size={20} color={c.orange} />
          <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}>
              Acquiring your location…
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 2 }}>
              Please allow location access if prompted
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* ─── CONFIRMING ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {phase === "confirming" ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.confirmBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {/* Confirm header */}
          <View style={styles.confirmHeader}>
            {isCheckIn ? (
              <FaCheckCircle size={22} color={c.green} />
            ) : (
              <FaCircle size={22} color={c.red} />
            )}
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}
              >
                {isCheckIn ? "Confirm Check-In" : "Confirm Check-Out"}
              </AppText>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 2 }}>
                {new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {
                  hour: "2-digit",
                  minute: "2-digit",
                  weekday: "short",
                  day: "numeric",
                  month: "short",
                })}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Location card */}
          <View
            style={[
              styles.locationCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View style={styles.locationRow}>
              <FaLocationArrow
                size={16}
                color={c.orange}
                style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
              />
              <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    textTransform: "uppercase",
                    letterSpacing: 0.8,
                    color: c.textMuted,
                  }}
                >
                  Your current location
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.text,
                    marginTop: 2,
                  }}
                >
                  {locationLabel || "Unknown"}
                </AppText>
                {gpsData?.accuracy ? (
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
                  >
                    ±{gpsData.accuracy}m accuracy
                  </AppText>
                ) : null}
                {gpsData?.latitude ? (
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color: c.textMuted,
                      fontFamily: "monospace",
                      marginTop: 2,
                    }}
                  >
                    {gpsData.latitude.toFixed(5)},{" "}
                    {gpsData.longitude.toFixed(5)}
                  </AppText>
                ) : null}
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* Distance */}
            {distanceKm !== null ? (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.distanceRow,
                  distanceKm > 1
                    ? { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }
                    : { backgroundColor: c.greenDim },
                ]}
              >
                {distanceKm < 0.1 ? (
                  <FaCheckCircle size={13} color={c.green} />
                ) : distanceKm > 1 ? (
                  <FaExclamationTriangle size={13} color="#fbbf24" />
                ) : (
                  <FaLocationArrow size={13} color={c.textDim} />
                )}
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: distanceKm > 1 ? c.orange : c.green,
                    marginLeft: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  {distanceKm < 0.1
                    ? "You're at the job site"
                    : `${distanceKm.toFixed(2)} km from job site`}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* No GPS warning */}
            {!gpsData?.latitude ? (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.noGpsRow,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <FaExclamationTriangle size={12} color="#fbbf24" />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: c.textDim,
                    marginLeft: 6,
                    flex: 1,
                    lineHeight: 16,
                  }}
                >
                  Location unavailable — check-in will proceed without GPS
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          {/* Distance warning */}
          {distanceWarning ? (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.warningBox,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
              ]}
            >
              <FaExclamationTriangle
                size={11}
                color={c.orange}
                style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
              />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: c.orange,
                  marginLeft: 6,
                  flex: 1,
                  lineHeight: 17,
                }}
              >
                {distanceWarning} Your location is still recorded.
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {/* Actions */}
          <View style={styles.actionsRow}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleReset}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.cancelBtn,
                { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
              ]}
            >
              <FaTimes size={11} color={c.textDim} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: c.textDim,
                  marginLeft: 4,
                }}
              >
                Cancel
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleConfirm}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.confirmBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: isCheckIn ? c.orange : c.green,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <FaCheck size={12} color={c.bg} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.bg,
                  marginLeft: 6,
                }}
              >
                {isCheckIn ? "Confirm Check-In" : "Confirm Check-Out"}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* ─── SUBMITTING ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {phase === "submitting" ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.locatingBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: c.textDim,
              marginLeft: 10,
            }}
          >
            {isCheckIn ? "Checking in…" : "Checking out…"}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* ─── ERROR ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {error ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.errorBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.redDim, borderColor: c.red },
          ]}
        >
          <FaExclamationTriangle
            size={11}
            color={c.red}
            style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
          />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.red,
              marginLeft: 6,
              flex: 1,
              lineHeight: 17,
            }}
          >
            {error}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleReset}
            style={[styles.retryBtn, { borderColor: c.red }]}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.red, fontWeight: "600" }}>
              Retry
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/booking/InsuranceAddon.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/hirer/InsuranceAddon.jsx.
//
// Fetches GET /insurance/plans on mount (cached on backend).
// On "Pay & Activate": POST /insurance/checkout with { planId, bookingId },
// backend returns { url, sessionId } and we open the URL in the device
// browser via Linking.openURL. After payment, the checkout provider
// redirects back to a deep link, and the booking refetch shows the
// insurance activated (booking.insuranceRef != null).
//
// States:
//   · Already insured (booking.insuranceRef) → green "Insured: {plan}" pill
//   · Otherwise                              → collapsible panel with plan cards
//
// No mobile-specific swaps needed except:
//   · window.location.href = res.data.data.url → Linking.openURL(url)

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Linking,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaShieldAlt,
  FaChevronUp,
  FaChevronDown,
  FaCheck,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
} from "../../icons/fa";

export default function InsuranceAddon({ bookingId, booking, onPurchased }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [plans, setPlans] = useState([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [purchasing, setPurchasing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const isInsured = !!booking?.insuranceRef;

  // ── Fetch plans on mount ────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    client
      .get("/insurance/plans")
      .then((res) => setPlans(res?.data?.data?.plans || []))
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  // ── Checkout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleCheckout = async () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    setPurchasing(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const res = await client.post("/insurance/checkout", {
        planId: selected,
        bookingId: bookingId || null,
      });
      const url = res?.data?.data?.url;
      if (url) {
        await Linking.openURL(url);
        onPurchased?.();
      } else {
        setError("Checkout URL missing. Try again.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.message || "Checkout failed.");
    } finally {
      setPurchasing(false);
    }
  };

  const selectedPlan = plans.find((p) => p.id === selected);

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ALREADY INSURED
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (isInsured) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.insuredBadge,
          { backgroundColor: c.greenDim, borderColor: c.green },
        ]}
      >
        <FaShieldAlt size={18} color={c.green} />
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.green,
            }}
          >
            Insured: {booking.insurancePlan || "Active"}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              color: c.textMuted,
              fontFamily: "monospace",
              marginTop: 2,
            }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            Ref: {booking.insuranceRef}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // NOT INSURED — collapsible
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <View>
      {/* Trigger */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.trigger,
          {
            backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
            borderColor: c.border,
            opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <FaShieldAlt size={18} color={c.orange} />
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
            Add Insurance Cover (Optional)
          </AppText>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 2 }}>
            Protect your property — charged in USD
          </AppText>
        </View>
        {open ? (
          <FaChevronUp size={12} color={c.textMuted} />
        ) : (
          <FaChevronDown size={12} color={c.textMuted} />
        )}
      </Pressable>

      {/* Expanded panel */}
      {open ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.panel,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.text,
            }}
          >
            Choose a plan
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              color: c.textDim,
              marginTop: 3,
              marginBottom: 12,
            }}
          >
            One-time cover for this booking. Paid securely via Flutterwave.
          </AppText>

          {/* Plan cards */}
          {loading ? (
            <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
              {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                <View
                  key={i}
                  style={[
                    styles.planSkeleton,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                />
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
              {plans.map((plan) => {
                const active = selected === plan.id;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={plan.id}
                    onPress={() => setSelected(plan.id)}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.planCard,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                        opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {plan.popular ? (
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.popularBadge,
                          { backgroundColor: c.orange },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 9,
                            fontWeight: "800",
                            color: c.bg,
                            letterSpacing: 0.3,
                          }}
                        >
                          MOST POPULAR
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    ) : null}

                    <AppText
                      style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}
                    >
                      {plan.name}
                    </AppText>

                    <View
                      style={{
                        flexDirection: "row",
                        alignItems: "baseline",
                        gap: 3,
                        marginTop: 4,
                      }}
                    >
                      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textDim }}>
                        USD
                      </AppText>
                      <AppText
                        style={{
                          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                          fontSize: 24,
                          fontWeight: "800",
                          color: c.orange,
                        }}
                      >
                        ${plan.price}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>

                    <AppText
                      style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
                    >
                      Covers up to $
                      {(plan.coverageAmount || 0).toLocaleString()}
                    </AppText>

                    <View style={{ gap: 4, marginTop: 10 }}>
                      {(plan.features || []).map((f, i) => (
                        <View
                          key={i}
                          style={{
                            flexDirection: "row",
                            alignItems: "flex-start",
                            gap: 5,
                          }}
                        >
                          <FaCheck
                            size={9}
                            color={c.green}
                            style={{ marginTop: 3 }}
                          />
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: c.textDim,
                              flex: 1,
                              lineHeight: 16,
                            }}
                          >
                            {f}
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                      ))}
                    </View>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Error */}
          {error ? (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.errorBox,
                { backgroundColor: c.redDim, borderColor: c.red },
              ]}
            >
              <FaExclamationTriangle size={10} color={c.red} />
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.red, marginLeft: 6, flex: 1 }}
              >
                {error}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {/* Purchase row */}
          <View style={styles.purchaseRow}>
            {selectedPlan ? (
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, flex: 1 }}>
                {selectedPlan.name} — USD ${selectedPlan.price}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleCheckout}
              disabled={!selected || purchasing}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.purchaseBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor:
                    !selected || purchasing ? c.bgInput : c.orange,
                  opacity: !selected || purchasing ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              {purchasing ? (
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}
                >
                  <ActivityIndicator color={c.bg} size="small" />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}
                  >
                    Redirecting…
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ) : (
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}
                >
                  <FaShieldAlt size={12} color={c.bg} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}
                  >
                    Pay & Activate Insurance
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          {/* Disclaimer */}
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              color: c.textMuted,
              lineHeight: 15,
              marginTop: 8,
            }}
          >
            Secure payment via Flutterwave. Coverage activates immediately after
            payment. You will be redirected back automatically.
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Notes parsing (identical to JobDetail.jsx) ────────────────────────
function parseRecurring(notes) {
  if (!notes) return null;
  const m = notes.match(/Recurring:\s*([^.]+)\./i);
  return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
}
function parseCustomDuration(notes) {
  if (!notes) return null;
  const m = notes.match(/Duration:\s*([^.]+)\./i);
  return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
}
function stripSystemNotes(notes) {
  if (!notes) return notes;
  return notes
    .replace(/Recurring:\s*[^.]+\.\s*/i, "")
    .replace(/Duration:\s*[^.]+\.\s*/i, "")
    .trim();
}

// ── Small detail card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DetailCard({ icon, label, value, accent, full }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.detailCard,
        full && styles.detailCardFull,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={styles.detailCardIcon}>{icon}</View>
      <View style={styles.detailCardBody}>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.detailCardLabel}>
          {label}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          weight="semibold"
          style={[styles.detailCardValue, accent && { color: c.orange }]}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

export default function JobPostBookingDetails({ booking }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [jobPost, setJobPost] = useState(booking?.jobPost || null);
  const [loadingJob, setLoadingJob] = useState(!booking?.jobPost);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!booking?.jobPostId) return;
    if (booking.jobPost) {
      setJobPost(booking.jobPost);
      setLoadingJob(false);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoadingJob(true);
    client
      .get(`/jobs/${booking.jobPostId}`)
      .then((res) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const payload = res.data?.data;
        setJobPost(payload?.jobPost ?? payload);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setJobPost(null);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoadingJob(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [booking?.jobPostId, booking?.jobPost]);

  if (!booking) return null;

  // Merge: booking wins, jobPost fills gaps
  const jp = jobPost || {};
  const merged = {
    title: booking.title || jp.title,
    description: booking.description || jp.description,

    locationType: booking.locationType || jp.locationType,
    address: booking.address || jp.address,
    latitude: booking.latitude ?? jp.latitude,
    longitude: booking.longitude ?? jp.longitude,

    jobType: booking.jobType || jp.jobType,
    scheduledAt: booking.scheduledAt || jp.scheduledAt,

    estimatedHours: booking.estimatedHours ?? jp.estimatedHours,
    estimatedUnit: booking.estimatedUnit || jp.estimatedUnit || "hours",
    estimatedValue: booking.estimatedValue || jp.estimatedValue,
    durationValue: booking.durationValue || jp.durationValue,
    durationType: booking.durationType || jp.durationType,

    skills:
      Array.isArray(booking.skills) && booking.skills.length
        ? booking.skills
        : Array.isArray(jp.skills)
          ? jp.skills
          : [],
    qualifications:
      Array.isArray(booking.qualifications) && booking.qualifications.length
        ? booking.qualifications
        : Array.isArray(jp.qualifications)
          ? jp.qualifications
          : [],
    requirements: booking.requirements || jp.requirements,
    responsibilities: booking.responsibilities || jp.responsibilities,
    notes: booking.notes || jp.notes,

    providesAccommodation:
      booking.providesAccommodation ?? jp.providesAccommodation ?? false,
    providesMeals: booking.providesMeals ?? jp.providesMeals ?? false,

    languageRequirement: booking.languageRequirement || jp.languageRequirement,

    currency: booking.currency || jp.currency,
    budgetType: booking.jobRateSnapshot?.budgetType || jp.budgetType || "FIXED",
    budget: jp.budget,
    salaryText: jp.salaryText,
    salaryAmount: jp.salaryAmount,
    salaryMin: jp.salaryMin,
    salaryMax: jp.salaryMax,
    salaryCurrency: jp.salaryCurrency,
    salaryPeriod: jp.salaryPeriod,
    budgetCustomLabel: jp.budgetCustomLabel,

    category: jp.category,

    minQualification: jp.minQualification,
    experienceLevel: jp.experienceLevel,
    experienceLength: jp.experienceLength,
    educationLevel: jp.educationLevel,
    workingHours: jp.workingHours,
    applicantLocation: jp.applicantLocation,

    applicationUrl: jp.applicationUrl,
    applicationEmail: jp.applicationEmail,
    applicationWhatsApp: jp.applicationWhatsApp,
    applicationPhone: jp.applicationPhone,
    sourcePlatform: jp.sourcePlatform,
    companyName: jp.companyName,

    expiryDate: jp.expiryDate,
    createdAt: jp.createdAt,
  };

  // Derived
  const LocationIcon = LOCATION_TYPE_ICON[merged.locationType];

  const languageLabel = merged.languageRequirement
    ? ALL_LANGUAGES.find((l) => l.code === merged.languageRequirement)?.label ||
      merged.languageRequirement.toUpperCase()
    : null;

  const recurringLabel = parseRecurring(merged.notes);
  const customDurationLabel = parseCustomDuration(merged.notes);
  const cleanNotes = stripSystemNotes(merged.notes);

  const durationParts = formatJobDurationParts({
    estimatedUnit: merged.estimatedUnit,
    estimatedValue: merged.estimatedValue,
    estimatedHours: merged.estimatedHours,
  });
  const hasEstimatedDuration = !!(durationParts || merged.estimatedHours);
  const hasProjectDuration = !!(merged.durationValue && merged.durationType);
  const hasRecurring = !!recurringLabel;
  const hasCustomDuration = !!customDurationLabel;

  const salaryPeriodLabel = SALARY_PERIOD_LABELS[merged.salaryPeriod];
  const educationLevelLabel = EDUCATION_LEVEL_LABELS[merged.educationLevel];
  const budgetTypeLabel = BUDGET_TYPE_LABELS[merged.budgetType];

  const hasSalaryText = !!merged.salaryText;
  const hasSalaryRange = !!(
    merged.salaryAmount ||
    merged.salaryMin ||
    merged.salaryMax
  );
  const hasBudget = merged.budget !== null && merged.budget !== undefined;

  let salaryRangeText = null;
  if (merged.salaryMin && merged.salaryMax) {
    const cur = merged.salaryCurrency || merged.currency || "";
    salaryRangeText = `${cur} ${Number(merged.salaryMin).toLocaleString()} – ${Number(merged.salaryMax).toLocaleString()}${salaryPeriodLabel ? ` · ${salaryPeriodLabel}` : ""}`;
  } else if (merged.salaryAmount) {
    const cur = merged.salaryCurrency || merged.currency || "";
    salaryRangeText = `${cur} ${Number(merged.salaryAmount).toLocaleString()}${salaryPeriodLabel ? ` · ${salaryPeriodLabel}` : ""}`;
  }

  const mainPaymentText = hasSalaryText
    ? merged.salaryText
    : hasSalaryRange
      ? salaryRangeText
      : hasBudget
        ? `${merged.currency} ${parseFloat(merged.budget).toLocaleString()}`
        : "—";

  const mainPaymentLabel = hasSalaryText
    ? "Salary"
    : hasSalaryRange
      ? "Salary Range"
      : t("booking.jobPost.budget", { defaultValue: "Budget" });

  const budgetSuffix =
    merged.budgetType && merged.budgetType !== "FIXED"
      ? merged.budgetType === "CUSTOM"
        ? merged.budgetCustomLabel
          ? ` · ${merged.budgetCustomLabel}`
          : " · Custom"
        : ` · ${BUDGET_TYPE_LABELS[merged.budgetType] || merged.budgetType}`
      : " total";

  const hasCoordinates =
    merged.latitude != null &&
    merged.longitude != null &&
    merged.locationType !== "REMOTE";

  const hasWorkConditions =
    merged.providesAccommodation || merged.providesMeals;

  const qualificationsList = Array.isArray(merged.qualifications)
    ? merged.qualifications.filter(
        (q) => typeof q === "string" && q.trim().length > 0,
      )
    : [];

  const requirementItems = [
    merged.minQualification && {
      icon: <FaAward size={14} color={c.orange} />,
      label: t("booking.jobPost.minQualification", {
        defaultValue: "Minimum Qualification",
      }),
      value: merged.minQualification,
    },
    merged.experienceLevel && {
      icon: <FaChartLine size={14} color={c.orange} />,
      label: t("booking.jobPost.experienceLevel", {
        defaultValue: "Experience Level",
      }),
      value: merged.experienceLength
        ? `${merged.experienceLevel} · ${merged.experienceLength}`
        : merged.experienceLevel,
    },
    merged.experienceLength &&
      !merged.experienceLevel && {
        icon: <FaChartLine size={14} color={c.orange} />,
        label: t("booking.jobPost.experienceLength", {
          defaultValue: "Experience Length",
        }),
        value: merged.experienceLength,
      },
    educationLevelLabel && {
      icon: <FaBookOpen size={14} color={c.orange} />,
      label: t("booking.jobPost.educationLevel", {
        defaultValue: "Education Level",
      }),
      value: educationLevelLabel,
    },
    languageLabel && {
      icon: <FaGlobe size={14} color={c.orange} />,
      label: t("booking.jobPost.language", { defaultValue: "Language" }),
      value: languageLabel,
    },
    merged.workingHours && {
      icon: <FaClock size={14} color={c.orange} />,
      label: t("booking.jobPost.workingHours", {
        defaultValue: "Working Hours",
      }),
      value: merged.workingHours,
    },
    merged.applicantLocation && {
      icon: <FaMapMarkerAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />,
      label: t("booking.jobPost.applicantLocation", {
        defaultValue: "Preferred Applicant Location",
      }),
      value: merged.applicantLocation,
    },
  ].filter(Boolean);

  const hasRequirementsBlock = requirementItems.length > 0;

  const hasExternalApplyChannels = !!(
    merged.applicationUrl ||
    merged.applicationEmail ||
    merged.applicationWhatsApp ||
    merged.applicationPhone
  );

  return (
    <>
      {/* DESCRIPTION */}
      {merged.description && (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.section,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="bold"
            tone="dim"
            style={styles.sectionTitle}
          >
            {t("booking.jobPost.jobDesc")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="body" style={styles.description}>
            {merged.description}
          </AppText>
          {cleanNotes && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.notes,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <FaFileAlt size={12} color={c.textMuted} />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 8 }}
              >
                {cleanNotes}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* RESPONSIBILITIES */}
      {merged.responsibilities && (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.section,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.sectionTitleRow}>
            <FaAlignLeft size={14} color={c.orange} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="bold"
              tone="dim"
              style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginLeft: 6, marginBottom: 0 }]}
            >
              {t("booking.jobPost.responsibilities")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <AppText variant="body" style={styles.description}>
            {merged.responsibilities}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* REQUIREMENTS */}
      {merged.requirements && (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.section,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.sectionTitleRow}>
            <FaClipboardCheck size={14} color={c.orange} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="bold"
              tone="dim"
              style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginLeft: 6, marginBottom: 0 }]}

              {t("booking.jobPost.requirements")}

      {/* REQUIRED SKILLS */}

                  variant="small"

      {/* REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS */}

              }

          )}

              icon={<FaClock size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.customDuration")}
              value={customDurationLabel}
            />
          )}

          {hasRecurring && (

              icon={<FaSyncAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.recurring")}
              value={recurringLabel}
            />
          )}

          {hasProjectDuration && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaClock size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.projectDuration")}
              value={`${merged.durationValue} ${String(merged.durationType).toLowerCase()}`}
            />
          )}

          {merged.locationType && merged.address && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaMapMarkerAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.location", {
                defaultValue: "Location",
              })}
              value={merged.address}
            />
          )}

          {hasCoordinates && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaLocationArrow size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.coordinates")}
              value={
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() =>
                    Linking.openURL(
                      `https://www.google.com/maps?q=${merged.latitude},${merged.longitude}`,
                    )
                  }
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.orange }}
                  >
                    {Number(merged.latitude).toFixed(5)},{" "}
                    {Number(merged.longitude).toFixed(5)}
                    <FaExternalLinkAlt
                      size={9}
                      color={c.orange}
                      style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}
                    />
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              }
            />
          )}

          <DetailCard
            icon={<FaTag size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label={t("booking.jobPost.status", { defaultValue: "Status" })}
            value={t("booking.jobPost.booked", { defaultValue: "Booked" })}
          />

          {merged.jobType && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaBriefcase size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.jobType", {
                defaultValue: "Job Type",
              })}
              value={JOB_TYPE_LABEL[merged.jobType] || merged.jobType}
            />
          )}

          {merged.locationType && LocationIcon && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<LocationIcon size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.workStyle")}
              value={
                LOCATION_TYPE_LABEL[merged.locationType] || merged.locationType
              }
            />
          )}

          {languageLabel && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaGlobe size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.languageRequired")}
              value={languageLabel}
            />
          )}

          {merged.budgetType && budgetTypeLabel && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaCreditCard size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.paymentType")}
              value={
                <>
                  {budgetTypeLabel}
                  {merged.budgetType === "CUSTOM" &&
                    merged.budgetCustomLabel && (
                      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                        {" "}
                        ({merged.budgetCustomLabel})
                      </AppText>
                    )}
                </>
              }
            />
          )}

          {merged.currency && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaDollarSign size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.currency", {
                defaultValue: "Currency",
              })}
              value={merged.currency}
            />
          )}

          {merged.sourcePlatform && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaExternalLinkAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.sourcePlatform", {
                defaultValue: "Source Platform",
              })}
              value={merged.sourcePlatform}
            />
          )}

          {merged.expiryDate && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.expires", { defaultValue: "Expires" })}
              value={new Date(merged.expiryDate).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                day: "numeric",
                month: "long",
                year: "numeric",
              })}
            />
          )}

          {merged.createdAt && (
            <DetailCard
              icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
              label={t("booking.jobPost.posted", { defaultValue: "Posted" })}
              value={new Date(merged.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                day: "numeric",
                month: "long",
                year: "numeric",
              })}
            />
          )}
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS BLOCK */}
      {hasRequirementsBlock && (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.section,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.sectionTitleRow}>
            <FaClipboardCheck size={14} color={c.orange} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="bold"
              tone="dim"
              style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginLeft: 6, marginBottom: 0 }]}
            >
              {t("booking.jobPost.requirements")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.detailGrid}>
            {requirementItems.map((item, i) => (
              <DetailCard
                key={i}
                icon={item.icon}
                label={item.label}
                value={item.value}
              />
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* HOW TO APPLY */}
      {hasExternalApplyChannels && (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.section,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="bold"
            tone="dim"
            style={styles.sectionTitle}
          >
            {t("booking.jobPost.howToApply")}
          </AppText>
          <View style={styles.pillRow}>
            {merged.applicationUrl && (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => Linking.openURL(merged.applicationUrl)}
                style={[
                  styles.channelPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <FaLink size={11} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText variant="small" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
                  {t("booking.jobPost.applyLink")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            )}
            {merged.applicationEmail && (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() =>
                  Linking.openURL(`mailto:${merged.applicationEmail}`)
                }
                style={[
                  styles.channelPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <FaEnvelope size={11} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText variant="small" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
                  {merged.applicationEmail}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            )}
            {merged.applicationWhatsApp && (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() =>
                  Linking.openURL(
                    `https://wa.me/${String(merged.applicationWhatsApp).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")}`,
                  )
                }
                style={[
                  styles.channelPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <FaWhatsapp size={11} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText variant="small" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
                  {merged.applicationWhatsApp}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            )}
            {merged.applicationPhone && (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() =>
                  Linking.openURL(`tel:${merged.applicationPhone}`)
                }
                style={[
                  styles.channelPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <FaPhone size={11} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText variant="small" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
                  {merged.applicationPhone}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

=== FILE: src/components/booking/PaymentOptions.js ===
// src/components/booking/PaymentOptions.js
//
// Real RN port of components/payment/PaymentOptions.jsx.
//
// Flow:
//   1. Pricing summary — agreed total (or rate × qty), platform fee,
//      referral deduction, "You Pay" total
//   2. Crypto token picker — USDC / USDT / BTC / ETH
//   3. "Pay with {token}" → POST /payments/crypto/:id (opens wallet step)
//   4. Wallet details — asset, network, wallet, amount, memo
//   5. Tx hash input + optional amount + optional receipt upload
//   6. "Confirm Transaction" → PATCH /payments/crypto/:id/confirm
//   7. On success → onSuccess callback fires; parent refetches booking
//
// The web version used window.navigator.clipboard and window.open; the
// mobile version uses expo-clipboard (if available) and Linking.openURL.
// Both are guarded so missing deps don't crash.

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Linking,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import { calcPricing, getHirerFeeRate } from "../../utils/pricing";
import {
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaPaperclip,
  FaTimes,
  FaGift,
  FaMoneyBillWave,
  FaBitcoin,
} from "../../icons/fa";

// ── Optional expo-clipboard / expo-image-picker — guarded ─────────────
let Clipboard = null;
let ImagePicker = null;
try {
  Clipboard = require("expo-clipboard");
} catch {}
try {
  ImagePicker = require("expo-image-picker");
} catch {}

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtMoney(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const n = Number(amount) || 0;
  return `${currency} ${n.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const CRYPTO_TOKENS = [
  { id: "USDC", label: "USDC", network: "Ethereum", icon: "$" },
  { id: "USDT", label: "USDT", network: "Tron (TRC20)", icon: "₮" },
  { id: "BTC", label: "Bitcoin", network: "Bitcoin", icon: "₿" },
  { id: "ETH", label: "Ethereum", network: "Ethereum", icon: "Ξ" },
];

export default function PaymentOptions({
  booking,
  onSuccess,
  referralAmount = 0,
  referralApplied = false,
  onReferralToggle,
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [step, setStep] = useState("select"); // "select" | "details"

  const [cryptoAsset, setCryptoAsset] = useState("USDC");
  const [cryptoTxHash, setCryptoTxHash] = useState("");
  const [cryptoAmount, setCryptoAmount] = useState("");
  const [cryptoDetails, setCryptoDetails] = useState(null);
  const [cryptoReceiptFile, setCryptoReceiptFile] = useState(null);

  // ── Pricing (mirror the web's manual job-post fix) ───────────────────
  const p = calcPricing(booking);
  const isJobPost = booking?.source === "JOB_POST";

  const agreedTotal = isJobPost
    ? Number(booking?.agreedRate) || 0
    : Number(p.subtotal) || 0;
  const currency = booking?.currency || p.currency || "NGN";

  const PLATFORM_FEE_RATE = getHirerFeeRate(currency);
  const PLATFORM_FEE_PCT = Math.round(PLATFORM_FEE_RATE * 100);
  const platformFee = isJobPost
    ? Math.round(agreedTotal * PLATFORM_FEE_RATE * 100) / 100
    : Number(p.hirerFee) || 0;

  const referralDeduct =
    referralApplied && referralAmount > 0 ? Number(referralAmount) : 0;

  const finalTotal = isJobPost
    ? Math.max(0, agreedTotal + platformFee - referralDeduct)
    : Math.max(0, p.grossTotal - referralDeduct);

  const durationText =
    isJobPost && booking?.estimatedValue
      ? `${booking.estimatedValue} ${booking.estimatedUnit || "hours"}`
      : null;

  // ── File size guard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const validateFileSize = (file) => {
    if (!file) return true;
    if (file.size && file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      setError(
        `File "${file.name}" is too large (${(file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB). Maximum size is 5MB.`,
      );
      return false;
    }
    setError("");
    return true;
  };

  // ── Receipt picker ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const pickReceipt = async () => {
    if (!ImagePicker) {
      toast.info("Receipt upload requires expo-image-picker.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
      if (!perm.granted) {
        toast.error("Media library permission required.");
        return;
      }
      const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
        mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
        quality: 0.85,
      });
      if (result.canceled) return;
      const asset = result.assets[0];
      setCryptoReceiptFile({
        uri: asset.uri,
        name: asset.fileName || `receipt_${Date.now()}.jpg`,
        type: asset.mimeType || "image/jpeg",
        size: asset.fileSize,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error("Could not pick image.");
    }
  };

  // ── Copy to clipboard ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const copyToClipboard = async (text) => {
    if (!Clipboard) {
      toast.info("Copy requires expo-clipboard.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      await Clipboard.setStringAsync(String(text));
      toast.success("Copied.");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not copy.");
    }
  };

  // ── Initiate crypto ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleCryptoInitiate() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const res = await client.post(`/payments/crypto/${booking.id}`, {
        cryptoCurrency: cryptoAsset,
      });
      const details =
        res.data?.data?.cryptoDetails ||
        res.data?.cryptoDetails ||
        res.data?.data ||
        null;
      setCryptoDetails(details);
      setStep("details");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        e?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to initiate crypto payment",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Confirm crypto ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleCryptoConfirm() {
    if (!cryptoTxHash.trim()) {
      setError("Transaction hash is required");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("txHash", cryptoTxHash.trim());
      form.append("cryptoCurrency", cryptoAsset);
      if (cryptoAmount) form.append("cryptoAmount", cryptoAmount);
      if (referralApplied && referralAmount > 0) {
        form.append("referralAmount", String(referralAmount));
      }
      if (cryptoReceiptFile) {
        form.append("proof", {
          uri: cryptoReceiptFile.uri,
          name: cryptoReceiptFile.name,
          type: cryptoReceiptFile.type,
        });
      }

      await client.patch(`/payments/crypto/${booking.id}/confirm`, form, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });

      onSuccess?.();
      toast.success("Crypto payment submitted.");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.message || "Confirmation failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {/* ── PRICING BREAKDOWN ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.summary,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 6,
            marginBottom: 4,
          }}
        >
          <FaMoneyBillWave size={13} color={c.text} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              flex: 1,
            }}
          >
            Payment Breakdown
          </AppText>
          {isJobPost ? (
            <View
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 6,
                paddingVertical: 2,
                borderRadius: 4,
                backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.12)",
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: "700", color: "#818cf8" }}
              >
                FROM JOB POST
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Agreed Total / Rate */}
        <FeeLine
          label={isJobPost ? "Agreed Total" : "Agreed Rate"}
          value={`${fmtMoney(agreedTotal, currency)}${!isJobPost ? p.unitSuffix || "" : ""}`}
        />

        {/* Duration */}
        {isJobPost && durationText ? (
          <FeeLine
            label="Duration"
            value={
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.text }}>
                {durationText}
                {booking.estimatedHours ? (
                  <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted, fontSize: 11 }}>
                    {" "}
                    (≈ {booking.estimatedHours}h)
                  </AppText>
                ) : null}
              </AppText>
            }
          />
        ) : null}
        {!isJobPost && p.hasQty ? (
          <FeeLine
            label="Duration"
            value={`${p.qty} ${p.unitLabel}${p.qty !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
          />
        ) : null}
        {!isJobPost && p.hasQty ? (
          <FeeLine
            label={`Subtotal (${p.qty} × ${fmtMoney(p.agreedRate, currency)})`}
            value={fmtMoney(p.subtotal, currency)}
          />
        ) : null}

        {/* Platform Fee */}
        <FeeLine
          label={`Platform Fee (${PLATFORM_FEE_PCT}%)`}
          value={`+ ${fmtMoney(platformFee, currency)}`}
          muted
        />

        {/* Referral */}
        {referralDeduct > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.row}>
            <View
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}
            >
              <FaGift size={11} color={c.green} />
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green }}>
                Referral bonus
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, fontWeight: "600" }}
            >
              − {fmtMoney(referralDeduct, currency)}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <View
          style={{ height: 1, backgroundColor: c.border, marginVertical: 6 }}
        />
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
            You Pay
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.orange,
            }}
          >
            {fmtMoney(finalTotal, currency)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* ── STEP 1: TOKEN SELECT ──────────────────────────────────── */}
      {step === "select" ? (
        <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, lineHeight: 18 }}>
            Pay with cryptocurrency. Send to our wallet and submit your
            transaction hash.
          </AppText>

          {/* Token grid */}
          <View style={styles.tokenGrid}>
            {CRYPTO_TOKENS.map((tok) => {
              const active = cryptoAsset === tok.id;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={tok.id}
                  onPress={() => setCryptoAsset(tok.id)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.tokenCard,
                    {
                      borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                      opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 20,
                      color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                    }}
                  >
                    {tok.icon}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: active ? c.orange : c.text,
                      marginTop: 4,
                    }}
                  >
                    {tok.label}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>
                    {tok.network}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>

          <Pressable
            onPress={handleCryptoInitiate}
            disabled={loading}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.payBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: loading ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                opacity: loading ? 0.7 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            {loading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
            ) : (
              <View
                style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}
              >
                <FaBitcoin size={14} color="#fff" />
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
                >
                  Pay with {cryptoAsset}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── STEP 2: WALLET DETAILS + CONFIRM ──────────────────────── */}
      {step === "details" && cryptoDetails ? (
        <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
            Send to this wallet
          </AppText>

          <View
            style={[
              styles.bankCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <BankRow
              label="Asset"
              value={cryptoDetails.currency || cryptoAsset}
            />
            <BankRow label="Network" value={cryptoDetails.network || "—"} />
            <BankRow
              label="Wallet"
              value={cryptoDetails.wallet || "—"}
              mono
              copyable
              onCopy={copyToClipboard}
            />
            <BankRow
              label="Amount"
              value={fmtMoney(finalTotal, currency)}
              accent
            />
            {cryptoDetails.note ? (
              <BankRow
                label="Memo"
                value={cryptoDetails.note}
                mono
                copyable
                onCopy={copyToClipboard}
              />
            ) : null}
          </View>

          <View
            style={[
              styles.warnBox,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaExclamationTriangle
              size={11}
              color={c.red}
              style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
            />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                color: c.red,
                flex: 1,
                marginLeft: 6,
                lineHeight: 18,
              }}
            >
              Only send {cryptoDetails.currency || cryptoAsset} on the{" "}
              {cryptoDetails.network || "correct"} network. Wrong network may
              result in permanent loss of funds.
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {/* Tx hash input */}
          <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
            Transaction Hash / TX ID *
          </AppText>
          <TextInput
            value={cryptoTxHash}
            onChangeText={setCryptoTxHash}
            placeholder="0x... or transaction ID"
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            style={[
              styles.input,
              {
                color: c.text,
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                fontFamily: "DMSans_400Regular",
              },
            ]}
          />

          {/* Amount input */}
          <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
            Amount Sent (optional)
          </AppText>
          <TextInput
            value={cryptoAmount}
            onChangeText={(v) => setCryptoAmount(v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""))}
            keyboardType="decimal-pad"
            placeholder="Amount in crypto"
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            style={[
              styles.input,
              {
                color: c.text,
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              },
            ]}
          />

          {/* Receipt upload */}
          <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
            Transaction Screenshot (optional)
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={pickReceipt}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.uploadBtn,
              {
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaPaperclip size={12} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textDim,
                marginLeft: 6,
                flex: 1,
              }}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {cryptoReceiptFile
                ? `✅ ${cryptoReceiptFile.name}`
                : "Upload screenshot"}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          {cryptoReceiptFile ? (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setCryptoReceiptFile(null)}
              style={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
            >
              <View
                style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}
              >
                <FaTimes size={10} color={c.red} />
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.red }}>
                  Remove screenshot
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </Pressable>
          ) : null}

          {/* Back + Confirm */}
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 6 }}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setStep("select")}
              disabled={loading}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.backBtn,
                {
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  opacity: loading ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
              >
                ← Back
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleCryptoConfirm}
              disabled={loading}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.payBtn,
                {
                  flex: 1,
                  backgroundColor: loading ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                  opacity: loading ? 0.7 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              {loading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}
                >
                  <FaCheckCircle size={12} color="#fff" />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    Confirm Transaction
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* Error */}
      {error ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.errorBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.redDim, borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)" },
          ]}
        >
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={11} color={c.red} />
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.red, marginLeft: 6, flex: 1 }}
          >
            {error}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* Disclaimer */}
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 11,
          color: c.textMuted,
          textAlign: "center",
          lineHeight: 15,
        }}
      >
        All payments are held in escrow and only released after you confirm job
        completion.
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function FeeLine({ label, value, muted }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  return (
    <View style={styles.row}>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 13,
          color: muted ? c.textMuted : c.textDim,
          flex: 1,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
      {typeof value === "string" ? (
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 13,
            color: muted ? c.textMuted : c.text,
            textAlign: "right",
          }}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
      ) : (
        value
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function BankRow({ label, value, mono, copyable, accent, onCopy }) {

  return (

      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {label}
      </AppText>
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 6,
          flex: 1,
          justifyContent: "flex-end",
        }}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: accent ? 14 : 13,
            fontWeight: accent ? "700" : "600",
            color: accent ? c.orange : c.text,
            fontFamily: mono ? "monospace" : undefined,
            textAlign: "right",
            flexShrink: 1,
          }}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
        {copyable ? (
          <Pressable onPress={() => onCopy?.(value)} hitSlop={8}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>⎘</AppText>
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
