=== FILE: src/components/booking/RaiseDisputeSheet.js ===
// src/components/booking/RaiseDisputeSheet.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/disputes/RaiseDisputeModal.jsx.
//
// POST /disputes/raise with multipart/form-data:
//   bookingId     — string
//   reason        — one of REASONS[].value (enum)
//   description   — 20–500 chars
//   files[]       — optional evidence (images/PDFs)
//
// Mobile port notes:
//   · Web uses <input type="file" multiple>, ported to expo-image-picker +
//     expo-document-picker (both guarded — install one to enable uploads)
//   · File previews use Image for images; PDFs render as a chip
//   · No client-side file size cap in the web; we cap at 10MB per file to
//     protect the mobile network

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaTimes,
  FaImage,
  FaTrashAlt,
  FaFileImage,
} from "../../icons/fa";

// Optional expo modules — guarded so the file compiles without them
let ImagePicker = null;
let DocumentPicker = null;
try {
  ImagePicker = require("expo-image-picker");
} catch {}
try {
  DocumentPicker = require("expo-document-picker");
} catch {}

// ── Reason enum — verbatim from web ─────────────────────────────────────
const REASONS = [
  { value: "PAYMENT_NOT_RELEASED", label: "Payment not released" },
  { value: "WORK_NOT_COMPLETED", label: "Work not completed" },
  { value: "POOR_QUALITY_WORK", label: "Poor quality of work" },
  { value: "NO_SHOW", label: "Worker/Hirer no-show" },
  { value: "OVERCHARGING", label: "Overcharging / wrong amount" },
  { value: "HARASSMENT", label: "Harassment or misconduct" },
  { value: "DAMAGE_TO_PROPERTY", label: "Damage to property" },
  { value: "OTHER", label: "Other" },
];

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB per file (mobile safety cap)
const MAX_DESC = 500;
const MIN_DESC = 20;

export default function RaiseDisputeSheet({
  bookingId,
  bookingTitle,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [files, setFiles] = useState([]);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const reset = () => {
    setReason("");
    setDescription("");
    setFiles([]);
    setError("");
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (submitting) return;
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  // ── File pickers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const addFiles = (newFiles) => {
    const sizeChecked = [];
    for (const f of newFiles) {
      if (f.size && f.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        toast.error(
          `"${f.name}" is ${(f.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB — max 10MB.`,
        );
        continue;
      }
      sizeChecked.push(f);
    }
    if (sizeChecked.length) setFiles((prev) => [...prev, ...sizeChecked]);
  };

  const pickImages = async () => {
    if (!ImagePicker) {
      toast.info("Install expo-image-picker to attach images.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
      if (!perm.granted) {
        toast.error("Media library permission required.");
        return;
      }
      const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
        mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
        allowsMultipleSelection: true,
        quality: 0.85,
      });
      if (result.canceled) return;
      addFiles(
        result.assets.map((a, i) => ({
          uri: a.uri,
          name: a.fileName || `evidence_${Date.now()}_${i}.jpg`,
          type: a.mimeType || "image/jpeg",
          size: a.fileSize,
        })),
      );
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not pick images.");
    }
  };

  const pickDoc = async () => {
    if (!DocumentPicker) {
      toast.info("Install expo-document-picker to attach PDFs.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      const result = await DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({
        type: ["application/pdf"],
        multiple: true,
        copyToCacheDirectory: true,
      });
      if (result.canceled) return;
      addFiles(
        result.assets.map((a) => ({
          uri: a.uri,
          name: a.name || `evidence_${Date.now()}.pdf`,
          type: a.mimeType || "application/pdf",
          size: a.size,
        })),
      );
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not pick documents.");
    }
  };

  const removeFile = (index) => {
    setFiles((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  // ── Submit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError("");

    if (!reason) {
      setError("Please select a reason.");
      return;
    }
    if (description.trim().length < MIN_DESC) {
      setError(
        `Please provide a description of at least ${MIN_DESC} characters.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("bookingId", String(bookingId));
      form.append("reason", reason);
      form.append("description", description.trim());
      files.forEach((f, i) => {
        form.append("files", {
          uri: f.uri,
          name:
            f.name || `evidence_${i}.${(f.type || "").split("/")[1] || "jpg"}`,
          type: f.type || "application/octet-stream",
        });
      });

      await client.post("/disputes/raise", form, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });

      onSuccess?.();
      toast.success("Dispute raised. Our team will review within 24–48 hours.");
      reset();
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to raise dispute.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      visible
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
    >
      <Pressable style={styles.backdrop} onPress={handleClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            styles.sheet,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderTopColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <ScrollView
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
            contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 20 }}
            keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          >
            {/* Handle */}
            <View style={[styles.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

            {/* Header */}
            <View style={styles.header}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 12 }}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 20,
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    color: c.text,
                    letterSpacing: -0.4,
                  }}
                >
                  Raise a Dispute
                </AppText>
                {bookingTitle ? (
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: c.textDim,
                      marginTop: 2,
                    }}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    For: {bookingTitle}
                  </AppText>
                ) : null}
              </View>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleClose}
                disabled={submitting}
                hitSlop={8}
                style={[
                  styles.closeBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    opacity: submitting ? 0.4 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaTimes size={14} color={c.textDim} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Warning banner */}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.warnBox,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                  borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <FaExclamationTriangle
                size={12}
                color={c.orange}
                style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
              />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: c.textDim,
                  flex: 1,
                  marginLeft: 8,
                  lineHeight: 18,
                }}
              >
                Disputes are reviewed by our support team within 24–48 hours.
                Please provide as much detail as possible.
              </AppText>
            </View>

            {/* Reason picker */}
            <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
              REASON *
            </AppText>
            <View style={styles.reasonPills}>
              {REASONS.map((r) => {
                const active = reason === r.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={r.value}
                    onPress={() => {
                      if (submitting) return;
                      setReason(r.value);
                      setError("");
                    }}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.pill,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgInput,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                        opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: "600",
                        color: active ? "#fff" : c.text,
                      }}
                    >
                      {r.label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>

            {/* Description */}
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                marginTop: 16,
                marginBottom: 6,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={[
                  styles.label,
                  { color: c.textDim, marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 0 },
                ]}
              >
                DESCRIPTION *
              </AppText>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
                {description.length}/{MAX_DESC}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <TextInput
              value={description}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                if (submitting) return;
                setDescription(v.slice(0, MAX_DESC));
                setError("");
              }}
              multiline
              numberOfLines={5}
              textAlignVertical="top"
              placeholder="Describe the issue in detail. Include dates, amounts, and any relevant context that will help our team resolve this quickly…"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              editable={!submitting}
              style={[
                styles.textarea,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            />

            {/* Evidence upload */}
            <AppText
              style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim, marginTop: 14 }]}
            >
              <FaImage size={10} color={c.textDim} /> EVIDENCE (OPTIONAL)
              {files.length > 0
                ? ` · ${files.length} file${files.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`
                : ""}
            </AppText>

            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={pickImages}
                disabled={submitting}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.uploadBtn,
                  {
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    opacity: submitting ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaFileImage size={12} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.textDim,
                    marginLeft: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  Images
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={pickDoc}
                disabled={submitting}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.uploadBtn,
                  {
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    opacity: submitting ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaFileImage size={12} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.textDim,
                    marginLeft: 6,
                  }}
                >
                  PDF
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* File previews */}
            {files.length > 0 ? (
              <ScrollView
                horizontal
                showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
                style={{ marginTop: 10 }}
                contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8, paddingRight: 8 }}
              >
                {files.map((f, idx) => {
                  const isImage = (f.type || "").startsWith("image/");
                  return (
                    <View
                      key={idx}
                      style={[
                        styles.fileChip,
                        { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {isImage ? (
                        <Image
                          source={{ uri: f.uri }}
                          style={styles.fileThumb}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <View
                          style={[
                            styles.fileThumb,
                            styles.pdfThumb,
                            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                          ]}
                        >
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 9,
                              fontWeight: "700",
                              color: c.textDim,
                            }}
                          >
                            PDF
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                      )}
                      <AppText
                        style={{
                          fontSize: 9,
                          color: c.textDim,
                          marginTop: 4,
                          maxWidth: 60,
                        }}
                        numberOfLines={1}
                      >
                        {f.name}
                      </AppText>
                      <Pressable
                        onPress={() => removeFile(idx)}
                        disabled={submitting}
                        hitSlop={6}
                        style={[
                          styles.removeBtn,
                          { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <FaTrashAlt size={8} color="#fff" />
                      </Pressable>
                    </View>
                  );
                })}
              </ScrollView>
            ) : null}

            {/* Error */}
            {error ? (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.errorBox,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                    borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.3)",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaExclamationTriangle size={11} color={c.red} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: c.red,
                    marginLeft: 6,
                    flex: 1,
                    lineHeight: 18,
                  }}
                >
                  {error}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* Submit row */}
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 20 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleClose}
                disabled={submitting}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.cancelBtn,
                  {
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    opacity: submitting ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
                >
                  Cancel
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleSubmit}
                disabled={submitting}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.submitBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: submitting ? c.bgCard : c.red,
                    opacity: submitting ? 0.6 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    Submit Dispute
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </ScrollView>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  backdrop: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)",
    justifyContent: "flex-end",
  },
  sheet: {
    borderTopLeftRadius: 24,
    borderTopRightRadius: 24,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    maxHeight: "92%",
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
  },
  handle: {
    width: 40,
    height: 4,
    borderRadius: 2,
    alignSelf: "center",
    marginTop: 12,
    marginBottom: 8,
  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "flex-start",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    marginBottom: 14,
  },
  closeBtn: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,

=== FILE: src/components/booking/Refund.js ===
// src/components/booking/Refund.js
//
// Verbatim port of:
//   · components/booking/Refund/RefundRequest.jsx
//   · components/booking/Refund/RefundStatus.jsx
//
// Exports:
//   · RefundRequest — form with 3 refund types (FULL / PARTIAL / CUSTOM_AMOUNT),
//                     48-hour eligibility countdown, confirmation modal
//   · RefundStatus  — status card with icon, color, role-aware description,
//                     reference/amount/type/timestamps, admin notes
//
// Endpoint: POST /refunds/request
// Payload: { bookingId, paymentId, refundType, percentage?, amount?, reason }

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import {
  FaMoneyBillWave,
  FaClock,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaInfoCircle,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaTimesCircle,
  FaSpinner,
  FaFileInvoice,
  FaPercent,
} from "../../icons/fa";

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtPrice(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const n = Number(amount) || 0;
  return `${currency} ${n.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

const REFUND_TYPES = [
  { value: "FULL", label: "Full Refund", icon: FaMoneyBillWave },
  { value: "PARTIAL", label: "Partial Refund", icon: FaPercent },
  { value: "CUSTOM_AMOUNT", label: "Custom Amount", icon: FaFileInvoice },
];

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// RefundRequest
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function RefundRequest({
  booking,
  payment,
  onRequestRefund,
  isProcessing = false,
  isHirer = false,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState("FULL");
  const [percentage, setPercentage] = useState(50);
  const [customAmount, setCustomAmount] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  // Only hirers can request refunds
  if (!isHirer) return null;

  // ── 48-hour eligibility ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const isEligible = () => {
    if (!booking?.completedAt) return false;
    const completedAt = new Date(booking.completedAt);
    const hoursSinceCompletion =
      (Date.now() - completedAt.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
    return hoursSinceCompletion <= 48;
  };

  const getTimeRemaining = () => {
    if (!booking?.completedAt) return null;
    const completedAt = new Date(booking.completedAt);
    const remainingMs =
      48 * 60 * 60 * 1000 - (Date.now() - completedAt.getTime());
    if (remainingMs <= 0) return null;
    const hours = Math.floor(remainingMs / (60 * 60 * 1000));
    const minutes = Math.floor((remainingMs % (60 * 60 * 1000)) / (60 * 1000));
    return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  };

  // ── Refund amount calculation ───────────────────────────────────────
  const originalAmount =
    Number(payment?.amount) || Number(booking?.agreedRate) || 0;
  const currency = payment?.currency || booking?.currency || "NGN";

  const calculateRefundAmount = () => {
    if (selectedType === "FULL") return originalAmount;
    if (selectedType === "PARTIAL") return (originalAmount * percentage) / 100;
    if (selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT") {
      const amount = parseFloat(customAmount);
      return isNaN(amount) ? 0 : amount;
    }
    return 0;
  };

  const refundAmount = calculateRefundAmount();
  const timeRemaining = getTimeRemaining();

  // ── Submit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSubmit = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    if (!reason.trim()) {
      newErrors.reason = "Please provide a reason for the refund";
    }
    if (
      selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT" &&
      (!customAmount || parseFloat(customAmount) <= 0)
    ) {
      newErrors.customAmount = "Please enter a valid amount";
    }
    if (
      selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT" &&
      parseFloat(customAmount) > originalAmount
    ) {
      newErrors.customAmount = "Amount cannot exceed the original payment";
    }
    if (Object.keys(newErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(newErrors);
      return;
    }
    setShowConfirm(true);
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    const payload = {
      bookingId: booking.id,
      paymentId: payment?.id,
      refundType: selectedType,
      reason: reason.trim(),
    };
    if (selectedType === "PARTIAL") payload.percentage = percentage;
    if (selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT")
      payload.amount = parseFloat(customAmount);

    onRequestRefund(payload);
    setShowConfirm(false);
  };

  // ── Not eligible ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!isEligible()) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.refundCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={styles.refundHeader}>
          <FaClock size={14} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
              fontSize: 15,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.text,
              marginLeft: 6,
            }}
          >
            Refund Unavailable
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 13,
            color: c.textDim,
            marginTop: 6,
            lineHeight: 20,
          }}
        >
          Refund requests must be made within 48 hours of booking completion.
        </AppText>
        {booking?.completedAt ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}>
            Completed on: {new Date(booking.completedAt).toLocaleString()}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ── Eligible form ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <>
      <View
        style={[
          styles.refundCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={styles.refundHeader}>
          <FaMoneyBillWave size={14} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
              fontSize: 15,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.text,
              marginLeft: 6,
              flex: 1,
            }}
          >
            Request Refund
          </AppText>
          {timeRemaining ? (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.timerBadge,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
              ]}
            >
              <FaClock size={9} color={c.orange} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.orange,
                  marginLeft: 3,
                }}
              >
                {timeRemaining}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Info summary */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.infoBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <InfoRow label="Booking" value={booking.title} c={c} />
          <InfoRow
            label="Original Amount"
            value={fmtPrice(originalAmount, currency)}
            c={c}
          />
          <InfoRow
            label="Status"
            value={
              <View
                style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}
              >
                <FaCheckCircle size={10} color={c.green} />
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.green }}
                >
                  Eligible
                </AppText>
              </View>
            }
            c={c}
          />
        </View>

        {/* Refund type selector */}
        <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
          REFUND TYPE
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.typeGrid}>
          {REFUND_TYPES.map((t) => {
            const active = selectedType === t.value;
            const Icon = t.icon;
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={t.value}
                onPress={() => setSelectedType(t.value)}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.typeBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgInput,
                    borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                    opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Icon size={14} color={active ? c.orange : c.textDim} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: active ? c.orange : c.text,
                    marginTop: 4,
                    textAlign: "center",
                  }}
                  numberOfLines={2}
                >
                  {t.label}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </View>

        {/* Partial slider */}
        {selectedType === "PARTIAL" ? (
          <View style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
            <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
              PERCENTAGE: {percentage}%
            </AppText>
            <PercentageSlider
              value={percentage}
              onChange={setPercentage}
              c={c}
            />
            <AmountPreview
              label="Refund Amount"
              value={fmtPrice(refundAmount, currency)}
              c={c}
            />
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Custom amount */}
        {selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT" ? (
          <View style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
            <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim }]}>
              ENTER AMOUNT ({currency})
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              value={customAmount}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                setCustomAmount(v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""));
                if (errors.customAmount)
                  setErrors({ ...errors, customAmount: null });
              }}
              keyboardType="decimal-pad"
              placeholder="Enter amount"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              style={[
                styles.input,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: errors.customAmount ? c.red : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            />
            {errors.customAmount ? (
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.red, marginTop: 4 }}>
                {errors.customAmount}
              </AppText>
            ) : (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}
              >
                Maximum: {fmtPrice(originalAmount, currency)}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Full preview */}
        {selectedType === "FULL" ? (
          <AmountPreview
            label="Refund Amount"
            value={fmtPrice(refundAmount, currency)}
            c={c}
          />
        ) : null}

        {/* Reason */}
        <AppText style={[styles.label, { color: c.textDim, marginTop: 14 }]}>
          REASON *
        </AppText>
        <TextInput
          value={reason}
          onChangeText={(v) => {
            setReason(v);
            if (errors.reason) setErrors({ ...errors, reason: null });
          }}
          multiline
          numberOfLines={3}
          textAlignVertical="top"
          placeholder="Please explain why you're requesting a refund…"
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[
            styles.textarea,
            {
              color: c.text,
              borderColor: errors.reason ? c.red : c.border,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
            },
          ]}
        />
        {errors.reason ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.red, marginTop: 4 }}>
            {errors.reason}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}

        {/* Submit */}
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          disabled={isProcessing}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.submitBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: isProcessing ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
              opacity: isProcessing ? 0.7 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {isProcessing ? (
            <View
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}
            >
              <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
              >
                Processing…
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}>
              Submit Refund Request
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>

        {/* Info note */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.infoNote,
            {
              backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.08)",
              borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.2)",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaInfoCircle size={11} color={c.orange} style={{ marginTop: 2 }} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              color: c.textDim,
              flex: 1,
              marginLeft: 6,
              lineHeight: 17,
            }}
          >
            Refund requests are reviewed within 24-48 hours. You'll be notified
            once your request is processed.
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Confirmation modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showConfirm}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.modalCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
                fontSize: 17,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.text,
              }}
            >
              Confirm Refund Request
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                color: c.textDim,
                marginTop: 6,
                lineHeight: 19,
              }}
            >
              Are you sure you want to request a refund for this booking? This
              action cannot be undone.
            </AppText>

            <View
              style={[
                styles.confirmDetails,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <ConfirmRow label="Booking" value={booking.title} c={c} />
              <ConfirmRow
                label="Amount"
                value={fmtPrice(refundAmount, currency)}
                c={c}
              />
              <ConfirmRow
                label="Type"
                value={
                  REFUND_TYPES.find((t) => t.value === selectedType)?.label
                }
                c={c}
              />
              <ConfirmRow label="Reason" value={reason} c={c} />
            </View>

            <View
              style={[
                styles.confirmWarning,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                  borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.25)",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <FaExclamationTriangle size={11} color={c.red} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: c.red,
                  marginLeft: 6,
                  flex: 1,
                }}
              >
                This action cannot be undone.
              </AppText>
            </View>

            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 14 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.modalBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: "transparent",
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.textDim }}
                >
                  Cancel
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleConfirm}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.modalBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: "#eab308",
                    opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#000" }}
                >
                  Yes, Request Refund
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// RefundStatus
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const STATUS_CONFIG = {
  PENDING: {
    icon: FaClock,
    color: "#fbbf24",
    label: "Pending Review",
    description: {
      hirer: "Your refund request is being reviewed by our team.",
      worker:
        "The hirer has requested a refund. This is being reviewed by our team.",
    },
  },
  APPROVED: {
    icon: FaCheckCircle,
    color: "#22c55e",
    label: "Approved",
    description: {
      hirer: "Your refund has been approved and is being processed.",
      worker:
        "The refund for this booking has been approved and is being processed.",
    },
  },
  PROCESSING: {
    icon: FaSpinner,
    color: "#818cf8",
    label: "Processing",
    description: {
      hirer: "Your refund is currently being processed.",
      worker: "The refund for this booking is currently being processed.",
    },
  },
  COMPLETED: {
    icon: FaCheckCircle,
    color: "#22c55e",
    label: "Completed",
    description: {
      hirer: "Your refund has been completed successfully.",
      worker: "The refund for this booking has been completed.",
    },
  },
  FAILED: {
    icon: FaTimesCircle,
    color: "#ef4444",
    label: "Failed",
    description: {
      hirer: "Your refund failed. Please contact support.",
      worker: "The refund for this booking failed. Please contact support.",
    },
  },
  REJECTED: {
    icon: FaTimesCircle,
    color: "#ef4444",
    label: "Rejected",
    description: {
      hirer: "Your refund request was rejected.",
      worker: "The refund request for this booking was rejected.",
    },
  },
  DISPUTED: {
    icon: FaExclamationTriangle,
    color: "#f59e0b",
    label: "In Dispute",
    description: {
      hirer: "This refund is under dispute review.",
      worker: "This refund is under dispute review.",
    },
  },
};

export function RefundStatus({ refund, onViewDetails, isHirer = true }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  if (!refund) return null;

  const config = STATUS_CONFIG[refund.status] || STATUS_CONFIG.PENDING;
  const Icon = config.icon;
  const roleKey = isHirer ? "hirer" : "worker";
  const description =
    config.description?.[roleKey] ||
    config.description?.hirer ||
    "Your refund is being processed.";

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.statusCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
          fontSize: 12,
          fontWeight: "700",
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          letterSpacing: 1,
          color: c.textDim,
          marginBottom: 12,
        }}
      >
        Refund
      </AppText>

      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.statusHeader}>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.statusIconWrap,
            {
              backgroundColor: `${config.color}22`,
              borderColor: `${config.color}55`,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Icon size={18} color={config.color} />
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
              fontSize: 15,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.text,
            }}
          >
            {config.label}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.textDim,
              marginTop: 3,
              lineHeight: 17,
            }}
          >
            {description}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <View
          style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: `${config.color}33` }]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 9,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: "#fff",
              letterSpacing: 0.4,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
            }}
          >
            {refund.status}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Details */}
      <View style={{ gap: 6, marginTop: 14 }}>
        <StatusRow label="Reference" value={refund.reference} c={c} mono />
        <StatusRow
          label="Amount"
          value={fmtPrice(refund.amount, refund.currency)}
          c={c}
        />
        <StatusRow
          label="Type"
          value={(refund.refundType || "").replace("_", " ")}
          c={c}
        />
        <StatusRow
          label="Requested"
          value={new Date(refund.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
            day: "numeric",
            month: "short",
            year: "numeric",
          })}
          c={c}
        />
        {refund.processedAt ? (
          <StatusRow
            label="Processed"
            value={new Date(refund.processedAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
              day: "numeric",
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
            c={c}
          />
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {/* Admin note */}
      {refund.adminNotes ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.adminNoteBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.textMuted,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              letterSpacing: 0.6,
              marginBottom: 3,
            }}
          >
            Admin Note
          </AppText>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, lineHeight: 17 }}>
            {refund.adminNotes}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* View details */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => onViewDetails?.(refund)}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.viewBtn,
          {
            borderColor: c.orange,
            backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
            opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}>
          View Full Details
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Sub-components ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function InfoRow({ label, value, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        justifyContent: "space-between",
        paddingVertical: 5,
      }}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>{label}</AppText>
      {typeof value === "string" ? (
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.text,
            flex: 1,
            textAlign: "right",
            marginLeft: 8,
          }}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
      ) : (
        value
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function ConfirmRow({ label, value, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        justifyContent: "space-between",
        paddingVertical: 4,
      }}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>{label}:</AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 12,
          fontWeight: "600",
          color: c.text,
          flex: 1,
          textAlign: "right",
          marginLeft: 8,
        }}
        numberOfLines={2}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function StatusRow({ label, value, c, mono }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        justifyContent: "space-between",
        paddingVertical: 5,
      }}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textMuted }}>{label}</AppText>

          fontSize: 12,
          fontWeight: "600",
          color: c.text,
          fontFamily: mono ? "monospace" : undefined,
        }}
        numberOfLines={1}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

        marginTop: 10,

      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>{label}:</AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 15,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color: c.orange,
        }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function PercentageSlider({ value, onChange, c }) {
  const step = 5;
  const dec = () => onChange(Math.max(1, value - step));
  const inc = () => onChange(Math.min(99, value + step));

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 8,
        marginTop: 4,
      }}
    >
      <Pressable
        onPress={dec}
        disabled={value <= 1}
        hitSlop={6}
        style={{
          width: 32,
          height: 32,
          borderRadius: 16,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          opacity: value <= 1 ? 0.4 : 1,
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 18, color: c.text, lineHeight: 20 }}>
          −
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          height: 6,
          borderRadius: 3,
          backgroundColor: c.border,
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            height: "100%",
            width: `${value}%`,
            backgroundColor: c.orange,
          }}
        />
      </View>
      <Pressable
        onPress={inc}
        disabled={value >= 99}
        hitSlop={6}
        style={{
          width: 32,
          height: 32,
          borderRadius: 16,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          opacity: value >= 99 ? 0.4 : 1,
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 18, color: c.text, lineHeight: 20 }}>
          +
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/booking/Refund/RefundHistory.js
import React from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  FaMoneyBillWave,
  FaChevronRight,
  FaClock,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaTimesCircle,
  FaSpinner,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaCalendarAlt,
} from "../../../icons/fa";

import AppText from "../../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";

const STATUS_CONFIG = {
  PENDING: { icon: FaClock, color: "#fbbf24", label: "Pending Review" },
  APPROVED: { icon: FaCheckCircle, color: "#22c55e", label: "Approved" },
  PROCESSING: { icon: FaSpinner, color: "#818cf8", label: "Processing" },
  COMPLETED: { icon: FaCheckCircle, color: "#22c55e", label: "Completed" },
  FAILED: { icon: FaTimesCircle, color: "#ef4444", label: "Failed" },
  REJECTED: { icon: FaTimesCircle, color: "#ef4444", label: "Rejected" },
  DISPUTED: {
    icon: FaExclamationTriangle,
    color: "#f59e0b",
    label: "In Dispute",
  },
};

export default function RefundHistory({ refunds, onPressItem }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  if (!refunds?.length) return null;

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      {refunds.map((refund) => {
        const cfg = STATUS_CONFIG[refund.status] || STATUS_CONFIG.PENDING;
        const Icon = cfg.icon;
        return (
          <Pressable
            key={refund.id}
            onPress={() => onPressItem?.(refund)}
            style={[
              styles.item,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View
              style={[
                styles.icon,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
              ]}
            >
              <FaMoneyBillWave size={14} color={c.orange} />
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: 8,
                  flexWrap: "wrap",
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  weight="bold"
                  numberOfLines={1}
                  style={{ flexShrink: 1 }}
                >
                  {refund.booking?.title || "Booking Refund"}
                </AppText>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.refBadge,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color: c.textMuted,
                      fontFamily: "monospace",
                    }}
                  >
                    {refund.reference}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: 10,
                  marginTop: 4,
                  flexWrap: "wrap",
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="bold"
                  style={{ color: c.orange }}
                >
                  {refund.currency}{" "}
                  {Number(refund.amount || 0).toLocaleString()}
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {refund.refundType?.replace("_", " ") || "Refund"}
                </AppText>
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 3 }}
                >
                  <FaCalendarAlt size={10} color={c.textMuted} />
                  <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                    {new Date(refund.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                      day: "numeric",
                      month: "short",
                      year: "numeric",
                    })}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
            </View>
            <View style={{ alignItems: "flex-end", gap: 4 }}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.badge,
                  { borderColor: cfg.color, backgroundColor: `${cfg.color}22` },
                ]}
              >
                <Icon size={9} color={cfg.color} />
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="bold"
                  style={{ color: cfg.color, marginLeft: 4, fontSize: 10 }}
                >
                  {cfg.label}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <FaChevronRight size={10} color={c.textMuted} />
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

=== FILE: src/components/booking/Refund/RefundRequest.js ===
// src/components/booking/Refund/RefundRequest.js
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { View, TextInput, Pressable, StyleSheet, Modal } from "react-native";
import Slider from "@react-native-community/slider";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  FaMoneyBillWave,
  FaClock,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaInfoCircle,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaSpinner,
  FaPercent,
  FaFileInvoice,
} from "../../../icons/fa";

import AppText from "../../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";

const formatPrice = (amount, currency = "NGN") => {
  if (amount == null) return `${currency} 0.00`;
  return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
};

const REFUND_TYPES = [
  { value: "FULL", label: "Full Refund", icon: FaMoneyBillWave },
  { value: "PARTIAL", label: "Partial Refund", icon: FaPercent },
  { value: "CUSTOM_AMOUNT", label: "Custom Amount", icon: FaFileInvoice },
];

export default function RefundRequest({
  booking,
  payment,
  onRequestRefund,
  isProcessing,
  isHirer,
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState("FULL");
  const [percentage, setPercentage] = useState(50);
  const [customAmount, setCustomAmount] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  if (!isHirer) return null;

  const isEligible = () => {
    if (!booking.completedAt) return false;
    const hours =
      (Date.now() - new Date(booking.completedAt).getTime()) / 3600000;
    return hours <= 48;
  };

  const getTimeRemaining = () => {
    if (!booking.completedAt) return null;
    const remainingMs =
      48 * 3600000 - (Date.now() - new Date(booking.completedAt).getTime());
    if (remainingMs <= 0) return null;
    const h = Math.floor(remainingMs / 3600000);
    const m = Math.floor((remainingMs % 3600000) / 60000);
    return `${h}h ${m}m`;
  };

  const calculateRefundAmount = () => {
    const orig = payment?.amount || booking.agreedRate || 0;
    if (selectedType === "FULL") return orig;
    if (selectedType === "PARTIAL") return (orig * percentage) / 100;
    const amt = parseFloat(customAmount);
    return isNaN(amt) ? 0 : amt;
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    const e = {};
    if (!reason.trim()) e.reason = "Please provide a reason for the refund";
    if (
      selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT" &&
      (!customAmount || parseFloat(customAmount) <= 0)
    ) {
      e.customAmount = "Please enter a valid amount";
    }
    if (
      selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT" &&
      parseFloat(customAmount) > (payment?.amount || 0)
    ) {
      e.customAmount = "Amount cannot exceed the original payment";
    }
    if (Object.keys(e).length) return setErrors(e);
    setShowConfirm(true);
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    const data = {
      bookingId: booking.id,
      paymentId: payment?.id,
      refundType: selectedType,
      reason: reason.trim(),
    };
    if (selectedType === "PARTIAL") data.percentage = percentage;
    if (selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT")
      data.amount = parseFloat(customAmount);
    onRequestRefund(data);
    setShowConfirm(false);
  };

  const refundAmount = calculateRefundAmount();
  const currency = payment?.currency || booking?.currency || "NGN";
  const timeRemaining = getTimeRemaining();

  if (!isEligible()) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.card,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 8,
            marginBottom: 8,
          }}
        >
          <FaClock size={16} color={c.textMuted} />
          <AppText weight="bold">Refund Unavailable</AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          Refund requests must be made within 48 hours of booking completion.
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <View
        style={[
          styles.card,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 8,
            marginBottom: 12,
          }}
        >
          <FaMoneyBillWave size={16} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText weight="bold" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            Request Refund
          </AppText>
          {timeRemaining && (
            <View style={[styles.timer, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}>
              <FaClock size={10} color={c.orange} />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.orange, marginLeft: 4 }}
              >
                {timeRemaining}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={{ gap: 6, marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <View style={styles.row}>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Booking
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
              {booking.title}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.row}>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Original Amount
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
              {formatPrice(
                payment?.amount || booking.agreedRate || 0,
                currency,
              )}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.row}>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Status
            </AppText>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" }}>
              <FaCheckCircle size={10} color="#22c55e" />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: "#22c55e", marginLeft: 4 }}
              >
                Eligible
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.label}>
          Refund Type
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 6, marginBottom: 12 }}>
          {REFUND_TYPES.map((type) => {
            const Icon = type.icon;
            const active = selectedType === type.value;
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={type.value}
                onPress={() => setSelectedType(type.value)}
                style={[
                  styles.typeBtn,
                  {
                    borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                    backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                    flex: 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Icon size={14} color={active ? c.orange : c.textDim} />
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  style={{
                    color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                    marginTop: 4,
                    textAlign: "center",
                  }}
                >
                  {type.label}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </View>

        {selectedType === "PARTIAL" && (
          <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.label}>
              Percentage: {percentage}%
            </AppText>
            <Slider
              minimumValue={1}
              maximumValue={99}
              step={1}
              value={percentage}
              onValueChange={setPercentage}
              minimumTrackTintColor={c.orange}
              maximumTrackTintColor={c.border}
              thumbTintColor={c.orange}
            />
            <View style={styles.row}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                Refund Amount
              </AppText>
              <AppText weight="bold" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
                {formatPrice(refundAmount, currency)}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        {selectedType === "CUSTOM_AMOUNT" && (
          <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.label}>
              Enter Amount ({currency})
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              value={customAmount}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                setCustomAmount(v);
                setErrors({ ...errors, customAmount: null });
              }}
              keyboardType="decimal-pad"
              placeholder="Enter amount"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              style={[
                styles.input,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  borderColor: errors.customAmount ? "#ef4444" : c.border,
                  color: c.text,
                },
              ]}
            />
            {errors.customAmount && (
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: "#ef4444", marginTop: 4 }}
              >
                {errors.customAmount}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {selectedType === "FULL" && (
          <View style={[styles.row, { marginBottom: 12 }]}>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Refund Amount
            </AppText>
            <AppText weight="bold" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
              {formatPrice(refundAmount, currency)}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}

        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.label}>
          Reason <AppText style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}>*</AppText>
        </AppText>
        <TextInput
          value={reason}
          onChangeText={(v) => {
            setReason(v);
            setErrors({ ...errors, reason: null });
          }}
          multiline
          placeholder="Please explain why you're requesting a refund..."
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[
            styles.textarea,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              borderColor: errors.reason ? "#ef4444" : c.border,
              color: c.text,
            },
          ]}
        />
        {errors.reason && (
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#ef4444", marginTop: 4 }}>
            {errors.reason}
          </AppText>
        )}

        <Pressable
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          disabled={isProcessing}
          style={[
            styles.submitBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.orange,
              opacity: isProcessing ? 0.5 : 1,
              marginTop: 12,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {isProcessing ? <FaSpinner size={11} color={c.bg} /> : null}
          <AppText
            weight="bold"
            style={{ color: c.bg, marginLeft: isProcessing ? 6 : 0 }}
          >
            {isProcessing ? "Processing..." : "Submit Refund Request"}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "flex-start",
            marginTop: 10,
            gap: 6,
          }}
        >
          <FaInfoCircle size={11} color={c.textMuted} />
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 11 }}>
            Refund requests are reviewed within 24-48 hours.
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      <Modal
        visible={showConfirm}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.modalCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText weight="bold" style={{ fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 8 }}>
              Confirm Refund Request
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
              Are you sure you want to request a refund for this booking? This
              action cannot be undone.
            </AppText>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
                style={[
                  styles.modalBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.border, borderWidth: 1 },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="small" weight="bold" tone="dim">
                  Cancel
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleConfirm}
                style={[styles.modalBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}

                  Yes, Request
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

import React from "react";

const STATUS_CONFIG = {
  PENDING: { icon: FaClock, color: "#fbbf24", label: "Pending Review" },
  APPROVED: { icon: FaCheckCircle, color: "#22c55e", label: "Approved" },
  PROCESSING: { icon: FaSpinner, color: "#818cf8", label: "Processing" },
  COMPLETED: { icon: FaCheckCircle, color: "#22c55e", label: "Completed" },
  FAILED: { icon: FaTimesCircle, color: "#ef4444", label: "Failed" },
  REJECTED: { icon: FaTimesCircle, color: "#ef4444", label: "Rejected" },
  DISPUTED: {
    icon: FaExclamationTriangle,
    color: "#f59e0b",
    label: "In Dispute",
  },

export default function RefundStatus({ refund, onViewDetails, isHirer }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  if (!refund) return null;

  const Icon = config.icon;

// src/components/booking/SOSButton.js

// Verbatim port of components/booking/SOSButton.jsx.

// Renders only when:
//   · isWorker === true
//   · bookingStatus ∈ ["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"]
//
// Three states:
//   · idle     → red "Emergency SOS" button
//   · locating → spinner "Getting your location…"
//   · sending  → spinner "Sending emergency alert…"
//   · active   → pulsing red card "SOS Active · sent at HH:MM"
//   · resolved → green "Emergency resolved" pill
//
// Endpoint: POST /bookings/:bookingId/sos
// Payload:  { latitude, longitude }
//
// Mobile port notes:
//   · navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition  →  expo-location
//     (requestForegroundPermissionsAsync + getCurrentPositionAsync)
//   · Timed at 8s to match web's `timeout: 8000`. If permission is denied
//     or the fix times out, the SOS is still sent without coordinates.

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaShieldAlt,
} from "../../icons/fa";

// Optional expo-location — guarded
let Location = null;
try {
  Location = require("expo-location");
} catch {}

async function getGPS() {
  if (!Location) return { latitude: null, longitude: null };
  try {
    const perm = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) return { latitude: null, longitude: null };
    const pos = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
      accuracy: Location.Accuracy?.Balanced ?? 3,
    });
    return {
      latitude: pos.coords.latitude,
      longitude: pos.coords.longitude,
    };
  } catch {
    return { latitude: null, longitude: null };
  }
}

export default function SOSButton({
  bookingId,
  bookingStatus,
  isWorker,
  sosActivatedAt,
  sosResolvedAt,
  onUpdate,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("idle"); // idle | locating | sending | done
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // ── Guards ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!isWorker) return null;
  if (!["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(bookingStatus)) return null;

  const isActive = !!sosActivatedAt && !sosResolvedAt;
  const isResolved = !!sosActivatedAt && !!sosResolvedAt;

  // ── SOS trigger ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleSOS() {
    if (isActive) return;
    setPhase("locating");
    setError("");

    const gps = await getGPS();

    setPhase("sending");
    try {
      const res = await client.post(`/bookings/${bookingId}/sos`, {
        latitude: gps.latitude,
        longitude: gps.longitude,
      });
      setPhase("done");
      onUpdate?.(res?.data?.data?.booking);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        e?.response?.data?.message ||
          "Failed to send SOS. Please call emergency services.",
      );
      setPhase("idle");
    }
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RESOLVED STATE
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (isResolved) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.resolved,
          {
            backgroundColor: "rgba(22,163,74,0.08)",
            borderColor: "rgba(22,163,74,0.2)",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <FaCheckCircle size={14} color="#16a34a" />
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: "#16a34a",
            marginLeft: 8,
          }}
        >
          Emergency resolved
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ACTIVE (activated but not resolved)
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (isActive) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.activeWrap,
          {
            backgroundColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.08)",
            borderColor: "#dc2626",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={styles.activeContent}>
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={22} color="#dc2626" />
          <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: "#dc2626",
              }}
            >
              SOS Active
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
              Sent at{" "}
              {new Date(sosActivatedAt).toLocaleTimeString([], {
                hour: "2-digit",
                minute: "2-digit",
              })}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 11,
            color: c.textMuted,
            marginTop: 8,
            lineHeight: 16,
          }}
        >
          Your hirer and our team have been alerted.
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // IDLE / LOCATING / SENDING / DONE
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
      {phase === "idle" ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleSOS}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.sosBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: pressed ? "#b91c1c" : "#dc2626",
              transform: [{ scale: pressed ? 0.98 : 1 }],
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.sosDot} />
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={13} color="#fff" />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: "#fff",
              letterSpacing: 0.3,
              marginLeft: 6,
            }}
          >
            Emergency SOS
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}

      {phase === "locating" ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.locatingBox,
            {
              backgroundColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.08)",
              borderColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.2)",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.spinnerDot,
              { borderTopColor: "#dc2626", borderColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.2)" },
            ]}
          />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: "#dc2626",
              marginLeft: 10,
            }}
          >
            Getting your location…
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {phase === "sending" ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.locatingBox,
            {
              backgroundColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.08)",
              borderColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.2)",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.spinnerDot,
              { borderTopColor: "#dc2626", borderColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.2)" },
            ]}
          />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: "#dc2626",
              marginLeft: 10,
            }}
          >
            Sending emergency alert…
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {phase === "done" ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.activeWrap,
            {
              backgroundColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.08)",
              borderColor: "#dc2626",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.activeContent}>
            <FaShieldAlt size={22} color="#dc2626" />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,

                color: "#dc2626",
                marginLeft: 10,
                flex: 1,
              }}
            >
              SOS Sent — help is on the way
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {error ? (
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "flex-start",
            gap: 4,
            marginTop: 2,
          }}
        >
          <FaExclamationTriangle
            size={10}
            color="#dc2626"
            style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
          />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#dc2626", flex: 1 }}>

      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 10,

}

import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { FaCheck } from "../../icons/fa";
import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

export default function Timeline({ step }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const steps = [
    t("booking.timeline.pending"),
    t("booking.timeline.accepted"),
    t("booking.timeline.inProgress"),
    t("booking.timeline.completed"),
  ];

  if (step < 0) return null;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.container,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {steps.map((label, i) => {
        const done = i < step;
        const current = i === step;
        return (
          <View key={label} style={styles.item}>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.dot,
                {
                  backgroundColor: done ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: done || current ? c.orange : c.border,
                },
              ]}
            >
              {done ? (
                <FaCheck size={10} color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 10,
                    color: current ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
                    fontWeight: "bold",
                  }}
                >
                  {i + 1}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                color: done || current ? c.text : c.textMuted,
                marginTop: 6,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              {label}
            </AppText>
            {i < steps.length - 1 && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.line,
                  { backgroundColor: i < step ? c.orange : c.border },
                ]}
              />
            )}
          </View>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

  container: {

    height: 24,

  },
