=== FILE: src/components/booking/VideoCallButton.js ===
// src/components/booking/VideoCallButton.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/booking/VideoCallButton.jsx.
//
// Renders only when:
//   · user is the hirer OR the worker
//   · bookingStatus ∈ ["PENDING", "ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"]
//
// Polls GET /video-calls/:id every 5s for call state changes:
//   PENDING + receiverId === userId  → incoming call UI (Accept / Decline)
//   PENDING + initiatorId === userId → waiting UI (Cancel)
//   ENDED / DECLINED                 → "Call again" UI
//   no call                          → idle "Video Call" button
//
// Endpoints:
//   GET   /video-calls/:bookingId
//   POST  /video-calls/:bookingId/initiate
//   PATCH /video-calls/:bookingId/accept
//   PATCH /video-calls/:bookingId/decline
//   PATCH /video-calls/:bookingId/end
//
// Port note:
//   · The web navigates to /call/:id when the call becomes ACTIVE. That page
//     renders an <iframe> to a Jitsi room.
//   · RN cannot render iframes reliably. This port instead opens the Jitsi
//     room URL in the device's default browser (or an in-app WebView if you
//     add react-native-webview). The room URL is built from the call's
//     `roomCode` / `roomUrl` field returned by the backend.
//   · If the backend doesn't expose a room URL, the ACTIVE state shows a
//     "Join Call" button that opens your video provider's join URL —
//     configure it via the ROOM_URL_TEMPLATE constant below.

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Linking, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaVideo,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaTimesCircle,
  FaPhoneSlash,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
} from "../../icons/fa";

const POLL_MS = 5000;

// Default room template — override if your backend returns a different URL.
// Common Jitsi pattern: https://meet.jit.si/skilledproz-<roomCode>
const ROOM_URL_TEMPLATE = "https://meet.jit.si/skilledproz-";

export default function VideoCallButton({
  bookingId,
  bookingStatus,
  userId,
  hirerId,
  workerId,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [call, setCall] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const openedRef = useRef(false);
  const isInvolved = userId === hirerId || userId === workerId;
  const canCall =
    isInvolved &&
    ["PENDING", "ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(bookingStatus);

  // ── Initial fetch ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canCall) return;
    client
      .get(`/video-calls/${bookingId}`)
      .then((r) => {
        const c0 = r?.data?.data?.call;
        if (c0) setCall(c0);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [bookingId, canCall]);

  // ── Open the room when the call becomes ACTIVE ──────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (call?.status !== "ACTIVE" || openedRef.current) return;
    openedRef.current = true;
    openRoom(call);
  }, [call?.status]);

  // ── Poll for state changes ──────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canCall) return;
    if (openedRef.current) return;
    if (call?.status === "ENDED" || call?.status === "DECLINED") return;

    const id = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const r = await client.get(`/video-calls/${bookingId}`);
        const updated = r?.data?.data?.call;
        if (!updated) return;
        setCall((prev) => {
          if (!prev) return updated;
          if (prev.status === updated.status) return prev;
          return updated;
        });
      } catch {}
    }, POLL_MS);

    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [canCall, bookingId, call?.status]);

  // ── Open room in browser ────────────────────────────────────────────
  function openRoom(callData) {
    const url =
      callData?.roomUrl ||
      (callData?.roomCode ? `${ROOM_URL_TEMPLATE}${callData.roomCode}` : null);
    if (!url) {
      setError("No room URL available for this call.");
      return;
    }
    Linking.openURL(url).catch(() => {
      setError("Could not open the call room.");
    });
  }

  // ── Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleInitiate = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const res = await client.post(`/video-calls/${bookingId}/initiate`);
      setCall(res?.data?.data?.call || null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to start call");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAccept = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.patch(`/video-calls/${bookingId}/accept`);
      setCall(res?.data?.data?.call || null);
    } catch {
      setError("Failed to accept call");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDecline = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await client.patch(`/video-calls/${bookingId}/decline`);
      setCall((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: "DECLINED" }));
    } catch {
      setError("Failed to decline call");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await client.patch(`/video-calls/${bookingId}/end`);
      setCall((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: "ENDED" }));
    } catch {
      // silent
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // ── Guard ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!canCall) return null;

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // INCOMING CALL
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (call?.status === "PENDING" && call?.receiverId === userId) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.incomingWrap,
          {
            backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.08)",
            borderColor: "#818cf8",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={styles.incomingContent}>
          <FaVideo size={20} color="#818cf8" />
          <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "800", color: "#818cf8" }}
            >
              Incoming Video Call
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
              Pre-job consultation
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.incomingBtns}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleAccept}
            disabled={loading}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.acceptBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "#16a34a",
                opacity: loading ? 0.6 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaCheckCircle size={13} color="#fff" />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: "#fff",
                marginLeft: 5,
              }}
            >
              Accept
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleDecline}
            disabled={loading}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.declineBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.1)",
                borderColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.3)",
                opacity: loading ? 0.6 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaTimesCircle size={13} color="#dc2626" />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: "#dc2626",
                marginLeft: 5,
              }}
            >
              Decline
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {error ? (
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
            <FaExclamationTriangle size={10} color="#dc2626" />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#dc2626" }}>
              {error}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // WAITING FOR ANSWER (outgoing)
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (call?.status === "PENDING" && call?.initiatorId === userId) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.waitingWrap,
          {
            backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.06)",
            borderColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.2)",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <View
          style={[
            styles.spinnerDot,
            { borderColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.2)", borderTopColor: "#818cf8" },
          ]}
        />
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: "#818cf8",
            flex: 1,
            marginLeft: 8,
          }}
        >
          Calling… waiting for answer
        </AppText>
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleCancel}
          disabled={loading}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.cancelCallBtn,
            {
              borderColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.3)",
              opacity: loading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaTimesCircle size={11} color="#dc2626" />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: "#dc2626",
              marginLeft: 4,
            }}
          >
            Cancel
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ACTIVE CALL — join via browser
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (call?.status === "ACTIVE") {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.activeWrap,
          {
            backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.08)",
            borderColor: "#818cf8",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}>
          <View
            style={{
              width: 8,
              height: 8,
              borderRadius: 4,
              backgroundColor: "#ef4444",
            }}
          />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: "800",
              letterSpacing: 1,
              color: "#ef4444",
              textTransform: "uppercase",
            }}
          >
            Live
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: "700",
            color: "#818cf8",
            marginTop: 4,
          }}
        >
          Video call in progress
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => openRoom(call)}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.callBtn,
              {
                flex: 1,
                backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.15)",
                borderColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.3)",
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaVideo size={12} color="#818cf8" />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: "#818cf8",
                marginLeft: 6,
              }}
            >
              Rejoin Call
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleCancel}
            disabled={loading}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.cancelCallBtn,
              {
                borderColor: "rgba(220,38,38,0.3)",
                opacity: loading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaPhoneSlash size={11} color="#dc2626" />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: "#dc2626",
                marginLeft: 4,
              }}
            >
              End
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ENDED / DECLINED
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (call?.status === "ENDED" || call?.status === "DECLINED") {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.endedWrap,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        {call.status === "DECLINED" ? (
          <FaTimesCircle size={16} color="#ef4444" />
        ) : (
          <FaPhoneSlash size={16} color={c.textDim} />
        )}
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 12,
            color: c.textMuted,
            flex: 1,
            marginLeft: 8,
          }}
        >
          {call.status === "DECLINED" ? "Call declined" : "Call ended"}
        </AppText>
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleInitiate}
          disabled={loading}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.callAgainBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.15)",
              borderColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.3)",
              opacity: loading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaVideo size={10} color="#818cf8" />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: "#818cf8",
              marginLeft: 4,
            }}
          >
            Call Again
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // IDLE
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
      <Pressable
        onPress={handleInitiate}
        disabled={loading}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.callBtn,
          {
            backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.15)",
            borderColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.3)",
            opacity: loading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <FaVideo size={13} color="#818cf8" />
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: "700",
            color: "#818cf8",
            marginLeft: 6,
          }}
        >
          Video Call
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 10,
          color: c.textMuted,
          textAlign: "center",
        }}
      >
        Start a video call before or during the job
      </AppText>
      {error ? (
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={10} color="#dc2626" />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#dc2626", flex: 1 }}>
            {error}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/booking/WorkerPaymentPreview.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/booking/BookingDetail/WorkerPaymentPreview.jsx.
//
// Renders only when `isWorker` is true — the parent screen guards this too
// (only shows for `isWorker && booking.status === "PENDING"`), but we keep
// the internal guard for safety.
//
// Shows:
//   · Header "Your Earnings Estimate" (or "Your Earnings (From Job Post)")
//   · Agreed Rate (direct bookings) OR Agreed Total (job-post)
//   · Duration (real duration for job-post, qty×unit for direct)
//   · Subtotal (direct bookings only, when hasQty)
//   · Negotiated Rate row (if booking.isNegotiated)
//   · Platform Fee (paid by hirer)
//   · You Earn (total payout)
//   · Info note — "platform fee is covered by the hirer"
//
// All numbers go through `calcPricing(booking)` and use the currency-aware
// `getHirerFeeRate(currency)` — NGN 2%, foreign 5%.

import React from "react";
import { StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { calcPricing, getHirerFeeRate } from "../../utils/pricing";
import { FaMoneyBillWave, FaHandshake, FaInfoCircle } from "../../icons/fa";

function formatPrice(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const n = Number(amount) || 0;
  return `${currency} ${n.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

export default function WorkerPaymentPreview({ booking, isWorker }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  if (!isWorker) return null;

  const p = calcPricing(booking);
  const currency = p.currency || "NGN";
  const subtotal = p.subtotal;
  const platformFee = p.hirerFee;
  const workerPayout = p.workerPayout;

  // Currency-aware fee percent (NGN 2%, foreign 5%)
  const feePercent = Math.round(getHirerFeeRate(currency) * 100);

  const unitLabel = p.unitLabel || "unit";
  const unitSuffix = p.unitSuffix || "";

  const isJobPostBooking = booking?.source === "JOB_POST";

  const realDurationText =
    booking?.estimatedValue && booking?.estimatedUnit
      ? `${booking.estimatedValue} ${
          {
            hours: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "hour" : "hours",
            days: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "day" : "days",
            weeks: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "week" : "weeks",
            months: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "month" : "months",
            years: booking.estimatedValue == 1 ? "year" : "years",
            custom: "",
          }[booking.estimatedUnit] || booking.estimatedUnit
        }`
      : null;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.card,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <FaMoneyBillWave size={16} color={c.green} />
        <AppText style={[styles.title, { color: c.text }]} numberOfLines={2}>
          {isJobPostBooking
            ? "Your Earnings (From Job Post)"
            : "Your Earnings Estimate"}
        </AppText>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.badge,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
              borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 9,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.orange,
              letterSpacing: 0.5,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
            }}
          >
            Before accepting
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Body rows */}
      <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
        {/* Agreed Rate / Total */}
        <Row
          label={isJobPostBooking ? "Agreed Total" : "Agreed Rate"}
          value={`${formatPrice(p.agreedRate, currency)}${
            !isJobPostBooking ? unitSuffix : ""
          }`}
        />

        {/* Real duration for job-post bookings */}
        {isJobPostBooking && realDurationText ? (
          <Row
            label="Duration"
            value={
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.text }}>
                {realDurationText}
                {booking.estimatedHours ? (
                  <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted, fontSize: 11 }}>
                    {" "}
                    (≈ {booking.estimatedHours}h)
                  </AppText>
                ) : null}
              </AppText>
            }
          />
        ) : null}

        {/* Duration & subtotal for direct bookings */}
        {!isJobPostBooking && p.hasQty ? (
          <Row
            label="Duration"
            value={`${p.qty} ${unitLabel}${p.qty !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
          />
        ) : null}

        {!isJobPostBooking && p.hasQty ? (
          <Row
            label={`Subtotal (${p.qty} × ${formatPrice(p.agreedRate, currency)})`}
            value={formatPrice(subtotal, currency)}
          />
        ) : null}

        {/* Negotiated rate row */}
        {booking.isNegotiated && booking.negotiatedRate ? (
          <View style={styles.row}>
            <View
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}
            >
              <FaHandshake size={11} color={c.textDim} />
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim }}>
                Negotiated Rate
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}>
              {formatPrice(booking.negotiatedRate, currency)}
              {!isJobPostBooking ? unitSuffix : ""}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <View
          style={{ height: 1, backgroundColor: c.border, marginVertical: 4 }}
        />

        {/* Platform Fee — paid by hirer */}
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim }}>
              Platform Fee ({feePercent}%)
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 1 }}>
              (paid by hirer)
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}>
            + {formatPrice(platformFee, currency)}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        <View
          style={{ height: 1, backgroundColor: c.border, marginVertical: 4 }}
        />

        {/* Total */}
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}>
            <FaMoneyBillWave size={13} color={c.text} />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
              You Earn
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 20,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.green,
            }}
          >
            {formatPrice(workerPayout, currency)}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Info note */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.noteBox,
            {
              backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.06)",
              borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.15)",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaInfoCircle size={12} color={c.green} style={{ marginTop: 2 }} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.textDim,
              flex: 1,
              marginLeft: 8,
              lineHeight: 17,
            }}
          >
            This is the amount you will receive after the job is completed and
            the hirer releases payment. The platform fee is covered by the
            hirer.
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  return (
    <View style={styles.row}>
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, flexShrink: 1 }}>
        {label}
      </AppText>
      {typeof value === "string" ? (
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.text,
            textAlign: "right",
            flexShrink: 1,
          }}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
      ) : (
        value
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    borderRadius: 16,
    borderWidth: 1,
    padding: 20,
    marginTop: 10,
    gap: 12,
  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: 8,
    flexWrap: "wrap",
  },
  title: {
    fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
    fontSize: 15,
    fontWeight: "700",
    flex: 1,
    minWidth: 0,
  },
  badge: {
    paddingHorizontal: 8,
    paddingVertical: 2,
    borderRadius: 999,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    gap: 8,
    paddingVertical: 4,
  },
  noteBox: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "flex-start",
    padding: 10,
    borderRadius: 8,
    borderWidth: 1,
    marginTop: 4,
  },
});

// src/components/posts/CreatePost.js
//
// Ported from CreatePost.jsx + CreatePost.module.css.
//
// Image upload specifics (RN-specific — differs from web):
//   • expo-image-picker returns { uri, fileName?, mimeType? } for each asset
//   • FormData.append("files", { uri, name, type }) — NOT a File object
//   • We send the field name "files" (matches backend multer config)
//     If your backend expects a different field name, change FILES_FIELD below.

import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  TextInput,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  Image,
  ActivityIndicator,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import * as ImagePicker from "expo-image-picker";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../api/client";

const FILES_FIELD = "images"; // ← matches src/api/posts.js and backend multer

const POST_TYPES = [
  { value: "GENERAL", key: "posts.typeGeneral", icon: "chatbubble-outline" },
  {
    value: "ACHIEVEMENT",
    key: "posts.typeAchievement",

  {
    value: "JOB_UPDATE",
    key: "posts.typeJobUpdate",
    icon: "briefcase-outline",
  },
  {
    value: "ANNOUNCEMENT",
    key: "posts.typeAnnouncement",
    icon: "volume-high-outline",
  },
];

export default function CreatePost({ onPostCreated, compact = false }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(!compact);
  const [content, setContent] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState("GENERAL");
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(true);
  const [images, setImages] = useState([]); // { uri, name, type }
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const textareaRef = useRef(null);

  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;

  if (!user) return null;

  const pickImages = async () => {
    const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) {
      setError(t("posts.permissionRequired"));
      return;
    }
    const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ["images"],
      allowsMultipleSelection: true,
      selectionLimit: 4,
      quality: 0.85,
    });
    if (result.canceled) return;

    const mapped = result.assets.map((a, idx) => ({
      uri: a.uri,
      name: a.fileName || `photo-${Date.now()}-${idx}.jpg`,
      type: a.mimeType || "image/jpeg",
    }));

    if (images.length + mapped.length > 4) {
      setError(t("posts.maxImagesError"));
      return;
    }

    setImages((prev) => [...prev, ...mapped]);
    setError("");
  };

  const openPhotoShortcut = () => {
    setExpanded(true);
    setTimeout(pickImages, 100);
  };

  const openJobShortcut = () => {
    setType("HIRING");
    setExpanded(true);
    setTimeout(() => textareaRef.current?.focus(), 100);
  };

  const removeImage = (idx) => {
    setImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!content.trim()) {
      setError(t("posts.pleaseWriteSomething"));
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("content", content);
      form.append("type", type);
      form.append("isPublic", isPublic ? "true" : "false");

      images.forEach((img) => {
        form.append(FILES_FIELD, {
          uri: img.uri,
          name: img.name,
          type: img.type,
        });
      });

      // TEMP diagnostic — remove once images work
      console.log(
        "[CreatePost] submitting",
        JSON.stringify({
          contentLength: content.length,
          type,
          isPublic,
          imagesCount: images.length,
          imageNames: images.map((i) => i.name),
        }),
      );

      const res = await client.post("/posts", form, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });

      console.log(
        "[CreatePost] response post:",
        JSON.stringify(res.data?.data?.post)?.slice(0, 600),
      );

      onPostCreated?.(res.data?.data?.post);
      toast.success(t("posts.postedSuccess"));
      setContent("");
      setImages([]);
      setType("GENERAL");
      if (compact) setExpanded(false);
    } catch (err) {
      console.log(
        "[CreatePost] error:",
        err?.message,
        err?.response?.status,
        err?.response?.data,
      );
      const msg = err?.response?.data?.message || t("posts.postFailed");
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const charLimit = 3000;
  const charLeft = charLimit - content.length;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.wrap,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* ── Compact trigger ─────────────────────────── */}
      {compact && !expanded ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setExpanded(true)}
          style={[styles.compactTrigger, { padding: width <= 640 ? 14 : 16 }]}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.triggerAvatar,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                width: width <= 380 ? 32 : width <= 640 ? 36 : 40,
                height: width <= 380 ? 32 : width <= 640 ? 36 : 40,
              },
            ]}
          >
            {user.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: user.avatar }}
                style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
                resizeMode="cover"
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                  fontSize: rem(0.9),
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.orange,
                }}
              >
                {user.firstName?.[0] || "?"}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.triggerInput,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                fontSize: rem(width <= 380 ? 0.78 : width <= 640 ? 0.82 : 0.85),
                color: c.textMuted,
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.compactPlaceholder")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.triggerActions}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={openPhotoShortcut}
              hitSlop={8}
              style={{ padding: 4 }}
            >
              <Ionicons name="camera-outline" size={16} color={c.textDim} />
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={openJobShortcut}
              hitSlop={8}
              style={{ padding: 4 }}
            >
              <Ionicons name="briefcase-outline" size={16} color={c.textDim} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Full editor ─────────────────────────────── */}
      {expanded ? (
        <View style={styles.editor}>
          <View style={styles.editorHeader}>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.editorAvatar,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, overflow: "hidden" },
              ]}
            >
              {user.avatar ? (
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: user.avatar }}
                  style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
                  resizeMode="cover"
                />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                    fontSize: rem(1),
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: c.orange,
                  }}
                >
                  {user.firstName?.[0] || "?"}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                  fontSize: rem(0.9),
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.text,
                }}
              >
                {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setIsPublic((v) => !v)}
                style={[
                  styles.visibilitySelect,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.72),
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  {isPublic ? t("posts.public") : t("posts.onlyMe")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>

          <TextInput
            ref={textareaRef}
            value={content}
            onChangeText={(v) => setContent(v.slice(0, charLimit))}
            placeholder={t("posts.editorPlaceholder")}
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            multiline
            autoFocus={!compact}
            style={{
              color: c.text,
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
              fontSize: rem(0.925),
              lineHeight: rem(0.925) * 1.7,
              minHeight: 120,
              textAlignVertical: "top",
            }}
          />

          {content.length > charLimit * 0.8 ? (
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: rem(0.72),
                color: charLeft < 100 ? c.red : c.textMuted,
                textAlign: "right",
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.charactersRemaining", { count: charLeft })}
            </AppText>
          ) : null}

          {images.length > 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.previews}>
              {images.map((img, i) => (
                <View key={i} style={styles.previewItem}>
                  <Image source={{ uri: img.uri }} style={styles.previewImg} />
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => removeImage(i)}
                    style={styles.previewRemove}
                    hitSlop={6}
                  >
                    <Ionicons name="close" size={11} color="#fff" />
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {error ? (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.errorBanner,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                  borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.25)",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={15} color={c.red} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  fontSize: rem(0.82),
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: c.red,
                  marginLeft: 6,
                }}
              >
                {error}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable onPress={() => setError("")} hitSlop={6}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={14} color={c.red} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          <View style={styles.typeRow}>
            {POST_TYPES.map((pt) => {
              const active = type === pt.value;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={pt.value}
                  onPress={() => setType(pt.value)}
                  style={[
                    styles.typeBtn,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                      borderColor: active ? c.orangeGlow : c.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <Ionicons
                    name={pt.icon}
                    size={12}
                    color={active ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                  />
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: rem(0.72),
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
                      marginLeft: 4,
                    }}
                  >
                    {t(pt.key)}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>

          <View style={[styles.footer, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={pickImages}
              style={[styles.attachBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <Ionicons name="camera-outline" size={14} color={c.textDim} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: rem(0.8),
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: c.textDim,
                  marginLeft: 5,
                }}
              >
                {t("posts.photoBtn")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <View style={styles.footerRight}>
              {compact ? (
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => {
                    setExpanded(false);
                    setContent("");
                    setImages([]);
                  }}
                  style={[styles.cancelBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: rem(0.83),
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: c.textDim,
                    }}
                  >
                    {t("common.cancel")}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              ) : null}
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleSubmit}
                disabled={!content.trim() || submitting}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.postBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor:
                      pressed && content.trim() && !submitting
                        ? c.orangeHover
                        : c.orange,
                    opacity: !content.trim() || submitting ? 0.5 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.bg} />
                ) : null}
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.875),
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: c.bg,
                    marginLeft: submitting ? 6 : 0,
                  }}
                >
                  {submitting ? t("posts.posting") : t("posts.postBtn")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/posts/PostCard.js

// Verbatim port of src/components/posts/PostCard.jsx + PostCard.module.css.
//
// Updates in this version:
//   • resolveUrl() — prefixes relative /uploads/... paths with the API base
//   • <Image> renders author / comment / reply avatars whenever avatar exists
//     (letter fallback retained when missing)
//   • Tapping any avatar navigates to that user's public profile
//     (Worker → WorkerProfile, Hirer → HirerPublicProfile)
//   • Post images render via resolveUrl
//   • Lightbox is fullscreen, swipeable via prev/next buttons, and
//     dismisses on backdrop tap — mirrors the website modal exactly
//   • Modal uses presentationStyle="overFullScreen" + statusBarTranslucent
//     so it renders above the Android nav bar (matches web z-index behavior)

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

// ─── URL resolver ───────────────────────────────────────
// Mirrors what the browser does automatically — any relative path
// (/uploads/..., /media/...) is prefixed with the API base URL.
const API_BASE = client?.defaults?.baseURL || "https://api.skilledproz.com";

function resolveUrl(raw) {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "string") return null;
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  if (trimmed.startsWith("http://") || trimmed.startsWith("https://")) {
    return trimmed;
  }
  return `${API_BASE}${trimmed.startsWith("/") ? "" : "/"}${trimmed}`;
}
