// src/components/video/VoiceCallFullScreen.js
//
// Full-screen voice-call UI.
//   PENDING + caller   → "Calling…", cancel
//   PENDING + receiver → accept / decline
//   ACTIVE             → duration, mute, end
//
// Ported from web src/components/video/VoiceCallFullScreen.jsx.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Image, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useVoiceCall } from "../../contexts/VoiceCallContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaPhone,
  FaPhoneSlash,
  FaMicrophone,
  FaMicrophoneSlash,
  FaCompress,
  FaSpinner,
} from "../../icons/fa";

function formatDuration(startedAt) {
  if (!startedAt) return "00:00";
  const elapsed = Math.floor(
    (Date.now() - new Date(startedAt).getTime()) / 1000,
  );
  const m = String(Math.floor(elapsed / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
  const s = String(elapsed % 60).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${m}:${s}`;
}

export default function VoiceCallFullScreen({ rtc }) {
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const { call, updateCall, endCall, minimize } = useVoiceCall();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [duration, setDuration] = useState("00:00");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [otherUser, setOtherUser] = useState(null);
  const fetchedForRef = useRef(null);

  const isActive = call?.status === "ACTIVE";
  const isPending = call?.status === "PENDING";
  const isInitiator = call?.initiatorId === user?.id;
  const isReceiver = call?.receiverId === user?.id;

  useEffect(() => {
    const convoId = call?.conversationId;
    if (!convoId) return;
    if (fetchedForRef.current === convoId) return;
    fetchedForRef.current = convoId;

    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await client.get("/messages/conversations", {
          params: { page: 1, limit: 100, _t: Date.now() },
        });
        const list = res.data.data?.conversations || [];
        const convo = list.find((x) => x.id === convoId);
        const other = convo?.users?.find((u) => u.userId !== user?.id);
        if (!cancelled) setOtherUser(other?.user || null);
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [call?.conversationId, user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isActive) {
      setDuration("00:00");
      return;
    }
    setDuration(formatDuration(call.startedAt));
    const id = setInterval(
      () => setDuration(formatDuration(call.startedAt)),
      1000,
    );
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [isActive, call?.startedAt]);

  async function handleAccept() {
    if (!call) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.patch(
        `/voice-calls/${call.conversationId}/accept`,
      );
      updateCall(res.data.data.call);
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleDecline() {
    if (!call) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await client.patch(`/voice-calls/${call.conversationId}/decline`);
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      endCall();
    }
  }

  async function handleEnd() {
    if (!call) return;
    try {
      await client.patch(`/voice-calls/${call.conversationId}/end`);
    } catch {}
    endCall();
  }

  if (!call) return null;

  const otherName =
    `${otherUser?.firstName || ""} ${otherUser?.lastName || ""}`.trim() ||
    "the other party";
  const initials =
    `${otherUser?.firstName?.[0] || ""}${otherUser?.lastName?.[0] || ""}`.toUpperCase();

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.overlay, { backgroundColor: "#0a0a0a" }]}>
      {/* Top bar */}
      <View style={styles.topBar}>
        <AppText style={styles.brand}>SkilledProz Voice Call</AppText>
        {isActive ? (
          <View style={styles.liveTag}>
            <View style={styles.liveDot} />
            <AppText style={styles.liveText}>LIVE</AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        <Pressable onPress={minimize} style={styles.minimizeBtn} hitSlop={8}>
          <FaCompress size={14} color="#fff" />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* Center */}
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <View style={styles.avatarWrap}>
          <View style={styles.avatar}>
            {otherUser?.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: otherUser.avatar }}
                style={styles.avatarImg}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText style={styles.avatarText}>{initials || "?"}</AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
        <AppText style={styles.name}>{otherName}</AppText>
        <AppText style={styles.status}>
          {isActive
            ? duration
            : isPending && isInitiator
              ? "Calling…"
              : isPending && isReceiver
                ? "Incoming voice call"
                : ""}
        </AppText>
        {rtc?.error ? (
          <AppText style={styles.error}>{rtc.error}</AppText>
        ) : null}
        {isActive ? (
          <AppText style={styles.hint}>
            You can minimize this call and keep browsing — the audio stays on.
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {/* Controls */}
      <View style={styles.controls}>
        {isActive ? (
          <>
            <Pressable
              onPress={rtc?.toggleMute}
              style={[
                styles.circleBtn,
                rtc?.isMuted ? styles.circleBtnOn : null,
              ]}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              {rtc?.isMuted ? (
                <FaMicrophoneSlash size={20} color="#0a0a0a" />
              ) : (
                <FaMicrophone size={20} color="#fff" />
              )}
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable onPress={handleEnd} style={styles.endBtn} hitSlop={8}>
              <FaPhoneSlash size={22} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {isPending && isReceiver ? (
          <>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleDecline}
              disabled={busy}
              style={styles.declineBtn}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              {busy ? (
                <FaSpinner size={22} color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <FaPhoneSlash size={22} color="#fff" />
              )}
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleAccept}
              disabled={busy}
              style={styles.acceptBtn}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              {busy ? (
                <FaSpinner size={22} color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <FaPhone size={22} color="#fff" />
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {isPending && isInitiator ? (
          <Pressable onPress={handleEnd} style={styles.endBtn} hitSlop={8}>
            <FaPhoneSlash size={22} color="#fff" />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

// src/components/video/VoiceCallMini.js
//
// Minimized voice-call widget. Docked bottom-right by default; user can
// drag anywhere with PanResponder.
// Ported from web src/components/video/VoiceCallMini.jsx.

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Animated,
  Image,
  PanResponder,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useVoiceCall } from "../../contexts/VoiceCallContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaPhoneSlash,
  FaMicrophone,
  FaMicrophoneSlash,
  FaExpand,
  FaGripVertical,
  FaSpinner,
} from "../../icons/fa";

function formatDuration(startedAt) {
  if (!startedAt) return "00:00";
  const elapsed = Math.floor(
    (Date.now() - new Date(startedAt).getTime()) / 1000,
  );
  const m = String(Math.floor(elapsed / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
  const s = String(elapsed % 60).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${m}:${s}`;
}

export default function VoiceCallMini({ rtc }) {
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const { call, updateCall, endCall, expand } = useVoiceCall();
  const { width: winW, height: winH } = useWindowDimensions();

  const [duration, setDuration] = useState("00:00");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [otherUser, setOtherUser] = useState(null);
  const fetchedForRef = useRef(null);

  const isActive = call?.status === "ACTIVE";
  const isPending = call?.status === "PENDING";
  const isReceiver = call?.receiverId === user?.id;

  // ── Drag position ──
  const pan = useRef(new Animated.ValueXY({ x: 0, y: 0 })).current;
  const offsetRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const dragStartRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  const panResponder = useMemo(
    () =>
      PanResponder.create({
        onStartShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,
        onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,
        onPanResponderGrant: () => {
          dragStartRef.current = { ...offsetRef.current };
        },
        onPanResponderMove: (_, g) => {
          let nx = dragStartRef.current.x + g.dx;
          let ny = dragStartRef.current.y + g.dy;
          const w = 130;
          const h = 60;
          const margin = 8;
          if (nx < -(winW - w - margin)) nx = -(winW - w - margin);
          if (nx > 0) nx = 0;
          if (ny < -(winH - h - margin)) ny = -(winH - h - margin);
          if (ny > 0) ny = 0;
          pan.setValue({ x: nx, y: ny });
        },
        onPanResponderRelease: () => {
          offsetRef.current = { x: pan.x._value, y: pan.y._value };
        },
      }),
    [pan, winW, winH],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const convoId = call?.conversationId;
    if (!convoId) return;
    if (fetchedForRef.current === convoId) return;
    fetchedForRef.current = convoId;

    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await client.get("/messages/conversations", {
          params: { page: 1, limit: 100, _t: Date.now() },
        });
        const list = res.data.data?.conversations || [];
        const convo = list.find((x) => x.id === convoId);
        const other = convo?.users?.find((u) => u.userId !== user?.id);
        if (!cancelled) setOtherUser(other?.user || null);
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [call?.conversationId, user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isActive) {
      setDuration("00:00");
      return;
    }
    setDuration(formatDuration(call.startedAt));
    const id = setInterval(
      () => setDuration(formatDuration(call.startedAt)),
      1000,
    );
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [isActive, call?.startedAt]);

  async function handleAccept() {
    if (!call) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.patch(
        `/voice-calls/${call.conversationId}/accept`,
      );
      updateCall(res.data.data.call);
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleEnd() {
    if (!call) return;
    try {
      await client.patch(`/voice-calls/${call.conversationId}/end`);
    } catch {}
    endCall();
  }

  if (!call) return null;

  const otherName =
    `${otherUser?.firstName || ""} ${otherUser?.lastName || ""}`.trim() ||
    "the other party";
  const initials =
    `${otherUser?.firstName?.[0] || ""}${otherUser?.lastName?.[0] || ""}`.toUpperCase();

  const showHeader = !isActive;

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        styles.widget,
        isActive ? styles.widgetCompact : null,
        {
          transform: pan.getTranslateTransform(),
        },
      ]}
      {...panResponder.panHandlers}
    >
      <View style={styles.grip}>
        <FaGripVertical size={12} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.35)" />
      </View>

      {showHeader ? (
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <View style={styles.avatar}>
            {otherUser?.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: otherUser.avatar }}
                style={styles.avatarImg}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText style={styles.avatarText}>{initials || "?"}</AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          <View style={styles.meta}>
            <AppText style={styles.name} numberOfLines={1}>
              {otherName}
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={styles.status}>
              {isPending && isReceiver ? "Incoming…" : "Calling…"}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.compactMeta}>
          <View style={styles.compactDot} />
          <AppText style={styles.compactTime}>{duration}</AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={styles.actions}>
        {isActive ? (
          <>
            <Pressable
              onPress={rtc?.toggleMute}
              style={[styles.iconBtn, rtc?.isMuted ? styles.iconBtnOn : null]}
              hitSlop={6}
            >
              {rtc?.isMuted ? (
                <FaMicrophoneSlash
                  size={12}
                  color={rtc?.isMuted ? "#0a0a0a" : "#fff"}
                />
              ) : (
                <FaMicrophone size={12} color="#fff" />
              )}
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable onPress={handleEnd} style={styles.endBtn} hitSlop={6}>
              <FaPhoneSlash size={12} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable onPress={expand} style={styles.iconBtn} hitSlop={6}>
              <FaExpand size={12} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
          </>
        ) : isReceiver ? (
          <>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleEnd}
              disabled={busy}
              style={styles.endBtn}
              hitSlop={6}
            >
              {busy ? (
                <FaSpinner size={12} color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <FaPhoneSlash size={12} color="#fff" />
              )}
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleAccept}
              disabled={busy}
              style={styles.acceptBtn}
              hitSlop={6}
            >
              {busy ? (
                <FaSpinner size={12} color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <AppText style={styles.acceptText}>Accept</AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </>
        ) : (
          <Pressable onPress={handleEnd} style={styles.endBtn} hitSlop={6}>
            <FaPhoneSlash size={12} color="#fff" />
          </Pressable>
        )}
      </View>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

=== FILE: src/components/video/VoiceCallProvider.js ===
// src/components/video/VoiceCallProvider.js
//
// Persistent voice-call widget. Runs the WebRTC session, polls call status,
// renders fullscreen/mini UI.
//
// AUDIO ROUTING FIX: InCallManager.start() must run when rtc.status ===
// "connected", not just when the DB says ACTIVE. Otherwise the audio
// session opens before the peer connection exists, and Android/iOS never
// re-route the remote track once it starts flowing.
//
// Additionally, toggling setForceSpeakerphoneOn(true) → false after a
// short delay forces the Android audio system to re-evaluate the route —
// a known workaround for "WebRTC connected but no audio" on some devices.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import InCallManager from "react-native-incall-manager";
import { useVoiceCall } from "../../contexts/VoiceCallContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../api/client";
import useVoiceCallWebRTC from "../../hooks/useVoiceCallWebRTC";
import VoiceCallFullScreen from "./VoiceCallFullScreen";
import VoiceCallMini from "./VoiceCallMini";

const POLL_MS = 3000;

const DEBUG = true;
function log(...args) {
  if (!DEBUG) return;
  const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 23);
  console.log(`[VCP ${ts}]`, ...args);
}

export default function VoiceCallProvider() {
  const { user, isHydrated } = useAuthStore();
  const { call, mode, updateCall, endCall } = useVoiceCall();

  const inFlightRef = useRef(false);
  const isActive = call?.status === "ACTIVE";

  const [everActive, setEverActive] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActive) setEverActive(true);
  }, [isActive]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!call) setEverActive(false);
  }, [call]);

  const callRef = useRef(call);
  const userRef = useRef(user);
  useEffect(() => {
    callRef.current = call;
  }, [call]);
  useEffect(() => {
    userRef.current = user;
  }, [user]);

  const getIsInitiator = useCallback(() => {
    const c = callRef.current;
    const u = userRef.current;
    return !!(c && u && c.initiatorId === u.id);
  }, []);

  const hookConversationId = call?.conversationId || null;
  const effectiveActive = isActive || everActive;

  const rtc = useVoiceCallWebRTC({
    conversationId: hookConversationId,
    getIsInitiator,
  });

  // ── Audio routing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Runs when the peer connection is CONNECTED — not just when the DB row
  // flips to ACTIVE. This is what makes the mobile speaker produce sound.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isActive) {
      log("audio: not active — stopping");
      try {
        InCallManager.stop();
        InCallManager.setKeepScreenOn(false);
      } catch {}
      return;
    }

    if (rtc.status !== "connected") {
      log("audio: active but peer not connected — waiting", {
        rtcStatus: rtc.status,
      });
      return;
    }

    log("audio: peer connected — starting InCallManager");
    try {
      // 1. Start the audio session (acquires the audio route)
      InCallManager.start({ media: "audio" });

      // 2. Force speaker on, then off after a short delay — this forces
      //    the Android AudioManager to re-evaluate the routing and pick
      //    up the WebRTC audio stream. Skip the second step to keep
      //    speaker on; call setForceSpeakerphoneOn(false) to use earpiece.
      InCallManager.setForceSpeakerphoneOn(true);
      const t = setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          InCallManager.setForceSpeakerphoneOn(false);
        } catch {}
      }, 250);
      InCallManager.setKeepScreenOn(true);

      return () => {
        clearTimeout(t);
        try {
          InCallManager.stop();
          InCallManager.setKeepScreenOn(false);
        } catch {}
      };
    } catch (err) {
      log("audio: InCallManager failed", err?.message);
    }
  }, [isActive, rtc.status]);

  // ── Poll for status ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isHydrated || !user) return;
    if (!call?.conversationId) return;

    let cancelled = false;
    const conversationId = call.conversationId;

    async function poll() {
      if (inFlightRef.current) return;
      inFlightRef.current = true;
      try {
        const res = await client.get(`/voice-calls/${conversationId}`);
        const data = res.data.data;
        if (cancelled) return;

        if (!data?.call) {
          endCall();
          return;
        }
        if (data.call.status === "ENDED" || data.call.status === "DECLINED") {
          endCall();
          return;
        }

        const current = callRef.current;
        const changed =
          !current ||
          current.status !== data.call.status ||
          current.initiatorId !== data.call.initiatorId ||
          current.receiverId !== data.call.receiverId;

        if (changed) {
          log("poll: status changed →", data.call.status);
          updateCall(data.call);
        }
      } catch {
      } finally {
        inFlightRef.current = false;
      }
    }

    poll();
    const id = setInterval(poll, POLL_MS);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(id);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isHydrated, user?.id, call?.conversationId]);

  if (!call || mode === "hidden") return null;

  return (
    <>
      {mode === "fullscreen" && <VoiceCallFullScreen rtc={rtc} />}
      {mode === "mini" && <VoiceCallMini rtc={rtc} />}
    </>
  );
}

// Mirrors the website's CSS variables in src/styles/global.css

// Also exports fontScaleFor() — the RN equivalent of the website's

    shadow: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)",
  },

export const THEMES = { dark, light };

// ── Font scale (mirrors the website's html { font-size } breakpoints) ──
// Website breakpoints:
//   > 860px  → 16px  (1.00×)
//   ≤ 860px  → 15px  (0.9375×)
//   ≤ 480px  → 14px  (0.875×)
//   ≤ 360px  → 13.5px (0.8437×)
//
// RN equivalent: multiply every fontSize by fontScaleFor(width).

export function fontScaleFor(width) {
  if (width <= 320) return 0.78;
  if (width <= 360) return 0.84; // ↔ 13.5px on 16px root
  if (width <= 400) return 0.88;
  if (width <= 480) return 0.9; // ↔ 14px on 16px root
  if (width <= 860) return 0.96; // ↔ 15px on 16px root
  return 1.0;
}

// Convenience: scale a base font size (in "web rem-like" px)
export const sfs = (base, factor = 1) => Math.round(base * factor);

// A React-free resolver — safe to call anywhere
export const getCurrentFontScale = () =>
  fontScaleFor(Dimensions.get("window").width);

// Respect the OS's accessibility font-size setting too
export const getSystemFontScale = () => PixelRatio.getFontScale() || 1.0;

// src/contexts/CurrencyContext.js
//
// Mobile currency context — EXTENDED with web's dual-currency model
// (dashboard display vs payment currency) so SettingsScreen.js can port.
//
// Preserves mobile fields: `currency`, `currencyCode`, `setCurrencyCode`,
// `format`, `currencies`. Adds web fields: `dashboardCurrency`,
// `paymentCurrency`, `changeDashboardCurrency`, `changePaymentCurrency`,
// `fmt`, `CURRENCY_META`, `ALL_CURRENCIES`.

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  useMemo,
  useCallback,
} from "react";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import { CURRENCIES, getCurrency } from "../constants/currencies";
import client from "../api/client";
import { useAuthStore } from "../store/authStore";

const STORAGE_KEY = "@skilledproz:currency";
const DASH_KEY = "@skilledproz:dashboard_currency";

// Web's CURRENCY_META — merge the mobile `CURRENCIES` constants with
// symbols that web has but mobile might not (USDC, USDT, etc.)
export const CURRENCY_META = {
  USD: { symbol: "$", name: "US Dollar" },
  EUR: { symbol: "€", name: "Euro" },
  GBP: { symbol: "£", name: "British Pound" },
  NGN: { symbol: "₦", name: "Nigerian Naira" },
  GHS: { symbol: "₵", name: "Ghanaian Cedi" },
  KES: { symbol: "KSh", name: "Kenyan Shilling" },
  ZAR: { symbol: "R", name: "South African Rand" },
  INR: { symbol: "₹", name: "Indian Rupee" },
  CAD: { symbol: "CA$", name: "Canadian Dollar" },
  AUD: { symbol: "A$", name: "Australian Dollar" },
  JPY: { symbol: "¥", name: "Japanese Yen" },
  CNY: { symbol: "¥", name: "Chinese Yuan" },
  BRL: { symbol: "R$", name: "Brazilian Real" },
  MXN: { symbol: "MX$", name: "Mexican Peso" },
  EGP: { symbol: "E£", name: "Egyptian Pound" },
  TZS: { symbol: "TSh", name: "Tanzanian Shilling" },
  UGX: { symbol: "USh", name: "Ugandan Shilling" },
  RWF: { symbol: "RF", name: "Rwandan Franc" },
  XOF: { symbol: "CFA", name: "West African CFA" },
  MAD: { symbol: "DH", name: "Moroccan Dirham" },
  PHP: { symbol: "₱", name: "Philippine Peso" },
  IDR: { symbol: "Rp", name: "Indonesian Rupiah" },
  VND: { symbol: "₫", name: "Vietnamese Dong" },
  THB: { symbol: "฿", name: "Thai Baht" },
  BDT: { symbol: "৳", name: "Bangladeshi Taka" },
  PKR: { symbol: "₨", name: "Pakistani Rupee" },
  AED: { symbol: "د.إ", name: "UAE Dirham" },
  SAR: { symbol: "﷼", name: "Saudi Riyal" },
  QAR: { symbol: "QR", name: "Qatari Riyal" },
  MYR: { symbol: "RM", name: "Malaysian Ringgit" },
  SGD: { symbol: "S$", name: "Singapore Dollar" },
  HKD: { symbol: "HK$", name: "Hong Kong Dollar" },
  USDC: { symbol: "USDC", name: "USD Coin" },
  USDT: { symbol: "USDT", name: "Tether" },
};

export const ALL_CURRENCIES = Object.keys(CURRENCY_META);

const CurrencyContext = createContext({
  currency: CURRENCIES[0],
  setCurrencyCode: () => {},
  format: () => "",
  dashboardCurrency: "USD",
  paymentCurrency: "USD",
  changeDashboardCurrency: () => {},
  changePaymentCurrency: () => {},
  fmt: () => "",
  CURRENCY_META,
  ALL_CURRENCIES,
});

export function CurrencyProvider({ children, initialCode = "USD" }) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState(initialCode);
  const [dashboardCurrency, setDashboardCurrency] = useState(initialCode);
  const [paymentCurrency, setPaymentCurrency] = useState(initialCode);
  const { user, updateUser } = useAuthStore();

  // Hydrate all three from storage
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [savedCode, savedDash] = await Promise.all([
          AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY),
          AsyncStorage.getItem(DASH_KEY),
        ]);
        if (savedCode) {
          setCode(savedCode);
          setPaymentCurrency(savedCode);
        }
        if (savedDash) setDashboardCurrency(savedDash);
      } catch {}
    })();
  }, []);

  // Sync from user
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.dashboardCurrency) setDashboardCurrency(user.dashboardCurrency);
    if (user?.paymentCurrency) setPaymentCurrency(user.paymentCurrency);
    if (user?.currency) setCode(user.currency);
  }, [user?.currency, user?.dashboardCurrency, user?.paymentCurrency]);

  const setCurrencyCode = async (next) => {
    setCode(next);
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
    } catch {}
  };

  const changeDashboardCurrency = useCallback(
    async (next) => {
      setDashboardCurrency(next);
      try {
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(DASH_KEY, next);
      } catch {}
      if (user) {
        try {
          await client.patch("/settings/profile", {
            dashboardCurrency: next,
          });
          updateUser?.({ dashboardCurrency: next });
        } catch {}
      }
    },
    [user, updateUser],
  );

  const changePaymentCurrency = useCallback(
    async (next) => {
      setPaymentCurrency(next);
      if (user) {
        try {
          await client.patch("/settings/profile", {
            paymentCurrency: next,
          });
          updateUser?.({ paymentCurrency: next });
        } catch {}
      }
    },
    [user, updateUser],
  );

  const currency = getCurrency(code);

  const format = useMemo(
    () =>
      (amount, opts = {}) => {
        const targetCode = opts.currencyCode || code;
        const target = getCurrency(targetCode);
        const num = Number(amount ?? 0);
        try {
          return new Intl.NumberFormat(opts.locale || undefined, {
            style: "currency",
            currency: targetCode,
            minimumFractionDigits: opts.minimumFractionDigits ?? 0,
            maximumFractionDigits: opts.maximumFractionDigits ?? 2,
          }).format(num);
        } catch {
          const formatted = num.toLocaleString(undefined, {
            minimumFractionDigits: opts.minimumFractionDigits ?? 0,
            maximumFractionDigits: opts.maximumFractionDigits ?? 2,
          });
          return `${target.symbol}${formatted}`;
        }
      },
    [code],
  );

  // Web parity: fmt(amount, currencyCode)
  const fmt = useCallback(
    (amount, currencyCode) => {
      const targetCode = currencyCode || dashboardCurrency;
      const isCrypto = ["USDC", "USDT"].includes(targetCode);
      const meta = CURRENCY_META[targetCode] || { symbol: targetCode };
      try {
        if (isCrypto) {
          return `${meta.symbol} ${Number(amount || 0).toFixed(2)}`;
        }
        return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
          style: "currency",
          currency: targetCode,
          maximumFractionDigits: [
            "JPY",
            "KES",
            "TZS",
            "UGX",
            "RWF",
            "XOF",
            "NGN",
            "GHS",
          ].includes(targetCode)
            ? 0
            : 2,
        }).format(amount || 0);
      } catch {
        return `${meta.symbol} ${Number(amount || 0).toFixed(2)}`;
      }
    },
    [dashboardCurrency],
  );

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      // Mobile-preserved
      currency,
      currencyCode: code,
      setCurrencyCode,
      format,
      currencies: CURRENCIES,
      // Web-parity additions
      dashboardCurrency,
      paymentCurrency,
      changeDashboardCurrency,
      changePaymentCurrency,
      fmt,
      CURRENCY_META,
      ALL_CURRENCIES,
    }),
    [
      currency,
      code,
      format,
      dashboardCurrency,
      paymentCurrency,
      changeDashboardCurrency,
      changePaymentCurrency,
      fmt,
    ],
  );

  return (
    <CurrencyContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </CurrencyContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useCurrency = () => useContext(CurrencyContext);

// src/contexts/SubscriptionContext.js
//
// Auth is proven by `user` existing — the axios client already injects
// the Bearer token into every request. We don't need to extract the
// token from the store, and we shouldn't gate on it.

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AppState } from "react-native";
import client from "../api/client";
import { useAuthStore } from "../store/authStore";

const SubscriptionContext = createContext(null);

function extractTierFromUser(user) {
  if (!user) return null;
  return (
    user.subscriptionTier ||
    user.tier ||
    user.subscription?.tier ||
    user.plan?.tier ||
    null
  );
}

export function SubscriptionProvider({ children }) {
  const { user } = useAuthStore();

  const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState(null);
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const tierFromUser = extractTierFromUser(user);
  const tier = subscription?.tier || tierFromUser || "FREE";
  const isFreeTier = tier === "FREE";
  const isProTier = tier === "PRO" || tier === "ENTERPRISE";
  const isEnterprise = tier === "ENTERPRISE";

  // ── Fetch subscription when user becomes available ─────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) {
      setSubscription(null);
      setPlan(null);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    let cancelled = false;

    client
      .get("/subscriptions/my")
      .then((res) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const data = res?.data?.data ?? {};
        const sub =
          data.subscription ?? (data.tier ? { tier: data.tier } : null);
        setSubscription(sub);
        setPlan(data.plan ?? null);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (__DEV__) {
          console.log(
            "[SubscriptionContext] /subscriptions/my failed:",
            err?.response?.status,
            err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message,
          );
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [user?.id]);

  // ── Re-fetch when app returns to foreground (picks up tier changes) ─
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    const sub = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
      if (state === "active") {
        client
          .get("/subscriptions/my")
          .then((res) => {
            const data = res?.data?.data ?? {};
            const s =
              data.subscription ?? (data.tier ? { tier: data.tier } : null);
            setSubscription(s);
            setPlan(data.plan ?? null);
          })
          .catch(() => {});
      }
    });
    return () => sub.remove();
  }, [user?.id]);

  const features = {
    advancedSearch: isProTier,
    gpsRadius: isProTier,
    verifiedFirst: isProTier,
    unlimitedSavedWorkers: isProTier,
    unlimitedJobPosts: isProTier,
    directBooking: isProTier,
    unlimitedApplications: isProTier,
    priorityMatching: isProTier,
    proBadge: isProTier,
    boostedSearch: isProTier,
    videoIntro: isProTier,
    unlimitedPortfolio: isProTier,
    analytics: isProTier,
    jobAnalytics: isProTier,
    earningsAnalytics: isProTier,
    prioritySupport: isProTier,
    accountManager: isEnterprise,
    teamAccounts: isEnterprise,
    apiAccess: isEnterprise,
    bulkHiring: isEnterprise,
    whitelabelInvoices: isEnterprise,
    complianceReporting: isEnterprise,
    customSLA: isEnterprise,
    jobPostsPerMonth: plan?.limits?.jobPostsPerMonth ?? 3,
    bidsPerMonth: plan?.limits?.bidsPerMonth ?? 5,
    portfolioImages: plan?.limits?.portfolioImages ?? 1,
    teamAccountCount: plan?.limits?.teamAccounts ?? 0,
  };

  const refresh = () => {
    if (!user) return;
    client
      .get("/subscriptions/my")
      .then((res) => {
        const data = res?.data?.data ?? {};
        const sub =
          data.subscription ?? (data.tier ? { tier: data.tier } : null);
        setSubscription(sub);
        setPlan(data.plan ?? null);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  };

  if (__DEV__) {
    console.log("[SubscriptionContext]", {
      hasUser: !!user,
      userId: user?.id,
      tierFromUser,
      tierFromAPI: subscription?.tier ?? null,
      effectiveTier: tier,
      isProTier,
      isEnterprise,
    });
  }

  return (
    <SubscriptionContext.Provider
      value={{
        subscription,
        plan,
        tier,
        loading,
        isFreeTier,
        isProTier,
        isEnterprise,
        features,
        refresh,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </SubscriptionContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useSubscription() {
  const ctx = useContext(SubscriptionContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    return {
      subscription: null,
      plan: null,
      tier: "FREE",
      loading: false,
      isFreeTier: true,
      isProTier: false,
      isEnterprise: false,
      features: {},
      refresh: () => {},
    };
  }
  return ctx;
}

// src/contexts/ThemeContext.js
//
// Mobile theme context — EXTENDED with web's `language` + `changeTheme`
// + `changeLanguage` so SettingsScreen.js can port verbatim.
//
// Everything previously exposed (`theme`, `mode`, `effectiveMode`, `setMode`,
// `fonts`, `radii`, `spacing`, `fontScale`, `systemFontScale`,
// `effectiveFontScale`) is preserved. Added: `language`, `changeTheme`,
// `changeLanguage`.

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  useMemo,
  useCallback,
} from "react";
import { Appearance, useWindowDimensions, PixelRatio } from "react-native";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import {
  THEMES,
  FONTS,
  RADII,
  SPACING,
  fontScaleFor,
} from "../constants/theme";
import * as Localization from "expo-localization";
import client from "../api/client";
import { useAuthStore } from "../store/authStore";

const STORAGE_KEY = "@skilledproz:theme";
const LANG_KEY = "@skilledproz:language";

const ThemeContext = createContext({
  theme: THEMES.dark,
  mode: "system",
  setMode: () => {},
  language: "en",
  changeTheme: () => {},
  changeLanguage: () => {},
});

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState("system");
  const [systemScheme, setSystemScheme] = useState(
    Appearance.getColorScheme() || "dark",
  );
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState(
    () => Localization.getLocales()?.[0]?.languageCode || "en",
  );

  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const { user, updateUser } = useAuthStore();

  // Hydrate stored mode + language
  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(LANG_KEY),
    ])
      .then(([storedMode, storedLang]) => {
        if (
          storedMode === "light" ||
          storedMode === "dark" ||
          storedMode === "system"
        ) {
          setModeState(storedMode);
        }
        if (storedLang) setLanguage(storedLang);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  // React to OS theme changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const sub = Appearance.addChangeListener(({ colorScheme }) => {
      setSystemScheme(colorScheme || "dark");
    });
    return () => sub.remove();
  }, []);

  // Sync from logged-in user
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    if (
      user.theme &&
      (user.theme === "light" ||
        user.theme === "dark" ||
        user.theme === "system")
    ) {
      setModeState(user.theme);
    }
    if (user.language) {
      setLanguage(user.language);
      AsyncStorage.setItem(LANG_KEY, user.language).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [user?.id]);

  const setMode = async (next) => {
    setModeState(next);
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
    } catch {}
  };

  // Alias used by SettingsScreen (web name)
  const changeTheme = useCallback(
    async (next) => {
      await setMode(next);
      if (user) {
        try {
          await client.patch("/settings/profile", { theme: next });
          updateUser?.({ theme: next });
        } catch {}
      }
    },
    [user, updateUser],
  );

  const changeLanguage = useCallback(
    async (lang) => {
      setLanguage(lang);
      try {
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(LANG_KEY, lang);
      } catch {}
      if (user) {
        try {
          await client.patch("/settings/profile", { language: lang });
          updateUser?.({ language: lang });
        } catch {}
      }
    },
    [user, updateUser],
  );

  const effectiveMode = mode === "system" ? systemScheme : mode;
  const theme = effectiveMode === "light" ? THEMES.light : THEMES.dark;

  const fontScale = fontScaleFor(width);
  const systemFontScale = PixelRatio.getFontScale() || 1.0;
  const effectiveFontScale = fontScale * systemFontScale;

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      theme,
      mode,
      effectiveMode,
      setMode,
      fonts: FONTS,
      radii: RADII,
      spacing: SPACING,
      fontScale,
      systemFontScale,
      effectiveFontScale,
      // Web parity additions
      language,
      changeTheme,
      changeLanguage,
    }),
    [
      theme,
      mode,
      effectiveMode,
      fontScale,
      systemFontScale,
      effectiveFontScale,
      language,
      changeTheme,
      changeLanguage,
    ],
  );

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useTheme = () => useContext(ThemeContext);

// src/contexts/ToastContext.js
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  useRef,
  useEffect,
} from "react";
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  Animated,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Platform,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { useTheme } from "./ThemeContext";

/**
 * Toast types: "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning"
 *
 * Usage anywhere in the tree:
 *   const { toast } = useToast();
 *   toast.success("Logged in");
 *   toast.error("Invalid credentials");
 *   toast.info("Heads up");
 *   toast.warning("Are you sure?");
 *
 * Always prefer this over Alert.alert.
 */

const ToastContext = createContext({
  show: () => {},
  toast: { success: () => {}, error: () => {}, info: () => {}, warning: () => {} },
});

const DURATION = 3500;

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id) => {
    setQueue((q) => q.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const show = useCallback(
    (message, type = "info", opts = {}) => {
      const id = ++idRef.current;
      const toast = {
        id,
        message: String(message ?? ""),
        type,
        duration: opts.duration ?? DURATION,
      };
      setQueue((q) => [...q, toast]);
      return id;
    },
    [],
  );

  const toast = {
    success: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "success", opts),
    error: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "error", opts),
    info: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "info", opts),
    warning: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "warning", opts),
  };

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ show, toast, dismiss }}>
      {children}
      <ToastViewport queue={queue} onDismiss={dismiss} />
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

function ToastViewport({ queue, onDismiss }) {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  return (
    <View
      pointerEvents="box-none"
      style={[
        styles.viewport,
        { top: insets.top + 8 },
      ]}
    >
      {queue.map((t) => (
        <ToastItem key={t.id} toast={t} onDismiss={onDismiss} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function ToastItem({ toast, onDismiss }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const opacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const translateY = useRef(new Animated.Value(-12)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(opacity, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 220,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 240,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start();

    const timer = setTimeout(handleDismiss, toast.duration);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleDismiss = () => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(opacity, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: -8,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start(() => onDismiss(toast.id));
  };

  const palette = getPalette(toast.type, theme);

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        styles.toast,
        {
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
          borderColor: palette.border,
          shadowColor: theme.colors.shadow,
          opacity,
          transform: [{ translateY }],
        },
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={[styles.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: palette.bgIcon }]}
      >
        <Ionicons name={palette.icon} size={18} color={palette.iconColor} />
      </View>
      <Text
        style={[styles.message, { color: theme.colors.text }]}
        numberOfLines={3}
      >
        {toast.message}
      </Text>
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={handleDismiss}
        hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
      >
        <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={theme.colors.textDim} />
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

function getPalette(type, theme) {
  switch (type) {
    case "success":
      return {
        icon: "checkmark-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.green,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.greenDim,
        border: theme.colors.greenDim,
      };
    case "error":
      return {
        icon: "alert-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.red,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.redDim,
        border: theme.colors.redDim,
      };
    case "warning":
      return {
        icon: "warning",
        iconColor: theme.colors.orange,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.orangeDim,
      };
    case "info":
    default:
      return {
        icon: "information-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.orange,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.border,
      };
  }
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  viewport: {
    position: "absolute",
    left: 12,
    right: 12,
    zIndex: 9999,
    elevation: 9999,
    gap: 8,
  },
  toast: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingVertical: 12,
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
    gap: 12,
    ...Platform.select({
      ios: {
        shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
        shadowOpacity: 0.18,
        shadowRadius: 12,
      },
      android: { elevation: 6 },
    }),
  },
  iconWrap: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    borderRadius: 16,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  message: {
    flex: 1,
    fontSize: 14,
    lineHeight: 19,
  },
});

export const useToast = () => useContext(ToastContext);

// src/contexts/VoiceCallContext.js
//
// Global voice-call state. Single source of truth for:
//   • which call is in progress (call)
//   • which UI mode we're in (mode: "hidden" | "fullscreen" | "mini")
//
// Ported verbatim from src/context/VoiceCallContext.jsx.

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
} from "react";

const DEBUG_VOICE_CALL = true;
function log(...args) {
  if (!DEBUG_VOICE_CALL) return;
  const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 23);
  console.log(`[VCC ${ts}]`, ...args);
}

const VoiceCallContext = createContext(null);

export function VoiceCallProvider({ children }) {
  const [call, setCallState] = useState(null);
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState("hidden");
  const callRef = useRef(null);

  const setCall = useCallback((next) => {
    if (next) {
      log("setCall →", {
        id: next.id,
        status: next.status,
        initiatorId: next.initiatorId,
        receiverId: next.receiverId,
        conversationId: next.conversationId,
        callType: next.callType,
      });
    } else {
      log("setCall → null");
    }
    callRef.current = next;
    setCallState(next);
  }, []);

  const startCall = useCallback(
    (nextCall) => {
      log("startCall()", {
        id: nextCall?.id,
        status: nextCall?.status,
        initiatorId: nextCall?.initiatorId,
      });
      setCall(nextCall);
      setModeState("fullscreen");
    },
    [setCall],
  );

  const openCall = useCallback(
    (nextCall) => {
      log("openCall()", {
        id: nextCall?.id,
        status: nextCall?.status,
        initiatorId: nextCall?.initiatorId,
      });
      setCall(nextCall);
      setModeState("fullscreen");
    },
    [setCall],
  );

  const updateCall = useCallback((patch) => {
    setCallState((prev) => {
      if (!prev) return prev;
      const next = { ...prev, ...patch };
      if (prev.status !== next.status) {
        log(`status ${prev.status} → ${next.status}`, {
          id: next.id,
          initiatorId: next.initiatorId,
          receiverId: next.receiverId,
        });
      }
      callRef.current = next;
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const minimize = useCallback(() => {
    log("minimize()");
    setModeState("mini");
  }, []);

  const expand = useCallback(() => {
    log("expand()");
    setModeState("fullscreen");
  }, []);

  const endCall = useCallback(() => {
    log("endCall()");
    callRef.current = null;
    setCallState(null);
    setModeState("hidden");
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      call,
      mode,
      startCall,
      openCall,
      updateCall,
      minimize,
      expand,
      endCall,
    }),
    [call, mode, startCall, openCall, updateCall, minimize, expand, endCall],
  );

  return (
    <VoiceCallContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </VoiceCallContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useVoiceCall() {
  const ctx = useContext(VoiceCallContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error("useVoiceCall must be used inside <VoiceCallProvider>");
  }
  return ctx;
}

// src/hooks/useDebounce.js
//
// Ported from the web's inline setTimeout pattern in AddStaffModal.jsx
// (searchDebounce useRef + setTimeout 350ms). Extracted so it's reusable.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export function useDebouncedValue(value, delay = 350) {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delay);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, delay]);
  return debounced;
}

export function useDebouncedCallback(fn, delay = 350) {
  const timer = useRef(null);
  const fnRef = useRef(fn);
  useEffect(() => {
    fnRef.current = fn;
  });
  return (...args) => {
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => fnRef.current(...args), delay);
  };
}

=== FILE: src/hooks/useFeedPolling.js ===
// src/hooks/useFeedPolling.js
//
// Ported from src/hooks/useFeedPolling.js.
// document.hidden → AppState.currentState !== "active".
// window "online" event → RN has no equivalent; dropped.
// visibilitychange → AppState.addEventListener("change", ...).

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { AppState } from "react-native";
import client from "../api/client";

export default function useFeedPolling({
  filter = "ALL",
  currentPosts = [],
  intervalMs = 25000,
  enabled = true,
} = {}) {
  const [pendingPosts, setPendingPosts] = useState([]);

  const filterRef = useRef(filter);
  const postsRef = useRef(currentPosts);
  const enabledRef = useRef(enabled);

  useEffect(() => {
    filterRef.current = filter;
  }, [filter]);
  useEffect(() => {
    postsRef.current = currentPosts;
  }, [currentPosts]);
  useEffect(() => {
    enabledRef.current = enabled;
  }, [enabled]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setPendingPosts([]);
  }, [filter]);

  const runPoll = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!enabledRef.current) return;
    if (AppState.currentState !== "active") return;

    try {
      const res = await client.get("/posts/feed", {
        params: {
          page: 1,
          limit: 15,
          ...(filterRef.current !== "ALL" && { type: filterRef.current }),
        },
      });

      const fresh = res?.data?.data?.posts ?? [];
      if (!fresh.length) return;

      const knownIds = new Set(postsRef.current.map((p) => p.id));
      const queuedIds = new Set(pendingPosts.map((p) => p.id));
      const brandNew = fresh.filter(
        (p) => !knownIds.has(p.id) && !queuedIds.has(p.id),
      );

      if (brandNew.length) {
        setPendingPosts((prev) => {
          const merged = [...brandNew, ...prev];
          const seen = new Set();
          return merged.filter((p) => {
            if (seen.has(p.id)) return false;
            seen.add(p.id);
            return true;
          });
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // swallow — polling must never break the UI
    }
  }, [pendingPosts]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;

    const id = setInterval(runPoll, intervalMs);

    const sub = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
      if (state === "active") runPoll();
    });

    return () => {
      clearInterval(id);
      sub.remove();
    };
  }, [enabled, intervalMs, runPoll]);

  const dismissPending = () => setPendingPosts([]);
  const clearPending = () => setPendingPosts([]);

  return { pendingPosts, dismissPending, clearPending };
}

=== FILE: src/hooks/useOTAUpdates.js ===
// src/hooks/useOTAUpdates.js
//
// Silently checks for and applies EAS OTA JS bundle updates.
// Behaviour:
//   - On mount, checks the configured updates.url for a newer bundle
//   - If found, downloads it in the background (no UI blocking)
//   - Applies it silently on the NEXT cold start (not this session)
//   - Never throws — all errors are logged in dev only
//
// Design rationale:
//   We deliberately do NOT force reload the app mid-session. Users get the
//   new bundle the next time they kill + reopen the app. This avoids the
//   jarring UX of a sudden screen reset while they're mid-task.

import { useEffect } from "react";
import * as Updates from "expo-updates";

export default function useOTAUpdates() {
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function checkForUpdates() {
      // In dev mode, OTA doesn't apply (Metro serves the bundle live).
      if (__DEV__) return;

      try {
        const update = await Updates.checkForUpdateAsync();
        if (cancelled || !update.isAvailable) return;

        // Download in the background — this is fast and safe.
        const fetched = await Updates.fetchUpdateAsync();
        if (cancelled) return;

        // Do NOT call Updates.reloadAsync() here. The new bundle will apply
        // automatically on the next cold start. Silent, non-disruptive.
        if (__DEV__ && fetched.isNew) {
          console.log("[OTA] New bundle downloaded — will apply on next launch.");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Never crash the app over an OTA check.
        if (__DEV__) {
          console.log("[OTA] Update check failed (non-fatal):", err?.message);
        }
      }
    }

    checkForUpdates();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);
}

=== FILE: src/hooks/useSavedWorker.js ===
// src/hooks/useSavedWorker.js
//
// Port of the web hook. Tracks whether a worker is saved by the current
// hirer, and provides toggle() to save/unsave.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import client from "../api/client";

export default function useSavedWorker(workerId, { enabled = true } = {}) {
  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(enabled && !!workerId);
  const [toggling, setToggling] = useState(false);
  const cancelledRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || !workerId) {
      setChecking(false);
      return;
    }
    cancelledRef.current = false;
    setChecking(true);

    client
      .get(`/hirers/me/saved-workers/${workerId}/exists`)
      .then((res) => {
        if (cancelledRef.current) return;
        setIsSaved(!!res?.data?.data?.saved);
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelledRef.current) setChecking(false);
      });

    return () => {
      cancelledRef.current = true;
    };
  }, [workerId, enabled]);

  const toggle = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!workerId || toggling) return;
    setToggling(true);
    const next = !isSaved;
    setIsSaved(next);

    try {
      if (next) {
        await client.post(`/hirers/me/saved-workers/${workerId}`);
      } else {
        await client.delete(`/hirers/me/saved-workers/${workerId}`);
      }
    } catch {
      setIsSaved(!next);
    } finally {
      setToggling(false);
    }
  }, [workerId, isSaved, toggling]);

  return { isSaved, checking, toggling, toggle };
}

=== FILE: src/hooks/useVoiceCallWebRTC.js ===
// src/hooks/useVoiceCallWebRTC.js
//
// Manages one WebRTC voice-call session.
//
// Uses tokenStore-backed getVoiceSocket() (async). Buffers offer/answer
// if they arrive before the PC exists. Logs ontrack details so we can see
// whether the remote audio track is live.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  RTCPeerConnection,
  RTCSessionDescription,
  RTCIceCandidate,
  MediaStream,
  mediaDevices,
} from "react-native-webrtc";
import { getVoiceSocket } from "../lib/voiceSocket";

const ICE_SERVERS = [
  { urls: "stun:stun.l.google.com:19302" },
  { urls: "stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302" },
];

const DEBUG_VOICE_CALL = true;
function log(...args) {
  if (!DEBUG_VOICE_CALL) return;
  const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 23);
  console.log(`[WRTC ${ts}]`, ...args);
}
function logErr(...args) {
  const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 23);
  console.error(`[WRTC ${ts}]`, ...args);
}

export default function useVoiceCallWebRTC({ conversationId, getIsInitiator }) {
  const [localStream, setLocalStream] = useState(null);
  const [remoteStream, setRemoteStream] = useState(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("idle");
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const pcRef = useRef(null);
  const socketRef = useRef(null);
  const localStreamRef = useRef(null);
  const remoteStreamRef = useRef(null);
  const pendingIceRef = useRef([]);
  const pendingOfferRef = useRef(null);
  const pendingAnswerRef = useRef(null);
  const startedRef = useRef(false);
  const offeringRef = useRef(false);
  const hasJoinedRef = useRef(false);

  const getIsInitiatorRef = useRef(getIsInitiator);
  useEffect(() => {
    getIsInitiatorRef.current = getIsInitiator;
  }, [getIsInitiator]);

  const cleanup = useCallback(() => {
    if (pcRef.current) {
      try {
        pcRef.current.getSenders().forEach((s) => s.track?.stop());
        pcRef.current.close();
      } catch {}
      pcRef.current = null;
    }
    if (localStreamRef.current) {
      localStreamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      localStreamRef.current = null;
    }
    remoteStreamRef.current = null;
    setLocalStream(null);
    setRemoteStream(null);
    setStatus("idle");
    setError(null);
    pendingIceRef.current = [];
    pendingOfferRef.current = null;
    pendingAnswerRef.current = null;
    offeringRef.current = false;
    hasJoinedRef.current = false;
    startedRef.current = false;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!conversationId) return;
    if (startedRef.current) return;
    startedRef.current = true;

    let cancelled = false;
    let socket = null;

    const applyOfferIfReady = async () => {
      const pc = pcRef.current;
      const pending = pendingOfferRef.current;
      if (!pc || !pending) return;
      pendingOfferRef.current = null;
      await applyOffer(pending);
    };

    const applyAnswerIfReady = async () => {
      const pc = pcRef.current;
      const pending = pendingAnswerRef.current;
      if (!pc || !pending) return;
      pendingAnswerRef.current = null;
      await applyAnswer(pending);
    };

    const applyOffer = async ({ sdp }) => {
      const pcLocal = pcRef.current;
      if (!pcLocal) return;
      try {
        if (
          pcLocal.signalingState === "have-local-offer" ||
          pcLocal.signalingState === "have-remote-offer"
        ) {
          try {
            await pcLocal.setLocalDescription({ type: "rollback" });
          } catch {}
        }
        await pcLocal.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(sdp));
        const answer = await pcLocal.createAnswer();
        await pcLocal.setLocalDescription(answer);
        socket.emit("voice:answer", { conversationId, sdp: answer });
        log("✅ sent answer");
        for (const c of pendingIceRef.current) {
          try {
            await pcLocal.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c));
          } catch {}
        }
        pendingIceRef.current = [];
      } catch (err) {
        logErr("applyOffer failed:", err);
      }
    };

    const applyAnswer = async ({ sdp }) => {
      const pcLocal = pcRef.current;
      if (!pcLocal) return;
      try {
        if (pcLocal.signalingState === "have-local-offer") {
          await pcLocal.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(sdp));
          for (const c of pendingIceRef.current) {
            try {
              await pcLocal.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c));
            } catch {}
          }
          pendingIceRef.current = [];
          log("✅ applied answer");
        } else {
          log(
            "applyAnswer: signalingState =",
            pcLocal.signalingState,
            "— ignoring",
          );
        }
      } catch (err) {
        logErr("applyAnswer failed:", err);
      }
    };

    async function start() {
      try {
        setStatus("requesting-mic");

        const stream = await mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          audio: {
            echoCancellation: true,
            noiseSuppression: true,
            autoGainControl: true,
          },
          video: false,
        });

        if (cancelled) {
          stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
          return;
        }

        localStreamRef.current = stream;
        setLocalStream(stream);
        log("🎤 local stream ready", {
          audioTracks: stream.getAudioTracks().length,
        });

        const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: ICE_SERVERS });
        pcRef.current = pc;

        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => {
          try {
            pc.addTrack(track, stream);
            log("added local track", track.kind);
          } catch (e) {
            logErr("addTrack failed:", e);
          }
        });

        // ── Remote track ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        pc.ontrack = (event) => {
          const incoming = event.streams[0];
          log("📥 ontrack fired", {
            kind: event.track.kind,
            enabled: event.track.enabled,
            muted: event.track.muted,
            readyState: event.track.readyState,
            streamsCount: event.streams.length,
          });

          const current = remoteStreamRef.current;
          const next = new MediaStream();
          const tracks = current
            ? [...current.getTracks(), ...incoming.getTracks()]
            : [...incoming.getTracks()];
          const seen = new Set();
          for (const t of tracks) {
            if (seen.has(t.id)) continue;
            seen.add(t.id);
            next.addTrack(t);
          }
          remoteStreamRef.current = next;
          setRemoteStream(next);
          log("📥 remoteStream ready", {
            trackCount: next.getTracks().length,
            audio: next.getAudioTracks().length,
          });
        };

        pc.onicecandidate = (event) => {
          if (!event.candidate) {
            log("ICE gathering complete");
            return;
          }
          socketRef.current?.emit("voice:ice", {
            conversationId,
            candidate: event.candidate.toJSON(),
          });
        };

        pc.onconnectionstatechange = () => {
          const s = pc.connectionState;
          log("connectionState:", s);
          if (s === "connected") setStatus("connected");
          else if (s === "connecting") setStatus("connecting");
          else if (s === "disconnected") setStatus("disconnected");
          else if (s === "failed") setStatus("failed");
        };

        pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = () => {
          log("iceConnectionState:", pc.iceConnectionState);
        };

        // ── Socket (async now — tokenStore) ──────────────────────────
        socket = await getVoiceSocket();
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (!socket) {
          setError("Could not connect to signaling server");
          setStatus("failed");
          return;
        }
        socketRef.current = socket;
        log("socket acquired", {
          connected: socket.connected,
          id: socket.id,
        });

        if (pendingOfferRef.current) {
          log("applying buffered offer (post-PC creation)");
          await applyOfferIfReady();
        }
        if (pendingAnswerRef.current) {
          log("applying buffered answer (post-PC creation)");
          await applyAnswerIfReady();
        }

        const joinRoom = (reason) => {
          if (hasJoinedRef.current) return;
          hasJoinedRef.current = true;
          log(`emitting voice:join [${reason}]`, { conversationId });
          socket.emit("voice:join", { conversationId }, (resp) => {
            log("voice:join response", resp);
            if (!resp?.ok) {
              hasJoinedRef.current = false;
              setError(resp?.error || "Failed to join call room");
              setStatus("failed");
            }
          });
        };

        if (socket.connected) {
          joinRoom("socket already connected");
        } else {
          socket.once("connect", () => joinRoom("initial connect"));
        }

        const createAndSendOffer = async (trigger) => {
          const pcLocal = pcRef.current;
          if (!pcLocal) return;
          if (offeringRef.current) return;
          const initiating = getIsInitiatorRef.current?.();
          if (!initiating) {
            log(`createAndSendOffer [${trigger}]: not initiator`);
            return;
          }

          offeringRef.current = true;
          try {
            if (pcLocal.signalingState === "have-local-offer") {
              try {
                await pcLocal.setLocalDescription({ type: "rollback" });
              } catch {}
            }
            setStatus("connecting");
            const offer = await pcLocal.createOffer({
              offerToReceiveAudio: true,
            });
            await pcLocal.setLocalDescription(offer);
            socket.emit("voice:offer", { conversationId, sdp: offer });
            log("✅ sent offer");
          } catch (err) {
            logErr("createOffer failed:", err);
          } finally {
            setTimeout(() => {
              offeringRef.current = false;
            }, 1500);
          }
        };

        const onPeerJoined = async () => {
          const initiating = getIsInitiatorRef.current?.();
          log(`🎯 peer-joined — isInitiator=${initiating}`);
          if (!initiating || !pcRef.current) return;
          setTimeout(() => createAndSendOffer("peer-joined"), 250);
        };

        const onOffer = async ({ sdp }) => {
          if (!pcRef.current) {
            log("📥 offer arrived BEFORE PC — buffering");
            pendingOfferRef.current = { sdp };
            return;
          }
          log("📥 received offer — applying");
          await applyOffer({ sdp });
        };

        const onAnswer = async ({ sdp }) => {
          if (!pcRef.current) {
            log("📥 answer arrived BEFORE PC — buffering");
            pendingAnswerRef.current = { sdp };
            return;
          }
          log("📥 received answer — applying");
          await applyAnswer({ sdp });
        };

        const onIce = async ({ candidate }) => {
          const pcLocal = pcRef.current;
          if (!pcLocal) {
            pendingIceRef.current.push(candidate);
            return;
          }
          if (pcLocal.remoteDescription?.type) {
            try {
              await pcLocal.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(candidate));
            } catch {}
          } else {
            pendingIceRef.current.push(candidate);
          }
        };

        const onPeerLeft = () => {
          log("peer left");
          setStatus("connecting");
        };

        const onSocketReconnect = () => {
          log("socket reconnect — rejoining room");
          hasJoinedRef.current = false;
          joinRoom("socket reconnect");
        };

        socket.on("voice:peer-joined", onPeerJoined);
        socket.on("voice:offer", onOffer);
        socket.on("voice:answer", onAnswer);
        socket.on("voice:ice", onIce);
        socket.on("voice:peer-left", onPeerLeft);
        socket.on("connect", onSocketReconnect);

        socketRef.current.__voiceHandlers = {
          onPeerJoined,
          onOffer,
          onAnswer,
          onIce,
          onPeerLeft,
          onSocketReconnect,
        };
      } catch (err) {
        logErr("setup failed:", err);
        if (err.name === "NotAllowedError") {
          setError(
            "Microphone permission denied. Enable it in your device settings.",
          );
        } else if (err.name === "NotFoundError") {
          setError("No microphone found on this device.");
        } else {
          setError(err.message || "Failed to start call");
        }
        setStatus("failed");
      }
    }

    start();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      if (socket) {
        try {
          socket.emit("voice:leave", { conversationId });
          const h = socket.__voiceHandlers;
          if (h) {
            socket.off("voice:peer-joined", h.onPeerJoined);
            socket.off("voice:offer", h.onOffer);
            socket.off("voice:answer", h.onAnswer);
            socket.off("voice:ice", h.onIce);
            socket.off("voice:peer-left", h.onPeerLeft);
            socket.off("connect", h.onSocketReconnect);
          }
          delete socket.__voiceHandlers;
        } catch {}
      }
      cleanup();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [conversationId]);

  const toggleMute = useCallback(() => {
    const stream = localStreamRef.current;
    if (!stream) return;
    const tracks = stream.getAudioTracks();
    const next = !isMuted;
    tracks.forEach((t) => (t.enabled = !next));
    setIsMuted(next);
    log("toggleMute →", next ? "muted" : "unmuted");
  }, [isMuted]);

  return {
    localStream,
    remoteStream,
    status,
    isMuted,
    error,
    toggleMute,
  };
}

// src/i18n/index.js
import i18n from "i18next";
import { initReactI18next } from "react-i18next";
import * as Localization from "expo-localization";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";

import en from "./locales/en.json";
import es from "./locales/es.json";
import fr from "./locales/fr.json";
import ar from "./locales/ar.json";
import pt from "./locales/pt.json";
import zh from "./locales/zh.json";
import ha from "./locales/ha.json";
import yo from "./locales/yo.json";
import ig from "./locales/ig.json";
import de from "./locales/de.json";
import it from "./locales/it.json";
import hi from "./locales/hi.json";

const resources = {
  en: { translation: en },
  es: { translation: es },
  fr: { translation: fr },
  ar: { translation: ar },
  pt: { translation: pt },
  zh: { translation: zh },
  ha: { translation: ha },
  yo: { translation: yo },
  ig: { translation: ig },
  de: { translation: de },
  it: { translation: it },
  hi: { translation: hi },
};

const LANG_KEY = "@skilledproz:lang";

export async function initI18n() {
  let savedLang = null;
  try {
    savedLang = await AsyncStorage.getItem(LANG_KEY);
  } catch {}

  const deviceLang = Localization.getLocales()[0]?.languageCode || "en";
  // Fall back to "en" if device language has no locale file
  const supported = Object.keys(resources);
  const lng =
    savedLang && supported.includes(savedLang)
      ? savedLang
      : supported.includes(deviceLang)
        ? deviceLang
        : "en";

  await i18n.use(initReactI18next).init({
    resources,
    lng,
    fallbackLng: "en",
    interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
    react: { useSuspense: false },
    compatibilityJSON: "v3",
  });

  return i18n;
}

export async function changeLanguage(code) {
  await i18n.changeLanguage(code);
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(LANG_KEY, code);
  } catch {}
}

export default i18n;

=== FILE: src/i18n/useAppLocale.js ===
// src/i18n/useAppLocale.js
// Hook to read and change the app locale, persisted in AsyncStorage

import { useCallback }      from 'react';
import { useTranslation }   from 'react-i18next';
import { I18nManager }      from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage         from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import * as Updates         from 'expo-updates';
import { LOCALES }          from './index';

const STORAGE_KEY = '@skilledproz_locale';

export function useAppLocale() {
  const { i18n } = useTranslation();

  const currentLocale = LOCALES.find((l) => l.code === i18n.language) ?? LOCALES[0];
  const isRTL = currentLocale.rtl;

  const changeLocale = useCallback(async (code) => {
    const locale = LOCALES.find((l) => l.code === code);
    if (!locale) return;

    await i18n.changeLanguage(code);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, code);

    // RTL languages (Arabic) need a full restart to flip layout
    if (locale.rtl !== I18nManager.isRTL) {
      I18nManager.allowRTL(locale.rtl);
      I18nManager.forceRTL(locale.rtl);
      await Updates.reloadAsync().catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [i18n]);

  const loadSavedLocale = useCallback(async () => {
    const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved && saved !== i18n.language) {
      await i18n.changeLanguage(saved);
    }
  }, [i18n]);

  return { currentLocale, isRTL, changeLocale, loadSavedLocale, locales: LOCALES };
}

=== END: src/i18n/useAppLocale.js ===

// src/lib/analytics/tracker.js
const enabled = __DEV__;
function log(kind, event, props) {
  if (!enabled) return;
  // console.log(`[tracker.${kind}]`, event, props);
}
const tracker = {
  track: (event, props) => log("track", event, props),
  action: (event, props) => log("action", event, props),
  page: (event, props) => log("page", event, props),
  identify: (id, props) => log("identify", id, props),
  screen: (event, props) => log("screen", event, props),
  reset: () => log("reset", "user"),
};
export default tracker;

=== FILE: src/lib/tracker.js ===
// src/lib/analytics/tracker.js
//
// No-op analytics stub. Mirrors the web tracker API so ported screens
// that call `tracker.track(...)` / `tracker.action(...)` compile without
// further changes.
//
// To wire real analytics later (Amplitude / PostHog / Firebase), replace
// the console.logs below with the real SDK call. Every call site stays
// identical — no edits across the app.

const enabled = __DEV__;

function log(kind, event, props) {
  if (!enabled) return;
  // Uncomment the next line for local event tracing during development.
  // console.log(`[tracker.${kind}]`, event, props);
}

const tracker = {
  track: (event, props) => log("track", event, props),
  action: (event, props) => log("action", event, props),
  page: (event, props) => log("page", event, props),
  identify: (id, props) => log("identify", id, props),
  screen: (event, props) => log("screen", event, props),
  reset: () => log("reset", "user"),
};

export default tracker;

=== END: src/lib/tracker.js ===

// src/lib/voiceSocket.js
//
// Socket.IO client for the voice-call signaling namespace.
// Token comes from the same tokenStore that client.js uses — reading
// useAuthStore.accessToken was failing because the store doesn't expose
// that field. tokenStore.getAccess() is async, so getVoiceSocket() is
// now async too.

import { io } from "socket.io-client";
import { tokenStore } from "../api/client";

const RAW_API_URL =
  process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL || "https://api.skilledproz.com/api";

// Strip trailing "/api" — the socket namespace lives at the server root.
const SOCKET_BASE = RAW_API_URL.replace(/\/api\/?$/, "");

let socket = null;
let connectingPromise = null;

const DEBUG_VOICE_CALL = true;
function log(...args) {
  if (!DEBUG_VOICE_CALL) return;
  const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 23);
  console.log(`[VS ${ts}]`, ...args);
}

export async function getVoiceSocket() {
  if (socket) {
    log("getVoiceSocket() — returning existing", {
      connected: socket.connected,
      id: socket.id,
    });
    return socket;
  }

  // Serialize concurrent calls — if two useEffects fire getVoiceSocket()
  // at once, only the first should create the socket.
  if (connectingPromise) {
    log("getVoiceSocket() — awaiting in-flight creation");
    return connectingPromise;
  }

  connectingPromise = (async () => {
    const token = await tokenStore.getAccess();
    log("getVoiceSocket() — creating NEW socket", { hasToken: !!token });

    if (!token) {
      log("no auth token — cannot connect");
      connectingPromise = null;
      return null;
    }

    const url = `${SOCKET_BASE}/voice-calls`;
    log("connecting →", url);

    socket = io(url, {
      auth: { token },
      transports: ["websocket", "polling"],
      upgrade: true,
      reconnection: true,
      reconnectionDelay: 800,
      reconnectionDelayMax: 4000,
      reconnectionAttempts: 50,
      randomizationFactor: 0.3,
      timeout: 20000,
    });

    socket.on("connect", () => {
      log("✅ connected", { id: socket.id });
    });

    socket.on("reconnect", (attempt) => {
      log("🔄 reconnected after", attempt, "attempts", { id: socket.id });
    });

    socket.on("reconnect_attempt", (attempt) => {
      log("reconnect attempt #" + attempt);
    });

    socket.on("connect_error", (err) => {
      log("❌ connect_error:", err.message);
    });

    socket.on("disconnect", (reason) => {
      log("⚠️ disconnected:", reason);
      if (reason === "io server disconnect") {
        log("server kicked us — reconnecting manually");
        socket.connect();
      }
    });

    connectingPromise = null;
    return socket;
  })();

  return connectingPromise;
}

export function disconnectVoiceSocket() {
  log("disconnectVoiceSocket() called");
  if (!socket) return;
  socket.removeAllListeners();
  socket.disconnect();
  socket = null;
  connectingPromise = null;
}

=== FILE: src/navigation/RootNavigator.js ===
// src/navigation/RootNavigator.js
//
// Top-level navigator. Four-way branch: auth / verify / hirer / worker.
//
// The incoming-call banners are mounted INSIDE HirerNavigator and
// WorkerNavigator (see CallOverlay there) so they render above the drawer
// without stealing focus. Mounting them as a separate RootStack screen
// broke every drawer action because RootStack couldn't handle openDrawer.

import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import { View, ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import {
  NavigationContainer,
  DarkTheme,
  DefaultTheme,
} from "@react-navigation/native";

import AuthNavigator from "./AuthNavigator";
import HirerNavigator from "./HirerNavigator";
import WorkerNavigator from "./WorkerNavigator";
import VerifyEmailScreen from "../screens/auth/VerifyEmailScreen";
import { navigationRef } from "./navigationRef";
import { useAuthStore } from "../store/authStore";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { createNativeStackNavigator } from "@react-navigation/native-stack";

const VerifyStack = createNativeStackNavigator();

function VerifyGate() {
  return (
    <VerifyStack.Navigator screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }}>
      <VerifyStack.Screen name="VerifyEmail" component={VerifyEmailScreen} />
    </VerifyStack.Navigator>
  );
}

export default function RootNavigator() {
  const { user, isHydrated, hydrate } = useAuthStore();
  const { theme, effectiveMode } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    hydrate();
  }, []);

  if (!isHydrated) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.loading, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.bg }]}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={theme.colors.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  const navTheme = {
    ...(effectiveMode === "light" ? DefaultTheme : DarkTheme),
    colors: {
      ...(effectiveMode === "light" ? DefaultTheme.colors : DarkTheme.colors),
      background: theme.colors.bg,
      card: theme.colors.bgPanel,
      text: theme.colors.text,
      border: theme.colors.border,
      primary: theme.colors.orange,
    },
  };

  let stack;
  if (!user) stack = <AuthNavigator />;
  else if (!user.isEmailVerified) stack = <VerifyGate />;
  else if (user.role === "WORKER") stack = <WorkerNavigator />;
  else stack = <HirerNavigator />;

  return (
    <NavigationContainer ref={navigationRef} theme={navTheme}>
      {stack}
    </NavigationContainer>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  loading: { flex: 1, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" },
});

=== END: src/navigation/RootNavigator.js ===

      subtitle: null,
    };

      <Stack.Navigator
        screenOptions={({ route }) => {

            return { headerShown: false };
          }

          }
          const m = stackMeta(route.name);
          return {
            headerShown: true,
            header: () => (
              <TopBar title={m.title} subtitle={m.subtitle} showBack />
            ),
          };
        }}
      >
        <Stack.Screen name="WorkerHome" component={WorkerDrawer} />
        <Stack.Screen name="BookingDetail" component={BookingDetailScreen} />
        <Stack.Screen
          name="HirerPublicProfile"
