=== FILE: src/navigation/navigationRef.js ===
// src/navigation/navigationRef.js
//
// Global navigation ref + drawer helpers.
//
// Drawer actions (openDrawer / closeDrawer / toggleDrawer) dispatched on the
// root ref propagate UP the navigator tree until they find a navigator that
// handles them. This makes them work regardless of how deeply the drawer is
// nested — which is now 3 levels deep (RootStack → RootBranch → Drawer).

import {
  createNavigationContainerRef,
  DrawerActions,
} from "@react-navigation/native";

export const navigationRef = createNavigationContainerRef();

export function navigate(name, params) {
  if (navigationRef.isReady()) {
    navigationRef.navigate(name, params);
  }
}

export function toggleDrawer() {
  if (!navigationRef.isReady()) return;
  try {
    navigationRef.dispatch(DrawerActions.toggleDrawer());
  } catch {}
}

export function openDrawer() {
  if (!navigationRef.isReady()) return;
  try {
    navigationRef.dispatch(DrawerActions.openDrawer());
  } catch {}
}

export function closeDrawer() {
  if (!navigationRef.isReady()) return;
  try {
    navigationRef.dispatch(DrawerActions.closeDrawer());
  } catch {}
}

// src/components/auth/AuthShell.js
//
// Shared auth screen primitives — mirrors the website's AuthLayout
// + form.module.css. Every auth screen composes these so all look
// identical and match the website 1:1.
//
// Safe-area aware: the back button always clears the notch/status bar
// by a comfortable margin, on every device, without per-screen tweaks.

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  TextInput,
  ScrollView,
  Animated,
  ActivityIndicator,
  StyleSheet,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

// ─── Icon safety helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Simple pass-through. Anything non-null is trusted; consumers pass
// valid Ionicons names. If you ever ship an invalid name, only that
// icon is affected — the screen survives.
const safeIcon = (name) => name || null;

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AuthShell — outer wrapper for every auth screen.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function AuthShell({ children, showBack = true, backTo = "Login" }) {
  const ctx = useTheme() || {};
  const th = ctx.theme;
  const c = (th && th.colors) || {
    bg: "#080810",
    text: "#fff",
    textDim: "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)",
    textMuted: "rgba(255,255,255,0.28)",
    orange: "#f97316",
  };

  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const navigation = useNavigation();

  const fade = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const slide = useRef(new Animated.Value(16)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    const anim = Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(fade, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 450,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(slide, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 450,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]);
    anim.start();
    return () => anim.stop();
  }, [fade, slide]);

  return (
    <KeyboardAvoidingView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : undefined}
    >
      <ScrollView
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
        contentContainerStyle={{
          flexGrow: 1,
          paddingHorizontal: 16,
          paddingTop: Math.max(insets.top, 24) + 32,
          paddingBottom: 40,
        }}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {showBack && (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.canGoBack()
                ? navigation.goBack()
                : navigation.navigate(backTo)
            }
            style={styles.backRow}
            hitSlop={8}
          >
            <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={15} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="medium"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
            >
              Back
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        <Animated.View
          style={{
            width: "100%",
            maxWidth: 400,
            alignSelf: "center",
            opacity: fade,
            transform: [{ translateY: slide }],
          }}
        >
          {children}
        </Animated.View>
      </ScrollView>
    </KeyboardAvoidingView>
  );
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AuthField — label + input + icon + error
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function AuthField({
  label,
  value,
  onChangeText,
  placeholder,
  iconLeft,
  iconRight,
  secureTextEntry,
  keyboardType,
  autoCapitalize,
  autoComplete,
  textContentType,
  error,
  editable = true,
  inputRef,
}) {
  const ctx = useTheme() || {};
  const c = (ctx.theme && ctx.theme.colors) || {
    red: "#ef4444",
    border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",

    textMuted: "rgba(255,255,255,0.28)",
    text: "#fff",
    textDim: "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)",
  };

  const borderColor = error ? c.red : c.border;
  const leftIcon = safeIcon(iconLeft);
  const rightIconName = safeIcon(iconRight?.name);

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 7 }}>
      {label ? (
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.textDim, letterSpacing: 0.2, fontSize: 12 }}
        >
          {label}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
      <View
        style={[styles.inputWrap, { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor }]}
      >
        {leftIcon && (
          <View style={styles.iconLeft}>
            <Ionicons name={leftIcon} size={15} color={c.textMuted} />
          </View>
        )}
        <TextInput
          ref={inputRef}
          value={value}
          onChangeText={onChangeText}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          secureTextEntry={secureTextEntry}
          keyboardType={keyboardType}
          autoCapitalize={autoCapitalize ?? "none"}
          autoCorrect={false}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          textContentType={textContentType}
          editable={editable}
          style={[
            styles.input,
            {
              color: c.text,
              paddingLeft: leftIcon ? 42 : 15,
              paddingRight: rightIconName ? 42 : 15,
              opacity: editable ? 1 : 0.4,
            },
          ]}
        />
        {rightIconName && (
          <Pressable
            style={styles.iconRight}
            onPress={iconRight?.onPress}
            hitSlop={8}
          >
            <Ionicons name={rightIconName} size={16} color={c.textMuted} />

        )}

        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
          <Ionicons name="alert-circle" size={12} color="#fca5a5" />
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#fca5a5", fontSize: 11.5 }}>
            {error}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );

=== FILE: src/screens/auth/ForgotPasswordScreen.js ===
// src/screens/auth/ForgotPasswordScreen.js
//
// Mirrors the website's ForgotPassword.jsx.
// Uses AuthShell + AuthField + AuthButton + AuthStateBox + AuthFooter.

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { View } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import {
  AuthShell,
  AuthHeader,
  AuthField,
  AuthButton,
  AuthAlert,
  AuthStateBox,
  AuthFooter,
} from "../../components/auth/AuthShell";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { isEmail } from "../../utils/validators";

export default function ForgotPasswordScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const { forgotPassword } = useAuthStore();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError("");
    if (!isEmail(email)) {
      setError(t("auth.validEmailRequired"));
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await forgotPassword(email.trim().toLowerCase());
      setSent(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // ── Success state ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (sent) {
    return (
      <AuthShell showBack backTo="Login">
        <AuthStateBox
          icon="checkmark-circle"
          title={t("auth.resetLinkSent")}
          subtitle={
            <>
              If{" "}
              <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.textDim }}>
                {email}
              </AppText>{" "}
              is registered, check your inbox.
            </>
          }
        />
        <AuthButton
          title={t("auth.backToSignIn", {
            defaultValue: "Back to sign in",
          })}
          variant="outline"
          iconLeft="arrow-back"
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Login")}
        />
      </AuthShell>
    );
  }

  // ── Form state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <AuthShell showBack backTo="Login">
      <AuthHeader
        eyebrow={t("auth.accountRecovery", {
          defaultValue: "Account recovery",
        })}
        title={t("auth.forgotPasswordTitle")}
        subtitle={t("auth.forgotPasswordBody")}
      />

      {error ? <AuthAlert type="error" message={error} /> : null}

      <View style={{ gap: 18 }}>
        <AuthField
          label={t("auth.emailAddress")}
          iconLeft="mail-outline"
          placeholder={t("auth.emailPlaceholder")}
          value={email}
          onChangeText={(v) => {
            setEmail(v);
            setError("");
          }}
          keyboardType="email-address"
          autoComplete="email"
          textContentType="emailAddress"
          error={error || undefined}
        />

        <AuthButton
          title={
            loading
              ? t("auth.sending", { defaultValue: "Sending…" })
              : t("auth.sendResetLink")
          }
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          loading={loading}
          disabled={!email}
        />
      </View>

      <AuthFooter
        prompt={t("auth.rememberPassword")}
        actionLabel={t("auth.signIn")}
        onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Login")}
      />
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

=== END: src/screens/auth/ForgotPasswordScreen.js ===

=== FILE: src/screens/auth/LoginScreen.js ===
// src/screens/auth/LoginScreen.js
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { View, Pressable, ActivityIndicator, Linking } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import Constants from "expo-constants";
import {
  GoogleSignin,
  statusCodes,
} from "@react-native-google-signin/google-signin";

import {
  AuthShell,
  AuthHeader,
  AuthField,
  AuthButton,
  AuthAlert,
  AuthFooter,
} from "../../components/auth/AuthShell";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { isEmail, isNonEmpty } from "../../utils/validators";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";

const extra = Constants.expoConfig?.extra || {};
const GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID = extra.googleWebClientId || "";

if (GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID) {
  GoogleSignin.configure({
    webClientId: GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
    offlineAccess: false,
    scopes: ["openid", "email", "profile"],
  });
}

export default function LoginScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const { login, googleSignIn } = useAuthStore();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [googleLoading, setGoogleLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [block, setBlock] = useState(null);
  const [refCode, setRefCode] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const stored = await AsyncStorage.getItem(
          "@skilledproz:pendingRefCode",
        );
        if (stored) setRefCode(stored);
      } catch {}
    })();
  }, []);

  const handleGoogleToken = async (idToken) => {
    try {
      const result = await googleSignIn({
        idToken,
        ref: refCode || undefined,
      });

      if (result?.needsRole) {
        navigation.navigate("Register", {
          googleProfile: result.googleProfile,
          idToken,
          refCode,
          from: "google",
        });
        return;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const res = err?.response?.data;
      const code = res?.code;

      if (
        code === "ACCOUNT_BANNED" ||
        code === "ACCOUNT_DELETED" ||
        code === "ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND"
      ) {
        setBlock(
          code === "ACCOUNT_BANNED"
            ? "banned"
            : code === "ACCOUNT_DELETED"
              ? "deleted"
              : "not_found",
        );
      } else {
        setError(
          res?.message ||
            err?.message ||
            t("auth.googleFailed", {
              defaultValue: "Google sign-in failed. Please try again.",
            }),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setGoogleLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGooglePress = async () => {
    setError("");
    setBlock(null);

    if (!GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID) {
      setError(
        t("auth.googleNotConfigured", {
          defaultValue:
            "Google Sign-In is not configured yet. Use email + password to continue.",
        }),
      );
      return;
    }

    setGoogleLoading(true);
    try {
      await GoogleSignin.hasPlayServices();
      const userInfo = await GoogleSignin.signIn();
      const idToken = userInfo.idToken || userInfo.data?.idToken;

      if (!idToken) {
        setError(
          t("auth.googleNoToken", {
            defaultValue: "Google sign-in did not return a token.",
          }),
        );
        setGoogleLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      await handleGoogleToken(idToken);
    } catch (err) {
      setGoogleLoading(false);

      if (err.code === statusCodes.SIGN_IN_CANCELLED) {
        // User cancelled — do nothing
      } else if (err.code === statusCodes.IN_PROGRESS) {
        // Already signing in
      } else if (err.code === statusCodes.PLAY_SERVICES_NOT_AVAILABLE) {
        setError("Google Play Services not available on this device.");
      } else {
        setError(
          err?.message ||
            t("auth.googleFailed", { defaultValue: "Google sign-in failed." }),
        );
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError("");
    setBlock(null);

    if (!isNonEmpty(email)) return setError(t("auth.emailRequired"));
    if (!isEmail(email)) return setError(t("auth.validEmailRequired"));
    if (!isNonEmpty(password)) return setError(t("auth.fillAllFields"));

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim().toLowerCase(), password);
    } catch (err) {
      const res = err?.response?.data;
      const code = res?.code;

      if (
        code === "ACCOUNT_BANNED" ||
        code === "ACCOUNT_DELETED" ||
        code === "ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND"
      ) {
        setBlock(
          code === "ACCOUNT_BANNED"
            ? "banned"
            : code === "ACCOUNT_DELETED"
              ? "deleted"
              : "not_found",
        );
        return;
      }

      if (
        code === "GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_NO_PASSWORD" ||
        code === "GOOGLE_ONLY_ACCOUNT"
      ) {
        setError(
          res?.message ||
            t("auth.googleOnlyAccount", {
              defaultValue:
                "This account was created with Google. Please sign in with Google.",
            }),
        );
        return;
      }

      setError(res?.message || err?.message || t("auth.invalidCredentials"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const blockContent =
    block === "banned"
      ? {
          title: t("auth.accountSuspended", {
            defaultValue: "Account suspended",
          }),
          body: t("auth.accountSuspendedBody", {
            defaultValue:
              "Your account has been suspended by an administrator. Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.",
          }),
        }
      : block === "deleted"
        ? {
            title: t("auth.accountDeactivated", {
              defaultValue: "Account deactivated",
            }),
            body: t("auth.accountDeactivatedBody", {
              defaultValue:
                "This account has been deactivated. Contact support to restore access.",
            }),
          }
        : block === "not_found"
          ? {
              title: t("auth.accountNotFound", {
                defaultValue: "Account not found",
              }),
              body: t("auth.accountNotFoundBody", {
                defaultValue:
                  "This account no longer exists. Contact support if this is unexpected.",
              }),
            }
          : null;

  return (
    <AuthShell showBack={false}>
      <AuthHeader
        eyebrow={t("auth.welcomeBack", { defaultValue: "Welcome back" })}
        title={t("auth.signInTitle")}
        subtitle={
          <>
            {t("auth.noAccountYet")}{" "}
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Register")}
            >
              {t("auth.createOneFree")} →
            </AppText>
          </>
        }
      />

      {block && blockContent ? (
        <View style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <AuthAlert
            type="error"
            message={`${blockContent.title}. ${blockContent.body}`}
          />
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => Linking.openURL("mailto:support@skilledproz.com")}
            style={{
              marginTop: 8,
              paddingVertical: 10,
              borderRadius: 8,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              alignItems: "center",
            }}
          >
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" tone="dim">
              {t("auth.contactSupport", { defaultValue: "Contact support" })}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      <GoogleSignInButton loading={googleLoading} onPress={handleGooglePress} />

      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 12,
          marginVertical: 18,
        }}
      >
        <View style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, backgroundColor: c.border }} />
        <AppText variant="small" tone="muted">
          {t("auth.or", { defaultValue: "or" })}
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, backgroundColor: c.border }} />
      </View>

      {error && !block ? <AuthAlert type="error" message={error} /> : null}

      <View style={{ gap: 14 }}>
        <AuthField
          label={t("auth.emailAddress")}
          iconLeft="mail-outline"
          placeholder={t("auth.emailPlaceholder")}
          value={email}
          onChangeText={(v) => {
            setEmail(v);
            setError("");
          }}
          keyboardType="email-address"
          autoComplete="email"
          textContentType="emailAddress"
          editable={!loading}
        />

        <AuthField
          label={t("auth.password")}
          iconLeft="lock-closed-outline"
          placeholder={t("auth.passwordMinChars")}
          value={password}
          onChangeText={(v) => {
            setPassword(v);
            setError("");
          }}
          secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
          autoComplete="password"
          textContentType="password"
          editable={!loading}
          iconRight={{
            name: showPassword ? "eye-off-outline" : "eye-outline",
            onPress: () => setShowPassword((v) => !v),
          }}
        />

        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => navigation.navigate("ForgotPassword")}
            hitSlop={6}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {t("auth.forgot")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        <AuthButton
          title={loading ? t("auth.signingIn") : t("auth.signIn")}
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          loading={loading}
          disabled={!email || !password}
        />
      </View>

      <AuthFooter
        prompt={t("auth.noAccountYet")}
        actionLabel={t("auth.createOneFree")}
        onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Register")}
      />
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

function GoogleSignInButton({ loading, onPress }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={loading}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        {
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          height: 50,
          borderRadius: 10,
          backgroundColor: pressed ? c.bgCard : c.bgInput,
          borderColor: c.border,
          borderWidth: 1.5,
          opacity: loading ? 0.6 : 1,
          gap: 10,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.text} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <GoogleGlyph />
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {t("auth.continueWithGoogle", {
              defaultValue: "Continue with Google",
            })}
          </AppText>
        </>
      )}
    </Pressable>
  );
}

function GoogleGlyph() {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: 18,
        height: 18,
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
      }}
    >
      <Ionicons name="logo-google" size={18} color="#4285F4" />
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/auth/RegisterHirerScreen.js
//
// Mirrors the website's RegisterHirer.jsx.

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import Constants from "expo-constants";
import {
  GoogleSignin,
  statusCodes,
} from "@react-native-google-signin/google-signin";

import {
  AuthShell,
  AuthField,
  AuthButton,
  AuthAlert,
} from "../../components/auth/AuthShell";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import {
  isEmail,
  isNonEmpty,
  isStrongEnoughPassword,
} from "../../utils/validators";

const extra = Constants.expoConfig?.extra || {};
const GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID = extra.googleWebClientId || "";

if (GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID) {
  GoogleSignin.configure({
    webClientId: GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
    offlineAccess: false,
    scopes: ["openid", "email", "profile"],
  });
}

export default function RegisterHirerScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const { register, googleSignIn, isLoading } = useAuthStore();

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    firstName: "",
    lastName: "",
    email: "",
    phone: "",
    country: "",
    city: "",
    password: "",
    confirm: "",
    referralCode: "",
  });

  const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false);
  const [agree, setAgree] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [googleLoading, setGoogleLoading] = useState(false);

  const update = (key) => (value) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value }));
    if (errors[key]) setErrors((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: "" }));
  };

  // ── Google Sign-Up (native) ────────────────────────────────────
  const handleGooglePress = async () => {
    setErrors({});
    if (!GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID) {
      setErrors({ api: "Google Sign-In is not configured yet." });
      return;
    }

    setGoogleLoading(true);
    try {
      await GoogleSignin.hasPlayServices();
      const userInfo = await GoogleSignin.signIn();
      const idToken = userInfo.idToken || userInfo.data?.idToken;

      if (!idToken) {
        setErrors({ api: "Google sign-up did not return a token." });
        setGoogleLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      await handleGoogleToken(idToken);
    } catch (err) {
      setGoogleLoading(false);

      if (err.code === statusCodes.SIGN_IN_CANCELLED) {
        // User cancelled — do nothing
      } else if (err.code === statusCodes.IN_PROGRESS) {
        // Already signing in
      } else if (err.code === statusCodes.PLAY_SERVICES_NOT_AVAILABLE) {
        setErrors({
          api: "Google Play Services not available on this device.",
        });
      } else {
        setErrors({ api: err?.message || "Google sign-up failed." });
      }
    }
  };

  const handleGoogleToken = async (idToken) => {
    try {
      const result = await googleSignIn({
        idToken,
        role: "HIRER", // Force Hirer role since they are on this screen
        ref: form.referralCode.trim() || undefined,
      });

      if (result?.needsRole) {
        // Edge case: backend still asks for role despite us sending it
        navigation.navigate("Register", {
          googleProfile: result.googleProfile,
          idToken,
          refCode: form.referralCode,
          from: "google",
        });
      }
      // If successful, RootNavigator handles the redirect to the dashboard
    } catch (err) {
      setErrors({
        api: err?.response?.data?.message || "Google signup failed.",
      });
    } finally {
      setGoogleLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // ── Validation & Submit ────────────────────────────────────────
  const validate = () => {
    const e = {};
    if (!isNonEmpty(form.firstName)) e.firstName = "Required";
    if (!isNonEmpty(form.lastName)) e.lastName = "Required";
    if (!isNonEmpty(form.email)) e.email = "Required";
    else if (!isEmail(form.email)) e.email = t("auth.validEmailRequired");
    if (!isStrongEnoughPassword(form.password)) e.password = "Min 8 characters";
    if (form.password !== form.confirm) e.confirm = "Doesn't match";

    if (!agree) e.agree = "You must accept the terms";

    setErrors(e);
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!validate()) return;

    try {
      await register({
        firstName: form.firstName.trim(),
        lastName: form.lastName.trim(),
        email: form.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
        phone: form.phone.trim() || undefined,
        country: form.country.trim() || undefined,
        city: form.city.trim() || undefined,
        password: form.password,
        role: "HIRER",
        ...(form.referralCode?.trim()
          ? { referralCode: form.referralCode.trim().toUpperCase() }
          : {}),
      });
      // No manual navigation needed; RootNavigator handles the redirect.
    } catch (err) {
      setErrors({
        api: err?.response?.data?.message || "Registration failed.",
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <AuthShell showBack backTo="Register">
      <View style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="bold"
          style={{ color: c.orange, letterSpacing: 1.8 }}
        >
          {t("auth.hirerAccount", { defaultValue: "HIRER ACCOUNT" })}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          variant="display"
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={{ marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 4, lineHeight: 34 }}
        >
          {t("auth.findNextProz", {
            defaultValue: "Find your next\nskilled proz",
          })}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* ── Google Sign-Up ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={handleGooglePress}
        disabled={googleLoading}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.googleBtn,
          {
            backgroundColor: pressed ? c.bgCard : c.bgInput,
            borderColor: c.border,
            opacity: googleLoading ? 0.6 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {googleLoading ? (
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.text} />
        ) : (
          <>
            <Ionicons name="logo-google" size={18} color="#4285F4" />
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text, marginLeft: 10 }}
            >
              {t("auth.signUpWithGoogle", {
                defaultValue: "Sign up with Google",
              })}
            </AppText>
          </>
        )}
      </Pressable>

      {/* ── Divider ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <View style={styles.dividerRow}>
        <View style={[styles.dividerLine, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
        <AppText variant="small" tone="muted" style={{ marginHorizontal: 12 }}>
          {t("auth.orContinueWithEmail", {
            defaultValue: "or continue with email",
          })}
        </AppText>
        <View style={[styles.dividerLine, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
      </View>

      {errors.api ? <AuthAlert type="error" message={errors.api} /> : null}

      <View style={styles.form}>
        {/* First Name & Last Name */}
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.firstName", { defaultValue: "First name" })}
              iconLeft="person-outline"
              placeholder={t("auth.firstNamePlaceholder", {
                defaultValue: "John",
              })}
              value={form.firstName}
              onChangeText={update("firstName")}
              autoCapitalize="words"
              textContentType="givenName"
              error={errors.firstName}
            />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.lastName", { defaultValue: "Last name" })}
              placeholder={t("auth.lastNamePlaceholder", {
                defaultValue: "Doe",
              })}
              value={form.lastName}
              onChangeText={update("lastName")}
              autoCapitalize="words"
              textContentType="familyName"
              error={errors.lastName}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Email */}
        <AuthField
          label={t("auth.emailAddress", { defaultValue: "Email address" })}
          iconLeft="mail-outline"
          placeholder={t("auth.emailPlaceholder", {
            defaultValue: "you@example.com",
          })}
          value={form.email}
          onChangeText={update("email")}
          keyboardType="email-address"
          autoComplete="email"
          textContentType="emailAddress"
          error={errors.email}
        />

        {/* Phone */}
        <AuthField
          label={`${t("auth.phone", { defaultValue: "Phone" })} (${t("common.optional", { defaultValue: "optional" })})`}
          iconLeft="call-outline"
          placeholder={t("auth.phonePlaceholder", {
            defaultValue: "+234 801 234 5678",
          })}
          value={form.phone}
          onChangeText={update("phone")}
          keyboardType="phone-pad"
          autoComplete="tel"
          textContentType="telephoneNumber"
        />

        {/* Country & City */}
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.country", { defaultValue: "Country" })}
              iconLeft="globe-outline"
              placeholder={t("auth.countryPlaceholder", {
                defaultValue: "Nigeria",
              })}
              value={form.country}
              onChangeText={update("country")}
              autoCapitalize="words"
            />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.city", { defaultValue: "City" })}
              iconLeft="location-outline"
              placeholder={t("auth.cityPlaceholder", { defaultValue: "Lagos" })}
              value={form.city}
              onChangeText={update("city")}
              autoCapitalize="words"
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Referral Code */}
        <AuthField
          label={`${t("auth.referralCode", { defaultValue: "Referral code" })} (${t("common.optional", { defaultValue: "optional" })})`}
          placeholder={t("auth.referralPlaceholder", {
            defaultValue: "e.g. SPTEST01",
          })}
          value={form.referralCode}
          onChangeText={update("referralCode")}
          autoCapitalize="characters"
          maxLength={12}
        />

        {/* Password & Confirm */}
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.password", { defaultValue: "Password" })}
              iconLeft="lock-closed-outline"
              placeholder={t("auth.passwordMinChars", {
                defaultValue: "Min 8 chars",
              })}
              value={form.password}
              onChangeText={update("password")}
              secureTextEntry={!showPw}
              textContentType="newPassword"
              error={errors.password}
              iconRight={{
                name: showPw ? "eye-off-outline" : "eye-outline",
                onPress: () => setShowPw((v) => !v),
              }}
            />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.confirm", { defaultValue: "Confirm" })}
              placeholder={t("auth.confirmPlaceholder", {
                defaultValue: "Repeat password",
              })}
              value={form.confirm}
              onChangeText={update("confirm")}
              secureTextEntry={!showPw}
              error={errors.confirm}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Terms Checkbox */}
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setAgree((a) => !a)}
          style={styles.checkRow}
          hitSlop={6}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.checkbox,
              {
                borderColor: agree ? c.orange : c.border,
                backgroundColor: agree ? c.orange : "transparent",
              },
            ]}
          >
            {agree ? (
              <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={14} color="#0f0f1a" />
            ) : null}
          </View>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ flex: 1, lineHeight: 20 }}
          >
            {t("auth.agreeToTerms", { defaultValue: "I agree to the" })}{" "}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
              weight="semibold"
            >
              {t("auth.terms", { defaultValue: "Terms" })}
            </AppText>{" "}
            {t("auth.and", { defaultValue: "and" })}{" "}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
              weight="semibold"
            >
              {t("auth.privacyPolicy", { defaultValue: "Privacy Policy" })}
            </AppText>
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
        {errors.agree ? (
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#fca5a5", marginTop: -8 }}>
            {errors.agree}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}

        {/* Submit Button */}
        <AuthButton
          title={
            isLoading
              ? t("auth.creating", { defaultValue: "Creating account…" })
              : t("auth.createHirerAccount", {
                  defaultValue: "Create Hirer Account",
                })
          }
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          loading={isLoading}
          style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
        />
      </View>

      {/* Footer */}
      <View style={styles.footer}>
        <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ fontSize: 13.5 }}>
          {t("auth.alreadyHaveAccount", {
            defaultValue: "Already have an account?",
          })}{" "}
        </AppText>
        <Pressable onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Login")} hitSlop={6}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 13.5 }}
          >
            {t("auth.signIn", { defaultValue: "Sign in" })}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

});

// src/screens/auth/RegisterScreen.js
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";

import {
  AuthShell,
  AuthButton,
  AuthAlert,
} from "../../components/auth/AuthShell";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

export default function RegisterScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);

// src/screens/auth/VerifyEmailScreen.js
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet, AppState } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";

/**
 * Mounted by RootNavigator when user is signed in but isEmailVerified === false.
 *
 *  - "Resend email" calls /auth/resend-verification
 *  - "I've verified" calls /auth/me; once the server flips the flag,
 *    RootNavigator auto-swaps to HirerNavigator (no navigation.navigate needed).
 *  - Also polls every 8s while the screen is focused, and fires fetchMe
 *    whenever the app returns to foreground (typical post-email-tap flow).
 */
export default function VerifyEmailScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user, resendVerification, fetchMe, logout } = useAuthStore();

  const email = user?.email || "";
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const pollRef = useRef(null);

  // Poll every 8s while mounted
  useEffect(() => {
    pollRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      fetchMe().catch(() => {});
    }, 8000);
    return () => clearInterval(pollRef.current);
  }, [fetchMe]);

  // Re-check immediately when the app comes back to foreground
  useEffect(() => {
    const sub = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
      if (state === "active") fetchMe().catch(() => {});
    });
    return () => sub.remove();
  }, [fetchMe]);

  const handleResend = async () => {
    if (!email) {
      toast.error(t("auth.emailRequired"));
      return;
    }
    setSending(true);
    try {
      await resendVerification(email);
      toast.success(t("auth.verificationResent"));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCheck = async () => {
    setChecking(true);
    try {
      const u = await fetchMe();
      if (!u?.isEmailVerified) {
        toast.info(t("auth.notVerifiedYet"));
      }
      // If verified, RootNavigator unmounts this screen automatically.
    } finally {
      setChecking(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen>
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={{ height: 40 }} />

        <View
          style={[
            styles.iconBubble,
            { backgroundColor: theme.colors.orangeDim },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="mail-open-outline"
            size={36}
            color={theme.colors.orange}
          />
        </View>

        <AppText
          variant="displaySm"
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={{ marginTop: 24 }}
        >
          {t("auth.verifyEmailTitle")}
        </AppText>

        <AppText variant="subtitle" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          {t("auth.verifyEmailBody", { email: email || "your inbox" })}
        </AppText>

        <View style={styles.actions}>
          <AppButton
            title={checking ? t("auth.checking") : t("auth.iVerified")}
            iconLeft={checking ? undefined : "checkmark-circle-outline"}
            onPress={handleCheck}
            loading={checking}
          />

          <AppButton
            title={sending ? t("auth.resending") : t("auth.resend")}
            variant="secondary"
            iconLeft={sending ? undefined : "refresh"}
            onPress={handleResend}
            loading={sending}
          />

          <AppButton
            title={t("auth.signOut")}
            variant="ghost"
            onPress={async () => {
              await logout();
              toast.info(t("auth.logoutSuccess"));
            }}
          />
        </View>
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { gap: 8, alignItems: "flex-start" },
  iconBubble: {
    width: 72,
    height: 72,
    borderRadius: 20,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  actions: { width: "100%", gap: 12, marginTop: 32 },
});
