// ─── Step Indicator ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StepIndicator({ current, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={si.row}>
      {STEPS.map((step, i) => {
        const done = i < current;
        const active = i === current;
        return (
          <React.Fragment key={step.id}>
            <View style={si.dotWrap}>
              <View
                style={[
                  si.dot,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: done
                      ? c.orange
                      : active
                        ? c.orangeDim
                        : c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: done || active ? c.orange : c.border,
                    borderWidth: 2,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {done ? (
                  <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={16} color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <Ionicons
                    name={step.icon}
                    size={14}
                    color={active ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                  />
                )}
              </View>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  position: "absolute",
                  top: 40,
                  color: done || active ? c.text : c.textMuted,
                  fontSize: 9,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                }}
              >
                {step.label}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            {i < STEPS.length - 1 && (
              <View
                style={[
                  si.line,
                  { backgroundColor: i < current ? c.orange : c.border },
                ]}
              />
            )}
          </React.Fragment>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Currency Picker ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function CurrencyPicker({ value, onChange, c }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <View>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        style={[
          s.selector,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
          {value}
        </AppText>
        <Ionicons
          name={open ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down"}
          size={16}
          color={c.textMuted}
        />
      </Pressable>
      {open && (
        <View
          style={[
            s.selectorMenu,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <ScrollView style={{ maxHeight: 240 }} nestedScrollEnabled>
            {ALL_CURRENCIES.map((cur) => (
              <Pressable
                key={cur}
                onPress={() => {
                  onChange(cur);
                  setOpen(false);
                }}
                style={[
                  s.selectorItem,
                  {
                    backgroundColor:
                      cur === value ? c.orangeDim : "transparent",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  style={{
                    color: cur === value ? c.orange : c.text,
                    fontWeight: cur === value ? "700" : "500",
                  }}
                >
                  {cur}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function WorkerRegisterScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const { register, googleSignIn, isLoading } = useAuthStore();

  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [agreed, setAgreed] = useState(false);
  const [googleLoading, setGoogleLoading] = useState(false);

  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);

  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [catSearch, setCatSearch] = useState("");
  const [selectedCats, setSelectedCats] = useState([]);
  const [primaryCatId, setPrimaryCatId] = useState("");
  const [showCustomCat, setShowCustomCat] = useState(false);
  const [customCatName, setCustomCatName] = useState("");
  const [addingCat, setAddingCat] = useState(false);

  const [account, setAccount] = useState({
    firstName: "",
    lastName: "",
    email: "",
    phone: "",
    country: "",
    city: "",
    password: "",
    confirm: "",
    referralCode: "",
  });

  const [profile, setProfile] = useState({
    title: "",
    description: "",
    yearsExperience: "",
    serviceRadius: "25",
  });

  const [pricing, setPricing] = useState({
    currency: "USD",
    hourlyRate: "",
    dailyRate: "",
    weeklyRate: "",
    monthlyRate: "",
    customRate: "",
    customRateLabel: "",
    pricingNote: "",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    client
      .get("/categories", { params: { limit: 1000 } })
      .then((r) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const data = r.data?.data;
        const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data?.categories ?? []);
        setCategories(list);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.warn("Failed to load categories:", err?.message);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  // ── Google Sign-Up (native) ────────────────────────────────────
  const handleGooglePress = async () => {
    setError("");
    if (!GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID) {
      setError("Google Sign-In is not configured yet.");
      return;
    }

    setGoogleLoading(true);
    try {
      await GoogleSignin.hasPlayServices();
      const userInfo = await GoogleSignin.signIn();
      const idToken = userInfo.idToken || userInfo.data?.idToken;

      if (!idToken) {
        setError("Google sign-up did not return a token.");
        setGoogleLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      await handleGoogleToken(idToken);
    } catch (err) {
      setGoogleLoading(false);

      if (err.code === statusCodes.SIGN_IN_CANCELLED) {
        // cancelled
      } else if (err.code === statusCodes.IN_PROGRESS) {
        // already in progress
      } else if (err.code === statusCodes.PLAY_SERVICES_NOT_AVAILABLE) {
        setError("Google Play Services not available.");
      } else {
        setError(err?.message || "Google sign-up failed.");
      }
    }
  };

  const handleGoogleToken = async (idToken) => {
    try {
      const result = await googleSignIn({
        idToken,
        role: "WORKER",
        ref: account.referralCode.trim() || undefined,
      });

      if (result?.needsRole) {
        navigation.navigate("Register", {
          googleProfile: result.googleProfile,
          idToken,
          refCode: account.referralCode,
          from: "google",
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.message || "Google signup failed.");
    } finally {
      setGoogleLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleCat = (cat) => {
    setSelectedCats((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.find((x) => x.id === cat.id);
      if (exists) {
        const next = prev.filter((x) => x.id !== cat.id);
        if (primaryCatId === cat.id) setPrimaryCatId(next[0]?.id ?? "");
        return next;
      }
      if (prev.length >= 5) return prev;
      const next = [...prev, cat];
      if (!primaryCatId) setPrimaryCatId(cat.id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleAddCustomCategory = async () => {
    if (!customCatName.trim()) return;
    setAddingCat(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.post("/categories/suggest", {
        name: customCatName.trim(),
      });
      const cat = res.data?.data?.category;
      if (cat) {
        setCategories((prev) =>
          prev.find((x) => x.id === cat.id) ? prev : [...prev, cat],
        );
        toggleCat(cat);
      }
      setCustomCatName("");
      setShowCustomCat(false);
      setCatSearch("");
    } catch {
      setError("Failed to add custom category");
    } finally {
      setAddingCat(false);
    }
  };

  const validateStep = () => {
    if (step === 0) {
      if (!account.firstName || !account.lastName)
        return "First and last name required";
      if (!account.email) return "Email required";
      if (account.password.length < 8)
        return "Password must be at least 8 characters";
      if (account.password !== account.confirm) return "Passwords do not match";
    }
    if (step === 1) {
      if (!profile.title) return "Professional title required";
      if (!profile.description) return "Description required";
    }
    if (step === 2) {
      if (selectedCats.length === 0) return "Select at least one category";
    }
    if (step === 3) {
      const hasRate =
        pricing.hourlyRate ||
        pricing.dailyRate ||
        pricing.weeklyRate ||
        pricing.monthlyRate ||
        pricing.customRate;
      if (!hasRate) return "Set at least one rate";
      if (!agreed) return "Please agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy";
    }
    return null;
  };

  const next = () => {
    const err = validateStep();
    if (err) return setError(err);
    setError("");
    Keyboard.dismiss();
    setStep((s) => s + 1);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    const err = validateStep();
    if (err) return setError(err);

    Keyboard.dismiss();

    try {
      await register({
        ...account,
        role: "WORKER",
        workerProfile: {
          ...profile,
          yearsExperience: parseInt(profile.yearsExperience) || 0,
          serviceRadius: parseInt(profile.serviceRadius) || 25,
          currency: pricing.currency,
          hourlyRate: parseFloat(pricing.hourlyRate) || 0,
          dailyRate: pricing.dailyRate ? parseFloat(pricing.dailyRate) : null,
          weeklyRate: pricing.weeklyRate
            ? parseFloat(pricing.weeklyRate)
            : null,
          monthlyRate: pricing.monthlyRate
            ? parseFloat(pricing.monthlyRate)
            : null,
          customRate: pricing.customRate
            ? parseFloat(pricing.customRate)
            : null,
          customRateLabel: pricing.customRateLabel || null,
          pricingNote: pricing.pricingNote || null,
        },
        categories: selectedCats.map((cat) => ({
          categoryId: cat.id,
          isPrimary: cat.id === primaryCatId,
        })),
        referralCode: account.referralCode?.trim().toUpperCase() || undefined,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.response?.data?.message || "Registration failed");
    }
  };

  const a = (k, v) => setAccount((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: v }));
  const p = (k, v) => setProfile((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: v }));
  const pr = (k, v) => setPricing((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: v }));

  const filteredCats = categories.filter(
    (cat) =>
      !catSearch || cat.name.toLowerCase().includes(catSearch.toLowerCase()),
  );

  return (
    <AuthShell showBack backTo="Register">
      <View style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="bold"
          style={{ color: c.orange, letterSpacing: 1.8 }}
        >
          {t("workerReg.workerAccount", { defaultValue: "WORKER ACCOUNT" })}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          variant="display"
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={{ marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 4, lineHeight: 34 }}
        >
          {t("workerReg.startEarning", {
            defaultValue: "Start earning on your terms",
          })}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
          {t("workerReg.startEarningSubtitle", {
            defaultValue: "Set up your profile and start getting hired",
          })}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      <StepIndicator current={step} c={c} />

      {error ? (
        <View style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
          <AuthAlert type="error" message={error} />
        </View>
      ) : null}

      <View
        style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border }]}
      >
        {step === 0 && (
          <View style={s.stepContent}>
            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={s.stepTitle}>
              {t("workerReg.createAccount", {
                defaultValue: "Create your account",
              })}
            </AppText>

            <Pressable
              onPress={handleGooglePress}
              disabled={googleLoading}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                s.googleBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: pressed ? c.bgCard : c.bgInput,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  opacity: googleLoading ? 0.6 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              {googleLoading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.text} />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Ionicons name="logo-google" size={18} color="#4285F4" />
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text, marginLeft: 10 }}
                  >
                    {t("auth.signUpWithGoogle", {
                      defaultValue: "Sign up with Google",
                    })}
                  </AppText>
                </>
              )}
            </Pressable>

            <View style={s.dividerRow}>
              <View style={[s.dividerLine, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="muted"
                style={{ marginHorizontal: 12 }}
              >
                {t("auth.orContinueWithEmail", {
                  defaultValue: "or continue with email",
                })}
              </AppText>
              <View style={[s.dividerLine, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
            </View>

            <View style={s.row2}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label={t("auth.firstName") + " *"}
                  placeholder="John"
                  value={account.firstName}
                  onChangeText={(v) => a("firstName", v)}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label={t("auth.lastName") + " *"}
                  placeholder="Doe"
                  value={account.lastName}
                  onChangeText={(v) => a("lastName", v)}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.emailAddress") + " *"}
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              keyboardType="email-address"
              autoCapitalize="none"
              value={account.email}
              onChangeText={(v) => a("email", v)}
            />

            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.phone")}
              placeholder="+234..."
              keyboardType="phone-pad"
              value={account.phone}
              onChangeText={(v) => a("phone", v)}
            />

            <View style={s.row2}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label={t("auth.country")}
                  placeholder="Nigeria"
                  value={account.country}
                  onChangeText={(v) => a("country", v)}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label={t("auth.city")}
                  placeholder="Lagos"
                  value={account.city}
                  onChangeText={(v) => a("city", v)}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.referralCode") + " (optional)"}
              placeholder="e.g. SPTEST01"
              autoCapitalize="characters"
              maxLength={12}
              value={account.referralCode}
              onChangeText={(v) => a("referralCode", v.toUpperCase())}
            />

            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.password") + " * (min 8 chars)"}
              secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
              value={account.password}
              onChangeText={(v) => a("password", v)}
              iconRight={{
                name: showPassword ? "eye-off-outline" : "eye-outline",
                onPress: () => setShowPassword((v) => !v),
              }}
            />

            <AuthField
              label={t("auth.confirm") + " *"}
              secureTextEntry={!showConfirmPassword}
              value={account.confirm}
              onChangeText={(v) => a("confirm", v)}
              iconRight={{
                name: showConfirmPassword ? "eye-off-outline" : "eye-outline",
                onPress: () => setShowConfirmPassword((v) => !v),
              }}
            />
          </View>
        )}

        {step === 1 && (
          <View style={s.stepContent}>
            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={s.stepTitle}>
              {t("workerReg.yourProfile", {
                defaultValue: "Your professional profile",
              })}
            </AppText>

            <AuthField
              label={t("workerReg.professionalTitle") + " *"}
              placeholder="e.g. Certified Electrician"
              value={profile.title}
              onChangeText={(v) => p("title", v)}
            />

            <View>
              <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={s.label}>
                {t("workerReg.description")} *
              </AppText>
              <TextInput
                multiline
                numberOfLines={4}
                placeholder="Describe your skills, experience, specializations..."
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                value={profile.description}
                onChangeText={(v) => p("description", v)}
                style={[
                  s.textarea,
                  {
                    color: c.text,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                  },
                ]}
              />
            </View>

            <View style={s.row2}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label={t("workerReg.yearsExperience", {
                    defaultValue: "Years of Experience",
                  })}
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  placeholder="0"
                  value={profile.yearsExperience}
                  onChangeText={(v) => p("yearsExperience", v)}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label={t("workerReg.serviceRadius", {
                    defaultValue: "Service Radius (km)",
                  })}
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  placeholder="25"
                  value={profile.serviceRadius}
                  onChangeText={(v) => p("serviceRadius", v)}
                />
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        {step === 2 && (
          <View style={s.stepContent}>
            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={s.stepTitle}>
              {t("workerReg.yourCategories", {
                defaultValue: "Your service categories",
              })}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ marginTop: -8, marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("workerReg.categoriesHint", {
                defaultValue: "Select up to 5 categories. Mark one as primary.",
              })}
            </AppText>

            {selectedCats.length > 0 && (
              <View style={s.selectedCats}>
                {selectedCats.map((cat) => {
                  const isPrimary = cat.id === primaryCatId;
                  return (
                    <View
                      key={cat.id}
                      style={[
                        s.selectedChip,
                        {
                          backgroundColor: isPrimary ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                          borderColor: isPrimary ? c.orange : c.border,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: isPrimary ? c.orange : c.text }}
                      >
                        {cat.icon ? `${cat.icon} ` : ""}
                        {cat.name}
                      </AppText>
                      <Pressable
                        onPress={() => setPrimaryCatId(cat.id)}
                        hitSlop={6}
                        style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
                      >
                        <Ionicons
                          name={isPrimary ? "star" : "star-outline"}
                          size={13}
                          color={isPrimary ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                        />
                      </Pressable>
                      <Pressable
                        onPress={() => toggleCat(cat)}
                        hitSlop={6}
                        style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}
                      >
                        <Ionicons
                          name="close"
                          size={14}
                          color={isPrimary ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                        />
                      </Pressable>
                    </View>
                  );
                })}
              </View>
            )}

            <AuthField
              placeholder="Search categories..."
              iconLeft="search-outline"
              value={catSearch}
              onChangeText={setCatSearch}
            />

            {/* ✅ ScrollView with increased maxHeight and no slice limit */}
            <ScrollView style={{ maxHeight: 400 }} nestedScrollEnabled>
              <View style={s.catGrid}>
                {filteredCats.map((cat) => {
                  const selected = !!selectedCats.find((x) => x.id === cat.id);
                  return (
                    <Pressable
                      key={cat.id}
                      onPress={() => toggleCat(cat)}
                      style={[
                        s.catChip,
                        {
                          backgroundColor: selected ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                          borderColor: selected ? c.orange : c.border,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        style={{ color: selected ? c.orange : c.textDim }}
                      >
                        {cat.icon ? `${cat.icon} ` : ""}
                        {cat.name}
                      </AppText>
                    </Pressable>
                  );
                })}
              </View>
            </ScrollView>

            {!showCustomCat ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setShowCustomCat(true)}
                style={[s.addCatBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
              >
                <Ionicons name="add" size={14} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" tone="dim">
                  Add a custom category
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ) : (
              <View style={s.customCatBox}>
                <AuthField
                  autoFocus
                  placeholder="e.g. Solar Panel Installation"
                  value={customCatName}
                  onChangeText={setCustomCatName}
                />
                <View style={s.row2}>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={handleAddCustomCategory}
                    disabled={addingCat || !customCatName.trim()}
                    style={[
                      s.primaryBtn,
                      { backgroundColor: c.orange, flex: 1 },
                      (addingCat || !customCatName.trim()) && { opacity: 0.5 },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="bold"
                      style={{ color: "#fff", textAlign: "center" }}
                    >
                      {addingCat ? "Adding..." : "Add Category"}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => {
                      setShowCustomCat(false);
                      setCustomCatName("");
                    }}
                    style={[s.secondaryBtn, { borderColor: c.border, flex: 1 }]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      tone="dim"
                      style={{ textAlign: "center" }}
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {step === 3 && (
          <View style={s.stepContent}>
            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={s.stepTitle}>
              {t("workerReg.setYourRates", {
                defaultValue: "Set your rates",
              })}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ marginTop: -8, marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("workerReg.ratesNote", {
                defaultValue:
                  "Leave blank to hide that option from your profile. Set at least one rate.",
              })}
            </AppText>

            <View>
              <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={s.label}>
                Currency
              </AppText>
              <CurrencyPicker
                value={pricing.currency}
                onChange={(v) => pr("currency", v)}
                c={c}
              />
            </View>

            <View style={s.row2}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label="Hourly Rate"
                  keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  value={pricing.hourlyRate}
                  onChangeText={(v) => pr("hourlyRate", v)}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label="Daily Rate"
                  keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  value={pricing.dailyRate}
                  onChangeText={(v) => pr("dailyRate", v)}
                />
              </View>
            </View>
            <View style={s.row2}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label="Weekly Rate"
                  keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  value={pricing.weeklyRate}
                  onChangeText={(v) => pr("weeklyRate", v)}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label="Monthly Rate"
                  keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  value={pricing.monthlyRate}
                  onChangeText={(v) => pr("monthlyRate", v)}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            <View style={[s.divider, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
              <AppText variant="small" weight="bold" tone="muted">
                Custom Rate
              </AppText>
            </View>

            <View style={s.row2}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label="Custom Rate Amount"
                  keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  value={pricing.customRate}
                  onChangeText={(v) => pr("customRate", v)}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <AuthField
                  label="Custom Label"
                  placeholder="e.g. per project"
                  value={pricing.customRateLabel}
                  onChangeText={(v) => pr("customRateLabel", v)}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            <View>
              <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={s.label}>
                Pricing Note (optional)
              </AppText>
              <TextInput
                multiline
                numberOfLines={3}
                placeholder="Discounts, terms, travel fees..."
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                value={pricing.pricingNote}
                onChangeText={(v) => pr("pricingNote", v)}
                style={[
                  s.textarea,
                  {
                    color: c.text,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                  },
                ]}
              />
            </View>

            {(pricing.hourlyRate ||
              pricing.dailyRate ||
              pricing.weeklyRate ||
              pricing.monthlyRate ||
              pricing.customRate) && (
              <View
                style={[
                  s.preview,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="small" weight="bold" tone="muted">
                  YOUR RATES PREVIEW
                </AppText>
                <View style={s.previewPills}>
                  {pricing.hourlyRate ? (
                    <View
                      style={[s.previewPill, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="bold"
                        style={{ color: c.orange }}
                      >
                        {pricing.currency} {pricing.hourlyRate}/hr
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ) : null}
                  {pricing.dailyRate ? (
                    <View
                      style={[s.previewPill, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="bold"
                        style={{ color: c.orange }}
                      >
                        {pricing.currency} {pricing.dailyRate}/day
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ) : null}
                  {pricing.weeklyRate ? (
                    <View
                      style={[s.previewPill, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="bold"
                        style={{ color: c.orange }}
                      >
                        {pricing.currency} {pricing.weeklyRate}/wk
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ) : null}
                  {pricing.monthlyRate ? (
                    <View
                      style={[s.previewPill, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="bold"
                        style={{ color: c.orange }}
                      >
                        {pricing.currency} {pricing.monthlyRate}/mo
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ) : null}
                  {pricing.customRate ? (
                    <View
                      style={[s.previewPill, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="bold"
                        style={{ color: c.orange }}
                      >
                        {pricing.currency} {pricing.customRate}
                        {pricing.customRateLabel
                          ? `/${pricing.customRateLabel}`
                          : "/custom"}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ) : null}
                </View>
              </View>
            )}

            <Pressable onPress={() => setAgreed(!agreed)} style={s.checkRow}>
              <View
                style={[
                  s.checkbox,
                  {
                    borderColor: agreed ? c.orange : c.border,
                    backgroundColor: agreed ? c.orange : "transparent",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {agreed && <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={14} color="#fff" />}
              </View>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                I agree to the{" "}
                <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
                  Terms
                </AppText>{" "}
                and{" "}
                <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
                  Privacy Policy
                </AppText>
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}

        <View style={[s.navRow, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
          {step > 0 && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => {
                Keyboard.dismiss();
                setStep((s) => s - 1);
                setError("");
              }}
              style={[s.secondaryBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" tone="dim">
                ← Back
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}

          {step < STEPS.length - 1 ? (
            <Pressable
              onPress={next}
              style={[s.primaryBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" weight="bold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
                Continue →
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ) : (
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleSubmit}
              disabled={isLoading || !agreed}
              style={[
                s.primaryBtn,
                { backgroundColor: isLoading || !agreed ? c.bgCard : c.orange },
              ]}
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="bold"
                  style={{ color: isLoading || !agreed ? c.textMuted : "#fff" }}
                >
                  🚀 Create Account
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={{ alignItems: "center", marginTop: 20 }}>
        <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
          Already have an account?{" "}
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange }}
            onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Login")}
          >
            Sign in
          </AppText>
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
            Hiring someone?{" "}
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("RegisterHirer")}
            >
              Register as Hirer
            </AppText>
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

const si = StyleSheet.create({
  row: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "flex-start", marginBottom: 20 },
  dotWrap: { alignItems: "center", zIndex: 1, position: "relative" },
  dot: {
    width: 36,
    height: 36,
    borderRadius: 18,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  line: { flex: 1, height: 2, marginTop: 17, marginHorizontal: -2 },
});

const s = StyleSheet.create({
  googleBtn: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    height: 50,
    borderRadius: 10,
    borderWidth: 1.5,
  },
  dividerRow: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    marginVertical: 16,
  },
  dividerLine: {
    flex: 1,
    height: 1,
  },
  card: {
    borderRadius: 20,
    borderWidth: 1,
    padding: 20,
    marginTop: 24,
  },
  stepContent: { gap: 16 },
  stepTitle: { marginBottom: 8 },
  label: {
    marginBottom: 6,
    textTransform: "uppercase",
    letterSpacing: 0.8,
    fontSize: 11,
  },
  row2: { flexDirection: "row", gap: 12 },
  textarea: {
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: 10,
    padding: 14,
    minHeight: 100,
    textAlignVertical: "top",
  },
  divider: {
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    paddingTop: 12,
    marginTop: 4,
    alignItems: "center",
  },
  selectedCats: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    flexWrap: "wrap",
    gap: 6,
    marginBottom: 8,
  },
  selectedChip: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 10,
    paddingVertical: 4,
    borderRadius: 100,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  catGrid: {
    flexDirection: "row",

function RefundRequestInline({
  booking,
  payment,
  isProcessing,
  isHirer,
  onRequestRefund,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  if (!isHirer) {
    return (
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, textAlign: "center" }}>
        Only the hirer can request a refund.
      </AppText>
    );
  }

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!reason.trim()) {
      setError("Please describe the reason for the refund request.");
      return;
    }
    const amount = Number(payment?.amount) || Number(booking?.agreedRate) || 0;
    onRequestRefund({
      bookingId: booking.id,
      reason: reason.trim(),
      amount,
      currency: booking.currency || "NGN",
    });
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, lineHeight: 20 }}>
        Request a refund for this booking. Our team will review it within 24-48
        hours.
      </AppText>

      <View>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 10,
            fontWeight: "700",
            color: c.textMuted,
            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 0.6,
            marginBottom: 6,
          }}
        >
          Reason for refund <AppText style={{ color: c.red }}>*</AppText>
        </AppText>
        <View
          style={{
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: error ? c.red : c.border,
            borderRadius: 8,
            backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
            overflow: "hidden",
          }}
        >
          <TextInput
            value={reason}
            onChangeText={(t) => {
              setReason(t);
              setError("");
            }}
            placeholder="Explain why you're requesting a refund…"
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            multiline
            numberOfLines={4}
            textAlignVertical="top"
            style={{
              minHeight: 96,
              padding: 12,
              fontSize: 13,
              color: c.text,
              lineHeight: 18,
            }}
          />
        </View>
        {error ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.red, marginTop: 4 }}>
            {error}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <Pressable
        onPress={handleSubmit}
        disabled={isProcessing}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          {
            paddingVertical: 12,
            backgroundColor: c.red,
            borderRadius: 10,
            alignItems: "center",
            opacity: isProcessing ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {isProcessing ? (
          <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
        ) : (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}>
            Submit Refund Request
          </AppText>
        )}
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

function formatPrice(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const n = Number(amount) || 0;
  return `${currency} ${n.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Helpers
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function haversineKm(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) {
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLng = ((lng2 - lng1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
  return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
}

function formatDuration(booking) {
  if (!booking) return null;
  const unit = booking.estimatedUnit || "hours";
  const value = booking.estimatedValue;
  const hours = booking.estimatedHours;
  if (!value && !hours) return null;

  if (value) {
    if (unit === "custom") return { main: value, sub: null };
    const labels = {
      hours: "hour",
      days: "day",
      weeks: "week",
      months: "month",
      years: "year",
    };
    const num = parseFloat(value);
    const label = (labels[unit] || unit) + (num !== 1 ? "s" : "");
    const eqv = unit !== "hours" && hours ? `≈ ${hours}h` : null;
    return { main: `${num} ${label}`, sub: eqv };
  }
  return hours ? { main: `${hours} hours`, sub: null } : null;
}

const STATUS_STEP = {
  PENDING: 0,
  ACCEPTED: 1,
  IN_PROGRESS: 2,
  COMPLETED: 3,
  PAID: 3,
  CANCELLED: -1,
  DISPUTED: -1,
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Screen
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export default function BookingDetailScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const bookingId = route.params?.bookingId;
  const userId = user?.id;

  // Data
  const [booking, setBooking] = useState(null);
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);
  const [invoiceLoading, setInvoiceLoading] = useState(false);

  // Refund / dispute
  const [refunds, setRefunds] = useState([]);
  const [refundLoading, setRefundLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showRefundModal, setShowRefundModal] = useState(false);
  const [showDispute, setShowDispute] = useState(false);

  // SOS
  const [resolvingSOS, setResolvingSOS] = useState(false);
  const [sosConfirmVisible, setSosConfirmVisible] = useState(false);
  const [emergencyContact, setEmergencyContact] = useState(null);

  // Review
  const [hasReviewed, setHasReviewed] = useState(false);
  const [reviewCheckDone, setReviewCheckDone] = useState(false);

  // Wallet + referral
  const [walletBalance, setWalletBalance] = useState(0);
  const [referralPercent, setReferralPercent] = useState(0);
  const [referralAmount, setReferralAmount] = useState(0);
  const [referralApplied, setReferralApplied] = useState(false);

  // Cancel
  const [showCancel, setShowCancel] = useState(false);
  const [cancelReason, setCancelReason] = useState("");
  const [cancelError, setCancelError] = useState("");

  // Pay options toggle
  const [showPayOptions, setShowPayOptions] = useState(false);

  // ── Fetch ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchAll = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      if (!bookingId) return;
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const bRes = await client.get(`/bookings/${bookingId}`);
        const b = bRes.data?.data?.booking;
        if (!b) throw new Error("Booking not found");
        setBooking(b);

        if (b.emergencyContact) {
          try {
            setEmergencyContact(
              typeof b.emergencyContact === "string"
                ? JSON.parse(b.emergencyContact)
                : b.emergencyContact,
            );
          } catch {
            setEmergencyContact(null);
          }
        }

        try {
          const pRes = await client.get(`/payments/${b.id}`);
          setPayment(pRes.data?.data || null);
        } catch {
          setPayment(null);
        }

        if (b.status === "COMPLETED") {
          try {
            const r = await client.get(`/reviews/check/${bookingId}`);
            setHasReviewed(!!r.data?.data?.hasReviewed);
          } catch {
            setHasReviewed(false);
          }
        }
        setReviewCheckDone(true);

        if (user?.role === "HIRER") {
          try {
            const wRes = await client.get("/referral/wallet");
            setWalletBalance(Number(wRes.data?.data?.balance) || 0);
          } catch {
            setWalletBalance(0);
          }
        }

        try {
          const rRes = await client.get(`/refunds/my`, {
            params: { bookingId },
          });
          setRefunds(rRes.data?.data?.refunds || []);
        } catch {
          setRefunds([]);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(
          err?.response?.data?.message || "Could not load booking details.",
        );
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [bookingId, user?.role],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAll(false);
  }, [fetchAll]);

  // Recompute referral amount
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!booking) return;
    const p = calcPricing(booking);
    const subtotal = p.subtotal || 0;
    const maxDiscount = Math.min(subtotal, walletBalance);
    const rawAmount = (referralPercent / 100) * subtotal;
    setReferralAmount(Math.min(Math.round(rawAmount), maxDiscount));
  }, [referralPercent, walletBalance, booking]);

  // ── Derived flags ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const isHirer = userId === booking?.hirerId;
  const isWorker = userId === booking?.workerId;
  const step = booking ? (STATUS_STEP[booking.status] ?? 0) : 0;
  const other = isHirer ? booking?.worker : booking?.hirer;
  const dur = formatDuration(booking);
  const sosActive = !!booking?.sosActivatedAt && !booking?.sosResolvedAt;

  const hasCheckInGps =
    booking?.checkInLat != null && booking?.checkInLng != null;
  const hasCheckOutGps =
    booking?.checkOutLat != null && booking?.checkOutLng != null;
  const checkInDistKm =
    hasCheckInGps && booking?.latitude && booking?.longitude
      ? haversineKm(
          booking.checkInLat,
          booking.checkInLng,
          booking.latitude,
          booking.longitude,
        )
      : null;
  const checkOutDistKm =
    hasCheckOutGps && booking?.latitude && booking?.longitude
      ? haversineKm(
          booking.checkOutLat,
          booking.checkOutLng,
          booking.latitude,
          booking.longitude,
        )
      : null;

  const feeBreakdown = useMemo(() => {
    if (!booking) return null;
    const p = calcPricing(booking);
    return {
      label: "Payment Breakdown",
      subtotal: p.subtotal,
      total: p.grossTotal,
      platformFee: p.hirerFee,
      workerPayout: p.workerPayout,
      currency: p.currency,
      isActual: false,
      agreedRate: p.agreedRate,
      estimatedUnit: p.unit,
      hasQty: p.hasQty,
      qty: p.qty,
      unitLabel: p.unitLabel,
      suffix: p.unitSuffix,
      noDuration: !p.hasQty,
    };
  }, [booking]);

  const paymentRequired =
    isHirer &&
    ["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(booking?.status) &&
    (!payment || payment.status === "PENDING");

  // Active refund — only for THIS booking
  const activeRefund = refunds.find((r) =>
    ["PENDING", "APPROVED", "PROCESSING", "DISPUTED"].includes(r.status),
  );

  // ── Actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const updateStatus = async (status, extra = {}) => {
    setActing(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.patch(`/bookings/${bookingId}/status`, {
        status,
        ...extra,
      });
      const updated = res.data?.data?.booking || booking;
      setBooking(updated);
      toast.success(
        `Booking ${String(status).toLowerCase().replace("_", " ")}.`,
      );
      setShowCancel(false);
      setCancelReason("");
      setCancelError("");
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e?.response?.data?.message || "Action failed.");
    } finally {
      setActing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelSubmit = () => {
    if (!cancelReason.trim()) {
      setCancelError("Please provide a reason.");
      return;
    }
    updateStatus("CANCELLED", { cancelReason: cancelReason.trim() });
  };

  const handleResolveSOS = async () => {
    setResolvingSOS(true);
    try {
      await client.patch(`/bookings/${bookingId}/sos/resolve`);
      toast.success("SOS marked as resolved.");
      fetchAll(true);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to resolve SOS.");
    } finally {
      setResolvingSOS(false);
      setSosConfirmVisible(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRefundRequest = async (refundData) => {
    setRefundLoading(true);
    try {
      await client.post("/refunds/request", refundData);
      toast.success("Refund request submitted.");
      setShowRefundModal(false);
      fetchAll(true);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e?.response?.data?.message || "Refund request failed.");
    } finally {
      setRefundLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReleasePayment = () => {
    navigation.navigate("ReleaseEscrow", { bookingId });
  };

  const handlePayByCard = () => {
    navigation.navigate("InitiatePayment", { bookingId });
  };

  const handlePercentChange = (pct) => {
    const subtotal = calcPricing(booking).subtotal || 0;
    const maxDiscount = Math.min(subtotal, walletBalance);
    const rawAmount = (pct / 100) * subtotal;
    const final = Math.min(Math.round(rawAmount), maxDiscount);
    setReferralPercent(pct);
    setReferralAmount(final);
    setReferralApplied(final > 0);
  };

  const handleReferralToggle = () => setReferralApplied((v) => !v);

  // ── Invoice Generation (with Android retry) ─────────────────────
  const handleDownloadInvoice = async () => {
    setInvoiceLoading(true);
    try {
      const p = calcPricing(booking);

      const transaction = {
        reference: payment?.providerRef || booking.id,
        type: "PAYMENT",
        amount: p.grossTotal || booking.amount || 0,
        currency: booking.currency || "NGN",
        status: "COMPLETED",
        createdAt: booking.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
        description: `Payment for booking: ${booking.title}`,
        fee: p.hirerFee || 0,
        netAmount: p.subtotal || booking.amount || 0,
        bookingId: booking.id,
        bookingTitle: booking.title,
        workerName: booking.worker
          ? `${booking.worker.firstName} ${booking.worker.lastName}`
          : "—",
        hirerName: booking.hirer
          ? `${booking.hirer.firstName} ${booking.hirer.lastName}`
          : "—",
        meta: {
          paymentProvider: payment?.provider || "Paystack",
        },
      };

      const html = generateReceiptHTML(transaction);
      const { uri } = await Print.printToFileAsync({ html, base64: false });

      // Give Android a tick to settle the activity before opening the
      // share sheet — fixes "activity is no longer available".
      await new Promise((resolve) =>
        setTimeout(resolve, Platform.OS === "android" ? 300 : 0),
      );

      const canShare = await Sharing.isAvailableAsync();

      if (!canShare) {
        Alert.alert(
          "Invoice Ready",
          "The share sheet isn't available on this device. Opening the invoice...",
          [
            {
              text: "OK",
              onPress: async () => {
                try {
                  await Linking.openURL(uri);
                } catch {
                  toast.error("Could not open invoice.");
                }
              },
            },
          ],
        );
        return;
      }

      try {
        await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, {
          mimeType: "application/pdf",
          dialogTitle: `Invoice — ${booking.title}`,
          UTI: "com.adobe.pdf",
        });
      } catch (firstErr) {
        if (
          Platform.OS === "android" &&
          /activity.*(no longer|not).*available/i.test(
            String(firstErr?.message),
          )
        ) {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800));
          await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, {
            mimeType: "application/pdf",
            dialogTitle: `Invoice — ${booking.title}`,
            UTI: "com.adobe.pdf",
          });
        } else {
          throw firstErr;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Invoice error:", e);
      toast.error(
        e?.message?.includes("activity")
          ? "Couldn't open share sheet. Please try again."
          : "Failed to generate invoice.",
      );
    } finally {
      setInvoiceLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLeaveReview = () => {
    navigation.navigate("LeaveReview", { bookingId });
  };
  const handleShowRefundModal = () => setShowRefundModal(true);

  // Back to Bookings list
  const handleBack = () => {
    navigation.navigate("Bookings");
  };

  // ── Loading — SKELETON ─────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }} edges={["top"]}>
        <PageSkeleton variant="detail" />
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Not found ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!booking) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }} edges={["top"]}>
        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            padding: 24,
            gap: 12,
          }}
        >
          <FaExclamationCircle size={44} color={c.red} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
            }}
          >
            Booking not found
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 6,
                marginTop: 8,
                paddingVertical: 10,
                paddingHorizontal: 20,
                backgroundColor: c.orange,
                borderRadius: 10,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaArrowLeft size={12} color="#000" />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: "#000",
              }}
            >
              Back to Bookings
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      edges={["top", "left", "right"]}
    >
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 8, paddingBottom: 40, gap: 10 }}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {/* Back link */}
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleBack}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            {
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 6,
              alignSelf: "flex-start",
              paddingVertical: 6,
              paddingHorizontal: 14,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 20,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaArrowLeft size={12} color={c.textDim} />
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
          >
            Back to Bookings
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {/* SOS banner */}
        {sosActive ? (
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 10,
              padding: 14,
              borderRadius: 12,
              borderWidth: 2,
              backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.1)",
              borderColor: c.red,
              flexWrap: "wrap",
            }}
          >
            <FaExclamationCircle size={20} color={c.red} />
            <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.red }}
              >
                SOS Alert Active
              </AppText>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 2 }}>
                The worker has triggered an emergency alert.
                {booking.sosActivatedAt
                  ? ` Activated ${new Date(booking.sosActivatedAt).toLocaleTimeString()}`
                  : ""}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            {isHirer || user?.role === "ADMIN" ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setSosConfirmVisible(true)}
                disabled={resolvingSOS}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    paddingHorizontal: 12,
                    paddingVertical: 8,
                    backgroundColor: c.red,
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    opacity: resolvingSOS ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
                >
                  {resolvingSOS ? "Resolving…" : "Mark Resolved"}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* MAIN COLUMN */}
        <BookingDetailMain
          booking={booking}
          step={step}
          dur={dur}
          hasCheckInGps={hasCheckInGps}
          hasCheckOutGps={hasCheckOutGps}
          checkInDistKm={checkInDistKm}
          checkOutDistKm={checkOutDistKm}
          reviewCheckDone={reviewCheckDone}
          hasReviewed={hasReviewed}
          bookingId={booking.id}
          invoiceLoading={invoiceLoading}
          onDownloadInvoice={handleDownloadInvoice}
          onLeaveReview={handleLeaveReview}
          isHirer={isHirer}
          payment={payment}
          paymentStatus={payment?.status}
          isWorker={isWorker}
          workerName={booking.worker?.firstName}
          refundLoading={refundLoading}
          hasActiveRefund={!!activeRefund}
          onShowRefundModal={handleShowRefundModal}
        />

        {/* Worker preview — pending only */}
        {isWorker && booking.status === "PENDING" ? (
          <WorkerPaymentPreview booking={booking} isWorker={isWorker} />
        ) : null}

        {/* Payment card — ALWAYS rendered (breakdown or receipt inside) */}
        <BookingDetailPayment
          booking={booking}
          payment={payment}
          feeBreakdown={feeBreakdown}
          walletBalance={walletBalance}
          referralAmount={referralAmount}
          referralApplied={referralApplied}
          referralPercent={referralPercent}
          onPercentChange={handlePercentChange}
          onReferralToggle={handleReferralToggle}
          showPayOptions={showPayOptions}
          onTogglePayOptions={() => setShowPayOptions((v) => !v)}
          paymentRequired={paymentRequired}
          onPayByCard={handlePayByCard}
          refetch={() => fetchAll(true)}
          onSuccess={(msg) => toast.success(msg)}
          isHirer={isHirer}
          isWorker={isWorker}
        />

        {/* Sidebar — party + actions */}
        <BookingDetailSidebar
          booking={booking}
          payment={payment}
          isHirer={isHirer}
          isWorker={isWorker}
          other={other}
          userId={userId}
          acting={acting}
          emergencyContact={emergencyContact}
          showCancel={showCancel}
          cancelReason={cancelReason}
          cancelError={cancelError}
          onCancelOpen={() => {
            setShowCancel(true);
            setCancelError("");
          }}
          onCancelClose={() => {
            setShowCancel(false);
            setCancelReason("");
            setCancelError("");
          }}
          onCancelReasonChange={(v) => {
            setCancelReason(v);
            setCancelError("");
          }}
          onCancelSubmit={handleCancelSubmit}
          onShowDispute={() => setShowDispute(true)}
          onSuccess={(msg) => toast.success(msg)}
          refetch={() => fetchAll(true)}
          updateStatus={updateStatus}
          onRelease={handleReleasePayment}
          onMessage={() =>
            navigation.navigate("Chat", { withUserId: other?.id })
          }
          onVideoCall={() =>
            navigation.navigate("VideoCall", { bookingId: booking.id })
          }
        />

        {/* Refund status — ONLY for this booking */}
        {activeRefund ? (
          <RefundStatusInline
            refund={activeRefund}
            isHirer={isHirer}
            onViewDetails={() =>
              navigation.navigate("RefundDetail", { id: activeRefund.id })
            }
          />
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* SOS confirmation modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={sosConfirmVisible}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setSosConfirmVisible(false)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            padding: 20,
          }}
          onPress={() => setSosConfirmVisible(false)}
        >
          <Pressable
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation?.()}
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 16,
              padding: 20,
              width: "100%",
              maxWidth: 460,
            }}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.text,
                marginBottom: 8,
              }}
            >
              Resolve SOS Alert
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                color: c.textDim,
                lineHeight: 19,
                marginBottom: 16,
              }}
            >
              Are you sure you want to mark this SOS alert as resolved?
            </AppText>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setSosConfirmVisible(false)}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flex: 1,
                    paddingVertical: 12,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    alignItems: "center",
                    opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
                >
                  Cancel
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleResolveSOS}
                disabled={resolvingSOS}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flex: 1,
                    paddingVertical: 12,
                    backgroundColor: "#eab308",
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    alignItems: "center",
                    opacity: resolvingSOS ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#000" }}
                >
                  {resolvingSOS ? "…" : "Yes, Resolve"}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>

      {/* Dispute sheet */}
      {showDispute ? (
        <RaiseDisputeSheet
          bookingId={booking.id}
          bookingTitle={booking.title}
          onClose={() => setShowDispute(false)}
          onSuccess={() => {
            toast.success(
              "Dispute raised. Our team will review within 24–48 hours.",
            );
            setShowDispute(false);
            fetchAll(true);
          }}
        />
      ) : null}

      {/* Refund modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showRefundModal}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowRefundModal(false)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",
            justifyContent: "flex-end",
          }}
          onPress={() => setShowRefundModal(false)}
        >
          <Pressable
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation?.()}
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderTopLeftRadius: 20,
              borderTopRightRadius: 20,
              padding: 20,
              maxHeight: "92%",
            }}
          >
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "center",
                marginBottom: 16,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                  fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: "800",
                  color: c.text,
                }}
              >
                Request Refund
              </AppText>
              <Pressable onPress={() => setShowRefundModal(false)} hitSlop={10}>
                <FaTimes size={16} color={c.textDim} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
            <ScrollView>
              <RefundRequestInline
                booking={booking}
                payment={payment}
                isProcessing={refundLoading}
                isHirer={isHirer}
                onRequestRefund={handleRefundRequest}
              />
            </ScrollView>
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

// ── Duration formatter (mirrors website) ────────────────────────────────
function formatDuration(booking) {
  if (!booking) return null;

  const unit = booking.estimatedUnit || "hours";
  const value = booking.estimatedValue || null;
  const hours = booking.estimatedHours || null;
  const customLabel = booking.customLabel || "Custom";

  if (!value && !hours) return null;

  if (unit === "custom") {
    const quantityNum = booking.quantity || 1;
    return { main: `${quantityNum} ${customLabel}`, sub: null };
  }

  if (value) {
    const unitLabel =
      {
        hours: "hour",
        days: "day",
        weeks: "week",
        months: "month",
        years: "year",
      }[unit] || unit;

    let numValue = value;
    if (typeof value === "string" && !isNaN(parseFloat(value))) {
      numValue = parseFloat(value);
    }

    const num = typeof numValue === "number" ? numValue : parseFloat(value);
    if (isNaN(num) || num <= 0) {
      return { main: value, sub: null };
    }

    const label = unitLabel + (num !== 1 ? "s" : "");
    const eqv = unit !== "hours" && hours ? `≈ ${hours}h` : null;
    return { main: `${num} ${label}`, sub: eqv };
  }

  if (hours) {
    const num = parseFloat(hours);
    if (isNaN(num) || num <= 0) {
      return { main: `${hours} hours`, sub: null };
    }
    return { main: `${num} hours`, sub: null };
  }

  return null;
}
