const URL_REGEX =
  /((?:https?:\/\/|www\.)[^\s<>()"']+[^\s<>()"'.,;:!?]|\b(?:call|api|app)\.skilledproz\.com\/[^\s<>()"',;!?]+)/gi;

function linkify(text) {
  if (!text || typeof text !== "string") return [{ text }];
  if (!/https?:\/\/|www\.|\.skilledproz\.com/i.test(text)) {
    return [{ text }];
  }
  const parts = [];
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match;
  URL_REGEX.lastIndex = 0;
  while ((match = URL_REGEX.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const start = match.index;
    const end = URL_REGEX.lastIndex;
    if (start > lastIndex) parts.push({ text: text.slice(lastIndex, start) });
    const url = match[0];
    const href = /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) ? url : `https://${url}`;
    parts.push({ text: url, url: href });
    lastIndex = end;
  }
  if (lastIndex < text.length) parts.push({ text: text.slice(lastIndex) });
  return parts;
}

function formatTime(dateStr) {
  return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleTimeString([], {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function formatDateDivider(dateStr) {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  const now = new Date();
  const yesterday = new Date(now);
  yesterday.setDate(now.getDate() - 1);
  if (d.toDateString() === now.toDateString()) return "Today";
  if (d.toDateString() === yesterday.toDateString()) return "Yesterday";
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    weekday: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    month: "long",
  });
}

// ── Tick states ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// pending      → one grey check
// !pending
//   !read & delivered  → two grey checks
//   read               → two blue checks
//   !pending & !read & !delivered → one grey check (delivered unknown)
function Ticks({ pending, delivered, read, color }) {
  const grey = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
  const baseColor = color || grey;
  const blue = "#3b82f6";

  if (pending) {
    // One check — message queued/sending
    return (
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", marginLeft: 4 }}>
        <FaCheck size={10} color={baseColor} style={{ opacity: 0.85 }} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (read) {
    // Two blue checks — message read by receiver
    return (
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", marginLeft: 4 }}>
        <FaCheck size={10} color={blue} style={{ opacity: 0.95 }} />
        <FaCheck
          size={10}
          color={blue}
          style={{ opacity: 0.95, marginLeft: -3 }}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (delivered) {
    // Two grey checks — receiver's client has fetched the message
    return (
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", marginLeft: 4 }}>
        <FaCheck size={10} color={baseColor} style={{ opacity: 0.85 }} />
        <FaCheck
          size={10}
          color={baseColor}
          style={{ opacity: 0.85, marginLeft: -3 }}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  // Sent, delivered unknown — one grey check
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", marginLeft: 4 }}>
      <FaCheck size={10} color={baseColor} style={{ opacity: 0.85 }} />
    </View>
  );
}

function TranslateButton({ text }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const [translated, setTranslated] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showPicker, setShowPicker] = useState(false);

  async function translate(langCode) {
    setShowPicker(false);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.post("/translate", {
        text,
        targetLang: langCode,
      });
      setTranslated(res.data.data.translated);
    } catch {
      setTranslated("Translation failed.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  if (translated) {
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          marginTop: 6,
          paddingHorizontal: 10,
          paddingVertical: 6,
          backgroundColor: "rgba(59,130,246,0.08)",
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: "rgba(59,130,246,0.2)",
          borderRadius: 8,
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "flex-start",
          gap: 6,
        }}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 10,
            fontWeight: "700",
            color: "#60a5fa",
            marginTop: 1,
          }}
        >
          Translated:
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 12, color: "#93c5fd" }}>
          {translated}
        </AppText>
        <Pressable onPress={() => setTranslated(null)} hitSlop={4}>
          <FaX size={11} color="#60a5fa" />
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
      <Pressable onPress={() => setShowPicker(true)} disabled={loading}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, opacity: 0.7 }}>
          {loading ? "…" : <FaGlobe size={12} color={c.textDim} />}
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>

      <Modal
        visible={showPicker}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowPicker(false)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",
            justifyContent: "center",
          }}
          onPress={() => setShowPicker(false)}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              margin: 24,
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderRadius: 14,
              padding: 8,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              maxHeight: "70%",
            }}
          >
            <FlatList
              data={LANGUAGES}
              keyExtractor={(l) => l.code}
              renderItem={({ item }) => (
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => translate(item.code)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => ({
                    paddingVertical: 12,
                    paddingHorizontal: 14,
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    backgroundColor: pressed ? c.bgCard : "transparent",
                  })}
                >
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.text }}>
                    {item.label}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              )}
            />
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}

function Avatar({ user, size = 28 }) {
  const initials =
    `${user?.firstName?.[0] || ""}${user?.lastName?.[0] || ""}`.toUpperCase();
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: size / 2,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.3)",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}
    >
      {user?.avatar ? (
        <Image
          source={{ uri: user.avatar }}
          style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
        />
      ) : (
        <AppText
          style={{ fontSize: size * 0.36, fontWeight: "700", color: "#f97316" }}
        >
          {initials || "?"}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function SkeletonBubble({ c, mine }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: mine ? "row-reverse" : "row",
        alignItems: "flex-end",
        gap: 6,
        marginBottom: 10,
      }}
    >
      <View
        style={{
          width: mine ? 0 : 28,
          height: 28,
          borderRadius: 14,
          backgroundColor: mine ? "transparent" : c.bgCard,
          marginRight: mine ? 0 : 6,
        }}
      />
      <View
        style={{
          width: mine ? "55%" : "65%",
          height: 36,
          borderRadius: 16,
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
          opacity: 0.6,
        }}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

export default function ChatScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const { startCall, call: activeCall } = useVoiceCall();
  const isOnCall = !!activeCall;

  const initialConvoId = route.params?.conversationId || null;
  const initialWithId = route.params?.withUserId || null;
  const initialDraft = route.params?.draft || "";

  const [activeConvoId, setActiveConvoId] = useState(initialConvoId);
  const [withUserId, setWithUserId] = useState(initialWithId);
  const [withUser, setWithUser] = useState(null);
  const [convoMeta, setConvoMeta] = useState(null);

  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [loadingMessages, setLoadingMessages] = useState(true);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState(initialDraft);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [sendingMessage, setSendingMessage] = useState(null);
  const [uploadingFile, setUploadingFile] = useState(false);
  const [lightboxSrc, setLightboxSrc] = useState(null);
  const [pendingCallType, setPendingCallType] = useState(null);
  const [startingCall, setStartingCall] = useState(false);
  const [showJump, setShowJump] = useState(false);

  const listRef = useRef(null);
  const pollRef = useRef(null);
  const initiatingRef = useRef(false);
  const lastIdRef = useRef(null);
  const markingReadRef = useRef(false);

  const activeOther = useMemo(() => {
    if (convoMeta) {
      return convoMeta.users?.find((u) => u.userId !== user?.id)?.user || null;
    }
    return withUser || null;
  }, [convoMeta, withUser, user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeConvoId) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await client.get("/messages/conversations", {
          params: { page: 1, limit: 100, _t: Date.now() },
        });
        const list = res.data.data.conversations || [];
        const convo = list.find((x) => x.id === activeConvoId);
        if (!cancelled) setConvoMeta(convo || null);
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [activeConvoId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!withUserId) {
      setWithUser(null);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await client.get(`/users/${withUserId}`);
        const data = res.data.data;
        const u = data?.user || data?.profile?.user || data?.profile || data;
        if (!cancelled && u?.id) setWithUser(u);
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [withUserId]);

  const markRead = useCallback((convoId) => {
    if (!convoId || markingReadRef.current) return;
    markingReadRef.current = true;
    client
      .patch(`/messages/${convoId}/read`)
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => {
        markingReadRef.current = false;
      });
  }, []);

  const loadMessages = useCallback(
    async (convoId, silent = false) => {
      if (!convoId) return;
      if (!silent) setLoadingMessages(true);
      try {
        const res = await client.get(`/messages/${convoId}`, {
          params: { page: 1, limit: 100, _t: Date.now() },
        });
        const msgs = res.data.data.messages || [];

        // Auto-mark unread from other as read on every poll
        const hasUnreadFromOther = msgs.some(
          (m) => m.senderId !== user?.id && !m.isRead,
        );
        if (hasUnreadFromOther) markRead(convoId);

        setMessages(msgs);
      } catch {
        if (!silent) setMessages([]);
      }
      if (!silent) setLoadingMessages(false);
    },
    [user?.id, markRead],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeConvoId) {
      setMessages([]);
      setLoadingMessages(false);
      return;
    }

    loadMessages(activeConvoId);
    markRead(activeConvoId);

    clearInterval(pollRef.current);
    pollRef.current = setInterval(
      () => loadMessages(activeConvoId, true),
      MSG_POLL_MS,
    );
    return () => clearInterval(pollRef.current);
  }, [activeConvoId, loadMessages, markRead]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (messages.length === 0) {
      lastIdRef.current = null;
      return;
    }
    const newestId = messages[messages.length - 1]?.id;
    if (newestId && newestId !== lastIdRef.current) {
      lastIdRef.current = newestId;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        listRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true });
      });
    }
  }, [messages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sendingMessage) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        listRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true });
      });
    }
  }, [sendingMessage]);

  const resolveReceiver = () => {
    if (activeOther?.id) return activeOther.id;
    if (withUserId) return withUserId;
    return null;
  };

  const handleSend = async () => {
    const content = newMessage.trim();
    if (!content || sending) return;
    const receiverId = resolveReceiver();
    if (!receiverId) return;

    const tempId = `temp-${Date.now()}`;
    setSendingMessage({
      id: tempId,
      senderId: user?.id,
      receiverId,
      content,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      pending: true,
    });
    setNewMessage("");
    setSending(true);

    try {
      const res = await client.post("/messages", {
        receiverId,
        content,
        conversationId: activeConvoId || undefined,
      });
      const { message, conversationId } = res.data.data;
      setSendingMessage(null);
      if (!activeConvoId || conversationId !== activeConvoId) {
        setActiveConvoId(conversationId);
        setWithUserId(null);
        setWithUser(null);
        loadMessages(conversationId);
      } else {
        setMessages((prev) => {
          if (prev.some((m) => m.id === message.id)) return prev;
          return [...prev, message];
        });
      }
    } catch {
      setSendingMessage(null);
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const uploadAsset = async (asset) => {
    const receiverId = resolveReceiver();
    if (!receiverId || !asset?.uri) return;

    setUploadingFile(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("file", {
        uri: asset.uri,
        name: asset.fileName || `upload-${Date.now()}.jpg`,
        type: asset.mimeType || "image/jpeg",
      });
      fd.append("receiverId", receiverId);
      fd.append("content", asset.fileName || "Attachment");
      if (activeConvoId) fd.append("conversationId", activeConvoId);

      const res = await client.post("/messages", fd, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });
      const { message, conversationId } = res.data.data;
      if (!activeConvoId || conversationId !== activeConvoId) {
        setActiveConvoId(conversationId);
        setWithUserId(null);
        setWithUser(null);
        loadMessages(conversationId);
      } else {
        setMessages((prev) => {
          if (prev.some((m) => m.id === message.id)) return prev;
          return [...prev, message];
        });
      }
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setUploadingFile(false);
    }
  };

  const pickFromLibrary = async () => {
    const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) return;
    const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.All,
      quality: 0.8,
    });
    if (result.canceled || !result.assets?.[0]) return;
    await uploadAsset(result.assets[0]);
  };

  const pickFromCamera = async () => {
    const perm = await ImagePicker.requestCameraPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) {
      Alert.alert(
        "Camera permission",
        "SkilledProz needs camera access to take live photos.",
      );
      return;
    }
    const result = await ImagePicker.launchCameraAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.All,
      quality: 0.8,
    });
    if (result.canceled || !result.assets?.[0]) return;
    await uploadAsset(result.assets[0]);
  };

  const handlePickFile = () => {
    Alert.alert("Send attachment", "Choose a source", [
      { text: "Take Photo", onPress: pickFromCamera },
      { text: "Choose from Library", onPress: pickFromLibrary },
      { text: "Cancel", style: "cancel" },
    ]);
  };

  const confirmStartCall = async () => {
    const callType = pendingCallType;
    setPendingCallType(null);
    if (!callType || !activeConvoId) return;
    if (isOnCall) return;
    if (initiatingRef.current) return;

    initiatingRef.current = true;
    setStartingCall(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.post(`/voice-calls/${activeConvoId}/initiate`, {
        callType,
      });
      if (callType === "voice") {
        startCall(res.data.data.call);
      } else {
        navigation.navigate("VideoCall", { conversationId: activeConvoId });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert(
        "Call failed",
        err.response?.data?.message || "Could not start call.",
      );
    } finally {
      setStartingCall(false);
      setTimeout(() => {
        initiatingRef.current = false;
      }, 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleScroll = (e) => {
    const { contentOffset, contentSize, layoutMeasurement } = e.nativeEvent;
    const distanceFromBottom =
      contentSize.height - contentOffset.y - layoutMeasurement.height;
    setShowJump(distanceFromBottom > 200);
  };

  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const out = [];
    let lastDate = null;
    for (const m of messages) {
      const dateKey = new Date(m.createdAt).toDateString();
      if (dateKey !== lastDate) {
        out.push({ type: "divider", date: m.createdAt, key: `d-${dateKey}` });
        lastDate = dateKey;
      }
      out.push({ type: "msg", msg: m, key: `m-${m.id}` });
    }
    if (sendingMessage) {
      out.push({
        type: "msg",
        msg: sendingMessage,
        key: `m-${sendingMessage.id}`,
      });
    }
    return out;
  }, [messages, sendingMessage]);

  const otherProfileUrl = activeOther
    ? activeOther.role === "WORKER"
      ? `WorkerProfile:${activeOther.id}`
      : `HirerProfile:${activeOther.id}`
    : null;

  const renderItem = ({ item }) => {
    if (item.type === "divider") {
      return (
        <View style={{ alignItems: "center", marginVertical: 12 }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              color: c.textMuted,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              letterSpacing: 0.6,
            }}
          >
            {formatDateDivider(item.date)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      );
    }

    const msg = item.msg;
    const isMine = msg.senderId === user?.id;
    const isImage =
      msg.fileUrl &&
      (msg.fileUrl.match(/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif)$/i) ||
        msg.fileUrl.includes("image"));
    const isVideo =
      msg.fileUrl &&
      (msg.fileUrl.match(/\.(mp4|mov|webm)$/i) ||
        msg.fileUrl.includes("video"));

    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: isMine ? "row-reverse" : "row",
          alignItems: "flex-end",
          gap: 6,
          marginBottom: 4,
        }}
      >
        {!isMine && (
          <View style={{ width: 28, alignItems: "center" }}>
            <Avatar user={msg.sender} size={28} />
          </View>
        )}
        <View
          style={{
            maxWidth: "72%",
            paddingVertical: 8,
            paddingHorizontal: 12,
            borderRadius: 16,
            backgroundColor: isMine ? c.orange : c.bgPanel,
            borderWidth: isMine ? 0 : 1,
            borderColor: c.border,
            opacity: msg.pending ? 0.6 : 1,
          }}
        >
          {!isMine && msg.sender && (
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.orange,
                marginBottom: 3,
              }}
            >
              {msg.sender.firstName} {msg.sender.lastName}
            </AppText>
          )}

          {isImage && (
            <Pressable onPress={() => setLightboxSrc(msg.fileUrl)}>
              <Image
                source={{ uri: msg.fileUrl }}
                style={{
                  width: 220,
                  height: 220,
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  marginBottom: 4,
                }}
                resizeMode="cover"
              />
            </Pressable>
          )}

          {isVideo && (
            <Video
              source={{ uri: msg.fileUrl }}
              useNativeControls
              style={{
                width: 240,
                height: 160,
                borderRadius: 10,
                marginBottom: 4,
              }}
              resizeMode="contain"
            />
          )}

          {msg.fileUrl && !isImage && !isVideo && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => Linking.openURL(msg.fileUrl)}
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 6,
                padding: 8,
                backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.15)",
                borderRadius: 8,
                marginBottom: 4,
              }}
            >
              <FaPaperclip size={13} color={isMine ? c.bg : c.text} />
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 12, color: isMine ? c.bg : c.text }}
                numberOfLines={1}
              >
                {msg.content || "Attachment"}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}

          {(!msg.fileUrl || (!isImage && !isVideo)) && (
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 14,
                lineHeight: 20,
                color: isMine ? c.bg : c.text,
              }}
            >
              {linkify(msg.content).map((part, idx) =>
                part.url ? (
                  <AppText
                    key={idx}
                    onPress={() => Linking.openURL(part.url)}
                    style={{
                      color: isMine ? "#fff" : c.orange,
                      textDecorationLine: "underline",
                      fontWeight: "500",
                    }}
                  >
                    {part.text}
                  </AppText>
                ) : (
                  <AppText key={idx}>{part.text}</AppText>
                ),
              )}
            </AppText>
          )}

          {!isMine && msg.content && !isImage && !isVideo && (
            <TranslateButton text={msg.content} />
          )}

          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "flex-end",
              marginTop: 2,
            }}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                color: isMine ? "rgba(8,8,16,0.6)" : c.textMuted,
                fontStyle: msg.pending ? "italic" : "normal",
              }}
            >
              {msg.pending ? "sending…" : formatTime(msg.createdAt)}
            </AppText>
            {isMine && (
              <Ticks
                pending={!!msg.pending}
                delivered={!!msg.delivered}
                read={!!msg.isRead}
                color={
                  msg.pending
                    ? "rgba(8,8,16,0.5)"
                    : msg.isRead
                      ? "#3b82f6"
                      : "rgba(8,8,16,0.6)"
                }
              />
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      edges={["top", "bottom"]}
    >
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : "height"}
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 10,
            paddingHorizontal: 12,
            paddingVertical: 10,
            borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
            borderBottomColor: c.border,
            backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
          }}
        >
          <Pressable onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} hitSlop={8}>
            <FaArrowLeft size={18} color={c.textDim} />
          </Pressable>
          {activeOther && <Avatar user={activeOther} size={34} />}
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}
            >
              {activeOther?.firstName} {activeOther?.lastName}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim }}
            >
              {convoMeta?.booking?.title || "Direct message"}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          {otherProfileUrl && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => {
                const [screen, id] = otherProfileUrl.split(":");
                navigation.navigate(screen, { userId: id });
              }}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "600", color: c.orange }}
              >
                Profile →
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={{ flex: 1, position: "relative" }}>
          {loadingMessages ? (
            <View style={{ flex: 1, padding: 16 }}>
              {[
                { mine: false },
                { mine: false },
                { mine: true },
                { mine: false },
                { mine: true },
                { mine: true },
                { mine: false },
              ].map((b, i) => (
                <SkeletonBubble key={i} c={c} mine={b.mine} />
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : messages.length === 0 && !sendingMessage ? (
            <View
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                padding: 24,
              }}
            >
              <FaSmile size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 14,
                  color: c.textDim,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  marginTop: 8,
                }}
              >
                Start the conversation
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}
              >
                Say hello to get things started
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <FlatList
              ref={listRef}
              data={grouped}
              keyExtractor={(it) => it.key}
              renderItem={renderItem}
              contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 24 }}
              onScroll={handleScroll}
              scrollEventThrottle={100}
              onContentSizeChange={() => {
                if (messages.length > 0) {

          {showJump && (

                position: "absolute",

                right: 16,
                width: 40,

          )}

        <View
          style={{
            borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
            borderTopColor: c.border,
            backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
            paddingHorizontal: 12,
            paddingTop: 8,
            paddingBottom: 8,
          }}
        >
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 4, paddingBottom: 6 }}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handlePickFile}
              disabled={uploadingFile}
              style={[
                styles.toolBtn,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
              hitSlop={4}
            >
              {uploadingFile ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.textDim} />
              ) : (
                <FaPaperclip size={14} color={c.textDim} />
              )}
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => !isOnCall && setPendingCallType("voice")}
              disabled={!activeConvoId || startingCall || isOnCall}
              style={[
                styles.toolBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  opacity: !activeConvoId || isOnCall ? 0.4 : 1,
                },
              ]}
              hitSlop={4}
            >
              <FaPhone size={14} color={c.textDim} />
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => !isOnCall && setPendingCallType("video")}
              disabled={!activeConvoId || startingCall || isOnCall}
              style={[
                styles.toolBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  opacity: !activeConvoId || isOnCall ? 0.4 : 1,
                },
              ]}
              hitSlop={4}
            >
              <FaVideo size={14} color={c.textDim} />

          </View>

          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "flex-end",
              gap: 8,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 14,
              paddingHorizontal: 12,
              paddingVertical: 6,
            }}
          >
            <TextInput
              value={newMessage}
              onChangeText={setNewMessage}
              placeholder="Type a message..."
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              multiline
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                color: c.text,
                fontSize: 14,
                maxHeight: 120,
                paddingVertical: 8,
              }}
            />
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleSend}
              disabled={!newMessage.trim() || sending}
              style={{
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                borderRadius: 10,
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                backgroundColor: newMessage.trim() ? c.orange : c.border,

              hitSlop={4}

                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.bg} />

                />

        <Pressable
          style={{

            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",

        >
          <Pressable
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderRadius: 16,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              padding: 20,
              maxWidth: 340,
              width: "100%",
              alignItems: "center",

            <View
              style={{
                width: 52,
                height: 52,
                borderRadius: 26,
                backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                marginBottom: 12,
              }}

              {pendingCallType === "video" ? (
                <FaVideo size={22} color={c.orange} />
              ) : (

              style={{
                fontSize: 15,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.text,

                )}

=== FILE: src/screens/main/CommunityFeedScreen.js ===
// src/screens/main/CommunityFeedScreen.js
//
// Ported verbatim from src/pages/FeedPage.jsx + FeedPage.module.css.
//
// Sidebar hidden on mobile (matches @media max-width: 899px).
// Polling uses AppState instead of document.hidden.
// window.scrollTo → ScrollView ref.

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  RefreshControl,
  useWindowDimensions,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import CreatePost from "../../components/posts/CreatePost";
import PostCard from "../../components/posts/PostCard";
import PostSkeleton from "../../components/posts/PostSkeleton";
import useFeedPolling from "../../hooks/useFeedPolling";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../api/client";
import tracker from "../../lib/tracker";

import { getFeed, createPost } from "../../api/posts";

const FILTERS = [
  { value: "ALL", labelKey: "posts.filterAll" },
  { value: "GENERAL", labelKey: "posts.filterGeneral" },
  {
    value: "HIRING",
    labelKey: "posts.filterHiring",
    icon: "megaphone-outline",
  },
  {
    value: "ACHIEVEMENT",
    labelKey: "posts.filterAchievements",
    icon: "trophy-outline",
  },
  {
    value: "PORTFOLIO",
    labelKey: "posts.filterPortfolio",
    icon: "image-outline",
  },
  { value: "ANNOUNCEMENT", labelKey: "posts.filterAnnouncements" },
];

export default function CommunityFeedScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  const scrollRef = useRef(null);

  const [posts, setPosts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);

  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;

  useEffect(() => {
    tracker.track("page.feed.view", { role: user?.role || "GUEST" });
  }, []);

  const fetchPosts = useCallback(
    async (p = 1, f = filter, reset = false) => {
      if (p === 1) setLoading(true);
      else setLoadingMore(true);
      try {
        const data = await getFeed({
          page: p,
          limit: 15,
          ...(f !== "ALL" && { type: f }),
        });
        const newPosts = data?.posts || [];
        const pages = data?.pages || 1;
        setTotal(data?.total || 0);

        if (reset || p === 1) setPosts(newPosts);
        else setPosts((prev) => [...prev, ...newPosts]);

        setHasMore(p < pages);
        tracker.track("feed.loaded", {
          page: p,
          filter: f,
          count: newPosts.length,
          total: data?.total || 0,
          isLoadMore: p > 1,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        tracker.track("feed.load.failed", {
          page: p,
          filter: f,
          reason: err?.response?.data?.message || "unknown",
        });
        toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || t("posts.loadFailed"));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setLoadingMore(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [filter, toast, t],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1);
    fetchPosts(1, filter, true);
  }, [filter]);

  const { pendingPosts, dismissPending } = useFeedPolling({
    filter,
    currentPosts: posts,
    intervalMs: 25000,
  });

  const showPending = () => {
    if (!pendingPosts.length) return;
    setPosts((prev) => [...pendingPosts, ...prev]);
    setTotal((prev) => prev + pendingPosts.length);
    dismissPending();
    scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y: 0, animated: true });
    tracker.action("feed.newPostsBanner.clicked", {
      pendingCount: pendingPosts.length,
      filter,
    });
  };

  const handleFilterChange = (f) => {
    const prev = filter;
    setFilter(f);
    setPage(1);
    dismissPending();
    tracker.track("feed.filter.changed", { from: prev, to: f });
  };

  const handleLoadMore = () => {
    const next = page + 1;
    setPage(next);
    fetchPosts(next);
    tracker.track("feed.loadMore.clicked", {
      fromPage: page,
      toPage: next,
      filter,
    });
  };

  const handlePostCreated = (newPost) => {
    setPosts((prev) => [newPost, ...prev]);
    setTotal((prev) => prev + 1);
    tracker.action("feed.post.created", {
      postId: newPost?.id || null,
      postType: newPost?.type || null,
      hasImages: (newPost?.images?.length || 0) > 0,
      contentLength: newPost?.content?.length || 0,
    });
  };

  const handlePostDeleted = (postId) => {
    setPosts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== postId));
    setTotal((prev) => prev - 1);
    tracker.action("feed.post.deleted", { postId });
  };

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    fetchPosts(1, filter, true);
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen
      scroll={false}
      contentContainerStyle={{
        paddingHorizontal: 8,
        paddingVertical: 10,
        gap: 8,
      }}
      refreshControl={null}
    >
      <ScrollView
        ref={scrollRef}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
            colors={[c.orange]}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={{
          paddingHorizontal: width <= 640 ? 12 : 16,
          paddingVertical: 14,
          gap: 12,
        }}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {/* New posts banner */}
        {pendingPosts.length > 0 ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={showPending}
            style={({ pressed }) => ({
              alignSelf: "center",
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              backgroundColor: c.orange,
              paddingHorizontal: 16,
              paddingVertical: 8,
              borderRadius: 999,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
              shadowColor: "#000",
              shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 6 },
              shadowOpacity: 0.35,
              shadowRadius: 12,
              elevation: 8,
            })}
          >
            <Ionicons name="arrow-up" size={14} color={c.bg} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                fontSize: rem(0.78),
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.bg,
                marginLeft: 6,
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.newPostsBanner", {
                count: pendingPosts.length,
              })}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}

        <CreatePost onPostCreated={handlePostCreated} compact />

        {/* Filter bar */}
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingBottom: 2 }}
        >
          {FILTERS.map((f) => {
            const active = filter === f.value;
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={f.value}
                onPress={() => handleFilterChange(f.value)}
                style={({ pressed }) => ({
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: active ? c.orangeGlow : c.border,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderRadius: 999,
                  paddingHorizontal: 12,
                  paddingVertical: 5,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                })}
              >
                {f.icon ? (
                  <Ionicons
                    name={f.icon}
                    size={12}
                    color={active ? c.orange : c.textDim}
                    style={{ marginRight: 4 }}
                  />
                ) : null}
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily:
                      theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                    fontSize: rem(0.75),
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  {t(f.labelKey)}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </ScrollView>

        {/* Total count */}
        {!loading ? (
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" }}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                fontSize: rem(0.72),
                color: c.textMuted,
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.postCount", { count: total })}
            </AppText>
            {pendingPosts.length > 0 ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  width: 6,
                  height: 6,
                  borderRadius: 3,
                  backgroundColor: "#22c55e",
                  marginLeft: 6,
                }}
              />
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Feed */}
        {loading ? (
          <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
            <PostSkeleton />
            <PostSkeleton />
            <PostSkeleton />
          </View>
        ) : posts.length === 0 ? (
          <View
            style={{
              alignItems: "center",
              padding: 40,
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 14,
            }}
          >
            <Ionicons name="file-tray-outline" size={32} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.display || "Syne_700Bold",
                fontSize: rem(1),
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.text,
                marginTop: 12,
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.noPostsYet")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                fontSize: rem(0.85),
                color: c.textDim,
                textAlign: "center",
                marginTop: 6,
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.noPostsSub")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
            {posts.map((post) => (
              <PostCard
                key={post.id}
                post={post}
                onDelete={handlePostDeleted}
              />
            ))}

            {hasMore ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleLoadMore}
                disabled={loadingMore}
                style={({ pressed }) => ({
                  backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                  borderColor: pressed ? c.orange : c.border,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  paddingVertical: 14,
                  alignItems: "center",
                  opacity: loadingMore ? 0.5 : 1,
                })}
              >
                {loadingMore ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontFamily:
                        theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                      fontSize: rem(0.875),
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: c.textDim,
                    }}
                  >
                    {t("posts.loadMorePosts")}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

const UNIT_TO_TYPES = {
  hours: { budget: "HOURLY", duration: "HOURS" },
  days: { budget: "DAILY", duration: "DAYS" },
  weeks: { budget: "WEEKLY", duration: "WEEKS" },
  months: { budget: "MONTHLY", duration: "MONTHS" },
  years: { budget: "YEARLY", duration: "YEARLY" },
  custom: { budget: "CUSTOM", duration: "CUSTOM" },
};

function computeFees(agreedRate, qty = 1, currency = "NGN") {
  const subtotal = parseFloat((agreedRate * qty).toFixed(2));
  const rate = getHirerFeeRate(currency);
  const hirerFee = parseFloat((subtotal * rate).toFixed(2));
  const totalToPay = parseFloat((subtotal + hirerFee).toFixed(2));
  return { subtotal, hirerFee, totalToPay, workerGets: subtotal };
}

export default function CreateBookingScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const fromJobId = route.params?.fromJob || null;

  const [worker, setWorker] = useState(null);
  const [workerLoading, setWorkerLoading] = useState(false);
  const [workerError, setWorkerError] = useState("");
  const [jobPost, setJobPost] = useState(null);
  const [selectedUnit, setSelectedUnit] = useState(null);
  const [jobType, setJobType] = useState("FULL_TIME");
  const [locationType, setLocationType] = useState("REMOTE");
  const [budgetType, setBudgetType] = useState("HOURLY");
  const [durationType, setDurationType] = useState("HOURS");
  const [isNegotiated, setIsNegotiated] = useState(false);
  const [negotiatedRate, setNegotiatedRate] = useState("");
  const [negotiationNote, setNegotiationNote] = useState("");
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    workerId: propWorkerId,
    categoryId: "",
    title: "",
    description: "",
    address: "",
    latitude: "",
    longitude: "",
    scheduledAt: "",
    estimatedValue: "",
    notes: "",
    requirements: "",
    responsibilities: "",
    rate: 0,
    customLabel: "",
    quantity: 1,
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [categoryPickerOpen, setCategoryPickerOpen] = useState(false);

  // Date/time picker state
  const [showDatePicker, setShowDatePicker] = useState(false);
  const [showTimePicker, setShowTimePicker] = useState(false);

  const minDate = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000)
    .toISOString()
    .slice(0, 16);

  // Sync budgetType & durationType to selectedUnit
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedUnit && UNIT_TO_TYPES[selectedUnit]) {
      setBudgetType(UNIT_TO_TYPES[selectedUnit].budget);
      setDurationType(UNIT_TO_TYPES[selectedUnit].duration);
    }
  }, [selectedUnit]);

  // Load worker
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = form.workerId?.trim();
    if (!id) {
      setWorker(null);
      return;
    }
    setWorkerLoading(true);
    setWorkerError("");
    client
      .get(`/workers/${id}`)
      .then((res) => {
        const w = res.data.data.worker;
        setWorker(w);
        setForm((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          rate: w.customRate || 0,
          customLabel: w.customRateLabel || "",
        }));
        const available = DURATION_OPTIONS.filter((o) =>
          o.rateKey === "customRate" ? w.customRate > 0 : w[o.rateKey] > 0,
        );
        setSelectedUnit((available[0] || DURATION_OPTIONS[0]).unit);
        const primaryCat =
          w.categories?.find((cc) => cc.isPrimary) || w.categories?.[0];
        if (primaryCat)
          setForm((f) => ({ ...f, categoryId: primaryCat.category.id }));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setWorkerError("Worker not found. Check the ID and try again.");
      })
      .finally(() => setWorkerLoading(false));
  }, [form.workerId]);

  // Load job post
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!fromJobId) return;
    client
      .get(`/jobs/${fromJobId}`)
      .then((res) => {
        const jp = res.data.data.jobPost;
        setJobPost(jp);
        setForm((f) => ({
          ...f,
          categoryId: jp.categoryId || f.categoryId,
          title: jp.title || f.title,
          description: jp.description || f.description,
          address: jp.address || f.address,
          estimatedValue:
            jp.estimatedValue ||
            (jp.estimatedHours ? String(jp.estimatedHours) : f.estimatedValue),
        }));
        if (jp.estimatedUnit) setSelectedUnit(jp.estimatedUnit);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [fromJobId]);

  // Derived
  const isFromJob = !!fromJobId && !!jobPost;
  const currentOption = DURATION_OPTIONS.find((o) => o.unit === selectedUnit);
  const lockedRate = isFromJob
    ? jobPost?.budget || 0
    : worker && currentOption
      ? worker[currentOption.rateKey] || 0
      : 0;
  const lockedCurrency = isFromJob
    ? jobPost?.currency || "USD"
    : worker?.currency || "USD";
  const availableUnits = worker
    ? DURATION_OPTIONS.filter((o) =>
        o.rateKey === "customRate"
          ? worker.customRate > 0
          : worker[o.rateKey] > 0,
      )
    : [];
  const finalRate =
    isNegotiated && negotiatedRate ? parseFloat(negotiatedRate) : lockedRate;
  const estQty = parseFloat(form.estimatedValue) || 1;

  let estFees = null;
  if (selectedUnit === "custom") {
    const customRate = form.rate || worker?.customRate || 0;
    const customQty = form.quantity || 1;
    if (customRate > 0)
      estFees = computeFees(customRate, customQty, lockedCurrency);
  } else if (
    lockedRate > 0 &&
    form.estimatedValue &&
    currentOption?.inputType === "number"
  ) {
    estFees = computeFees(finalRate, estQty, lockedCurrency);
  }

  const set = (key, val) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: val }));
    setError("");
  };

  // ── Date/Time picker handlers ─────────────────────────────────
  const handleDateChange = (event, selectedDate) => {
    // On Android, always close after selection (even on dismiss)
    if (Platform.OS !== "ios") setShowDatePicker(false);
    if (event.type === "dismissed") return;
    if (selectedDate) {
      const current = form.scheduledAt
        ? new Date(form.scheduledAt)
        : new Date(Date.now() + 3600 * 1000);
      current.setFullYear(selectedDate.getFullYear());
      current.setMonth(selectedDate.getMonth());
      current.setDate(selectedDate.getDate());
      // ISO slice for local timezone (not UTC)
      const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
      const str = `${current.getFullYear()}-${pad(
        current.getMonth() + 1,
      )}-${pad(current.getDate())}T${pad(current.getHours())}:${pad(
        current.getMinutes(),
      )}`;
      set("scheduledAt", str);
    }
  };

  const handleTimeChange = (event, selectedTime) => {
    if (Platform.OS !== "ios") setShowTimePicker(false);
    if (event.type === "dismissed") return;
    if (selectedTime) {
      const current = form.scheduledAt
        ? new Date(form.scheduledAt)
        : new Date(Date.now() + 3600 * 1000);
      current.setHours(selectedTime.getHours());
      current.setMinutes(selectedTime.getMinutes());
      const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
      const str = `${current.getFullYear()}-${pad(
        current.getMonth() + 1,
      )}-${pad(current.getDate())}T${pad(current.getHours())}:${pad(
        current.getMinutes(),
      )}`;
      set("scheduledAt", str);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!worker) {
      setError("Please enter a valid Worker ID first.");
      return;
    }
    const required = [
      "workerId",
      "categoryId",
      "title",
      "description",
      ...(locationType !== "REMOTE" ? ["address"] : []),
      "scheduledAt",
    ];
    for (const k of required) {
      if (!form[k]) {
        setError(
          `Please fill in: ${k.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").toLowerCase()}`,
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    if (lockedRate <= 0 && currentOption?.unit !== "custom" && !isNegotiated) {
      setError("This worker has not set a rate for the selected duration.");
      return;
    }
    if (isNegotiated && !negotiatedRate) {
      setError("Please enter the agreed total amount.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      let estimatedHours = null;
      const rawVal = form.estimatedValue
        ? parseFloat(form.estimatedValue)
        : null;
      if (!isNegotiated && rawVal !== null) {
        if (currentOption?.unit === "hours") estimatedHours = rawVal;
        else if (currentOption?.unit === "days") estimatedHours = rawVal * 8;
        else if (currentOption?.unit === "weeks") estimatedHours = rawVal * 40;
        else if (currentOption?.unit === "months")
          estimatedHours = rawVal * 160;
        else if (currentOption?.unit === "years")
          estimatedHours = rawVal * 1920;
      }

      const finalAgreedRate = isNegotiated
        ? parseFloat(negotiatedRate)
        : finalRate;

      let estimatedValueStr = undefined;
      if (isNegotiated) {
        if (selectedUnit === "custom")
          estimatedValueStr = String(form.quantity || 1);
        else
          estimatedValueStr = form.estimatedValue
            ? String(form.estimatedValue)
            : undefined;
      } else if (selectedUnit === "custom") {
        estimatedValueStr = String(form.rate * (form.quantity || 1));
      } else if (form.estimatedValue) {
        estimatedValueStr = String(form.estimatedValue);
      }

      const payload = {
        workerId: form.workerId,
        categoryId: form.categoryId,
        title: form.title,
        description: form.description,
        address: locationType === "REMOTE" ? "Remote" : form.address,
        latitude: form.latitude ? parseFloat(form.latitude) : undefined,
        longitude: form.longitude ? parseFloat(form.longitude) : undefined,
        scheduledAt: form.scheduledAt,
        estimatedHours: estimatedHours ?? undefined,
        estimatedUnit: currentOption?.unit || "hours",
        estimatedValue: estimatedValueStr,
        quantity: selectedUnit === "custom" ? form.quantity || 1 : 1,
        customLabel: form.customLabel || null,
        agreedRate: isNegotiated
          ? parseFloat(negotiatedRate)
          : selectedUnit === "custom"
            ? form.rate
            : finalRate,
        isNegotiated,
        negotiatedRate: isNegotiated ? parseFloat(negotiatedRate) : undefined,
        negotiationNote:
          isNegotiated && negotiationNote ? negotiationNote : undefined,
        currency: lockedCurrency,
        notes: form.notes || undefined,
        jobType: jobType || undefined,
        locationType: locationType || undefined,
        budgetType: budgetType || undefined,
        durationType: durationType || undefined,
        requirements: form.requirements || undefined,
        responsibilities: form.responsibilities || undefined,
      };

      const res = await client.post("/bookings", payload);
      const { booking } = res.data.data;
      navigation.navigate("BookingDetail", { bookingId: booking.id });
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        e.response?.data?.message ||
          "Failed to create booking. Please try again.",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleBack = () => navigation.navigate("Bookings");
  const onBrowseWorkers = () => navigation.navigate("BrowseWorkers");

  // Restricted
  if (user?.role !== "HIRER") {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }} edges={["top"]}>
        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            padding: 24,
            gap: 12,
          }}
        >
          <FaClipboardList size={44} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 20,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              textAlign: "center",
            }}
          >
            Only Hirers Can Post Jobs
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            Workers can accept and complete jobs, but only Hirers can post them.
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                marginTop: 8,
                paddingVertical: 12,
                paddingHorizontal: 24,
                backgroundColor: c.orange,
                borderRadius: 10,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: "#000",
              }}
            >
              Back to Bookings
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      edges={["top", "left", "right"]}
    >
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : "height"}
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
      >
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 60, gap: 14 }}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        >
          {/* Back */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 6,
                alignSelf: "flex-start",
                paddingVertical: 6,
                paddingHorizontal: 12,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 20,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaArrowLeft size={12} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
            >
              Back to Bookings
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>

          {/* Header */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.orange,
                letterSpacing: 1,
                textTransform: "uppercase",
                marginBottom: 4,
              }}
            >
              New Job
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 24,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.text,
                letterSpacing: -0.3,
              }}
            >
              Create Booking
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                color: c.textDim,
                marginTop: 4,
                lineHeight: 18,
              }}
            >
              Fill in the details and the worker will be notified immediately.
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {/* Worker info + pricing */}
          <BookingWorkerInfo
            propWorkerId={propWorkerId}
            worker={worker}
            workerLoading={workerLoading}
            workerError={workerError}
            selectedUnit={selectedUnit}
            setSelectedUnit={setSelectedUnit}
            availableUnits={availableUnits}
            currentOption={currentOption}
            lockedRate={lockedRate}
            lockedCurrency={lockedCurrency}
            isFromJob={isFromJob}
            isNegotiated={isNegotiated}
            setIsNegotiated={setIsNegotiated}
            negotiatedRate={negotiatedRate}
            setNegotiatedRate={setNegotiatedRate}
            negotiationNote={negotiationNote}
            setNegotiationNote={setNegotiationNote}
            estFees={estFees}
            form={form}
            set={set}
            onBrowseWorkers={onBrowseWorkers}
          />

          {/* Form fields */}
          <BookingFormFields
            worker={worker}
            jobType={jobType}
            setJobType={setJobType}
            locationType={locationType}
            setLocationType={setLocationType}
            budgetType={budgetType}
            setBudgetType={setBudgetType}
            durationType={durationType}
            setDurationType={setDurationType}
            form={form}
            set={set}
            minDate={minDate}
            selectedUnit={selectedUnit}
            isNegotiated={isNegotiated}
            onOpenCategoryPicker={() => setCategoryPickerOpen(true)}
            onOpenDatePicker={() => setShowDatePicker(true)}
            onOpenTimePicker={() => setShowTimePicker(true)}
          />

          {/* Error */}
          {error ? (
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 8,
                backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)",
                borderRadius: 12,
                paddingHorizontal: 14,
                paddingVertical: 12,
              }}
            >
              <FaExclamationTriangle size={14} color={c.red} />
              <AppText style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 13, color: c.red }}>
                {error}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {/* Submit */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleSubmit}
            disabled={loading || !worker}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                height: 56,
                backgroundColor: c.orange,
                borderRadius: 999,
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                gap: 10,
                opacity: loading || !worker ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            {loading ? (
              <>
                <Skeleton width={17} height={17} radius={9} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    color: "#000",
                  }}
                >
                  Creating booking…
                </AppText>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <View
                  style={{
                    width: 28,
                    height: 28,
                    borderRadius: 14,
                    borderWidth: 2,
                    borderColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                  }}
                >
                  <FaPlus size={14} color="#000" />
                </View>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    color: "#000",
                  }}
                >
                  Create Booking
                </AppText>
              </>
            )}
          </Pressable>

          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              color: c.textMuted,
              textAlign: "center",
              lineHeight: 16,
              paddingHorizontal: 8,
            }}
          >
            The worker will be notified immediately. Payment is only charged
            after the worker accepts and you approve it.
          </AppText>
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>

      {/* Category picker modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={categoryPickerOpen}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setCategoryPickerOpen(false)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)",
            justifyContent: "center",
            padding: 24,
          }}
          onPress={() => setCategoryPickerOpen(false)}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 14,
              padding: 8,
              maxHeight: 400,
            }}
          >
            <ScrollView>
              {worker?.categories?.map((wc) => {
                const active = form.categoryId === wc.category.id;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={wc.id}
                    onPress={() => {
                      set("categoryId", wc.category.id);
                      setCategoryPickerOpen(false);
                    }}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      {
                        flexDirection: "row",
                        alignItems: "center",
                        gap: 8,
                        paddingHorizontal: 14,
                        paddingVertical: 12,
                        borderRadius: 8,
                        backgroundColor: active
                          ? c.orangeDim
                          : pressed
                            ? c.bgCard
                            : "transparent",
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        flex: 1,
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: active ? "700" : "500",
                        color: active ? c.orange : c.text,
                      }}
                    >
                      {`${wc.category.icon || ""} ${wc.category.name || ""}${
                        wc.isPrimary ? " (Primary)" : ""
                      }`.trim()}
                    </AppText>
                    {active ? <FaCheck size={14} color={c.orange} /> : null}
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>

      {/* ── Date picker (Android: dialog, iOS: inline spinner) ── */}
      {showDatePicker ? (
        <DateTimePicker
          value={
            form.scheduledAt
              ? new Date(form.scheduledAt)
              : new Date(Date.now() + 3600 * 1000)
          }
          mode="date"
          display={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "spinner" : "default"}
          minimumDate={new Date()}
          onChange={handleDateChange}
        />
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Time picker (Android: dialog, iOS: inline spinner) ── */}
      {showTimePicker ? (
        <DateTimePicker
          value={
            form.scheduledAt
              ? new Date(form.scheduledAt)
              : new Date(Date.now() + 3600 * 1000)
          }
          mode="time"
          display={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "spinner" : "default"}
          onChange={handleTimeChange}
          is24Hour={false}
        />
      ) : null}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({});

// src/screens/main/DashboardScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of HirerDashboard.jsx + HirerDashboard.module.css.
//
// Mapping reference:
//   react-icons  →  @expo/vector-icons (Ionicons)
//     FiClipboard      → "clipboard-outline"
//     FiZap            → "flash-outline"
//     FiCheckCircle    → "checkmark-circle-outline"
//     FiCreditCard     → "card-outline"
//     FiStar           → "star" (filled, 12px, #fbbf24)
//     FiPlus           → "add" (16px, color = --bg)
//
// Phone root font-size = 14 (global.css @media 480).
//
// Responsive breakpoints (mirror website media queries):
//   ≥768  → statsGrid 4 cols
//   ≥900  → grid2 2 cols
//   <360  → header stacked; .ctaBtn flex:1 + center; booking/worker rows
//           shrink to padding 8/10
//
// Loading state uses <DashboardSkeleton /> (matches website's shimmer).
//
// Backend: GET /hirers/me/dashboard (via getHirerDashboard)

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  StyleSheet,
  RefreshControl,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import Panel from "../../components/Panel";
import BookingRow from "../../components/BookingRow";
import WorkerRow from "../../components/WorkerRow";
import CurrencyPicker from "../../components/CurrencyPicker";
import DashboardSkeleton from "../../components/DashboardSkeleton";

import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useCurrency } from "../../contexts/CurrencyContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { getHirerDashboard } from "../../api/hirer";

export default function DashboardScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { format } = useCurrency();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  // Breakpoints — mirror website media queries exactly.
  const statsRowSingle = width >= 768;
  const gridTwoCol = width >= 900;
  const headerStacked = width < 360;

  // Stat value clamp — clamp(16px, 3vw, 28px) from website
  const statValueFontSize = Math.min(28, Math.max(16, width * 0.03));

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const result = await getHirerDashboard();
      setData(result);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.networkError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load();
  }, [load]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
        <DashboardSkeleton />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  const stats = data?.stats || {};
  const recentBookings = data?.recentBookings || [];
  const recentWorkers = data?.recentWorkers || [];

  const totalSpent = Number(stats.totalSpent) || 0;
  const inEscrow = Number(stats.inEscrow) || 0;
  const released = Math.max(0, totalSpent - inEscrow);

  const spentFooter =
    inEscrow > 0
      ? `${format(inEscrow)} in escrow · ${format(released)} released`
      : `${format(released)} released`;

  const goPostJob = () => navigation.navigate("PostJob");
  const goAllBookings = () => navigation.navigate("Bookings");
  const goAllWorkers = () => navigation.navigate("SavedWorkers");

  return (
    <AppScreen
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={theme.colors.orange}
          colors={[theme.colors.orange]}
        />
      }
    >
      {/* ══════════ HEADER ══════════ */}
      <View style={[styles.header, headerStacked && styles.headerStacked]}>
        <View style={styles.headerTitleBlock}>
          <AppText style={[styles.eyebrow, { color: theme.colors.orange }]}>
            {t("dashboard.overview")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={[styles.title, { color: theme.colors.text }]}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {t("dashboard.title")}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        <View
          style={[
            styles.headerActions,
            headerStacked && styles.headerActionsStacked,
          ]}
        >
          <CurrencyPicker compact />
          <View
            style={[
              styles.ctaBtn,
              { backgroundColor: theme.colors.orange },
              headerStacked && styles.ctaBtnStacked,
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color={theme.colors.bg} />
            <AppText style={[styles.ctaBtnText, { color: theme.colors.bg }]}>
              {t("dashboard.postAJob")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* ══════════ STATS ══════════ */}
      <View
        style={[styles.statsGrid, statsRowSingle && styles.statsGridSingleRow]}
      >
        <View
          style={[
            styles.statCell,
            statsRowSingle ? styles.statCellSingleRow : styles.statCellTwoCol,
          ]}
        >
          <StatCard
            icon="clipboard-outline"
            label={t("dashboard.totalBookings")}
            value={String(stats.totalBookings ?? 0)}
            fontSize={statValueFontSize}
            color={theme.colors.text}
            bg={theme.colors.bgCard}
            border={theme.colors.border}
          />
        </View>

        <View
          style={[
            styles.statCell,
            statsRowSingle ? styles.statCellSingleRow : styles.statCellTwoCol,
          ]}
        >
          <StatCard
            icon="flash-outline"
            label={t("dashboard.activeJobs")}
            value={String(stats.activeBookings ?? 0)}
            fontSize={statValueFontSize}
            color="#f97316"
            bg="rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.12)"
            border="rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.20)"
          />
        </View>

        <View
          style={[
            styles.statCell,
            statsRowSingle ? styles.statCellSingleRow : styles.statCellTwoCol,
          ]}
        >
          <StatCard
            icon="checkmark-circle-outline"
            label={t("dashboard.completed")}
            value={String(stats.completedBookings ?? 0)}
            fontSize={statValueFontSize}
            color="#22c55e"
            bg="rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.10)"
            border="rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)"
          />
        </View>

        <View
          style={[
            styles.statCell,
            statsRowSingle ? styles.statCellSingleRow : styles.statCellTwoCol,
          ]}
        >
          <StatCard
            icon="card-outline"
            label={t("dashboard.totalSpent")}
            value={format(totalSpent)}
            fontSize={statValueFontSize}
            color={theme.colors.text}
            bg={theme.colors.bgCard}
            border={theme.colors.border}
            footer={spentFooter}
          />
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* ══════════ PANELS ══════════ */}
      <View style={[styles.grid2, gridTwoCol && styles.grid2TwoCol]}>
        {/* Recent Bookings */}
        <View style={styles.grid2Cell}>
          <Panel
            title={t("dashboard.recentBookings")}
            actionLabel={
              recentBookings.length > 0 ? t("dashboard.viewAll") : undefined
            }
            onActionPress={
              recentBookings.length > 0 ? goAllBookings : undefined
            }
          >
            {recentBookings.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon="briefcase-outline"
                text={t("dashboard.noBookingsYet")}
              />
            ) : (
              recentBookings.map((booking, idx) => (
                <BookingRow
                  key={booking.id}
                  booking={booking}
                  showDivider={idx < recentBookings.length - 1}
                  onPress={() =>
                    navigation.navigate("BookingDetail", {
                      bookingId: booking.id,
                    })
                  }
                />
              ))
            )}
          </Panel>
        </View>

        {/* Recent Workers */}
        <View style={styles.grid2Cell}>
          <Panel
            title={t("dashboard.recentWorkers")}
            actionLabel={
              recentWorkers.length > 0 ? t("dashboard.viewAll") : undefined
            }
            onActionPress={recentWorkers.length > 0 ? goAllWorkers : undefined}
          >
            {recentWorkers.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon="people-outline"
                text={t("dashboard.noWorkersYet")}
              />
            ) : (
              recentWorkers.map((worker, idx) => (
                <WorkerRow
                  key={worker.id}
                  worker={worker}
                  showDivider={idx < recentWorkers.length - 1}
                  onPress={() =>
                    navigation.navigate("WorkerProfile", {
                      userId: worker.id,
                    })
                  }
                />
              ))
            )}
          </Panel>
        </View>
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// Mirrors the website's local `StatCard` function in HirerDashboard.jsx
// (which reads its colors from the .statCard/.statCard_{accent} CSS classes).

function StatCard({ icon, label, value, footer, fontSize, color, bg, border }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <View
      style={[styles.statCard, { backgroundColor: bg, borderColor: border }]}
    >
      <Ionicons name={icon} size={24} color={color} style={styles.statIcon} />
      <AppText
        numberOfLines={1}
        adjustsFontSizeToFit
        minimumFontScale={0.5}
        style={[
          styles.statValue,
          { color, fontSize, lineHeight: fontSize * 1.2 },
        ]}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        numberOfLines={1}
        style={[styles.statLabel, { color: theme.colors.textDim }]}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
      {footer ? (
        <AppText
          numberOfLines={2}
          style={[styles.statFooter, { color: theme.colors.textMuted }]}
        >
          {footer}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ icon, text }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <View style={styles.empty}>
      <Ionicons name={icon} size={28} color={theme.colors.textMuted} />
      <AppText
        numberOfLines={3}
        style={[styles.emptyText, { color: theme.colors.textMuted }]}
      >
        {text}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/DisputesScreen.js
//
// Port of pages/disputes/Disputes.jsx + Disputes.module.css.
//
// Preserved verbatim:
//   - STATUS_META (DISPUTED / UNDER_REVIEW / RESOLVED / CANCELLED)
//   - GET /disputes/my (list)
//   - PATCH /disputes/:id/cancel (cancel)
//   - Header stats trio (Total / Active / Resolved)
//   - 5 filter tabs (All / Open / Under Review / Resolved / Cancelled)
//   - Expandable card: card-top → card-body
//   - Detail grid (reason / description / evidence)
//   - Booking details section
//   - Parties row (hirer + worker chips)
//   - Payment info block
//   - Actions: Cancel Dispute (only DISPUTED) + View Booking
//   - Confirmation modal
//   - Image lightbox
//
// Dedupe fix: `filtered` de-duplicates by id, so duplicate server rows can't
// trigger React's "two children with the same key" warning.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import Skeleton from "../../components/Skeleton";

  FaShieldAlt,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaTimesCircle,
