                              <FaHandHoldingHeart size={14} color={c.bg} />
                              <AppText style={styles.applyBtnText(c)}>
                                Apply Now
                              </AppText>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </Pressable>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </View>
                )}

                <Pressable
                  onPress={() =>
                    navigation.navigate("JobDetail", { jobId: job.id })
                  }
                  style={styles.jobViewLink}
                >
                  <AppText style={styles.jobViewLinkText(c)}>
                    View full details →
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              </View>
            ))
          )}
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {tab === "reviews" ? (
        <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
          {reviews.length === 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.emptySection}>
              <FaStar size={32} color={c.textMuted} />
              <AppText style={styles.emptyText(c)}>No reviews yet.</AppText>
            </View>
          ) : (
            reviews.map((r) => (
              <View
                key={r.id}
                style={[
                  styles.reviewCard,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <View style={styles.reviewTop}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.reviewAvatar,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                        borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {r.giver.avatar ? (
                      <Image
                        source={{ uri: r.giver.avatar }}
                        style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <AppText style={styles.reviewAvatarText(c)}>
                        {r.giver.firstName?.[0]}
                        {r.giver.lastName?.[0]}
                      </AppText>
                    )}
                  </View>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <AppText style={styles.reviewName(c)}>
                      {r.giver.firstName} {r.giver.lastName}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText style={styles.reviewDate(c)}>
                      {new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                        day: "numeric",
                        month: "short",
                        year: "numeric",
                      })}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <Stars rating={r.rating} c={c} />
                </View>
                {r.comment && (
                  <AppText style={styles.reviewComment(c)}>
                    "{r.comment}"
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
            ))
          )}
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/InitiatePaymentScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of components/payment/InitiatePayment.jsx.
//
// Four render branches (in this order):
//   1. loading               → <PageSkeleton variant="form" />
//   2. error && !booking     → error card
//   3. bookingStatus PENDING → polling "Waiting for Worker" card
//   4. default               → method-selection form
//
// Navigate here from BookingDetail with { bookingId } as route params.
// On successful card checkout, `Linking.openURL(paystackUrl)` opens the
// device browser; the backend returns the user to the app via the
// callbackUrl you pass (set to a deep link in the app, or leave blank and
// let the user return manually).

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Linking,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import PageSkeleton from "../../components/PageSkeleton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../api/client";
import { calcPricing, getHirerFeeRate } from "../../utils/pricing";
import {
  FaArrowLeft,
  FaCreditCard,
  FaBitcoin,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaLock,
  FaShieldAlt,
  FaUser,
  FaCalendarAlt,
  FaMapMarkerAlt,
  FaGift,
  FaBriefcase,
} from "../../icons/fa";

import PaymentOptions from "../../components/booking/PaymentOptions";
import { ReferralSlider } from "../../components/booking/BookingDetailPayment";

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtMoney(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const n = Number(amount) || 0;
  return `${currency} ${n.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

const METHODS = [
  {
    id: "card",
    icon: "card",
    label: "Card / Mobile Money",
    desc: "Redirected to Flutterwave or Paystack",
  },
  {
    id: "crypto",
    icon: "bitcoin",
    label: "Crypto",
    desc: "USDC · USDT · BTC · ETH",
  },
];

// ── Screen ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function InitiatePaymentScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const bookingId = route.params?.bookingId;

  const [booking, setBooking] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [paying, setPaying] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [method, setMethod] = useState("card");
  const [bookingStatus, setBookingStatus] = useState(null);

  const [walletBalance, setWalletBalance] = useState(0);
  const [referralPercent, setReferralPercent] = useState(0);
  const [referralAmount, setReferralAmount] = useState(0);
  const [referralApplied, setReferralApplied] = useState(false);

  const pollRef = useRef(null);

  // ── Fetch booking on mount ──────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!bookingId) return;
    client
      .get(`/bookings/${bookingId}`)
      .then((res) => {
        const b = res.data?.data?.booking || res.data?.data || null;
        setBooking(b);
        setBookingStatus(b?.status ?? null);
      })
      .catch(() => setError("Could not load booking details."))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [bookingId]);

  // ── Fetch referral wallet ───────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!booking) return;
    client
      .get("/referral/wallet")
      .then((res) => setWalletBalance(Number(res.data?.data?.balance) || 0))
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [booking]);

  // ── Poll while PENDING ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (bookingStatus !== "PENDING") return;
    pollRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      client
        .get(`/bookings/${bookingId}`)
        .then((res) => {
          const b = res.data?.data?.booking || res.data?.data || null;
          setBooking(b);
          setBookingStatus(b?.status ?? null);
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }, 8000);
    return () => {
      if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);
    };
  }, [bookingId, bookingStatus]);

  // ── Pricing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const p = booking ? calcPricing(booking) : null;
  const isJobPostBooking = booking?.source === "JOB_POST";

  const handlePercentChange = useCallback(
    (pct) => {
      if (!p) return;
      const subtotal = p.subtotal || 0;
      const maxDiscount = Math.min(subtotal, walletBalance);
      const amount = Math.round((pct / 100) * subtotal);
      const final = Math.min(amount, maxDiscount);
      setReferralPercent(pct);
      setReferralAmount(final);
      setReferralApplied(final > 0);
    },
    [p, walletBalance],
  );

  const handleReferralToggle = () => {
    if (referralAmount === 0) return;
    setReferralApplied((v) => !v);
  };

  // ── Card payment ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleCardPay() {
    setPaying(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const res = await client.post(`/payments/initiate/${bookingId}`, {
        referralAmount: referralApplied ? referralAmount : 0,
      });
      const data = res.data?.data || res.data || {};

      // Already paid
      if (data.alreadyPaid) {
        toast.info("Payment already in escrow.");
        return;
      }

      // Paystack
      if (data.authorizationUrl) {
        await Linking.openURL(data.authorizationUrl);
        return;
      }

      // Stripe Checkout — create a session and open it
      if (data.clientSecret) {
        const checkout = await client.post(
          `/payments/initiate-checkout/${bookingId}`,
          {
            referralAmount: referralApplied ? referralAmount : 0,
          },
        );
        const url = checkout.data?.data?.url;
        if (url) await Linking.openURL(url);
        return;
      }

      toast.error("Payment URL not received. Try again.");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.message || "Payment initiation failed.");
    } finally {
      setPaying(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Method dispatch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function handlePrimary() {
    if (method === "card") return handleCardPay();
    // Crypto is handled inline by <PaymentOptions> further down.
    toast.info("Choose a crypto asset to continue below.");
  }

  // ── Guards ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}>
        <PageSkeleton variant="form" />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (error && !booking) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.center, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
        <FaExclamationTriangle size={40} color={c.red} />
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 12 }}>
          {error}
        </AppText>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          style={[styles.backBtn, { borderColor: c.border, marginTop: 16 }]}
        >
          <FaArrowLeft size={12} color={c.textDim} />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, marginLeft: 6 }}>
            Back to Bookings
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ── PENDING state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (bookingStatus === "PENDING") {
    return (
      <ScrollView
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
      >
        {/* Back + badge */}
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
            style={styles.backLink}
          >
            <FaArrowLeft size={12} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, marginLeft: 4 }}>
              View Booking
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.payBadge,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
            >
              ⏳ Pending Acceptance
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Summary */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.summaryCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: c.textMuted,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              letterSpacing: 1,
            }}
          >
            Booking created
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              marginTop: 4,
            }}
          >
            {booking?.title}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.orange,
              fontWeight: "600",
              marginTop: 2,
            }}
          >
            {booking?.worker?.firstName} {booking?.worker?.lastName} ·{" "}
            {booking?.category?.name}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Preview breakdown */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.breakdownCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.textMuted,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              letterSpacing: 1,
              marginBottom: 10,
            }}
          >
            Payment Preview
          </AppText>
          {renderBreakdownRows(
            p,
            isJobPostBooking,
            booking,
            referralApplied,
            referralAmount,
            c,
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Waiting spinner */}
        <View style={{ alignItems: "center", paddingVertical: 24 }}>
          <ActivityIndicator color="#eab308" size="large" />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: "#eab308",
              marginTop: 12,
            }}
          >
            Waiting for Worker
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.textDim,
              marginTop: 6,
              textAlign: "center",
              maxWidth: 300,
              lineHeight: 18,
            }}
          >
            Once they accept, you'll be able to complete payment here. This page
            checks every 8 seconds.
          </AppText>
        </View>

        <Pressable
          onPress={async () => {
            try {
              const r = await client.get(`/bookings/${bookingId}`);
              const b = r.data?.data?.booking || r.data?.data || null;
              setBooking(b);
              setBookingStatus(b?.status ?? null);
            } catch {}
          }}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.payBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.textDim }}
          >
            🔄 Check for Updates
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          style={{ paddingVertical: 12, alignItems: "center" }}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.textMuted,
              textDecorationLine: "underline",
            }}
          >
            View booking details while you wait →
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }

  // ── Main method selection ───────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <ScrollView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
    >
      {/* Back + Secure badge */}
      <View style={styles.headerRow}>
        <Pressable onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} style={styles.backLink}>
          <FaArrowLeft size={12} color={c.textDim} />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, marginLeft: 4 }}>
            Back to Booking
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.payBadge,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
          ]}
        >
          <FaLock size={10} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.orange,
              marginLeft: 4,
            }}
          >
            Secure Payment
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Summary */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.summaryCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 10,
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.textMuted,
            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 1,
          }}
        >
          You're paying for
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
            fontSize: 18,
            fontWeight: "800",
            color: c.text,
            marginTop: 4,
          }}
        >
          {booking?.title}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 12,
            color: c.orange,
            fontWeight: "600",
            marginTop: 2,
          }}
        >
          {booking?.category?.name}
        </AppText>

        {isJobPostBooking ? (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.jobPostNote,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.08)",
                borderColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.25)",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaBriefcase size={12} color="#818cf8" style={{ marginTop: 1 }} />
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 6 }}>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: "#818cf8",
                  textTransform: "uppercase",
                  letterSpacing: 0.6,
                }}
              >
                From Job Post
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: c.textDim,
                  marginTop: 2,
                  lineHeight: 16,
                }}
              >
                This booking was created from a job post. The final amount is
                the rate you selected on the booking creation page.
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <View style={{ marginTop: 12, gap: 6 }}>
          <MetaRow
            icon={<FaUser size={12} color={c.textDim} />}
            text={`${booking?.worker?.firstName} ${booking?.worker?.lastName}`}
            c={c}
          />
          <MetaRow
            icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={12} color={c.textDim} />}
            text={new Date(booking?.scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
              weekday: "short",
              day: "numeric",
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
            c={c}
          />
          {booking?.address ? (
            <MetaRow
              icon={<FaMapMarkerAlt size={12} color={c.textDim} />}
              text={booking.address}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Referral slider — NGN only, wallet > 0 */}
      {walletBalance > 0 && booking?.currency === "NGN" ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.referralBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}>
            <FaGift size={13} color={c.green} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.text,
                flex: 1,

            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.orange,
                minWidth: 44,
              }}
            >
              {referralPercent}%
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.text,
                flex: 1,
                textAlign: "right",
              }}
            >
              {fmtMoney(referralAmount, "NGN")}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleReferralToggle}
              disabled={referralAmount === 0}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                {
                  paddingHorizontal: 12,
                  paddingVertical: 4,
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: referralApplied ? c.orange : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: referralApplied ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                  opacity: referralAmount === 0 ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}

              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: referralApplied ? "#fff" : c.textDim,
                }}
              >
                {referralApplied ? "Remove" : "Apply"}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

          isJobPostBooking,

              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.textDim,

              marginLeft: 6,

            }}

            Funds are held in escrow and only released to the worker after you

          </AppText>

        style={[
          styles.breakdownCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },

        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: "700",

            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 1,
            marginBottom: 10,
          }}
        >

        </AppText>

        {METHODS.map((m) => {
          const active = method === m.id;

                  style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 1 }}

            {error}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* Primary CTA — only for card (crypto has its own button inside <PaymentOptions>) */}
      {method === "card" ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={handlePrimary}
          disabled={paying}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.payBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: paying ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
              opacity: paying ? 0.7 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,

          ]}
        >
          {paying ? (
            <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
          ) : (
            <View
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}
            >
              <FaCreditCard size={13} color="#fff" />

                style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}

            </View>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}

      {/* Disclaimer */}
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 11,
          color: c.textMuted,
          textAlign: "center",
          lineHeight: 15,
        }}
      >
        Powered by Flutterwave & Paystack · Escrow protected · Refund policy
        applies
      </AppText>

      {/* Trust row */}
      <View style={styles.trustRow}>
        <AppText style={[styles.trustItem, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          🔒 256-bit SSL
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={[styles.trustItem, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          🛡️ Escrow protected
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={[styles.trustItem, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          🦋 Flutterwave
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={[styles.trustItem, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          💚 Paystack
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

// ── Helper: breakdown rows (shared by PENDING and default branches) ───
function renderBreakdownRows(
  p,
  isJobPostBooking,
  booking,
  referralApplied,
  referralAmount,
  c,
) {
  if (!p) return null;
  const currency = p.currency || booking?.currency || "NGN";
  const feePct = Math.round(getHirerFeeRate(currency) * 100);

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
      <BR
        label={isJobPostBooking ? "Agreed Total" : "Agreed Rate"}
        value={`${fmtMoney(p.agreedRate, currency)}${!isJobPostBooking ? p.unitSuffix || "" : ""}`}
        c={c}
      />
      {isJobPostBooking && booking?.estimatedValue ? (
        <BR
          label="Duration"
          value={`${booking.estimatedValue} ${booking.estimatedUnit || "hours"}${
            booking.estimatedHours ? ` (≈ ${booking.estimatedHours}h)` : ""
          }`}
          c={c}
        />
      ) : null}
      {!isJobPostBooking && p.hasQty ? (
        <>
          <BR
            label="Duration"
            value={`${p.qty} ${p.unitLabel}${p.qty !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
            c={c}
          />
          <BR
            label={`Job Value (${p.qty} × ${fmtMoney(p.agreedRate, currency)})`}
            value={fmtMoney(p.subtotal, currency)}
            c={c}
          />
        </>
      ) : null}
      <BR
        label={`Service Fee (${feePct}%)`}
        value={`+ ${fmtMoney(p.hirerFee, currency)}`}
        c={c}
      />
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
        }}
      >
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
          <FaCheckCircle size={10} color={c.green} />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.green }}>
            Worker receives (no fee)
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, fontWeight: "600" }}>
          {fmtMoney(p.workerPayout, currency)}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      {referralApplied && referralAmount > 0 ? (
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
          }}
        >
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
            <FaGift size={10} color={c.green} />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.green }}>
              Referral bonus
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, fontWeight: "600" }}>
            − {fmtMoney(referralAmount, currency)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <View
        style={{ height: 1, backgroundColor: c.border, marginVertical: 4 }}
      />
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
          You Pay
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
            fontSize: 18,
            fontWeight: "800",
            color: c.orange,
          }}
        >
          {fmtMoney(
            p.grossTotal - (referralApplied ? referralAmount : 0),
            currency,
          )}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/JobApplicationsScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of pages/hirer/JobApplications.jsx.
//
// Endpoints:
//   GET   /jobs/:id
//   GET   /jobs/:id/applications
//   PATCH /jobs/:id/applications/:appId/status     (accept / reject)
//   PATCH /jobs/:id/applications/:appId/unaccept   (undo accept)
//   PATCH /jobs/:id/applications/:appId/reconsider (reject → pending)
//   POST  /interviews                              (create video room)
//
// Job stays OPEN after accepting an application — bookings are the
// formal contract. This matches web behaviour exactly.
//
// InterviewCallButton:
//   · If ../video/InterviewCallButton exists, uses it.
//   · Otherwise, renders an inline fallback with the SAME three buttons
//     as the web component: Start Interview, Message Link, Copy Link.

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  Linking,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";

// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Stars({ rating = 0, total = 5, c }) {
  const rounded = Math.round(rating);
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 1 }}>
      {Array.from({ length: total }).map((_, i) =>
        i < rounded ? (
          <FaStar key={i} size={10} color={c.orange} />
        ) : (
          <FaRegStar key={i} size={10} color={c.textMuted} />
        ),
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const APP_STATUS = {
  PENDING: {
    label: "Pending",

};

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Inline InterviewCallButton (verbatim web behaviour)
// Renders:
//   · Start Interview    → POST /interviews → open Jitsi
//   · Message Link       → copy invite text + open Chat with prefilled
//   · Copy Link          → clipboard + toast
// Once a room exists, all three stay visible AND a "Room ready" pill
// is shown beneath them.
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function InlineInterviewCallButton({
  jobPostId,
  workerId,
  workerName,
  jobTitle,
  navigation,
  c,
}) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [room, setRoom] = useState(null); // { roomUrl, roomName, callId }
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const inviteText = useMemo(() => {
    if (!room) return "";
    return (
      `Hi ${workerName || "there"}, I'd like to interview you for "${jobTitle || "the role"}". ` +
      `Join my video room here: ${room.roomUrl}`
    );
  }, [room, workerName, jobTitle]);

  async function handleStartInterview() {
    // If room already exists → just reopen it
    if (room?.roomUrl) {
      Linking.openURL(room.roomUrl).catch(() =>
        toast.error("Couldn't open the video room."),
      );
      return;
    }
    if (!workerId || !jobPostId) return;
    setCreating(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const res = await client.post("/interviews", {
        jobPostId,
        workerId,
        title: jobTitle,
      });
      const data = res?.data?.data?.call || res?.data?.data;
      const roomUrl =
        data?.roomUrl ||
        data?.meetingUrl ||
        data?.jitsiUrl ||
        (data?.roomName ? `https://meet.jit.si/${data.roomName}` : null);
      if (!roomUrl) {
        throw new Error("No room URL returned");
      }
      setRoom({
        roomUrl,
        roomName: data?.roomName || roomUrl.split("/").pop(),
        callId: data?.id,
      });
      await Linking.openURL(roomUrl).catch(() => {});
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err?.response?.data?.message ||
          "Failed to start interview. Please try again.",
      );
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleMessageLink() {
    if (!room?.roomUrl) {
      // If no room yet → create first, then navigate to chat
      await handleStartInterview();
      // fallthrough: navigation should still happen after room is set
    }
    const text = room?.roomUrl
      ? inviteText
      : `Hi ${workerName || "there"}, I'd like to interview you for "${jobTitle || "the role"}". I'll send a video link shortly.`;
    if (navigation) {
      navigation.navigate("Chat", {
        userId: workerId,
        prefillMessage: text,
      });
    }
  }

  async function handleCopyLink() {
    if (!room?.roomUrl) {
      toast.info("Start the interview first to get a room link.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      await Clipboard.setStringAsync(room.roomUrl);
      toast.success("Room link copied to clipboard.");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to copy link.");
    }
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.interviewButtons}>
      {/* Start Interview — primary */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={handleStartInterview}
        disabled={creating}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.interviewBtnPrimary,
          {
            backgroundColor: c.orange,
            opacity: creating ? 0.6 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {creating ? (
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.bg} />
        ) : (
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 5 }}>
            <FaVideo size={12} color={c.bg} />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}>
              {room ? "Rejoin Interview" : "Start Interview"}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </Pressable>

      {/* Message Link — secondary */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={handleMessageLink}
        disabled={creating}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.interviewBtnSecondary,
          {
            borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
            backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
            opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <FaCommentDots size={11} color={c.orange} />
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: "700",
            color: c.orange,
            marginLeft: 5,
          }}
        >
          Message Link
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* Copy Link — tertiary ghost */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={handleCopyLink}
        disabled={creating || !room}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.interviewBtnTertiary,
          {
            borderColor: c.border,
            opacity: !room ? 0.45 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <FaCopy size={10} color={c.textDim} />
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.textDim,
            marginLeft: 5,
          }}
        >
          Copy Link
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* Room-ready indicator */}
      {room ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.roomReadyPill,
            { backgroundColor: c.greenDim, borderColor: c.green },
          ]}
        >
          <FaCheckCircle size={9} color={c.green} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: c.green,
              marginLeft: 4,
            }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            Room ready · {room.roomName}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* Error */}
      {error ? (
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 10,
            color: c.red,
            marginTop: 4,
            width: "100%",
          }}
        >
          {error}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// Wrapper that prefers the real component when available
function InterviewCallButton(props) {
  if (RealInterviewCallButton) {
    return <RealInterviewCallButton {...props} />;
  }
  return <InlineInterviewCallButton {...props} />;
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MAIN
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export default function JobApplicationsScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const jobId = route.params?.jobId;

  const [job, setJob] = useState(null);
  const [applications, setApplications] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");
  const [lightboxSrc, setLightboxSrc] = useState(null);
  const [undoTarget, setUndoTarget] = useState(null);

  // ── Fetch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchAll = useCallback(
    async (isRefresh = false) => {
      if (!jobId) return;
      if (!isRefresh) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const [jobRes, appsRes] = await Promise.all([
          client.get(`/jobs/${jobId}`),
          client.get(`/jobs/${jobId}/applications`),
        ]);
        setJob(jobRes?.data?.data?.jobPost || jobRes?.data?.data);
        setApplications(appsRes?.data?.data?.applications || []);
      } catch (err) {
        setError("Failed to load applications.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [jobId],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAll(false);
  }, [fetchAll]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    fetchAll(true);
  };

  // ── Decisions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleDecision = async (applicationId, status) => {
    setUpdating(applicationId);
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
    try {
      await client.patch(
        `/jobs/${jobId}/applications/${applicationId}/status`,
        { status },
      );
      setApplications((prev) =>
        prev.map((a) => (a.id === applicationId ? { ...a, status } : a)),
      );
      setSuccess(
        status === "ACCEPTED"
          ? "Application accepted! You can now create a booking for this worker. The job stays open for more hires."
          : "Application rejected.",
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to update application.");
    } finally {
      setUpdating(null);
    }
  };

  // ── Undo acceptance ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleUnaccept = async ({ applicationId, hasBooking }) => {
    setUpdating(applicationId);
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
    try {
      await client.patch(
        `/jobs/${jobId}/applications/${applicationId}/unaccept`,
      );
      setApplications((prev) =>
        prev.map((a) =>
          a.id === applicationId ? { ...a, status: "PENDING" } : a,
        ),
      );
      setJob((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: "OPEN" }));
      setSuccess(
        hasBooking
          ? "Acceptance undone. The application is back in Pending Review and the job is open again. The existing booking was not affected."
          : "Acceptance undone. The application is back in Pending Review and the job is open again.",
      );
      setUndoTarget(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err?.response?.data?.message ||
          "Failed to undo. Please try again or contact support.",
      );
    } finally {
      setUpdating(null);
    }
  };

  // ── Reconsider rejection ──────────────────────────────────────
  const handleReconsider = async (applicationId) => {
    setUpdating(applicationId);
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
    try {
      await client.patch(
        `/jobs/${jobId}/applications/${applicationId}/reconsider`,
      );
      setApplications((prev) =>
        prev.map((a) =>
          a.id === applicationId ? { ...a, status: "PENDING" } : a,
        ),
      );
      setSuccess(
        "Application moved back to Pending Review. You can accept, decline, or interview the worker again.",
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err?.response?.data?.message ||
          "Failed to reconsider. Please try again.",
      );
    } finally {
      setUpdating(null);
    }
  };

  // ── Derived ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const pending = useMemo(
    () => applications.filter((a) => a.status === "PENDING"),
    [applications],
  );
  const accepted = useMemo(
    () => applications.filter((a) => a.status === "ACCEPTED"),
    [applications],
  );
  const declined = useMemo(
    () => applications.filter((a) => a.status === "REJECTED"),
    [applications],
  );
  const decided = useMemo(
    () => applications.filter((a) => a.status !== "PENDING"),
    [applications],
  );

  // ── Loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <PageSkeleton variant="detail" />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <AppScreen
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
    >
      {/* Back */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => navigation.navigate("JobsManagement")}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.backBtn,
          { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
        ]}
      >
        <FaArrowLeft size={11} color={c.textDim} />
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, marginLeft: 6 }}>
          Back to Jobs
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* ── Job summary ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {job ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.jobSummary,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.summaryLeft}>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.summaryIcon,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
              ]}
            >
              {job.category?.icon ? (
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>{job.category.icon}</AppText>
              ) : (
                <FaClipboardList size={18} color={c.orange} />
              )}
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
                  fontSize: 15,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.text,
                }}
                numberOfLines={2}
              >
                {job.title}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 3 }}
                numberOfLines={2}
              >
                {job.category?.name} · {job.address} ·{" "}
                {new Date(job.scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                  day: "numeric",
                  month: "short",
                  year: "numeric",
                })}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Stats grid */}
          <View style={styles.summaryStats}>
            <SummaryStat
              value={applications.length}
              label="Total"
              color={c.orange}
              c={c}
            />
            <SummaryStat
              value={pending.length}
              label="Pending"
              color={c.orange}
              c={c}
            />
            <SummaryStat
              value={accepted.length}
              label="Accepted"
              color={c.green}
              c={c}
            />
            <SummaryStat
              value={declined.length}
              label="Declined"
              color={c.red}
              c={c}
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Alerts ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {error ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setError("")}
          style={[
            styles.alertBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.redDim, borderColor: c.red },
          ]}
        >
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={12} color={c.red} />
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.red, flex: 1, marginLeft: 6 }}
          >
            {error}
          </AppText>
          <AppText style={{ color: c.red, fontSize: 16 }}>×</AppText>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
      {success ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setSuccess("")}
          style={[
            styles.alertBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.greenDim, borderColor: c.green },
          ]}
        >
          <FaCheckCircle size={12} color={c.green} />
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, flex: 1, marginLeft: 6 }}
          >
            {success}
          </AppText>
          <AppText style={{ color: c.green, fontSize: 16 }}>×</AppText>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Applications ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {applications.length === 0 ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.empty,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <FaInbox size={40} color={c.textMuted} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 17,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              marginTop: 12,
            }}
          >
            No applications yet
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: c.textDim,
              marginTop: 6,
              textAlign: "center",
              lineHeight: 18,
              maxWidth: 320,
            }}
          >
            Workers haven't applied to this job yet. Share it to get more
            visibility.
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Pending */}
          {pending.length > 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.section}>
              <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <AppText style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: c.textDim }]}>
                  Pending Review
                </AppText>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.sectionCount,
                    { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: c.orange,
                    }}
                  >
                    {pending.length}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
              {pending.map((app) => (
                <ApplicationCard
                  key={app.id}
                  app={app}
                  jobId={jobId}
                  jobTitle={job?.title}
                  updating={updating}
                  onAccept={() => handleDecision(app.id, "ACCEPTED")}
                  onReject={() => handleDecision(app.id, "REJECTED")}
                  onReconsider={() => handleReconsider(app.id)}
                  onUnacceptRequest={() =>
                    setUndoTarget({
                      applicationId: app.id,
                      workerName:
                        `${app.worker?.firstName || ""} ${app.worker?.lastName || ""}`.trim(),
                      hasBooking: !!app.latestBooking,
                    })
                  }
                  onAvatarClick={setLightboxSrc}
                  onViewProfile={() =>
                    navigation.navigate("Profile", {
                      userId: app.worker?.id,
                    })
                  }
                  navigation={navigation}
                  c={c}
                />
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {/* Decided */}
          {decided.length > 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.section}>
              <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <AppText style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: c.textDim }]}>
                  Reviewed
                </AppText>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.sectionCount,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: c.textDim,
                    }}
                  >
                    {decided.length}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
              {decided.map((app) => (
                <ApplicationCard
                  key={app.id}
                  app={app}
                  jobId={jobId}
                  jobTitle={job?.title}
                  updating={updating}
                  decided
                  onReconsider={() => handleReconsider(app.id)}
                  onUnacceptRequest={() =>
                    setUndoTarget({
                      applicationId: app.id,
                      workerName:
                        `${app.worker?.firstName || ""} ${app.worker?.lastName || ""}`.trim(),
                      hasBooking: !!app.latestBooking,
                    })
                  }
                  onAvatarClick={setLightboxSrc}
                  onViewProfile={() =>
                    navigation.navigate("Profile", {
                      userId: app.worker?.id,
                    })
                  }
                  navigation={navigation}
                  c={c}
                />
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </>
      )}

      {/* ── Undo confirmation modal ─────────────────────────────── */}
      <Modal
        visible={!!undoTarget}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setUndoTarget(null)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={styles.modalBackdrop}
          onPress={() => setUndoTarget(null)}
        >
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.modalCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <View
              style={[
                styles.modalIcon,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                  borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.3)",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <FaUndo size={26} color={c.red} />
            </View>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 17,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.text,
                textAlign: "center",
                marginBottom: 8,
              }}
            >
              Undo this acceptance?
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                color: c.textDim,
                lineHeight: 18,
                textAlign: "center",
                marginBottom: 16,
              }}
            >
              This will return{" "}
              <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
                {undoTarget?.workerName || "the worker"}
              </AppText>
              's application to Pending Review and set the job back to Open. You
              can accept a different applicant, or accept this worker again
              afterwards.
              {undoTarget?.hasBooking ? (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
                    The existing booking with this worker will not be affected
                  </AppText>{" "}
                  — you can still view, cancel, or manage it from the booking
                  detail page.
                </>
              ) : null}
            </AppText>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setUndoTarget(null)}
                disabled={updating === undoTarget?.applicationId}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.modalBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: "transparent",
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.textDim }}
                >
                  Keep it
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => handleUnaccept(undoTarget)}
                disabled={updating === undoTarget?.applicationId}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.modalBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.red,
                    opacity:
                      updating === undoTarget?.applicationId
                        ? 0.5
                        : pressed
                          ? 0.9
                          : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {updating === undoTarget?.applicationId ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <View
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      alignItems: "center",
                      gap: 4,
                    }}
                  >
                    <FaUndo size={11} color="#fff" />
                    <AppText
                      style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: "#fff" }}
                    >
                      Undo Acceptance
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                )}
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>

      {/* ── Full-screen avatar lightbox ─────────────────────────── */}
      <Modal
        visible={!!lightboxSrc}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setLightboxSrc(null)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={styles.lightboxBackdrop}
          onPress={() => setLightboxSrc(null)}
        >
          <Pressable
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{ width: "90%", maxWidth: 500, alignItems: "center" }}
          >
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setLightboxSrc(null)}
              style={styles.lightboxClose}
            >
              <FaTimes size={18} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
            {lightboxSrc ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: lightboxSrc }}
                style={{ width: "100%", height: 400, borderRadius: 12 }}
                resizeMode="contain"
              />
            ) : null}
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// ── Summary stat ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SummaryStat({ value, label, color, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.summaryStatCol}>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 20,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color,
        }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 9,
          fontWeight: "700",
          color: c.textMuted,
          marginTop: 2,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          letterSpacing: 0.4,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Application card
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function ApplicationCard({
  app,
  jobId,
  jobTitle,
  updating,
  onAccept,
  onReject,
  onReconsider,
  onUnacceptRequest,
  onAvatarClick,
  onViewProfile,
  navigation,
  decided,
  c,
}) {
  const { worker } = app;
  const wp = worker?.workerProfile;
  const statusInfo = APP_STATUS[app.status] || APP_STATUS.PENDING;
  const StatusIcon = statusInfo.icon;
  const hasAvatar = !!worker?.avatar;

  const latestBooking = app.latestBooking || null;
  const hasBooking = !!latestBooking;
  const bookingId = latestBooking?.id || null;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.appCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Worker info */}
      <View style={styles.appTop}>
        <View style={styles.workerLeft}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => hasAvatar && onAvatarClick?.(worker.avatar)}
            disabled={!hasAvatar}
            style={[
              styles.workerAvatar,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
            ]}
          >
            {hasAvatar ? (
              <>
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: worker.avatar }}
                  style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
                />
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.avatarExpandBadge,
                    { backgroundColor: c.orange, borderColor: c.bgPanel },
                  ]}
                >
                  <FaExpand size={7} color="#fff" />
                </View>
              </>
            ) : (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
              >
                {worker?.firstName?.[0]}
                {worker?.lastName?.[0]}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </Pressable>
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}>
              {worker?.firstName} {worker?.lastName}
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim }}>
              {wp?.title || "Worker"}
            </AppText>
            {worker?.city || worker?.country ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: 3,
                  marginTop: 2,
                }}
              >
                <FaMapMarkerAlt size={9} color={c.textMuted} />
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>
                  {[worker.city, worker.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </View>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.statusBadge,
            { backgroundColor: statusInfo.bg, borderColor: statusInfo.color },
          ]}
        >
          <StatusIcon size={10} color={statusInfo.color} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 9,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: statusInfo.color,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              letterSpacing: 0.3,
              marginLeft: 3,
            }}
          >
            {statusInfo.label}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Worker stats */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.workerStats,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        {wp?.avgRating > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.workerStatItem}>
            <Stars rating={wp.avgRating} c={c} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.text,
                marginLeft: 4,
              }}
            >
              {wp.avgRating.toFixed(1)}
            </AppText>
            {wp.totalReviews > 0 ? (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 3 }}
              >
                ({wp.totalReviews})
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}
        {wp?.completedJobs > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.workerStatItem}>
            <FaBriefcase size={9} color={c.textMuted} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.text,
                marginLeft: 3,
              }}
            >
              {wp.completedJobs} jobs
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        {wp?.hourlyRate ? (
          <View style={styles.workerStatItem}>
            <FaMoneyBillWave size={9} color={c.textMuted} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.text,
                marginLeft: 3,
              }}
            >
              {wp.currency} {wp.hourlyRate.toLocaleString()}/hr
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        {wp?.yearsExperience > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.workerStatItem}>
            <FaTrophy size={9} color={c.textMuted} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: "600",

// Verbatim port of components/hirer/HirerJobBoardManagement.jsx.

// Fetch: GET /jobs/hirer/me?page=N&limit=9&status=X
// Update: PATCH /jobs/:jobId/status with { status: "OPEN"|"FILLED"|"CANCELLED" }
//
// Renders:
//   · Header: "MY JOBS" eyebrow + "Job Board" title + "Post New Job" CTA
//   · Success / error alerts (dismissible)
//   · Summary pills: Open / Filled / Cancelled / Total
//   · Filter tabs: All / Open / Filled / Cancelled
//   · Job cards with:
//       - Colored accent bar per status
//       - Category chip + status badge
//       - Title + description (clamped)
//       - Meta row (date, address, duration, job type, location type)
//       - Budget + applicants count + skills count
//       - Recent applicant thumbnails (+ more)
//       - Actions: View Details, Applications, Edit (open), Mark Filled,
//                  Cancel, Reopen
//       - Inline confirm row for Mark Filled / Cancel
//   · Pagination
//   · PageSkeleton during initial load

// ── Constants — verbatim from web ────────────────────────────────────

const BUDGET_TYPE_LABELS = {
