// ── Duration label helper ────────────────────────────────────────────
function formatJobDuration(job) {
  if (!job) return null;
  const value = job.estimatedValue;
  const hours = job.estimatedHours;
  const unit = job.estimatedUnit || "hours";

  if (unit === "custom") return value || null;
  if (!value && !hours) return null;

  const UNIT_MAP = {
    hours: "hour",
    days: "day",
    weeks: "week",
    months: "month",
    years: "year",
  };

  if (value) {
    const num = parseFloat(value);
    if (isNaN(num) || num <= 0) return String(value);
    const noun = UNIT_MAP[unit] || unit;
    const label = noun + (num !== 1 ? "s" : "");
    return `${num} ${label}`;
  }

  if (hours) {
    const num = parseFloat(hours);
    if (isNaN(num) || num <= 0) return `${hours} hours`;
    return `${num} hours`;
  }

  return null;
}

export default function JobsManagementScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [jobs, setJobs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(1);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // ── Fetch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(
    async (pg = page, flt = filter, isRefresh = false) => {
      if (!isRefresh) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const params = { page: pg, limit: 9 };
        if (flt !== "ALL") params.status = flt;
        const res = await client.get("/jobs/hirer/me", { params });
        const data = res?.data?.data || {};
        setJobs(data.jobPosts || []);
        setTotal(data.total || 0);
        setPages(data.pages || 1);
      } catch (err) {
        setError("Failed to load jobs.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [page, filter],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load(page, filter);
  }, [filter, page, load]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load(1, filter, true);
  };

  // ── Update status ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const updateStatus = async (jobId, status) => {
    setActing(jobId);
    setError("");
    setSuccess("");
    try {
      await client.patch(`/jobs/${jobId}/status`, { status });
      setJobs((prev) =>
        prev.map((j) => (j.id === jobId ? { ...j, status } : j)),
      );
      setSuccess(`Job marked as ${status.toLowerCase()}.`);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccess(""), 3000);
    } catch {
      setError("Failed to update job status.");
    } finally {
      setActing(null);
    }
  };

  // ── Summary counts ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const openCount = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "OPEN").length;
  const filledCount = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "FILLED").length;
  const cancelledCount = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "CANCELLED").length;

  // ── Loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <PageSkeleton variant="list" rows={6} />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <AppScreen
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
    >
      {/* ── Header ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <View style={styles.headerRow}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.orange,
              letterSpacing: 1.5,
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              marginBottom: 4,
            }}
          >
            My Jobs
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 24,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              letterSpacing: -0.4,
            }}
          >
            Job Board
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate("PostJob")}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.postBtn,
            { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1 },
          ]}
        >
          <FaPlus size={10} color={c.bg} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.bg,
              marginLeft: 5,
            }}
          >
            Post New Job
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ── Alerts ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {error ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setError("")}
          style={[
            styles.alert,
            { backgroundColor: c.redDim, borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)" },
          ]}
        >
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={11} color={c.red} />
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.red, flex: 1, marginLeft: 6 }}
          >
            {error}
          </AppText>
          <FaTimes size={10} color={c.red} />
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
      {success ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setSuccess("")}
          style={[
            styles.alert,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
              borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.2)",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <FaCheckCircle size={11} color={c.green} />
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.green, flex: 1, marginLeft: 6 }}
          >
            {success}
          </AppText>
          <FaTimes size={10} color={c.green} />
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Summary pills ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={{ flexGrow: 0, marginTop: 14, marginBottom: 10 }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8, paddingRight: 8 }}
      >
        <SummaryPill label="Open" value={openCount} color={c.green} c={c} />
        <SummaryPill label="Filled" value={filledCount} color="#818cf8" c={c} />
        <SummaryPill
          label="Cancelled"
          value={cancelledCount}
          color={c.red}
          c={c}
        />
        <SummaryPill label="Total" value={total} color={c.textDim} c={c} />
      </ScrollView>

      {/* ── Filter tabs ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={{ flexGrow: 0, marginBottom: 16 }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingRight: 8 }}
      >
        {STATUS_TABS.map((s) => {
          const active = filter === s;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={s}
              onPress={() => {
                setFilter(s);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.filterTab,
                {
                  backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                  opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                }}
              >
                {s === "ALL" ? "All Jobs" : STATUS_META[s]?.label}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* ── Grid ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {jobs.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty filter={filter} c={c} navigation={navigation} />
      ) : (
        <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
          {jobs.map((job) => (
            <JobCard
              key={job.id}
              job={job}
              acting={acting === job.id}
              onStatusChange={updateStatus}
              c={c}
              navigation={navigation}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Pagination ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {pages > 1 ? (
        <View style={[styles.pager, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
          <Pressable
            disabled={page === 1}
            onPress={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.pageBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: page === 1 ? 0.35 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaChevronLeft size={10} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textDim,
                marginLeft: 4,
              }}
            >
              Prev
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>
            {page} / {pages}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            disabled={page === pages}
            onPress={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(pages, p + 1))}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.pageBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: page === pages ? 0.35 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textDim,
                marginRight: 4,
              }}
            >
              Next
            </AppText>
            <FaChevronRight size={10} color={c.textDim} />
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// ── Job card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function JobCard({ job, acting, onStatusChange, c, navigation }) {
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(null);
  const meta = STATUS_META[job.status] || STATUS_META.OPEN;
  const isOpen = job.status === "OPEN";
  const scheduled = new Date(job.scheduledAt);
  const applicantCount = job._count?.applications || 0;
  const recentApplicants = job.applications?.slice(0, 3) || [];
  const skillsCount = job.skills?.length || 0;
  const budgetSuffix = BUDGET_TYPE_LABELS[job.budgetType];
  const LocationIcon = locIcon(job.locationType);
  const dur = formatJobDuration(job);

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.card,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Accent bar */}
      <View style={[styles.accentBar, { backgroundColor: meta.color }]} />

      <View style={styles.cardInner}>
        {/* Top: category + badge */}
        <View style={styles.cardTop}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.categoryChip,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
            ]}
          >
            {job.category?.icon ? (
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{job.category.icon}</AppText>
            ) : null}
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.orange,
                marginLeft: 4,
              }}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {job.category?.name || "General"}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: meta.bg }]}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 9,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: meta.color,
                letterSpacing: 0.4,
                textTransform: "uppercase",
              }}
            >
              {meta.label}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Title & description */}
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
            fontSize: 15,
            fontWeight: "700",
            color: c.text,
            marginTop: 8,
            lineHeight: 20,
          }}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {job.title}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontSize: 12,
            color: c.textDim,
            marginTop: 4,
            lineHeight: 18,
          }}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {job.description}
        </AppText>

        {/* Meta row */}
        <View style={styles.metaRow}>
          <MetaItem
            icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={10} color={c.textMuted} />}
            label={scheduled.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
              day: "numeric",
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
            c={c}
          />
          {job.address ? (
            <MetaItem
              icon={<FaMapMarkerAlt size={10} color={c.textMuted} />}
              label={job.address}
              c={c}
              truncate
            />
          ) : null}
          {dur ? (
            <MetaItem
              icon={<AppText style={{ fontSize: 9 }}>⏱</AppText>}
              label={dur}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {JOB_TYPE_LABELS[job.jobType] ? (
            <MetaItem
              icon={<FaBriefcase size={10} color={c.textMuted} />}
              label={JOB_TYPE_LABELS[job.jobType]}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
          {LOCATION_TYPE_LABELS[job.locationType] ? (
            <MetaItem
              icon={
                LocationIcon ? (
                  <LocationIcon size={10} color={c.textMuted} />
                ) : null
              }
              label={LOCATION_TYPE_LABELS[job.locationType]}
              c={c}
            />
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Budget + applicants */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.statsRow,
            { borderTopColor: c.border, marginTop: 10, paddingTop: 10 },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "baseline" }}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.orange,
              }}
            >
              {job.currency} {Number(job.budget || 0).toLocaleString()}
            </AppText>
            {budgetSuffix ? (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 3 }}
              >
                {budgetSuffix}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </View>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("JobApplications", { jobId: job.id })
            }
            style={[
              styles.applicantChip,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <FaUsers size={10} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginLeft: 4 }}>
              {applicantCount} applicant{applicantCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
            </AppText>
            {skillsCount > 0 ? (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 4 }}
              >
                · {skillsCount} skill{skillsCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {/* Applicant previews */}
        {recentApplicants.length > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.previewsRow}>
            {recentApplicants.map((app) => (
              <View
                key={app.id}
                style={[
                  styles.previewAvatar,
                  { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.bgPanel },
                ]}
              >
                {app.worker?.avatar ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: app.worker.avatar }}
                    style={styles.previewImg}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
                  >
                    {app.worker?.firstName?.[0]}
                    {app.worker?.lastName?.[0]}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
            ))}
            {applicantCount > 3 ? (
              <View style={[styles.previewMore, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard }]}>
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: "700", color: c.textDim }}
                >
                  +{applicantCount - 3}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Actions */}
        <View style={styles.actionsRow}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => navigation.navigate("JobDetail", { jobId: job.id })}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.viewBtn,
              {
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
            >
              View Details
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("JobApplications", { jobId: job.id })
            }
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.appsBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.25)",
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
            >
              Applications
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          {isOpen ? (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("EditJob", { jobId: job.id })}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.editBtn,
                {
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <FaEdit size={10} color={c.textDim} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: c.textDim,
                  marginLeft: 3,
                }}
              >
                Edit
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Status actions */}
        {isOpen && !showConfirm ? (
          <View style={styles.statusActions}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowConfirm("FILLED")}
              disabled={acting}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.fillBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.1)",
                  borderColor: "rgba(129,140,248,0.25)",
                  opacity: acting ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: "#818cf8" }}
              >
                Mark Filled
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowConfirm("CANCELLED")}
              disabled={acting}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.cancelBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                  borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)",
                  opacity: acting ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: c.red }}
              >
                Cancel
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Confirm row */}
        {showConfirm ? (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.confirmRow,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, flex: 1 }}>
              {showConfirm === "FILLED"
                ? "Mark job as filled?"
                : "Cancel this job?"}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              disabled={acting}
              onPress={() => {
                onStatusChange(job.id, showConfirm);
                setShowConfirm(null);
              }}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.confirmYes,
                {
                  backgroundColor:
                    showConfirm === "CANCELLED" ? c.red : c.green,
                  opacity: acting ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}>
                {acting ? "…" : "Yes"}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowConfirm(null)}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.confirmNo,
                { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
              >
                No
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {!isOpen ? (
          <Pressable
            disabled={acting}
            onPress={() => onStatusChange(job.id, "OPEN")}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.reopenBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
                borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.25)",
                opacity: acting ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700", color: c.green }}
            >
              {acting ? "…" : "Reopen Job"}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function SummaryPill({ label, value, color, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.summaryPill,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 15,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color,
          lineHeight: 17,
        }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textDim, marginLeft: 6 }}>
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function MetaItem({ icon, label, c, truncate }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 3 }}>
      {icon}
      <AppText
        style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textDim, flexShrink: truncate ? 1 : 0 }}
        numberOfLines={truncate ? 1 : 1}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function Empty({ filter, c, navigation }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.empty,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <FaFileAlt size={40} color={c.textMuted} />
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 17,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color: c.text,
          marginTop: 12,
        }}
      >
        {filter === "ALL"
          ? "No jobs posted yet"
          : `No ${filter.toLowerCase()} jobs`}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 12,
          color: c.textDim,
          marginTop: 6,
          marginBottom: 16,
          textAlign: "center",
          lineHeight: 18,
          maxWidth: 320,
        }}
      >
        {filter === "ALL"
          ? "Post your first job and start receiving applications from skilled workers."
          : `You don't have any ${filter.toLowerCase()} jobs right now.`}
      </AppText>
      {filter === "ALL" ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate("PostJob")}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.emptyBtn,
            { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1 },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}>
            Post a Job
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/MessagesScreen.js

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import {
  useFocusEffect,
  useNavigation,
  useRoute,
} from "@react-navigation/native";
import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import { FaSearch, FaComments } from "../../icons/fa";

const CONVO_POLL_MS = 12000;

function formatTime(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return "";
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  const now = new Date();
  if (d.toDateString() === now.toDateString()) {
    return d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
  }
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short" });
}

function Avatar({ user, size = 46 }) {
  const initials =
    `${user?.firstName?.[0] || ""}${user?.lastName?.[0] || ""}`.toUpperCase();
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: size / 2,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.3)",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}
    >
      {user?.avatar ? (
        <Image
          source={{ uri: user.avatar }}
          style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
        />
      ) : (
        <AppText
          style={{ fontSize: size * 0.36, fontWeight: "700", color: "#f97316" }}
        >
          {initials || "?"}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Skeleton row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SkeletonRow({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.skeletonRow}>
      <View
        style={[
          styles.skeletonAvatar,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      />
      <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 8 }}>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.skeletonLine,
            {
              width: "55%",
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderColor: c.border,
            },
          ]}
        />
        <View
          style={[
            styles.skeletonLine,
            {
              width: "85%",
              height: 10,
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderColor: c.border,
            },
          ]}
        />
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

export default function MessagesScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  const loadConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await client.get("/messages/conversations", {
        params: { page: 1, limit: 50, _t: Date.now() },
      });
      setConversations(res.data.data.conversations || []);
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      let cancelled = false;
      (async () => {
        await loadConversations();
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      })();
      return () => {
        cancelled = true;
      };
    }, [loadConversations]),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      loadConversations();
    }, CONVO_POLL_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [loadConversations]);

  // Deep-link: conversationId or withUserId passed via route
  useEffect(() => {
    const convoId = route.params?.conversationId;
    const withUserId = route.params?.withUserId;
    const draft = route.params?.draft;

    if (!convoId && !withUserId) return;

    navigation.setParams({
      conversationId: undefined,
      withUserId: undefined,
      draft: undefined,
    });

    navigation.navigate("Chat", {
      conversationId: convoId,
      withUserId,
      draft,
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const getOtherUser = (convo) =>
    convo.users?.find((u) => u.userId !== user?.id)?.user;

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return conversations;
    return conversations.filter((c) => {
      const o = getOtherUser(c);
      return `${o?.firstName || ""} ${o?.lastName || ""}`
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(q);
    });
  }, [conversations, search, user?.id]);

  const totalUnread = conversations.reduce(
    (sum, c) => sum + (c.unreadCount || 0),
    0,
  );

  return (
    <AppScreen scroll={false} contentContainerStyle={{ flex: 1 }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 24,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
            }}
          >
            Messages
          </AppText>
          {totalUnread > 0 && (
            <View
              style={{
                minWidth: 22,
                height: 22,
                paddingHorizontal: 6,
                borderRadius: 11,
                backgroundColor: c.orange,
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
              }}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "800", color: c.bg }}>
                {totalUnread > 99 ? "99+" : totalUnread}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Search */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.searchWrap,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <FaSearch size={14} color={c.textMuted} />
        <TextInput
          value={search}
          onChangeText={setSearch}
          placeholder="Search conversations..."
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[styles.searchInput, { color: c.text }]}
          returnKeyType="search"
        />
      </View>

      {/* Skeleton while loading */}
      {loading ? (
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
            <SkeletonRow key={i} c={c} />
          ))}
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={filtered}
          keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.id)}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={refreshing}
              onRefresh={async () => {
                setRefreshing(true);
                await loadConversations();
                setRefreshing(false);
              }}
              tintColor={c.orange}
            />
          }
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <FaComments size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 14,
                  color: c.textDim,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  marginTop: 10,
                }}
              >
                No conversations yet
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}
              >
                Start a booking to begin messaging
              </AppText>
            </View>
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const other = getOtherUser(item);
            const lastMsg = item.messages?.[0];
            const unread = item.unreadCount || 0;
            const preview = lastMsg
              ? lastMsg.senderId === user?.id
                ? `You: ${lastMsg.content}`
                : lastMsg.content
              : "No messages yet";

            return (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() =>
                  navigation.navigate("Chat", { conversationId: item.id })
                }
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.row,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: pressed ? c.bgCard : "transparent",
                    borderBottomColor: c.border,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Avatar user={other} />
                <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <View
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      alignItems: "center",
                      gap: 6,
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      numberOfLines={1}
                      style={{
                        flex: 1,
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: unread > 0 ? "700" : "600",
                        color: c.text,
                      }}
                    >
                      {other?.firstName} {other?.lastName}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>
                      {lastMsg ? formatTime(lastMsg.createdAt) : ""}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <View
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      alignItems: "center",
                      gap: 6,
                      marginTop: 3,
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      numberOfLines={1}
                      style={{
                        flex: 1,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: unread > 0 ? c.text : c.textDim,
                        fontWeight: unread > 0 ? "600" : "400",
                      }}
                    >
                      {preview}
                    </AppText>
                    {unread > 0 && (
                      <View
                        style={{
                          minWidth: 18,
                          height: 18,
                          paddingHorizontal: 4,
                          borderRadius: 9,
                          backgroundColor: c.orange,
                          alignItems: "center",
                          justifyContent: "center",
                        }}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: "800",
                            color: c.bg,
                          }}
                        >
                          {unread > 9 ? "9+" : unread}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    )}
                  </View>
                </View>
              </Pressable>
            );
          }}
        />
      )}
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/MyDisputesScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of pages/disputes/MyDisputes.jsx.
//
// Fetch: GET /disputes/my
// Cancel: PATCH /disputes/:bookingId/cancel
//
// Renders:
//   · Header: "SUPPORT" eyebrow + "My Disputes" title + subtitle +
//             3 header stats (total / active / resolved)
//   · 5 filter tabs (All / Open / Under Review / Resolved / Cancelled)
//   · Error + success banners (dismissible)
//   · Expandable dispute cards with:
//       - Icon + title + reason tag + date + category tag + status badge
//       - Body: reason, description, evidence gallery (with lightbox),
//               booking details grid, parties (hirer + worker),
//               payment status, actions (cancel dispute + view booking)
//   · Cancel dispute confirmation modal
//   · Image lightbox modal
//   · Empty state
//   · PageSkeleton during initial load
//
// Port notes:
//   · window.confirm → ConfirmModal (React Native Modal)
//   · <img> with onClick lightbox → Pressable + Modal Image
//   · <button> → Pressable throughout

// ── Status meta — verbatim from web ──────────────────────────────────

];

function fmtCurrency(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  if (amount == null) return `${currency} 0.00`;
  return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

export default function MyDisputesScreen({ route }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [disputes, setDisputes] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState(null);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState("");
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(null);

  // Cancel confirmation modal
  const [showCancelModal, setShowCancelModal] = useState(false);
  const [cancelBookingId, setCancelBookingId] = useState(null);

  // Image lightbox
  const [lightboxImage, setLightboxImage] = useState(null);

  // ── Fetch ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(
    async (isRefresh = false) => {
      if (!isRefresh) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await client.get("/disputes/my");
        const list = res?.data?.data?.disputes || [];
        setDisputes(list);
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to load disputes.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load(false);
  }, [load]);

  // If routed with a bookingId (from "Raise a Dispute" on booking detail),
  // auto-expand that dispute when it loads.
  useEffect(() => {
    const targetId = route?.params?.bookingId;
    if (targetId && disputes.length > 0) {
      const match = disputes.find((d) => d.id === targetId);
      if (match) setExpanded(match.id);
    }
  }, [disputes, route?.params?.bookingId]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load(true);
  };

  // ── Cancel dispute ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const openCancelModal = (bookingId) => {
    setCancelBookingId(bookingId);
    setShowCancelModal(true);
  };

  const closeCancelModal = () => {
    setShowCancelModal(false);
    setCancelBookingId(null);
  };

  const confirmCancel = async () => {
    if (!cancelBookingId) return;
    setCancelling(cancelBookingId);
    try {
      await client.patch(`/disputes/${cancelBookingId}/cancel`);
      setDisputes((prev) =>
        prev.map((d) =>
          d.id === cancelBookingId ? { ...d, status: "CANCELLED" } : d,
        ),
      );
      toast.success("Dispute cancelled successfully.");
      closeCancelModal();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to cancel dispute.");
      closeCancelModal();
    } finally {
      setCancelling(null);
    }
  };

  // ── Derived ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const total = disputes.length;
  const activeCount = disputes.filter(
    (d) => d.status === "DISPUTED" || d.status === "UNDER_REVIEW",
  ).length;
  const resolvedCount = disputes.filter((d) => d.status === "RESOLVED").length;

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!filterStatus) return disputes;
    return disputes.filter((d) => d.status === filterStatus);
  }, [disputes, filterStatus]);

  // ── Loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <PageSkeleton variant="list" rows={4} />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <AppScreen
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
    >
      {/* ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 10,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color: c.orange,
          letterSpacing: 1.5,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          marginBottom: 6,
        }}
      >
        Support
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 24,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color: c.text,
          letterSpacing: -0.4,
          lineHeight: 30,
        }}
      >
        My Disputes
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 12,
          color: c.textDim,
          marginTop: 4,
          marginBottom: 16,
          lineHeight: 18,
        }}
      >
        Track and manage disputes raised on your bookings
      </AppText>

      {/* ── Header stats ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <View style={styles.headerStats}>
        <HeaderStat label="Total" value={total} color={c.text} />
        <HeaderStat label="Active" value={activeCount} color={c.orange} />
        <HeaderStat label="Resolved" value={resolvedCount} color={c.green} />
      </View>

      {/* ── Filter tabs ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={{ flexGrow: 0, marginBottom: 14 }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 4 }}
      >
        {FILTERS.map((f) => {

          return (

                  borderBottomColor: active ? c.orange : "transparent",

            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 13,

                {f.label}

                              color: c.text,
                              lineHeight: 19,
                            }}
                          >
                            {dispute.disputeDescription}
                          </AppText>
                        </DetailBlock>
                      ) : null}
                      {dispute.disputeEvidence?.length > 0 ? (
                        <DetailBlock label="Evidence" c={c}>
                          <ScrollView
                            horizontal
                            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
                            contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8 }}
                          >
                            {dispute.disputeEvidence.map((url, idx) => (
                              <Pressable
                                key={idx}
                                onPress={() => setLightboxImage(url)}
                                style={[
                                  styles.evidenceThumb,
                                  {
                                    backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                                    borderColor: c.border,
                                  },
                                ]}
                              >
                                <Image
                                  source={{ uri: url }}
                                  style={styles.evidenceImg}
                                />
                                <View
                                  style={[
                                    styles.evidenceOverlay,
                                    { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)" },
                                  ]}
                                >
                                  <FaEye size={12} color="#fff" />
                                </View>
                              </Pressable>
                            ))}
                          </ScrollView>
                        </DetailBlock>
                      ) : null}
                    </View>

                    {/* Booking details */}
                    <DetailSection title="Booking Details" c={c}>
                      <View style={styles.detailGrid}>
                        {dispute.agreedRate != null ? (
                          <GridItem
                            label="Agreed Rate"
                            value={fmtCurrency(
                              dispute.agreedRate,
                              dispute.currency,
                            )}
                            c={c}
                          />
                        ) : null}
                        {dispute.estimatedUnit && dispute.estimatedValue ? (
                          <GridItem
                            label="Duration"
                            value={`${dispute.estimatedValue} ${dispute.estimatedUnit}`}
                            c={c}
                          />
                        ) : null}
                        {dispute.address ? (
                          <GridItem
                            label="Address"
                            value={dispute.address}
                            c={c}
                            icon={
                              <FaMapMarkerAlt size={9} color={c.textMuted} />
                            }
                          />
                        ) : null}
                        {dispute.scheduledAt ? (
                          <GridItem
                            label="Scheduled"
                            value={new Date(dispute.scheduledAt).toLocaleString(
                              "en-GB",
                              { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" },
                            )}
                            c={c}
                            icon={
                              <FaCalendarAlt size={9} color={c.textMuted} />
                            }
                          />
                        ) : null}
                        {dispute.jobType ? (
                          <GridItem
                            label="Job Type"
                            value={String(dispute.jobType).replace(/_/g, " ")}
                            c={c}
                          />
                        ) : null}
                        {dispute.locationType ? (
                          <GridItem
                            label="Location"
                            value={String(dispute.locationType).replace(
                              /_/g,
                              " ",
                            )}
                            c={c}
                          />
                        ) : null}
                      </View>
                    </DetailSection>

                    {/* Parties */}
                    {dispute.hirer || dispute.worker ? (
                      <View style={styles.partiesRow}>
                        {dispute.hirer ? (
                          <PartyChip party={dispute.hirer} role="Hirer" c={c} />
                        ) : null}
                        {dispute.worker ? (
                          <PartyChip
                            party={dispute.worker}
                            role="Worker"
                            c={c}
                          />
                        ) : null}
                      </View>
                    ) : null}

                    {/* Payment info */}
                    {dispute.payments?.length > 0 ? (
                      <DetailSection
                        title="Payment"
                        c={c}
                        icon={<FaMoneyBillWave size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                      >
                        <View style={styles.detailGrid}>
                          <GridItem
                            label="Status"
                            value={dispute.payments[0].status}
                            c={c}
                          />
                          <GridItem
                            label="Amount"
                            value={fmtCurrency(
                              dispute.payments[0].amount,
                              dispute.payments[0].currency,
                            )}
                            c={c}
                          />
                        </View>
                      </DetailSection>
                    ) : null}

                    {/* Actions */}
                    <View
                      style={[styles.actionsRow, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}
                    >
                      {dispute.status === "DISPUTED" ? (
                        <Pressable
                          onPress={() => openCancelModal(dispute.id)}
                          disabled={cancelling === dispute.id}
                          style={({ pressed }) => [
                            styles.cancelBtn,
                            {
                              borderColor: c.red,
                              backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                              opacity:
                                cancelling === dispute.id
                                  ? 0.5
                                  : pressed
                                    ? 0.85
                                    : 1,
                            },
                          ]}
                        >
                          {cancelling === dispute.id ? (
                            <ActivityIndicator color={c.red} size="small" />
                          ) : (
                            <View
                              style={{
                                flexDirection: "row",
                                alignItems: "center",
                                gap: 4,
                              }}
                            >
                              <FaTrash size={10} color={c.red} />
                              <AppText
                                style={{
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                  fontWeight: "600",
                                  color: c.red,
                                }}
                              >
                                Cancel Dispute
                              </AppText>
                            </View>
                          )}
                        </Pressable>
                      ) : null}
                      <Pressable
                        onPress={() =>
                          navigation.navigate("BookingDetail", {
                            bookingId: dispute.id,
                          })
                        }
                        style={styles.viewBookingBtn}
                      >
                        <View
                          style={{
                            flexDirection: "row",
                            alignItems: "center",
                            gap: 4,
                          }}
                        >
                          <FaEye size={10} color={c.orange} />
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: "600",
                              color: c.orange,
                            }}
                          >
                            View Booking →
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                      </Pressable>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                ) : null}
              </View>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Cancel confirmation modal ────────────────────────────── */}
      <Modal
        visible={showCancelModal}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={closeCancelModal}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.modalCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                marginBottom: 10,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
                  fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.text,
                }}
              >
                Cancel Dispute
              </AppText>
              <Pressable onPress={closeCancelModal} hitSlop={8}>
                <FaTimesCircle size={18} color={c.textDim} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                color: c.textDim,
                lineHeight: 19,
                marginBottom: 16,
              }}
            >
              Are you sure you want to cancel this dispute? This action cannot
              be undone.
            </AppText>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={closeCancelModal}
                disabled={!!cancelling}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.modalBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: "transparent",
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  Cancel
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={confirmCancel}
                disabled={!!cancelling}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.modalBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.red,
                    opacity: cancelling ? 0.6 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {cancelling ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 13,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: "#fff",
                    }}
                  >
                    Confirm
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* ── Image lightbox modal ─────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Modal
        visible={!!lightboxImage}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setLightboxImage(null)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={styles.lightboxBackdrop}
          onPress={() => setLightboxImage(null)}
        >
          <Pressable
            style={styles.lightboxContent}
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setLightboxImage(null)}
              style={styles.lightboxClose}
            >
              <FaTimes size={20} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
            {lightboxImage ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: lightboxImage }}
                style={styles.lightboxImg}
                resizeMode="contain"
              />
            ) : null}
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function DetailBlock({ label, children, c }) {
  return (
    <View>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 10,
          fontWeight: "700",
          color: c.textMuted,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          letterSpacing: 0.8,
          marginBottom: 4,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

function DetailSection({ title, children, c, icon }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        paddingTop: 12,
        marginTop: 12,
        borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
        borderTopColor: c.border,
      }}
    >
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",

          marginBottom: 8,

        {icon || <FaMoneyBillWave size={11} color={c.orange} />}

            fontSize: 10,

            color: c.textMuted,
            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 0.8,
          }}
        >
          {title}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

function GridItem({ label, value, c, icon }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[

        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },

      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 3 }}>

          style={{

            textTransform: "uppercase",
            letterSpacing: 0.4,
            marginBottom: 2,
          }}
        >
          {label}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <AppText
        style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.text, fontWeight: "600" }}
        numberOfLines={3}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function PartyChip({ party, role, c }) {
  const initials = `${party.firstName?.[0] || ""}${
    party.lastName?.[0] || ""
  }`.toUpperCase();
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.partyChip,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={[
          styles.partyAvatar,
          { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
        ]}
      >
        {party.avatar ? (
          <Image source={{ uri: party.avatar }} style={styles.partyAvatarImg} />
        ) : (
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: c.orange,
            }}
          >
            {initials}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <AppText
          style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}
          numberOfLines={1}
        >
          {party.firstName} {party.lastName}
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 3 }}>
          <FaUser size={8} color={c.textMuted} />
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>{role}</AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/MyPostsScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of src/pages/MyPostsPage.jsx + MyPostsPage.module.css.
//
// Mapping reference:
//   .myPostsPage { margin: -1.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.75rem 4rem } @≤640px
//     → AppScreen with 0 base padding; listContent uses 0.75rem × 16 × fontScale
//       padding (≈10.8px on mobile, matching the website's visible padding).
//   .myPostsPage { padding: 1.5rem } @≥900px
//     → 1.5rem × 16 × fontScale (≈24px) on wide screens.
//   .myPostsHeader / .myPostsTitle / .myPostsSub → identical text scale + weight.
//   .myPostsSpacer 0.875rem → <View style={{ height: rem(0.875) }} />
//   <CreatePost onPostCreated /> (expanded, not compact)
//     → <CreatePost onPostCreated={...} /> — existing component.
//   <PostCard post onDelete />  → identical.
//   styles.feedList { gap: 0.75rem } → <View style={{ gap: rem(0.75) }}>
//   .empty block with FiEdit3 → Ionicons "create-outline"

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
  RefreshControl,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import CreatePost from "../../components/posts/CreatePost";
import PostCard from "../../components/posts/PostCard";
import PostSkeleton from "../../components/posts/PostSkeleton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { getMyPosts } from "../../api/posts";

export default function MyPostsScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  const [posts, setPosts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;

  // Breakpoints — mirror CSS:
  //   Default → padding 1.5rem  (≥ 900 / wide tablets)
  //   ≤ 640   → padding 0.75rem (mobile, which is the primary target)
  const isCompact = width <= 640;
  const isWide = width >= 900;

  // Visible padding from screen edge:
  //   ≤ 640  → 0.75rem × 16 × fontScale  (~10.8px on 360w)
  //   641-899 → 1rem × 16 × fontScale    (interpolated)
  //   ≥ 900  → 1.5rem × 16 × fontScale   (~24px on tablet)
  const padH = isCompact
    ? 0.75 * 16 * fontScale
    : isWide
      ? 1.5 * 16 * fontScale
      : 1 * 16 * fontScale;

  const padBottom = isCompact ? 4 * 16 * fontScale : 1.5 * 16 * fontScale;

  // Header text sizes — rem × 16 × fontScale
  const titleFs = 1.5 * 16 * fontScale;
  const subFs = 0.85 * 16 * fontScale;

  const fetchPosts = useCallback(
    async (opts = {}) => {
      if (!opts.silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const data = await getMyPosts();
        setPosts(data?.posts || []);
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || t("posts.loadFailed"));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [toast, t],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPosts();
  }, [fetchPosts]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    fetchPosts({ silent: true });
  };

  const handlePostCreated = (newPost) => {
    if (!newPost) return;
    setPosts((prev) => [newPost, ...prev]);
  };

  const handlePostDeleted = (postId) => {
    setPosts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== postId));
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen
      scroll={false}
      contentContainerStyle={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
    >
      <ScrollView
        style={{ flex: 1, width: "100%" }}
        contentContainerStyle={{
          paddingHorizontal: padH,
          paddingTop: padH,
          paddingBottom: padBottom,
        }}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
            colors={[c.orange]}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* ─── Header ──────────────────────────────────── */}
        <View style={{ marginBottom: rem(0.5) }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: titleFs,
              lineHeight: titleFs * 1.2,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              letterSpacing: -0.02 * titleFs,
              marginBottom: rem(0.25),
            }}
          >
            {t("posts.myTitle")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
              fontSize: subFs,
              lineHeight: subFs * 1.45,
              color: c.textDim,
            }}
          >
            {t("posts.mySubtitle")}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* ─── CreatePost (expanded, full editor) ──────── */}
        <CreatePost onPostCreated={handlePostCreated} />

        {/* ─── Spacer 0.875rem ─────────────────────────── */}
        <View style={{ height: rem(0.875) }} />

        {/* ─── Loading / Empty / Feed ──────────────────── */}
        {loading ? (
          <View style={{ gap: rem(0.75) }}>
            <PostSkeleton />
            <PostSkeleton />
            <PostSkeleton />
          </View>
        ) : posts.length === 0 ? (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.empty,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                borderColor: c.border,
                paddingVertical: rem(2.5),
                paddingHorizontal: rem(1.5),
                gap: rem(0.5),
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="create-outline" size={rem(2)} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.display || "Syne_700Bold",
                fontSize: rem(1),
                lineHeight: rem(1) * 1.3,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.text,
                marginTop: rem(0.5),
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.noMyPosts")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                fontSize: rem(0.82),
                lineHeight: rem(0.82) * 1.4,
                color: c.textDim,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.noMyPostsSub")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={{ gap: rem(0.75) }}>
            {posts.map((post) => (
              <PostCard
                key={post.id}
                post={post}
                onDelete={handlePostDeleted}
              />
            ))}
          </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  empty: {
    flexDirection: "column",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: 14,
  },
});

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const fmtDate = (d) =>
  d
    ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
        day: "2-digit",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
      })
    : "—";

const timeAgo = (d) => {
  if (!d) return "—";
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(d).getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
  const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
  if (days < 30) return `${days}d ago`;
  return fmtDate(d);
};

// ── StatusBadge ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const m = STATUS_META[status] || STATUS_META.DISMISSED;
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        paddingHorizontal: 10,
        paddingVertical: 4,
        borderRadius: 20,
        backgroundColor: m.bg,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: m.border,
      }}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700", color: m.color }}>
        {m.icon} {m.label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Submit Report Modal (bottom sheet) ────────────────────────────────────────
function ReportFormModal({ visible, onClose, onSuccess, c, modalBg, toast }) {
  const [targetType, setTargetType] = useState("USER");
  const [targetId, setTargetId] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [evidence, setEvidence] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(null);

  function reset() {
    setTargetType("USER");
    setTargetId("");
    setReason("");
    setDescription("");
    setEvidence("");
    setDone(null);
  }

  function handleClose() {
    reset();
    onClose();
  }

  async function submit() {
    if (!targetId.trim()) {
      toast.error("Please enter the Target ID.");
      return;
    }
    if (!reason) {
      toast.error("Please select a reason.");
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const evidenceArr = evidence
        .split("\n")
        .map((l) => l.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(0, 5);
      const res = await client.post("/reports", {
        targetType,
        targetId: targetId.trim(),
        reason,
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        evidence: evidenceArr,
      });
      setDone({ ref: res.data.data.ref });
      onSuccess?.();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to submit report.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      visible
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
    >
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : "height"}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.65)" }}
          onPress={handleClose}
        >
          <Pressable
            style={[s.sheet, { backgroundColor: modalBg, maxHeight: "92%" }]}
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Handle */}
            <View style={[s.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

            {/* Header */}
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "center",
                marginBottom: 18,
              }}
            >
              <View>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: c.orange,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    letterSpacing: 0.8,
                  }}
                >
                  SAFETY & TRUST
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  weight="displayBlack"
                  style={{ fontSize: 24, color: c.text, marginTop: 2 }}
                >
                  File a Report
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleClose}
                style={{
                  width: 36,
                  height: 36,
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                }}
              >
                <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={c.textDim} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            <ScrollView
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            >
              {done ? (
                /* ── Success state ── */
                <View
                  style={{ alignItems: "center", paddingVertical: 32, gap: 12 }}
                >
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 52 }}>✅</AppText>
                  <AppText
                    weight="displayBlack"
                    style={{ fontSize: 22, color: c.text, textAlign: "center" }}
                  >
                    Report Submitted
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{
                      textAlign: "center",
                      lineHeight: 20,
                      maxWidth: 280,
                    }}
                  >
                    Reference:{" "}
                    <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
                      {done.ref}
                    </AppText>
                    {"\n"}Our team will review it within 24–48 hours.
                  </AppText>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={handleClose}
                    style={{
                      marginTop: 8,
                      paddingHorizontal: 28,

                      borderRadius: 12,
                      backgroundColor: c.orange,
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#000" }}>

              ) : (

                  >
                    {Object.entries(TYPE_META).map(([key, m]) => (
                      <Pressable
                        key={key}
                        onPress={() => setTargetType(key)}
                        style={{
                          paddingHorizontal: 14,
                          paddingVertical: 9,
                          borderRadius: 10,
                          borderWidth: 1,
                          backgroundColor:

                              ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.18)"
                              : c.bgCard,

// ── Detail Drawer (bottom sheet) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function DetailDrawer({ report, visible, onClose, onCancel, c, modalBg }) {
  if (!report || !visible) return null;

  const typeMeta = TYPE_META[report.targetType] || {
    label: report.targetType,
    icon: "📄",
  };
  const statusMeta = STATUS_META[report.status] || STATUS_META.DISMISSED;
  const actionMeta = ACTION_META[report.actionTaken] || {
    label: report.actionTaken || "—",
    icon: "—",
  };
  const canCancel = report.status === "PENDING";
  const isDone = report.status === "RESOLVED" || report.status === "DISMISSED";

  const timelineSteps = [
    {
      label: "Report submitted",
      date: fmtDate(report.createdAt),
      done: true,
      active: false,
    },
    {
      label: "Review started",
      date: "—",
      done: report.status !== "PENDING",
      active: report.status === "REVIEWING",
    },
    {
      label: isDone
        ? report.status === "RESOLVED"
          ? "Resolved"
          : "Dismissed"
        : "Awaiting resolution",
      date: isDone ? fmtDate(report.resolvedAt) : "—",
      done: isDone,
      active: false,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <Pressable
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.65)" }}

            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              justifyContent: "space-between",

                REPORT DETAIL
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                weight="displayBlack"
                style={{ fontSize: 20, color: c.text, letterSpacing: 0.5 }}

                {report.ref}

                borderColor: statusMeta.border,
                marginBottom: 16,
              }}

                <AppText
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ fontSize: 15, color: c.text }}

                </AppText>
