                  letterSpacing: 0.8,
                  textTransform: "uppercase",
                  marginBottom: 12,
                }}
              >
                TIMELINE
              </AppText>
              {timelineSteps.map((step, i) => (
                <View
                  key={i}
                  style={{
                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 12,
                    paddingVertical: 10,
                    borderBottomWidth:
                      i < timelineSteps.length - 1
                        ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth
                        : 0,
                    borderBottomColor: c.border,
                  }}
                >
                  <View
                    style={{
                      width: 12,
                      height: 12,
                      borderRadius: 6,
                      backgroundColor: step.done
                        ? "#22c55e"
                        : step.active
                          ? "#3b82f6"
                          : c.border,
                      flexShrink: 0,
                    }}
                  />
                  <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    {step.label}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
                    {step.date}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>

            {/* Cancel button */}
            {canCancel ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => {
                  onClose();
                  onCancel(report);
                }}
                style={{
                  paddingVertical: 14,
                  borderRadius: 12,
                  alignItems: "center",
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.35)",
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.10)",
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#ef4444", fontSize: 14 }}
                >
                  🗑️ Cancel this report
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
          </ScrollView>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ── Cancel Confirm Modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CancelConfirmModal({
  report,
  visible,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  c,
  modalBg,
  toast,
}) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleCancel() {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await client.delete(`/reports/${report.id}`);
      onSuccess("Report cancelled and removed.");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to cancel report.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  if (!report || !visible) return null;

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <Pressable
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          padding: 24,
        }}
        onPress={onClose}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={{
            backgroundColor: modalBg,
            borderRadius: 22,
            padding: 28,
            width: "100%",
            maxWidth: 360,
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 10,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)",
          }}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 40 }}>🗑️</AppText>
          <AppText
            weight="displayBlack"
            style={{ fontSize: 20, color: c.text, textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            Cancel this report?
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 19 }}
          >
            Ref{" "}
            <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
              {report.ref}
            </AppText>
            {"\n"}
            {REASON_OPTIONS.find((r) => r.value === report.reason)?.label}
            {"\n"}This action cannot be undone.
          </AppText>

          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              gap: 10,
              width: "100%",
              marginTop: 8,
            }}
          >
            <Pressable
              onPress={onClose}
              disabled={loading}
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                paddingVertical: 13,
                borderRadius: 12,
                alignItems: "center",
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: "transparent",
              }}
            >
              <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.textDim }}>
                Keep it
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleCancel}
              disabled={loading}
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                paddingVertical: 13,
                borderRadius: 12,
                alignItems: "center",
                backgroundColor: "#ef4444",
              }}
            >
              {loading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
              ) : (
                <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
                  Yes, cancel
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ── Report Card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReportCard({ report, onView, onCancel, c }) {
  const typeMeta = TYPE_META[report.targetType] || {
    label: report.targetType,
    icon: "📄",
  };
  const actionMeta = ACTION_META[report.actionTaken];
  const canCancel = report.status === "PENDING";
  const hasOutcome = report.actionTaken && report.actionTaken !== "NO_ACTION";
  const noAction =
    report.actionTaken === "NO_ACTION" && report.status === "RESOLVED";
  const reasonLabel =
    REASON_OPTIONS.find((r) => r.value === report.reason)?.label ||
    report.reason;

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={() => onView(report)}
      style={{
        backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
        borderRadius: 16,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: c.border,
        padding: 16,
        marginBottom: 10,
      }}
    >
      {/* Top row */}
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          alignItems: "flex-start",
          marginBottom: 10,
        }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 10,
            flex: 1,
            marginRight: 10,
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              width: 42,
              height: 42,
              borderRadius: 12,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
            }}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>{typeMeta.icon}</AppText>
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AppText
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.text, letterSpacing: 0.3 }}

              {report.ref}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                color: c.textMuted,
                textTransform: "uppercase",

                marginTop: 1,

          {reasonLabel}
        </AppText>
        {report.description ? (
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            numberOfLines={2}
            style={{ lineHeight: 18 }}
          >
            {report.description}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {/* Outcome pill */}
      {hasOutcome ? (
        <View
          style={{
            alignSelf: "flex-start",
            marginLeft: 52,
            marginBottom: 8,
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 5,
            paddingHorizontal: 10,
            paddingVertical: 4,
            borderRadius: 6,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.25)",
            backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.10)",
          }}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "600", color: "#22c55e" }}
          >
            {actionMeta?.icon} {actionMeta?.label}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : noAction ? (
        <View
          style={{
            alignSelf: "flex-start",
            marginLeft: 52,
            marginBottom: 8,
            paddingHorizontal: 10,
            paddingVertical: 4,
            borderRadius: 6,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: c.border,
            backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          }}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textMuted }}
          >
            — No action taken
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* Footer */}
      <View
        style={{

          justifyContent: "space-between",
          paddingTop: 10,
          borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
          borderTopColor: c.border,
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
          {timeAgo(report.createdAt)}

        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>

// ── Main Screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function MyReportsScreen() {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;
  const modalBg = th.effectiveMode === "dark" ? "#111118" : "#ffffff";

  const [reports, setReports] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("ALL");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(1);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [viewTarget, setViewTarget] = useState(null);
  const [cancelTarget, setCancelTarget] = useState(null);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);

  const LIMIT = 10;

  const load = useCallback(
    async (pg = 1, status = tab, isRefresh = false) => {
      if (isRefresh) setRefreshing(true);
      else setLoading(true);
      try {
        const params = { page: pg, limit: LIMIT };
        if (status !== "ALL") params.status = status;
        const res = await client.get("/reports/my", { params });
        const d = res.data.data;
        setReports(d.reports || []);
        setTotal(d.total || 0);
        setPages(d.pages || 1);
        setPage(pg);
      } catch {
        toast.error("Failed to load reports.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [tab],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load(1, tab);
  }, [tab]);

  function handleTabChange(key) {
    setTab(key);
    setPage(1);
  }

  function handleCancelSuccess(msg) {
    setCancelTarget(null);
    toast.success(msg);
    load(page, tab);
  }

  function handleReportSuccess() {
    setShowForm(false);
    load(1, "ALL");
    setTab("ALL");
  }

  // Summary counts
  const pending = reports.filter((r) => r.status === "PENDING").length;
  const reviewing = reports.filter((r) => r.status === "REVIEWING").length;
  const resolved = reports.filter((r) => r.status === "RESOLVED").length;

  return (
    <>
      <AppScreen
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 56 }}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => load(1, tab, true)}
            tintColor={c.orange}
            colors={[c.orange]}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* ── Page header ── */}
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "flex-start",
            marginBottom: 18,
            gap: 10,
            flexWrap: "wrap",
          }}
        >
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                color: c.orange,
                fontWeight: "700",
                letterSpacing: 0.8,
              }}
            >
              SAFETY & TRUST
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 10,
                marginTop: 2,
                flexWrap: "wrap",
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                weight="displayBlack"
                style={{ fontSize: 30, color: c.text, lineHeight: 36 }}
              >
                My Reports
              </AppText>
              {total > 0 && (
                <View
                  style={{
                    paddingHorizontal: 10,
                    paddingVertical: 3,
                    borderRadius: 20,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                  }}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: c.textMuted,
                    }}
                  >
                    {total}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ marginTop: 4, lineHeight: 18 }}
            >
              Track reports you've submitted. Reviewed within 24–48 hours.
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setShowForm(true)}
            style={{
              paddingHorizontal: 14,
              paddingVertical: 10,
              borderRadius: 12,
              backgroundColor: "#ef4444",
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 6,
            }}
          >
            <Ionicons name="flag" size={14} color="#fff" />
            <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 13 }}>
              Report
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {/* ── Summary strip ── */}
        {!loading && reports.length > 0 && (
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              borderRadius: 14,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              overflow: "hidden",
              marginBottom: 14,
            }}
          >
            {[
              { icon: "⏳", value: pending, label: "Pending" },
              { icon: "🔍", value: reviewing, label: "Reviewing" },
              { icon: "✅", value: resolved, label: "Resolved" },
            ].map((item, i) => (
              <React.Fragment key={item.label}>
                {i > 0 && (
                  <View
                    style={{
                      width: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
                      backgroundColor: c.border,
                    }}
                  />
                )}
                <View
                  style={{
                    flex: 1,
                    alignItems: "center",
                    paddingVertical: 14,
                    gap: 3,
                  }}
                >
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>{item.icon}</AppText>
                  <AppText
                    weight="displayBlack"
                    style={{ fontSize: 20, color: c.text, lineHeight: 24 }}
                  >
                    {item.value}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 10,
                      color: c.textMuted,
                      textTransform: "uppercase",
                      letterSpacing: 0.6,
                    }}
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </React.Fragment>
            ))}
          </View>
        )}

        {/* ── Info banner ── */}
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            gap: 12,
            padding: 14,
            borderRadius: 12,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: c.border,
            borderLeftWidth: 3,
            borderLeftColor: c.orange,
            backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
            marginBottom: 16,
          }}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>🔒</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ flex: 1, lineHeight: 18 }}
          >
            All reports are confidential. The reported party is never told who
            filed the report.
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* ── Status tabs ── */}
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
          contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingBottom: 2 }}
        >
          {STATUS_TABS.map((t) => (
            <Pressable
              key={t.key}
              onPress={() => handleTabChange(t.key)}
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 16,
                paddingVertical: 8,
                borderRadius: 20,
                borderWidth: 1,
                backgroundColor:
                  tab === t.key ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)" : "transparent",
                borderColor: tab === t.key ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.5)" : c.border,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: tab === t.key ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                }}
              >
                {t.label}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ))}
        </ScrollView>

        {/* ── Cards ── */}
        {loading ? (
          Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
            <SkeletonCard key={i} c={c} />
          ))
        ) : reports.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={{ alignItems: "center", paddingVertical: 64, gap: 10 }}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 44, opacity: 0.35 }}>🚩</AppText>
            <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ fontSize: 16, color: c.text }}>
              {tab === "ALL"
                ? "No reports yet"
                : `No ${tab.toLowerCase()} reports`}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ textAlign: "center", maxWidth: 260, lineHeight: 18 }}
            >
              {tab === "ALL"
                ? "Tap Report to flag a user, job post, or any content."
                : "Try a different filter above."}
            </AppText>
            {tab !== "ALL" ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => handleTabChange("ALL")}
                style={{
                  marginTop: 8,
                  paddingHorizontal: 18,
                  paddingVertical: 8,
                  borderRadius: 20,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
                >
                  View all reports
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : (
          reports.map((r) => (
            <ReportCard
              key={r.id}
              report={r}
              c={c}
              onView={setViewTarget}
              onCancel={setCancelTarget}
            />
          ))
        )}

        {/* ── Pagination ── */}
        {pages > 1 && (
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
              gap: 16,
              marginTop: 8,
            }}
          >
            <Pressable
              disabled={page <= 1 || loading}
              onPress={() => load(page - 1)}
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 18,
                paddingVertical: 8,
                borderRadius: 10,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                opacity: page <= 1 || loading ? 0.4 : 1,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
              >
                ← Prev
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textMuted }}>
              Page {page} of {pages}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              disabled={page >= pages || loading}
              onPress={() => load(page + 1)}
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 18,
                paddingVertical: 8,
                borderRadius: 10,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                opacity: page >= pages || loading ? 0.4 : 1,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
              >
                Next →
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}
      </AppScreen>

      {/* ── Modals — outside AppScreen so they cover full screen ── */}
      <ReportFormModal
        visible={showForm}
        onClose={() => setShowForm(false)}
        onSuccess={handleReportSuccess}
        c={c}
        modalBg={modalBg}
        toast={toast}
      />

      <DetailDrawer
        report={viewTarget}
        visible={!!viewTarget}
        onClose={() => setViewTarget(null)}
        onCancel={(r) => {
          setViewTarget(null);
          setCancelTarget(r);
        }}
        c={c}
        modalBg={modalBg}
      />

      <CancelConfirmModal
        report={cancelTarget}
        visible={!!cancelTarget}
        onClose={() => setCancelTarget(null)}
        onSuccess={handleCancelSuccess}
        c={c}
        modalBg={modalBg}
        toast={toast}
      />
    </>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/NotificationsScreen.js
// Endpoint: GET /notifications  |  PATCH /notifications/:id/read
//           PATCH /notifications/read-all  |  DELETE /notifications/clear-all

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";

  FlatList,

  Pressable,

  useWindowDimensions,

import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

// ── Time ago ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function timeAgo(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  const diff = (Date.now() - new Date(d)) / 1000;
  if (diff < 60) return `${Math.floor(diff)}s ago`;
  if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}m ago`;
  if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400)}d ago`;
}

// ── Notification type → Ionicons name + color ─────────────────────────────────
// React-icons replacements (app uses @expo/vector-icons Ionicons throughout).
// Icon size stays 20 — visually balanced with the row's text block.
function typeIcon(type) {
  const map = {
    BOOKING_ACCEPTED: { name: "checkmark-circle", color: "#22c55e" },
    BOOKING_CANCELLED: { name: "close-circle", color: "#ef4444" },
    BOOKING_COMPLETED: { name: "trophy", color: "#f97316" },
    BOOKING_IN_PROGRESS: { name: "construct", color: "#818cf8" },
    PAYMENT_RECEIVED: { name: "card", color: "#22c55e" },
    PAYMENT_HELD: { name: "lock-closed", color: "#f97316" },
    DISPUTE_RAISED: { name: "warning", color: "#f87171" },
    DISPUTE_RESOLVED: { name: "shield-checkmark", color: "#22c55e" },
    POST_COMMENT: { name: "chatbubble-ellipses", color: "#818cf8" },
    POST_REACTION: { name: "thumbs-up", color: "#f97316" },
    POST_REPOST: { name: "repeat", color: "#818cf8" },
    NEW_LOGIN: { name: "shield", color: "#f97316" },
    INSURANCE_PURCHASED: { name: "shield-checkmark", color: "#22c55e" },
    WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST: { name: "cash", color: "#f97316" },
    BANK_TRANSFER_PROOF: { name: "business", color: "#818cf8" },
    CRYPTO_TX_SUBMITTED: { name: "logo-bitcoin", color: "#f97316" },
  };
  return map[type] ?? { name: "notifications", color: "#f97316" };
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Notification Detail Modal
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DetailModal({ notification, onClose, c, t, modalBg }) {
  if (!notification) return null;

  const data = notification.data ?? {};
  const hasIp = !!data.ip || !!data.ipAddress;
  const hasDevice = !!data.device || !!data.userAgent;
  const extraKeys = Object.keys(data).filter(
    (k) => !["ip", "ipAddress", "device", "userAgent"].includes(k),
  );

  const ti = typeIcon(notification.type);

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <Pressable style={d.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[d.modal, { backgroundColor: modalBg, borderColor: c.border }]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <View style={d.header}>
            <View style={d.headerLeft}>
              <View
                style={[d.typeIconWrap, { backgroundColor: `${ti.color}22` }]}
              >
                <Ionicons name={ti.name} size={20} color={ti.color} />
              </View>
              <View style={{ marginLeft: 12, flex: 1 }}>
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text }}
                >
                  {notification.title}
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
                >
                  {timeAgo(notification.createdAt)}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </View>
            <Pressable
              onPress={onClose}
              style={[
                d.closeBtn,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons name="close" size={16} color={c.text} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          <View style={[d.divider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

          {/* Body */}
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ color: c.text, lineHeight: 22, marginBottom: 16 }}
          >
            {notification.body}
          </AppText>

          {/* Details table */}
          {(hasIp || hasDevice || extraKeys.length > 0) && (
            <View
              style={[
                d.detailsBox,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color: c.textMuted,
                  letterSpacing: 1,
                  marginBottom: 10,
                }}
              >
                {t("notifications.details")}
              </AppText>
              {hasIp && (
                <View style={[d.detailRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted, width: 72 }}
                  >
                    {t("notifications.ip")}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1, textAlign: "right" }}
                  >
                    {data.ip ?? data.ipAddress}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
              {hasDevice && (
                <View style={[d.detailRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted, width: 72 }}
                  >
                    {t("notifications.device")}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1, textAlign: "right" }}
                    numberOfLines={3}
                  >
                    {data.device ?? data.userAgent}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
              {extraKeys.slice(0, 4).map((key) => (
                <View
                  key={key}
                  style={[d.detailRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted, width: 80 }}
                  >
                    {key}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1, textAlign: "right" }}
                    numberOfLines={2}
                  >
                    {String(data[key])}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Notification row

function NotifRow({ notif, onPress, onDelete, c }) {
  const unread = !notif.isRead;
  const ti = typeIcon(notif.type);

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={() => onPress(notif)}
      style={[
        n.row,
        {
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderColor: unread ? c.orange : c.border,
          borderLeftColor: unread ? c.orange : c.border,
          borderLeftWidth: unread ? 3 : StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {unread && <View style={[n.dot, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]} />}

      {/* Type icon */}
      <View style={[n.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: `${ti.color}22` }]}>
        <Ionicons name={ti.name} size={18} color={ti.color} />
      </View>

      {/* Content */}
      <View style={n.content}>
        <View style={n.titleRow}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1, fontSize: 14 }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {notif.title}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 11 }}
          >
            {timeAgo(notif.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          style={{
            color: c.textMuted,
            lineHeight: 17,
            marginTop: 2,
            fontSize: 12,
          }}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {notif.body}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Delete */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => onDelete(notif.id)}
        style={n.deleteBtn}
        hitSlop={10}
      >
        <Ionicons name="close" size={14} color="#ef4444" />
      </Pressable>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Skeleton (shimmer) — matches DashboardSkeleton pattern
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SkeletonRow({ c }) {
  const anim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  useEffect(() => {
    const loop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.timing(anim, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 1400,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    );
    loop.start();
    return () => loop.stop();
  }, [anim]);

  const translateX = anim.interpolate({
    inputRange: [0, 1],
    outputRange: [-width, width],
  });

  return (
    <View
      style={[n.skRow, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject, { transform: [{ translateX }] }]}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            width: "40%",
            height: "100%",
            backgroundColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)",
          }}
        />
      </Animated.View>
    </View>
  );
}

function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <SkeletonRow key={i} c={c} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main Screen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function NotificationsScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();

  const [all, setAll] = useState([]);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("all");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getNotifications({ page: 1, limit: 50 });
      setAll(data.notifications ?? []);
      setUnreadCount(data.unreadCount ?? 0);
      setTotal(data.total ?? 0);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load();
  };

  const handlePress = async (notif) => {
    setSelected(notif);
    if (!notif.isRead) {
      try {
        await markAsRead(notif.id);
        setAll((prev) =>
          prev.map((n) => (n.id === notif.id ? { ...n, isRead: true } : n)),
        );
        setUnreadCount((u) => Math.max(0, u - 1));
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (id) => {
    setConfirm({
      title: t("notifications.deleteTitle"),
      message: t("notifications.deleteMessage"),
      confirmLabel: t("common.delete"),
      destructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await deleteNotification(id);
          setAll((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
          setTotal((t) => t - 1);
        } catch {
          toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleMarkAll = async () => {
    try {
      await markAllAsRead();
      setAll((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, isRead: true })));
      setUnreadCount(0);
      toast.success(t("notifications.markedAll"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    }
  };

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    setConfirm({
      title: t("notifications.clearTitle"),
      message: t("notifications.clearMessage"),
      confirmLabel: t("notifications.clearAll"),
      destructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await clearAllNotifications();
          setAll([]);
          setTotal(0);
          setUnreadCount(0);
          toast.success(t("notifications.cleared"));
        } catch {
          toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const visible = tab === "unread" ? all.filter((n) => !n.isRead) : all;

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={visible}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            <View style={styles.pageHeader}>
              {unreadCount > 0 && (
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}
                >
                  {t("notifications.unreadCount", { count: unreadCount })}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>

            {/* Action buttons */}
            <View style={styles.actionRow}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleMarkAll}
                style={[
                  styles.actionBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <Ionicons name="checkmark-done" size={16} color={c.text} />
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text, marginLeft: 6 }}
                >
                  {t("notifications.markAllRead")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleClearAll}
                style={[
                  styles.actionBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={16} color="#ef4444" />
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#ef4444", marginLeft: 6 }}
                >
                  {t("notifications.clearAll")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Tabs */}
            <View style={[styles.tabRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
              {[
                { key: "all", label: t("notifications.all"), count: total },
                {
                  key: "unread",
                  label: t("notifications.unread"),
                  count: unreadCount,
                },
              ].map(({ key, label, count }) => {
                const active = tab === key;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={key}
                    onPress={() => setTab(key)}
                    style={[
                      styles.tabItem,
                      { borderBottomColor: active ? c.orange : "transparent" },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight={active ? "semibold" : "regular"}
                      style={{
                        color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
                        fontSize: 14,
                      }}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </AppText>
                    {count > 0 && (
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.badge,
                          { backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgInput },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: "700",
                            color: active ? "#fff" : c.textMuted,
                          }}
                        >
                          {count > 99 ? "99+" : count}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <NotifRow
            notif={item}
            onPress={handlePress}
            onDelete={handleDelete}
            c={c}
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 8 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <Ionicons
                name="notifications-outline"
                size={36}
                color={c.textMuted}
              />
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 12, fontSize: 14 }}
              >
                {t("notifications.empty")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6, fontSize: 12 }}
              >
                {t("notifications.emptySub")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={<View style={{ height: 40 }} />}
      />

      <DetailModal
        notification={selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        c={c}
        t={t}
        modalBg={th.mode === "dark" ? "#111118" : "#ffffff"}
      />

      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!confirm}
        title={confirm?.title}
        message={confirm?.message}
        confirmLabel={confirm?.confirmLabel}
        destructive={confirm?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          confirm?.onConfirm?.();
          setConfirm(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/PaymentHistoryScreen.js
//
// Port of pages/hirer/HirerPaymentHistory.jsx.
//
// Currency switcher: uses `format` from useCurrency() — the SAME function
// DashboardScreen uses. `format` reads `currencyCode` (set by CurrencyPicker
// via setCurrencyCode), so tapping the picker changes every displayed amount
// here immediately, identical to the Dashboard.
//
// `fmt` from useCurrency reads `dashboardCurrency` — a separate state field
// CurrencyPicker does NOT change. Using `fmt` was why the switcher had no
// effect. We use `format` throughout.
//
// Receipt modal + receipt HTML deliberately use the payment's OWN currency
// (payment.currency), because a receipt must reflect the actual transaction,
// not the user's display preference.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Alert,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import * as Print from "expo-print";

import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import Skeleton from "../../components/Skeleton";
import CurrencyPicker from "../../components/CurrencyPicker";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useCurrency, CURRENCY_META } from "../../contexts/CurrencyContext";
import { getHirerFeeRate } from "../../utils/pricing";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaSearch,
  FaTimes,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaChevronLeft,
  FaChevronRight,
  FaInbox,
} from "../../icons/fa";

const LIMIT = 10;

// ── Status config ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STATUS_META = {

  RELEASED: { label: "Released", key: "released" },

};

const BOOKING_STATUS_META = {

};

// ── Utility ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtMoneyNative(amount, currency) {
  // ALWAYS native currency — used only by the receipt.
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: currency || "USD",
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(amount ?? 0);
  } catch {
    return `${currency || "USD"} ${Number(amount ?? 0).toFixed(2)}`;
  }
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function fmtDateTime(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase() || "?";
}

function formatDateLong(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "long",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function getPaymentChannel(tx) {
  if (tx.provider === "PAYSTACK" || tx.provider?.includes("PAYSTACK")) {
    return { label: "Card (Paystack)" };
  }
  if (tx.provider === "FLUTTERWAVE" || tx.provider?.includes("FLUTTERWAVE")) {
    return { label: "Card / Mobile Money" };
  }
  return { label: tx.provider || "Payment" };
}

// Rough luminance — used only to pick dark/light receipt colors.
function bgLuminance(color) {
  if (!color) return 0.5;
  let r = 0,
    g = 0,
    b = 0;
  if (color.startsWith("#")) {
    const hex = color.replace("#", "");
    if (hex.length === 3) {
      r = parseInt(hex[0] + hex[0], 16);
      g = parseInt(hex[1] + hex[1], 16);
      b = parseInt(hex[2] + hex[2], 16);
    } else if (hex.length >= 6) {
      r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
      g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
      b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
    }
  } else if (color.startsWith("rgb")) {
    const m = color.match(/[\d.]+/g);
    if (m) {
      r = Number(m[0]);
      g = Number(m[1]);
      b = Number(m[2]);
    }
  }
  return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255;
}

function statusColors(key, c) {
  switch (key) {
    case "escrow":
      return { bg: "rgba(234,179,8,0.12)", fg: "#eab308" };
    case "released":
      return { bg: c.greenDim, fg: c.green };
    case "pending":
      return { bg: c.orangeDim, fg: c.orange };
    case "refunded":
      return { bg: "rgba(139,92,246,0.12)", fg: "#a78bfa" };
    case "failed":
      return { bg: c.redDim, fg: c.red };
    default:
      return { bg: c.orangeDim, fg: c.orange };
  }
}

// ── Receipt HTML — native currency ──────────────────────────────────────
function generateReceiptHTML(payment, isDark) {
  const channel = getPaymentChannel(payment);
  const feeRate = getHirerFeeRate(payment.currency);
  const feePercent = Math.round(feeRate * 100);

  const bg = isDark ? "#080810" : "#f8f9fa";
  const panel = isDark ? "#0c0c18" : "#ffffff";
  const text = isDark ? "#ffffff" : "#1a1a2e";
  const textDim = isDark ? "#a1a1aa" : "#6b7280";
  const border = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" : "#e5e7eb";
  const borderDash = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" : "#e5e7eb";
  const footerBg = isDark ? "#0c0c18" : "#f9fafb";

  const statusLabel =
    STATUS_CONFIG_LABEL[payment.status] || payment.status || "—";

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Receipt - ${payment.id}</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; background: ${bg}; color: ${text}; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; padding: 20px; }
    .receipt { max-width: 520px; width: 100%; background: ${panel}; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid ${border}; }
    .receipt-header { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316 0%, #ea580c 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 32px 32px 24px; text-align: center; }
    .receipt-header h1 { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; }
    .receipt-header .subtitle { font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.9; margin-top: 4px; color: #fff; }
    .receipt-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 16px; padding: 6px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; }
    .receipt-amount { text-align: center; padding: 28px 32px 24px; border-bottom: 2px dashed ${borderDash}; }
    .receipt-amount .label { font-size: 12px; color: ${textDim}; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 700; }
    .receipt-amount .value { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 8px; }
    .receipt-amount .value.debit { color: #ef4444; }
    .receipt-amount .channel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(249,115,22,0.15); color: #f97316; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
    .receipt-body { padding: 24px 32px; }
    .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid ${border}; gap: 16px; }
    .row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .row .label { color: ${textDim}; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .row .value { color: ${text}; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; word-break: break-word; }
    .row .value.mono { font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; }
    .row.section-title { padding-top: 18px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: none; }
    .row.section-title .label { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: ${textDim}; font-weight: 800; }
    .fee-row { color: #f97316; }
    .net-row { margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 2px solid ${border}; border-bottom: none; }
    .net-row .label { font-weight: 700; color: ${text}; }
    .net-row .value { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #22c55e; }
    .receipt-footer { padding: 24px 32px; background: ${footerBg}; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: ${textDim}; }
    .receipt-footer strong { color: ${text}; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="receipt">
    <div class="receipt-header">
      <h1>SkilledProz</h1>
      <p class="subtitle">Transaction Receipt</p>
      <div class="receipt-status">${statusLabel}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="receipt-amount">
      <div class="label">Amount Charged</div>
      <div class="value debit">- ${fmtMoneyNative(payment.amount, payment.currency)}</div>
      <div class="channel">${channel.label}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="receipt-body">
      <div class="row section-title"><span class="label">Transaction</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Receipt ID</span><span class="value mono">#${String(payment.id).slice(0, 12).toUpperCase()}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Type</span><span class="value">Payment</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Date</span><span class="value">${formatDateLong(payment.createdAt)}</span></div>
      <div class="row section-title"><span class="label">Booking Details</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Service</span><span class="value">${payment.booking?.title || "—"}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Worker</span><span class="value">${payment.booking?.worker?.firstName || ""} ${payment.booking?.worker?.lastName || ""}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Hirer</span><span class="value">${payment.booking?.hirer?.firstName || ""} ${payment.booking?.hirer?.lastName || ""}</span></div>
      <div class="row section-title"><span class="label">Breakdown</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Worker's Earnings</span><span class="value">${fmtMoneyNative(payment.workerPayout || payment.amount * (1 - feeRate), payment.currency)}</span></div>
      <div class="row fee-row"><span class="label">Platform Fee (${feePercent}%)</span><span class="value">+ ${fmtMoneyNative(payment.platformFee || payment.amount * feeRate, payment.currency)}</span></div>
      <div class="row net-row"><span class="label">Total Paid</span><span class="value">${fmtMoneyNative(payment.amount, payment.currency)}</span></div>
      ${
        payment.provider || payment.providerRef
          ? `
      <div class="row section-title"><span class="label">Payment Details</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Provider</span><span class="value">${payment.provider || "—"}</span></div>
      ${payment.providerRef ? `<div class="row"><span class="label">Provider Ref</span><span class="value mono">${payment.providerRef}</span></div>` : ""}
      `
          : ""
      }
    </div>
    <div class="receipt-footer">
      <p>Thank you for using <strong>SkilledProz</strong></p>
      <p style="margin-top: 6px;">This is an electronically generated receipt. No signature required.</p>
      <p style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px;">skilledproz.com · support@skilledproz.com</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
}

// ── Receipt Modal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReceiptModal({ payment, onClose, c, isDark }) {
  const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false);
  if (!payment) return null;

  const { booking } = payment;
  const hirer = booking?.hirer ?? {};
  const worker = booking?.worker ?? {};
  const statusMeta = STATUS_META[payment.status] ?? {
    label: payment.status,
    key: "pending",
  };
  const sc = statusColors(statusMeta.key, c);

  const feeRate = getHirerFeeRate(payment.currency);
  const feePercent = Math.round(feeRate * 100);
  const workerPayout = payment.workerPayout ?? payment.amount * (1 - feeRate);
  const platformFee = payment.platformFee ?? payment.amount * feeRate;

  const handlePrint = async () => {
    setPrinting(true);
    try {
      await Print.printAsync({
        html: generateReceiptHTML(payment, isDark),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert(
        "Print failed",
        err?.message || "Could not open the print dialog.",
      );
    } finally {
      setPrinting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "rgba(8,8,16,0.9)" }}>
        <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1 }} edges={["top", "bottom"]}>
          <ScrollView
            contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40 }}
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          >
            <View
              style={{
                backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                borderRadius: 16,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                padding: 20,
                gap: 18,
              }}
            >
              {/* Header */}
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                }}
              >
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}
                >
                  <View
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: c.orange,
                      paddingHorizontal: 6,
                      paddingVertical: 3,
                      borderRadius: 5,
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: "700",
                        color: "#000",
                      }}
                    >
                      SP
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: c.text,
                    }}
                  >
                    SkilledProz
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={onClose}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    {
                      width: 30,
                      height: 30,
                      borderRadius: 6,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgInput || c.bgCard,
                      borderWidth: 1,
                      borderColor: c.border,
                      alignItems: "center",
                      justifyContent: "center",
                      opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <FaTimes size={13} color={c.textDim} />
                </Pressable>
              </View>

              {/* Title + status pill */}
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  gap: 10,
                  flexWrap: "wrap",
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 20,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: c.text,
                  }}
                >
                  Payment Receipt
                </AppText>
                <View
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: sc.bg,
                    paddingHorizontal: 10,
                    paddingVertical: 4,
                    borderRadius: 999,
                  }}

                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: sc.fg,
