function MetaItem({ label, value, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexBasis: "45%", minWidth: 120 }}>
      <AppText style={labelStyle(c)}>{label}</AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
          fontSize: 12,
          color: c.textDim,
          marginTop: 2,
        }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

const rowBetween = {
  flexDirection: "row",
  justifyContent: "space-between",
  alignItems: "center",
  gap: 10,
};

const labelStyle = (c) => ({
  fontSize: 10,
  fontWeight: "700",
  color: c.textMuted,
  letterSpacing: 0.7,
  textTransform: "uppercase",
});

const dimText = (c) => ({
  fontSize: 14,
  color: c.textDim,
});

// ── Summary card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SummaryCard({ label, value, sub, accent, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flex: 1,
        minWidth: 140,
        backgroundColor: accent ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.06)" : c.bgCard,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: accent ? c.orangeGlow : c.border,
        borderRadius: 12,
        padding: 16,
        gap: 4,
      }}
    >
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 11,
          color: c.textDim,
          letterSpacing: 0.7,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        numberOfLines={1}
        adjustsFontSizeToFit
        minimumFontScale={0.7}
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 20,
          fontWeight: "700",
          color: accent ? c.orange : c.text,
          marginTop: 2,
        }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
      {sub ? (
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>{sub}</AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Payment card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// `format` comes straight from useCurrency() — it reads `currencyCode`,
// which CurrencyPicker changes via setCurrencyCode. This is the exact same
// function DashboardScreen uses on its Total Spent card.
function PaymentCard({ payment, onOpenReceipt, c, format }) {
  const statusMeta = STATUS_META[payment.status] ?? {
    label: payment.status,
    key: "pending",
  };
  const sc = statusColors(statusMeta.key, c);
  const worker = payment.booking?.worker ?? {};
  const bookingStatus = BOOKING_STATUS_META[payment.booking?.status];
  const rowFeePercent = Math.round(getHirerFeeRate(payment.currency) * 100);

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: c.border,
        borderRadius: 12,
        padding: 14,
        gap: 12,
      }}
    >
      {/* Top row: job + status */}
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          gap: 10,
        }}
      >
        <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <AppText
            numberOfLines={1}
            style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}
          >
            {payment.booking?.title ?? "—"}
          </AppText>
          {payment.booking?.category?.name ? (
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 2 }}
            >
              {payment.booking.category.name}
            </AppText>
          ) : null}
          {bookingStatus ? (
            <View
              style={{
                alignSelf: "flex-start",
                marginTop: 6,
                backgroundColor: statusColors(bookingStatus.key, c).bg,
                paddingHorizontal: 7,
                paddingVertical: 2,
                borderRadius: 999,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 9,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: statusColors(bookingStatus.key, c).fg,
                }}
              >
                {bookingStatus.label}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>
        <View
          style={{
            alignSelf: "flex-start",
            backgroundColor: sc.bg,
            paddingHorizontal: 9,
            paddingVertical: 3,
            borderRadius: 999,
          }}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700", color: sc.fg }}>
            {statusMeta.label}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Worker + date */}
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          gap: 10,
        }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 8,
            flex: 1,
            minWidth: 0,
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              width: 28,
              height: 28,
              borderRadius: 14,
              backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
              overflow: "hidden",
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            {worker.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: worker.avatar }}
                style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: c.orange,
                }}
              >
                {initials(worker.firstName, worker.lastName)}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          <AppText
            numberOfLines={1}
            style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.text, flex: 1 }}
          >
            {`${worker.firstName || ""} ${worker.lastName || ""}`.trim() || "—"}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>
          {fmtDate(payment.createdAt)}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Amount block — uses format(amount), which reflects currencyCode */}
      <View
        style={{
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderRadius: 9,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
          padding: 10,
          gap: 4,
        }}
      >
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontFamily: "Syne_700Bold",
            fontSize: 15,
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.text,
          }}
        >
          {format(payment.amount)}
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
          Worker gets{" "}
          <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.green }}>100%</AppText>{" "}
          ({format(payment.workerPayout)})
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.orange, fontWeight: "600" }}>
          {`Platform fee: ${rowFeePercent}%`}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Actions */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={onOpenReceipt}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          {
            alignSelf: "flex-start",
            backgroundColor: c.bgInput || c.bgCard,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: c.border,
            borderRadius: 7,
            paddingHorizontal: 14,
            paddingVertical: 6,
            opacity: pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}>
          Receipt
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Skeleton rows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SkeletonRows({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
      {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
        <Skeleton
          key={i}
          width="100%"
          height={150}
          radius={12}
          style={{ backgroundColor: c.bgPanel }}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Empty state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EmptyState({ c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        alignItems: "center",
        paddingVertical: 56,
        paddingHorizontal: 20,
        backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: c.border,
        borderRadius: 14,
        gap: 8,
      }}
    >
      <FaInbox size={40} color={c.textMuted} />
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}>
        No transactions yet
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 12,
          color: c.textMuted,
          textAlign: "center",
          maxWidth: 300,
        }}
      >
        Your payment history will appear here once you book a worker.
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Main screen ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function PaymentHistoryScreen() {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const isDark = bgLuminance(c.bg) < 0.5;

  // `format` is the SAME currency formatter DashboardScreen uses.
  // It reads `currencyCode` under the hood (via CurrencyContext's `code`),
  // which CurrencyPicker updates through setCurrencyCode. That's why
  // tapping the picker changes every displayed amount below.
  const { format } = useCurrency();

  const [payments, setPayments] = useState([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [statusFilter, setStatus] = useState("ALL");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [currencyFilter, setCurrency] = useState("ALL");
  const [availableCurrencies, setAvailableCurrencies] = useState([]);

  // Fetch
  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    const params = { page, limit: LIMIT };
    if (statusFilter !== "ALL") params.status = statusFilter;
    if (currencyFilter !== "ALL") params.currency = currencyFilter;

    client
      .get("/payments/hirer", { params })
      .then((res) => {
        const d = res.data.data ?? res.data;
        setPayments(d.payments ?? []);
        setTotal(d.total ?? 0);
        setTotalPages(d.pages ?? 1);
        setSummary(d.summary ?? null);
        setAvailableCurrencies(d.availableCurrencies ?? []);
      })
      .catch(() => setError("Failed to load payment history."))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [page, statusFilter, currencyFilter]);

  // Client-side search
  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    if (!search.trim()) return payments;
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return payments.filter(
      (p) =>
        p.booking?.title?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.booking?.worker?.firstName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.booking?.worker?.lastName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.id?.toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }, [payments, search]);

  // Derived summary (client-side fallback if summary omitted)
  const totalSpent =
    summary?.totalSpent ??
    payments
      .filter((p) => p.status === "RELEASED")
      .reduce((s, p) => s + (p.amount ?? 0), 0);
  const inEscrow =
    summary?.inEscrow ??
    payments
      .filter((p) => p.status === "HELD")
      .reduce((s, p) => s + (p.amount ?? 0), 0);
  const totalRefunds =
    summary?.totalRefunds ??
    payments
      .filter((p) => p.status === "REFUNDED")
      .reduce((s, p) => s + (p.amount ?? 0), 0);

  const statusTabList = ["ALL", "HELD", "RELEASED", "REFUNDED", "FAILED"];

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      edges={["top", "left", "right"]}
    >
      <FlatList
        data={loading ? [] : visible}
        keyExtractor={(p) => String(p.id)}
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40, gap: 10 }}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View style={{ gap: 16, marginBottom: 10 }}>
            {/* Page header */}
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "flex-start",
                gap: 12,
                flexWrap: "wrap",
              }}
            >
              <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 22,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    color: c.text,
                    letterSpacing: -0.3,
                  }}
                >
                  Payment History
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 2 }}
                >
                  All transactions and receipts
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <CurrencyPicker compact />
            </View>

            {/* Summary row — uses format(), same as Dashboard Total Spent */}
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10 }}>
              <SummaryCard
                label="Total Spent"
                value={format(totalSpent)}
                sub={`${total} transaction${total !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
                accent
                c={c}
              />
              <SummaryCard
                label="In Escrow"
                value={format(inEscrow)}
                sub="Awaiting release"
                c={c}
              />
              <SummaryCard
                label="Refunded"
                value={format(totalRefunds)}
                sub="Returned to you"
                c={c}
              />
            </View>

            {/* Search */}
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput || c.bgCard,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 9,
                paddingHorizontal: 12,
                paddingVertical: 4,
              }}
            >
              <FaSearch size={14} color={c.textDim} />
              <TextInput
                value={search}
                onChangeText={setSearch}
                placeholder="Search by job, worker, or ID…"
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  marginLeft: 8,
                  color: c.text,
                  fontSize: 13,
                  paddingVertical: 8,
                }}
              />
              {search ? (
                <Pressable onPress={() => setSearch("")} hitSlop={6}>
                  <FaTimes size={14} color={c.textDim} />
                </Pressable>
              ) : null}
            </View>

            {/* Status tabs */}
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingRight: 8 }}
            >
              {statusTabList.map((s) => {
                const active = statusFilter === s;
                const label =
                  s === "ALL" ? "All" : (STATUS_META[s]?.label ?? s);
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={s}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setStatus(s);
                      setPage(1);
                    }}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      {
                        paddingHorizontal: 12,
                        paddingVertical: 6,
                        borderRadius: 999,
                        borderWidth: 1,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : "transparent",
                        opacity: pressed ? 0.8 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                        fontWeight: "600",
                      }}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>

            {/* Currency filter — server-side filter, independent of picker */}
            {availableCurrencies.length > 0 ? (
              <ScrollView
                horizontal
                showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
                contentContainerStyle={{
                  gap: 6,
                  alignItems: "center",
                  paddingRight: 8,
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: c.textMuted,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    marginRight: 4,
                  }}
                >
                  Currency:
                </AppText>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => {
                    setCurrency("ALL");
                    setPage(1);
                  }}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    {
                      paddingHorizontal: 12,
                      paddingVertical: 6,
                      borderRadius: 999,
                      borderWidth: 1,
                      borderColor:
                        currencyFilter === "ALL" ? c.orange : c.border,
                      backgroundColor:
                        currencyFilter === "ALL" ? c.orangeDim : "transparent",
                      opacity: pressed ? 0.8 : 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: currencyFilter === "ALL" ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                      fontWeight: "600",
                    }}
                  >
                    All
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
                {availableCurrencies.map((cur) => {
                  const active = currencyFilter === cur;
                  return (
                    <Pressable
                      key={cur}
                      onPress={() => {
                        setCurrency(cur);
                        setPage(1);
                      }}
                      style={({ pressed }) => [
                        {
                          paddingHorizontal: 12,
                          paddingVertical: 6,
                          borderRadius: 999,
                          borderWidth: 1,
                          borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                          backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : "transparent",
                          opacity: pressed ? 0.8 : 1,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        style={{
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                          fontWeight: "600",
                        }}
                      >
                        {`${CURRENCY_META?.[cur]?.symbol || ""} ${cur}`.trim()}
                      </AppText>
                    </Pressable>
                  );
                })}
              </ScrollView>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <PaymentCard
            payment={item}
            onOpenReceipt={() => setReceipt(item)}
            c={c}
            format={format}
          />
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          error ? (
            <View style={{ padding: 40, alignItems: "center" }}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.red }}>{error}</AppText>
            </View>
          ) : loading ? (
            <SkeletonRows c={c} />
          ) : (
            <EmptyState c={c} />
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          !loading && totalPages > 1 ? (
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                gap: 16,
                marginTop: 20,
              }}
            >
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                disabled={page === 1}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 4,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    paddingHorizontal: 12,
                    paddingVertical: 8,
                    opacity: page === 1 ? 0.35 : pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaChevronLeft size={11} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>
                  Prev
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>
                {`Page ${page} of ${totalPages}`}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                disabled={page === totalPages}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 4,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    paddingHorizontal: 12,
                    paddingVertical: 8,
                    opacity: page === totalPages ? 0.35 : pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim }}>
                  Next
                </AppText>
                <FaChevronRight size={11} color={c.textDim} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : null
        }
      />

      {receipt ? (
        <ReceiptModal
          payment={receipt}
          onClose={() => setReceipt(null)}
          c={c}
          isDark={isDark}
        />
      ) : null}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/PlaceholderScreen.js
import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * PlaceholderScreen — used for drawer items whose real screens haven't been
 * built yet (Bookings, PostJob, Disputes, etc.). It shows a friendly
 * "coming soon" with the route name so the user always lands somewhere
 * coherent instead of seeing a crash.
 *
 * As we ship each real screen, swap it in via HirerNavigator and this one
 * stops being referenced.
 */
export default function PlaceholderScreen() {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const route = useRoute();
  const navigation = useNavigation();

  return (
    <AppScreen scroll={false}>
      <View style={styles.center}>
        <View
          style={[styles.icon, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.orangeDim }]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="construct-outline"
            size={32}
            color={theme.colors.orange}
          />
        </View>

        <AppText
          variant="displaySm"
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={{ marginTop: 20, textAlign: "center" }}
        >
          {prettify(route.name)}
        </AppText>

        <AppText
          variant="subtitle"
          tone="dim"
          style={{ marginTop: 8, textAlign: "center" }}
        >
          This screen is coming soon.
        </AppText>

        <AppButton
          title="Back to Dashboard"
          variant="primary"
          fullWidth={false}
          style={{ marginTop: 24 }}
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Dashboard")}
        />
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

function prettify(name) {
  return (name || "Screen").replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").trim();
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

  icon: {
    width: 72,
    height: 72,
    borderRadius: 20,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
});

=== FILE: src/screens/main/PostDetailScreen.js ===
// src/screens/main/PostDetailScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of src/pages/PostDetail.jsx + PostDetail.module.css.
//
// Mapping reference:
//   useParams()                 → route.params?.id ?? route.params?.postId
//   useNavigate()               → navigation
//   useLocation()               → route
//   location.key === "default"  → !navigation.canGoBack()
//   navigate(-1)                → navigation.goBack()
//   navigate("/feed")           → navigation.navigate("CommunityFeed")
//   navigate("/login", state)   → navigation.navigate("Login", { from })
//   api.get(`/posts/${id}`)     → getPost(id) from src/api/posts.js
//   <PostCardSkeleton />        → <PostSkeleton /> (existing RN port)
//   <PostCard post onDelete />  → <PostCard post onDelete /> (identical)
//   showBack = isHydrated       → identical
//   .page maxWidth 640          → style capped at 640
//   .page padding 1rem / 480 → 0.75rem → responsive booleans

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import PostCard from "../../components/posts/PostCard";
import PostSkeleton from "../../components/posts/PostSkeleton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { getPost } from "../../api/posts";

export default function PostDetailScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { user, isHydrated } = useAuthStore();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  // Route param — the website uses :id; we accept both names
  const postId = route.params?.id ?? route.params?.postId;

  const [post, setPost] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;

  // Compact paddings — mirror @media (max-width: 480px) { .page { padding: 0.75rem } }
  const isCompact = width <= 480;

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    getPost(postId)
      .then((fetched) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setPost(fetched ?? null);
        if (!fetched) setError(t("posts.postNoLongerExists"));
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setError(
          err?.response?.status === 404
            ? t("posts.postNoLongerExists")
            : t("posts.postLoadFailed"),
        );
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [postId, t]);

  // ─── Smart back handler — verbatim from website ────────────
  const handleBack = () => {
    // 1. Not logged in → login page, remember where they came from
    if (!user) {
      navigation.navigate("Login", {
        from: route.name,
        params: route.params,
      });
      return;
    }

    // 2. Logged in but arrived via direct load (deep link / cold start).
    //    RN equivalent of `location.key === "default"` = "no previous screen".
    if (!navigation.canGoBack()) {
      navigation.navigate("CommunityFeed");
      return;
    }

    // 3. Logged in and arrived from within the app → normal back
    navigation.goBack();
  };

  // Wait until auth state has been restored — matches `const showBack = isHydrated`
  const showBack = isHydrated;

  return (
    <AppScreen
      scroll={false}
      contentContainerStyle={{
        // .page { max-width: 640; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem } — mirrored via wrapper
        flex: 1,
        alignItems: "center",
      }}
    >
      <ScrollView
        style={{ flex: 1, width: "100%" }}
        contentContainerStyle={{
          maxWidth: 640,
          width: "100%",
          alignSelf: "center",
          padding: isCompact ? 0.75 * 16 * fontScale : 16,
        }}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {/* ─── Back button (mirrors {showBack && <button className={styles.backBtn}>…} */}
        {showBack ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            hitSlop={8}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.backBtn,
              {
                marginBottom: 0.75 * 16 * fontScale,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                fontSize: rem(0.85),
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textDim,
              }}
            >
              ← {t("common.back")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}

        {/* ─── Loading — mirrors `{loading && <><PostCardSkeleton /><PostCardSkeleton /></>}` */}
        {loading ? (
          <View style={{ gap: rem(0.75) }}>
            <PostSkeleton />
            <PostSkeleton />
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* ─── Error state ──────────────────────────────────────
            Mirrors:
              <div className={styles.state}>
                <p className={styles.stateTitle}>{error}</p>
                <p className={styles.stateSub}>The post may have been deleted or made private.</p>
                <Link to="/feed" className={styles.stateLink}>Go to feed</Link>
              </div>
        */}
        {!loading && error ? (
          <View style={styles.state}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                fontSize: rem(0.95),
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.text,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              {error}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                fontSize: rem(0.82),
                color: c.textDim,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              {t("posts.postMayBeDeleted")}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("CommunityFeed")}
              hitSlop={8}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.stateLink,
                {
                  marginTop: rem(0.5),
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                  fontSize: rem(0.85),
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: c.orange,
                }}
              >
                {t("posts.goToFeed")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* ─── PostCard — mirrors `{!loading && post && <PostCard post={post} onDelete={() => navigate("/feed")} />}` */}
        {!loading && post ? (
          <PostCard
            post={post}
            onDelete={() => navigation.navigate("CommunityFeed")}
          />
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// ── Recurring pricing helpers (verbatim) ─────────────────────────────
const PERIODS_PER_RECURRENCE = {
  "2_WEEKS": {
    HOURLY: 14 * 8,
    DAILY: 14,
    WEEKLY: 2,
    MONTHLY: 14 / 30.44,
    YEARLY: 14 / 365,
  },
  "1_MONTH": {
    HOURLY: 30.44 * 8,
    DAILY: 30.44,
    WEEKLY: 4.33,
    MONTHLY: 1,
    YEARLY: 1 / 12,
  },
  "3_MONTHS": {
    HOURLY: 91.31 * 8,
    DAILY: 91.31,
    WEEKLY: 13,
    MONTHLY: 3,
    YEARLY: 0.25,
  },
  "6_MONTHS": {
    HOURLY: 182.62 * 8,
    DAILY: 182.62,
    WEEKLY: 26,
    MONTHLY: 6,
    YEARLY: 0.5,
  },
  "1_YEAR": { HOURLY: 365 * 8, DAILY: 365, WEEKLY: 52, MONTHLY: 12, YEARLY: 1 },
};

const DURATION_UNIT_FOR_BUDGET_TYPE = {
  HOURLY: "hours",
  DAILY: "days",
  WEEKLY: "weeks",
  MONTHLY: "months",
  YEARLY: "years",
};

function computeRecurringEstimated(recurrenceDuration, budgetType) {
  const table = PERIODS_PER_RECURRENCE[recurrenceDuration];
  const unit = DURATION_UNIT_FOR_BUDGET_TYPE[budgetType];
  if (!table || !unit) return null;
  const count = table[budgetType];
  if (!Number.isFinite(count) || count <= 0) return null;
  const rounded =
    unit === "hours" ? Math.round(count) : Number(count.toFixed(2));
  return { count: rounded, unit };
}

function toEstimatedHours(unit, value) {
  if (unit === "custom") return null;
  const v = parseFloat(value) || 0;
  if (unit === "hours") return v;
  if (unit === "days") return v * 8;
  if (unit === "weeks") return v * 56;
  if (unit === "months") return v * 242.5;
  if (unit === "years") return v * 2910;
  return null;
}
