// MAIN COMPONENT
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export default function PostJobScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [categoriesLoading, setCategoriesLoading] = useState(true);
  const [catSearch, setCatSearch] = useState("");
  const [showCustomCat, setShowCustomCat] = useState(false);
  const [customCatName, setCustomCatName] = useState("");
  const [addingCat, setAddingCat] = useState(false);

  const [postedJob, setPostedJob] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const [skillInput, setSkillInput] = useState("");
  const [qualificationInput, setQualificationInput] = useState("");
  const [showQualificationPresets, setShowQualificationPresets] =
    useState(false);
  const [showCurrencyPicker, setShowCurrencyPicker] = useState(false);
  const [showDatePicker, setShowDatePicker] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    categoryId: "",
    title: "",
    description: "",
    locationType: "REMOTE",
    address: "",
    latitude: "",
    longitude: "",
    jobType: "FULL_TIME",
    scheduledAt: "",
    languageRequirement: "en",
    scheduleMode: "ONE_OFF",
    durationUnit: "hours",
    durationCustomLabel: "",
    estimatedValue: "",
    recurrenceInterval: "WEEKLY",
    recurrenceDuration: "1_MONTH",
    budget: "",
    currency: "NGN",
    showRateOptions: false,
    budgetType: "HOURLY",
    budgetCustomLabel: "",
    providesAccommodation: false,
    providesMeals: false,
    qualifications: [],
    skills: [],
    notes: "",
  });

  // ── Load categories ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    client
      .get("/categories", { params: { all: true } })
      .then((res) => {
        const data = res?.data?.data;
        setCategories(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.categories || []);
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setCategoriesLoading(false));
  }, []);

  // ── Search filter ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const normalizedSearch = catSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filteredCats = useMemo(
    () =>
      categories.filter(
        (cat) =>
          !normalizedSearch ||
          cat.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch),
      ),
    [categories, normalizedSearch],
  );

  const selectedCat = categories.find((cat) => cat.id === form.categoryId);
  const isSearching = normalizedSearch.length > 0;
  const showSearchResults = isSearching && !selectedCat;

  const selectedLanguageLabel =
    ALL_LANGUAGES.find((l) => l.code === form.languageRequirement)?.label ||
    "English";

  const currencySymbol =
    CURRENCIES.find((cu) => cu.code === form.currency)?.symbol || form.currency;

  function set(key, val) {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: val }));
    setError("");
  }

  // ── Custom category ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleAddCustomCategory() {
    if (!customCatName.trim()) return;
    setAddingCat(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.post("/categories/suggest", {
        name: customCatName.trim(),
      });
      const newCat = res?.data?.data?.category;
      if (!newCat) throw new Error("No category returned");
      setCategories((prev) =>
        prev.some((cat) => cat.id === newCat.id) ? prev : [...prev, newCat],
      );
      setForm((f) => ({ ...f, categoryId: newCat.id }));
      setCustomCatName("");
      setShowCustomCat(false);
      setCatSearch("");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to add custom category");
    } finally {
      setAddingCat(false);
    }
  }

  function clearCategory() {
    set("categoryId", "");
    setCatSearch("");
  }

  // ── Skills ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function addSkill(skill) {
    const trimmed = skill.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    if (form.skills.includes(trimmed)) {
      setSkillInput("");
      return;
    }
    if (form.skills.length >= 20) {
      setError("Maximum 20 skills");
      return;
    }
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, skills: [...f.skills, trimmed] }));
    setSkillInput("");
    setError("");
  }

  function removeSkill(skill) {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, skills: f.skills.filter((s) => s !== skill) }));
  }

  // ── Qualifications ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function addQualification(qual) {
    const trimmed = qual.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    if (form.qualifications.includes(trimmed)) {
      setQualificationInput("");
      return;
    }
    if (form.qualifications.length >= 10) {
      setError("Maximum 10 qualifications");
      return;
    }
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      qualifications: [...f.qualifications, trimmed],
    }));
    setQualificationInput("");
    setError("");
  }

  function removeQualification(qual) {
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      qualifications: f.qualifications.filter((q) => q !== qual),
    }));
  }

  // ── Submit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleSubmit() {
    if (!form.categoryId) return setError("Please select a category.");
    if (!form.title) return setError("Job title is required.");
    if (!form.description) return setError("Description is required.");
    if (form.locationType !== "REMOTE" && !form.address)
      return setError(
        "Please enter a service address for on-site or hybrid jobs.",
      );
    if (!form.scheduledAt)
      return setError("Please choose a scheduled date and time.");
    if (form.scheduleMode === "ONE_OFF" && !form.estimatedValue) {
      return setError(
        form.durationUnit === "custom"
          ? "Please describe the duration."
          : "Please estimate how long the job will take.",
      );
    }
    if (!form.budget) return setError("Please enter a budget.");
    if (
      form.showRateOptions &&
      form.budgetType === "CUSTOM" &&
      !form.budgetCustomLabel.trim()
    )
      return setError("Please describe your custom pay rate.");

    const finalSkills = skillInput.trim()
      ? [...form.skills, skillInput.trim()].slice(0, 20)
      : form.skills;
    const finalQualifications = qualificationInput.trim()
      ? [...form.qualifications, qualificationInput.trim()].slice(0, 10)
      : form.qualifications;

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const clean = (v) =>
        v === "" || v === null || v === undefined ? undefined : v;

      let estimatedHours = null;
      let resolvedEstimatedUnit;
      let resolvedEstimatedValue;

      if (form.scheduleMode === "ONE_OFF") {
        estimatedHours = toEstimatedHours(
          form.durationUnit,
          form.estimatedValue,
        );
        resolvedEstimatedUnit =
          form.durationUnit === "custom" ? "custom" : form.durationUnit;
        resolvedEstimatedValue =
          form.durationUnit === "custom"
            ? form.estimatedValue.trim()
            : clean(form.estimatedValue);
      } else {
        const effectiveBudgetType = form.showRateOptions
          ? form.budgetType
          : "FIXED";
        const recurring = computeRecurringEstimated(
          form.recurrenceDuration,
          effectiveBudgetType,
        );
        if (recurring) {
          estimatedHours = recurring.unit === "hours" ? recurring.count : null;
          resolvedEstimatedUnit = recurring.unit;
          resolvedEstimatedValue = String(recurring.count);
        }
      }

      const noteParts = [];
      if (form.scheduleMode === "RECURRING") {
        const intervalLabel =
          RECURRENCE_INTERVALS.find((i) => i.value === form.recurrenceInterval)
            ?.label || form.recurrenceInterval;
        const durationLabel =
          RECURRENCE_DURATIONS.find(
            (d) => d.value === form.recurrenceDuration,
          )?.label?.toLowerCase() || form.recurrenceDuration;
        noteParts.push(`Recurring: ${intervalLabel} ${durationLabel}.`);
      } else if (form.durationUnit === "custom" && form.estimatedValue) {
        noteParts.push(`Duration: ${form.estimatedValue.trim()}.`);
      }
      if (form.notes) noteParts.push(form.notes);
      const finalNotes = noteParts.join(" ");

      const payload = {
        categoryId: form.categoryId,
        title: form.title,
        description: form.description,
        locationType: form.locationType,
        address: form.locationType !== "REMOTE" ? form.address : undefined,
        latitude: form.latitude ? parseFloat(form.latitude) : undefined,
        longitude: form.longitude ? parseFloat(form.longitude) : undefined,
        jobType: form.jobType,
        scheduledAt: new Date(form.scheduledAt).toISOString(),
        estimatedHours: estimatedHours ?? undefined,
        estimatedUnit: resolvedEstimatedUnit,
        estimatedValue: resolvedEstimatedValue,
        budget: parseFloat(form.budget),
        currency: clean(form.currency),
        budgetType: form.showRateOptions ? form.budgetType : "FIXED",
        skills: finalSkills,
        notes: clean(finalNotes),
        languageRequirement: form.languageRequirement || "en",
        qualifications: finalQualifications,
        providesAccommodation: form.providesAccommodation,
        providesMeals: form.providesMeals,
      };

      const res = await client.post("/jobs", payload);
      const job = res?.data?.data?.jobPost;
      setPostedJob(job);
      setSubmitted(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.message || "Failed to post job.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function resetForm() {
    setSubmitted(false);
    setPostedJob(null);
    setError("");
    setForm({
      categoryId: "",
      title: "",
      description: "",
      locationType: "REMOTE",
      address: "",
      latitude: "",
      longitude: "",
      jobType: "FULL_TIME",
      scheduledAt: "",
      languageRequirement: "en",
      scheduleMode: "ONE_OFF",
      durationUnit: "hours",
      durationCustomLabel: "",
      estimatedValue: "",
      recurrenceInterval: "WEEKLY",
      recurrenceDuration: "1_MONTH",
      budget: "",
      currency: "NGN",
      showRateOptions: false,
      budgetType: "HOURLY",
      budgetCustomLabel: "",
      providesAccommodation: false,
      providesMeals: false,
      qualifications: [],
      skills: [],
      notes: "",
    });
    setSkillInput("");
    setQualificationInput("");
    setCatSearch("");
    setShowQualificationPresets(false);
    setShowCustomCat(false);
    setCustomCatName("");
  }

  // ── Categories loading ────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (categoriesLoading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <PageSkeleton variant="form" />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // SUCCESS STATE
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (submitted && postedJob) {
    const hirer = postedJob.hirer;
    const applicationsCount = postedJob._count?.applications ?? 0;

    return (
      <AppScreen contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
        <View style={styles.successState}>
          <FaTarget size={52} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 24,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              marginTop: 14,
              textAlign: "center",
            }}
          >
            Job Posted!
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              color: c.textDim,
              marginTop: 8,
              textAlign: "center",
              lineHeight: 19,
            }}
          >
            Your job{" "}
            <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
              "{postedJob.title}"
            </AppText>{" "}
            is now live on the platform.
          </AppText>

          {/* Success card */}
          <View
            style={[
              styles.successCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: c.orange,
                textTransform: "uppercase",
                letterSpacing: 0.8,
                marginBottom: 4,
              }}
            >
              {postedJob.category?.icon} {postedJob.category?.name}
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "600", color: c.text }}>
              {postedJob.title}
            </AppText>

            {hirer ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaUser size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text={`${hirer.firstName} ${hirer.lastName}`}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}

            <SuccessMeta
              icon={<FaMapMarkerAlt size={11} color={c.orange} />}
              text={
                postedJob.locationType === "REMOTE"
                  ? "Remote"
                  : postedJob.address || "—"
              }
              c={c}
            />

            <SuccessMeta
              icon={<FaDollarSign size={11} color={c.orange} />}
              text={`${postedJob.currency} ${Number(postedJob.budget).toLocaleString()}${
                postedJob.budgetType === "FIXED" || !postedJob.budgetType
                  ? " total"
                  : ` · ${BUDGET_TYPES.find((t) => t.value === postedJob.budgetType)?.label}`
              }`}
              c={c}
            />

            {postedJob.estimatedValue ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaClock size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text={`Est. ${postedJob.estimatedValue} ${postedJob.estimatedUnit || ""}`}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}

            {postedJob.jobType ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaBriefcase size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text={
                  JOB_TYPES.find((t) => t.value === postedJob.jobType)?.label
                }
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}

            {postedJob.scheduledAt ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text={new Date(postedJob.scheduledAt).toLocaleString()}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}

            {postedJob.languageRequirement ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaGlobe size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text={
                  ALL_LANGUAGES.find(
                    (l) => l.code === postedJob.languageRequirement,
                  )?.label || postedJob.languageRequirement
                }
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}

            {postedJob.qualifications?.length > 0 ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaAward size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text={`${postedJob.qualifications.length} qualification${postedJob.qualifications.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} required`}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}

            {postedJob.skills?.length > 0 ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaTag size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text={`${postedJob.skills.length} skill${postedJob.skills.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} required`}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}

            {postedJob.providesAccommodation ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaHome size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text="Accommodation provided"
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {postedJob.providesMeals ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaCoffee size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text="Meals provided"
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}

            <SuccessMeta
              icon={<FaUsers size={11} color={c.orange} />}
              text={`${applicationsCount} applicant${applicationsCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""} so far`}
              c={c}
            />

            {postedJob.notes ? (
              <SuccessMeta
                icon={<FaAlignLeft size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                text={postedJob.notes}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
          </View>

          <View style={styles.successActions}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("JobsManagement")}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.successPrimaryBtn,
                { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1 },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}>
                View My Jobs
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={resetForm}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.successSecondaryBtn,
                { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
              >
                Post Another Job
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // FORM
  // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  return (
    <AppScreen contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
      {/* ── Header ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 10,
          fontWeight: "700",
          color: c.orange,
          letterSpacing: 1.5,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          marginBottom: 4,
        }}
      >
        Hiring
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 24,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color: c.text,
          letterSpacing: -0.4,
        }}
      >
        Post a Job
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 13,
          color: c.textDim,
          marginTop: 6,
          marginBottom: 20,
          lineHeight: 19,
        }}
      >
        Describe what you need and connect with skilled workers.
      </AppText>

      {/* ── Category ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Category" required c={c}>
        {selectedCat ? (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.selectedCat,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
                borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.2)",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaCheckCircle size={12} color={c.green} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                color: c.green,
                marginLeft: 6,
                flex: 1,
              }}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              Selected:{" "}
              <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700" }}>
                {selectedCat.icon} {selectedCat.name}
              </AppText>
            </AppText>
            <Pressable onPress={clearCategory} hitSlop={6}>
              <FaX size={12} color={c.green} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <>
            <TextInput
              value={catSearch}
              onChangeText={setCatSearch}
              placeholder="Search categories..."
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              style={[
                styles.input,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  marginBottom: 6,
                },
              ]}
            />
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingRight: 8 }}
            >
              {filteredCats.slice(0, 20).map((cat) => (
                <Pressable
                  key={cat.id}
                  onPress={() => {
                    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, categoryId: cat.id }));
                    setCatSearch("");
                  }}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.categoryPill,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                      borderColor: c.border,
                      opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.text }}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {cat.icon ? `${cat.icon} ` : ""}
                    {cat.name}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              ))}
            </ScrollView>
            {showSearchResults && filteredCats.length === 0 ? (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}
              >
                No categories match "{catSearch.trim()}"
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}

        {!selectedCat ? (
          <>
            {!showCustomCat ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setShowCustomCat(true)}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.addCatBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
                ]}
              >
                <FaPlus size={10} color={c.textDim} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.textDim,
                    marginLeft: 4,
                  }}
                >
                  Can't find your category? Add a custom one
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ) : (
              <View style={{ marginTop: 8, gap: 6 }}>
                <TextInput
                  value={customCatName}
                  onChangeText={setCustomCatName}
                  placeholder="Category name e.g. Solar Panel Installation"
                  placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                  autoFocus
                  style={[
                    styles.input,
                    {
                      color: c.text,
                      borderColor: c.border,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                    },
                  ]}
                />
                <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 6 }}>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={handleAddCustomCategory}
                    disabled={addingCat || !customCatName.trim()}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.smallPrimaryBtn,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: c.orange,
                        opacity:
                          addingCat || !customCatName.trim()
                            ? 0.5
                            : pressed
                              ? 0.9
                              : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: "700",
                        color: c.bg,
                      }}
                    >
                      {addingCat ? "Adding…" : "Add Category"}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => {
                      setShowCustomCat(false);
                      setCustomCatName("");
                    }}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.smallSecondaryBtn,
                      { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: "600",
                        color: c.textDim,
                      }}
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              </View>
            )}
          </>
        ) : null}
      </Field>

      {/* ── Title ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Job Title" required c={c}>
        <TextInput
          value={form.title}
          onChangeText={(v) => set("title", v)}
          placeholder="e.g. Fix leaking bathroom pipe"
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[
            styles.input,
            {
              color: c.text,
              borderColor: c.border,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
            },
          ]}
        />
      </Field>

      {/* ── Description ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Description" required c={c}>
        <TextInput
          value={form.description}
          onChangeText={(v) => set("description", v)}
          placeholder="Describe the job in detail..."
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          multiline
          numberOfLines={4}
          textAlignVertical="top"
          style={[
            styles.textarea,
            {
              color: c.text,
              borderColor: c.border,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
            },
          ]}
        />
      </Field>

      {/* ── Job Type ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Job Type" c={c}>
        <OptionGrid
          options={JOB_TYPES}
          value={form.jobType}
          onChange={(v) => set("jobType", v)}
          c={c}
        />
      </Field>

      {/* ── Location Type ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Work Location" c={c}>
        <OptionGrid
          options={LOCATION_TYPES}
          value={form.locationType}
          onChange={(v) => set("locationType", v)}
          c={c}
        />
      </Field>

      {/* ── Address (if not remote) ─────────────────────────────── */}
      {form.locationType !== "REMOTE" ? (
        <Field label="Service Address" required c={c}>
          <TextInput
            value={form.address}
            onChangeText={(v) => set("address", v)}
            placeholder="Full address where work will be done"
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            style={[
              styles.input,
              {
                color: c.text,
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              },
            ]}
          />
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <TextInput
              value={form.latitude}
              onChangeText={(v) => set("latitude", v.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ""))}
              placeholder="Latitude (optional)"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              keyboardType="decimal-pad"
              style={[
                styles.input,
                {
                  flex: 1,
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            />
            <TextInput
              value={form.longitude}
              onChangeText={(v) => set("longitude", v.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ""))}
              placeholder="Longitude (optional)"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              keyboardType="decimal-pad"
              style={[
                styles.input,
                {
                  flex: 1,
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            />
          </View>
        </Field>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Scheduled Date ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Scheduled Date & Time" required c={c}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setShowDatePicker(true)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.input,
            {
              justifyContent: "center",
              borderColor: c.border,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              color: form.scheduledAt ? c.text : c.textMuted,
            }}
          >
            {form.scheduledAt
              ? new Date(form.scheduledAt).toLocaleString()
              : "Tap to choose a date and time"}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
        {showDatePicker ? (
          <DateTimePicker
            value={form.scheduledAt ? new Date(form.scheduledAt) : new Date()}
            mode="datetime"
            display="default"
            onChange={(event, selectedDate) => {
              setShowDatePicker(false);
              if (event.type === "dismissed") return;
              if (selectedDate) {
                set("scheduledAt", selectedDate.toISOString());
              }
            }}
          />
        ) : null}
      </Field>

      {/* ── Language ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Language Requirement" c={c}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          What language should the worker speak fluently?
        </AppText>
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingRight: 8 }}
        >
          {ALL_LANGUAGES.map((l) => {
            const active = form.languageRequirement === l.code;
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={l.code}
                onPress={() => set("languageRequirement", l.code)}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.pill,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                    opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  {l.label}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </ScrollView>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 8 }}>
          ✓ Workers must speak{" "}
          <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
            {selectedLanguageLabel}
          </AppText>
        </AppText>
      </Field>

      {/* ── Schedule Mode ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Schedule" c={c}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          Is this a one-off job, or something that repeats?
        </AppText>
        <OptionGrid
          options={[
            { value: "ONE_OFF", label: "One-off job", icon: FaTarget },
            { value: "RECURRING", label: "Recurring", icon: FaRefreshCw },
          ]}
          value={form.scheduleMode}
          onChange={(v) => set("scheduleMode", v)}
          c={c}
        />

        {form.scheduleMode === "ONE_OFF" ? (
          <>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                color: c.textMuted,
                marginTop: 10,
                marginBottom: 8,
              }}
            >
              Roughly how long will it take?
            </AppText>
            <View style={styles.unitPills}>
              {DURATION_UNITS.map((u) => {
                const active = form.durationUnit === u.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={u.value}
                    onPress={() => set("durationUnit", u.value)}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.pill,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                        opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: "600",
                        color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                      }}
                    >
                      {u.label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>

            <TextInput
              value={form.estimatedValue}
              onChangeText={(v) => set("estimatedValue", v)}
              placeholder={
                DURATION_UNITS.find((u) => u.value === form.durationUnit)
                  ?.hint || ""
              }
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              keyboardType={
                form.durationUnit === "custom" ? "default" : "numeric"
              }
              style={[
                styles.input,
                {
                  marginTop: 8,
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            />

            {form.estimatedValue && form.durationUnit !== "custom" ? (
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 6 }}>
                ✓ Est. {form.estimatedValue} {form.durationUnit} = approx.{" "}
                {toEstimatedHours(form.durationUnit, form.estimatedValue)}h of
                work
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
            {form.estimatedValue && form.durationUnit === "custom" ? (
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 6 }}>
                ✓ Duration: {form.estimatedValue}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                color: c.textMuted,
                marginTop: 10,
                marginBottom: 8,
              }}
            >
              How often, and for how long?
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textMuted,
                marginBottom: 4,
              }}
            >
              FREQUENCY
            </AppText>
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingRight: 8 }}
            >
              {RECURRENCE_INTERVALS.map((i) => {
                const active = form.recurrenceInterval === i.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={i.value}
                    onPress={() => set("recurrenceInterval", i.value)}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.pill,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                        opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: "600",
                        color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                      }}
                    >
                      {i.label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>

            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textMuted,
                marginTop: 10,
                marginBottom: 4,
              }}
            >
              FOR HOW LONG
            </AppText>
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingRight: 8 }}
            >
              {RECURRENCE_DURATIONS.map((d) => {
                const active = form.recurrenceDuration === d.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={d.value}
                    onPress={() => set("recurrenceDuration", d.value)}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.pill,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                        opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: "600",
                        color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                      }}
                    >
                      {d.label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>

            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 8 }}>
              ✓ Repeats{" "}
              {RECURRENCE_INTERVALS.find(
                (i) => i.value === form.recurrenceInterval,
              )?.label?.toLowerCase()}{" "}
              {RECURRENCE_DURATIONS.find(
                (d) => d.value === form.recurrenceDuration,
              )?.label?.toLowerCase()}
            </AppText>
          </>
        )}
      </Field>

      {/* ── Budget ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Budget" required c={c}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          How much are you offering for this job?
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
          <TextInput
            value={form.budget}
            onChangeText={(v) => set("budget", v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""))}
            placeholder="0.00"
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            keyboardType="decimal-pad"
            style={[
              styles.input,
              {
                flex: 1,
                color: c.text,
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              },
            ]}
          />
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setShowCurrencyPicker((v) => !v)}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.currencyBtn,
              {
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
            >
              {currencySymbol} {form.currency}
            </AppText>
            <FaChevronDown size={9} color={c.textDim} />
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {showCurrencyPicker ? (
          <ScrollView
            horizontal
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
            contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingRight: 8 }}
          >
            {CURRENCIES.map((cu) => {
              const active = form.currency === cu.code;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={cu.code}
                  onPress={() => {
                    set("currency", cu.code);
                    setShowCurrencyPicker(false);
                  }}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.pill,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                      borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                    }}
                  >
                    {cu.symbol} {cu.code}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </ScrollView>
        ) : null}

        {!form.showRateOptions ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => set("showRateOptions", true)}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.addCatBtn,
              { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
            ]}
          >
            <FaPlus size={10} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: c.textDim,
                marginLeft: 4,
              }}
            >
              Pay by the hour / day instead
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        ) : (
          <View style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 6 }}
            >
              Pay rate:
            </AppText>
            <View style={styles.unitPills}>
              {BUDGET_TYPES.map((t) => {
                const active = form.budgetType === t.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={t.value}
                    onPress={() => set("budgetType", t.value)}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.pill,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                        opacity: pressed && !active ? 0.85 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: "600",
                        color: active ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                      }}
                    >
                      {t.label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>

            {form.budgetType === "CUSTOM" ? (
              <TextInput
                value={form.budgetCustomLabel}
                onChangeText={(v) => set("budgetCustomLabel", v)}
                placeholder="Describe your rate (e.g. 'Per session')"
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                style={[
                  styles.input,
                  {
                    marginTop: 8,
                    color: c.text,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  },
                ]}
              />
            ) : null}

            <Pressable
              onPress={() => {
                set("showRateOptions", false);
                set("budgetType", "HOURLY");
                set("budgetCustomLabel", "");
              }}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.addCatBtn,
                { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
              ]}
            >
              <FaX size={10} color={c.textDim} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: c.textDim,
                  marginLeft: 4,
                }}
              >
                Back to total budget
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Total preview */}
        {form.budget && form.showRateOptions && form.budgetType !== "CUSTOM" ? (
          <BudgetPreview form={form} c={c} />
        ) : null}

        {form.budget && !form.showRateOptions ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 8 }}>
            ✓ You're offering{" "}
            <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
              {form.currency} {parseFloat(form.budget || 0).toLocaleString()}
            </AppText>{" "}
            as the total budget
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </Field>

      {/* ── Work Conditions ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Work Conditions" c={c}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          Does this job come with accommodation or meals?
        </AppText>
        <OptionGrid
          options={WORK_CONDITION_OPTIONS.map((opt) => ({
            value: opt.key,
            label: opt.label,
            icon: opt.icon,
          }))}
          value={
            form.providesAccommodation
              ? "providesAccommodation"
              : form.providesMeals
                ? "providesMeals"
                : null
          }
          multiValue={[
            form.providesAccommodation ? "providesAccommodation" : null,
            form.providesMeals ? "providesMeals" : null,
          ].filter(Boolean)}
          onChange={(v) => {
            set(v, !form[v]);
          }}
          c={c}
        />
        {form.providesAccommodation || form.providesMeals ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 8 }}>
            ✓ Job includes{" "}
            {[
              form.providesAccommodation && "accommodation",
              form.providesMeals && "meals",
            ]
              .filter(Boolean)
              .join(" and ")}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </Field>

      {/* ── Qualifications ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Required Qualifications" c={c}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          Add any specific qualifications this job requires. Optional.
        </AppText>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.skillBox,
            { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgInput },
          ]}
        >
          {form.qualifications.map((qual) => (
            <View
              key={qual}
              style={[
                styles.skillTag,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
              ]}
            >
              <FaAward size={9} color={c.orange} />
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.orange, marginLeft: 4 }}>
                {qual}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable onPress={() => removeQualification(qual)} hitSlop={6}>
                <FaX size={10} color={c.orange} style={{ marginLeft: 4 }} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ))}
          <TextInput
            value={qualificationInput}
            onChangeText={setQualificationInput}
            onSubmitEditing={() => addQualification(qualificationInput)}
            onBlur={() => {
              if (qualificationInput.trim())
                addQualification(qualificationInput);
            }}
            placeholder={
              form.qualifications.length === 0 ? "Type a qualification…" : ""
            }
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 120,
              color: c.text,
              fontSize: 12,
              paddingVertical: 4,
            }}
          />
        </View>

        {form.qualifications.length < 10 ? (
          <>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowQualificationPresets((v) => !v)}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.addCatBtn,
                { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
              ]}
            >
              {showQualificationPresets ? (
                <>
                  <FaChevronUp size={10} color={c.textDim} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: c.textDim,
                      marginLeft: 4,
                    }}
                  >
                    Hide common qualifications
                  </AppText>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <FaChevronDown size={10} color={c.textDim} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: c.textDim,
                      marginLeft: 4,
                    }}
                  >
                    Show common qualifications
                  </AppText>
                </>
              )}
            </Pressable>

            {showQualificationPresets ? (
              <View style={styles.skillSuggestions}>
                {QUALIFICATION_PRESETS.filter(
                  (q) => !form.qualifications.includes(q),
                )
                  .slice(0, 12)
                  .map((q) => (
                    <Pressable
                      key={q}
                      onPress={() => addQualification(q)}
                      style={({ pressed }) => [
                        styles.suggestionPill,
                        { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <FaPlus size={8} color={c.textMuted} />
                      <AppText
                        style={{
                          fontSize: 10,
                          fontWeight: "600",
                          color: c.textMuted,
                          marginLeft: 3,
                        }}
                      >
                        {q}
                      </AppText>
                    </Pressable>
                  ))}
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </>
        ) : null}

        {form.qualifications.length > 0 ? (
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 6 }}>
            ✓ {form.qualifications.length} qualification
            {form.qualifications.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} required
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </Field>

      {/* ── Skills ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Required Skills" c={c}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          Add skills the worker should have.
        </AppText>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.skillBox,
            { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgInput },
          ]}
        >
          {form.skills.map((skill) => (
            <View
              key={skill}
              style={[
                styles.skillTag,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.orange, marginLeft: 2 }}>
                {skill}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable onPress={() => removeSkill(skill)} hitSlop={6}>
                <FaX size={10} color={c.orange} style={{ marginLeft: 4 }} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ))}
          <TextInput
            value={skillInput}
            onChangeText={setSkillInput}
            onSubmitEditing={() => addSkill(skillInput)}
            onBlur={() => {
              if (skillInput.trim()) addSkill(skillInput);
            }}
            placeholder={form.skills.length === 0 ? "Type a skill…" : ""}
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 120,
              color: c.text,
              fontSize: 12,
              paddingVertical: 4,
            }}
          />
        </View>

        {form.skills.length < 20 ? (
          <View style={styles.skillSuggestions}>
            {SKILL_SUGGESTIONS.filter((s) => !form.skills.includes(s))
              .slice(0, 8)
              .map((s) => (
                <Pressable
                  key={s}
                  onPress={() => addSkill(s)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.suggestionPill,
                    { borderColor: c.border, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
                  ]}
                >
                  <FaPlus size={8} color={c.textMuted} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: "600",
                      color: c.textMuted,
                      marginLeft: 3,
                    }}
                  >
                    {s}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              ))}
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </Field>

      {/* ── Notes ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Field label="Additional Notes" c={c}>
        <TextInput
          value={form.notes}
          onChangeText={(v) => set("notes", v)}
          placeholder="Access instructions, tools needed, preferences..."
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          multiline
          numberOfLines={3}
          textAlignVertical="top"
          style={[
            styles.textarea,
            {
              color: c.text,
              borderColor: c.border,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              minHeight: 80,
            },
          ]}
        />
      </Field>

      {/* ── Error ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {error ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.errorBox,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.redDim,
              borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.red }}>{error}</AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Submit ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={handleSubmit}
        disabled={loading}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.submitBtn,
          {
            backgroundColor: loading ? c.bgInput : c.orange,
            opacity: loading ? 0.6 : pressed ? 0.9 : 1,

          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
            <FaBolt size={14} color={c.bg} />
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: c.bg }}>
              Post Job
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </Pressable>
    </AppScreen>

}

// ── Budget preview ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function BudgetPreview({ form, c }) {
  if (form.scheduleMode === "ONE_OFF") {
    const rate = parseFloat(form.budget);
    if (!Number.isFinite(rate) || rate <= 0) return null;
    const valueNum = parseFloat(form.estimatedValue);
    if (!Number.isFinite(valueNum) || valueNum <= 0) return null;

    const MONTHS_PER_UNIT = {
      hours: 1 / (30.44 * 8),
      days: 1 / 30.44,
      weeks: 1 / 4.33,
      months: 1,
      years: 12,
    };
    const MONTHS_PER_RATE_PERIOD = {
      HOURLY: 1 / (30.44 * 8),
      DAILY: 1 / 30.44,
      WEEKLY: 1 / 4.33,
      MONTHLY: 1,
      YEARLY: 12,
    };

    const durationInMonths =
      valueNum * (MONTHS_PER_UNIT[form.durationUnit] || 0);
    const ratePeriodMonths = MONTHS_PER_RATE_PERIOD[form.budgetType];
    if (!ratePeriodMonths) return null;
    const periods = durationInMonths / ratePeriodMonths;
    if (!Number.isFinite(periods) || periods <= 0) return null;
    const total = rate * periods;

    const unitNounMap = {
      HOURLY: ["hour", "hours"],
      DAILY: ["day", "days"],
      WEEKLY: ["week", "weeks"],
      MONTHLY: ["month", "months"],
      YEARLY: ["year", "years"],
    };
    const [sing, plur] = unitNounMap[form.budgetType] || ["unit", "units"];
    const rounded = Number(periods.toFixed(2));
    const periodsLabel = `${rounded} ${rounded === 1 ? sing : plur}`;
    const periodLabel =
      {
        HOURLY: "per hour",
        DAILY: "per day",
        WEEKLY: "per week",
        MONTHLY: "per month",
        YEARLY: "per year",
      }[form.budgetType] || `per ${form.budgetType.toLowerCase()}`;

    return (
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 8 }}>
        ✓ Total:{" "}
        <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
          {form.currency} {Math.round(total).toLocaleString()}
        </AppText>{" "}
        ({form.currency} {rate.toLocaleString()} {periodLabel} × {periodsLabel})
      </AppText>
    );
  }

  const recurring = computeRecurringEstimated(
    form.recurrenceDuration,
    form.budgetType,
  );
  if (!recurring) return null;
  const rate = parseFloat(form.budget);
  if (!Number.isFinite(rate) || rate <= 0) return null;
  const total = rate * recurring.count;
  const unitLabel =
    recurring.unit === "hours"
      ? `${recurring.count} hours`
      : `${recurring.count} ${recurring.unit}`;
  const periodLabel =
    {
      HOURLY: "per hour",
      DAILY: "per day",
      WEEKLY: "per week",
      MONTHLY: "per month",
      YEARLY: "per year",
    }[form.budgetType] || `per ${form.budgetType.toLowerCase()}`;

  return (
    <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 8 }}>
      ✓ Total:{" "}
      <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
        {form.currency} {Math.round(total).toLocaleString()}
      </AppText>{" "}
      ({form.currency} {rate.toLocaleString()} {periodLabel} × {unitLabel})
    </AppText>
  );
}

function initials(u) {
  if (!u) return "??";
  return `${u.firstName?.[0] ?? ""}${u.lastName?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

function timeAgo(date) {
  if (!date) return "Never";
  const m = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(date).getTime()) / 60000);
  if (m < 1) return "Just now";
  if (m < 60) return `${m}m ago`;
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
  if (h < 24) return `${h}h ago`;
  const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
  if (d < 30) return `${d}d ago`;
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString();
}

function Stars({ rating = 0, max = 5, c }) {
  return (

      {Array.from({ length: max }, (_, i) => (
        <FaStar

          size={12}
          color={i < Math.round(rating) ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

        <AppText style={styles.proTextWhite}>ENTERPRISE</AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (isProTier) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.proBadge, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
        <FaSparkles size={9} color={c.bg} />
        <AppText style={[styles.proTextWhite, { color: c.bg }]}>PRO</AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return null;
}

export default function ProfileScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { user: me, updateUser } = useAuthStore();
  const { isEnterprise, isProTier } = useSubscription();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const isWide = width >= 860;

  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [initialLoading, setInitialLoading] = useState(true);
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [reviewsLoading, setReviewsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("About");
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const [avatarLightbox, setAvatarLightbox] = useState(false);
  const [certMedia, setCertMedia] = useState(null);
  const [portfolioLightbox, setPortfolioLightbox] = useState(null);

  const isWorker = user?.role === "WORKER";
  const wp = user?.workerProfile;
  const hp = user?.hirerProfile;

  // ── Fetch the FULL user — GET /users/:id (same endpoint as web) ──
  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      const id = me?.id;
      if (!id) return;
      let cancelled = false;
      client
        .get(`/users/${id}`)
        .then((res) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setUser(res.data.data.user);
          updateUser?.(res.data.data.user);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (!cancelled && me) setUser(me);
        })
        .finally(() => {
          if (!cancelled) setInitialLoading(false);
        });
      return () => {
        cancelled = true;
      };
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [me?.id]),
  );

  const handleAvatarChange = async () => {
    const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) return;
    const res = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
      allowsEditing: true,
      aspect: [1, 1],
      quality: 0.7,
    });
    if (res.canceled || !res.assets[0]) return;
    const uri = res.assets[0].uri;
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("avatar", { uri, name: "avatar.jpg", type: "image/jpeg" });
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const { data } = await client.put("/users/me/avatar", form, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });
      const newAvatar = data.data.user.avatar;
      setUser((u) => ({ ...u, avatar: newAvatar }));
      updateUser?.({ avatar: newAvatar });
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== "Reviews" || !user?.id) return;
    setReviewsLoading(true);
    const endpoint = isWorker
      ? `/reviews/worker/${user.id}`
      : `/reviews/hirer/${user.id}`;
    client
      .get(endpoint, { params: { limit: 20 } })
      .then((res) => setReviews(res.data.data.reviews || []))
      .catch(() => setReviews([]))
      .finally(() => setReviewsLoading(false));
  }, [tab, user?.id, isWorker]);

  if (initialLoading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <PageSkeleton variant="detail" />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }
  if (!user) return null;

  const tabs = TABS[user.role] ?? ["About"];

  const handleCall = () => user.phone && Linking.openURL(`tel:${user.phone}`);
  const handleEmail = () =>
    user.email && Linking.openURL(`mailto:${user.email}`);
  const handleWebsite = () => {
    if (!hp?.website) return;
    const url = hp.website.startsWith("http")
      ? hp.website
      : `https://${hp.website}`;
    Linking.openURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
      <View style={isWide ? styles.layoutWide : styles.layout}>
        {/* ════════ SIDEBAR ════════ */}
        <View style={[styles.sidebar, isWide && styles.sidebarWide]}>
          {/* Hero card */}
          <View
            style={[
              styles.heroCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View
              style={[
                styles.heroBg,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, opacity: 0.6 },
              ]}
            />

            <View style={styles.avatarWrap}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => user.avatar && setAvatarLightbox(true)}
                disabled={!user.avatar}
              >
                {user.avatar ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: user.avatar }}
                    style={styles.avatarImg}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.avatarFallback,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                        borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={[styles.avatarInitials, { color: c.orange }]}
                    >
                      {initials(user)}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                )}
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleAvatarChange}
                disabled={uploading}
                style={[
                  styles.avatarBadge,
                  { backgroundColor: c.orange, borderColor: c.bgPanel },
                ]}
              >
                {uploading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.bg} />
                ) : (
                  <FaCamera size={12} color={c.bg} />
                )}
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.heroNameRow}>
              <AppText
                style={[styles.heroName, { color: c.text }]}
                numberOfLines={2}
              >
                {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
              </AppText>
              {(wp?.verificationStatus ?? hp?.verificationStatus) ===
                "VERIFIED" && <FaShieldAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            </View>

            <ProBadge isEnterprise={isEnterprise} isProTier={isProTier} c={c} />

            {(wp?.verificationStatus ?? hp?.verificationStatus) ===
              "VERIFIED" && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.badge,
                  { backgroundColor: c.greenDim, borderColor: c.green },
                ]}
              >
                <FaShieldAlt size={9} color={c.green} />
                <AppText
                  style={{ color: c.green, fontSize: 10, marginLeft: 4 }}
                >
                  {isWorker ? "Verified Worker" : "Verified Hirer"}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
            {wp?.backgroundCheck === true && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.badge,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: "rgba(59,130,246,0.12)",
                    borderColor: "#60a5fa",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaAward size={9} color="#60a5fa" />
                <AppText
                  style={{ color: "#60a5fa", fontSize: 10, marginLeft: 4 }}
                >
                  Background Checked
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}

            <View
              style={[
                styles.rolePill,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
              ]}
            >
              {isWorker ? (
                <FaHardHat size={11} color={c.orange} />
              ) : (
                <FaBriefcase size={11} color={c.orange} />
              )}
              <AppText style={[styles.rolePillText, { color: c.orange }]}>
                {isWorker ? "Worker" : "Hirer"}
              </AppText>
            </View>

            {wp?.title ? (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, fontStyle: "italic" }}
              >
                {wp.title}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}

            {wp?.avgRating > 0 ? (
              <View style={styles.ratingRow}>
                <Stars rating={wp.avgRating} c={c} />
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "800", color: c.text }}
                >
                  {Number(wp.avgRating).toFixed(1)}
                </AppText>
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
                  ({wp.totalReviews ?? 0} reviews)
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            <Pressable
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Settings")}
              style={[
                styles.editBtn,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <FaSettings size={12} color={c.textDim} />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: c.textDim,
                  marginLeft: 6,
                }}
              >
                Settings
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          {/* STATS STRIP */}
          <View
            style={[
              styles.statsWrap,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={{ paddingVertical: 4 }}
              style={{ flexGrow: 0 }}
            >
              {wp ? (
                <>
                  <Stat
                    icon={<FaDollarSign size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                    value={`${wp.currency ?? user.currency ?? "USD"} ${Number(wp.hourlyRate ?? 0).toLocaleString()}`}
                    label="/hr"
                    c={c}
                  />
                  <Stat
                    icon={<FaCheckCircle size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                    value={`${wp.completedJobs ?? 0}`}
                    label="jobs done"
                    c={c}
                  />
                  <Stat
                    icon={<FaBolt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                    value={`${wp.responseRate ?? 0}%`}
                    label="response"
                    c={c}
                  />
                  {wp.serviceRadius ? (
                    <Stat
                      icon={<FaMapMarkerAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                      value={`${wp.serviceRadius} km`}

                      c={c}

              {user.role === "HIRER" && user.hirerStats ? (
                <>
                  <Stat
                    icon={<FaBriefcase size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                    value={`${user.hirerStats.totalHires}`}

                    c={c}
                  />
                  <Stat
                    icon={<FaDollarSign size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                    value={`${user.currency ?? "USD"} ${Number(user.hirerStats.totalSpent).toLocaleString()}`}
                    label="spent"
                    c={c}
                  />
                  {user.hirerStats.avgRating > 0 ? (
                    <Stat
                      icon={<FaStar size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                      value={`${Number(user.hirerStats.avgRating).toFixed(1)}`}

                    />

              <Stat
