              <Stat
                icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
                value={new Date(user.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en", {
                  month: "short",
                  year: "numeric",
                })}
                label="joined"
                c={c}
              />
            </ScrollView>
          </View>

          {/* INFO PILLS */}
          <View
            style={[
              styles.infoCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            {hp?.companyName ? (
              <InfoPill
                icon={<FaBuilding size={12} color={c.textDim} />}
                text={hp.companyName}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {hp?.companySize ? (
              <InfoPill
                icon={<FaUsers size={12} color={c.textDim} />}
                text={`${hp.companySize} employees`}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {user.city || user.country ? (
              <InfoPill
                icon={<FaMapMarkerAlt size={12} color={c.textDim} />}
                text={[user.city, user.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {user.phone ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleCall}
                style={[
                  styles.infoPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <FaPhone size={12} color={c.orange} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: c.orange,
                    marginLeft: 5,
                    textDecorationLine: "underline",
                  }}
                >
                  {user.phone}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
            {user.email ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleEmail}
                style={[
                  styles.infoPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <FaEnvelope size={12} color={c.orange} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: c.orange,
                    marginLeft: 5,
                    textDecorationLine: "underline",
                  }}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {user.email}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
            {user.currency ? (
              <InfoPill
                icon={<FaGlobe size={12} color={c.textDim} />}
                text={user.currency}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {hp?.website ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleWebsite}
                style={[
                  styles.infoPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <FaGlobe size={12} color={c.orange} />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: c.orange,
                    marginLeft: 5,
                    textDecorationLine: "underline",
                  }}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {hp.website.replace(/^https?:\/\//, "")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          {/* Categories */}
          {wp?.categories?.length > 0 ? (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.catCard,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={[styles.cardLabel, { color: theme.colors.textMuted }]}>Specialities</AppText>
              <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
                {wp.categories.map((cat) => (
                  <View
                    key={cat.id}
                    style={[
                      styles.catPill,
                      { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim }}>
                      {cat.category?.name ?? cat.name}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* ════════ MAIN ════════ */}
        <View style={[styles.main, isWide && styles.mainWide]}>
          <ScrollView
            horizontal
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            style={[styles.tabBar, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
            contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: 4 }}
          >
            {tabs.map((t) => {
              const active = tab === t;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={t}
                  onPress={() => setTab(t)}
                  style={[
                    styles.tabBtn,
                    { borderBottomColor: active ? c.orange : "transparent" },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 13,
                      fontWeight: active ? "700" : "500",
                      color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
                    }}
                  >
                    {t}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </ScrollView>

          {/* ABOUT */}
          {tab === "About" && (
            <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
              {user.bio ? (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.bioCard,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText style={[styles.cardLabel, { color: theme.colors.textMuted }]}>About</AppText>
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, lineHeight: 20 }}
                  >
                    {user.bio}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ) : (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.emptyCard,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 13,
                      color: c.textMuted,
                      textAlign: "center",
                    }}
                  >
                    Add a bio to tell people about yourself.
                  </AppText>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => navigation.navigate("EditProfile")}
                    style={[styles.smallBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
                  >
                    <FaPencil size={11} color={c.orange} />
                    <AppText
                      style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.orange, marginLeft: 6 }}
                    >
                      Add bio
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              )}

              {wp?.availability ? (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.availCard,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText style={[styles.cardLabel, { color: theme.colors.textMuted }]}>Availability</AppText>
                  <View
                    style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}
                  >
                    {WEEK_DAYS.map((d) => {
                      const active = wp.availability?.includes(d);
                      return (
                        <View
                          key={d}
                          style={[
                            styles.dayPill,
                            {
                              backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgInput,
                              borderColor: active ? c.orangeGlow : c.border,
                            },
                          ]}
                        >
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: "700",
                              color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
                            }}
                          >
                            {d}
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                      );
                    })}
                  </View>
                </View>
              ) : null}

              <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
                <Badge
                  icon={<FaCheckCircle size={11} color={c.green} />}
                  text={`Email ${user.isEmailVerified ? "Verified" : "Unverified"}`}
                  color={user.isEmailVerified ? c.green : c.textMuted}
                  bg={user.isEmailVerified ? c.greenDim : c.bgCard}
                  c={c}
                />
                {(wp?.verificationStatus ?? hp?.verificationStatus) ===
                "VERIFIED" ? (
                  <Badge
                    icon={<FaShieldAlt size={11} color={c.orange} />}
                    text="ID Verified"
                    color={c.orange}
                    bg={c.orangeDim}
                    c={c}
                  />
                ) : null}
                {wp?.backgroundCheck === true ? (
                  <Badge
                    icon={<FaAward size={11} color="#60a5fa" />}
                    text="Background Checked"
                    color="#60a5fa"
                    bg="rgba(59,130,246,0.1)"
                    c={c}
                  />
                ) : null}
              </View>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* PORTFOLIO */}
          {tab === "Portfolio" && (
            <View>
              {wp?.portfolio?.length > 0 ? (
                <View
                  style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10 }}
                >
                  {wp.portfolio.map((item) => (
                    <Pressable
                      key={item.id}
                      onPress={() =>
                        setPortfolioLightbox({
                          img: item.imageUrl,
                          title: item.title,
                        })
                      }
                      style={({ pressed }) => [
                        styles.portfolioCard,
                        {
                          backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                          borderColor: c.border,
                          opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                          width: isWide ? "31%" : "48%",
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {item.imageUrl ? (
                        <Image
                          source={{ uri: item.imageUrl }}
                          style={styles.portfolioImg}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <View
                          style={[
                            styles.portfolioPlaceholder,
                            { backgroundColor: c.bgInput },
                          ]}
                        >
                          <FaImage size={22} color={c.textMuted} />
                        </View>
                      )}
                      <View style={{ padding: 10 }}>
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: "700",
                            color: c.text,
                          }}
                          numberOfLines={1}
                        >
                          {item.title}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    </Pressable>
                  ))}
                </View>
              ) : (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.emptyCard,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <FaImage size={28} color={c.textMuted} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 8 }}
                  >
                    Upload your best work to attract clients.
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
          )}

          {/* CERTIFICATIONS */}
          {tab === "Certifications" && (
            <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
              {wp?.certifications?.length > 0 ? (
                wp.certifications.map((cert) => (
                  <Pressable
                    key={cert.id}
                    onPress={() =>
                      cert.documentUrl &&
                      setCertMedia({
                        src: cert.documentUrl,
                        title: cert.name || "Certification",
                      })
                    }
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.certCard,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                        borderColor: c.border,
                        opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.certIcon,
                        {
                          backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                          borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <FaAward size={16} color={c.orange} />
                    </View>
                    <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <AppText
                        style={{
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: "700",
                          color: c.text,
                        }}
                        numberOfLines={2}
                      >
                        {cert.name}
                      </AppText>
                      {cert.issuer ? (
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 11,
                            color: c.textDim,
                            marginTop: 2,
                          }}
                        >
                          Issued by {cert.issuer}
                        </AppText>
                      ) : null}
                    </View>
                    <View style={{ alignItems: "flex-end", gap: 6 }}>
                      {cert.verified ? (
                        <Badge
                          icon={<FaCheckCircle size={9} color={c.green} />}
                          text="Verified"
                          color={c.green}
                          bg={c.greenDim}
                          c={c}
                        />
                      ) : cert.rejectionReason ? (
                        <Badge
                          icon={<FaAlertCircle size={9} color={c.red} />}
                          text="Rejected"
                          color={c.red}
                          bg={c.redDim}
                          c={c}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <Badge
                          icon={<FaClock size={9} color="#eab308" />}
                          text="Pending"
                          color="#eab308"
                          bg="rgba(234,179,8,0.12)"
                          c={c}
                        />
                      )}
                    </View>
                  </Pressable>
                ))
              ) : (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.emptyCard,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <FaAward size={28} color={c.textMuted} />
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 8 }}
                  >
                    Add certifications to build trust with clients.
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}

          )}

          {/* REVIEWS */}
          {tab === "Reviews" && (
            <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
              {reviewsLoading ? (
                <>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.reviewSummary,
                      { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <View
                      style={{
                        width: 60,
                        height: 28,
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                        opacity: 0.5,
                      }}
                    />
                    <View
                      style={{
                        width: 80,
                        height: 12,
                        borderRadius: 6,
                        backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                        opacity: 0.5,
                      }}
                    />
                  </View>
                  {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                    <View
                      key={i}

                        styles.reviewCard,
                        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
                        <View
                          style={{
                            width: 36,
                            height: 36,
                            borderRadius: 18,
                            backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                            opacity: 0.5,
                          }}

                        <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 6 }}>
                          <View
                            style={{
                              width: "50%",
                              height: 12,
                              borderRadius: 6,
                              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                              opacity: 0.5,
                            }}

                          <View

                  style={[

                    { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },

                  <FaStar size={28} color={c.textMuted} />

                      { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },

                      style={{
                        flexDirection: "row",
                        alignItems: "center",
                        gap: 8,
                      }}

                      <AppText
                        style={{
                          fontFamily: FONT_DISPLAY,
                          fontSize: 28,
                          fontWeight: "800",
                          color: c.orange,
                        }}
                      >
                        {(
                          reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) /
                          reviews.length
                        ).toFixed(1)}
                      </AppText>
                      <Stars
                        rating={
                          reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) /
                          reviews.length
                        }
                        c={c}
                      />
                    </View>
                    <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
                      {reviews.length} review{reviews.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>

                  {reviews.map((r) => (
                    <View
                      key={r.id}
                      style={[
                        styles.reviewCard,
                        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <View style={styles.reviewTop}>
                        <View
                          style={[
                            styles.reviewAvatar,
                            {
                              backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                              borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                            },
                          ]}
                        >
                          {r.giver?.avatar ? (
                            <Image
                              source={{ uri: r.giver.avatar }}
                              style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.orange }}>
                              {r.giver?.firstName?.[0]}
                              {r.giver?.lastName?.[0]}
                            </AppText>
                          )}
                        </View>
                        <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: "700",
                              color: c.text,
                            }}
                            numberOfLines={1}
                          >
                            {r.giver?.firstName} {r.giver?.lastName}
                            <AppText
                              style={{
                                fontSize: 10,
                                color: c.textMuted,
                                fontWeight: "400",
                              }}
                            >
                              {" "}
                              · {r.giver?.role === "HIRER" ? "Hirer" : "Worker"}
                            </AppText>
                          </AppText>
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 10,
                              color: c.textMuted,
                              marginTop: 2,
                            }}
                          >
                            {new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                              day: "numeric",
                              month: "short",
                              year: "numeric",
                            })}
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                        <Stars rating={r.rating} c={c} />
                      </View>
                      {r.comment ? (
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 12,
                            color: c.textDim,
                            fontStyle: "italic",
                            lineHeight: 18,
                            marginTop: 8,
                            paddingLeft: 10,
                            borderLeftWidth: 2,
                            borderLeftColor: c.orangeGlow,
                          }}
                        >
                          "{r.comment}"
                        </AppText>
                      ) : null}
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </>
              )}
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Modals */}
      <Modal
        visible={avatarLightbox}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setAvatarLightbox(false)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={styles.lightboxBackdrop}
          onPress={() => setAvatarLightbox(false)}
        >
          <Pressable
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{ width: "90%", maxWidth: 500, alignItems: "center" }}
          >
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setAvatarLightbox(false)}
              style={styles.lightboxClose}
            >
              <FaTimes size={18} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
            {user.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: user.avatar }}
                style={{ width: "100%", height: 400, borderRadius: 12 }}
                resizeMode="contain"
              />
            ) : null}
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        visible={!!portfolioLightbox}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setPortfolioLightbox(null)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={styles.lightboxBackdrop}
          onPress={() => setPortfolioLightbox(null)}
        >
          <Pressable
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{ width: "90%", maxWidth: 500, alignItems: "center" }}
          >
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setPortfolioLightbox(null)}
              style={styles.lightboxClose}
            >
              <FaTimes size={18} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
            {portfolioLightbox?.img ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: portfolioLightbox.img }}
                style={{ width: "100%", height: 400, borderRadius: 12 }}
                resizeMode="contain"
              />
            ) : null}
            {portfolioLightbox?.title ? (
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: FONT_DISPLAY,
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: "700",
                  color: "#fff",
                  marginTop: 12,
                  textAlign: "center",
                }}
              >
                {portfolioLightbox.title}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>

      {certMedia ? (
        <CertMediaViewer
          src={certMedia.src}
          title={certMedia.title}
          onClose={() => setCertMedia(null)}
        />
      ) : null}
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// APIs:

const STATUS_COLORS = {
  PENDING: { color: "#f59e0b", bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.18)" },
  QUALIFIED: { color: "#818cf8", bg: "rgba(129,140,248,0.15)" },
  CONVERTED: { color: "#60a5fa", bg: "rgba(59,130,246,0.15)" },
  REWARDED: { color: "#22c55e", bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.15)" },
  EXPIRED: { color: "#6b7280", bg: "rgba(107,114,128,0.14)" },
  FLAGGED: { color: "#ef4444", bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.15)" },

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const fmtAmt = (n) =>
  `₦${Number(n || 0).toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}`;
const fmtDate = (d) =>
  d
    ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
        day: "numeric",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
      })
    : "—";
const timeAgo = (d) => {
  if (!d) return "—";
  const days = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(d)) / 86400000);
  if (days === 0) return "Today";
  if (days === 1) return "Yesterday";
  return `${days}d ago`;
};

// ─── StatCard (same pattern as WorkerWithdrawalsScreen) ──────────────────────
function StatCard({ label, value, sub, orange, green, c }) {
  const bgColor = orange
    ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)"
    : green
      ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)"
      : c.bgPanel;
  const bdColor = orange
    ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.40)"
    : green
      ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.35)"
      : c.border;
  const valColor = orange ? c.orange : green ? "#22c55e" : c.text;
  return (
    <View style={[sc.card, { backgroundColor: bgColor, borderColor: bdColor }]}>
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 10,
          color: c.textMuted,
          fontWeight: "700",
          letterSpacing: 0.8,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        weight="displayBlack"
        style={{ fontSize: 22, lineHeight: 28, color: valColor, marginTop: 4 }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
      {sub ? (
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
          {sub}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}
const sc = StyleSheet.create({
  card: { flex: 1, borderRadius: 14, borderWidth: 1, padding: 13 },
});

// ─── Avatar ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Avatar({ name, avatar, size = 38, c }) {
  const initials =
    name
      ?.split(" ")
      .map((w) => w[0])
      .join("")
      .slice(0, 2)
      .toUpperCase() || "?";
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: size / 2,
        borderWidth: 1.5,
        borderColor: c.orange,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}
    >
      {avatar ? (
        <Image
          source={{ uri: avatar }}
          style={{ width: size, height: size, borderRadius: size / 2 }}
        />
      ) : (
        <AppText
          style={{ fontSize: size * 0.33, color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}
        >
          {initials}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

          </AppText>

      </View>
      <View style={{ alignItems: "flex-end", gap: 4 }}>

            borderColor: `${s.color}55`,
          }}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: s.color, fontWeight: "700" }}>

          </AppText>
        </View>
        {r.status === "REWARDED" && (
          <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#22c55e" }}>
            +{fmtAmt(r.bonus)}
          </AppText>
        )}
        {r.status === "PENDING" && r.expiresAt && (

// ─── Withdraw Modal (bottom sheet — same pattern as RequestPayoutModal) ────────
function WithdrawModal({
  visible,
  wallet,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  c,
  modalBg,
  toast,
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    amount: "",
    bankName: "",
    accountNumber: "",
    accountName: "",
  });
  const [submitting, setSub] = useState(false);

  function setF(k, v) {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  }

  const avail = wallet?.balance ?? 0;
  const minWd = wallet?.minWithdrawal ?? 5000;
  const setPercent = (pct) =>
    setF("amount", (pct === 1 ? avail : avail * pct).toFixed(0));

  async function submit() {
    const numAmt = parseFloat(form.amount);
    if (!numAmt || numAmt < minWd) {
      toast.error(`Minimum withdrawal is ${fmtAmt(minWd)}`);
      return;
    }
    if (numAmt > avail) {
      toast.error(`Insufficient balance. Available: ${fmtAmt(avail)}`);
      return;
    }
    if (!form.bankName || !form.accountNumber || !form.accountName) {
      toast.error("All bank details are required");
      return;
    }
    setSub(true);
    try {
      await client.post("/referral/withdraw", {
        amount: form.amount,
        bankName: form.bankName.trim(),
        accountNumber: form.accountNumber.trim(),
        accountName: form.accountName.trim(),
      });
      toast.success("Withdrawal submitted! Processing in 1–3 business days 💸");
      setForm({ amount: "", bankName: "", accountNumber: "", accountName: "" });
      onSuccess?.();
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Withdrawal failed");
    } finally {
      setSub(false);
    }
  }

  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : "height"}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" }}
          onPress={onClose}
        >
          <Pressable
            style={[wm.sheet, { backgroundColor: modalBg }]}
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <View style={[wm.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "center",
                marginBottom: 16,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                weight="displayBlack"
                style={{ fontSize: 24, color: c.text }}
              >
                💸 Withdraw Earnings
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                onPress={onClose}
                style={[wm.closeBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
              >
                <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={c.text} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            <ScrollView
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            >
              {/* Balance summary */}
              <View
                style={[
                  wm.balRow,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.10)",
                    borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.25)",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 9,
                      color: "#22c55e",
                      letterSpacing: 0.8,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                    }}
                  >
                    AVAILABLE
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    weight="displayBlack"
                    style={{ color: "#22c55e", fontSize: 22, marginTop: 2 }}
                  >
                    {fmtAmt(avail)}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 9,
                      color: c.textMuted,
                      letterSpacing: 0.8,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                    }}
                  >
                    MINIMUM
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted, fontSize: 16, marginTop: 2 }}
                  >
                    {fmtAmt(minWd)}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>

              {/* Amount */}
              <AppText style={wm.sectionLabel}>AMOUNT (₦) *</AppText>
              <View
                style={[
                  wm.amtRow,
                  {
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgInput ?? c.bgCard,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <View style={[wm.curBadge, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel }]}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted }}
                  >
                    NGN
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <TextInput
                  value={form.amount}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setF("amount", v)}
                  placeholder="0"
                  placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                  keyboardType="numeric"
                  style={{
                    flex: 1,
                    color: c.text,
                    fontSize: 18,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                    paddingHorizontal: 12,
                  }}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={wm.pctRow}>
                {[0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((p) => (
                  <Pressable
                    key={p}
                    onPress={() => setPercent(p)}
                    style={[
                      wm.pctBtn,
                      { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgPanel },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: c.text }}
                    >
                      {p === 1 ? "Max" : `${p * 100}%`}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                ))}
              </View>

              {/* Bank fields */}
              <AppText style={[wm.sectionLabel, { marginTop: 4 }]}>
                BANK DETAILS
              </AppText>
              {[
                {
                  k: "bankName",
                  label: "Bank Name *",
                  kb: "default",
                  ph: "e.g. First Bank",
                },
                {
                  k: "accountNumber",
                  label: "Account Number *",
                  kb: "numeric",
                  ph: "10-digit number",
                  max: 10,
                },
                {
                  k: "accountName",
                  label: "Account Name *",
                  kb: "default",
                  ph: "Name as on account",
                },
              ].map((f) => (
                <View key={f.k} style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 6 }}
                  >
                    {f.label}
                  </AppText>
                  <TextInput
                    value={form[f.k]}
                    onChangeText={(v) => setF(f.k, v)}
                    placeholder={f.ph}
                    placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                    keyboardType={f.kb}
                    maxLength={f.max}
                    style={[
                      wm.input,
                      {
                        color: c.text,
                        borderColor: c.border,
                        backgroundColor: c.bgInput ?? c.bgCard,
                      },
                    ]}
                  />
                </View>
              ))}

              <Pressable
                onPress={submit}
                disabled={submitting || !form.amount.trim()}
                style={[
                  wm.submitBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: form.amount.trim() ? c.orange : c.bgPanel,
                    opacity: form.amount.trim() ? 1 : 0.6,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: form.amount.trim() ? "#fff" : c.textMuted }}
                  >
                    Request Withdrawal
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>

              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 32 }}
              >
                Processing within 1–3 business days
              </AppText>
            </ScrollView>
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MAIN SCREEN
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function ReferralDashboardScreen() {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const c = th.colors;
  const modalBg = th.mode === "dark" ? "#111118" : "#ffffff";

  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [leaderboard, setLeaderboard] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("referrals");
  const [showWd, setShowWd] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // ── Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await client.get("/referral/dashboard");
      setDashboard(res.data.data);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to load referral data",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  // Lazy-load leaderboard when tab selected
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== "leaderboard" || leaderboard) return;
    client
      .get("/referral/leaderboard?limit=20")
      .then((r) => setLeaderboard(r.data.data))
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [tab, leaderboard]);

  // ── Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function copyLink() {
    const link = dashboard?.link || "";
    if (!link) return;
    await Clipboard.setStringAsync(link);
    setCopied(true);
    toast.success("Link copied to clipboard!");
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  }

  async function shareLink() {
    try {
      await Share.share({
        message: dashboard?.shareText || "",
        url: dashboard?.link || "",
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  const openWA = () => {
    const text = encodeURIComponent(dashboard?.shareText || "");
    Linking.openURL(`whatsapp://send?text=${text}`).catch(() =>
      Linking.openURL(`https://wa.me/?text=${text}`),
    );
  };
  const openX = () =>
    Linking.openURL(
      `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=${encodeURIComponent(dashboard?.shareText || "")}`,
    );

  // ── Derived ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const d = dashboard;
  const tier = d?.tier;
  const ts = tier
    ? TIER_STYLES[tier.key] || TIER_STYLES.BRONZE
    : TIER_STYLES.BRONZE;

  // ── Initial loading spinner ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ── Main render — NOTE: <> fragment wraps ScrollView + WithdrawModal ─────────
  return (
    <>
      <ScrollView
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 56 }}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => {
              setRefreshing(true);
              load();
            }}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* ── Page Header ── */}
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "flex-start",
            marginBottom: 18,
            gap: 12,
            flexWrap: "wrap",
          }}
        >
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                color: c.orange,
                fontWeight: "700",
                letterSpacing: 0.8,
              }}
            >
              REFERRAL PROGRAM
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              weight="displayBlack"
              style={{
                fontSize: 34,
                lineHeight: 40,
                color: c.text,
                marginVertical: 4,
              }}
            >
              Invite & Earn
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
              Share your code. Earn real money when your referrals complete
              their first booking.
            </AppText>
          </View>
          {d?.leaderboardRank && (
            <View
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 12,
                paddingVertical: 7,
                backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.4)",
                borderRadius: 20,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}
              >
                🏅 Rank #{d.leaderboardRank}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* ── Code Card ── */}
        <Card
          padded
          style={{
            marginBottom: 12,
            borderWidth: 1.5,
            borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.35)",
          }}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              color: c.textMuted,
              fontWeight: "700",
              letterSpacing: 0.8,
              marginBottom: 6,
            }}
          >
            YOUR REFERRAL CODE
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            weight="displayBlack"
            style={{

            }}
          >

          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            numberOfLines={1}
            style={{

                ios: "Courier",
                android: "monospace",
              }),
              marginBottom: 14,
            }}
          >
            {d?.link || "Loading…"}
          </AppText>

          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginBottom: 14 }}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={copyLink}
              disabled={!d?.link}
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                paddingVertical: 11,
                borderRadius: 12,
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                backgroundColor: copied ? "#22c55e" : c.orange,
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#000" }}
              >
                {copied ? "✅ Copied!" : "📋 Copy Link"}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={shareLink}
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",

                borderRadius: 12,

                borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.4)",
                backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.10)",
              }}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name="share-outline"
                size={15}
                color={c.orange}
                style={{ marginRight: 5 }}
              />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                Share
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          <View
            style={{
              borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
              borderTopColor: c.border,
              paddingTop: 14,
            }}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                color: c.textMuted,
                fontWeight: "700",
                letterSpacing: 0.8,
                marginBottom: 8,
              }}
            >
              SHARE VIA
            </AppText>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={openWA}
                style={{
                  paddingHorizontal: 16,
                  paddingVertical: 8,
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(37,211,102,0.08)",
                  borderColor: "rgba(37,211,102,0.35)",
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#25d366" }}
                >
                  WhatsApp
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={openX}
                style={{
                  paddingHorizontal: 16,

                ₦ NGN

          <AppText

          <AppText
            weight="displayBlack"

            {fmtAmt(d?.wallet?.balance)}

          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>

          <Pressable

              marginBottom: 4,

            }}
          >
            <AppText
              weight="semibold"
              style={{
                fontSize: 15,

              }}

            </AppText>
          </Pressable>

          {!d?.wallet?.canWithdraw && (
            <AppText

              style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 4 }}
            >
              Min. {fmtAmt(d?.wallet?.minWithdrawal)} needed
              {(d?.wallet?.balance ?? 0) > 0
                ? ` · You have ${fmtAmt(d.wallet.balance)}`

          )}

          {d?.recentEarnings?.length > 0 && (
            <View
              style={{

              }}

              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,

                  letterSpacing: 0.8,
                  marginBottom: 10,
                }}
              >
                RECENT EARNINGS
              </AppText>
              {d.recentEarnings.slice(0, 4).map((tx) => (
                <View
                  key={tx.id}

                    borderBottomColor: c.border,
                  }}
                >
                  <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 8 }}>
                    <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
                      {tx.description}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      {timeAgo(tx.createdAt)}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <AppText
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{
                      color: tx.amount >= 0 ? "#22c55e" : "#ef4444",

                    }}
                  >
                    {tx.amount < 0 ? "-" : "+"}₦
                    {Math.abs(tx.amount).toLocaleString()}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          )}
        </Card>

        {/* ── How It Works ── */}
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ letterSpacing: 0.8, marginBottom: 14 }}
          >
            HOW IT WORKS
          </AppText>
          {[
            {
              icon: "🔗",
              step: "Step 1",
              title: "Share your code",
              desc: "Copy your unique link and share with friends, colleagues, or on social media.",
            },
            {
              icon: "📝",
              step: "Step 2",
              title: "They sign up",
              desc: "Your referral creates an account using your code and gets exclusive perks.",
            },
            {

function getStatusConfig(status) {
  return (
    STATUS_CONFIG[status] || {
      Icon: FaClock,
      color: "#888",
      label: status || "Unknown",
      bg: "rgba(136,136,136,0.1)",
    }
  );
}

function formatCurrency(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const num = typeof amount === "number" ? amount : parseFloat(amount) || 0;
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: currency || "NGN",
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(num);
  } catch {
    return `${currency} ${num.toFixed(2)}`;
  }
}

function formatDateLong(date) {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "long",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function formatDateShort(date) {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Date(date).toLocaleString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function getPaymentChannel(tx) {
  if (tx.type === "REFUND") return { label: "Refund", Icon: FaArrowUp };
  if (tx.type === "PAYMENT") {
    const p = tx.meta?.paymentProvider || "WALLET";
    if (p === "WALLET") return { label: "Wallet", Icon: FaWallet };
    if (p === "PAYSTACK")
      return { label: "Card (Paystack)", Icon: FaCreditCard };
    if (p === "FLUTTERWAVE")
      return { label: "Card (Flutterwave)", Icon: FaCreditCard };
    if (p === "BANK_TRANSFER")
      return { label: "Bank Transfer", Icon: FaBuilding };
    if (p === "CRYPTO") return { label: "Crypto", Icon: FaDollarSign };
    return { label: "Payment", Icon: FaCreditCard };
  }
  if (tx.type === "SUBSCRIPTION")
    return { label: "Subscription", Icon: FaShieldAlt };
  if (tx.type === "BONUS") return { label: "Bonus", Icon: FaPlus };
  return { label: "Adjustment", Icon: FaMinus };
}

function bgLuminance(color) {
  if (!color) return 0.5;
  let r = 0,
    g = 0,
    b = 0;
  if (color.startsWith("#")) {
    const hex = color.replace("#", "");
    if (hex.length === 3) {
      r = parseInt(hex[0] + hex[0], 16);
      g = parseInt(hex[1] + hex[1], 16);
      b = parseInt(hex[2] + hex[2], 16);
    } else if (hex.length >= 6) {
      r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
      g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
      b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
    }
  }
  return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255;
}

function generateReceiptHTML(refund, isDark) {
  const transaction = {
    reference: refund.reference,
    type: "REFUND",
    amount: refund.amount,
    currency: refund.currency,
    status: refund.status,
    createdAt: refund.createdAt,
    completedAt: refund.processedAt,
    description: refund.reason || "Refund processed for booking",
    fee: 0,
    netAmount: refund.amount,
    meta: {
      paymentProvider: refund.payment?.provider,
      transactionId: refund.payment?.providerRef,
    },
  };

  const channel = getPaymentChannel(transaction);
  const isPaid =
    transaction.status === "COMPLETED" || transaction.status === "SUCCESS";

  const bg = isDark ? "#080810" : "#f8f9fa";
  const panel = isDark ? "#0c0c18" : "#ffffff";
  const text = isDark ? "#ffffff" : "#1a1a2e";
  const textDim = isDark ? "#a1a1aa" : "#6b7280";
  const border = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" : "#e5e7eb";
  const borderDash = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" : "#e5e7eb";
  const footerBg = isDark ? "#0c0c18" : "#f9fafb";
  const tearColor = isDark ? "#080810" : "#f9fafb";

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Receipt - ${transaction.reference}</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; background: ${bg}; color: ${text}; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; min-height: 100vh; padding: 20px; }
    .receipt { max-width: 520px; width: 100%; background: ${panel}; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,${isDark ? "0.4" : "0.1"}); border: 1px solid ${border}; }
    .receipt-header { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316 0%, #ea580c 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 32px 32px 24px; text-align: center; }
    .receipt-header h1 { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; }
    .receipt-header .subtitle { font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.9; margin-top: 4px; color: #fff; }
    .receipt-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 16px; padding: 6px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; }
    .receipt-amount { text-align: center; padding: 28px 32px 24px; border-bottom: 2px dashed ${borderDash}; }
    .receipt-amount .label { font-size: 12px; color: ${textDim}; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 700; }
    .receipt-amount .value { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 8px; }
    .receipt-amount .value.credit { color: #22c55e; }
    .receipt-amount .channel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(249,115,22,0.15); color: #f97316; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
    .receipt-body { padding: 24px 32px; }
    .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid ${border}; gap: 16px; }
    .row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .row .label { color: ${textDim}; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .row .value { color: ${text}; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; word-break: break-word; }
    .row .value.mono { font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; }
    .row.section-title { padding-top: 18px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: none; }
    .row.section-title .label { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: ${textDim}; font-weight: 800; }
    .net-row { margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 2px solid ${border}; border-bottom: none; }
    .net-row .label { font-weight: 700; color: ${text}; }
    .net-row .value { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #22c55e; }
    .receipt-footer { padding: 24px 32px; background: ${footerBg}; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: ${textDim}; }
    .receipt-footer strong { color: ${text}; }

<body>

      ${transaction.completedAt ? `<div class="row"><span class="label">Completed</span><span class="value">${formatDateLong(transaction.completedAt)}</span></div>` : ""}

              valueStyle,
            ]}
          >
            {value}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function SectionTitle({ Icon, children, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 6,
        marginBottom: 10,
      }}
    >
      {Icon ? <Icon size={12} color={c.orange} /> : null}
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
          fontSize: 10,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color: c.textMuted,
          letterSpacing: 1,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function RefundDetailScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const isDark = bgLuminance(c.bg) < 0.5;

  const id = route.params?.id;

  const [refund, setRefund] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) {
      setError("Refund not found");
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    client
      .get(`/refunds/${id}`)
      .then((res) => setRefund(res.data.data.refund))
      .catch((err) => {
        setError(
          err.response?.data?.message || "Failed to load refund details",
        );
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);

  const handlePrint = async () => {
    if (!refund) return;
    try {
      await Print.printAsync({ html: generateReceiptHTML(refund, isDark) });
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert(
        "Print failed",
        err?.message || "Could not open the print dialog.",
      );
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadReceipt = async () => {
    if (!refund) return;
    setDownloading(true);
    try {
      const { uri } = await Print.printToFileAsync({
        html: generateReceiptHTML(refund, isDark),
      });
      if (await Sharing.isAvailableAsync()) {
        await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, {
          mimeType: "application/pdf",
          dialogTitle: `receipt-${refund.reference}`,
        });
      } else {
        Alert.alert("Receipt saved", uri);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert(
        "Download failed",
        err?.message || "Failed to generate receipt. Please try again.",
      );
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleBack = () => navigation.navigate("RefundHistory");

  // Loading
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }} edges={["top"]}>
        <View style={{ padding: 16, gap: 14 }}>
          <Skeleton width="40%" height={18} radius={6} />
          <Skeleton width="60%" height={30} radius={8} />
          <Skeleton width="100%" height={80} radius={14} />
          {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} width="100%" height={160} radius={14} />
          ))}
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // Error
  if (error || !refund) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }} edges={["top"]}>
        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            padding: 24,
            gap: 12,
          }}
        >
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={44} color={c.red} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
            }}
          >
            {error || "Refund not found"}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            The refund could not be loaded.
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 6,
                marginTop: 8,
                paddingVertical: 12,
                paddingHorizontal: 24,
                backgroundColor: c.orange,
                borderRadius: 10,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaArrowLeft size={12} color="#000" />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: "#000",
              }}
            >
              Back to Refunds
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const statusConfig = getStatusConfig(refund.status);
  const StatusIcon = statusConfig.Icon;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      edges={["top", "left", "right"]}
    >
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 60, gap: 14 }}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <View>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 6,
                alignSelf: "flex-start",
                paddingVertical: 4,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaArrowLeft size={12} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
            >
              Back to Refunds
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 22,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              letterSpacing: -0.3,
              marginTop: 4,
            }}
          >
            Refund Details
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Status banner */}
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 12,
            paddingHorizontal: 14,
            paddingVertical: 14,
            backgroundColor: statusConfig.bg,
            borderWidth: 1.5,
            borderColor: statusConfig.color,
            borderRadius: 14,
          }}
        >
          <StatusIcon size={22} color={statusConfig.color} />
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                fontSize: 9,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.textMuted,
                letterSpacing: 1,
                textTransform: "uppercase",
              }}
            >
              Status
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: statusConfig.color,
                marginTop: 2,
              }}
            >
              {statusConfig.label}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View
            style={{
              paddingHorizontal: 8,
              paddingVertical: 4,
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 999,
              maxWidth: 160,
            }}
          >
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{
                fontSize: 9,
                color: c.textMuted,

              label="Admin Notes"
              value={refund.adminNotes}
              valueStyle={{ maxWidth: "65%" }}
              c={c}

          ) : null}

        {/* Actions */}
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>

                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    color: c.text,
                  }}
                >
                  Print
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleDownloadReceipt}
                disabled={downloading}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flex: 1,
                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    gap: 6,
                    paddingVertical: 12,
                    backgroundColor: c.orange,
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    opacity: downloading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                    minWidth: 120,
                  },

                {downloading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#000" />
                ) : (
                  <FaDownload size={13} color="#000" />
                )}
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    color: "#000",
                  }}
                >
                  {downloading ? "Generating..." : "Download"}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </>
          ) : null}
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flexBasis: "100%",
                alignItems: "center",
                paddingVertical: 12,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 10,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
            >
              View All Refunds
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function Section({ Icon, title, children, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: c.border,
        borderRadius: 14,
        padding: 14,
      }}
    >
      <SectionTitle Icon={Icon} c={c}>
        {title}
      </SectionTitle>
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

// Port of pages/refund/RefundHistory.jsx + Refund.module.css.
//
// Preserved verbatim:
//   - STATUS_CONFIG (7 statuses, exact colors)
//   - GET /refunds/my?status=... (server-side filter)
//   - Stats computed client-side from fetched list (total / totalAmount /
//     pending / completed / rejected)
//   - Filter tabs: all / PENDING / APPROVED / PROCESSING / COMPLETED / REJECTED
//   - Search box (reference / booking.title / currency)
//   - Empty state copy with filter-aware subtext
//   - Skeleton mirrors the CSS shimmer

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useFocusEffect, useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import Skeleton from "../../components/Skeleton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

import {
  FaHistory,
  FaMoneyBillWave,

const STATUS_CONFIG = {
  PENDING: { Icon: FaClock, color: "#fbbf24", label: "Pending Review" },
  APPROVED: { Icon: FaCheckCircle, color: "#22c55e", label: "Approved" },
  PROCESSING: { Icon: FaSpinner, color: "#818cf8", label: "Processing" },
  COMPLETED: { Icon: FaCheckCircle, color: "#22c55e", label: "Completed" },
  FAILED: { Icon: FaTimesCircle, color: "#ef4444", label: "Failed" },
  REJECTED: { Icon: FaTimesCircle, color: "#ef4444", label: "Rejected" },
  DISPUTED: {
    Icon: FaExclamationTriangle,
    color: "#f59e0b",
    label: "In Dispute",
  },
};

const formatPrice = (amount, currency = "NGN") => {
  if (amount == null) return `${currency} 0.00`;
  return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
};

// ── Skeleton ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function RefundSkeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 14 }}>
      {/* Stats skeletons */}
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>

          <View key={i} style={{ width: "48%", minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Skeleton width="100%" height={72} radius={14} />

        ))}
      </View>

      {/* Filter skeletons */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6 }}
      >
        {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
          <Skeleton key={i} width={70} height={32} radius={999} />
        ))}
      </ScrollView>
      <Skeleton width="100%" height={40} radius={10} />

      {/* Refund rows skeleton */}
      {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <Skeleton key={i} width="100%" height={92} radius={12} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function RefundHistoryScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [refunds, setRefunds] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");

  const fetchRefunds = useCallback(
    async (showLoading = true) => {
      if (showLoading) setLoading(true);
      setRefreshing(true);
      try {
        const params = {};
        if (filter !== "all") params.status = filter;

        const response = await client.get("/refunds/my", { params });
        const data = response.data.data;
        const list = data.refunds || [];
        setRefunds(list);

        const totalAmount = list.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.amount || 0), 0);
        const pendingCount = list.filter((r) => r.status === "PENDING").length;
        const completedCount = list.filter(
          (r) => r.status === "COMPLETED",
        ).length;
        const rejectedCount = list.filter(
          (r) => r.status === "REJECTED" || r.status === "FAILED",
        ).length;

        setStats({
          total: list.length,
          totalAmount,
          pending: pendingCount,
          completed: completedCount,
          rejected: rejectedCount,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        if (__DEV__) console.log("[RefundHistory] fetch failed:", err?.message);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [filter],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRefunds(true);
  }, [fetchRefunds]);

  // Refresh when returning from the detail screen
  const firstFocusRef = useCallback(() => true, []);
  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      // re-fetch on focus (initial fetch handled by useEffect)
      fetchRefunds(false);
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [filter]),
  );

  const filteredRefunds = refunds.filter((refund) => {
    if (!searchTerm) return true;
    const search = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    return (
      refund.reference?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
      refund.booking?.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
      refund.currency?.toLowerCase().includes(search)
    );
  });

  const statusTabs = [
    { value: "all", label: "All" },
    { value: "PENDING", label: "Pending" },
    { value: "APPROVED", label: "Approved" },
    { value: "PROCESSING", label: "Processing" },
    { value: "COMPLETED", label: "Completed" },
    { value: "REJECTED", label: "Rejected" },
  ];

  if (loading && !refunds.length) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }} edges={["top"]}>
        <View style={{ padding: 16, gap: 16 }}>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
            <FaHistory size={20} color={c.orange} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.text,
                letterSpacing: -0.3,
              }}
            >
              Refund History
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <RefundSkeleton c={c} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      edges={["top", "left", "right"]}
    >
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 60, gap: 14 }}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => fetchRefunds(false)}
            tintColor={c.orange}
            colors={[c.orange]}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 8,
            flexWrap: "wrap",
          }}
        >
          <FaHistory size={20} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 22,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              letterSpacing: -0.3,
            }}
          >
            Refund History
          </AppText>
          {stats ? (
            <View
              style={{
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                paddingHorizontal: 10,
                paddingVertical: 3,
                borderRadius: 999,
                marginLeft: "auto",
              }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700", color: c.textDim }}
              >
                {`${stats.total} requests`}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Stats grid */}
        {stats ? (
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
            <StatCard
              label="Total Requests"
              value={String(stats.total)}
              c={c}
            />
            <StatCard
              label="Pending"
              value={String(stats.pending)}
              valueColor="#fbbf24"
              c={c}
            />
            <StatCard

              c={c}

              full
              c={c}

        ) : null}

                >
                  {tab.label}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </ScrollView>

        {/* Search */}
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 6,
            backgroundColor: c.bgInput || c.bgCard,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: c.border,
            borderRadius: 10,
            paddingHorizontal: 12,
            paddingVertical: 4,
          }}
        >
          <FaSearch size={13} color={c.textMuted} />
          <TextInput
            value={searchTerm}
            onChangeText={setSearchTerm}
            placeholder="Search by reference or booking..."
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              fontSize: 13,
              color: c.text,
              paddingVertical: 8,
            }}
          />
        </View>

        {/* List */}
        {filteredRefunds.length === 0 ? (
          <View
            style={{
              alignItems: "center",
              paddingVertical: 48,
              paddingHorizontal: 20,
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderWidth: 1.5,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderStyle: "dashed",
              borderRadius: 14,
              gap: 10,
            }}
          >
            <FaHistory size={40} color={c.textMuted} style={{ opacity: 0.5 }} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.text,
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              No refund requests found
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontSize: 12,
                color: c.textDim,
                textAlign: "center",
                maxWidth: 340,
              }}
            >
              {filter !== "all"
                ? `You have no ${filter.toLowerCase()} refund requests.`
                : "You haven't requested any refunds yet."}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Bookings")}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                {
                  marginTop: 6,

                  paddingHorizontal: 24,
                  backgroundColor: c.orange,

          <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            {filteredRefunds.map((refund) => {
              const statusConfig = STATUS_CONFIG[refund.status];
              const StatusIcon = statusConfig?.Icon || FaClock;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={refund.id}
                  onPress={() =>
                    navigation.navigate("RefundDetail", { id: refund.id })

                    {
