                      borderWidth: 1,

                    style={{
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      alignItems: "flex-start",
                      gap: 10,

                  >
                    <View
                      style={{
                        width: 36,
                        height: 36,
                        borderRadius: 9,
                        backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                        borderWidth: 1,
                        borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                        alignItems: "center",
                        justifyContent: "center",
                        flexShrink: 0,

                    </View>
                    <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <View
                        style={{
                          flexDirection: "row",
                          alignItems: "center",
                          gap: 6,
                          flexWrap: "wrap",
                        }}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          numberOfLines={1}
                          style={{
                            fontFamily: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: "700",
                            color: c.text,
                            flexShrink: 1,
                          }}
                        >
                          {refund.booking?.title || "Booking Refund"}
                        </AppText>
                        <View
                          style={{
                            paddingHorizontal: 6,
                            paddingVertical: 1,
                            backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            borderColor: c.border,
                            borderRadius: 999,
                          }}
                        >
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 9,
                              color: c.textMuted,
                              fontWeight: "600",
                            }}
                          >
                            {refund.reference}
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                      </View>
                      <View
                        style={{
                          flexDirection: "row",
                          flexWrap: "wrap",
                          gap: 8,
                          marginTop: 6,
                          alignItems: "center",
                        }}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: "800",
                            color: c.orange,
                          }}
                        >
                          {`${refund.currency} ${Number(refund.amount).toLocaleString()}`}
                        </AppText>
                        <View
                          style={{
                            paddingHorizontal: 6,
                            paddingVertical: 1,
                            backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            borderColor: c.border,
                            borderRadius: 999,
                          }}
                        >
                          <AppText
                            style={{
                              fontSize: 9,
                              fontWeight: "700",
                              color: c.textDim,
                              textTransform: "uppercase",
                              letterSpacing: 0.4,
                            }}
                          >
                            {(
                              refund.refundType?.replace("_", " ") || "Refund"
                            ).toUpperCase()}
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                        <View
                          style={{
                            flexDirection: "row",
                            alignItems: "center",
                            gap: 3,
                          }}
                        >
                          <FaCalendarAlt size={10} color={c.textMuted} />
                          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>
                            {new Date(refund.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(
                              "en-GB",
                              {
                                day: "numeric",
                                month: "short",
                                year: "numeric",
                              },
                            )}
                          </AppText>
                        </View>
                      </View>
                    </View>
                  </View>

                  {/* Footer */}
                  <View
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      alignItems: "center",
                      justifyContent: "space-between",
                      paddingTop: 8,
                      borderTopWidth: 1,
                      borderTopColor: c.border,
                      borderStyle: "dashed",
                    }}
                  >
                    <View
                      style={{
                        flexDirection: "row",
                        alignItems: "center",
                        gap: 4,
                        paddingHorizontal: 8,
                        paddingVertical: 3,
                        borderRadius: 999,
                        borderWidth: 1,
                        borderColor: statusConfig?.color || c.textMuted,
                      }}
                    >
                      <StatusIcon
                        size={10}
                        color={statusConfig?.color || c.textMuted}
                      />
                      <AppText
                        style={{
                          fontSize: 9,
                          fontWeight: "800",
                          color: statusConfig?.color || c.textMuted,
                          textTransform: "uppercase",
                          letterSpacing: 0.5,
                        }}
                      >
                        {statusConfig?.label || refund.status}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                    <FaChevronRight size={11} color={c.textMuted} />
                  </View>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

// ── Stat card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatCard({ label, value, valueColor, full, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: full ? "100%" : "48%",
        minWidth: 0,
        backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: c.border,
        borderRadius: 14,
        paddingHorizontal: 12,
        paddingVertical: 14,
        alignItems: "center",
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}
    >
      <View
        style={{
          position: "absolute",
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          height: 2,
          backgroundColor: c.orange,
          opacity: 0.4,
        }}
      />
      <AppText
        numberOfLines={1}
        adjustsFontSizeToFit
        minimumFontScale={0.7}
        style={{
          fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
          fontSize: 18,
          fontWeight: "800",
          color: valueColor || c.text,
          letterSpacing: -0.4,
        }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        numberOfLines={1}
        style={{
          fontFamily: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
          fontSize: 9,
          fontWeight: "700",
          color: c.textMuted,
          letterSpacing: 1,
          textTransform: "uppercase",
          marginTop: 4,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/RetainedStaffCycleDetailScreen.js

// Verbatim port of src/pages/hirer/retained-staff/HirerCycleDetail.jsx
// + HirerCycleDetail.module.css.

// Note: RN has no useSearchParams. We read `route.params.payment` for
// the "success" flag (set by PayCycleModal navigation).

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  TextInput,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
  RefreshControl,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import EmptyState from "../../components/EmptyState";
import PayCycleModal from "../../components/RetainedStaff/PayCycleModal";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { retainedStaffApi } from "../../api/retainedStaff";

function formatMoney(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  if (amount == null) return "—";
  return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

function formatDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  try {
    return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
      day: "numeric",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
    });
  } catch {
    return "—";
  }
}

const STATUS_META = (t) => ({
  AWAITING_PAYMENT: {
    labelKey: "retainedStaff.cycleStatusAwaiting",
    color: "yellow",
    icon: "time-outline",
  },
  HELD: {
    labelKey: "retainedStaff.cycleStatusHeld",
    color: "orange",
    icon: "cash-outline",
  },
  PARTIALLY_RELEASED: {
    labelKey: "retainedStaff.cycleStatusPartial",
    color: "orange",
    icon: "send-outline",
  },
  RELEASED: {
    labelKey: "retainedStaff.cycleStatusReleased",
    color: "green",
    icon: "checkmark-circle-outline",
  },
  CANCELLED: {
    labelKey: "retainedStaff.cycleStatusCancelled",
    color: "red",
    icon: "close-outline",
  },
  FAILED: {
    labelKey: "retainedStaff.cycleStatusFailed",
    color: "red",
    icon: "alert-circle-outline",
  },
});

export default function RetainedStaffCycleDetailScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  const { id: memberId, cycleId, payment } = route.params || {};

  const [cycle, setCycle] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [showPayModal, setShowPayModal] = useState(false);
  const [releaseAmount, setReleaseAmount] = useState("");
  const [releaseNote, setReleaseNote] = useState("");
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState("");
  const [showCancel, setShowCancel] = useState(false);
  const [cancelReason, setCancelReason] = useState("");

  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;

  const loadCycle = useCallback(
    async (opts = {}) => {
      if (!opts.silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await retainedStaffApi.getCycle(memberId, cycleId);
        setCycle(res.data?.data?.cycle || null);
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(
          err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.cycleLoadFailed"),
        );
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [memberId, cycleId, toast, t],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCycle();
  }, [loadCycle]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (payment === "success") {
      setSuccessMessage(t("retainedStaff.paymentHeld"));
    } else if (payment === "failed") {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.paymentFailed"));
    }
  }, [payment, t]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    loadCycle({ silent: true });
  };

  const paymentObj = cycle?.booking?.payments?.[0];
  const releases = paymentObj?.releases || [];
  const workerPayout = Number(paymentObj?.workerPayout) || 0;
  const releasedAmount = Number(paymentObj?.releasedAmount) || 0;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, workerPayout - releasedAmount);
  const fullyReleased = remaining === 0 && releasedAmount > 0;
  const releasedPct =
    workerPayout > 0 ? Math.round((releasedAmount / workerPayout) * 100) : 0;

  const handleRelease = async () => {
    setError("");
    const amount = parseFloat(releaseAmount);
    if (!amount || amount <= 0) {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.releaseAmountRequired"));
      return;
    }
    if (amount > remaining) {
      setError(
        t("retainedStaff.releaseAmountExceeds", {
          amount: formatMoney(remaining, cycle.currency),
        }),
      );
      return;
    }
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await retainedStaffApi.releaseCycle(cycleId, {
        amount,
        note: releaseNote.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success(t("retainedStaff.releaseSuccess"));
      setReleaseAmount("");
      setReleaseNote("");
      loadCycle({ silent: true });
    } catch (err) {
      const msg =
        err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.releaseFailed");
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = async () => {
    if (!cancelReason.trim()) {
      setError(t("retainedStaff.cancelReasonRequired"));
      return;
    }
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await retainedStaffApi.cancelCycle(cycleId, cancelReason.trim());
      toast.success(t("retainedStaff.cycleCancelled"));
      setShowCancel(false);
      loadCycle({ silent: true });
    } catch (err) {
      const msg =
        err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.cancelFailed");
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const goBack = () => navigation.navigate("RetainedStaffDetail", { memberId });

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false} contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 20 }}>
        <View style={{ gap: 16 }}>
          <View
            style={{
              height: 20,
              width: "30%",
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              borderRadius: 4,
            }}
          />
          <View
            style={{
              height: 100,
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderRadius: 12,
            }}
          />
          <View
            style={{
              height: 140,
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderRadius: 12,
            }}
          />
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  if (!cycle) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <EmptyState
          icon="alert-circle-outline"
          iconSize={48}
          title={t("retainedStaff.cycleNotFound")}
          text={t("retainedStaff.cycleNotFoundSub")}
        />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  const metaFn = STATUS_META(t);
  const meta = metaFn[cycle.status] || metaFn.AWAITING_PAYMENT;
  const statusColor = {
    green: c.green,
    orange: c.orange,
    yellow: "#fbbf24",
    red: c.red,
  }[meta.color];

  return (
    <AppScreen
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={c.orange}
          colors={[c.orange]}
        />
      }
    >
      <Pressable
        onPress={goBack}
        style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 16 }}
      >
        <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={16} color={c.textDim} />
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
            fontSize: rem(0.85),
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.textDim,
            marginLeft: 6,
          }}
        >
          {t("retainedStaff.backToStaff")}
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {successMessage ? (
        <View
          style={{
            backgroundColor: c.greenDim,
            borderRadius: 8,
            padding: 12,
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 8,
            marginBottom: 12,
          }}
        >
          <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={18} color={c.green} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
              fontSize: rem(0.875),
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: c.green,
              flex: 1,
            }}
          >
            {successMessage}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {error ? (
        <View
          style={{
            backgroundColor: c.redDim,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.3)",
            borderRadius: 8,
            padding: 12,
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 8,
            marginBottom: 12,
          }}
        >
          <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={16} color={c.red} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
              fontSize: rem(0.85),
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: c.red,
              flex: 1,
            }}
          >
            {error}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable onPress={() => setError("")} hitSlop={8}>
            <Ionicons name="close" size={16} color={c.red} />
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* Header */}
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "flex-start",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          gap: 12,
          marginBottom: 16,
        }}
      >
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",

          </View>

      ) : null}

            <Pressable
              onPress={handleCancel}
              disabled={actionLoading}
              style={({ pressed }) => ({
                backgroundColor: c.red,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : actionLoading ? 0.6 : 1,
                paddingHorizontal: 16,
                paddingVertical: 10,
                borderRadius: 8,
                flex: 1,
                alignItems: "center",
              })}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{

          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {cycle.member ? (
        <PayCycleModal
          isOpen={showPayModal}
          onClose={() => setShowPayModal(false)}
          cycle={cycle}
          member={cycle.member}
        />
      ) : null}
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/RetainedStaffDetailScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of src/pages/hirer/retained-staff/HirerRetainedStaffDetail.jsx
// + HirerRetainedStaff.module.css (profile header, KPIs, tabs, table).

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
  RefreshControl,
  Image,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import EmptyState from "../../components/EmptyState";
import StatCard from "../../components/RetainedStaff/StatCard";
import CreateCycleModal from "../../components/RetainedStaff/CreateCycleModal";
import EditStaffModal from "../../components/RetainedStaff/EditStaffModal";
import ConfirmModal from "../../components/ConfirmModal";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { retainedStaffApi } from "../../api/retainedStaff";
import client from "../../api/client";

const API_BASE = client?.defaults?.baseURL || "https://api.skilledproz.com";
const resolveAvatar = (raw) => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "string") return null;
  if (raw.startsWith("http")) return raw;
  return `${API_BASE}${raw.startsWith("/") ? "" : "/"}${raw}`;
};

function formatMoney(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  if (amount == null) return "—";
  return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

function formatDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  try {
    return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
      day: "numeric",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
    });
  } catch {
    return "—";
  }
}

const STATUS_COLOR = (theme, status) => {
  const map = {
    ACTIVE: theme.colors.green,
    PAUSED: "#fbbf24",
    ENDED: theme.colors.textMuted,
    TERMINATED: theme.colors.red,
  };
  return map[status] || theme.colors.textMuted;
};

const CYCLE_STATUS_COLOR = (theme, status) => {
  const map = {
    RELEASED: theme.colors.green,
    AWAITING_PAYMENT: "#fbbf24",
    HELD: theme.colors.orange,
    CANCELLED: theme.colors.red,
    PARTIALLY_RELEASED: theme.colors.orange,
    FAILED: theme.colors.red,
  };
  return map[status] || theme.colors.textMuted;
};

export default function RetainedStaffDetailScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  const { memberId } = route.params || {};

  const [member, setMember] = useState(null);
  const [cycles, setCycles] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("payroll");
  const [showCycleModal, setShowCycleModal] = useState(false);
  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);
  const [showDeleteModal, setShowDeleteModal] = useState(false);
  const [cycleToDelete, setCycleToDelete] = useState(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);

  const isWide = width >= 768;
  const isCompact = width <= 640;
  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;

  const loadMember = useCallback(
    async (opts = {}) => {
      if (!opts.silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await retainedStaffApi.getStaff(memberId);
        setMember(res.data?.data?.member || null);
        setCycles(res.data?.data?.recentCycles || []);
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(
          err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.detailLoadFailed"),
        );
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [memberId, toast, t],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    loadMember();
  }, [loadMember]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    loadMember({ silent: true });
  };

  const handlePause = async () => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await retainedStaffApi.pauseStaff(memberId, "Paused from staff detail");
      toast.success(t("retainedStaff.staffPaused"));
      loadMember({ silent: true });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.pauseFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResume = async () => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await retainedStaffApi.resumeStaff(memberId);
      toast.success(t("retainedStaff.staffResumed"));
      loadMember({ silent: true });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.resumeFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteStaff = async () => {
    setShowDeleteModal(false);
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await retainedStaffApi.deleteStaff(memberId);
      toast.success(t("retainedStaff.staffDeleted"));
      navigation.navigate("RetainedStaffList");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.deleteFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteCycle = async () => {
    if (!cycleToDelete) return;
    const target = cycleToDelete;
    setCycleToDelete(null);
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await retainedStaffApi.deleteCycle(target.id);
      toast.success(t("retainedStaff.cycleDeleted"));
      loadMember({ silent: true });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.cycleDeleteFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const goBack = () => navigation.navigate("RetainedStaffList");
  const goCycle = (cycleId) =>
    navigation.navigate("RetainedStaffCycleDetail", {
      id: memberId,
      cycleId,
    });

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false} contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 20 }}>
        <View style={{ gap: 16 }}>
          <View
            style={{
              height: 80,
              width: 80,
              borderRadius: 40,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
            }}
          />
          <View
            style={{
              height: 24,
              width: "60%",
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              borderRadius: 6,
            }}
          />
          <View
            style={{
              height: 14,
              width: "40%",
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              borderRadius: 4,
            }}
          />
          <View
            style={{
              height: 100,
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderRadius: 12,
              marginTop: 12,
            }}
          />
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  if (!member) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <EmptyState
          icon="alert-circle-outline"
          iconSize={48}
          title={t("retainedStaff.detailNotFound")}
          text={t("retainedStaff.detailNotFoundSub")}
        />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  const avatar = resolveAvatar(
    member?.worker?.avatar || member?.worker?.avatarUrl,
  );
  const statusColor = STATUS_COLOR(theme, member.status);
  const canDelete = (member?._count?.cycles ?? 0) === 0;

  return (
    <AppScreen
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={c.orange}
          colors={[c.orange]}
        />
      }
    >
      {/* Back link */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={goBack}
        style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 16 }}

            fontSize: rem(0.85),
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.textDim,
            marginLeft: 6,

            <Ionicons name="person-outline" size={32} color={c.textMuted} />
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <AppText
            numberOfLines={2}
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: rem(1.35),
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,

            {member?.worker?.firstName} {member?.worker?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",

              color: c.textDim,
              marginTop: 2,
            }}

            {member.jobTitle}
            {member.department ? ` · ${member.department}` : ""}
          </AppText>
          <View
            style={{
              alignSelf: "flex-start",
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: statusColor,
              borderRadius: 999,
              paddingHorizontal: 10,
              paddingVertical: 2,
              marginTop: 6,
            }}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                fontSize: rem(0.65),
                fontWeight: "800",
                letterSpacing: 0.05 * rem(0.65),
                textTransform: "uppercase",
                color: statusColor,
              }}
            >
              {member.status}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {member.status === "ACTIVE" ? (

          {member.status === "PAUSED" ? (

                fontWeight: "600",

                        fontSize: rem(0.8),
                        fontWeight: "600",
                        color: c.orange,

              ))}

          )}
        </View>

      <CreateCycleModal

function IconBtn({ icon, onPress, danger, theme }) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => ({
        width: 38,
        height: 38,
        borderRadius: 8,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: pressed
          ? danger
            ? theme.colors.red
            : theme.colors.orange
          : theme.colors.border,
        backgroundColor: pressed
          ? danger
            ? theme.colors.redDim
            : theme.colors.orangeDim
          : theme.colors.bgCard,
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
      })}
    >
      <Ionicons
        name={icon}
        size={16}
        color={danger ? theme.colors.red : theme.colors.textDim}
      />
    </Pressable>
  );
}

function SmallBtn({ label, icon, onPress, disabled, theme, rem }) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={disabled}
      style={({ pressed }) => ({
        flexDirection: "row",
        alignItems: "center",
        paddingHorizontal: 12,
        paddingVertical: 8,
        borderRadius: 8,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: pressed ? theme.colors.orange : theme.colors.border,
        opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1,
      })}
    >
      <Ionicons name={icon} size={14} color={theme.colors.textDim} />
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
          fontSize: rem(0.8),
          fontWeight: "600",
          color: theme.colors.textDim,
          marginLeft: 6,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/RetainedStaffListScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of src/pages/hirer/retained-staff/HirerRetainedStaffList.jsx
// + HirerRetainedStaff.module.css (grid / card sections).
//
// Avatar comes from member.worker.avatar (listStaff returns full worker
// objects per the backend schema).

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  TextInput,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
  RefreshControl,
  Image,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import EmptyState from "../../components/EmptyState";
import FilterTabs from "../../components/RetainedStaff/FilterTabs";
import AddStaffModal from "../../components/RetainedStaff/AddStaffModal";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { retainedStaffApi } from "../../api/retainedStaff";
import client from "../../api/client";

const API_BASE = client?.defaults?.baseURL || "https://api.skilledproz.com";

function resolveAvatar(raw) {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "string") return null;
  if (raw.startsWith("http://") || raw.startsWith("https://")) return raw;
  return `${API_BASE}${raw.startsWith("/") ? "" : "/"}${raw}`;
}

function formatMoney(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  if (amount == null) return "—";
  return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

const STATUS_MAP = (theme) => ({
  ACTIVE: theme.colors.green,
  PAUSED: "#fbbf24",
  ENDED: theme.colors.textMuted,
  TERMINATED: theme.colors.red,
});

export default function RetainedStaffListScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  const [staff, setStaff] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("");
  const [showAdd, setShowAdd] = useState(false);

  const isWide = width >= 768;
  const isCompact = width <= 640;
  const rem = (n) => n * 16 * fontScale;
  const c = theme.colors;
  const statusColors = STATUS_MAP(theme);

  const loadStaff = useCallback(
    async (opts = {}) => {
      if (!opts.silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await retainedStaffApi.listStaff({
          status: statusFilter || undefined,
          search: search || undefined,
        });
        setStaff(res.data?.data?.staff || []);
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(
          err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.listLoadFailed"),
        );
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [statusFilter, search, toast, t],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStaff();
  }, [statusFilter]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    loadStaff({ silent: true });
  }, [loadStaff]);

  const handleSearch = () => {
    loadStaff();
  };

  const goBack = () => navigation.navigate("RetainedStaff");
  const goDetail = (memberId) =>
    navigation.navigate("RetainedStaffDetail", { memberId });

  const statuses = [
    { value: "", label: t("retainedStaff.filterAll") },
    { value: "ACTIVE", label: t("retainedStaff.filterActive") },
    { value: "PAUSED", label: t("retainedStaff.filterPaused") },
    { value: "ENDED", label: t("retainedStaff.filterEnded") },
  ];

  return (
    <AppScreen
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={c.orange}
          colors={[c.orange]}
        />
      }
    >
      {/* Back link */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={goBack}
        style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 16 }}
      >
        <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={16} color={c.textDim} />
        <AppText
          style={{
            fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
            fontSize: rem(0.85),
            fontWeight: "600",
            color: c.textDim,
            marginLeft: 6,
          }}
        >
          {t("retainedStaff.backToPayroll")}
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* Header */}
      <View style={[styles.header, isWide && styles.headerRow]}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
              fontSize: rem(0.75),
              fontWeight: "700",
              letterSpacing: 0.05 * rem(0.75),
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              color: c.orange,
              marginBottom: 4,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.eyebrow")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: Math.min(rem(1.5), Math.max(rem(1.25), width * 0.04)),
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.listTitle")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
              fontSize: rem(0.85),
              color: c.textDim,
              marginTop: 4,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.membersOnPayroll", { count: staff.length })}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setShowAdd(true)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.addBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: pressed ? c.orangeHover : c.orange,
              marginTop: isWide ? 0 : 12,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color="#fff" />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
              fontSize: rem(0.85),
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: "#fff",
              marginLeft: 6,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.addStaffShort")}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* Filter tabs */}
      <View style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <FilterTabs
          options={statuses.map((s) => s.label)}
          value={
            statuses.find((s) => s.value === statusFilter)?.label ||
            statuses[0].label
          }
          onChange={(label) => {
            const match = statuses.find((s) => s.label === label);
            setStatusFilter(match?.value || "");
          }}
        />
      </View>

      {/* Search */}
      <View style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.searchWrap,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="search-outline"
            size={18}
            color={c.textMuted}
            style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
          />
          <TextInput
            value={search}
            onChangeText={setSearch}
            onSubmitEditing={handleSearch}
            placeholder={t("retainedStaff.listSearchPlaceholder")}
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            returnKeyType="search"
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              color: c.text,
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
              fontSize: rem(0.9),
              paddingVertical: 0,
            }}
          />
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Grid */}
      {loading ? (
        <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
          {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
            <View
              key={i}
              style={{
                height: 92,
                backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 12,
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      ) : staff.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon="person-outline"
          iconSize={48}
          title={t("retainedStaff.listEmptyTitle")}
          text={t("retainedStaff.listEmptySub")}
          bordered
        >
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setShowAdd(true)}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.addBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: pressed ? c.orangeHover : c.orange,
                marginTop: 16,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color="#fff" />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                fontSize: rem(0.85),
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: "#fff",
                marginLeft: 6,
              }}
            >
              {t("retainedStaff.addStaffBtn")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </EmptyState>
      ) : (
        <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
          {staff.map((member) => {
            const avatar = resolveAvatar(
              member?.worker?.avatar || member?.worker?.avatarUrl,
            );
            const statusColor =
              statusColors[member.status] || statusColors.ENDED;
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={member.id}
                onPress={() => goDetail(member.id)}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.card,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                    borderColor: pressed ? c.orange : c.border,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.avatar,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                      borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  {avatar ? (
                    <Image source={{ uri: avatar }} style={styles.avatarImg} />
                  ) : (
                    <Ionicons
                      name="person-outline"
                      size={20}
                      color={c.orange}
                    />
                  )}
                </View>
                <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                  <AppText
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    style={{
                      fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                      fontSize: rem(0.9),
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: c.text,
                    }}
                  >
                    {member?.worker?.firstName} {member?.worker?.lastName}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    style={{
                      fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                      fontSize: rem(0.75),
                      color: c.textDim,
                    }}
                  >
                    {member.jobTitle}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    style={{
                      fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                      fontSize: rem(0.75),
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: c.orange,
                      marginTop: 4,
                    }}
                  >
                    {formatMoney(member.payRate, member.currency)} /{" "}
                    {String(member.payFrequency || "")
                      .toLowerCase()
                      .replace("_", " ")}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <View style={{ alignItems: "flex-end", gap: 6 }}>
                  <View
                    style={{
                      borderWidth: 1,
                      borderColor: statusColor,
                      borderRadius: 999,
                      paddingHorizontal: 8,
                      paddingVertical: 2,
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
                        fontSize: rem(0.65),
                        fontWeight: "800",
                        letterSpacing: 0.05 * rem(0.65),
                        textTransform: "uppercase",
                        color: statusColor,
                      }}
                    >
                      {member.status}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <Ionicons
                    name="chevron-forward"
                    size={16}
                    color={c.textMuted}
                  />
                </View>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      )}

      <AddStaffModal
        isOpen={showAdd}
        onClose={() => setShowAdd(false)}
        onSuccess={(member) => {
          loadStaff({ silent: true });
          if (member?.id) goDetail(member.id);
        }}
      />
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/RetainedStaffScreen.js
//
// Verbatim port of src/pages/hirer/retained-staff/HirerRetainedStaffDashboard.jsx
// + HirerRetainedStaff.module.css.
//
// Post-load enrichment: /retained-staff/dashboard does NOT include worker
// avatars in upcomingCycles. We fetch each member's full record via
// GET /retained-staff/:memberId and merge `worker.avatar` into the cycle.

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
  I18nManager,
  RefreshControl,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import EmptyState from "../../components/EmptyState";
import StatCard from "../../components/RetainedStaff/StatCard";
import FilterTabs from "../../components/RetainedStaff/FilterTabs";
import UpcomingItem from "../../components/RetainedStaff/UpcomingItem";
import SummaryItem from "../../components/RetainedStaff/SummaryItem";
import AddStaffModal from "../../components/RetainedStaff/AddStaffModal";
import RetainedStaffSkeleton from "../../components/Skeleton/RetainedStaffSkeleton";

import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { retainedStaffApi } from "../../api/retainedStaff";

function formatMoney(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  if (amount == null) return "—";
  try {
    return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    })}`;
  } catch {
    return `${currency} ${amount}`;
  }
}

// Pull the avatar from a full staff record.
// Backend shape is typically: { worker: { avatar, firstName, lastName, ... }, ... }
function extractAvatarFromMember(member) {
  if (!member) return null;
  return (
    member?.worker?.avatar ||
    member?.worker?.avatarUrl ||
    member?.workerAvatar ||
    member?.avatar ||
    member?.avatarUrl ||
    member?.profileImage ||
    null
  );
}

export default function RetainedStaffScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme, fontScale } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [showAdd, setShowAdd] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCurrency, setSelectedCurrency] = useState("NGN");

  // ── Breakpoints (mirror CSS) ────────────────────────────────
  const isWide = width >= 768;
  const isXWide = width >= 900;
  const isCompact = width <= 640;

  const rem = useCallback((n) => n * 16 * fontScale, [fontScale]);
  const chevron = I18nManager.isRTL ? "chevron-back" : "chevron-forward";

  const load = useCallback(
    async (opts = {}) => {
      if (!opts.silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await retainedStaffApi.getDashboard();
        const dashboard = res.data?.data?.dashboard || {};
        setData(dashboard);
        const active = dashboard.activeCurrencies || [];
        if (active.length > 0 && !active.includes("NGN")) {
          setSelectedCurrency(active[0]);
        } else if (active.length > 0) {
          setSelectedCurrency("NGN");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(
          err?.response?.data?.message || t("retainedStaff.genericError"),
        );
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [toast, t],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  // ─── AVATAR ENRICHMENT ─────────────────────────────────────
  // /dashboard omits worker avatars → fetch each member's full
  // record via /retained-staff/:id and merge worker.avatar.
  useEffect(() => {
    const cycles = data?.upcomingCycles;
    if (!Array.isArray(cycles) || cycles.length === 0) return;

    // Skip if all cycles already have an avatar (idempotent)
    const needsFetch = cycles.some((c) => !c.workerAvatar && !c.avatar);
    if (!needsFetch) return;

    let cancelled = false;

    (async () => {
      const enriched = await Promise.all(
        cycles.map(async (c) => {
          // Already has avatar → keep as-is
          if (c.workerAvatar || c.avatar) return c;
          try {
            const r = await retainedStaffApi.getStaff(c.memberId);
            const member =
              r.data?.data?.member ||
              r.data?.data ||
              r.data?.member ||
              r.member ||
              null;
            const avatar = extractAvatarFromMember(member);
            if (avatar) {
              return { ...c, workerAvatar: avatar };
            }
            return c;
          } catch (err) {
            console.log(
              "[RetainedStaff] getStaff failed for",
              c.memberId,
              err?.message,
              err?.response?.status,
            );
            return c;
          }
        }),
      );
      if (cancelled) return;
      setData((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, upcomingCycles: enriched } : prev));
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [data?.upcomingCycles]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load({ silent: true });
  }, [load]);

  // ── Derived data ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const currency = selectedCurrency;
  const burn = data?.monthlyBurnByCurrency?.[currency] || 0;
  const activeCount = data?.activeCount || 0;
  const pendingPayments = data?.pendingPayments || 0;
  const heldInEscrow = data?.heldInEscrowByCurrency?.[currency] || 0;
  const releasedThisMonth = data?.releasedThisMonthByCurrency?.[currency] || 0;

  const upcoming = useMemo(
    () => (data?.upcomingCycles || []).filter((c) => c.currency === currency),
    [data?.upcomingCycles, currency],
  );
  const activeCurrencies = data?.activeCurrencies || ["NGN"];

  // ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const goStaffList = () => navigation.navigate("RetainedStaffList");
  const goStaffDetail = (memberId) =>
    navigation.navigate("RetainedStaffDetail", { memberId });

  // ── Loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
        <RetainedStaffSkeleton />
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AppScreen
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={theme.colors.orange}
          colors={[theme.colors.orange]}
        />
      }
    >
      {/* ── Header ── */}
      <View style={[styles.header, isWide && styles.headerRow]}>
        <View style={{ flexShrink: 1, flex: isWide ? 1 : undefined }}>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodyBold || "DMSans_700Bold",
              fontSize: rem(0.75),
              lineHeight: rem(0.75) * 1.3,
              fontWeight: "700",
              letterSpacing: 0.05 * rem(0.75),
              textTransform: "uppercase",
              color: theme.colors.orange,
              marginBottom: 4,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.eyebrow")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.displayBlack || "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: Math.min(rem(1.5), Math.max(rem(1.25), width * 0.04)),
              lineHeight:
                Math.min(rem(1.5), Math.max(rem(1.25), width * 0.04)) * 1.15,
              fontWeight: "800",
              letterSpacing: -0.02 * rem(1.5),
              color: theme.colors.text,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.title")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
              fontSize: rem(0.85),
              lineHeight: rem(0.85) * 1.35,
              color: theme.colors.textDim,
              marginTop: 4,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.subtitle")}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setShowAdd(true)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.addBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: pressed
                ? theme.colors.orangeHover
                : theme.colors.orange,
              marginTop: isWide ? 0 : 12,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color="#fff" />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
              fontSize: rem(0.85),
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: "#fff",
              marginLeft: 6,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.addStaffBtn")}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ── Currency filter ── */}
      {activeCurrencies.length > 1 ? (
        <View style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
          <FilterTabs
            options={activeCurrencies}
            value={selectedCurrency}
            onChange={setSelectedCurrency}
          />
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── KPI cards ── */}
      <View style={styles.statsGrid}>
        {[
          {
            icon: "people-outline",
            label: t("retainedStaff.activeStaff"),
            value: String(activeCount),
            accent: "default",
          },
          {
            icon: "cash-outline",
            label: t("retainedStaff.monthlyBurn"),
            value: formatMoney(burn, currency),
            accent: "orange",
          },
          {
            icon: "time-outline",
            label: t("retainedStaff.pendingPayments"),
            value: String(pendingPayments),
            accent: "yellow",
          },
          {
            icon: "checkmark-circle-outline",
            label: t("retainedStaff.releasedThisMonth"),
            value: formatMoney(releasedThisMonth, currency),
            accent: "green",
          },
        ].map((c, i) => (
          <View
            key={i}
            style={{
              width: isCompact ? "48%" : isWide ? "23%" : "48%",
              marginBottom: 12,
            }}
          >
            <StatCard
              icon={c.icon}
              label={c.label}
              value={c.value}
              accent={c.accent}
            />
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>

      {/* ── Two-column panels ── */}
      <View style={[styles.twoCol, isXWide && styles.twoColRow]}>
        {/* Upcoming cycles panel */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.panel,
            {
              width: isXWide ? "48%" : "100%",
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
              borderColor: theme.colors.border,
              marginBottom: 16,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.panelHeader}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.display || "Syne_700Bold",
                fontSize: rem(1.125),
                lineHeight: rem(1.125) * 1.2,
                fontWeight: "700",
                letterSpacing: -0.01 * rem(1.125),
                color: theme.colors.text,
                flex: 1,
              }}
            >
              {t("retainedStaff.upcomingCycles", { currency })}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              onPress={goStaffList}
              hitSlop={8}
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" }}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                  fontSize: rem(0.8),
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: theme.colors.textDim,
                }}
              >
                {t("retainedStaff.manageStaff")}
              </AppText>
              <Ionicons
                name={chevron}
                size={14}
                color={theme.colors.textDim}
                style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}
              />
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          {upcoming.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon="time-outline"

              compact

        </View>

        {/* Payroll summary panel */}
        <View

              marginBottom: 16,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: theme.fonts?.display || "Syne_700Bold",
              fontSize: rem(1.125),
              lineHeight: rem(1.125) * 1.2,
              fontWeight: "700",
              letterSpacing: -0.01 * rem(1.125),
              color: theme.colors.text,
              marginBottom: 20,
            }}
          >
            {t("retainedStaff.payrollSummary", { currency })}
          </AppText>

          <SummaryItem
            label={t("retainedStaff.heldInEscrow")}
            value={formatMoney(heldInEscrow, currency)}
          />
          <SummaryItem
            label={t("retainedStaff.releasedThisMonth")}
            value={formatMoney(releasedThisMonth, currency)}
          />
          <SummaryItem
            label={t("retainedStaff.monthlyBurn")}
            value={formatMoney(burn, currency)}
            isLast
          />

          <Pressable
            onPress={goStaffList}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.btnGhost,
              {
                borderColor: pressed
                  ? theme.colors.orange
                  : theme.colors.border,
                marginTop: 16,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                fontSize: rem(0.85),
                fontWeight: "600",
                color: theme.colors.textDim,
              }}
            >
              {t("retainedStaff.viewAllStaff")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* ── Hint card ── */}
      {activeCount === 0 ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.hintCard,
            isWide && styles.hintRow,
            {
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
              borderColor: theme.colors.border,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.hintIcon,
              { backgroundColor: theme.colors.orangeDim },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="briefcase-outline"
              size={22}
              color={theme.colors.orange}
            />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.display || "Syne_700Bold",
                fontSize: rem(1),
                lineHeight: rem(1) * 1.25,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: theme.colors.text,
                marginBottom: 8,
                textAlign: isWide ? "left" : "center",
              }}
            >
              {t("retainedStaff.getStartedTitle")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: theme.fonts?.body || "DMSans_400Regular",
                fontSize: rem(0.85),
                lineHeight: rem(0.85) * 1.5,
                color: theme.colors.textDim,
                marginBottom: 12,
                textAlign: isWide ? "left" : "center",
              }}
            >
              {t("retainedStaff.getStartedDesc")}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowAdd(true)}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.addBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: pressed
                    ? theme.colors.orangeHover
                    : theme.colors.orange,
                  alignSelf: isWide ? "flex-start" : "center",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color="#fff" />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontFamily: theme.fonts?.bodySemiBold || "DMSans_600SemiBold",
                  fontSize: rem(0.85),
                  fontWeight: "600",
                  color: "#fff",
                  marginLeft: 6,
                }}
              >
                {t("retainedStaff.addFirstStaff")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── Add Staff Modal ── */}
      <AddStaffModal
        isOpen={showAdd}
        onClose={() => setShowAdd(false)}
        onSuccess={(member) => {
          load({ silent: true });
          if (member?.id) goStaffDetail(member.id);
        }}
      />
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/ReviewsGivenScreen.js
// Endpoint: GET /hirers/me/reviews/given
// Shows stats card + reviews given with "View Profile →" button.
// All strings via t(). Full dark/light mode support.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { getReviewsGiven } from "../../api/reviews";

function fmtDateTime(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

function StarRow({ rating, size = 16, color }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <AppText
          key={i}
          style={{ fontSize: size, color: i <= rating ? color : "#4b5563" }}
        >
          ★
        </AppText>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Stats card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatsCard({ totalReviews, avgRating, c, t }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        s.statsCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={s.statItem}>
        <AppText weight="displayBlack" style={[s.statNum, { color: c.orange }]}>
          {totalReviews}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
          {t("reviews.submitted")}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <View style={[s.statDivider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
      <View style={s.statItem}>
        <AppText weight="displayBlack" style={[s.statNum, { color: c.orange }]}>
          {Number(avgRating).toFixed(1)}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
          {t("reviews.avgGiven")}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Review card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReviewGivenCard({ review, c, t, onViewProfile }) {
  const receiver = review.receiver ?? review.giver ?? {};
  const booking = review.booking;
  const location = [receiver.city, receiver.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

  return (
    <View
      style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* Author row */}
      <View style={s.authorRow}>
        <View
          style={[
            s.avatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {receiver.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: receiver.avatar }} style={s.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
              {initials(receiver.firstName, receiver.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={s.authorInfo}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {receiver.firstName} {receiver.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            {receiver.role === "WORKER"
              ? t("reviews.worker")
              : t("reviews.hirer")}
          </AppText>
          {!!location && (
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
              {location}
            </AppText>
          )}
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            {fmtDateTime(review.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <View style={s.ratingCol}>
          <StarRow rating={review.rating} size={15} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, textAlign: "right", marginTop: 2 }}
          >
            {review.rating}/5
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Comment */}
      {!!review.comment && (
        <View style={[s.quoteRow, { borderLeftColor: c.orange }]}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ color: c.text, fontStyle: "italic" }}
          >
            "{review.comment}"
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Booking chip + View Profile */}
      {booking && (
        <View
          style={[
            s.bookingChip,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={s.chipLeft}>
            {!!booking.category?.icon && (
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, marginRight: 6 }}>
                {booking.category.icon}
              </AppText>
            )}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {booking.title}
            </AppText>
            {booking.category?.name && (
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 6 }}
              >
                {booking.category.name}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          {/* View Profile — only on Reviews Given */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => onViewProfile(receiver.id)}
            style={s.viewProfileBtn}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {t("reviews.viewProfile")} →
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            s.skCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function ReviewsGivenScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);

  const doFetch = useCallback(async (pg = 1, replace = true) => {
    try {
      const d = await getReviewsGiven({ page: pg, limit: 15 });
      setData(d);
      setReviews(
        replace ? (d.reviews ?? []) : (prev) => [...prev, ...(d.reviews ?? [])],
      );
      setTotalPages(d.pages ?? 1);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    doFetch(1, true);
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setPage(1);
    doFetch(1, true);
  };
  const loadMore = () => {
    if (page < totalPages) {
      const next = page + 1;
      setPage(next);
      doFetch(next, false);
    }
  };

  // Derive stats from response
  const totalReviews = data?.total ?? reviews.length;
  const avgRating =
    data?.avgRating ??
    (reviews.length
      ? reviews.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length
      : 0);

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={reviews}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
        onEndReached={loadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.4}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* Hero */}
            <View style={styles.heroWrap}>
              <View style={[styles.eyebrow, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff", letterSpacing: 1.2 }}
                >
                  {t("reviews.feedbackEyebrow")}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.givenSubtitle")}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => navigation.navigate("ReviewsReceived")}
                style={[
                  styles.switchBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.text }}>
                  {t("reviews.seeReceived")} →
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Stats */}
            {!loading && (
              <StatsCard
                totalReviews={totalReviews}
                avgRating={avgRating}
                c={c}
                t={t}
              />
            )}
            <View style={{ height: 16 }} />
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <ReviewGivenCard
            review={item}
            c={c}
            t={t}
            onViewProfile={(userId) =>
              navigation.navigate("WorkerProfile", { userId })
            }
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>✍️</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.noReviewsYet")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.noGivenSub")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", padding: 20 }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
          )
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  screen: { flex: 1 },
  content: { padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40 },

        </AppText>

    </View>

// ── Rating summary card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function RatingSummaryCard({ avgRating, totalReviews, distribution, c, t }) {
  const filledStars = Math.round(avgRating);
  const maxCount = Math.max(
    ...[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((s) => distribution[s] ?? 0),
    1,
  );

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        s.summaryCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Top row: big number + star row */}
      <View style={s.summaryTop}>
        <AppText
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={[s.bigRating, { color: c.orange }]}
        >
          {Number(avgRating).toFixed(1)}
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}>
          <StarRow rating={filledStars} size={22} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
            {totalReviews} {t("reviews.reviewsCount", { count: totalReviews })}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Distribution bars */}
      <View style={[s.distBlock, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((star) => {
          const count = distribution[star] ?? 0;
          const pct = maxCount > 0 ? count / maxCount : 0;
          return (
            <View key={star} style={s.distRow}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.distLabel}>
                {star} ★
              </AppText>
              <View style={[s.barTrack, { backgroundColor: c.bgInput }]}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    s.barFill,
                    { backgroundColor: c.orange, width: `${pct * 100}%` },
                  ]}
                />
              </View>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.distCount}>
                {count}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff", letterSpacing: 1.2 }}
                >
                  {t("reviews.reputationEyebrow")}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.receivedSubtitle")}
              </AppText>
              {/* See Reviews Given link */}
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => navigation.navigate("ReviewsGiven")}
                style={[
                  styles.switchBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.text }}>
                  {t("reviews.seeGiven")} →
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Rating summary */}
            {data && (
              <RatingSummaryCard
                avgRating={data.avgRating ?? 0}
                totalReviews={data.totalReviews ?? 0}
                distribution={data.distribution ?? {}}
                c={c}
                t={t}
              />
            )}
            <View style={{ height: 16 }} />
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => <ReviewCard review={item} c={c} t={t} />}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>⭐</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.noReviewsYet")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.noReceivedSub")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", padding: 20 }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
          )
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}
