// src/screens/main/SavedWorkersScreen.js
//
// Port of pages/hirer/HirerSavedWorkers.jsx.
// Two tabs: Saved (explicit bookmarks) and Previously Hired (booking history).
// Eager-loads both on mount (matching the web). Unsave stays local on success
// — no refetch. Uses the shared Skeleton component for loading state.
//
// Navigation targets verified against HirerNavigator.js:
//   - WorkerProfile  (WorkerPublicProfileScreen)  → { userId }
//   - CreateBooking  (CreateBookingScreen)         → { workerId }
//   - BrowseWorkers  (BrowseWorkersScreen)         → no params
//
// RN GOTCHA fixed: category pill previously rendered
//   {icon} {name}
// as two JSX expressions separated by a literal space — the space escaped
// the <AppText> wrapper and threw "Text strings must be rendered within a
// <Text> component". Now built as a single template string.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useFocusEffect, useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import Skeleton from "../../components/Skeleton";
import ReportButton from "../../components/ReportButton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaMapMarkerAlt,
  FaBookmark,
  FaBriefcase,
  FaStar,
  FaCheck,
  FaPlus,
  FaArrowRight,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaAlertCircle,
} from "../../icons/fa";

// ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Avatar({ user, size = 44, c }) {
  const initials =
    `${user?.firstName?.[0] || ""}${user?.lastName?.[0] || ""}`.toUpperCase() ||
    "?";

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: size / 2,
        backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
        borderWidth: 2,
        borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        overflow: "hidden",
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
    >
      {user?.avatar ? (
        <Image
          source={{ uri: user.avatar }}
          style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
        />
      ) : (
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "800", color: c.orange }}>
          {initials}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function StarRating({ rating, c }) {
  if (!rating) return null;
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 3,
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
    >
      <FaStar size={12} color={c.orange} />
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.orange }}>
        {Number(rating).toFixed(1)}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Single worker card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function WorkerCard({
  worker,
  isSaved,
  onUnsave,
  unsaving,
  onNavigateProfile,
  onNavigateBook,
  c,
}) {
  const wp = worker.workerProfile;

  // Build the location string once — avoids two-expression JSX
  const locationText = [worker.city, worker.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

  // Build the hourly rate once
  const hourlyText =
    wp?.hourlyRate != null
      ? `${wp.currency || "NGN"} ${Number(wp.hourlyRate).toLocaleString()}`
      : null;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.card,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Top: avatar + name/title/location + rating */}
      <View style={styles.cardTop}>
        <Avatar user={worker} size={44} c={c} />
        <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <AppText
            numberOfLines={1}
            style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}
          >
            {`${worker.firstName || ""} ${worker.lastName || ""}`.trim()}
          </AppText>

          {wp?.title ? (
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 2 }}
            >
              {wp.title}
            </AppText>
          ) : null}

          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              flexWrap: "wrap",
              gap: 8,
              marginTop: 4,
            }}
          >
            {locationText ? (
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: 3,
                }}
              >
                <FaMapMarkerAlt size={11} color={c.textMuted} />
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
                  {locationText}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {wp?.isAvailable ? (
              <AppText
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "600", color: c.green }}
              >
                ● Available
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </View>
        <StarRating rating={wp?.avgRating} c={c} />
      </View>

      {/* Categories */}
      {wp?.categories?.length > 0 ? (
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 5 }}>
          {wp.categories.map((cat, i) => {
            // Build the label as a SINGLE string — no adjacent JSX
            // expressions separated by a literal space (RN throws).
            const icon = cat?.category?.icon || "";
            const name = cat?.category?.name || "";
            const label = `${icon} ${name}`.trim();
            if (!label) return null;
            return (
              <View
                key={`${name || i}`}
                style={{
                  paddingHorizontal: 8,
                  paddingVertical: 2,
                  borderRadius: 20,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                }}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  {label}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* Stats row */}
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          flexWrap: "wrap",
          gap: 10,
          paddingVertical: 8,
          paddingHorizontal: 10,
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderRadius: 9,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
        }}
      >
        {hourlyText ? (
          <View
            style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "baseline", gap: 2 }}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
              {hourlyText}
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>/hr</AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {wp?.completedJobs > 0 ? (
          <View
            style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "baseline", gap: 2 }}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
              {String(wp.completedJobs)}
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>jobs</AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {wp?.totalReviews > 0 ? (
          <View
            style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "baseline", gap: 2 }}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
              {String(wp.totalReviews)}
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 10, color: c.textMuted }}>
              reviews
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {wp?.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED" ? (
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 3,
              marginLeft: "auto",
              paddingHorizontal: 7,
              paddingVertical: 2,
              backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.1)",
              borderRadius: 8,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.25)",
            }}
          >
            <FaCheck size={10} color={c.green} />
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700", color: c.green }}
            >
              Verified
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {/* Last hired — hired tab only */}
      {worker.lastCategory ? (
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
          {"Last hired for: "}
          <AppText style={{ fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}>
            {worker.lastCategory.name || ""}
          </AppText>
        </AppText>
      ) : null}

      {/* Saved at — saved tab only */}
      {worker.savedAt ? (
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}>
          {`Saved ${new Date(worker.savedAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
            day: "numeric",
            month: "short",
            year: "numeric",
          })}`}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}

      {/* Actions */}
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 6, marginTop: 2 }}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => onNavigateProfile(worker.id)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.viewBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderColor: c.border,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
          >
            View Profile
          </AppText>
          <FaArrowRight size={12} color={c.textDim} />
        </Pressable>

        <ReportButton
          targetType="USER"
          targetId={worker.id}
          targetName={`${worker.firstName || ""} ${
            worker.lastName || ""
          }`.trim()}
          variant="icon"
        />

        <Pressable
          onPress={() => onNavigateBook(worker.id)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.bookBtn,
            { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1 },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "700", color: "#000" }}>
            Book
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {isSaved ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => onUnsave(worker.id)}
            disabled={unsaving === worker.id}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.unsaveBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.redDim,
                borderColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.25)",
                opacity: unsaving === worker.id ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            {unsaving === worker.id ? (
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.red }}>…</AppText>
            ) : (
              <FaBookmark size={14} color={c.red} />
            )}
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Main screen ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function SavedWorkersScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [tab, setTab] = useState("saved");
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState([]);
  const [hired, setHired] = useState([]);
  const [loadingSaved, setLoadingSaved] = useState(true);
  const [loadingHired, setLoadingHired] = useState(true);
  const [unsaving, setUnsaving] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const notify = useCallback((msg, type = "success") => {
    setToast({ msg, type });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
  }, []);

  const fetchSaved = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingSaved(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.get("/hirers/me/saved-workers");
      setSaved(res.data.data?.workers || []);
    } catch {
      notify("Failed to load saved workers", "error");
    } finally {
      setLoadingSaved(false);
    }
  }, [notify]);

  const fetchHired = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingHired(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.get("/hirers/me/hired-workers");
      setHired(res.data.data?.workers || []);
    } catch {
      notify("Failed to load hired workers", "error");
    } finally {
      setLoadingHired(false);
    }
  }, [notify]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSaved();
  }, [fetchSaved]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchHired();
  }, [fetchHired]);

  // Refresh on focus so newly-saved workers from another screen appear
  // when the user returns. Skip the very first focus (mount already
  // triggers both fetch calls).
  const firstFocusRef = useRef(true);
  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      if (firstFocusRef.current) {
        firstFocusRef.current = false;
        return;
      }
      fetchSaved();
      fetchHired();
    }, [fetchSaved, fetchHired]),
  );

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    await Promise.all([fetchSaved(), fetchHired()]);
    setRefreshing(false);
  }, [fetchSaved, fetchHired]);

  const handleUnsave = useCallback(
    async (workerId) => {
      setUnsaving(workerId);
      try {
        await client.delete(`/hirers/me/saved-workers/${workerId}`);
        setSaved((prev) => prev.filter((w) => w.id !== workerId));
        notify("Worker removed from saved list");
      } catch {
        notify("Failed to remove worker", "error");
      } finally {
        setUnsaving(null);
      }
    },
    [notify],
  );

  const handleNavigateProfile = useCallback(
    (workerId) => {
      navigation.navigate("WorkerProfile", { userId: workerId });
    },
    [navigation],
  );

  const handleNavigateBook = useCallback(
    (workerId) => {
      navigation.navigate("CreateBooking", { workerId });
    },
    [navigation],
  );

  const handleBrowse = useCallback(() => {
    navigation.navigate("BrowseWorkers");
  }, [navigation]);

  const activeWorkers = tab === "saved" ? saved : hired;
  const isLoading = tab === "saved" ? loadingSaved : loadingHired;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      edges={["top", "left", "right"]}
    >
      {/* Toast */}
      {toast ? (
        <View
          pointerEvents="none"
          style={{
            position: "absolute",
            top: 60,
            right: 16,
            zIndex: 9999,
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 8,
            paddingHorizontal: 14,
            paddingVertical: 10,
            borderRadius: 10,
            backgroundColor: toast.type === "success" ? c.greenDim : c.redDim,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: toast.type === "success" ? c.green : c.red,
          }}
        >
          {toast.type === "success" ? (
            <FaCheckCircle size={14} color={c.green} />
          ) : (
            <FaAlertCircle size={14} color={c.red} />
          )}
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: toast.type === "success" ? c.green : c.red,
            }}
          >
            {toast.msg}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      <FlatList
        data={isLoading ? [] : activeWorkers}
        keyExtractor={(w) => String(w.id)}
        contentContainerStyle={{
          paddingHorizontal: 16,
          paddingTop: 20,
          paddingBottom: 80,
        }}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={handleRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
            colors={[c.orange]}
          />
        }
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View style={{ gap: 20, marginBottom: 12 }}>
            {/* Header */}
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "flex-start",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                gap: 12,
                flexWrap: "wrap",
              }}
            >
              <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 24,
                    fontWeight: "900",
                    color: c.text,
                    letterSpacing: -0.5,
                  }}
                >
                  My Workers
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, marginTop: 4 }}
                >
                  Manage your saved shortlist and view your hiring history.
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleBrowse}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 6,
                    paddingHorizontal: 16,
                    paddingVertical: 9,
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    backgroundColor: c.orange,
                    opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaPlus size={14} color="#000" />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: "800",
                    color: "#000",
                  }}
                >
                  Browse Workers
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Tabs */}
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                gap: 6,
                padding: 6,
                backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 12,
                alignSelf: "flex-start",
              }}
            >
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setTab("saved")}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 6,
                    paddingHorizontal: 14,
                    paddingVertical: 8,
                    borderRadius: 8,

                    color: tab === "saved" ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  Saved
                </AppText>
                {saved.length > 0 ? (
                  <View
                    style={{
                      minWidth: 18,
                      height: 18,

                      borderRadius: 9,
                      backgroundColor: c.orange,
                      alignItems: "center",
                      justifyContent: "center",
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "800", color: "#000" }}
                    >
                      {String(saved.length)}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                ) : null}
              </Pressable>

              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setTab("hired")}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flexDirection: "row",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: 6,
                    paddingHorizontal: 14,
                    paddingVertical: 8,
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    backgroundColor:
                      tab === "hired" ? c.orangeDim : "transparent",
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: tab === "hired" ? c.orangeGlow : "transparent",
                    opacity: pressed && tab !== "hired" ? 0.8 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <FaBriefcase
                  size={13}
                  color={tab === "hired" ? c.orange : c.textDim}
                />
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: "600",
                    color: tab === "hired" ? c.orange : c.textDim,
                  }}
                >
                  Previously Hired
                </AppText>
                {hired.length > 0 ? (
                  <View
                    style={{
                      minWidth: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      paddingHorizontal: 5,
                      borderRadius: 9,
                      backgroundColor: c.orange,
                      alignItems: "center",
                      justifyContent: "center",
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "800", color: "#000" }}
                    >
                      {String(hired.length)}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                ) : null}
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        }
        ListEmptyComponent={
          isLoading ? (
            <Skeletons c={c} />
          ) : (
            <Empty tab={tab} onBrowse={handleBrowse} c={c} />
          )
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <WorkerCard
              worker={item}
              isSaved={tab === "saved"}
              onUnsave={handleUnsave}
              unsaving={unsaving}
              onNavigateProfile={handleNavigateProfile}
              onNavigateBook={handleNavigateBook}
              c={c}
            />
          </View>
        )}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/SubscriptionsScreen.js
// Endpoints: GET /subscriptions/plans?role=HIRER
//            GET /subscriptions/my
//            POST /subscriptions/checkout  → opens Stripe URL in browser

// Mirrors website SubscriptionPlans page exactly.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Linking,

  RefreshControl,

  View,
} from "react-native";

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

// ── Skeleton ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 16 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            styles.planCard,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderColor: c.border,
              minHeight: 300,
              opacity: 0.4,
            },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Plan Card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function PlanCard({ plan, isCurrent, isPopular, onSubscribe, subscribing, c }) {
  const isFree = plan.price === 0;

  // Border color
  const borderColor = isCurrent ? "#22c55e" : isPopular ? c.orange : c.border;

  const btnBg = isCurrent
    ? "transparent"
    : isPopular || !isFree
      ? c.orange
      : c.bgInput;

  const btnLabel = isCurrent
    ? "Current Plan"
    : isFree
      ? "Free Plan"
      : `Upgrade to ${plan.name}`;

  const btnTextColor = isCurrent ? "#22c55e" : isFree ? c.textMuted : "#fff";

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.planCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor },
        isCurrent && { borderWidth: 2 },
        isPopular && !isCurrent && { borderWidth: 2 },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Top badge */}
      {(isPopular || isCurrent) && (
        <View style={styles.badgeWrap}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.badge,
              { backgroundColor: isCurrent ? "#22c55e" : c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 12 }}
            >
              {isCurrent ? "Current Plan" : "Most Popular"}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={styles.planBody}>
        {/* Plan name */}
        <AppText
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={[styles.planName, { color: c.text }]}
        >
          {plan.name}
        </AppText>

        {/* Price */}
        <View style={styles.priceRow}>
          {isFree ? (
            <AppText
              weight="displayBlack"
              style={[styles.priceAmount, { color: c.orange }]}
            >
              Free
            </AppText>
          ) : (
            <>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  color: c.textMuted,
                  fontSize: 15,
                  marginRight: 4,
                  alignSelf: "flex-end",
                  marginBottom: 4,
                }}
              >
                {plan.currency}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                weight="displayBlack"
                style={[styles.priceAmount, { color: c.orange }]}
              >
                {plan.price.toLocaleString()}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  color: c.textMuted,
                  fontSize: 15,
                  alignSelf: "flex-end",
                  marginBottom: 4,
                  marginLeft: 2,
                }}
              >
                /mo
              </AppText>
            </>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Feature list */}
        <View style={styles.featureList}>
          {plan.features.map((f, i) => (
            <View key={i} style={styles.featureRow}>
              <AppText
                style={{
                  color: "#22c55e",
                  fontSize: 15,
                  marginRight: 10,
                  marginTop: 1,
                }}
              >
                ✓
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, flex: 1, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                {f}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* CTA */}
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => !isCurrent && !isFree && onSubscribe(plan.id)}
          disabled={isCurrent || isFree || subscribing === plan.id}
          style={[
            styles.planBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: btnBg,
              borderColor: isCurrent ? "#22c55e" : isFree ? c.border : c.orange,
              borderWidth: isCurrent || isFree ? 1 : 0,
              opacity: subscribing && subscribing !== plan.id ? 0.5 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {subscribing === plan.id ? (
            <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
          ) : (
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: btnTextColor }}
            >
              {btnLabel}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Main Screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function SubscriptionsScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();

  const [plans, setPlans] = useState([]);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [subscribing, setSubscribing] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [p, s] = await Promise.all([
        getPlans(user?.role ?? "HIRER"), // passes the viewer's role
        getMySubscription(),
      ]);
      setPlans(p);
      setCurrent(s);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to load plans");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load();
  };

  const handleSubscribe = async (planId) => {
    setSubscribing(planId);
    try {
      const data = await createCheckout(planId);
      if (data?.url) {
        // Open Stripe checkout in browser
        await Linking.openURL(data.url);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to start checkout");
    } finally {
      setSubscribing(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      "Cancel Subscription",
      "Are you sure? You'll keep access until the end of the billing period.",
      [
        { text: "Keep Plan", style: "cancel" },
        {
          text: "Cancel Subscription",
          style: "destructive",
          onPress: async () => {
            try {
              await cancelSubscription();
              toast.success(
                "Subscription cancelled. Access remains until period end.",
              );
              load();
            } catch {
              toast.error("Failed to cancel subscription");
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  };

  const currentTier = current?.subscription?.tier ?? "FREE";
  const hasActivePaid = currentTier !== "FREE";

  return (
    <ScrollView
      style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
    >
      {/* ── Hero ── */}
      <View style={styles.hero}>
        <AppText
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={[styles.heroTitle, { color: c.text }]}
        >
          Choose Your Plan
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={[styles.heroSub, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          Hire smarter, faster, and at scale
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* ── Active plan banner ── */}
      {!loading && hasActivePaid && (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.activeBanner,
            { backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.08)", borderColor: "#22c55e" },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22, lineHeight: 28 }}>✅</AppText>
          <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
              Active: {current?.plan?.name}
            </AppText>
            {current?.expiresAt && (
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
              >
                Renews {fmtDate(current.expiresAt)}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          <Pressable onPress={handleCancel}>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              Cancel
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Plans ── */}
      {loading ? (
        <Skeleton c={c} />
      ) : (
        <View style={{ gap: 20 }}>
          {plans.map((plan) => (
            <PlanCard
              key={plan.id}
              plan={plan}
              isCurrent={currentTier === plan.tier}
              isPopular={!!plan.popular}
              onSubscribe={handleSubscribe}
              subscribing={subscribing}
              c={c}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Disclaimer ── */}
      {!loading && (
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          style={{ color: c.textMuted, textAlign: "center", marginTop: 24 }}
        >
          Payments processed securely. Cancel anytime. All prices in USD.
        </AppText>
      )}

      <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

  PENDING: { emoji: "⏳", color: "#f97316", label: "Pending Review" },

  "Your profile shows a Verified badge in search",
  "Unlock higher booking frequency and limits",
  "Disputes are resolved faster for verified accounts",
];

const WHY_VERIFY_WORKER = [

  "Hirers are 3× more likely to book a verified worker",
  "Your profile shows a shield badge ✅",
  "Get access to premium job listings",
];

// Normalize different response shapes into one common shape
function normalize(data, role) {
  if (role === "WORKER") {
    return {
      currentStatus: data.verificationStatus ?? "UNVERIFIED",
      statusMessage: data.statusMessage ?? "",
      latestSubmission: data.lastSubmittedAt
        ? {
            verificationType: "INDIVIDUAL",
            submittedAt: data.lastSubmittedAt,
            documentUrl: data.idDocument ?? null,
            idType: data.submissionData?.idType ?? null,
          }
        : null,
      latestReview: null,
      certifications: data.certifications ?? [],
      backgroundCheck: data.backgroundCheck ?? false,
    };
  }
  return data; // hirer shape already matches
}

      </View>
    );
  if (status === "VERIFIED")
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          s.stateCard,
          { backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)", borderColor: "#22c55e" },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 48, lineHeight: 60, textAlign: "center" }}>
          ✅
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={[s.stateTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
          Account Verified
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={[s.stateBody, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          Your account is fully verified and your profile shows a Verified
          badge.
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );
  if (status === "REJECTED")
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          s.stateCard,
          { backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.10)", borderColor: "#ef4444" },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 48, lineHeight: 60, textAlign: "center" }}>
          ❌
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={[s.stateTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
          Verification Rejected
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={[s.stateBody, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          Please review the reason above and re-submit with a valid document.
        </AppText>
        <Pressable
          onPress={onRetry}
          style={[s.retryBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
        >
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
            Try Again
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    );
  return null;
}

function Field({ label, required, c, children }) {
  return (
    <View style={s.fieldWrap}>
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{
          color: c.textMuted,
          letterSpacing: 0.6,
          marginBottom: 8,
          fontSize: 12,
        }}
      >
        {label}
        {required ? " *" : ""}
      </AppText>
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function VerificationScreen() {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const isWorker = user?.role === "WORKER";
  const modalBg = th.mode === "dark" ? "#111118" : "#ffffff";

  const [statusData, setStatusData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [forceForm, setForceForm] = useState(false);

  // Form — shared
  const [docFile, setDocFile] = useState(null);
  const [idType, setIdType] = useState(null);
  const [showIdModal, setShowIdModal] = useState(false);
  const [idNumber, setIdNumber] = useState("");

  // Form — hirer only
  const [verificationType, setVerificationType] = useState("INDIVIDUAL");
  const [companyName, setCompanyName] = useState("");
  const [companyRegNumber, setCompanyRegNumber] = useState("");
  const [companyCountry, setCompanyCountry] = useState("");
  const [website, setWebsite] = useState("");

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const raw = await getVerificationStatus(user?.role);
      setStatusData(normalize(raw, user?.role));
    } catch {
      setStatusData(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [user?.role]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const pickDocument = async () => {
    try {
      const { status } =
        await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
      if (status !== "granted") {
        toast.error("Permission required to access files");
        return;
      }
      Alert.alert("Upload Document", "Choose source", [
        {
          text: "Photo Library",
          onPress: async () => {
            const r = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
              mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
              quality: 0.85,
            });
            if (!r.canceled && r.assets?.[0]) {
              const a = r.assets[0];
              setDocFile({
                uri: a.uri,
                name: a.fileName ?? "photo.jpg",
                mimeType: "image/jpeg",
              });
            }
          },
        },
        {
          text: "Files (PDF / Image)",
          onPress: async () => {
            const r = await DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({
              type: ["image/*", "application/pdf"],
              copyToCacheDirectory: true,
            });
            if (!r.canceled && r.assets?.[0]) setDocFile(r.assets[0]);
          },
        },
        { text: "Cancel", style: "cancel" },
      ]);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not open file picker");
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    // Validation
    if (isWorker || verificationType === "INDIVIDUAL") {
      if (!idType) {
        toast.error("Please select an ID type");
        return;
      }
      if (!idNumber.trim()) {
        toast.error("Please enter your ID number");
        return;
      }
    } else {
      // hirer BUSINESS
      if (!companyName.trim()) {
        toast.error("Please enter your company name");
        return;
      }
      if (!companyRegNumber.trim()) {
        toast.error("Please enter your registration number");
        return;
      }
    }
    if (!docFile) {
      toast.error("Please upload a verification document");
      return;
    }

    // Build FormData
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", {
      uri: docFile.uri,
      name: docFile.name ?? "document.jpg",
      type: docFile.mimeType ?? "image/jpeg",
    });

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      if (isWorker) {
        formData.append("idType", idType.value);
        formData.append("idNumber", idNumber.trim());
        await submitIdVerification(formData);
      } else {
        formData.append("verificationType", verificationType);
        if (verificationType === "INDIVIDUAL") {
          formData.append("idType", idType.value);
          formData.append("idNumber", idNumber.trim());
        } else {
          formData.append("companyName", companyName.trim());
          formData.append("companyRegNumber", companyRegNumber.trim());
          if (companyCountry.trim())
            formData.append("companyCountry", companyCountry.trim());
          if (website.trim()) formData.append("website", website.trim());
        }
        await submitHirerVerification(formData);
      }
      toast.success("Verification submitted! We'll review within 24–48 hours.");
      setForceForm(false);
      setDocFile(null);
      setIdType(null);
      setIdNumber("");
      setCompanyName("");
      setCompanyRegNumber("");
      setCompanyCountry("");
      setWebsite("");
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Submission failed. Please try again.",
      );
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const currentStatus = statusData?.currentStatus ?? "UNVERIFIED";
  const showForm =
    forceForm || currentStatus === "UNVERIFIED" || currentStatus === "REJECTED";
  const whyList = isWorker ? WHY_VERIFY_WORKER : WHY_VERIFY_HIRER;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          s.screen,
          {
            backgroundColor: c.bg,
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrollView
      style={[s.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}
      contentContainerStyle={s.content}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            load();
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
    >
      {/* ── Hero ── */}
      <View style={s.hero}>
        <View
          style={[
            s.eyebrow,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, letterSpacing: 1.2 }}
          >
            TRUST & SAFETY
          </AppText>
        </View>

        <AppText style={[s.heroSub, { color: c.textMuted }]}>
          {isWorker
            ? "Verified workers appear higher in search and get hired faster."
            : "Verified hirers attract better workers and unlock higher booking limits."}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* ── Why verify ── */}
      <View
        style={[
          s.whyCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 14 }}
        >
          Why verify?
        </AppText>
        {whyList.map((reason, i) => (
          <View key={i} style={s.whyRow}>
            <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, marginRight: 10, fontSize: 16 }}>
              →
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              style={{ color: c.textMuted, flex: 1, lineHeight: 22 }}
            >
              {reason}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>

      {/* ── Status card ── */}
      {statusData && currentStatus !== "UNVERIFIED" && (
        <StatusCard data={statusData} c={c} />
      )}

      {/* ── State card ── */}
      {!forceForm &&
        (currentStatus === "PENDING" ||
          currentStatus === "VERIFIED" ||
          currentStatus === "REJECTED") && (
          <StateCard
            status={currentStatus}
            c={c}
            onRetry={() => setForceForm(true)}
          />
        )}

      {/* ── Verification Form ── */}
      {showForm && (
        <View>
          {/* Type selector — hirers only */}
          {!isWorker && (
            <View style={s.typeRow}>
              {[
                {
                  value: "INDIVIDUAL",
                  emoji: "🪪",
                  label: "Individual",
                  sub: "Personal ID",
                },
                {
                  value: "BUSINESS",
                  emoji: "🏢",
                  label: "Business",
                  sub: "Company registration",
                },
              ].map((t) => {
                const active = verificationType === t.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={t.value}
                    onPress={() => setVerificationType(t.value)}
                    style={[
                      s.typeCard,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? `${c.orange}18` : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText style={{ fontSize: 36, marginBottom: 10 }}>
                      {t.emoji}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: c.text }}
                    >
                      {t.label}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
                    >
                      {t.sub}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          )}

          {/* INDIVIDUAL fields — always visible for worker, visible for hirer when INDIVIDUAL */}
          {(isWorker || verificationType === "INDIVIDUAL") && (
            <>
              <Field label="ID Type" required c={c}>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => setShowIdModal(true)}
                  style={[
                    s.selectBtn,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    style={{ flex: 1, color: idType ? c.text : c.textMuted }}
                  >
                    {idType?.label ?? "Select ID type"}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>▾</AppText>
                </Pressable>
              </Field>

              <Field label="ID Number" required c={c}>
                <TextInput
                  value={idNumber}
                  onChangeText={setIdNumber}
                  placeholder="e.g. A123456789"
                  placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                  autoCapitalize="characters"
                  style={[
                    s.input,
                    {
                      color: c.text,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                      borderColor: c.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                />
              </Field>
            </>
          )}

          {/* BUSINESS fields — hirer only, when BUSINESS selected */}
          {!isWorker && verificationType === "BUSINESS" && (
            <>
              <Field label="Company Name" required c={c}>
                <TextInput
                  value={companyName}
                  onChangeText={setCompanyName}
                  placeholder="e.g. Acme Services Ltd"
                  placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                  style={[
                    s.input,
                    {
                      color: c.text,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgInput,

                <TextInput

                  placeholder="e.g. RC1234567"
                  placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                  autoCapitalize="characters"
                  style={[
                    s.input,
                    {
                      color: c.text,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                      borderColor: c.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                />
              </Field>

              <Field label="Country of Registration" c={c}>
                <TextInput
                  value={companyCountry}
                  onChangeText={setCompanyCountry}
                  placeholder="e.g. Nigeria"
                  placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                  autoCapitalize="words"
                  style={[
                    s.input,
                    {
                      color: c.text,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                      borderColor: c.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                />
              </Field>

              <Field label="Website" c={c}>
                <TextInput
                  value={website}
                  onChangeText={setWebsite}
                  placeholder="https://yourcompany.com"
                  placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  keyboardType="url"
                  style={[
                    s.input,
                    {
                      color: c.text,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                      borderColor: c.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                />
              </Field>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Document upload */}
          <DocumentUpload
            label={
              !isWorker && verificationType === "BUSINESS"
                ? "Upload CAC / Registration Document"
                : "Upload ID Document"
            }
            file={docFile}
            onPick={pickDocument}
            c={c}
          />

          {/* Submit */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleSubmit}
            disabled={submitting}
            style={[
              s.submitBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: submitting ? 0.75 : 1 },
            ]}
          >
            {submitting ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#fff" }}
              >
                Submit for Verification
              </AppText>
            )}
          </Pressable>

          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{
              textAlign: "center",
              marginTop: 8,
              marginBottom: 16,
              lineHeight: 18,
            }}
          >
            Your documents are encrypted and only used for verification
            purposes.
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={{ height: 40 }} />

      <IdTypeModal
        visible={showIdModal}
        onClose={() => setShowIdModal(false)}
        onSelect={setIdType}
        c={c}
        modalBg={modalBg}
      />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/VideoCallScreen.js
//
// Full-screen conversation-scoped video call.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Linking,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { WebView } from "react-native-webview";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaPhoneSlash,
  FaExclamationTriangle,
  FaExpand,
  FaCompress,
  FaExternalLinkAlt,
} from "../../icons/fa";

const CALL_BASE_URL = "https://call.skilledproz.com";
const POLL_MS = 1500;

function buildConversationVideoUrl(conversationId, displayName) {
  if (!conversationId) return null;
  const roomId = `skp-conv-${conversationId}`;
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  params.set("audio", "1");
  params.set("video", "1");
  params.set("notify", "0");
  params.set("chat", "0");
  params.set("screen", "0");
  if (displayName) params.set("name", displayName);
  return `${CALL_BASE_URL}/${roomId}?${params.toString()}`;
}

export default function VideoCallScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();

  const conversationId = route.params?.conversationId;

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [endedByRemote, setEndedByRemote] = useState(false);
  const [fullscreen, setFullscreen] = useState(false);
  const [webViewKey, setWebViewKey] = useState(0);

  const webViewRef = useRef(null);
  const pollRef = useRef(null);
  const inCallRef = useRef(false);

  const displayName = (() => {
    if (!user) return "";
    const first = user.firstName || user.first_name || "";
    const last = user.lastName || user.last_name || "";
    if (first || last) return `${first} ${last}`.trim();
    return user.name || user.fullName || user.username || "";
  })();

  const roomUrl = conversationId
    ? buildConversationVideoUrl(conversationId, displayName)
    : null;

  const goBackToChat = () => {
    if (conversationId) {
      navigation.navigate("Chat", { conversationId });
    } else {
      navigation.goBack();
    }
  };

  const killWebView = () => {
    try {
      webViewRef.current?.injectJavaScript?.(
        "window.location.replace('about:blank'); true;"
      );
    } catch {}
    setTimeout(() => setWebViewKey((k) => k + 1), 0);
  };

  const patchEnd = async () => {
    if (!conversationId) return;
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt++) {
      try {
        await client.patch(`/voice-calls/${conversationId}/end`);
        return;
      } catch (err) {
        if (attempt < 3) {
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
        }
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!conversationId) {
      setError("Missing conversation");
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await client.get(`/voice-calls/${conversationId}`);
        const data = res.data.data;
        const call = data?.call;
        if (!call) {
          if (!cancelled) {
            setError("Call not found");
            setTimeout(goBackToChat, 1200);
          }
          return;
        }
        inCallRef.current = true;
        if (call.status === "ENDED" || call.status === "DECLINED") {
          setEndedByRemote(true);
          setTimeout(goBackToChat, 1500);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled)
          setError(err.response?.data?.message || "Failed to load call");
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [conversationId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inCallRef.current || !conversationId) return;
    pollRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await client.get(`/voice-calls/${conversationId}`);
        const call = res.data.data?.call;
        if (!call) return;
        if (call.status === "ENDED" || call.status === "DECLINED") {
          try {
            webViewRef.current?.injectJavaScript?.(
              "window.location.replace('about:blank'); true;"
            );
          } catch {}
          setWebViewKey((k) => k + 1);
          setEndedByRemote(true);
          clearInterval(pollRef.current);
          setTimeout(goBackToChat, 1000);
        }
      } catch {}
    }, POLL_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(pollRef.current);
  }, [conversationId]);

  function handleEnd() {
    if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);
    killWebView();
    patchEnd();
    inCallRef.current = false;
    setTimeout(goBackToChat, 80);
  }

  function handleOpenExternal() {
    if (roomUrl) Linking.openURL(roomUrl).catch(() => {});
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={[styles.page, { backgroundColor: "#0a0a0a" }]}>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <ActivityIndicator color="#f97316" size="large" />
          <AppText style={styles.centerText}>
            Connecting your video call…
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (error || endedByRemote || !roomUrl) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={[styles.page, { backgroundColor: "#0a0a0a" }]}>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={32} color="#ef4444" />
          <AppText style={styles.centerText}>
            {endedByRemote
              ? "The other party ended the call"
              : error || "Call unavailable"}
          </AppText>
          {endedByRemote ? (
            <AppText style={styles.centerSub}>Returning to chat…</AppText>
          ) : null}
          <Pressable onPress={goBackToChat} style={styles.primaryBtn}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "700", color: "#000" }}>
              Back to Chat
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={[styles.page, { backgroundColor: "#0a0a0a" }]}
      edges={fullscreen ? [] : ["top", "bottom"]}
    >
      {!fullscreen ? (
        <View style={styles.topBar}>
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 10,
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 0,
            }}
          >
            <AppText style={styles.topTitle}>SkilledProz Call</AppText>
            {displayName ? (
              <AppText style={styles.topUser} numberOfLines={1}>
                {displayName}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
            <View style={styles.liveTag}>
              <View style={styles.liveDot} />
              <AppText style={styles.liveText}>LIVE</AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setFullscreen(true)}
              style={styles.iconBtn}
              hitSlop={6}
            >
              <FaExpand size={12} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleOpenExternal}
              style={styles.iconBtn}
              hitSlop={6}
            >
              <FaExternalLinkAlt size={12} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#000", position: "relative" }}>
        <WebView
          key={webViewKey}
          ref={webViewRef}
          source={{ uri: roomUrl }}
          style={{ flex: 1 }}
          mediaPlaybackRequiresUserAction={false}
          allowsInlineMediaPlayback
          javaScriptEnabled
          domStorageEnabled
          allowsFullscreenVideo
          originWhitelist={["*"]}
          onError={() => setError("Could not load call")}
          cacheEnabled={false}
          incognito={true}
        />
        {fullscreen ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setFullscreen(false)}
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              top: 12,
              right: 12,
              width: 40,
              height: 40,
              borderRadius: 20,
              backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
            }}
          >
            <FaCompress size={16} color="#fff" />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {!fullscreen ? (
        <View style={styles.controlBar}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AppText style={styles.controlBrand}>SkilledProz</AppText>
          </View>
          <Pressable onPress={handleEnd} style={styles.endBtn} hitSlop={6}>
            <FaPhoneSlash size={16} color="#fff" />
            <AppText style={styles.endText}>End Call</AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        </View>
      ) : (
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleEnd}
          style={styles.floatingEndBtn}
          hitSlop={6}
        >
          <FaPhoneSlash size={18} color="#fff" />
        </Pressable>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

=== FILE: src/screens/main/VoiceCallFullScreen.js ===
// src/components/video/VoiceCallFullScreen.js
//
// Full-screen voice-call UI.
//
// Key fix vs. previous version: the End / Decline / Accept handlers no longer
// await the server PATCH. They fire it, then immediately clear local state.
// This makes the buttons feel instant and prevents a hung PATCH from leaving
// the user stuck on the call screen.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Image, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import AppText from "../AppText";
import { useVoiceCall } from "../../contexts/VoiceCallContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../api/client";
import {
  FaPhone,
  FaPhoneSlash,
  FaMicrophone,
  FaMicrophoneSlash,
  FaCompress,
} from "../../icons/fa";

function formatDuration(startedAt) {
  if (!startedAt) return "00:00";
  const elapsed = Math.floor(
    (Date.now() - new Date(startedAt).getTime()) / 1000,
  );
  const m = String(Math.floor(elapsed / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
  const s = String(elapsed % 60).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${m}:${s}`;
}

export default function VoiceCallFullScreen({ rtc }) {
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const { call, updateCall, endCall, minimize } = useVoiceCall();

  const [duration, setDuration] = useState("00:00");
  const [otherUser, setOtherUser] = useState(null);
  const fetchedForRef = useRef(null);

  const isActive = call?.status === "ACTIVE";
  const isPending = call?.status === "PENDING";
  const isInitiator = call?.initiatorId === user?.id;
  const isReceiver = call?.receiverId === user?.id;

  useEffect(() => {
    const convoId = call?.conversationId;
    if (!convoId) return;
    if (fetchedForRef.current === convoId) return;
    fetchedForRef.current = convoId;

    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await client.get("/messages/conversations", {
          params: { page: 1, limit: 100, _t: Date.now() },
        });
        const list = res.data.data?.conversations || [];
        const convo = list.find((x) => x.id === convoId);
        const other = convo?.users?.find((u) => u.userId !== user?.id);
        if (!cancelled) setOtherUser(other?.user || null);
      } catch {}
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [call?.conversationId, user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isActive) {
      setDuration("00:00");
      return;
    }
    setDuration(formatDuration(call.startedAt));
    const id = setInterval(
      () => setDuration(formatDuration(call.startedAt)),
      1000,
    );
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [isActive, call?.startedAt]);

  // ── Fire-and-forget handlers ────────────────────────────────────────
  function handleAccept() {
    if (!call) return;
    const convoId = call.conversationId;
    client
      .patch(`/voice-calls/${convoId}/accept`)
      .then((res) => {
        if (res.data?.data?.call) updateCall(res.data.data.call);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }

  function handleDecline() {
    if (!call) return;
    const convoId = call.conversationId;
    client.patch(`/voice-calls/${convoId}/decline`).catch(() => {});
    endCall();
  }

  function handleEnd() {
    if (!call) return;
    const convoId = call.conversationId;
    client.patch(`/voice-calls/${convoId}/end`).catch(() => {});
    endCall();
  }

  if (!call) return null;

  const otherName =
    `${otherUser?.firstName || ""} ${otherUser?.lastName || ""}`.trim() ||
    "the other party";
  const initials =
    `${otherUser?.firstName?.[0] || ""}${otherUser?.lastName?.[0] || ""}`.toUpperCase();

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.overlay, { backgroundColor: "#0a0a0a" }]}>
      <View style={styles.topBar}>
        <AppText style={styles.brand}>SkilledProz Voice Call</AppText>
        {isActive ? (
          <View style={styles.liveTag}>
            <View style={styles.liveDot} />
            <AppText style={styles.liveText}>LIVE</AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        <Pressable onPress={minimize} style={styles.minimizeBtn} hitSlop={8}>
          <FaCompress size={14} color="#fff" />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.center}>
        <View style={styles.avatarWrap}>
          <View style={styles.avatar}>
            {otherUser?.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: otherUser.avatar }}
                style={styles.avatarImg}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText style={styles.avatarText}>{initials || "?"}</AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
        <AppText style={styles.name}>{otherName}</AppText>
        <AppText style={styles.status}>
          {isActive
            ? duration
            : isPending && isInitiator
              ? "Calling…"
              : isPending && isReceiver
                ? "Incoming voice call"
                : ""}
        </AppText>
        {rtc?.error ? (
          <AppText style={styles.error}>{rtc.error}</AppText>
        ) : null}
        {isActive ? (
          <AppText style={styles.hint}>
            You can minimize this call and keep browsing — the audio stays on.
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.controls}>
        {isActive ? (
          <>
            <Pressable
              onPress={rtc?.toggleMute}
              style={[
                styles.circleBtn,
                rtc?.isMuted ? styles.circleBtnOn : null,
              ]}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              {rtc?.isMuted ? (
                <FaMicrophoneSlash size={20} color="#0a0a0a" />
              ) : (
                <FaMicrophone size={20} color="#fff" />
              )}
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable onPress={handleEnd} style={styles.endBtn} hitSlop={8}>
              <FaPhoneSlash size={22} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {isPending && isReceiver ? (
          <>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleDecline}
              style={styles.declineBtn}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              <FaPhoneSlash size={22} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleAccept}
              style={styles.acceptBtn}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              <FaPhone size={22} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {isPending && isInitiator ? (
          <Pressable onPress={handleEnd} style={styles.endBtn} hitSlop={8}>
            <FaPhoneSlash size={22} color="#fff" />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  overlay: {
    position: "absolute",
    top: 0,
    left: 0,
    right: 0,

  topBar: {

// src/screens/main/WalletTransactionDetailScreen.js
//
// Port of pages/hirer/WalletTransactionDetail.jsx + HirerWallet.module.css.
//
// Preserved verbatim:
//   - STATUS_CONFIG (8 statuses, exact colors/labels/backgrounds)
//   - fetch: GET /wallet/transactions?limit=100, find by id
//   - status banner, two detail sections, conditional Payment Details
//     & Description blocks
//   - generateReceiptHTML (byte-identical to web, minus DOM-only calls)
//   - Print / Download / Share actions
//   - error state with auto-back to wallet
//
// RN adaptations:
//   - <Link to> → navigation.navigate("Wallet", ...)
//   - navigator.clipboard → expo-clipboard
//   - handlePrint (window.open) → expo-print Print.printAsync({ html })
//   - handleDownloadReceipt (Blob URL) → expo-print Print.printToFileAsync
//     → expo-sharing shareAsync(file.uri)
//   - handleShare (navigator.share) → expo-sharing shareAsync
//   - useParams/useNavigate → route.params / useNavigation

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

  ActivityIndicator,

// ── Status config (verbatim) ────────────────────────────────────────────

function getStatusConfig(status) {
  return (
    STATUS_CONFIG[status] || {
      Icon: FaClock,
      color: "#888",
      label: status || "Unknown",
      bg: "rgba(136,136,136,0.1)",
    }

// ── Formatters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function formatCurrency(amount, currency = "NGN") {
  const num = typeof amount === "number" ? amount : parseFloat(amount) || 0;
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
      style: "currency",
      currency: currency || "NGN",
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(num);
  } catch {
    return `${currency} ${num.toFixed(2)}`;
  }
}

function formatDateLong(date) {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "long",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function formatDateShort(date) {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function getTransactionLabel(type) {
  const labels = {
    DEPOSIT: "Deposit",
    WITHDRAWAL: "Withdrawal",
    PAYMENT: "Payment",
    SUBSCRIPTION: "Subscription",
    REFUND: "Refund",
    BONUS: "Bonus",
    ADJUSTMENT: "Adjustment",
  };
  return labels[type] || type;
}

function getPaymentChannel(tx) {
  if (tx.type === "DEPOSIT") {
    const p = tx.meta?.paymentProvider;
    if (p === "FLUTTERWAVE" || p === "PAYSTACK")
      return { label: "Card / Mobile Money", Icon: FaCreditCard };
    return { label: "Card / Bank", Icon: FaCreditCard };
  }
  if (tx.type === "WITHDRAWAL")
    return { label: "Bank Transfer", Icon: FaBuilding };
  if (tx.type === "PAYMENT") {
    const p = tx.meta?.paymentProvider || "WALLET";
    if (p === "WALLET") return { label: "Wallet", Icon: FaWallet };
    if (p === "PAYSTACK")
      return { label: "Card (Paystack)", Icon: FaCreditCard };
    if (p === "FLUTTERWAVE")
      return { label: "Card (Flutterwave)", Icon: FaCreditCard };
    if (p === "BANK_TRANSFER")
      return { label: "Bank Transfer", Icon: FaBuilding };
    if (p === "CRYPTO") return { label: "Crypto", Icon: FaDollarSign };
    return { label: "Payment", Icon: FaCreditCard };
  }
  if (tx.type === "SUBSCRIPTION")
    return { label: "Subscription", Icon: FaShieldAlt };
  if (tx.type === "REFUND") return { label: "Refund", Icon: FaArrowUp };
  if (tx.type === "BONUS") return { label: "Bonus", Icon: FaPlus };
  return { label: "Adjustment", Icon: FaMinus };
}

// ── Receipt HTML (verbatim from web) ────────────────────────────────────
function generateReceiptHTML(transaction, isDark) {
  const isCredit =
    transaction.type === "DEPOSIT" ||
    transaction.type === "REFUND" ||
    transaction.type === "BONUS";
  const amountPrefix = isCredit ? "+" : "-";
  const channel = getPaymentChannel(transaction);
  const isPaid =
    transaction.status === "COMPLETED" || transaction.status === "SUCCESS";

  const bg = isDark ? "#080810" : "#f8f9fa";
  const panel = isDark ? "#0c0c18" : "#ffffff";
  const text = isDark ? "#ffffff" : "#1a1a2e";
  const textDim = isDark ? "#a1a1aa" : "#6b7280";
  const border = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" : "#e5e7eb";
  const borderDash = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" : "#e5e7eb";
  const footerBg = isDark ? "#0c0c18" : "#f9fafb";
  const tearColor = isDark ? "#080810" : "#f9fafb";

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Receipt - ${transaction.reference}</title>

    .receipt { max-width: 520px; width: 100%; background: ${panel}; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,${isDark ? "0.4" : "0.1"}); border: 1px solid ${border}; }
