    .receipt-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 16px; padding: 6px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; }
    .receipt-amount { text-align: center; padding: 28px 32px 24px; border-bottom: 2px dashed ${borderDash}; }
    .receipt-amount .label { font-size: 12px; color: ${textDim}; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 700; }
    .receipt-amount .value { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 8px; }
    .receipt-amount .value.credit { color: #22c55e; }
    .receipt-amount .value.debit { color: #ef4444; }
    .receipt-amount .channel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(249,115,22,0.15); color: #f97316; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
    .receipt-body { padding: 24px 32px; }
    .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid ${border}; gap: 16px; }
    .row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .row .label { color: ${textDim}; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .row .value { color: ${text}; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; word-break: break-word; }
    .row .value.mono { font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; }
    .row.section-title { padding-top: 18px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: none; }
    .row.section-title .label { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: ${textDim}; font-weight: 800; }
    .fee-row { color: #f97316; }
    .net-row { margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 2px solid ${border}; border-bottom: none; }
    .net-row .label { font-weight: 700; color: ${text}; }
    .net-row .value { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #22c55e; }
    .receipt-footer { padding: 24px 32px; background: ${footerBg}; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: ${textDim}; }
    .receipt-footer strong { color: ${text}; }
    .tear-line { height: 16px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, ${tearColor} 4px, transparent 4px); background-size: 16px 16px; background-position: -8px 50%; background-color: ${footerBg}; }
    @media print {
      @page { size: auto; margin: 0; }
      body { background: #fff; color: #000; display: block; padding: 0; }
      .receipt { max-width: 100%; box-shadow: none; border-radius: 0; border: none; page-break-inside: avoid; margin: 0 auto; }
      .receipt { background: #fff !important; }
      .receipt-body { background: #fff !important; padding: 16px 32px; }
      .receipt-footer { background: #fff !important; border-top: 1px solid #eee; }
      .row .value, .net-row .label { color: #000 !important; }
      .row .label, .receipt-amount .label, .receipt-footer { color: #555 !important; }
      .tear-line { display: none; }
      .row { padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="receipt">
    <div class="receipt-header">
      <h1>SkilledProz</h1>
      <p class="subtitle">Transaction Receipt</p>
      <div class="receipt-status">${STATUS_CONFIG[transaction.status]?.label || transaction.status}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="receipt-amount">
      <div class="label">${isCredit ? "Amount Received" : "Amount Charged"}</div>
      <div class="value ${isCredit ? "credit" : "debit"}">${amountPrefix} ${formatCurrency(transaction.amount, transaction.currency)}</div>
      <div class="channel">${channel.label}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="receipt-body">
      <div class="row section-title"><span class="label">Transaction</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Reference</span><span class="value mono">${transaction.reference}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Type</span><span class="value">${getTransactionLabel(transaction.type)}</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Date</span><span class="value">${formatDateLong(transaction.createdAt)}</span></div>
      ${transaction.completedAt ? `<div class="row"><span class="label">Completed</span><span class="value">${formatDateLong(transaction.completedAt)}</span></div>` : ""}
      ${transaction.description ? `<div class="row"><span class="label">Description</span><span class="value">${transaction.description}</span></div>` : ""}
      <div class="row section-title"><span class="label">Breakdown</span></div>
      <div class="row"><span class="label">Gross Amount</span><span class="value">${formatCurrency(transaction.amount, transaction.currency)}</span></div>
      <div class="row fee-row"><span class="label">Platform Fee</span><span class="value">- ${formatCurrency(transaction.fee || 0, transaction.currency)}</span></div>
      <div class="row net-row"><span class="label">Net Amount</span><span class="value">${formatCurrency(transaction.netAmount || transaction.amount, transaction.currency)}</span></div>
      ${
        transaction.balanceBefore != null || transaction.balanceAfter != null
          ? `<div class="row section-title"><span class="label">Wallet Impact</span></div>
             <div class="row"><span class="label">Balance Before</span><span class="value">${formatCurrency(transaction.balanceBefore || 0, transaction.currency)}</span></div>
             <div class="row"><span class="label">Balance After</span><span class="value">${formatCurrency(transaction.balanceAfter || 0, transaction.currency)}</span></div>`
          : ""
      }
      ${
        transaction.meta?.paymentProvider
          ? `<div class="row section-title"><span class="label">Payment Details</span></div>
             <div class="row"><span class="label">Provider</span><span class="value">${transaction.meta.paymentProvider}</span></div>
             ${transaction.meta?.transactionId ? `<div class="row"><span class="label">Provider Ref</span><span class="value mono">${transaction.meta.transactionId}</span></div>` : ""}`
          : ""
      }
    </div>
    <div class="tear-line"></div>
    <div class="receipt-footer">
      <p>Thank you for using <strong>SkilledProz</strong></p>
      <p style="margin-top: 6px;">This is an electronically generated receipt. No signature required.</p>
      <p style="margin-top: 6px; font-size: 11px;">skilledproz.com · support@skilledproz.com</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
}

// ── Small helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function bgLuminance(color) {
  if (!color) return 0.5;
  let r = 0,
    g = 0,
    b = 0;
  if (color.startsWith("#")) {
    const hex = color.replace("#", "");
    if (hex.length === 3) {
      r = parseInt(hex[0] + hex[0], 16);
      g = parseInt(hex[1] + hex[1], 16);
      b = parseInt(hex[2] + hex[2], 16);
    } else if (hex.length >= 6) {
      r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
      g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
      b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
    }
  }
  return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255;
}

// ── CopyButton ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CopyButton({ text, label = "Copy", c }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const handleCopy = async () => {
    try {
      await Clipboard.setStringAsync(String(text ?? ""));
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch {}
  };
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={handleCopy}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        {
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 3,
          paddingHorizontal: 8,
          paddingVertical: 3,
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor: c.border,
          borderRadius: 6,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {copied ? (
        <FaCheck size={10} color={c.green} />
      ) : (
        <FaCopy size={10} color={c.textDim} />
      )}
      <AppText
        style={{
          fontSize: 9,
          fontWeight: "600",
          color: copied ? c.green : c.textDim,
        }}
      >
        {copied ? "Copied!" : label}
      </AppText>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const labelStyle = (c) => ({
  fontFamily: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
  fontSize: 10,
  fontWeight: "700",
  color: c.textMuted,
  letterSpacing: 0.7,
  textTransform: "uppercase",
});

// ── Detail row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DetailRow({ label, value, copy, valueStyle, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        justifyContent: "space-between",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 10,
        paddingVertical: 8,
        borderBottomWidth: 1,
        borderBottomColor: c.border,
      }}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textDim }}>{label}</AppText>
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: "row",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 6,
          flexShrink: 1,
          flexWrap: "wrap",
          justifyContent: "flex-end",
        }}
      >
        <AppText
          numberOfLines={2}
          style={[
            {
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: "600",
              color: c.text,
              textAlign: "right",
            },
            valueStyle,
          ]}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
        {copy && String(value) !== "—" ? (
          <CopyButton text={String(value)} c={c} />
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Section title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SectionTitle({ Icon, children, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 6,
        marginBottom: 10,
      }}
    >
      {Icon ? <Icon size={12} color={c.orange} /> : null}
      <AppText style={labelStyle(c)}>{children}</AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── MAIN SCREEN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WalletTransactionDetailScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const c = theme.colors;
  const isDark = bgLuminance(c.bg) < 0.5;

  const id = route.params?.id;

  const [transaction, setTransaction] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) {
      setError("Transaction not found.");
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    client
      .get("/wallet/transactions", { params: { limit: 100 } })
      .then((res) => {
        const list = res.data.data?.transactions || [];
        const match = list.find((t) => t.id === id);
        if (!match) setError("Transaction not found.");
        else setTransaction(match);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        setError(
          err.response?.data?.message || "Failed to load transaction details.",
        );
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);

  const handleBackToWallet = useCallback(() => {
    navigation.navigate("Wallet");
  }, [navigation]);

  const handlePrint = async () => {
    if (!transaction) return;
    try {
      await Print.printAsync({
        html: generateReceiptHTML(transaction, isDark),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert(
        "Print failed",
        err?.message || "Could not open the print dialog.",
      );
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadReceipt = async () => {
    if (!transaction) return;
    setDownloading(true);
    try {
      const { uri } = await Print.printToFileAsync({
        html: generateReceiptHTML(transaction, isDark),
      });
      if (await Sharing.isAvailableAsync()) {
        await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, {
          mimeType: "application/pdf",
          dialogTitle: `receipt-${transaction.reference}`,
        });
      } else {
        Alert.alert("Receipt saved", uri);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert(
        "Download failed",
        err?.message || "Failed to generate receipt. Please try again.",
      );
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleShare = async () => {
    if (!transaction) return;
    const channel = getPaymentChannel(transaction);
    const text =
      `Transaction ${transaction.reference}\n` +
      `Type: ${getTransactionLabel(transaction.type)}\n` +
      `Channel: ${channel.label}\n` +
      `Amount: ${formatCurrency(transaction.amount, transaction.currency)}\n` +
      `Status: ${STATUS_CONFIG[transaction.status]?.label || transaction.status}\n` +
      `Date: ${formatDateLong(transaction.createdAt)}`;
    try {
      await Share.share({ message: text, title: "Transaction Details" });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err?.message !== "User did not share") {
        await Clipboard.setStringAsync(text);
        Alert.alert("Copied", "Transaction details copied to clipboard!");
      }
    }
  };

  // ── Loading ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }} edges={["top"]}>
        <View style={{ padding: 16, gap: 14 }}>
          <Skeleton width="40%" height={20} radius={6} />
          <Skeleton width="60%" height={32} radius={8} />
          <Skeleton width="100%" height={80} radius={14} />
          <Skeleton width="100%" height={220} radius={14} />
          <Skeleton width="100%" height={180} radius={14} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Error ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (error || !transaction) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }} edges={["top"]}>
        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            padding: 24,
            gap: 12,
          }}
        >
          <FaExclamationTriangle size={44} color={c.red} />
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
            }}
          >
            {error || "Transaction not found"}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 13, color: c.textDim, textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            The transaction could not be loaded.
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBackToWallet}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                marginTop: 8,
                paddingVertical: 12,
                paddingHorizontal: 24,
                backgroundColor: c.orange,
                borderRadius: 10,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: "#000",
              }}
            >
              Back to Wallet
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Derived ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const isCredit =
    transaction.type === "DEPOSIT" ||
    transaction.type === "REFUND" ||
    transaction.type === "BONUS";
  const amountPrefix = isCredit ? "+" : "-";
  const channel = getPaymentChannel(transaction);
  const statusConfig = getStatusConfig(transaction.status);
  const StatusIcon = statusConfig.Icon;
  const hasPaymentDetails =
    transaction.meta?.paymentProvider ||
    transaction.meta?.transactionId ||
    transaction.meta?.bankName ||
    transaction.meta?.accountNumber ||
    transaction.meta?.accountName;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      edges={["top", "left", "right"]}
    >
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 60, gap: 16 }}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <View>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBackToWallet}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 6,
                alignSelf: "flex-start",
                paddingVertical: 6,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.75 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaArrowLeft size={12} color={c.textDim} />
            <AppText
              style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
            >
              Back to Wallet
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
              fontSize: 22,
              fontWeight: "800",
              color: c.text,
              letterSpacing: -0.3,
              marginTop: 4,
            }}
          >
            Transaction Details
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Status banner */}
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            gap: 12,
            paddingHorizontal: 14,
            paddingVertical: 14,
            backgroundColor: statusConfig.bg,
            borderWidth: 1.5,
            borderColor: statusConfig.color,
            borderRadius: 14,
          }}
        >
          <StatusIcon size={22} color={statusConfig.color} />
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <AppText style={labelStyle(c)}>STATUS</AppText>
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: statusConfig.color,
                marginTop: 2,
              }}
            >
              {statusConfig.label}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View
            style={{
              paddingHorizontal: 8,
              paddingVertical: 4,
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 999,
              maxWidth: 160,
            }}
          >
            <AppText
              numberOfLines={1}
              style={{
                fontSize: 9,
                color: c.textMuted,
                fontFamily: "monospace",
              }}
            >
              {`Ref: ${transaction.reference}`}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Detail sections */}
        <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
          {/* Transaction Information */}
          <View
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 14,
              padding: 14,
            }}
          >
            <SectionTitle Icon={FaMoneyBillWave} c={c}>
              TRANSACTION INFORMATION
            </SectionTitle>
            <DetailRow
              label="Amount"
              value={`${amountPrefix} ${formatCurrency(transaction.amount, transaction.currency)}`}
              valueStyle={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 15,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: isCredit ? c.green : c.orange,
              }}
              c={c}
            />
            <DetailRow
              label="Type"
              value={getTransactionLabel(transaction.type)}
              c={c}
            />
            <DetailRow label="Channel" value={channel.label} c={c} />
            <DetailRow
              label="Fee"
              value={formatCurrency(transaction.fee || 0, transaction.currency)}
              c={c}
            />
            <DetailRow
              label="Net Amount"
              value={`${amountPrefix} ${formatCurrency(
                transaction.netAmount || transaction.amount,
                transaction.currency,
              )}`}
              c={c}
            />
          </View>

          {/* Reference & Dates */}
          <View
            style={{
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 14,
              padding: 14,
            }}
          >
            <SectionTitle Icon={FaCalendarAlt} c={c}>
              REFERENCE & DATES
            </SectionTitle>
            <DetailRow
              label="Reference"
              value={transaction.reference}
              copy
              c={c}
            />
            <DetailRow
              label="Date"
              value={formatDateShort(transaction.createdAt)}
              c={c}
            />
            {transaction.completedAt ? (
              <DetailRow
                label="Completed"
                value={formatDateShort(transaction.completedAt)}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {transaction.balanceBefore != null ? (
              <DetailRow
                label="Balance Before"
                value={formatCurrency(
                  transaction.balanceBefore,
                  transaction.currency,
                )}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
            {transaction.balanceAfter != null ? (
              <DetailRow
                label="Balance After"
                value={formatCurrency(
                  transaction.balanceAfter,
                  transaction.currency,
                )}
                c={c}
              />
            ) : null}
          </View>

          {/* Payment Details */}
          {hasPaymentDetails ? (
            <View
              style={{
                backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 14,
                padding: 14,
              }}
            >
              <SectionTitle Icon={FaUser} c={c}>
                PAYMENT DETAILS
              </SectionTitle>
              {transaction.meta?.paymentProvider ? (
                <DetailRow
                  label="Provider"
                  value={transaction.meta.paymentProvider}
                  c={c}
                />
              ) : null}
              {transaction.meta?.transactionId ? (
                <DetailRow
                  label="Provider Reference"
                  value={String(transaction.meta.transactionId)}
                  copy
                  c={c}
                />
              ) : null}
              {transaction.meta?.bankName ? (
                <DetailRow
                  label="Bank"
                  value={transaction.meta.bankName}
                  c={c}
                />
              ) : null}
              {transaction.meta?.accountNumber ? (
                <DetailRow
                  label="Account Number"
                  value={transaction.meta.accountNumber}
                  c={c}
                />
              ) : null}
              {transaction.meta?.accountName ? (
                <DetailRow
                  label="Account Name"
                  value={transaction.meta.accountName}
                  c={c}
                />
              ) : null}
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {/* Description */}
          {transaction.description ? (
            <View
              style={{
                backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 14,
                padding: 14,
              }}
            >
              <SectionTitle Icon={FaInfoCircle} c={c}>
                DESCRIPTION
              </SectionTitle>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, color: c.text, lineHeight: 18 }}>
                {transaction.description}
              </AppText>

          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Actions */}
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handlePrint}
            style={({ pressed }) => [

            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleDownloadReceipt}

            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flex: 1,
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                gap: 6,
                paddingVertical: 12,
                backgroundColor: c.orange,
                borderRadius: 10,
                opacity: downloading ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                minWidth: 120,
              },
            ]}
          >
            {downloading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#000" />
            ) : (
              <FaDownload size={13} color="#000" />
            )}
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: "#000",
              }}
            >
              {downloading ? "Generating..." : "Download"}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleShare}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flex: 1,
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                gap: 6,
                paddingVertical: 12,
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderColor: c.border,
                borderRadius: 10,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                minWidth: 100,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <FaShareAlt size={13} color={c.text} />
            <AppText
              style={{
                fontFamily: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: "800",
                color: c.text,
              }}
            >
              Share
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        <Pressable
          onPress={handleBackToWallet}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            {
              alignItems: "center",
              paddingVertical: 12,
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: c.border,
              borderRadius: 10,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "600", color: c.textDim }}
          >
            View All Transactions
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function timeAgo(date) {
  if (!date) return "—";
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(date).getTime();
  const d = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
  if (d < 1) return "Today";
  if (d < 30) return `${d}d ago`;
  const m = Math.floor(d / 30);
  if (m < 12) return `${m}mo ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(m / 12)}y ago`;
}

export default function WorkerPublicProfileScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { user: viewerUser } = useAuthStore();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const userId = route.params?.userId;

  const [worker, setWorker] = useState(null);
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("about");
  const [avatarLightbox, setAvatarLightbox] = useState(null);
  const [lightbox, setLightbox] = useState(null);

  const isOwnProfile = viewerUser?.id === userId;
  const isHirer = viewerUser?.role === "HIRER";
  const saved = useSavedWorker(userId, { enabled: isHirer && !isOwnProfile });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!userId) {
      setError("Worker not found");
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    Promise.all([
      client.get(`/workers/${userId}`),
      client
        .get(`/reviews/worker/${userId}`, { params: { limit: 10 } })
        .catch(() => ({ data: { data: { reviews: [] } } })),
    ])
      .then(([wRes, rRes]) => {
        setWorker(wRes.data.data.worker);
        setReviews(rRes.data.data.reviews || []);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(e.response?.data?.message || "Profile not found");
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [userId]);

  if (loading) {
    return (

      </AppScreen>
    );

          <AppText style={styles.errorTitle(c)}>
            {isPrivate ? "Private Profile" : "Worker not found"}

      <Modal
        visible={!!lightbox}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setLightbox(null)}
      >
        <Pressable
          style={styles.lightboxBackdrop}

        >
          <Pressable
            onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{ width: "90%", maxWidth: 500, alignItems: "center" }}
          >
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setLightbox(null)}
              style={styles.lightboxClose}
            >
              <FaTimes size={18} color="#fff" />
            </Pressable>
            {lightbox?.type === "pdf" ? (

                style={{

              >
                <WebView source={{ uri: lightbox.url }} />
              </View>
            ) : lightbox?.url ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: lightbox.url }}
                style={{ width: "100%", height: 400, borderRadius: 12 }}

              />
            ) : null}
            {lightbox?.title ? (
              <AppText style={styles.lightboxTitleText}>
                {lightbox.title}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
            {lightbox?.description ? (
              <AppText style={styles.lightboxDescText}>
                {lightbox.description}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// ── Sub-components ──

function StatItem({ icon, value, label, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.statItem}>
      {icon}
      <AppText style={styles.statItemVal(c)} numberOfLines={1}>
        {value}
      </AppText>
      <AppText style={styles.statItemLabel(c)}>{label}</AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function RatePill({ value, suffix, currency, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.ratePill,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText style={styles.ratePillMain(c)}>
        {currency} {Number(value).toLocaleString()}
      </AppText>
      <AppText style={styles.ratePillSuffix(c)}>{suffix}</AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function AboutTab({ worker, user, availability, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      <View
        style={[
          styles.section,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText style={styles.sectionTitle(c)}>About</AppText>
        <AppText style={styles.aboutBio(c)}>
          {worker.description || "No description provided."}
        </AppText>

        {/* ── 2-COLUMN GRID ── */}
        <View style={styles.infoCardsGrid}>
          <InfoCard
            icon={<FaAward size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label="Years Exp."
            value={`${worker.yearsExperience || 0} yr${worker.yearsExperience !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
            c={c}
          />
          <InfoCard
            icon={<FaMapMarkerAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label="Radius"
            value={`${worker.serviceRadius} km`}
            c={c}
          />
          <InfoCard
            icon={<FaCalendarAlt size={14} color={c.orange} />}
            label="Joined"
            value={new Date(user.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
            c={c}
          />
          {worker.backgroundCheck && (
            <InfoCard
              icon={<FaShieldAlt size={14} color={c.green} />}
              label="Background"
              value="Cleared"
              accent
              c={c}
            />
          )}
        </View>
      </View>

      <View
        style={[
          styles.section,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText style={styles.sectionTitle(c)}>Weekly Availability</AppText>
        <View style={styles.weekRow}>
          {DAYS_SHORT.map((d, i) => {
            const slot = availability.find(
              (a) => a.dayOfWeek === i && a.isAvailable,
            );
            return (
              <View
                key={d}
                style={[
                  styles.dayCell,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: slot ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: slot ? c.orangeGlow : c.border,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={[
                    styles.dayText,
                    { color: slot ? c.orange : c.textMuted },
                  ]}
                >
                  {d}
                </AppText>
                {slot ? (
                  <AppText style={[styles.dayTime, { color: c.orange }]}>
                    {slot.startTime?.slice(0, 5)}
                  </AppText>
                ) : null}
              </View>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function InfoCard({ icon, label, value, accent, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.infoCard,
        {
          backgroundColor: accent ? c.greenDim : c.bgCard,
          borderColor: accent ? c.green : c.border,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {icon}
      <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <AppText
          style={[
            styles.infoCardLabel,
            { color: accent ? c.green : c.textMuted },
          ]}
          numberOfLines={1}
        >
          {label}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          style={[styles.infoCardValue, { color: accent ? c.green : c.text }]}
          numberOfLines={1}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function PortfolioTab({ portfolio, onOpen, c }) {
  if (!portfolio?.length) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.emptySection,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <FaImage size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
        <AppText style={styles.emptyText(c)}>No portfolio items yet.</AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View style={styles.portfolioGrid}>
      {portfolio.map((item) => (
        <Pressable
          key={item.id}
          onPress={() => onOpen(item)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.portfolioCard,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderColor: c.border,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Image source={{ uri: item.imageUrl }} style={styles.portfolioImg} />
          <View style={styles.portfolioBody}>
            <AppText style={styles.portfolioTitle(c)} numberOfLines={1}>
              {item.title}
            </AppText>
            {item.description ? (
              <AppText style={styles.portfolioDesc(c)} numberOfLines={2}>
                {item.description}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function VideoTab({ worker, user, onPlay, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.section,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },

    >
      <AppText style={styles.sectionTitle(c)}>Video Introduction</AppText>
      <Pressable

          styles.videoPlaceholder,

            backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
            borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
            opacity: pressed ? 0.9 : 1,
          },

        <AppText style={styles.videoName(c)}>
          {user.firstName}'s Introduction
        </AppText>
        <AppText style={styles.videoHint(c)}>Tap to watch</AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

function CertificationsTab({ certifications, onOpen, c }) {
  if (!certifications?.length) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.emptySection,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <FaFileAlt size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
        <AppText style={styles.emptyText(c)}>No certifications added.</AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
      {certifications.map((cert) => (
        <View
          key={cert.id}
          style={[
            styles.certCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.certIcon,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
            ]}
          >
            <FaFileAlt size={18} color={c.orange} />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <AppText style={styles.certName(c)} numberOfLines={2}>
              {cert.name}
            </AppText>
            <AppText style={styles.certIssuer(c)} numberOfLines={1}>
              Issued by {cert.issuedBy}
            </AppText>
            {cert.issueDate ? (
              <AppText style={styles.certDate(c)}>
                {new Date(cert.issueDate).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                  month: "short",
                  year: "numeric",
                })}
                {cert.expiryDate
                  ? ` – ${new Date(cert.expiryDate).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { month: "short", year: "numeric" })}`
                  : ""}
              </AppText>
            ) : null}
          </View>
          {cert.verified && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.certVerified,
                { backgroundColor: c.greenDim, borderColor: c.green },
              ]}
            >
              <FaCheckCircle size={9} color={c.green} />
              <AppText style={styles.certVerifiedText(c)}>Verified</AppText>
            </View>
          )}
          {cert.documentUrl && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => onOpen(cert)}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.certViewBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: c.orangeDim,
                  borderColor: c.orangeGlow,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={styles.certViewText(c)}>View</AppText>
              <FaChevronRight size={10} color={c.orange} />
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function AvailabilityTab({ availability, c }) {
  if (!availability?.length) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.emptySection,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <FaCalendarAlt size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
        <AppText style={styles.emptyText(c)}>No availability set.</AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.section,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {DAYS_SHORT.map((day, i) => {
        const slot = availability.find((a) => a.dayOfWeek === i);
        return (
          <View
            key={day}
            style={[styles.availRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
          >
            <AppText style={styles.availDay(c)}>{day}</AppText>
            {slot?.isAvailable ? (
              <AppText style={[styles.availTime, { color: c.green }]}>
                {slot.startTime?.slice(0, 5)} – {slot.endTime?.slice(0, 5)}
              </AppText>
            ) : (
              <AppText style={styles.availOff(c)}>Unavailable</AppText>
            )}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.availDotSmall,
                {
                  backgroundColor: slot?.isAvailable ? c.green : c.textMuted,
                  marginLeft: "auto",
                },
              ]}
            />
          </View>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

function ReviewsTab({ reviews, total, avgRating, c }) {
  if (!reviews?.length) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.emptySection,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <FaStar size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
        <AppText style={styles.emptyText(c)}>No reviews yet.</AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
      <View
        style={[
          styles.ratingSummary,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={{ alignItems: "center" }}>
          <AppText style={styles.reviewAvg(c)}>
            {avgRating > 0 ? avgRating.toFixed(1) : "—"}
          </AppText>
          <AppText style={styles.reviewTotalLabel(c)}>
            {total} review{total !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((s) => (
              <FaStar
                key={s}
                size={16}
                color={s <= Math.round(avgRating) ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
              />
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      {reviews.map((r) => (
        <View
          key={r.id}
          style={[
            styles.reviewCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.reviewTop}>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.reviewAvatar,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orangeGlow },
              ]}
            >
              {r.giver?.avatar ? (
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: r.giver.avatar }}
                  style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
                />
              ) : (
                <AppText style={styles.reviewAvatarText(c)}>
                  {r.giver?.firstName?.[0]}
                  {r.giver?.lastName?.[0]}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <AppText style={styles.reviewName(c)} numberOfLines={1}>
                {r.giver?.firstName} {r.giver?.lastName}
              </AppText>
              {r.booking?.title && (
                <AppText style={styles.reviewBookingTitle(c)} numberOfLines={1}>
                  {r.booking.title}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 1 }}>
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((s) => (
                <FaStar
                  key={s}
                  size={10}
                  color={s <= r.rating ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                />
              ))}
            </View>
          </View>
          {r.comment && (
            <AppText style={styles.reviewComment(c)}>"{r.comment}"</AppText>
          )}
          <AppText style={styles.reviewDate(c)}>
            {new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
              day: "numeric",
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// src/components/WithdrawalPinSection.js
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Self-contained withdrawal PIN section for SettingsScreen.
// Drop into the Security tab — renders set/change/locked states automatically.
//
// Usage in SettingsScreen.js:
//   import WithdrawalPinSection from "../../components/WithdrawalPinSection";
//   then inside your security tab JSX: <WithdrawalPinSection />
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Animated,
} from "react-native";
import client from "../../../api/client";

import { settingsApi } from "../../../api/settings";

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// PIN BOXES — 4 individual digit boxes backed by a hidden TextInput
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function PinBoxes({ value, onChange, disabled, shake }) {
  const inputRef = useRef();
  const shakeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

  // Trigger shake animation when shake prop changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shake) return;
    Animated.sequence([
      Animated.timing(shakeAnim, {
        toValue: 8,
        duration: 60,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(shakeAnim, {
        toValue: -8,
        duration: 60,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(shakeAnim, {
        toValue: 6,
        duration: 60,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(shakeAnim, {
        toValue: -6,
        duration: 60,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(shakeAnim, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 60,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start();
  }, [shake]);

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      activeOpacity={1}
      onPress={() => !disabled && inputRef.current?.focus()}
      style={styles.pinBoxesWrap}
    >
      <Animated.View
        style={[styles.pinBoxes, { transform: [{ translateX: shakeAnim }] }]}
      >
        {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
          <View
            key={i}
            style={[
              styles.pinBox,
              value.length > i && styles.pinBoxFilled,
              value.length === i && styles.pinBoxActive,
              shake && styles.pinBoxError,
            ]}
          >
            <Text
              style={[styles.pinDot, value.length > i && styles.pinDotFilled]}
            >
              {value.length > i ? "●" : ""}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ))}
      </Animated.View>

      {/* Hidden input that receives keystrokes */}
      <TextInput
        ref={inputRef}
        value={value}
        onChangeText={(v) => onChange(v.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4))}
        keyboardType="number-pad"
        secureTextEntry
        maxLength={4}
        editable={!disabled}
        style={styles.pinHiddenInput}
        autoComplete="off"
        caretHidden
      />
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MAIN COMPONENT
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WithdrawalPinSection() {
  // PIN status from server
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(null); // { pinSet, isLocked, attemptsRemaining, lockedUntil }
  const [loadingStatus, setLoadingStatus] = useState(true);

  // Set PIN flow (first time)
  const [newPin, setNewPin] = useState("");
  const [confirmPin, setConfirmPin] = useState("");
  const [setError, setSetError] = useState("");
  const [settingPin, setSettingPin] = useState(false);
  const [shakeConfirm, setShakeConfirm] = useState(false);

  // Change PIN flow
  const [showChange, setShowChange] = useState(false);
  const [currentPin, setCurrentPin] = useState("");
  const [changedNew, setChangedNew] = useState("");
  const [changeConfirm, setChangeConfirm] = useState("");
  const [changeError, setChangeError] = useState("");
  const [changing, setChanging] = useState(false);
  const [shakeCurrentPin, setShakeCurrentPin] = useState(false);
  const [shakeChangeConfirm, setShakeChangeConfirm] = useState(false);

  // Success flash
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState("");

  // ── Load status ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadStatus() {
    setLoadingStatus(true);
    settingsApi
      .getPinStatus()
      .then((data) => setStatus(data))
      .catch(() =>
        setStatus({ pinSet: false, isLocked: false, attemptsRemaining: 3 }),
      )
      .finally(() => setLoadingStatus(false));
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStatus();
  }, []);

  function flashSuccess(msg) {
    setSuccessMsg(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setSuccessMsg(""), 3000);
  }

  function triggerShake(setter) {
    setter(true);
    setTimeout(() => setter(false), 500);
  }

  // ── Set PIN (first time) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleSetPin() {
    setSetError("");
    if (newPin.length < 4) {
      setSetError("Enter a 4-digit PIN.");
      return;
    }
    if (newPin !== confirmPin) {
      setSetError("PINs don't match.");
      triggerShake(setShakeConfirm);
      return;
    }
    setSettingPin(true);
    try {
      await settingsApi.setPin(newPin);
      setNewPin("");
      setConfirmPin("");
      flashSuccess("Withdrawal PIN set successfully! 🔐");
      loadStatus();
    } catch (e) {
      setSetError(e.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to set PIN.");
    } finally {
      setSettingPin(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Change PIN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleChangePin() {
    setChangeError("");
    if (currentPin.length < 4) {
      setChangeError("Enter your current PIN.");
      return;
    }
    if (changedNew.length < 4) {
      setChangeError("Enter a new 4-digit PIN.");
      return;
    }
    if (changedNew !== changeConfirm) {
      setChangeError("New PINs don't match.");
      triggerShake(setShakeChangeConfirm);
      return;
    }
    if (currentPin === changedNew) {
      setChangeError("New PIN must be different from current PIN.");
      return;
    }
    setChanging(true);
    try {
      await settingsApi.changePin(currentPin, changedNew);
      setCurrentPin("");
      setChangedNew("");
      setChangeConfirm("");
      setShowChange(false);
      flashSuccess("Withdrawal PIN changed successfully!");
      loadStatus();
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to change PIN.";
      setChangeError(msg);
      if (e.response?.status === 401) {
        triggerShake(setShakeCurrentPin);
        setCurrentPin("");
      }
      loadStatus(); // refresh lock status
    } finally {
      setChanging(false);
    }
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // RENDER
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loadingStatus) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.section}>
        <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Withdrawal PIN</Text>
          <Text style={styles.sectionSub}>
            4-digit security PIN for payouts
          </Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.loadingRow}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#f97316" />
          <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Checking PIN status…</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.section}>
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Withdrawal PIN</Text>
        <Text style={styles.sectionSub}>
          Required to authorise every payout from your wallet
        </Text>
      </View>

      {/* Success flash */}
      {!!successMsg && (
        <View style={styles.successBanner}>
          <Text style={styles.successBannerText}>✅ {successMsg}</Text>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── LOCKED STATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {status?.isLocked && (
        <View style={styles.lockedCard}>
          <Text style={styles.lockedIcon}>🔒</Text>
          <Text style={styles.lockedTitle}>PIN Temporarily Locked</Text>
          <Text style={styles.lockedSub}>
            Too many incorrect attempts. Your PIN is locked for 30 minutes. Try
            again later.
          </Text>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── PIN NOT SET — first-time setup ────────────────────────────── */}
      {!status?.isLocked && !status?.pinSet && !showChange && (
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.noPin}>
            <Text style={styles.noPinIcon}>🔓</Text>
            <Text style={styles.noPinTitle}>No PIN Set</Text>
            <Text style={styles.noPinSub}>
              Set a 4-digit PIN to protect your withdrawals. You'll need it
              every time you request a payout.
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.pinRow}>
            <Text style={styles.pinFieldLabel}>Choose PIN</Text>
            <PinBoxes
              value={newPin}
              onChange={setNewPin}
              disabled={settingPin}
            />
          </View>

          <View style={styles.pinRow}>
            <Text style={styles.pinFieldLabel}>Confirm PIN</Text>
            <PinBoxes
              value={confirmPin}
              onChange={setConfirmPin}
              disabled={settingPin}
              shake={shakeConfirm}
            />
          </View>

          {!!setError && <Text style={styles.errorText}>⚠️ {setError}</Text>}

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.btn,
              styles.btnPrimary,
              (settingPin || newPin.length < 4 || confirmPin.length < 4) &&
                styles.btnDisabled,
            ]}
            onPress={handleSetPin}
            disabled={settingPin || newPin.length < 4 || confirmPin.length < 4}
          >
            {settingPin ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#000" />
            ) : (
              <Text style={styles.btnPrimaryText}>Set Withdrawal PIN</Text>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── PIN SET — status card + change button ─────────────────────── */}
      {!status?.isLocked && status?.pinSet && !showChange && (
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.pinSetRow}>
            <View style={styles.pinSetLeft}>
              <Text style={styles.pinSetIcon}>🔐</Text>
              <View>
                <Text style={styles.pinSetTitle}>PIN Active</Text>
                <Text style={styles.pinSetSub}>
                  Your withdrawal PIN is set and protecting your payouts.
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.pinActiveBadge}>
              <Text style={styles.pinActiveBadgeText}>Active</Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.btn, styles.btnOutline]}
            onPress={() => {
              setShowChange(true);
              setChangeError("");
            }}
          >
            <Text style={styles.btnOutlineText}>Change PIN</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── CHANGE PIN FLOW ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {!status?.isLocked && status?.pinSet && showChange && (
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.changePinTitle}>Change Withdrawal PIN</Text>

          <View style={styles.pinRow}>
            <Text style={styles.pinFieldLabel}>Current PIN</Text>
            <PinBoxes
              value={currentPin}
              onChange={setCurrentPin}
              disabled={changing}
              shake={shakeCurrentPin}
            />
          </View>

          <View style={styles.pinRow}>
            <Text style={styles.pinFieldLabel}>New PIN</Text>
            <PinBoxes
              value={changedNew}
              onChange={setChangedNew}
              disabled={changing}
            />
          </View>

          <View style={styles.pinRow}>
            <Text style={styles.pinFieldLabel}>Confirm New PIN</Text>
            <PinBoxes
              value={changeConfirm}
              onChange={setChangeConfirm}
              disabled={changing}
              shake={shakeChangeConfirm}
            />
          </View>

          {!!changeError && (
            <Text style={styles.errorText}>⚠️ {changeError}</Text>
          )}

          <View style={styles.btnRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.btn, styles.btnOutline, styles.btnFlex]}
              onPress={() => {
                setShowChange(false);
                setCurrentPin("");
                setChangedNew("");
                setChangeConfirm("");
                setChangeError("");
              }}
              disabled={changing}
            >
              <Text style={styles.btnOutlineText}>Cancel</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[
                styles.btn,
                styles.btnPrimary,
                styles.btnFlex,
                (changing ||
                  currentPin.length < 4 ||
                  changedNew.length < 4 ||
                  changeConfirm.length < 4) &&
                  styles.btnDisabled,
              ]}
              onPress={handleChangePin}
              disabled={
                changing ||
                currentPin.length < 4 ||
                changedNew.length < 4 ||
                changeConfirm.length < 4
              }
            >
              {changing ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#000" />
              ) : (
                <Text style={styles.btnPrimaryText}>Update PIN</Text>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Attempts hint */}
      {status?.pinSet && !status?.isLocked && !showChange && (
        <Text style={styles.attemptsHint}>
          {status.attemptsRemaining} attempt
          {status.attemptsRemaining !== 1 ? "s" : ""} remaining before lockout
        </Text>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Status meta - now functions that accept t ──────────────────────────────
function getAppStatusMeta(t) {
  return {
    PENDING: {
      label: t("workerApplications.status.pending"),
      color: "#f97316",
      bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
    },
    ACCEPTED: {
      label: t("workerApplications.status.accepted"),
      color: "#22c55e",
      bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.15)",
    },
    REJECTED: {
      label: t("workerApplications.status.rejected"),
      color: "#ef4444",
      bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.15)",
    },
  };
}

function getJobStatusMeta(t) {
  return {
    OPEN: {
      label: t("workerApplications.jobStatus.open"),
      color: "#22c55e",
      bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.15)",
    },
    FILLED: {
      label: t("workerApplications.jobStatus.filled"),
      color: "#3b82f6",
      bg: "rgba(59,130,246,0.15)",
    },
    CANCELLED: {
      label: t("workerApplications.jobStatus.cancelled"),
      color: "#ef4444",
      bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.15)",
    },
  };
}

function getFilterTabs(t) {
  return [
    { key: null, label: t("workerApplications.filter.all") },
    { key: "PENDING", label: t("workerApplications.filter.pending") },
    { key: "ACCEPTED", label: t("workerApplications.filter.accepted") },
    { key: "REJECTED", label: t("workerApplications.filter.rejected") },
  ];
}

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function timeAgo(date, t) {
  if (!date) return "";
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(date).getTime();
  const d = Math.floor(diff / 86_400_000);
  if (d < 1) return t("workerApplications.time.today");
  if (d < 7) return t("workerApplications.time.daysAgo", { d });
  if (d < 30)
    return t("workerApplications.time.weeksAgo", { w: Math.floor(d / 7) });
  const m = Math.floor(d / 30);
  if (m < 12) return t("workerApplications.time.monthsAgo", { m });
  return t("workerApplications.time.yearsAgo", { y: Math.floor(m / 12) });
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return null;
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

// ─── Application card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ApplicationCard({ app, onViewJob, onMessage, onHirerProfile, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const APP_STATUS_META = getAppStatusMeta(t);
  const JOB_STATUS_META = getJobStatusMeta(t);

  const job = app.jobPost ?? {};
  const hirer = job.hirer ?? {};
  const profile = hirer.hirerProfile ?? {};
  const company =
    profile.companyName ??
    `${hirer.firstName ?? ""} ${hirer.lastName ?? ""}`.trim();
  const appMeta = APP_STATUS_META[app.status] ?? APP_STATUS_META.PENDING;
  const jobMeta = JOB_STATUS_META[job.status] ?? JOB_STATUS_META.OPEN;
  const isAccepted = app.status === "ACCEPTED";

  return (
    <View
      style={[ac.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* ── Category badge + job status ── */}
      <View style={ac.topRow}>

// ─── Filter tab ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function FilterTab({ label, count, active, onPress, c }) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={[
        ft.tab,
        {
          backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
          borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
      {count != null && count > 0 && (
        <View
          style={[
            ft.badge,
            { backgroundColor: active ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)" : c.bgPanel },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text, fontSize: 11 }}
          >
            {count}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}
    </Pressable>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerApplicationsScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(null); // null = All
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  // Get FILTER_TABS inside component with t()
  const FILTER_TABS = getFilterTabs(t);

  // ── Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await client.get("/jobs/worker/my-applications", {
        params: { limit: 100, page: 1 }, // load all, filter client-side
      });
      const d = res.data.data ?? res.data;
      setAllApps(d.applications ?? []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message ??
          t("workerApplications.error.loadFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  // ── Derived ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const counts = {
    PENDING: allApps.filter((a) => a.status === "PENDING").length,
    ACCEPTED: allApps.filter((a) => a.status === "ACCEPTED").length,
    REJECTED: allApps.filter((a) => a.status === "REJECTED").length,
  };

  const filtered = activeTab
    ? allApps.filter((a) => a.status === activeTab)
    : allApps;
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filtered.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
  const displayed = filtered.slice(
    (page - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE,
    page * ITEMS_PER_PAGE,
  );

  const handleTabChange = (tab) => {
    setActiveTab(tab);
    setPage(1);
  };

  // ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const onViewJob = (jobId) =>
    navigation.navigate("WorkerJobDetail", { jobId });
  const onMessage = (userId) =>
    navigation.navigate("Chat", { recipientId: userId });
  const onHirerProfile = (userId) =>
    navigation.navigate("HirerPublicProfile", { userId });

  // ── Loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <ScrollView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            load();
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
    >
      {/* ── Page header ── */}
      <View style={s.pageHeader}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
            {t("workerApplications.header.submitted", {
              count: allApps.length,
              s: allApps.length !== 1 ? "s" : "",
            })}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate("WorkerJobs")}
          style={[
            s.browseBtn,
            { backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)", borderColor: c.orange },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange }}
          >
            {t("workerApplications.header.browseJobs")} →
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ── Filter tabs ── */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8 }}
      >
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count = tab.key ? counts[tab.key] || 0 : allApps.length;
          return (
            <FilterTab
              key={String(tab.key)}
              label={tab.label}
              count={count}
              active={activeTab === tab.key}
              onPress={() => handleTabChange(tab.key)}
              c={c}
            />
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* ── Empty state ── */}
      {filtered.length === 0 && (
        <View style={s.empty}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 52, marginBottom: 14 }}>📋</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="title"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 8 }}
          >
            {activeTab
              ? t("workerApplications.empty.noFiltered", {
                  status: activeTab.toLowerCase(),
                })
              : t("workerApplications.empty.noApplications")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 20 }}
          >
            {activeTab
              ? t("workerApplications.empty.tryDifferentFilter")
              : t("workerApplications.empty.startBrowsing")}
          </AppText>
          {!activeTab && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("WorkerJobs")}
              style={[s.browseEmptyBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#fff" }}
              >
                {t("workerApplications.header.browseJobs")} →
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Application cards ── */}
      {displayed.map((app) => (
        <ApplicationCard
          key={app.id}
          app={app}
          onViewJob={onViewJob}
          onMessage={onMessage}
          onHirerProfile={onHirerProfile}
          c={c}
        />
      ))}

      {/* ── Pagination ── */}
      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <View style={[s.pagination, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
            disabled={page === 1}
            style={[
              s.pageBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: page === 1 ? 0.4 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {t("workerApplications.pagination.prev")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>

          <View
            style={[
              s.pageIndicator,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {page} {t("workerApplications.pagination.of")} {totalPages}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
            disabled={page === totalPages}
            style={[
              s.pageBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: page === totalPages ? 0.4 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {t("workerApplications.pagination.next")} →
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      )}
    </ScrollView>
  );
}
