// src/screens/main/worker/WorkerAvailabilityScreen.js
// Mirrors: website /worker/availability
// APIs:
//   GET /workers/:userId          — loads worker.availability (numeric dayOfWeek 0-6)
//   PUT /workers/availability     — { availability: [...] } (string dayOfWeek names)

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  Switch,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import DateTimePicker from "@react-native-community/datetimepicker";

import AppScreen from "../../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../../api/client";

// ─── Day definitions — matches website exactly ────────────────────────────────
// Now a function that accepts t
function getDays(t) {
  return [
    { value: "MONDAY", label: t("workerAvailability.days.monday"), num: 1 },
    { value: "TUESDAY", label: t("workerAvailability.days.tuesday"), num: 2 },
    {
      value: "WEDNESDAY",
      label: t("workerAvailability.days.wednesday"),
      num: 3,
    },
    { value: "THURSDAY", label: t("workerAvailability.days.thursday"), num: 4 },
    { value: "FRIDAY", label: t("workerAvailability.days.friday"), num: 5 },
    { value: "SATURDAY", label: t("workerAvailability.days.saturday"), num: 6 },
    { value: "SUNDAY", label: t("workerAvailability.days.sunday"), num: 0 },
  ];
}

// Backend returns numeric dayOfWeek; we map back to name
const NUM_TO_DAY = {
  0: "SUNDAY",
  1: "MONDAY",
  2: "TUESDAY",
  3: "WEDNESDAY",
  4: "THURSDAY",
  5: "FRIDAY",
  6: "SATURDAY",
};
// Name → numeric (for matching incoming data)
const DAY_TO_NUM = {
  SUNDAY: 0,
  MONDAY: 1,
  TUESDAY: 2,
  WEDNESDAY: 3,
  THURSDAY: 4,
  FRIDAY: 5,
  SATURDAY: 6,
};

function buildDefault(t) {
  const DAYS = getDays(t);
  return DAYS.map((d) => ({
    dayOfWeek: d.value,
    startTime: "08:00",
    endTime: "18:00",
    isAvailable: !["SATURDAY", "SUNDAY"].includes(d.value),
  }));
}

// Convert "09:00" → "09:00 AM", "18:00" → "06:00 PM"
function fmt24to12(time24) {
  if (!time24) return "—";
  const [h, m] = time24.split(":").map(Number);
  const period = h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  const h12 = h === 0 ? 12 : h > 12 ? h - 12 : h;
  return `${String(h12).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")} ${period}`;
}

// Parse "09:00" → Date object (today at that time)
function timeStringToDate(timeStr) {
  const [h, m] = (timeStr ?? "08:00").split(":").map(Number);
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(h, m, 0, 0);
  return d;
}

// Date → "HH:MM"
function dateToTimeString(date) {
  return `${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

// ─── Time picker field ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function TimeField({ value, onChange, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const dateVal = timeStringToDate(value);

  const handleChange = (event, selected) => {
    if (Platform.OS === "android") setShow(false);
    if (selected) onChange(dateToTimeString(selected));
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setShow(true)}
        style={[
          av.timeBtn,
          {
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)",
            borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: "#fff", flex: 1 }}>
          {fmt24to12(value)}
        </AppText>
        <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={18} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" />
      </Pressable>

      {/* iOS: wrap in Modal */}
      {Platform.OS === "ios" && show && (
        <Modal
          transparent
          animationType="slide"
          onRequestClose={() => setShow(false)}
        >
          <Pressable style={av.pickerBackdrop} onPress={() => setShow(false)}>
            <View style={[av.pickerSheet, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard }]}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setShow(false)}
                style={{ alignSelf: "flex-end", padding: 14 }}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.orange }}
                >
                  {t("workerAvailability.common.done")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <DateTimePicker
                value={dateVal}
                mode="time"
                display="spinner"
                onChange={handleChange}
                textColor={c.text}
              />
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* Android: dialog */}
      {Platform.OS === "android" && show && (
        <DateTimePicker
          value={dateVal}
          mode="time"
          display="default"
          onChange={handleChange}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Single day row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DayRow({ day, onToggle, onTimeChange, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const active = day.isAvailable;
  const DAYS = getDays(t);
  const dayLabel =
    DAYS.find((d) => d.value === day.dayOfWeek)?.label || day.dayOfWeek;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        av.dayRow,
        {
          backgroundColor: active ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)" : c.bgPanel,
          borderColor: active ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.3)" : c.border,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Toggle + label */}
      <View style={av.dayHeader}>
        <Switch
          value={active}
          onValueChange={onToggle}
          trackColor={{ false: "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)", true: c.orange }}
          thumbColor="#fff"
          ios_backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.12)"
        />
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted, marginLeft: 10 }}
        >
          {dayLabel}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Time pickers or "Not available" */}
      {active ? (
        <View style={av.timeRow}>
          <TimeField
            value={day.startTime}
            onChange={(t) => onTimeChange("startTime", t)}
            c={c}
          />
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)", marginHorizontal: 6 }}
          >
            {t("workerAvailability.common.to")}
          </AppText>
          <TimeField
            value={day.endTime}
            onChange={(t) => onTimeChange("endTime", t)}
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
      ) : (
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={av.offLabel}>
          {t("workerAvailability.common.notAvailable")}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerAvailabilityScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  const DAYS = getDays(t);
  const [schedule, setSchedule] = useState(buildDefault(t));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // ── Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    try {
      const res = await client.get(`/workers/${user.id}`);
      const avail = res.data.data?.worker?.availability ?? [];
      if (avail.length > 0) {
        // API returns numeric dayOfWeek — map back to named strings
        setSchedule(
          DAYS.map((d) => {
            const saved = avail.find(
              (a) =>
                a.dayOfWeek === DAY_TO_NUM[d.value] || a.dayOfWeek === d.value,
            );
            return saved
              ? {
                  dayOfWeek: d.value,
                  startTime: saved.startTime,
                  endTime: saved.endTime,
                  isAvailable: saved.isAvailable,
                }
              : {
                  dayOfWeek: d.value,
                  startTime: "08:00",
                  endTime: "18:00",
                  isAvailable: false,
                };
          }),
        );
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("workerAvailability.error.loadFailed"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  // ── Quick actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const setMonFri = () =>
    setSchedule((s) =>
      s.map((d) => ({
        ...d,
        isAvailable: !["SATURDAY", "SUNDAY"].includes(d.dayOfWeek),
        startTime: "08:00",
        endTime: "18:00",
      })),
    );

  const setEveryDay = () =>
    setSchedule((s) =>
      s.map((d) => ({
        ...d,
        isAvailable: true,
        startTime: "08:00",
        endTime: "18:00",
      })),
    );

  const reset = () => setSchedule(buildDefault(t));

  // ── Day mutations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const toggle = (idx) =>
    setSchedule((s) =>
      s.map((d, i) => (i === idx ? { ...d, isAvailable: !d.isAvailable } : d)),
    );

  const setTime = (idx, key, val) =>
    setSchedule((s) => s.map((d, i) => (i === idx ? { ...d, [key]: val } : d)));

  // ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await client.put("/workers/availability", { availability: schedule });
      toast.success(t("workerAvailability.success.saved"));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message ??
          t("workerAvailability.error.saveFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const activeDays = schedule.filter((d) => d.isAvailable).length;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AppScreen
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            load();
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
    >
      {/* ── Header ── */}

      <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        {t("workerAvailability.subtitle")}
      </AppText>

      {/* ── Quick actions ── */}
      <View style={av.quickRow}>
        {[
          { label: t("workerAvailability.quick.monFri"), onPress: setMonFri },
          {
            label: t("workerAvailability.quick.everyDay"),
            onPress: setEveryDay,
          },
          { label: t("workerAvailability.quick.reset"), onPress: reset },
        ].map((btn) => (
          <Pressable
            key={btn.label}
            onPress={btn.onPress}
            style={[
              av.quickBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {btn.label}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        ))}
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          tone="dim"
          style={{ alignSelf: "center", flexShrink: 1 }}
        >
          {t("workerAvailability.common.daysActive", {
            count: activeDays,
            s: activeDays !== 1 ? "s" : "",
          })}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* ── Schedule card ── */}
      <View
        style={[
          av.scheduleCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="title"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 4 }}
        >
          {t("workerAvailability.schedule.title")}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          {t("workerAvailability.schedule.subtitle")}
        </AppText>

        {schedule.map((day, idx) => (
          <DayRow
            key={day.dayOfWeek}
            day={day}
            onToggle={() => toggle(idx)}
            onTimeChange={(key, val) => setTime(idx, key, val)}
            c={c}
          />
        ))}

        {/* Save button */}
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleSave}
          disabled={saving || loading}
          style={[
            av.saveBtn,
            { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: saving ? 0.75 : 1 },
          ]}
        >
          {saving ? (
            <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
          ) : (
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
              {t("workerAvailability.button.save")}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  const date = new Date(d);
  const dd = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const mm = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const yyyy = date.getFullYear();
  const hh = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, "0");
  const min = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy} · ${hh}:${min}`;
}

function fmtBudget(currency, rate) {
  if (!rate && rate !== 0) return "—";
  return `${currency ?? ""} ${Number(rate).toLocaleString()}`.trim();
}

// ─── Booking card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (

    >

      <View style={bc.topRow}>

        />

          style={[

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerBookingsScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [bookings, setBookings] = useState([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);

  // ── Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(
    async (pg = 1, tab = activeTab, replace = true) => {
      if (replace && pg === 1) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const params = { page: pg, limit: LIMIT };
        if (tab) params.status = tab;

        const data = await getBookings(params);
        const list = data.bookings ?? data.data ?? [];

        setBookings(replace ? list : (prev) => [...prev, ...list]);
        setTotal(data.total ?? 0);
        setTotalPages(data.pages ?? 1);
        setPage(pg);
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Could not load bookings");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [activeTab],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1);
    load(1, activeTab, true);
  }, [activeTab]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load(1, activeTab, true);
  };

  const loadMore = () => {
    if (page < totalPages && !loading) load(page + 1, activeTab, false);
  };

  // ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <View style={[s.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={bookings}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={s.listContent}
        onEndReached={loadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.4}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* ── Page header ── */}
            <AppText
              weight="semibold"
              style={{
                color: c.orange,
                letterSpacing: 1.2,
                fontSize: 12,
                marginBottom: 6,
              }}
            >
              MY JOBS
            </AppText>
            <View style={s.titleRow}>
              <AppText
                weight="displayBlack"
                style={[s.pageTitle, { color: c.text }]}
              >
                Bookings
              </AppText>
              {total > 0 && (
                <View
                  style={[
                    s.countBadge,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text }}
                  >
                    {total}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>

            {/* ── Filter tabs ── */}
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={s.tabsScroll}
              contentContainerStyle={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}
            >
              {STATUS_TABS.map((tab) => (
                <FilterTab
                  key={String(tab.key)}
                  label={tab.label}
                  active={activeTab === tab.key}
                  onPress={() => setActiveTab(tab.key)}
                  c={c}
                />
              ))}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <BookingCard
            booking={item}
            c={c}
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("BookingDetail", { bookingId: item.id })
            }
          />
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={s.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 52, marginBottom: 14 }}>📋</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 8 }}
              >
                {activeTab
                  ? `No ${activeTab.toLowerCase().replace("_", " ")} bookings`
                  : "No bookings yet"}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center" }}
              >
                {activeTab
                  ? "Try switching to a different filter."
                  : "When hirers book you, your jobs will appear here."}
              </AppText>
              {activeTab && (
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => setActiveTab(null)}
                  style={[s.clearBtn, { borderColor: c.border, marginTop: 16 }]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text }}
                  >
                    Show all bookings
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              )}
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", padding: 20 }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
          )
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}

const s = StyleSheet.create({
  screen: { flex: 1 },
  listContent: { padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40 },

  titleRow: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: 14,
    marginBottom: 20,
  },
  pageTitle: { fontSize: 36, lineHeight: 42 },
  countBadge: {
    borderRadius: 20,
    borderWidth: 1,
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 6,
  },

  tabsScroll: { flexGrow: 0, marginBottom: 20 },

  empty: { paddingVertical: 60, alignItems: "center", paddingHorizontal: 24 },
  clearBtn: {
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: 20,
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
    paddingVertical: 10,
  },
});

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";

import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../../store/authStore";

import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

const POPULAR_LIMIT = 12;

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function debounce(fn, delay) {
  let timer;
  return (...args) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delay);
  };
}

// ─── Category pill (selected categories shown above search results) ───────────
function Pill({ cat, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        pl.pill,
        {
          backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.18)",
          borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.5)",
        },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 12, marginRight: 4 }}>
        {cat.icon ?? "🔧"}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: c.orange }}
        numberOfLines={1}
      >
        {cat.name}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}
const pl = StyleSheet.create({
  pill: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    paddingVertical: 6,
    borderRadius: 20,
    borderWidth: 1,
    marginRight: 8,
  },
});

// ─── Search result row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ResultRow({ cat, isAdded, onPress, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={[
        rr.row,
        {
          borderBottomColor: c.border,
          backgroundColor: isAdded ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.06)" : "transparent",
        },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22, marginRight: 12, width: 30 }}>
        {cat.icon ?? "🔧"}
      </AppText>
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
          {cat.name}
        </AppText>
        {cat._count?.workers != null && (
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {t("workerCategory.workerCount", { count: cat._count.workers })}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>
      {isAdded && <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={18} color="#22c55e" />}
    </Pressable>
  );
}
const rr = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    paddingVertical: 12,
    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
  },
});

// ─── Category list row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CatRow({ wc, onSetPrimary, onRemove, removing, settingPrimary, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const cat = wc.category ?? wc;
  const catId = wc.categoryId ?? cat.id;
  const isPrim = wc.isPrimary;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        cr.row,
        {
          borderColor: isPrim ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.4)" : c.border,
          backgroundColor: isPrim ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.08)" : c.bgCard,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={cr.left}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 28, marginRight: 12, width: 36 }}>
          {cat.icon ?? "🔧"}
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {cat.name}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
            {cat.slug}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={cr.right}>
        {isPrim ? (
          <View style={[cr.primaryBadge, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>⭐</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#fff", marginLeft: 4 }}
            >
              {t("workerCategory.primary")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => onSetPrimary(catId)}
            disabled={settingPrimary === catId}
            style={[cr.setPrimBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
          >
            {settingPrimary === catId ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.orange} />
            ) : (
              <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.text }}>
                {t("workerCategory.setPrimary")}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </Pressable>
        )}

        <Pressable
          onPress={() => onRemove(catId, cat.name)}
          disabled={removing === catId}
          style={[cr.removeBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          {removing === catId ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#ef4444" />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted, fontSize: 14 }}>✕</AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
const cr = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    borderRadius: 14,
    borderWidth: 1,
    padding: 12,
    marginBottom: 10,
  },
  left: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", flex: 1 },
  right: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, flexShrink: 0 },
  primaryBadge: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    paddingVertical: 7,
    borderRadius: 20,
  },
  setPrimBtn: {
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    paddingVertical: 7,
    borderRadius: 20,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  removeBtn: {
    width: 34,
    height: 34,
    borderRadius: 10,
    borderWidth: 1,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
});

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerCategoriesScreen() {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  // ── Worker categories ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [myCategories, setMyCategories] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState(null);
  const [settingPrim, setSettingPrim] = useState(null);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(null);

  // ── Search / dropdown ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState([]);
  const [totalCats, setTotalCats] = useState(0);
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);
  const [dropdownOpen, setDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);

  // ── Custom add ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [showCustom, setShowCustom] = useState(false);
  const [customName, setCustomName] = useState("");
  const [addingCustom, setAddingCustom] = useState(false);

  // ── Load worker categories ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadMyCategories = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    try {
      const res = await client.get(`/workers/${user.id}`);
      const worker = res.data.data?.worker ?? res.data.data ?? {};
      setMyCategories(worker.categories ?? []);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("workerCategory.error.loadFailed"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadMyCategories();
  }, [loadMyCategories]);

  // ── Load popular categories ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadPopular = useCallback(async () => {
    setSearching(true);
    try {
      const res = await client.get("/categories", {
        params: { limit: POPULAR_LIMIT },
      });
      const d = res.data.data ?? res.data;
      setResults(d.categories ?? d.data ?? (Array.isArray(d) ? d : []));
      setTotalCats(d.total ?? d.count ?? 0);
    } catch {
      setResults([]);
    } finally {
      setSearching(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // ── Debounced search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const doSearch = useCallback(
    debounce(async (q) => {
      if (!q.trim()) {
        loadPopular();
        return;
      }
      setSearching(true);
      try {
        const res = await client.get("/categories", {
          params: { q: q.trim(), limit: 20 },
        });
        const d = res.data.data ?? res.data;
        setResults(d.categories ?? d.data ?? (Array.isArray(d) ? d : []));
        setTotalCats(d.total ?? 0);
      } catch {
        setResults([]);
      } finally {
        setSearching(false);
      }
    }, 350),
    [loadPopular],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dropdownOpen) doSearch(searchText);
  }, [searchText]);

  const openDropdown = () => {
    setDropdownOpen(true);
    loadPopular();
  };

  const closeDropdown = () => {
    setDropdownOpen(false);
    setSearchText("");
    setShowCustom(false);
  };

  // ── Add existing category ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleAdd = async (cat) => {
    const alreadyAdded = myCategories.find(
      (wc) => (wc.category?.id ?? wc.categoryId) === cat.id,
    );
    if (alreadyAdded) {
      toast.info(t("workerCategory.alreadyAdded", { name: cat.name }));
      return;
    }
    setAdding(cat.id);
    try {
      await client.post("/workers/categories", {
        categoryId: cat.id,
        isPrimary: myCategories.length === 0,
      });
      await loadMyCategories();
      toast.success(t("workerCategory.addSuccess", { name: cat.name }));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message ?? t("workerCategory.error.addFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setAdding(null);
    }
  };

  // ── Add as new (suggest) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleAddNew = async (name) => {
    if (!name.trim()) return;
    setAddingCustom(true);
    try {
      const cat = await categoriesApi.suggest(name.trim());
      await client.post("/workers/categories", {
        categoryId: cat.id,
        isPrimary: myCategories.length === 0,
      });
      await loadMyCategories();
      toast.success(t("workerCategory.addNewSuccess", { name: cat.name }));
      setCustomName("");
      setShowCustom(false);
      closeDropdown();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message ?? t("workerCategory.error.addNewFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setAddingCustom(false);
    }
  };

  // ── Remove ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleRemove = (catId, name) => {
    Alert.alert(
      t("workerCategory.removeConfirmTitle"),
      t("workerCategory.removeConfirm", { name }),
      [
        { text: t("common.cancel"), style: "cancel" },
        {
          text: t("common.remove"),
          style: "destructive",
          onPress: async () => {
            setRemoving(catId);
            try {
              await client.delete(`/workers/categories/${catId}`);
              await loadMyCategories();
              toast.success(t("workerCategory.removeSuccess", { name }));
            } catch {
              toast.error(t("workerCategory.error.removeFailed"));
            } finally {
              setRemoving(null);
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  };

  // ── Set primary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSetPrimary = async (catId) => {
    setSettingPrim(catId);
    try {
      await client.post("/workers/categories", {
        categoryId: catId,
        isPrimary: true,
      });
      await loadMyCategories();
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("workerCategory.error.primaryFailed"));
    } finally {
      setSettingPrim(null);
    }
  };

  // ── Derived ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const myIds = new Set(
    myCategories.map((wc) => wc.category?.id ?? wc.categoryId),
  );
  const myCats = myCategories.map((wc) => wc.category ?? wc); // for pills
  const noResults = !searching && searchText.trim() && results.length === 0;

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <ScrollView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 48 }}
      keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            loadMyCategories();
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
    >
      {/* ── Page header ── */}
      <AppText weight="displayBlack" style={[s.pageTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
        {t("workerCategory.title")}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="body"
        tone="dim"
        style={{ marginBottom: 20, lineHeight: 22 }}
      >
        {t("workerCategory.subtitle")}
      </AppText>

      {/* ═══ ADD CATEGORY CARD ═══ */}
      <View
        style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="title"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 4 }}
        >
          {t("workerCategory.addTitle")}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
          {t("workerCategory.addSub")}
        </AppText>

        {/* Search input */}
        <View
          style={[
            s.searchBox,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              borderColor: dropdownOpen ? c.orange : c.border,
              borderWidth: dropdownOpen ? 1.5 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="search"
            size={16}
            color={c.textMuted}
            style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
          />
          <TextInput
            ref={inputRef}
            value={searchText}
            onChangeText={setSearchText}
            onFocus={openDropdown}
            placeholder={t("workerCategory.searchPlaceholder")}
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            style={{ flex: 1, color: c.text, fontSize: 15 }}
            returnKeyType="search"
          />
          {searching ? (
            <ActivityIndicator
              size="small"
              color={c.orange}
              style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
            />
          ) : dropdownOpen ? (
            <Pressable
              onPress={closeDropdown}
              hitSlop={8}
              style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
            >
              <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={c.textMuted} />
            </Pressable>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Selected pills (always visible above dropdown) */}
        {myCats.length > 0 && (
          <ScrollView
            horizontal
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            style={{ marginTop: 12 }}
            contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 2 }}
          >
            {myCats.map((cat) => (
              <Pill key={cat?.id ?? cat?.name} cat={cat} c={c} />
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        )}

        {/* Dropdown: search results or popular */}
        {dropdownOpen && (
          <View
            style={[
              s.dropdown,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            {!searchText.trim() && !searching && (
              <View style={[s.dropHeader, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{
                    color: c.textMuted,
                    letterSpacing: 0.8,
                    fontSize: 11,
                  }}
                >
                  {t("workerCategory.popularLabel")}
                </AppText>
                {totalCats > 0 && (
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.orange }}
                  >
                    {totalCats.toLocaleString()} {t("workerCategory.total")}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
            )}

            {/* Loading */}
            {searching && (
              <View style={{ paddingVertical: 20, alignItems: "center" }}>
                <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
              </View>
            )}

            {/* No results */}
            {noResults && (
              <View style={{ padding: 16 }}>
                <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                  {t("workerCategory.noResults", { query: searchText })}
                </AppText>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => handleAddNew(searchText)}
                  disabled={!!addingCustom}
                  style={[s.addNewBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
                >
                  {addingCustom ? (
                    <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
                  ) : (
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                    >
                      {t("workerCategory.addNew", { name: searchText })}
                    </AppText>
                  )}
                </Pressable>
              </View>
            )}

            {/* Results list */}
            {!searching &&
              results.length > 0 &&
              results.map((cat) => (
                <ResultRow
                  key={cat.id}
                  cat={cat}
                  isAdded={myIds.has(cat.id)}
                  onPress={() => handleAdd(cat)}
                  c={c}
                />
              ))}

            {/* Custom add link */}
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => {
                setShowCustom(true);
                setDropdownOpen(false);
                setSearchText("");
              }}
              style={{ padding: 14 }}
            >
              <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
                {t("workerCategory.cantFind")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Custom add form */}
        {showCustom && (
          <View
            style={[
              s.customForm,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginBottom: 10 }}
            >
              {t("workerCategory.customPrompt")}
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}
            >
              <TextInput
                value={customName}
                onChangeText={setCustomName}
                placeholder={t("workerCategory.customPlaceholder")}
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                style={[
                  s.customInput,
                  {
                    color: c.text,
                    borderColor: c.orange,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                    flex: 1,
                  },
                ]}
                autoFocus
                returnKeyType="done"
                onSubmitEditing={() => handleAddNew(customName)}
              />
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => handleAddNew(customName)}
                disabled={!customName.trim() || !!addingCustom}
                style={[
                  s.addCustomBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: customName.trim() ? c.orange : c.bgPanel,
                    opacity: customName.trim() ? 1 : 0.6,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {addingCustom ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    + {t("workerCategory.add")}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => {
                  setShowCustom(false);
                  setCustomName("");
                }}
                style={[s.closeCustomBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
              >
                <AppText style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>✕</AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* ═══ MY CATEGORIES LIST ═══ */}
      <View
        style={[
          s.card,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border, marginTop: 16 },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={s.listHeader}>
          <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {t("workerCategory.myCategories")}
          </AppText>
          <View style={[s.countBadge, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#fff" }}
            >
              {myCategories.length}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        {loading ? (
          <View style={{ gap: 10, marginTop: 8 }}>
            {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
              <View
                key={i}
                style={[s.skeleton, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel }]}
              />
            ))}
          </View>
        ) : myCategories.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={s.empty}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 12 }}>🔧</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 6 }}
            >
              {t("workerCategory.noCategoriesTitle")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
              {t("workerCategory.noCategoriesSub")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : (
          myCategories.map((wc) => (
            <CatRow
              key={wc.id ?? wc.categoryId}
              wc={wc}
              onSetPrimary={handleSetPrimary}
              onRemove={handleRemove}
              removing={removing}
              settingPrimary={settingPrim}
              c={c}
            />
          ))
        )}
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/screens/main/worker/WorkerCertificationsScreen.js
// Mirrors: website /worker/certifications
// APIs:
//   GET  /workers/:userId             — load certifications
//   POST /workers/certifications      — FormData: name, issuedBy, issueDate?, expiryDate?, document?
//   DELETE /workers/certifications/:certId  (via workerAuth.js deleteCertification)

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Linking,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
  Image,
  Dimensions,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import * as DocumentPicker from "expo-document-picker";
import DateTimePicker from "@react-native-community/datetimepicker";

import AppScreen from "../../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../../api/client";

const SCREEN_W = Dimensions.get("window").width;

// ─── Date picker field ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DateField({ label, value, onChange, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);

  const dateValue = value ? new Date(value) : new Date();
  const display = value
    ? new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
        day: "numeric",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
      })
    : t("workerCertifications.date.placeholder");

  const handleChange = (event, selected) => {
    if (Platform.OS === "android") setShow(false);
    if (selected) {
      onChange(selected.toISOString().split("T")[0]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={cert.label}>
        {label}
      </AppText>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setShow(true)}
        style={[
          cert.input,
          cert.dateField,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          style={{ flex: 1, color: value ? c.text : c.textMuted }}
        >
          {display}
        </AppText>
        <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={18} color={c.textMuted} />
      </Pressable>

      {/* iOS — wrap in Modal */}
      {Platform.OS === "ios" && show && (
        <Modal
          transparent
          animationType="slide"
          onRequestClose={() => setShow(false)}
        >
          <Pressable style={cert.dateBackdrop} onPress={() => setShow(false)}>
            <View style={[cert.dateSheet, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard }]}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setShow(false)}
                style={{ alignSelf: "flex-end", padding: 12 }}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.orange }}
                >
                  {t("workerCertifications.common.done")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <DateTimePicker
                value={dateValue}
                mode="date"
                display="spinner"
                onChange={handleChange}
                textColor={c.text}
                style={{ width: SCREEN_W - 32 }}
              />
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* Android — renders as dialog automatically */}
      {Platform.OS === "android" && show && (
        <DateTimePicker
          value={dateValue}
          mode="date"
          display="default"
          onChange={handleChange}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Cert row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CertRow({ cert: c2, onDelete, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const isExpired = c2.expiryDate && new Date(c2.expiryDate) < new Date();

  const fmtDate = (d) =>
    d
      ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-NG", {
          day: "numeric",
          month: "short",
          year: "numeric",
        })
      : "—";

  const handleView = () => {
    if (!c2.documentUrl) return;
    Linking.openURL(c2.documentUrl).catch(() => {});
  };

  return (
    <View style={[cert.certRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
      {/* Medal icon */}
      <View
        style={[
          cert.medal,
          {
            backgroundColor: isExpired
              ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)"
              : "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 26 }}>🏅</AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Info */}
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 2 }}
        >
          {c2.name}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {t("workerCertifications.cert.issuedBy", { issuer: c2.issuedBy })} ·{" "}
          {fmtDate(c2.issueDate)}
          {c2.expiryDate
            ? ` · ${t("workerCertifications.cert.expires", { date: fmtDate(c2.expiryDate) })}`
            : ""}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Actions */}
      <View style={{ gap: 6, alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
        {isExpired && (
          <View
            style={[
              cert.expiredBadge,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.15)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444", fontSize: 10 }}
            >
              {t("workerCertifications.cert.expired")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
        {c2.documentUrl && (
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleView}
            style={[cert.viewBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {t("workerCertifications.cert.view")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerCertificationsScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [certs, setCerts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // Form state
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [issuedBy, setIssuedBy] = useState("");
  const [issueDate, setIssueDate] = useState("");
  const [expiryDate, setExpiryDate] = useState("");
  const [docFile, setDocFile] = useState(null);

  // ── Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    try {
      const res = await client.get(`/workers/${user.id}`);
      setCerts(res.data.data?.worker?.certifications ?? []);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("workerCertifications.error.loadFailed"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  // ── Pick document ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const pickDocument = async () => {
    const r = await DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({
      type: ["application/pdf", "image/*"],
      copyToCacheDirectory: true,
    });
    if (!r.canceled && r.assets?.[0]) setDocFile(r.assets[0]);
  };

  // ── Submit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) {
      toast.error(t("workerCertifications.error.nameRequired"));
      return;
    }
    if (!issuedBy.trim()) {
      toast.error(t("workerCertifications.error.issuerRequired"));
      return;
    }

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("name", name.trim());
    formData.append("issuedBy", issuedBy.trim());
    if (issueDate) formData.append("issueDate", issueDate);
    if (expiryDate) formData.append("expiryDate", expiryDate);
    if (docFile)
      formData.append("document", {
        uri: docFile.uri,
        name: docFile.name,
        type: docFile.mimeType ?? "application/pdf",
      });

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await client.post("/workers/certifications", formData, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });
      setName("");
      setIssuedBy("");
      setIssueDate("");
      setExpiryDate("");
      setDocFile(null);
      toast.success(t("workerCertifications.success.added"));
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message ??
          t("workerCertifications.error.addFailed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AppScreen
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            load();
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40, gap: 16 }}
    >
      {/* ── Add Certification ── */}
      <View
        style={[
          cert.card,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="title"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 16 }}
        >
          {t("workerCertifications.add.title")}
        </AppText>

        {/* Name + Issued By */}
        <View style={cert.row2}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={cert.label}>
              {t("workerCertifications.add.name")} *
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              value={name}
              onChangeText={setName}
              placeholder={t("workerCertifications.add.namePlaceholder")}
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              style={[
                cert.input,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                },
              ]}
            />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={cert.label}>
              {t("workerCertifications.add.issuedBy")} *
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              value={issuedBy}
              onChangeText={setIssuedBy}
              placeholder={t("workerCertifications.add.issuedByPlaceholder")}
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              style={[
                cert.input,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                },
              ]}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Issue Date + Expiry Date */}
        <View style={[cert.row2, { marginTop: 14 }]}>
          <DateField
            label={t("workerCertifications.add.issueDate")}
            value={issueDate}
            onChange={setIssueDate}
            c={c}
          />
          <DateField
            label={t("workerCertifications.add.expiryDate")}
            value={expiryDate}
            onChange={setExpiryDate}
            c={c}
          />
        </View>

        {/* Document */}
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          style={[cert.label, { marginTop: 14 }]}
        >
          {t("workerCertifications.add.document")}
        </AppText>
        <Pressable
          onPress={pickDocument}
          style={[
            cert.docPicker,
            {
              borderColor: docFile ? c.orange : c.border,
              backgroundColor: docFile ? `${c.orange}08` : c.bgInput,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name={docFile ? "document-text" : "attach-outline"}
            size={20}
            color={docFile ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
            style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
          />
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ flex: 1, color: docFile ? c.orange : c.textMuted }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {docFile
              ? docFile.name
              : t("workerCertifications.add.documentPlaceholder")}
          </AppText>
          {docFile && (
            <Pressable onPress={() => setDocFile(null)} hitSlop={8}>
              <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={18} color={c.textMuted} />
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </Pressable>

        {/* Submit */}
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          disabled={saving}
          style={[
            cert.submitBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.orange,
              opacity: saving ? 0.75 : 1,
              marginTop: 16,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {saving ? (
            <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
          ) : (
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
              + {t("workerCertifications.add.button")}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ── Certifications List ── */}
      <View
        style={[
          cert.card,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="title"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 16 }}
        >
          {t("workerCertifications.list.title", { count: certs.length })}
        </AppText>

        {certs.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={cert.empty}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 44, marginBottom: 10 }}>🏅</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 4 }}
            >
              {t("workerCertifications.list.emptyTitle")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
              {t("workerCertifications.list.emptySub")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : (
          certs.map((c2) => <CertRow key={c2.id} cert={c2} c={c} />)
        )}
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// API: GET /workers/dashboard
// All strings via t("workerDash.*") — fully i18n.

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import Card from "../../../components/Card";

// ─── Status meta ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// labelKey maps to workerDash.status* — resolved at render time via t()
const STATUS_META = {
  PENDING: {
    color: "#f97316",
    bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.18)",
    labelKey: "statusPending",
  },
  ACCEPTED: {
    color: "#a78bfa",
    bg: "rgba(167,139,250,0.18)",
    labelKey: "statusAccepted",
  },
  IN_PROGRESS: {
    color: "#6366f1",
    bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.18)",
    labelKey: "statusInProgress",
  },
  COMPLETED: {
    color: "#22c55e",
    bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.15)",
    labelKey: "statusCompleted",
  },
  CANCELLED: {
    color: "#ef4444",
    bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.15)",
    labelKey: "statusCancelled",
  },
  DISPUTED: {
    color: "#f43f5e",
    bg: "rgba(244,63,94,0.18)",
    labelKey: "statusDisputed",
  },
};

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmt(amount, currency = "USD") {
  if (!amount && amount !== 0) return "—";
  return `${currency} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase() || "?";
}

// ─── Stars ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StarRow({ rating, size = 14 }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((s) => (
        <Ionicons
          key={s}
          name={s <= Math.round(rating) ? "star" : "star-outline"}
          size={size}
          color="#f97316"
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Status badge ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatusBadge({ status, t }) {
  const meta = STATUS_META[status] ?? STATUS_META.PENDING;
  return (
    <View style={[bk.badge, { backgroundColor: meta.bg }]}>
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: meta.color, fontSize: 10 }}
      >
        {t(`workerDash.${meta.labelKey}`)}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Earnings Hero ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EarningsHero({ earnings, c, t }) {
  const {
    currency = "USD",
    thisMonth = 0,
    lastMonth = 0,
    pendingPayout = 0,
  } = earnings ?? {};
  return (
    <View style={[hero.card, { backgroundColor: "#1a0e00" }]}>
      <View style={hero.glow} />

      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: c.textMuted, letterSpacing: 1.2, fontSize: 11 }}
      >
        {t("workerDash.thisMonth")}
      </AppText>
      <AppText style={hero.amount}>{fmt(thisMonth, currency)}</AppText>
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
        {t("workerDash.lastMonth", { value: fmt(lastMonth, currency) })}
      </AppText>

      {pendingPayout > 0 && (
        <View style={[hero.escrow, { borderColor: c.orange }]}>
          <AppText

          >
            {t("workerDash.inEscrow")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText style={[hero.escrowAmt, { color: c.orange }]}>
            {fmt(pendingPayout, currency)}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">

          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Earnings Bar Chart ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EarningsChart({ monthlyTrend, c, t, onPress }) {
  if (!monthlyTrend?.length) return null;
  const max = Math.max(...monthlyTrend.map((m) => m.earnings), 1);
  const BAR_HEIGHT = 80;
  return (
    <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
      <View style={ch.header}>
        <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold">
          {t("workerDash.earningsTrend")}
        </AppText>
        <Pressable onPress={onPress} hitSlop={8}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange }}
          >
            {t("workerDash.fullReport")} →
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
      <View style={ch.chartRow}>
        {monthlyTrend.map((item, i) => {
          const barH = Math.max((item.earnings / max) * BAR_HEIGHT, 4);
          const isMax = item.earnings === max && item.earnings > 0;
          return (
            <View key={i} style={ch.barWrap}>
              <View style={[ch.barTrack, { height: BAR_HEIGHT }]}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    ch.bar,
                    {
                      height: barH,
                      backgroundColor: isMax ? c.orange : c.orangeDim,
                    },
                  ]}
                />
              </View>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ fontSize: 10, marginTop: 6, textAlign: "center" }}
              >
                {item.month?.split(" ")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? ""}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ─── Upcoming Job Row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function UpcomingJobRow({ booking, c, t, onPress }) {
  const hirer = booking.hirer ?? {};
  const cat = booking.category ?? {};
  const date = new Date(booking.scheduledAt);
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={[bk.row, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
    >
      <View style={[bk.avatar, { backgroundColor: c.bgInput }]}>
        {hirer.avatar ? (

          >
            {initials(hirer.firstName, hirer.lastName)}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>
          {booking.title}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
            weekday: "short",
            day: "numeric",
            month: "short",
          })}
          {cat.name ? ` · ${cat.name}` : ""}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <StatusBadge status={booking.status} t={t} />
    </Pressable>
  );
}

// ─── Recent Booking Row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function BookingRow({ booking, c, t, onPress }) {
  const hirer = booking.hirer ?? {};
  const cat = booking.category ?? {};
  const currency = booking.currency ?? "USD";
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={[bk.row, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
    >
      <View style={[bk.avatar, { backgroundColor: c.bgInput }]}>
        {hirer.avatar ? (
          <Image source={{ uri: hirer.avatar }} style={bk.avatarImg} />
        ) : (
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 11 }}
          >
            {initials(hirer.firstName, hirer.lastName)}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>
          {booking.title}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {[hirer.firstName, hirer.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
          {cat.name ? ` · ${cat.name}` : ""}
        </AppText>
        {booking.agreedRate > 0 && (
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: "#22c55e", marginTop: 2 }}
          >
            {currency} {Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>
      <StatusBadge status={booking.status} t={t} />
    </Pressable>
  );
}

// ─── Recent Review Row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReviewRow({ review, c }) {
  const giver = review.giver ?? {};
  return (
    <View style={[rv.row, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
      <View style={rv.left}>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
          {[giver.firstName, giver.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(" ") ||
            "Anonymous"}
        </AppText>
        {review.comment ? (
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            numberOfLines={2}
            style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
          >
            {review.comment}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      <StarRow rating={review.rating ?? 0} />
    </View>
  );
}

export default function WorkerDashboardScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = theme.colors;

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await client.get("/workers/dashboard");
      setData(res.data.data);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.networkError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={[s.center, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );

  const stats = data?.stats ?? {};
  const earnings = stats.earnings ?? {};
  const bookingStats = stats.bookings ?? {};
  const engagement = stats.engagement ?? {};
  const upcomingJobs = data?.upcomingBookings ?? [];
  const recentBookings = data?.recentBookings ?? [];
  const recentReviews = data?.recentReviews ?? [];
  const monthlyTrend = data?.monthlyTrend ?? [];
  const profilePct = profile.profileCompletion ?? 0;

          </AppText>

            variant="display"

            {workerUser.firstName}

                {item.label}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ))}
        </View>
      </Card>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/worker/WorkerEarningsScreen.js
// Mirrors: website /worker/earnings
// API: GET /payments/earnings?from=&to=&currency=&page=1&limit=15
//      Returns: { payments, total, pages, summary, availableCurrencies }

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
  Platform,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";

import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import Avatar from "../../../components/Avatar";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import client from "../../../api/client";
import DateTimePicker from "@react-native-community/datetimepicker";

const LIMIT = 15;

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function fmtAmount(currency, amount) {
  if (amount == null) return "—";
  return `${currency ?? ""} ${Number(amount).toLocaleString()}`.trim();
}

// Parse dd/mm/yyyy → ISO date string for API
function parseInputDate(str) {
  if (!str || str.length < 8) return null;
  const parts = str.split("/");
  if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
  const [dd, mm, yyyy] = parts;
  const d = new Date(`${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`);
  return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
}

// ─── Currency selector modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CurrencyModal({
  visible,
  currencies,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  onClose,
  c,
  modalBg,
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const opts = ["ALL", ...currencies];
  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <Pressable style={cm.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            cm.sheet,
            { backgroundColor: modalBg, borderTopColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              {
                width: 40,
                height: 4,
                borderRadius: 2,
                backgroundColor: c.border,
                alignSelf: "center",
                marginBottom: 12,
              },
            ]}
          />
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text, paddingHorizontal: 20, marginBottom: 10 }}
          >
            {t("workerEarnings.allCurrencies")}
          </AppText>
          {opts.map((cur) => {
            const sel = selected === cur || (cur === "ALL" && !selected);
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={cur}
                onPress={() => {
                  onSelect(cur === "ALL" ? null : cur);
                  onClose();
                }}
                style={[
                  cm.option,
                  {
                    borderBottomColor: c.border,
                    backgroundColor: sel ? `${c.orange}15` : "transparent",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  style={{ color: sel ? c.orange : c.text }}
                >
                  {cur === "ALL" ? t("workerEarnings.allCurrencies") : cur}
                </AppText>
                {sel && (
                  <Ionicons
                    name="checkmark-circle"
                    size={18}
                    color={c.orange}
                  />
                )}
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
          <View style={{ height: 20 }} />
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}
const cm = StyleSheet.create({
  backdrop: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",
    justifyContent: "flex-end",
  },
  sheet: {
    borderTopLeftRadius: 24,
    borderTopRightRadius: 24,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    paddingTop: 12,
  },
  option: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
    paddingVertical: 14,
    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
  },
});

// ─── Earning card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EarningCard({ payment, c }) {
  const booking = payment.booking ?? {};
  const hirer = booking.hirer ?? {};
  const cat = booking.category ?? {};
  const cur = payment.currency ?? booking.currency ?? "USD";

  return (
    <View
      style={[ec.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* Title */}
      <AppText
        variant="body"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 2 }}
      >
        {booking.title ?? "—"}
      </AppText>

      {/* Category */}
      {cat.name && (
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
          {cat.icon} {cat.name}
        </AppText>
      )}

      {/* Hirer row */}
      <View style={ec.hirerRow}>
        <Avatar
          uri={hirer.avatar}
          firstName={hirer.firstName}
          lastName={hirer.lastName}
          size={28}
        />
        <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.text, marginLeft: 8 }}>
          {hirer.firstName} {hirer.lastName}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Date */}
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
        {fmtDate(booking.scheduledAt ?? payment.createdAt)}
      </AppText>

      {/* Currency badge */}
      <CurrencyBadge currency={cur} c={c} />

      {/* Amount breakdown */}
      <View style={{ marginTop: 10, gap: 2 }}>
        <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
          {fmtAmount(cur, payment.amount)}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={{ color: "#22c55e", fontSize: 22, lineHeight: 28 }}
        >
          {fmtAmount(cur, payment.workerPayout)}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {fmtAmount(cur, payment.platformFee)}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Date input component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DateInput({ label, value, onChange, placeholder, c }) {
  const [showPicker, setShowPicker] = useState(false);
  const [tempDate, setTempDate] = useState(new Date());

  const handleChange = (event, selectedDate) => {
    if (Platform.OS === "android") setShowPicker(false);
    if (selectedDate) {
      const day = String(selectedDate.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
      const month = String(selectedDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
      const year = selectedDate.getFullYear();
      onChange(`${day}/${month}/${year}`);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setShowPicker(true)}
        style={[di.wrap, { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard }]}
      >
        {label ? (
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ marginRight: 6, fontSize: 11 }}
          >
            {label}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
        <AppText
          style={{ color: value ? c.text : c.textMuted, fontSize: 13, flex: 1 }}
        >
          {value || placeholder}
        </AppText>
        <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={14} color={c.textMuted} />
      </Pressable>

      {Platform.OS === "ios" && showPicker && (
        <Modal
          transparent
          animationType="slide"
          onRequestClose={() => setShowPicker(false)}
        >
          <Pressable style={dp.overlay} onPress={() => setShowPicker(false)}>
            <View style={[dp.pickerSheet, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard }]}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setShowPicker(false)}
                style={{ alignSelf: "flex-end", padding: 14 }}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.orange }}
                >
                  Done
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <DateTimePicker
                value={tempDate}
                mode="date"
                display="spinner"
                onChange={handleChange}
                textColor={c.text}
                style={{ backgroundColor: c.bgCard }}
              />
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {Platform.OS === "android" && showPicker && (
        <DateTimePicker
          value={tempDate}
          mode="date"
          display="default"
          onChange={handleChange}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
