export default function WorkerEarningsScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const c = th.colors;
  const modalBg = th.mode === "dark" ? "#111118" : "#ffffff";

  // ── Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [payments, setPayments] = useState([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(null);
  const [currencies, setCurrencies] = useState([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);

  // ── Filters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState(null); // null = All
  const [fromInput, setFromInput] = useState("");
  const [toInput, setToInput] = useState("");
  const [showCurModal, setShowCurModal] = useState(false);

  // ── Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(
    async (pg = 1, replace = true) => {
      if (replace) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const params = { page: pg, limit: LIMIT };
        if (currency) params.currency = currency;
        const from = parseInputDate(fromInput);
        const to = parseInputDate(toInput);
        if (from) params.from = from;
        if (to) params.to = to;

        const res = await client.get("/payments/earnings", { params });
        const data = res.data.data;

        setPayments(
          replace ? data.payments : (prev) => [...prev, ...data.payments],
        );
        setSummary(data.summary);
        setTotal(data.total ?? 0);
        setTotalPages(data.pages ?? 1);
        if (data.availableCurrencies?.length)
          setCurrencies(data.availableCurrencies);
        setPage(pg);
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(
          err?.response?.data?.message ?? t("workerEarnings.loadFail"),
        );
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [currency, fromInput, toInput],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load(1, true);
  }, [currency, fromInput, toInput]);

  const loadMore = () => {
    if (page < totalPages && !loading) load(page + 1, false);
  };

  // ── Summary values ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fmtSummary = (val) => {
    if (val == null) return "—";
    if (val >= 1_000_000) return `$${(val / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
    if (val >= 1_000) return `$${(val / 1_000).toFixed(0)}K`;
    return `$${Number(val).toLocaleString()}`;
  };

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}>
      <FlatList
        data={payments}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 48 }}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => {
              setRefreshing(true);
              load(1, true);
            }}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        onEndReached={loadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.4}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            {/* ── Summary card ── */}
            <View
              style={[
                s.summaryCard,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <SumStat
                label={t("workerEarnings.totalEarned")}
                value={fmtSummary(summary?.totalEarned)}
                orange
                c={c}
              />
              <SumStat
                label={t("workerEarnings.totalJobValue")}
                value={fmtSummary(summary?.totalJobValue)}
                c={c}
              />
              <SumStat
                label={t("workerEarnings.platformFees")}
                value={fmtSummary(summary?.totalFees)}
                c={c}
              />
              <SumStat
                label={t("workerEarnings.transactions")}
                value={String(total)}
                c={c}
              />
            </View>

            {/* ── Filters ── */}
            <View style={s.filterRow}>
              {/* Currency dropdown */}
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setShowCurModal(true)}
                style={[
                  s.currencyBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.orange, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1 }}
                >
                  {currency ?? t("workerEarnings.allCurrencies")}
                </AppText>
                <Ionicons name="chevron-down" size={14} color={c.textMuted} />
              </Pressable>

              {/* Date range */}
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ marginHorizontal: 8 }}
              >
                {t("workerEarnings.from")}
              </AppText>
              <DateInput
                label=""
                value={fromInput}
                onChange={setFromInput}
                placeholder={t("workerEarnings.datePlaceholder")}
                c={c}
              />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ marginHorizontal: 8 }}
              >
                {t("workerEarnings.to")}
              </AppText>
              <DateInput
                label=""
                value={toInput}
                onChange={setToInput}
                placeholder={t("workerEarnings.datePlaceholder")}
                c={c}
              />
            </View>
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => <EarningCard payment={item} c={c} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <View style={{ paddingVertical: 60, alignItems: "center" }}>
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={s.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 14 }}>💸</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 8 }}
              >
                {t("workerEarnings.noEarnings")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center" }}
              >
                {t("workerEarnings.noEarningsSub")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ paddingVertical: 20, alignItems: "center" }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : payments.length > 0 ? (
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ textAlign: "center", paddingVertical: 16 }}
            >
              All {total} {t("workerEarnings.transactions").toLowerCase()}{" "}
              loaded
            </AppText>
          ) : null
        }
      />

      <CurrencyModal
        visible={showCurModal}
        currencies={currencies}
        selected={currency}
        onSelect={setCurrency}
        onClose={() => setShowCurModal(false)}
        c={c}
        modalBg={modalBg}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function timeAgo(date) {
  if (!date) return "";
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(date).getTime();
  const d = Math.floor(diff / 86_400_000);
  if (d < 1) return "Today";
  if (d < 7) return `${d}d ago`;
  if (d < 30) return `${Math.floor(d / 7)}w ago`;
  const m = Math.floor(d / 30);
  if (m < 12) return `${m}mo ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(m / 12)}y ago`;
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    weekday: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function fmtBudget(currency, budget) {
  if (!budget && budget !== 0) return "—";
  return `${currency ?? ""} ${Number(budget).toLocaleString()}`.trim();
}

function fmtDuration(value, unit, durType, durVal) {
  // Try estimatedValue + estimatedUnit first, fall back to durationType + durationValue
  const v = value ?? durVal;
  const u = (unit ?? durType ?? "").toUpperCase();
  if (!v) return null;
  const num = parseFloat(v);
  if (!num) return null;
  const meta = DURATION_TYPES[u] ?? { label: u, emoji: "⏱" };
  if (u === "HOURS" && num >= 8) {
    const days = num / 8;
    const dStr = Number.isInteger(days) ? days : days.toFixed(1);
    return `${meta.emoji} ${num} hours (≈${dStr} days)`;
  }
  return `${meta.emoji} ${num} ${meta.label.toLowerCase()}`;
}

}

function ApplySheet({ visible, job, onClose, onSuccess, c, modalBg }) {
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("");
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) {
      setMsg("");
      setError(null);
      setSending(false);
    }
  }, [visible]);

  const submit = async () => {
    setSending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await client.post(`/jobs/${job?.id}/apply`, { message: msg.trim() });
      onSuccess?.();
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to submit application.");
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <Pressable style={as.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            as.sheet,
            { backgroundColor: modalBg, borderTopColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <View style={[as.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, paddingHorizontal: 20 }}
          >
            {job?.category?.icon} {job?.category?.name}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="title"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{
              color: c.text,
              paddingHorizontal: 20,
              marginTop: 2,
              marginBottom: 4,
            }}
            numberOfLines={2}
          >
            {job?.title}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            weight="displayBlack"
            style={{
              color: c.orange,
              paddingHorizontal: 20,
              marginBottom: 16,
              fontSize: 20,
            }}
          >
            {fmtBudget(job?.currency, job?.budget)}
          </AppText>

          <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 20 }}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{
                color: c.textMuted,
                letterSpacing: 0.8,
                marginBottom: 8,
                fontSize: 11,
              }}
            >
              COVER MESSAGE (OPTIONAL)
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              value={msg}
              onChangeText={setMsg}
              placeholder="Introduce yourself and explain why you're a great fit..."
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              multiline
              numberOfLines={4}
              textAlignVertical="top"
              style={[
                as.textarea,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                },
              ]}
            />
            {error && (
              <View
                style={[
                  as.errBox,
                  {
                    borderColor: "#ef4444",

              >

                  size={16}

                  style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
                />
                <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#ef4444", flex: 1 }}>
                  {error}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
            <Pressable
              onPress={submit}
              disabled={sending}
              style={[
                as.btn,

export default function WorkerJobDetailScreen({ route, navigation }) {
  const { jobId } = route.params ?? {};
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();

  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {

      const res = await client.get(`/jobs/${jobId}`);
      const d = res.data.data;
      setJob(d.jobPost ?? d);

    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Could not load job");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [jobId]);

    load();
  }, [load]);

  // ── Derived ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const budgetMeta = BUDGET_TYPES[job?.budgetType] ?? BUDGET_TYPES.FIXED;
  const jobTypeMeta = JOB_TYPES[job?.jobType] ?? JOB_TYPES.FULL_TIME;
  const locTypeMeta =
    LOCATION_TYPES[job?.locationType] ?? LOCATION_TYPES.REMOTE;
  const statusMeta = STATUS_META[job?.status] ?? STATUS_META.OPEN;
  const duration = fmtDuration(
    job?.estimatedValue,
    job?.estimatedUnit,
    job?.durationType,
    job?.durationValue,
  );
  const budget = fmtBudget(job?.currency, job?.budget);
  const hirer = job?.hirer;
  const hirerProfile = hirer?.hirerProfile ?? {};
  const companyName =
    hirerProfile.companyName ??
    `${hirer?.firstName ?? ""} ${hirer?.lastName ?? ""}`.trim();
  const hirerLocation = [hirer?.city, hirer?.country]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(", ");
  const applied = job?._count?.applications ?? 0;

  // ── Loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!job) {
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          padding: 32,
        }}
      >
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 12 }}>🔍</AppText>
        <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
          Job not found
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <>
      <ScrollView
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 48, gap: 12 }}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => {
              setRefreshing(true);
              load();
            }}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {/* ── Back button ── */}
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          style={[
            s.backBtn,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="arrow-back"
            size={16}
            color={c.text}
            style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
          />
          <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            Back to Jobs
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {/* ═══ HERO CARD ═══ */}
        <View
          style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          {/* Category + status */}
          <View style={s.heroTop}>
            <View
              style={[
                s.catBadge,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
                  borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.4)",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {job.category?.icon} {job.category?.name}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <View
              style={[
                s.statusBadge,
                {
                  backgroundColor: `${statusMeta.color}22`,
                  borderColor: `${statusMeta.color}55`,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: statusMeta.color, fontSize: 11 }}
              >
                {statusMeta.label.toUpperCase()}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Title — displayBlack matches website exactly */}
          <AppText weight="displayBlack" style={[s.title, { color: c.text }]}>
            {job.title}
          </AppText>

          {/* Meta row: date + location + posted */}
          <View style={s.metaRow}>
            {job.scheduledAt && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.metaItem}>
                📅 {fmtDate(job.scheduledAt)}
              </AppText>
            )}
            {job.address && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.metaItem}>
                📍 {job.address}
              </AppText>
            )}
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.metaItem}>
              📤 Posted {timeAgo(job.createdAt)}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {/* Budget hero */}
          <View
            style={[
              s.budgetRow,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <AppText
                weight="displayBlack"
                style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 32, lineHeight: 38 }}
              >
                {budget}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>
                Budget
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <View
              style={[
                s.applicantPill,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, marginRight: 4 }}>👥</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text }}
              >
                {applied} applicant{applied !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* ═══ JOB DESCRIPTION ═══ */}
        <View
          style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          <SectionLabel text="JOB DESCRIPTION" c={c} />
          <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.text, lineHeight: 24 }}>
            {job.description}
          </AppText>
          {job.notes && (
            <View
              style={[
                s.notesBox,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16, marginRight: 8 }}>📝</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, flex: 1, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                {job.notes}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
          {Array.isArray(job.skills) && job.skills.length > 0 && (
            <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color: c.textMuted,
                  letterSpacing: 0.8,
                  fontSize: 11,
                  marginBottom: 8,
                }}
              >
                SKILLS
              </AppText>
              <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
                {job.skills.map((sk, i) => (
                  <View
                    key={i}
                    style={[
                      s.skillBadge,
                      { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.text }}>
                      {sk}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* ═══ DETAILS grid (3-col) ═══ */}
        <View
          style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          <SectionLabel text="DETAILS" c={c} />
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <DetailTile
              emoji="📁"
              label="CATEGORY"
              value={job.category?.name ?? "—"}
              c={c}
            />
            <DetailTile
              emoji="💰"
              label="BUDGET"
              value={budget}
              valueColor={c.orange}
              c={c}
            />
            <DetailTile
              emoji="📅"
              label="SCHEDULED"
              value={
                job.scheduledAt
                  ? new Date(job.scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                      day: "numeric",
                      month: "short",
                      year: "numeric",
                    })
                  : "—"
              }
              c={c}
            />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
            <DetailTile
              emoji="📍"
              label="LOCATION"
              value={job.address ?? locTypeMeta.label}
              c={c}
            />
            <DetailTile
              emoji="🏷"
              label="STATUS"
              value={statusMeta.label}
              valueColor={statusMeta.color}
              c={c}
            />
            {duration && (
              <DetailTile emoji="⏱" label="DURATION" value={duration} c={c} />
            )}
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* ═══ PAYMENT TYPE ═══ */}
        <View
          style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          <SectionLabel text="PAYMENT TYPE" c={c} />
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
            {Object.entries(BUDGET_TYPES).map(([key, meta]) => (
              <View key={key} style={{ width: "30.5%" }}>
                <OptionCard
                  emoji={meta.emoji}
                  label={meta.label}
                  sub={meta.sub}
                  selected={job.budgetType === key}
                  c={c}
                />
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* ═══ JOB TYPE + LOCATION TYPE ═══ */}
        <View
          style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          <SectionLabel text="JOB TYPE" c={c} />
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            {Object.entries(JOB_TYPES).map(([key, meta]) => (
              <View key={key} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    oc.card,
                    {
                      backgroundColor:
                        job.jobType === key
                          ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)"
                          : c.bgPanel,
                      borderColor: job.jobType === key ? c.orange : c.border,
                      paddingVertical: 14,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  {job.jobType === key && (
                    <View style={[oc.dot, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]} />
                  )}
                  <Ionicons
                    name={meta.icon}
                    size={22}
                    color={job.jobType === key ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                    style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}
                  />
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{
                      color: job.jobType === key ? c.orange : c.text,
                      textAlign: "center",
                    }}
                  >
                    {meta.label}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

          <SectionLabel text="LOCATION TYPE" c={c} />
          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
            {Object.entries(LOCATION_TYPES).map(([key, meta]) => (
              <View key={key} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    oc.card,
                    {
                      backgroundColor:
                        job.locationType === key
                          ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)"
                          : c.bgPanel,
                      borderColor:
                        job.locationType === key ? c.orange : c.border,
                      paddingVertical: 14,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  {job.locationType === key && (
                    <View style={[oc.dot, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]} />
                  )}
                  <Ionicons
                    name={meta.icon}
                    size={22}
                    color={job.locationType === key ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                    style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}
                  />
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{
                      color: job.locationType === key ? c.orange : c.text,
                      textAlign: "center",
                    }}
                  >
                    {meta.label}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* ═══ JOB DURATION ═══ */}
        {(job.estimatedValue || job.durationValue) && (
          <View
            style={[
              s.card,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <SectionLabel text="JOB DURATION" c={c} />
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
              {Object.entries(DURATION_TYPES).map(([key, meta]) => {
                const unit = (
                  job.estimatedUnit ??
                  job.durationType ??
                  ""
                ).toUpperCase();
                const sel = unit === key;
                return (
                  <View key={key} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        oc.card,
                        {
                          backgroundColor: sel
                            ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)"
                            : c.bgPanel,
                          borderColor: sel ? c.orange : c.border,
                          paddingVertical: 14,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {sel && (
                        <View style={[oc.dot, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]} />
                      )}
                      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 20, marginBottom: 4 }}>
                        {meta.emoji}
                      </AppText>
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{
                          color: sel ? c.orange : c.text,
                          textAlign: "center",
                        }}
                      >
                        {meta.label}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                );
              })}
            </View>
            {duration && (
              <View
                style={[
                  s.durationResult,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text }}
                >
                  {duration}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {/* ═══ APPLY FOR THIS JOB ═══ */}
        <View
          style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          <SectionLabel text="APPLY FOR THIS JOB" c={c} />
          {hasApplied ? (
            <View
              style={[
                s.appliedBox,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.10)",
                  borderColor: "#22c55e",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name="checkmark-circle"
                size={20}
                color="#22c55e"
                style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
              />
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}
              >
                You have already applied to this job
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : job.status !== "OPEN" ? (
            <View
              style={[
                s.appliedBox,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(59,130,246,0.10)",
                  borderColor: "#3b82f6",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name="information-circle"
                size={20}
                color="#3b82f6"
                style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
              />
              <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: "#3b82f6" }}>
                This job is no longer accepting applications
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowApply(true)}
              style={[s.applyBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#fff" }}
              >
                🚀 Apply Now
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* ═══ POSTED BY ═══ */}
        {hirer && (
          <View
            style={[
              s.card,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{
                color: c.orange,
                letterSpacing: 1.2,
                fontSize: 11,
                textAlign: "center",
                marginBottom: 16,
              }}
            >
              POSTED BY
            </AppText>

            {/* Centered hirer info */}
            <View style={s.postedByInner}>
              <View style={[s.hirerAvatarWrap, { borderColor: c.orange }]}>
                {hirer.avatar ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: hirer.avatar }}
                    style={s.hirerAvatarImg}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <View
                    style={[
                      s.hirerAvatarFallback,
                      { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="title"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 20 }}
                    >
                      {hirer.firstName?.[0]}
                      {hirer.lastName?.[0]}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                )}
              </View>
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 12, fontSize: 20 }}
              >
                {hirer.firstName} {hirer.lastName}
              </AppText>
              {companyName && (
                <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>
                  {companyName}
                </AppText>
              )}
              {hirerLocation && (
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                  📍 {hirerLocation}
                </AppText>
              )}
              {hirerProfile.avgRating > 0 && (
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 6 }}
                >
                  ★ {Number(hirerProfile.avgRating).toFixed(1)}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>

            <Pressable
              onPress={() =>
                navigation.navigate("HirerPublicProfile", { userId: hirer.id })
              }
              style={[
                s.viewProfileBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
                  borderColor: c.orange,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                View Profile →
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* ═══ QUICK FACTS ═══ */}
        <View
          style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          <SectionLabel text="QUICK FACTS" c={c} />
          {[
            { label: "Budget", value: budget, valueColor: c.orange },
            {
              label: "Category",
              value: job.category?.name ?? "—",
              valueColor: c.text,
            },
            {
              label: "Job Type",
              value: JOB_TYPES[job.jobType]?.label ?? job.jobType ?? "—",
              valueColor: c.text,
            },
            {
              label: "Location",
              value: LOCATION_TYPES[job.locationType]?.label ?? "—",
              valueColor: c.text,
            },
            { label: "Applicants", value: String(applied), valueColor: c.text },
          ].map((row, i, arr) => (
            <View
              key={row.label}
              style={[
                s.factRow,
                {
                  borderBottomColor: c.border,
                  borderBottomWidth:
                    i < arr.length - 1 ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth : 0,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
                {row.label}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: row.valueColor }}
              >
                {row.value}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ))}

          {/* Status badge row */}
          <View style={[s.factRow, { borderBottomWidth: 0 }]}>
            <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
              Status
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={[
                s.statusBadge,
                {
                  backgroundColor: `${statusMeta.color}22`,
                  borderColor: `${statusMeta.color}55`,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: statusMeta.color, fontSize: 11 }}
              >
                {statusMeta.label.toUpperCase()}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* ── Apply bottom sheet ── */}
      <ApplySheet
        visible={showApply}
        job={job}
        onClose={() => setShowApply(false)}
        onSuccess={() => {
          setHasApplied(true);
          toast.success("Application submitted! The hirer will be notified.");
        }}
        c={c}
        modalBg={modalBg}
      />
    </>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/worker/WorkerJobsScreen.js
// Mirrors: website /worker/browse-jobs
// APIs:
//   GET /categories                             — category dropdown
//   GET /jobs?status=OPEN&search=&categoryId=   — job listing
//   POST /jobs/:id/apply { message }            — apply to job

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Dimensions,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import Avatar from "../../../components/Avatar";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../../store/authStore";
import { categoriesApi } from "../../../api/categories";
import client from "../../../api/client";

const SCREEN_W = Dimensions.get("window").width;
const H_PAD = 12; // horizontal padding each side
const COL_GAP = 10; // gap between the 2 columns
const CARD_W = (SCREEN_W - H_PAD * 2 - COL_GAP) / 2;

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// timeAgo now takes t as a parameter since it's called inside components
function timeAgo(date, t) {
  if (!date) return "";
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(date).getTime();
  const d = Math.floor(diff / 86_400_000);
  if (d < 1) return t("workerJobs.job.today");
  if (d < 7) return t("workerJobs.job.daysAgo", { d });
  if (d < 30) return t("workerJobs.job.weeksAgo", { w: Math.floor(d / 7) });
  const m = Math.floor(d / 30);
  if (m < 12) return t("workerJobs.job.monthsAgo", { m });
  return t("workerJobs.job.yearsAgo", { y: Math.floor(m / 12) });
}

// Format estimated duration exactly as website: "80 hours (≈10 days)"
function formatDuration(value, unit, t) {
  if (!value || !unit) return null;
  const v = parseFloat(value);
  if (!v) return null;
  const u = String(unit).toLowerCase();
  if (u === "hours" || u === "hour") {
    if (v >= 8) {
      const days = v / 8;
      const daysStr = Number.isInteger(days) ? days : days.toFixed(1);
      return t("workerJobs.job.durationFormat", { value: v, days: daysStr });
    }
    return `${v} ${v !== 1 ? t("workerJobs.job.hoursPlural") : t("workerJobs.job.hours")}`;
  }
  if (u === "days" || u === "day")
    return `${v} ${v !== 1 ? t("workerJobs.job.daysPlural") : t("workerJobs.job.days")}`;
  if (u === "weeks" || u === "week")
    return `${v} ${v !== 1 ? t("workerJobs.job.weeksPlural") : t("workerJobs.job.weeks")}`;
  if (u === "months" || u === "month")
    return `${v} ${v !== 1 ? t("workerJobs.job.monthsPlural") : t("workerJobs.job.months")}`;
  return `${v} ${unit}`;
}

function fmtBudget(currency, budget) {
  if (!budget && budget !== 0) return "";
  return `${currency ?? ""} ${Number(budget).toLocaleString()}`.trim();
}

// ─── Category selector Modal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CategoryModal({
  visible,
  categories,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  onClose,
  c,
  modalBg,
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const filtered = [
    { id: null, slug: null, name: t("workerJobs.category.all"), icon: "🔍" },
    ...categories,
  ].filter((cat) => !q || cat.name.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <Pressable style={cm.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            cm.sheet,
            { backgroundColor: modalBg, borderTopColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <View style={[cm.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
          <AppText
            variant="title"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text, paddingHorizontal: 20, marginBottom: 12 }}
          >
            {t("workerJobs.category.select")}
          </AppText>

          {/* Search */}
          <View
            style={[
              cm.searchBox,
              {
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                marginHorizontal: 16,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="search"
              size={15}
              color={c.textMuted}
              style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
            />
            <TextInput
              value={q}
              onChangeText={setQ}
              placeholder={t("workerJobs.category.search")}
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              style={{ flex: 1, color: c.text, fontSize: 14 }}
            />
            {q ? (
              <Pressable onPress={() => setQ("")} hitSlop={8}>
                <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color={c.textMuted} />
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          <FlatList
            data={filtered}
            keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.slug ?? "all")}
            style={{ maxHeight: 380, marginTop: 8 }}
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
            renderItem={({ item }) => {
              const sel = item.slug === selected;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => {
                    onSelect(item.slug);
                    onClose();
                  }}
                  style={[
                    cm.option,
                    {
                      borderBottomColor: c.border,
                      backgroundColor: sel ? `${c.orange}15` : "transparent",
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{ fontSize: 18, lineHeight: 30, marginRight: 10 }}
                  >
                    {item.icon}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    style={{ flex: 1, color: sel ? c.orange : c.text }}
                  >
                    {item.name}
                  </AppText>
                  {sel && (
                    <Ionicons
                      name="checkmark-circle"
                      size={18}
                      color={c.orange}
                    />
                  )}
                </Pressable>
              );
            }}
          />
          <View style={{ height: 20 }} />
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ─── Apply bottom-sheet Modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ApplyModal({ visible, job, onClose, c, modalBg, toast }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("");
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) {
      setMsg("");
      setResult(null);
      setSending(false);
    }
  }, [visible]);

  const handleApply = async () => {
    setSending(true);
    try {
      await client.post(`/jobs/${job.id}/apply`, { message: msg.trim() });
      setResult({
        success: true,
        msg: t("workerJobs.apply.success"),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setResult({
        success: false,
        msg: err?.response?.data?.message ?? t("workerJobs.apply.failed"),
      });
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  if (!job) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <Pressable style={am.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            am.sheet,
            { backgroundColor: modalBg, borderTopColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <View style={[am.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

          {/* Job title */}
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, paddingHorizontal: 20, marginBottom: 2 }}
          >
            {job.category?.icon} {job.category?.name}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="title"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text, paddingHorizontal: 20, marginBottom: 4 }}
            numberOfLines={2}
          >
            {job.title}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ paddingHorizontal: 20, marginBottom: 16 }}
          >
            {fmtBudget(job.currency, job.budget)}
          </AppText>

          {result?.success ? (
            <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 20 }}>
              <View
                style={[
                  am.resultBox,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)",
                    borderColor: "#22c55e",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Ionicons
                  name="checkmark-circle"
                  size={20}
                  color="#22c55e"
                  style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
                />
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#22c55e", flex: 1 }}
                >
                  {result.msg}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <Pressable
                onPress={onClose}
                style={[
                  am.btn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    marginTop: 8,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text }}
                >
                  {t("workerJobs.apply.close")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 20 }}>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color: c.textMuted,
                  letterSpacing: 0.6,
                  marginBottom: 8,
                  fontSize: 11,
                }}
              >
                {t("workerJobs.apply.message")}
              </AppText>
              <TextInput
                value={msg}
                onChangeText={setMsg}
                placeholder={t("workerJobs.apply.messagePlaceholder")}
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                multiline
                numberOfLines={3}
                textAlignVertical="top"
                style={[
                  am.textarea,
                  {
                    color: c.text,
                    backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                  },
                ]}
              />
              {result && !result.success && (
                <View
                  style={[
                    am.resultBox,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)",
                      borderColor: "#ef4444",
                      marginBottom: 10,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <Ionicons
                    name="alert-circle"
                    size={16}
                    color="#ef4444"
                    style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
                  />
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    style={{ color: "#ef4444", flex: 1 }}
                  >
                    {result.msg}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleApply}
                disabled={sending}
                style={[
                  am.btn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.orange, opacity: sending ? 0.75 : 1 },
                ]}
              >
                {sending ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    {t("workerJobs.apply.button")}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable onPress={onClose} style={am.cancelBtn}>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {t("workerJobs.apply.cancel")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          )}
          <View style={{ height: 24 }} />
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

  backdrop: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)",
    justifyContent: "flex-end",
  },
  sheet: {
    borderTopLeftRadius: 24,
    borderTopRightRadius: 24,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    paddingTop: 12,
  },
  handle: {
    width: 40,
    height: 4,
    borderRadius: 2,
    alignSelf: "center",
    marginBottom: 16,
  },
  textarea: {
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: 12,
    padding: 12,
    fontSize: 14,
    minHeight: 80,
    marginBottom: 12,
  },
  btn: { paddingVertical: 15, borderRadius: 14, alignItems: "center" },
  cancelBtn: { paddingVertical: 12, alignItems: "center" },
  resultBox: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: 10,
    padding: 12,
    marginBottom: 12,
  },
});

// ─── Hirer mini-card (inside job card) ───────────────────────────────────────
function HirerMiniCard({ hirer, c }) {
  const profile = hirer?.hirerProfile ?? {};
  const companyName =
    profile.companyName ??
    `${hirer?.firstName ?? ""} ${hirer?.lastName ?? ""}`.trim();
  const location = [hirer?.city, hirer?.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
  const rating = profile.avgRating ?? 0;

  return (
    <View
      style={[mc.wrap, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      <Avatar
        uri={hirer?.avatar}
        firstName={hirer?.firstName}
        lastName={hirer?.lastName}
        size={36}
      />
      <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 8 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text }}
          numberOfLines={1}
        >
          {companyName}
        </AppText>
        {location ? (
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
            📍 {location}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      {rating > 0 && (
        <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
          ★ {Number(rating).toFixed(1)}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const mc = StyleSheet.create({
  wrap: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    padding: 10,
    marginVertical: 10,
  },
});

// ─── Job card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function JobCard({ job, onApply, onHirerProfile, onViewDetail, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const duration = formatDuration(
    job.estimatedValue ?? job.estValue ?? job.defaultEstValue,
    job.estimatedUnit ?? job.estUnit ?? job.defaultEstUnit,
    t,
  );
  const applied = job._count?.applications ?? 0;
  const budgetStr = fmtBudget(job.currency, job.budget);

  return (
    <View
      style={[jc.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* Category badge + time ago */}
      <View style={jc.topRow}>
        <View
          style={[
            jc.catBadge,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.4)" },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 11 }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {job.category?.icon} {job.category?.name}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          tone="dim"
          style={{ fontSize: 11, flexShrink: 0, marginLeft: 4 }}
        >
          {timeAgo(job.createdAt, t)}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Job title — displayBlack weight, exactly as website */}
      <AppText
        weight="displayBlack"
        style={[jc.title, { color: c.text }]}
        numberOfLines={2}
      >
        {job.title}
      </AppText>

      {/* Description */}
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={jc.desc} numberOfLines={3}>
        {job.description}
      </AppText>

      {/* Hirer mini-card */}
      {job.hirer && <HirerMiniCard hirer={job.hirer} c={c} />}

      {/* Budget row: large orange displayBlack + duration badge + applied */}
      <View style={jc.budgetRow}>
        {/* Budget — displayBlack weight, orange, large — wraps naturally on narrow cards */}
        <AppText
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={[jc.budget, { color: c.orange }]}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {budgetStr}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Duration + applied count row */}
      <View style={jc.metaRow}>
        {duration && (
          <View
            style={[
              jc.durationBadge,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              style={{ color: c.textMuted, fontSize: 11 }}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              ⏱ {duration}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          tone="dim"
          style={{ fontSize: 11, flexShrink: 0 }}
        >
          {t("workerJobs.job.applied", { count: applied })}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Buttons */}
      <View style={jc.btnRow}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => onViewDetail(job.id)}
          style={[jc.applyBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
        >
          <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 13 }}>
            {t("workerJobs.job.viewApply")}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => onHirerProfile(job.hirer?.id)}
          style={[
            jc.hirerBtn,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text, fontSize: 13 }}>
            {t("workerJobs.job.hirerProfile")}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerJobsScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;
  const modalBg = th.mode === "dark" ? "#111118" : "#ffffff";

  // Data
  const [jobs, setJobs] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  // Filters
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState("");
  const [committed, setCommitted] = useState(""); // committed search (on Search press)
  const [catSlug, setCatSlug] = useState(null); // backend filters by slug not id
  const [showCatModal, setShowCatModal] = useState(false);

  // Apply modal
  const [applyJob, setApplyJob] = useState(null);
  const [showApply, setShowApply] = useState(false);

  // ── Load categories ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    client
      .get("/categories")
      .then((res) => {
        const d = res.data.data ?? res.data;
        setCategories(d.categories ?? d ?? []);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  // ── Load jobs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadJobs = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const params = { limit: 20, page: 1 };
      // backend param is "q" not "search"
      if (committed) params.q = committed;
      // backend param is "category" (slug) not "categoryId"
      if (catSlug) params.category = catSlug;

      const res = await client.get("/jobs", { params });
      const d = res.data.data ?? res.data;
      // backend returns "jobPosts" not "jobs"
      setJobs(d.jobPosts ?? d.jobs ?? []);
      setTotal(d.total ?? d.jobPosts?.length ?? 0);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(t("workerJobs.toast.loadError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [committed, catSlug]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadJobs();
  }, [loadJobs]);

  // ── Derived ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const selectedCat = categories.find((c) => c.slug === catSlug);
  const catLabel = selectedCat
    ? `${selectedCat.icon} ${selectedCat.name}`
    : t("workerJobs.category.all");

  // Group jobs into rows of 2 for the 2-column grid
  const rows = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < jobs.length; i += 2) {
    rows.push([jobs[i], jobs[i + 1]].filter(Boolean));
  }

  // ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSearch = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setCommitted(searchText.trim());
  };

  const handleApplyPress = (job) => {
    setApplyJob(job);
    setShowApply(true);
  };

  const handleViewDetail = (jobId) => {
    navigation.navigate("WorkerJobDetail", { jobId });
  };

  const handleHirerProfile = (hirerId) => {
    if (!hirerId) return;
    navigation.navigate("HirerPublicProfile", { userId: hirerId });
  };

  // ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <ScrollView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: H_PAD, paddingBottom: 40 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            loadJobs();
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
    >
      {/* ── Search + Category row ── */}
      <View style={s.filterRow}>
        {/* Search input */}
        <View
          style={[
            s.searchBox,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border, flex: 1 },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="search-outline"
            size={16}
            color={c.textMuted}
            style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
          />
          <TextInput
            value={searchText}
            onChangeText={setSearchText}
            onSubmitEditing={handleSearch}
            returnKeyType="search"
            placeholder={t("workerJobs.search.placeholder")}
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            style={{ flex: 1, color: c.text, fontSize: 14 }}
          />
          {searchText ? (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => {
                setSearchText("");
                setCommitted("");
              }}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color={c.textMuted} />
            </Pressable>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Category dropdown */}
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setShowCatModal(true)}
          style={[
            s.catDropdown,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1, fontSize: 13 }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {catLabel}
          </AppText>
          <Ionicons
            name="chevron-down"
            size={14}
            color={c.textMuted}
            style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}
          />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ── Search button ── */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={handleSearch}
        style={[s.searchBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
      >
        <AppText weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 15 }}>
          {t("workerJobs.search.button")}
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* ── Result count ── */}
      {!loading && (
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          tone="dim"
          style={{ marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 14 }}
        >
          {t("workerJobs.search.resultsFound", {
            count: total,
            s: total !== 1 ? "s" : "",
          })}
        </AppText>
      )}

      {/* ── Loading ── */}
      {loading && (
        <View style={s.loadingWrap}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Empty ── */}
      {!loading && jobs.length === 0 && (
        <View style={s.empty}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 12 }}>📋</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="title"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 6 }}
          >
            {t("workerJobs.empty.title")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
            {t("workerJobs.empty.subtitle")}
          </AppText>
          {(committed || catSlug) && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => {
                setSearchText("");
                setCommitted("");
                setCatSlug(null);
              }}
              style={[s.clearBtn, { borderColor: c.border, marginTop: 16 }]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text }}
              >
                {t("workerJobs.empty.clearFilters")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── 2-column job grid ── */}
      {!loading &&
        rows.map((row, rowIdx) => (
          <View key={rowIdx} style={s.row}>
            {row.map((job) => (
              <JobCard
                key={job.id}
                job={job}
                onApply={handleApplyPress}
                onHirerProfile={handleHirerProfile}
                onViewDetail={handleViewDetail}
                c={c}
              />
            ))}
            {/* If last row has 1 item, add spacer so it doesn't stretch */}
            {row.length === 1 && <View style={{ width: CARD_W }} />}
          </View>
        ))}

      {/* ── Category modal ── */}
      <CategoryModal
        visible={showCatModal}
        categories={categories}
        selected={catSlug}
        onSelect={(slug) => {
          setCatSlug(slug);
          setLoading(true);
        }}
        onClose={() => setShowCatModal(false)}
        c={c}
        modalBg={modalBg}
      />

      {/* ── Apply modal ── */}
      <ApplyModal
        visible={showApply}
        job={applyJob}
        onClose={() => setShowApply(false)}
        c={c}
        modalBg={modalBg}
        toast={toast}
      />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}
