// src/screens/main/worker/WorkerPortfolioScreen.js
// Mirrors: website /worker/portfolio
// APIs:
//   GET  /workers/:userId       — load portfolio + videoIntroUrl
//   POST /workers/portfolio     — FormData: image, title, description
//   DELETE /workers/portfolio/:id
//   POST /workers/video-intro   — FormData: file
//   DELETE /workers/video-intro

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Dimensions,
  Image,
  Linking,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import * as ImagePicker from "expo-image-picker";

import AppScreen from "../../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../../api/client";

const SCREEN_W = Dimensions.get("window").width;
const CARD_W = (SCREEN_W - 48 - 10) / 2; // 2-col grid, 16px padding, 10px gap

// ─── Full-screen image viewer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ImageViewer({ uri, onClose }) {
  return (
    <Modal
      visible={!!uri}
      transparent
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <View style={iv.bg}>
        <Pressable style={iv.closeBtn} onPress={onClose} hitSlop={12}>
          <Ionicons name="close" size={26} color="#fff" />
        </Pressable>
        {uri && <Image source={{ uri }} style={iv.img} resizeMode="contain" />}
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const iv = StyleSheet.create({
  bg: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.97)",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  closeBtn: {
    position: "absolute",
    top: 52,
    right: 20,
    zIndex: 10,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",
    borderRadius: 20,
    padding: 8,
  },
  img: { width: SCREEN_W, height: SCREEN_W * 1.2, maxHeight: "85%" },
});

// ─── Video Intro card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function VideoIntroCard({ videoUrl, onReload, c, toast }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const pickAndUpload = async () => {
    const { status } = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (status !== "granted") {
      toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.permissionRequired"));
      return;
    }
    const r = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Videos,
      quality: 1,
    });
    if (r.canceled || !r.assets?.[0]) return;
    const a = r.assets[0];
    if (a.fileSize && a.fileSize > 100 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.video.tooLarge"));
      return;
    }
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", {
      uri: a.uri,
      name: a.fileName ?? "intro.mp4",
      type: a.mimeType ?? "video/mp4",
    });
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      await client.post("/workers/video-intro", formData, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });
      toast.success(t("workerPortfolio.video.uploadSuccess"));
      onReload();
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.video.uploadFailed"));
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      t("workerPortfolio.video.removeTitle"),
      t("workerPortfolio.video.removeMessage"),
      [
        { text: t("common.cancel"), style: "cancel" },
        {
          text: t("common.remove"),
          style: "destructive",
          onPress: async () => {
            try {
              await client.delete("/workers/video-intro");
              toast.success(t("workerPortfolio.video.removeSuccess"));
              onReload();
            } catch {
              toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.video.removeFailed"));
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  };

  return (
    <View
      style={[p.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      <AppText
        variant="title"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 4 }}
      >
        🎬 {t("workerPortfolio.video.title")}
      </AppText>
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        {t("workerPortfolio.video.subtitle")}
      </AppText>

      {videoUrl ? (
        <View>
          {/* Video preview — tap to open in device player */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => Linking.openURL(videoUrl)}
            style={[
              p.videoPreview,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View style={p.playOverlay}>
              <View style={p.playCircle}>
                <Ionicons
                  name="play"
                  size={32}
                  color="#fff"
                  style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}
                />
              </View>
            </View>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              {t("workerPortfolio.video.tapToPlay")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>

          <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 12, marginTop: 12 }}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={pickAndUpload}
              disabled={uploading}
              style={[
                p.actionBtn,
                { borderColor: c.orange, opacity: uploading ? 0.7 : 1 },
              ]}
            >
              {uploading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.orange} />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.orange }}
                >
                  {t("workerPortfolio.video.replace")}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleDelete}
              style={[p.actionBtn, { borderColor: "#ef4444" }]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
              >
                {t("workerPortfolio.video.remove")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <Pressable
          onPress={pickAndUpload}
          disabled={uploading}
          style={[
            p.dropzone,
            { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgPanel },
          ]}
        >
          {uploading ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
          ) : (
            <>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 10 }}>🎥</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 4 }}
              >
                {t("workerPortfolio.video.upload")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t("workerPortfolio.video.requirements")}
              </AppText>
            </>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerPortfolioScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [worker, setWorker] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState(null);
  const [fullImg, setFullImg] = useState(null);

  // Form state
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState(null); // { uri, name, type }

  // ── Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    try {
      const res = await client.get(`/workers/${user.id}`);
      setWorker(res.data.data?.worker ?? null);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.error.loadFailed"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const portfolio = worker?.portfolio ?? [];
  const videoUrl = worker?.videoIntroUrl ?? null;

  // ── Pick image ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const pickImage = async () => {
    const { status } = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (status !== "granted") {
      toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.permissionRequired"));
      return;
    }
    const r = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
      quality: 0.85,
      allowsEditing: true,
    });
    if (!r.canceled && r.assets?.[0]) {
      const a = r.assets[0];
      setImageFile({
        uri: a.uri,
        name: a.fileName ?? "photo.jpg",
        type: a.mimeType ?? "image/jpeg",
      });
    }
  };

  // ── Upload portfolio item ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleUpload = async () => {
    if (!title.trim()) {
      toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.error.titleRequired"));
      return;
    }
    if (!imageFile) {
      toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.error.imageRequired"));
      return;
    }
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("image", imageFile);
    formData.append("title", title.trim());
    if (description.trim()) formData.append("description", description.trim());
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await client.post("/workers/portfolio", formData, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });
      setTitle("");
      setDescription("");
      setImageFile(null);
      toast.success(t("workerPortfolio.add.success"));
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(
        err?.response?.data?.message ?? t("workerPortfolio.add.failed"),
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // ── Delete portfolio item ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleDelete = (id) => {
    Alert.alert(
      t("workerPortfolio.remove.title"),
      t("workerPortfolio.remove.message"),
      [
        { text: t("common.cancel"), style: "cancel" },
        {
          text: t("common.delete"),
          style: "destructive",
          onPress: async () => {
            setDeletingId(id);
            try {
              await client.delete(`/workers/portfolio/${id}`);
              toast.success(t("workerPortfolio.remove.success"));
              load();
            } catch {
              toast.error(t("workerPortfolio.remove.failed"));
            } finally {
              setDeletingId(null);
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AppScreen
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            load();
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40, gap: 16 }}
    >
      {/* ── Video Intro ── */}
      <VideoIntroCard videoUrl={videoUrl} onReload={load} c={c} toast={toast} />

      {/* ── Add Portfolio Item ── */}
      <View
        style={[p.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="title"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 16 }}
        >
          {t("workerPortfolio.add.title")}
        </AppText>

        <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={p.label}>
          {t("workerPortfolio.add.titleLabel")} *
        </AppText>
        <TextInput
          value={title}
          onChangeText={setTitle}
          placeholder={t("workerPortfolio.add.titlePlaceholder")}
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[
            p.input,
            {
              color: c.text,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              borderColor: c.border,
            },
          ]}
        />

        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          style={[p.label, { marginTop: 14 }]}
        >
          {t("workerPortfolio.add.photo")} *
        </AppText>
        <Pressable
          onPress={pickImage}
          style={[
            p.imagePicker,
            {
              borderColor: imageFile ? c.orange : c.border,
              backgroundColor: imageFile ? `${c.orange}08` : c.bgInput,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {imageFile ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}>
              <Image source={{ uri: imageFile.uri }} style={p.imagePreview} />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {t("workerPortfolio.add.changePhoto")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
              <Ionicons name="image-outline" size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text }}
              >
                {t("workerPortfolio.add.selectPhoto")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t("workerPortfolio.add.photoRequirements")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </Pressable>

        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          style={[p.label, { marginTop: 14 }]}
        >
          {t("workerPortfolio.add.description")}
        </AppText>
        <TextInput
          value={description}
          onChangeText={setDescription}
          placeholder={t("workerPortfolio.add.descriptionPlaceholder")}
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[
            p.input,
            {
              color: c.text,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              borderColor: c.border,
            },
          ]}
        />

        <Pressable
          onPress={handleUpload}
          disabled={saving}
          style={[
            p.addBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.orange,
              opacity: saving ? 0.75 : 1,
              marginTop: 16,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {saving ? (
            <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
          ) : (
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
              + {t("workerPortfolio.add.button")}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ── Portfolio Grid ── */}
      <View
        style={[p.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="title"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 16 }}
        >
          {t("workerPortfolio.list.title")}{" "}
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
            ({portfolio.length})
          </AppText>
        </AppText>

        {portfolio.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={p.empty}>
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 10 }}>🖼️</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text, marginBottom: 4 }}
            >
              {t("workerPortfolio.list.emptyTitle")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
              {t("workerPortfolio.list.emptySub")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={p.grid}>
            {portfolio.map((item) => (
              <View
                key={item.id}
                style={[
                  p.gridCard,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                {/* Tap image → fullscreen */}
                <Pressable onPress={() => setFullImg(item.imageUrl)}>
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: item.imageUrl }}
                    style={p.gridImg}
                    resizeMode="cover"
                  />
                </Pressable>
                <View style={p.gridBody}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text }}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {item.title}
                  </AppText>
                  {item.description ? (
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      tone="dim"
                      numberOfLines={2}
                      style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
                    >
                      {item.description}
                    </AppText>
                  ) : null}
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
                    disabled={deletingId === item.id}
                    style={[p.removeBtn, { borderColor: "#ef4444" }]}
                  >
                    {deletingId === item.id ? (
                      <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#ef4444" />
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Ionicons
                          name="trash-outline"
                          size={14}
                          color="#ef4444"
                          style={{ marginRight: 4 }}
                        />
                        <AppText
                          variant="small"
                          weight="semibold"
                          style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
                        >
                          {t("workerPortfolio.list.remove")}
                        </AppText>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* ── Full-screen image viewer ── */}
      <ImageViewer uri={fullImg} onClose={() => setFullImg(null)} />
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// Mirrors: website /worker/profile (UserProfile component)
// API: GET /users/:id  →  data.data.user (includes workerProfile)
//      GET /reviews/worker/:id  →  data.data.reviews

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Linking,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";

import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import Avatar from "../../../components/Avatar";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../../store/authStore";
import client from "../../../api/client";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// These are now functions that accept t as a parameter
function getTabs(t) {
  return [
    t("workerProfile.tabs.about"),
    t("workerProfile.tabs.portfolio"),
    t("workerProfile.tabs.certifications"),
    t("workerProfile.tabs.reviews"),
  ];
}

function getDayMap(t) {
  return {
    MONDAY: t("workerProfile.days.mon"),
    TUESDAY: t("workerProfile.days.tue"),
    WEDNESDAY: t("workerProfile.days.wed"),
    THURSDAY: t("workerProfile.days.thu"),
    FRIDAY: t("workerProfile.days.fri"),
    SATURDAY: t("workerProfile.days.sat"),
    SUNDAY: t("workerProfile.days.sun"),
  };
}

function getDays(t) {
  return [
    t("workerProfile.days.mon"),
    t("workerProfile.days.tue"),
    t("workerProfile.days.wed"),
    t("workerProfile.days.thu"),
    t("workerProfile.days.fri"),
    t("workerProfile.days.sat"),
    t("workerProfile.days.sun"),
  ];
}

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function timeAgo(date, t) {
  if (!date) return t("workerProfile.time.never");
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(date).getTime();
  const m = Math.floor(diff / 60_000);
  if (m < 1) return t("workerProfile.time.justNow");
  if (m < 60) return t("workerProfile.time.minutesAgo", { m });
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
  if (h < 24) return t("workerProfile.time.hoursAgo", { h });
  const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
  if (d < 30) return t("workerProfile.time.daysAgo", { d });
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function getActiveDays(availability, t) {
  if (!availability || !Array.isArray(availability)) return new Set();
  const DAY_MAP = getDayMap(t);
  return new Set(
    availability
      .filter((a) => a.isAvailable)
      .map((a) => DAY_MAP[a.dayOfWeek] ?? a.dayOfWeek),
  );
}

// ─── Stars ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Stars({ rating = 0, size = 14 }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((s) => (
        <AppText
          key={s}
          style={{
            fontSize: size,
            color: s <= Math.round(rating) ? "#f59e0b" : "#374151",
          }}
        >
          ★
        </AppText>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Stat row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatRow({ icon, value, label, color, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={[sr.row, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
      <Ionicons
        name={icon}
        size={16}
        color={color ?? c.orange}
        style={{ marginRight: 12, width: 20 }}
      />
      <AppText
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: c.text, fontSize: 16, marginRight: 6 }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}
const sr = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingVertical: 14,
    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
  },
});

// ─── Info row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function InfoRow({ icon, value, onPress, c }) {
  const El = onPress ? Pressable : View;
  return (
    <El onPress={onPress} style={ir.row}>
      <Ionicons
        name={icon}
        size={15}
        color={c.textMuted}
        style={{ marginRight: 12, width: 20 }}
      />
      <AppText
        variant="body"
        style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1 }}
        numberOfLines={1}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
    </El>
  );
}
const ir = StyleSheet.create({
  row: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", paddingVertical: 8 },
});

// ─── Portfolio lightbox ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Lightbox({ item, onClose, c }) {
  if (!item) return null;
  return (
    <Modal transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <Pressable style={lb.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[lb.box, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard }]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <Pressable onPress={onClose} style={lb.close}>
            <AppText style={{ color: c.text, fontSize: 18 }}>✕</AppText>
          </Pressable>
          {item.imageUrl && (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: item.imageUrl }}
              style={lb.img}
              resizeMode="contain"
            />
          )}
          <View style={{ padding: 16 }}>
            <AppText
              variant="title"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {item.title}
            </AppText>
            {item.description && (
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ marginTop: 6, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                {item.description}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}
const lb = StyleSheet.create({
  backdrop: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)",
    justifyContent: "center",
    padding: 24,
  },
  box: { borderRadius: 20, overflow: "hidden" },
  close: { position: "absolute", top: 12, right: 16, zIndex: 10, padding: 4 },
  img: { width: "100%", height: 280 },
});

// ─── ABOUT TAB ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function AboutTab({ user, wp, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const DAYS = getDays(t);
  const activeDays = getActiveDays(wp?.availability, t);

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {/* Bio */}
      <View
        style={[tab.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          style={[tab.sectionLabel, { color: c.textMuted }]}
        >
          {t("workerProfile.section.about")}
        </AppText>
        {user.bio ? (
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ color: c.text, lineHeight: 24, marginTop: 8 }}
          >
            {user.bio}
          </AppText>
        ) : (
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
            {t("workerProfile.empty.noBio")}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Availability */}
      {wp?.availability && (
        <View
          style={[
            tab.card,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={[tab.sectionLabel, { color: c.textMuted }]}
          >
            {t("workerProfile.section.availability")}
          </AppText>
          <View style={tab.daysRow}>
            {DAYS.map((d) => {
              const active = activeDays.has(d);
              return (
                <View
                  key={d}
                  style={[
                    tab.dayPill,
                    {
                      borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      backgroundColor: active
                        ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)"
                        : c.bgPanel,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted }}
                  >
                    {d}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Verification badges */}
      <View style={tab.badgeRow}>
        <View
          style={[
            tab.badge,
            {
              borderColor: user.isEmailVerified ? "#22c55e" : c.border,
              backgroundColor: user.isEmailVerified
                ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)"
                : c.bgPanel,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="checkmark-circle"
            size={13}
            color={user.isEmailVerified ? "#22c55e" : c.textMuted}
          />
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{
              color: user.isEmailVerified ? "#22c55e" : c.textMuted,
              marginLeft: 5,
            }}
          >
            {user.isEmailVerified
              ? t("workerProfile.badge.emailVerified")
              : t("workerProfile.badge.emailUnverified")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        {wp?.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED" && (
          <View
            style={[
              tab.badge,
              {
                borderColor: c.orange,
                backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark" size={13} color={c.orange} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange, marginLeft: 5 }}
            >
              {t("workerProfile.badge.idVerified")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── PORTFOLIO TAB ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function PortfolioTab({ items, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [lightbox, setLightbox] = useState(null);

  if (!items?.length) {
    return (
      <View style={tab.empty}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 12 }}>🖼️</AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
          {t("workerProfile.empty.noPortfolio")}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // Chunk into pairs for 2-column grid
  const rows = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 2) {
    rows.push([items[i], items[i + 1]].filter(Boolean));
  }

  return (
    <>
      <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
        {rows.map((row, ri) => (
          <View key={ri} style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 10 }}>
            {row.map((item) => (
              <Pressable
                key={item.id}
                onPress={() => setLightbox(item)}
                style={[
                  pt.card,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border, flex: 1 },
                ]}
              >
                {item.imageUrl ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: item.imageUrl }}
                    style={pt.img}
                    resizeMode="cover"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <View
                    style={[pt.placeholder, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel }]}
                  >
                    <Ionicons
                      name="image-outline"
                      size={28}
                      color={c.textMuted}
                    />
                  </View>
                )}
                {item.title && (
                  <View style={[pt.footer, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel }]}>
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: c.text }}
                      numberOfLines={1}
                    >
                      {item.title}
                    </AppText>
                    {item.description && (
                      <AppText
                        style={{ fontSize: 11, color: c.textMuted }}
                        numberOfLines={1}
                      >
                        {item.description}
                      </AppText>
                    )}
                  </View>
                )}
              </Pressable>
            ))}
            {row.length === 1 && <View style={{ flex: 1 }} />}
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>
      <Lightbox item={lightbox} onClose={() => setLightbox(null)} c={c} />
    </>
  );
}

const pt = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    borderRadius: 14,
    borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    overflow: "hidden",
  },
  img: { width: "100%", height: 140 },
  placeholder: {
    width: "100%",
    height: 140,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  footer: { padding: 8 },
});

// ─── CERTIFICATIONS TAB ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CertificationsTab({ items, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  if (!items?.length) {
    return (
      <View style={tab.empty}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 12 }}>🏆</AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
          {t("workerProfile.empty.noCertifications")}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
      {items.map((cert) => (
        <View
          key={cert.id}
          style={[ct.row, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          <View style={[ct.icon, { backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)" }]}>
            <Ionicons name="ribbon" size={22} color={c.orange} />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
              {cert.name}
            </AppText>
            {cert.issuer && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t("workerProfile.cert.issuedBy", { issuer: cert.issuer })}
              </AppText>
            )}
            {cert.issuedAt && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {new Date(cert.issuedAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                  month: "short",
                  year: "numeric",
                })}
                {cert.expiryDate &&
                  ` – ${new Date(cert.expiryDate).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { month: "short", year: "numeric" })}`}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          {cert.isVerified && (
            <View
              style={[
                ct.verBadge,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)",
                  borderColor: "#22c55e",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={13} color="#22c55e" />
              <AppText
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: "#22c55e",
                  marginLeft: 4,
                  fontWeight: "600",
                }}
              >
                {t("workerProfile.badge.verified")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── REVIEWS TAB ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReviewsTab({ reviews, total, loading, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  if (loading)
    return (
      <View style={{ paddingVertical: 40, alignItems: "center" }}>
        <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );

  if (!reviews.length)
    return (
      <View style={tab.empty}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 40, marginBottom: 12 }}>⭐</AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
          {t("workerProfile.empty.noReviews")}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );

  const avg = reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length;
  const reviewLabel =
    total === 1
      ? t("workerProfile.reviews.reviewCount")
      : t("workerProfile.reviews.reviewCountPlural");

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {/* Summary */}
      <View
        style={[
          rv.summary,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={{ color: c.text, fontSize: 40, marginRight: 12 }}
        >
          {avg.toFixed(1)}
        </AppText>
        <View>
          <Stars rating={avg} size={18} />
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
            {total} {reviewLabel}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* List */}
      {reviews.map((r) => (
        <View
          key={r.id}
          style={[
            rv.card,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={rv.top}>
            <Avatar
              uri={r.giver?.avatar}
              firstName={r.giver?.firstName}
              lastName={r.giver?.lastName}
              size={38}
            />
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text }}
              >
                {r.giver?.firstName} {r.giver?.lastName}
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {" "}
                  ·{" "}
                  {r.giver?.role === "HIRER"
                    ? t("workerProfile.role.hirer")
                    : t("workerProfile.role.worker")}
                </AppText>
              </AppText>
              {r.booking?.title && (
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {r.booking.category?.icon} {r.booking.title}
                </AppText>
              )}
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                  day: "numeric",
                  month: "short",
                  year: "numeric",
                })}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <View style={{ alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
              <Stars rating={r.rating} size={13} />
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>
                {r.rating}
                {t("workerProfile.reviews.ratingOutOf")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
          {r.comment && (
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              style={{
                color: c.textMuted,
                fontStyle: "italic",
                marginTop: 10,
                lineHeight: 22,
              }}
            >
              "{r.comment}"
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

const rv = StyleSheet.create({
  summary: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    borderRadius: 14,
    borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    padding: 16,
  },
  card: {
    borderRadius: 14,
    borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    padding: 14,
  },
  top: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "flex-start" },
});

  sectionLabel: { letterSpacing: 0.8, fontSize: 11 },

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerProfileScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user: me } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  const userId = me?.id;

  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(t("workerProfile.tabs.about"));
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [reviewsTotal, setReviewsTotal] = useState(0);
  const [reviewsLoading, setReviewsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Get TABS inside component with t()
  const TABS = getTabs(t);

  // ── Load profile ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!userId) return;
    try {
      const res = await client.get(`/users/${userId}`);
      setUser(res.data.data?.user ?? res.data.data);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("workerProfile.error.loadFailed"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [userId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfile();
  }, [loadProfile]);

  // ── Load reviews when tab opens ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab !== t("workerProfile.tabs.reviews") || !userId) return;
    setReviewsLoading(true);
    client
      .get(`/reviews/worker/${userId}`, { params: { limit: 20 } })
      .then((res) => {
        setReviews(res.data.data?.reviews ?? []);
        setReviewsTotal(res.data.data?.total ?? 0);
      })
      .catch(() => setReviews([]))
      .finally(() => setReviewsLoading(false));
  }, [activeTab, userId]);

  // ── Loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading)
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
        }}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
      </View>
    );

  if (!user)
    return (
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          backgroundColor: c.bg,
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          padding: 32,
        }}
      >
        <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
          {t("workerProfile.error.notFound")}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    );

  const wp = user.workerProfile ?? {};
  const portfolio = wp.portfolio ?? [];
  const certs = wp.certifications ?? [];
  const categories = wp.categories ?? [];
  const location = [user.city, user.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

  return (
    <ScrollView
      style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: c.bg }}
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 48 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            loadProfile();
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
    >
      {/* ═══ HERO CARD ═══ */}
      <View
        style={[
          s.heroCard,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        {/* Banner strip */}
        <View
          style={[s.heroBanner, { backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.2)" }]}
        />

        {/* Avatar */}
        <View style={s.avatarWrap}>
          <View style={[s.avatarRing, { borderColor: c.orange }]}>
            {user.avatar ? (
              <Image source={{ uri: user.avatar }} style={s.avatarImg} />
            ) : (
              <View style={[s.avatarFallback, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel }]}>
                <AppText
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 26 }}
                >
                  {user.firstName?.[0]}
                  {user.lastName?.[0]}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Identity */}
        <AppText weight="displayBlack" style={[s.heroName, { color: c.text }]}>
          {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
        </AppText>

        {/* Role badge */}
        <View
          style={[
            s.rolePill,
            { backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)", borderColor: c.orange },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="construct-outline"
            size={12}
            color={c.orange}
            style={{ marginRight: 5 }}
          />
          <AppText
            variant="small"

// src/screens/main/worker/WorkerReviewsScreen.js
// Worker's "Reviews Received" screen.
// Mirrors: existing hirer ReviewsReceivedScreen.js exactly.
// API: GET /reviews/my/received  →  { reviews, avgRating, totalReviews, distribution, pages }

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTheme } from "../../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import AppText from "../../../components/AppText";
import Avatar from "../../../components/Avatar";
import { getMyReceivedReviews } from "../../../api/reviews";

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

// ─── Stars ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StarRow({ rating, size = 16, color }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <AppText
          key={i}
          style={{
            fontSize: size,
            color: i <= Math.round(rating) ? color : "#4b5563",
          }}
        >
          ★
        </AppText>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Rating summary card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function RatingSummaryCard({ avgRating, totalReviews, distribution, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const maxCount = Math.max(
    ...[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((s) => distribution[s] ?? 0),
    1,
  );

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        s.summaryCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Big number + stars */}
      <View style={s.summaryTop}>
        <AppText
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={{ fontSize: 64, lineHeight: 72, color: c.orange }}
        >
          {Number(avgRating).toFixed(1)}
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}>
          <StarRow rating={avgRating} size={22} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
            {t("workerReviews.reviewCount", {
              count: totalReviews,
              s: totalReviews !== 1 ? "s" : "",
            })}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Distribution bars */}
      <View style={[s.distBlock, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((star) => {
          const count = distribution[star] ?? 0;
          const pct = maxCount > 0 ? count / maxCount : 0;
          return (
            <View key={star} style={s.distRow}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.distLabel}>
                {star} ★
              </AppText>
              <View style={[s.barTrack, { backgroundColor: c.bgInput }]}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    s.barFill,
                    { backgroundColor: c.orange, width: `${pct * 100}%` },
                  ]}
                />
              </View>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.distCount}>
                {count}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Review card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReviewCard({ review, c }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const giver = review.giver ?? {};
  const booking = review.booking ?? null;
  const location = [giver.city, giver.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

  const roleLabel =
    giver.role === "WORKER"
      ? t("workerReviews.role.worker")
      : t("workerReviews.role.hirer");

  return (
    <View
      style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* Author row */}
      <View style={s.authorRow}>
        <Avatar
          uri={giver.avatar}
          firstName={giver.firstName}
          lastName={giver.lastName}
          size={50}
        />
        <View style={s.authorInfo}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {giver.firstName} {giver.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            {roleLabel}
          </AppText>
          {!!location && (
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
              {location}
            </AppText>
          )}
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            {fmtDate(review.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <View style={s.ratingCol}>
          <StarRow rating={review.rating} size={14} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, textAlign: "right", marginTop: 2 }}
          >
            {review.rating}/5
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Comment */}
      {!!review.comment && (
        <View style={[s.quoteRow, { borderLeftColor: c.orange }]}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ color: c.text, fontStyle: "italic" }}
          >
            "{review.comment}"
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Booking chip */}
      {booking && (
        <View
          style={[
            s.bookingChip,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {!!booking.category?.icon && (
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, marginRight: 6 }}>
              {booking.category.icon}
            </AppText>
          )}
          <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {booking.title}
          </AppText>
          {booking.category?.name && (
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 6 }}
            >
              {booking.category.name}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorkerReviewsScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);

  const load = useCallback(async (pg = 1, replace = true) => {
    try {
      const d = await getMyReceivedReviews({ page: pg, limit: 15 });
      setData(d);
      setReviews(
        replace ? (d.reviews ?? []) : (prev) => [...prev, ...(d.reviews ?? [])],
      );
      setTotalPages(d.pages ?? 1);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("workerReviews.error.loadFailed"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load(1, true);
  }, [load]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setPage(1);
    load(1, true);
  };
  const loadMore = () => {
    if (page < totalPages && !loading) {
      const next = page + 1;
      setPage(next);
      load(next, false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={[screen.wrap, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={reviews}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={screen.content}
        onEndReached={loadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.4}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* Page header */}
            <View style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
              <AppText
                weight="displayBlack"
                style={{ fontSize: 34, color: c.text, marginBottom: 4 }}
              >
                {t("workerReviews.title")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ lineHeight: 22 }}>
                {t("workerReviews.subtitle")}
              </AppText>
            </View>

            {/* Rating summary */}
            {data && data.totalReviews > 0 && (
              <View style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                <RatingSummaryCard
                  avgRating={data.avgRating ?? 0}
                  totalReviews={data.totalReviews ?? 0}
                  distribution={data.distribution ?? {}}
                  c={c}
                />
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => <ReviewCard review={item} c={c} />}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={screen.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>⭐</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                {t("workerReviews.empty.noReviews")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ marginTop: 6, textAlign: "center" }}
              >
                {t("workerReviews.empty.noReviewsSub")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", padding: 20 }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : reviews.length > 0 ? (
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ textAlign: "center", paddingVertical: 16 }}
            >
              {t("workerReviews.footer.loaded", {
                count: data?.totalReviews ?? reviews.length,
              })}
            </AppText>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
          )
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}

// src/store/authStore.js
// Mirror of the website's `useAuthStore` adapted for React Native:
//   - tokens live in SecureStore (via tokenStore)
//   - user lives in AsyncStorage so we can rehydrate quickly on app open

import { create } from "zustand";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import api, { tokenStore, getErrorMessage } from "../api/client";

const USER_KEY = "@skilledproz:user";

export const useAuthStore = create((set, get) => ({
  user: null,
  isLoading: false,
  isHydrated: false,

  // Rehydrate user + decide auth state on app launch
  hydrate: async () => {
    try {
      const [rawUser, access] = await Promise.all([
        AsyncStorage.getItem(USER_KEY),
        tokenStore.getAccess(),
      ]);
      const cachedUser = rawUser ? JSON.parse(rawUser) : null;
      // Show cached user immediately for snappy UX
      set({ user: cachedUser });

      if (access) {
        // Validate by fetching /auth/me - this also picks up server-side updates
        try {
          const { data } = await api.get("/auth/me");
          set({ user: data.data });
          await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(data.data));
        } catch {
          // Token invalid or refresh failed - clear
          await get().clearAuth();
        }
      }
    } finally {
      set({ isHydrated: true });
    }
  },

  setAuth: async (user, accessToken, refreshToken) => {
    await tokenStore.setTokens(accessToken, refreshToken);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
    set({ user });
  },

  updateUser: async (patch) => {
    const next = { ...(get().user || {}), ...patch };
    set({ user: next });
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch {}
  },

  clearAuth: async () => {
    await tokenStore.clear();
    await AsyncStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
    set({ user: null });
  },

  fetchMe: async () => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.get("/auth/me");
      set({ user: data.data });
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(data.data));
      return data.data;
    } catch {
      await get().clearAuth();
      return null;
    }
  },

  login: async (email, password) => {
    set({ isLoading: true });
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/login", { email, password });
      const { user, accessToken, refreshToken } = data.data;
      await get().setAuth(user, accessToken, refreshToken);
      return user;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Login failed"));
    } finally {
      set({ isLoading: false });
    }
  },

  // ✅ Google Sign-In — accepts idToken from the native Google SDK
  googleSignIn: async ({ idToken, ref }) => {
    set({ isLoading: true });
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/google", {
        idToken,
        ...(ref ? { ref } : {}),
      });

      // Backend responses can take two shapes:
      //   1. { user, accessToken, refreshToken } — existing account
      //   2. { needsRole: true, googleProfile } — new user, must pick role
      const payload = data.data || data;

      if (payload.needsRole) {
        return payload;
      }

      const { user, accessToken, refreshToken } = payload;
      if (!user || !accessToken) {
        throw new Error("Google sign-in response missing tokens");
      }

      await get().setAuth(user, accessToken, refreshToken);
      return payload;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Google sign-in failed"));
    } finally {
      set({ isLoading: false });
    }
  },

  register: async (payload) => {
    set({ isLoading: true });
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/register", payload);
      const { user, accessToken, refreshToken } = data.data;
      await get().setAuth(user, accessToken, refreshToken);
      return user;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Registration failed"));
    } finally {
      set({ isLoading: false });
    }
  },

  logout: async () => {
    try {
      await api.post("/auth/logout");
    } catch {}
    await get().clearAuth();
  },

  forgotPassword: async (email) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/forgot-password", { email });
      return data;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Could not send reset link"));
    }
  },

  resetPassword: async (token, password) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/reset-password", {
        token,
        password,
      });
      return data;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Could not reset password"));
    }
  },

  resendVerification: async (email) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/resend-verification", { email });
      return data;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Could not resend verification"));
    }
  },
}));

=== FILE: src/store/supportStore.js ===
// src/store/supportStore.js
//
// Single source of truth for "how many support items need my attention?".
//
// Counts:
//   unreadTickets → tickets with status OPEN or IN_REVIEW (needs your action)
//   unreadChats   → live chat threads the user hasn't read
//   unreadCount   → unreadTickets + unreadChats (this is what the drawer
//                    badges read, and matches the website's supportStore API)
//
// Both endpoints are called on refresh(); if either 404s or throws, we
// silently fall back to 0 so the drawer never crashes.

import { create } from "zustand";
import { getMyTickets, getMyChats } from "../api/support";

// Ticket statuses that count as "needs attention". Adjust if your backend
// uses different names (e.g. "PENDING", "NEW").
const OPEN_TICKET_STATUSES = new Set(["OPEN", "IN_REVIEW", "REVIEW"]);

// Reduce a list of tickets to the count of ones needing action.
function countTickets(tickets) {
  if (!Array.isArray(tickets)) return 0;
  return tickets.filter((tk) => {
    const status = String(tk?.status ?? "").toUpperCase();
    if (!OPEN_TICKET_STATUSES.has(status)) return false;
    // If the backend marks per-user unread, respect it
    if (typeof tk?.unreadForUser === "boolean") return tk.unreadForUser;
    if (typeof tk?.unreadCount === "number") return tk.unreadCount > 0;
    // Otherwise assume any OPEN ticket is unread for the user
    return true;
  }).length;
}

// Reduce a list of chat threads to the count with unread messages.
function countChats(chats) {
  if (!Array.isArray(chats)) return 0;
  return chats.filter((ch) => {
    if (typeof ch?.unreadForUser === "boolean") return ch.unreadForUser;
    if (typeof ch?.unreadCount === "number") return ch.unreadCount > 0;
    // Chat thread shape: if lastMessage.author !== currentUser, treat as unread
    // — but we can't know the current user id here, so just count OPEN chats.
    const status = String(ch?.status ?? "").toUpperCase();
    return status === "ACTIVE" || status === "OPEN";
  }).length;
}

export const useSupportStore = create((set, get) => ({
  unreadTickets: 0,
  unreadChats: 0,
  unreadCount: 0,
  loading: false,
  lastFetchedAt: null,

  refresh: async () => {
    set({ loading: true });

    // Both endpoints hit in parallel; a failure on one doesn't block the other.
    const [ticketsRes, chatsRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
      getMyTickets(),
      getMyChats(),
    ]);

    const tickets =
      ticketsRes.status === "fulfilled"
        ? (ticketsRes.value?.tickets ?? ticketsRes.value ?? [])
        : [];
    const chats =
      chatsRes.status === "fulfilled"
        ? (chatsRes.value?.chats ?? chatsRes.value ?? [])
        : [];

    const unreadTickets = countTickets(tickets);
    const unreadChats = countChats(chats);

    set({
      unreadTickets,
      unreadChats,
      unreadCount: unreadTickets + unreadChats,
      loading: false,
      lastFetchedAt: Date.now(),
    });

    return {
      unreadTickets,
      unreadChats,
      unreadCount: unreadTickets + unreadChats,
    };
  },

  // Optimistic "clear badge" after opening a support screen. Use this from
  // SupportChat / SupportHub when you know the user just read everything.
  clearTickets: () => {
    const { unreadChats } = get();
    set({ unreadTickets: 0, unreadCount: unreadChats });
  },
  clearChats: () => {
    const { unreadTickets } = get();
    set({ unreadChats: 0, unreadCount: unreadTickets });
  },
  clearAll: () => set({ unreadTickets: 0, unreadChats: 0, unreadCount: 0 }),
}));

=== END: src/store/supportStore.js ===

// src/utils/formatDuration.js
//
// Convert a numeric value in a given unit to hours.
// Mirrors the same math used by PostJob.jsx so the display stays
// consistent with what the hirer typed.
//
// Multipliers (must match PostJob.jsx):
//   1 day   = 8 hours
//   1 week  = 56 hours    (8 × 7)
//   1 month = 242.5 hours (56 × 4.33)
//   1 year  = 2910 hours  (242.5 × 12)

function toHours(n, unit) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return null;
  if (unit === "hours") return n;
  if (unit === "days") return n * 8;
  if (unit === "weeks") return n * 56;
  if (unit === "months") return n * 242.5;
  if (unit === "years") return n * 2910;
  return null;
}

function fromHours(hours, unit) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(hours)) return null;
  if (unit === "hours") return hours;
  if (unit === "days") return hours / 8;
  if (unit === "weeks") return hours / 56;
  if (unit === "months") return hours / 242.5;
  if (unit === "years") return hours / 2910;
  return hours;
}

/** Trim trailing zeros from decimals — 1.0 → 1, 2.50 → 2.5 */
function tidy(n) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return n;
  return Number.isInteger(n) ? n : Number(n.toFixed(1));
}

// Icons are represented by react-icons names so the UI layer chooses
// the actual <Fa…/> component. No emoji in the codebase.
const UNIT_CONFIG = {
  hours: { s: "hour", p: "hours", icon: "clock" },
  days: { s: "day", p: "days", icon: "calendar" },
  weeks: { s: "week", p: "weeks", icon: "calendar-week" },
  months: { s: "month", p: "months", icon: "calendar-alt" },
  years: { s: "year", p: "years", icon: "calendar-check" },
};

function resolveCount(job, unit) {
  const value = job?.estimatedValue;
  const hours = job?.estimatedHours;

  const num = value != null && value !== "" ? parseFloat(value) : null;
  if (Number.isFinite(num) && num > 0) return num;

  const h = Number(hours);
  if (Number.isFinite(h) && h > 0) {
    return fromHours(h, unit);
  }

  return null;
}

export function formatJobDuration(job) {
  if (!job) return null;

  const unit = job.estimatedUnit || "hours";

  if (unit === "custom") return job.estimatedValue || null;

  const c = UNIT_CONFIG[unit] || UNIT_CONFIG.hours;
  const count = resolveCount(job, unit);
  if (!count) return null;

  const primary = `${tidy(count)} ${count === 1 ? c.s : c.p}`;

  const equivParts = [];

  if (unit === "years") {
    equivParts.push(`${tidy(count * 12)} mo`);
    equivParts.push(`≈${tidy(count * 2910)}h`);
  } else if (unit === "months") {
    equivParts.push(`${tidy(count * 4.33)} wk`);
    equivParts.push(`≈${tidy(count * 242.5)}h`);
  } else if (unit === "weeks") {
    equivParts.push(`${tidy(count * 7)} day${count * 7 !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
    equivParts.push(`≈${tidy(count * 56)}h`);
  } else if (unit === "days") {
    equivParts.push(`≈${tidy(count * 8)}h`);
    if (count >= 7) equivParts.push(`${tidy(count / 7)} wk`);
  } else if (unit === "hours" && count >= 8) {
    equivParts.push(`≈${tidy(count / 8)} day${count / 8 !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
  }

  const suffix = equivParts.length > 0 ? ` (${equivParts.join(", ")})` : "";
  return `${primary}${suffix}`;
}

export function formatJobDurationParts(job) {
  if (!job) return null;

  const unit = job.estimatedUnit || "hours";

  if (unit === "custom") {
    return job.estimatedValue
      ? {
          primary: job.estimatedValue,
          icon: "file-alt",
          equivalents: [],
          unit: "custom",
        }
      : null;
  }

  const c = UNIT_CONFIG[unit] || UNIT_CONFIG.hours;
  const count = resolveCount(job, unit);
  if (!count) return null;

  const primary = `${tidy(count)} ${count === 1 ? c.s : c.p}`;
  const equivalents = [];

  if (unit === "years") {
    equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count * 12)} months`, unit: "months" });
    equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count * 52)} weeks`, unit: "weeks" });
  } else if (unit === "months") {
    equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count * 4.33)} weeks`, unit: "weeks" });
    equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count * 242.5)} hrs`, unit: "hours" });
  } else if (unit === "weeks") {
    equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count * 7)} days`, unit: "days" });
    equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count * 56)} hrs`, unit: "hours" });
  } else if (unit === "days") {
    equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count * 8)} hrs`, unit: "hours" });
    if (count >= 7) {
      equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count / 7)} wks`, unit: "weeks" });
    }
  } else if (unit === "hours" && count >= 8) {
    equivalents.push({ label: `${tidy(count / 8)} days`, unit: "days" });
  }

  return { primary, icon: c.icon, equivalents, unit, count };
}

// src/utils/pricing.js
//
// Verbatim port of the web pricing utility. This is the SINGLE source of
// truth for fee rates and the calcPricing pipeline — used by BookingDetail,
// BookingDetailPayment, WorkerPaymentPreview, and the dashboard Total Spent
// footnote.
//
// Rule (matches web exactly):
//   · NGN (local currency) → 2% fee, 98% to worker
//   · Any other currency   → 5% fee, 95% to worker
//
// Do NOT hardcode percentages anywhere else. Call getHirerFeeRate(currency).

const NGN_RATE = 0.03;
const FOREIGN_RATE = 0.06;

/**
 * Fee rate charged to the HIRER for the given currency.
 * Returns a decimal, e.g. 0.02 for 2% or 0.05 for 5%.
 */
export function getHirerFeeRate(currency = "NGN") {
  return String(currency).toUpperCase() === "NGN" ? NGN_RATE : FOREIGN_RATE;
}

// ── Normalize a booking's rate + quantity into a subtotal ────────────────────
function normalizeQuantity(booking) {
  const unit = booking?.estimatedUnit || "hours";
  const rawValue = booking?.estimatedValue;
  const rawHours = booking?.estimatedHours;

  // Custom duration → no arithmetic, treat estimatedValue as the human label
  if (unit === "custom") {
    return {
      unit,
      hasQty: false,
      qty: null,
      unitLabel: "custom",
      unitSuffix: "",
      subtotal: Number(booking?.agreedRate) || 0,
    };
  }

  // Negotiated bookings use negotiatedRate as the whole total (no * qty)
  if (booking?.isNegotiated && booking?.negotiatedRate) {
    return {
      unit,
      hasQty: false,
      qty: null,
      unitLabel: unit,
      unitSuffix: suffixForUnit(unit),
      subtotal: Number(booking.negotiatedRate) || 0,
    };
  }

  // Direct bookings: parse estimatedValue or estimatedHours into qty
  let qty = null;
  if (rawValue) qty = parseFloat(rawValue);
  else if (rawHours) qty = parseFloat(rawHours);

  const agreedRate = Number(booking?.agreedRate) || 0;

  // If we have a valid qty, subtotal = qty × rate; otherwise subtotal = rate
  const hasQty = Number.isFinite(qty) && qty > 0;
  const subtotal = hasQty ? qty * agreedRate : agreedRate;

  return {
    unit,
    hasQty,
    qty: hasQty ? qty : null,
    unitLabel:
      unit === "hours"
        ? "hour"
        : unit === "days"
          ? "day"
          : unit === "weeks"
            ? "week"
            : unit === "months"
              ? "month"
              : unit,
    unitSuffix: suffixForUnit(unit),
    subtotal,
  };
}

function suffixForUnit(unit) {
  switch (unit) {
    case "hours":
      return "/hr";
    case "days":
      return "/day";
    case "weeks":
      return "/wk";
    case "months":
      return "/mo";
    default:
      return "";
  }
}

/**
 * Full pricing pipeline. Given a booking, returns:
 *   { subtotal, hirerFee, grossTotal, workerPayout, currency,
 *     agreedRate, unit, hasQty, qty, unitLabel, unitSuffix }
 *
 * Never throws — bad data yields sensible zeros.
 */
export function calcPricing(booking) {
  if (!booking) {
    return {
      subtotal: 0,
      hirerFee: 0,
      grossTotal: 0,
      workerPayout: 0,
      currency: "NGN",
      agreedRate: 0,
      unit: "hours",
      hasQty: false,
      qty: null,
      unitLabel: "hour",
      unitSuffix: "/hr",
    };
  }

  const currency = booking.currency || "NGN";
  const feeRate = getHirerFeeRate(currency);
  const q = normalizeQuantity(booking);
  const subtotal = q.subtotal;

  // Two possible pricing models:
  //   1. Rate × qty → hirer pays subtotal + fee, worker gets subtotal
  //   2. Job post / negotiated → total is fixed; worker gets total, hirer
  //      pays total + fee
  //
  // Both cases agree that:
  //   hirerFee    = feeRate × (what worker receives)
  //   grossTotal  = worker_receives + hirerFee
  //
  // For "rate × qty" case, what the worker receives = subtotal.
  // For "fixed total" case, what the worker receives = subtotal (agreedRate).
  const workerPayout = subtotal;
  const hirerFee = Math.round(workerPayout * feeRate * 100) / 100;
  const grossTotal = Math.round((workerPayout + hirerFee) * 100) / 100;

  return {
    subtotal,
    hirerFee,
    grossTotal,
    workerPayout,
    currency,
    agreedRate: Number(booking.agreedRate) || 0,
    unit: q.unit,
    hasQty: q.hasQty,
    qty: q.qty,
    unitLabel: q.unitLabel,
    unitSuffix: q.unitSuffix,
  };
}

// sync-locales-from-files.js
// Collects all translation keys from all locale files,
// then ensures every language file contains every key.

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const LOCALE_DIR = "./src/i18n/locales";

// All languages you want to support
const LANGUAGES = [
  "en",
  "es",
  "fr",
  "ar",
  "pt",
  "zh",
  "ha",
  "yo",
  "ig",
  "de",
  "it",
  "hi",
];

const placeholder = (key, lang) => `[TODO: Translate to ${lang}] ${key}`;

// -------- Read all existing files and collect the union of keys --------
const allData = {};
const allKeysSet = new Set();

LANGUAGES.forEach((lang) => {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALE_DIR, `${lang}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      const content = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));
      allData[lang] = content;
      Object.keys(content).forEach((key) => allKeysSet.add(key));
      console.log(
        `📖 Loaded ${lang}.json (${Object.keys(content).length} keys)`,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`⚠️  Could not parse ${lang}.json – starting empty.`);
      allData[lang] = {};
    }
  } else {
    console.log(`🆕 Creating new file for ${lang}.`);
    allData[lang] = {};
  }
});

const allKeys = Array.from(allKeysSet).sort();
console.log(`\n✅ Collected ${allKeys.length} unique keys from all files.\n`);

// -------- For each language, add missing keys and write back --------
LANGUAGES.forEach((lang) => {
  const existing = allData[lang] || {};
  let addedCount = 0;

  allKeys.forEach((key) => {
    if (!existing.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
      existing[key] = placeholder(key, lang);
      addedCount++;
    }
  });

  // Sort alphabetically
  const sorted = {};
  Object.keys(existing)
    .sort()
    .forEach((k) => {
      sorted[k] = existing[k];
    });

  const filePath = path.join(LOCALE_DIR, `${lang}.json`);
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(sorted, null, 2), "utf8");
  console.log(
    `✅ ${lang}.json → ${Object.keys(sorted).length} keys (${addedCount} added)`,
  );
});

console.log(
  "\n🎉 All locale files are now in sync with the union of all keys.",
);
console.log("💡 Replace the placeholders with real translations.");

// sync-locales.js
// Extracts ALL translation keys from the audit file, regardless of structure,
// and ensures every locale file contains every key.

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

// -------- CONFIGURATION --------
const LOCALE_DIR = "./src/i18n/locales";
const AUDIT_FILE = "./full-audit-report.json";

const LANGUAGES = [
  "en",
  "es",
  "fr",
  "ar",
  "pt",
  "zh",
  "ha",
  "yo",
  "ig",
  "de",
  "it",
  "hi",
];

const makePlaceholder = (key, lang) => `[TODO: Translate to ${lang}] ${key}`;

// -------- EXTRACT ALL KEYS FROM AUDIT (FLEXIBLE) --------
function extractAllKeys(audit) {
  // If it's an array, use it directly
  if (Array.isArray(audit)) return audit;

  // If it has a details.en.missingKeys, use that
  if (audit.details?.en?.missingKeys) {
    return audit.details.en.missingKeys;
  }

  // If it's a plain object (keys are the translation keys), return Object.keys
  if (typeof audit === "object" && audit !== null) {
    // Check if it looks like a key-value store (no nested "details")
    const sampleKey = Object.keys(audit)[0];
    if (sampleKey && typeof audit[sampleKey] === "string") {
      return Object.keys(audit);
    }
  }

  // Fallback: traverse and collect all string keys recursively (deep)
  const keys = [];
  function traverse(obj, prefix = "") {
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      // Not expected, but skip arrays
      return;
    }
    if (obj && typeof obj === "object") {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
        const fullKey = prefix ? `${prefix}.${k}` : k;
        if (typeof v === "string") {
          keys.push(fullKey);
        } else if (typeof v === "object" && v !== null) {
          traverse(v, fullKey);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  traverse(audit);
  return keys;
}

// -------- MAIN --------
let allKeys = [];
try {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(AUDIT_FILE, "utf8");
  const audit = JSON.parse(raw);
  allKeys = extractAllKeys(audit);
  console.log(`✅ Extracted ${allKeys.length} keys from audit.`);
} catch (err) {
  console.error("❌ Failed to read or parse audit file:", err.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

if (allKeys.length === 0) {
  console.error("❌ No keys found in audit. Check the file format.");
  process.exit(1);
}

// -------- PROCESS EACH LANGUAGE --------
LANGUAGES.forEach((lang) => {
  const filePath = path.join(LOCALE_DIR, `${lang}.json`);
  let existing = {};

  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    try {
      existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8"));
      console.log(
        `📖 Loaded ${lang}.json (${Object.keys(existing).length} keys)`,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`⚠️  Could not parse ${lang}.json – starting fresh.`);
      existing = {};
    }
  } else {
    console.log(`🆕 Creating new file for ${lang}.`);
  }

  let addedCount = 0;
  allKeys.forEach((key) => {
    if (!existing.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
      existing[key] = makePlaceholder(key, lang);
      addedCount++;
    }
  });

  const sorted = {};
  Object.keys(existing)
    .sort()
    .forEach((k) => {
      sorted[k] = existing[k];
    });

  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(sorted, null, 2), "utf8");
  console.log(
    `✅ ${lang}.json updated → ${Object.keys(sorted).length} keys (${addedCount} added)`,
  );
});

console.log("\n🎉 All locale files are now complete.");
console.log("💡 Replace placeholders with real translations as needed.");
